The ascetics look towards him as Shiva, with sustenance of air, and the bard considers him a weapons-wielder.103.
For the night he is the moon and for day he is the sun.
The Ganas marked him as Rudra and the gods saw him as Indra.104.
The Vedas comprehended him as Brahman, the Brahmins considered him as Vyas.
Vishnu visualized him as the Immanent Lord, and Sita sees him as Ram.105.
Sita looks towards him as Ram, being pierced by Cupid’s arrow.
She fell down swinging on the earth like a roaming drunkeard.106.
She gained consciousness and arose like a great warrior.
She kept her eyes concentrated like that off a Chakori (a hill bird) on the moon.107.
Both were attached to each other and none on them faltered.
They stood firmly like the warrior in the battlefield.108.
The messengers were sent in the fort who went swiftly like Hanuman, the son of wind-god.
Gauree, Fifth Mehl:
You alone are my Chief Advisor.
I serve You with the Support of the Guru. ||1||Pause||
By various devices, I could not find You.
Taking hold of me, the Guru has made me Your slave. ||1||
I have conquered the five tyrants.
By Guru's Grace, I have vanquished the army of evil. ||2||
I have received the One Name as His bounty and blessing.
Now, I dwell in peace, poise and bliss. ||3||
Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

210.g: ਮਨ ਧਰ ਤਰਬੇ; ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਨੋ ॥
210.e: O mind, cross over with the Support of the Lord's Name.

210.g: ਸਾਗਰ ਲਹਰਿ. ਸੰਸਾ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ; ਗੁਰੁ ਬੋਹਿਥੁ ਪਾਰ ਗਰਾਮਨੋ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
210.e: The Guru is the boat to carry you across the world-ocean, through the waves of cynicism and doubt. ||1||Pause||
In this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, there is only pitch darkness.
The lamp of the Guru's spiritual wisdom illuminates and enlightens. ||1||
The poison of corruption is spread out far and wide.
Only the virtuous are saved, chanting and meditating on the Lord. ||2||
Intoxicated with Maya, the people are asleep.
Meeting the Guru, doubt and fear are dispelled. ||3||
Says Nanak, meditate on the One Lord;
behold Him in each and every heart. ||4||2||140||

211.e: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:
I am a sacrifice, dedicated hundreds of thousands of times, to my Lord and Master.

211.g: ਨਾਮੋ ਹੋ, ਨਾਮੁ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਕੋ; ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਅਧਰੀਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
211.e: His Name, and His Name alone, is the Support of the breath of life. ||1||Pause||
You alone are the Doer, the Cause of causes.
You are the Support of all beings and creatures. ||1||
O God, You are my power, authority and youth.
You are absolute, without attributes, and also related, with the most sublime attributes. ||2||
Here and hereafter, You are my Savior and Protector.
By Guru's Grace, some understand You. ||3||
God is All-knowing, the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts.
You are Nanak's strength and support. ||4||5||143||
The saw was placed after showing it to the gathered kings.109.
Ram took it in his hand, the hero (Ram) was filled with pride.
He pulled it smilingly and broke it into two parts.110.
All the gods were pleased and a loot of flowers were showered.
Other kings felt shy and went back to their countries.111.
Then the princess, the most fortunate in three worlds.
Garlanded Ram and wedded him as her spouse.112.
Gauree, Fifth Mehl:
With your tongue, chant the Name of the One Lord.

211.g: ਈਹਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਆਨੰਦੁ ਘਨਾ; ਆਗੈ ਜੀਅ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਕਾਮ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
211.e: In this world, it shall bring you peace, comfort and great joy; hereafter, it shall go with your soul, and shall be of use to you. ||1||Pause||
The disease of your ego shall be eradicated.

211.g: ਤੂੰ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ; ਕਰਿ ਰਾਜ ਜੋਗੁ ॥੧॥
211.e: By Guru's Grace, practice Raja Yoga, the Yoga of meditation and success. ||1||
Those who taste the sublime essence of the Lord
have their thirst quenched. ||2||
Those who have found the Lord, the Treasure of peace,

211.g: ਸੋ ਬਹੁਰਿ; ਨ ਕਤ ਹੀ ਧਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
211.e: shall not go anywhere else again. ||3||

211.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ; ਜਾ ਕਉ ਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਆ ॥
211.e: Those, unto whom the Guru has given the Lord's Name, Har, Har
- O Nanak, their fears are removed. ||4||8||146||
BHUJNAG PRAYYAT STANZA

211.g: ਕਿਧੌ ਦੇਵ ਕੰਨਿਆ ਕਿਧੌ ਬਾਸਵੀ ਹੈ ॥

211.e: Sita appeared like the daughter of a god or Indra, daughter of a Naga, daughter of a Yaksha or daughter of a Kinnar.

211.g: ਕਿਧੌ ਗੰਧ੍ਰਬੀ ਦੈਤ ਜਾ ਦੇਵਤਾ ਸੀ ॥
ਕਿਧੌ ਸੂਰਜਾ ਸੁਧ ਸੋਧੀ ਸੁਧਾ ਸੀ ॥੧੧੩॥
211.e: She looked like the daughter of a Gandharva, daughter of a demon or goddess. She appeared like the daughter of Sum or like the ambrosial light of the Moon.113.

211.g: ਕਿਧੌ ਜਛ ਬਿਦਿਆ ਧਰੀ ਗੰਧ੍ਰਬੀ ਹੈ ॥
ਕਿਧੌ ਰਾਗਨੀ ਭਾਗ ਪੂਰੇ ਰਚੀ ਹੈ ॥
211.e: She appeared like a Gandharva woman, having obtained the learning of Yakshas or a complete creation of a Ragini (musical mode).

211.g: ਕਿਧੌ ਸੁਵਰਨ ਕੀ ਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਕੀ ਪੁਤ੍ਰਕਾ ਹੈ ॥
ਕਿਧੌ ਕਾਮ ਕੀ ਕਾਮਨੀ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰਭਾ ਹੈ ॥੧੧੪॥
211.e: She looked like a golden puppet or the glory of a beautiful lady, full of passion.114.

211.g: ਕਿਧੌ ਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਕੀ ਪੁਤ੍ਰਕਾ ਸੀ ਬਨੀ ਹੈ ॥

211.e: She appeared like a puppet exquisite a Padmini (different gradations of a woman).

211.g: ਕਿਧੌ ਰਾਗ ਪੂਰੇ ਭਰੀ ਰਾਗ ਮਾਲਾ ॥
ਬਰੀ ਰਾਮ ਤੈਸੀ ਸੀਆ ਆਜ ਬਾਲਾ ॥੧੧੫॥
211.e: She looked like Ragmala, studded completely with Ragas (musical modes), and Ram wedded such a beautiful Sita.115.

211.g: ਛਕੇ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਦੋਨੋ ਲਗੇ ਨੈਨ ਐਸੇ ॥

211.e: Having been absorbed in love for each other.

211.g: ਬਿਧੁੰ ਬਾਕ ਬੈਣੀ ਕਟੰ ਦੇਸ ਛੀਣੰ ॥

211.e: Sita of sweet speech and slim waist and visually absorbed with Ram, is looking exquisitely beautiful.116.

211.g: ਜਿਣੀ ਰਾਮ ਸੀਤਾ ਸੁਣੀ ਸ੍ਰਉਣ ਰਾਮੰ ॥
ਗਹੇ ਸਸਤ੍ਰ ਅਸਤ੍ਰੰ ਰਿਸਯੋ ਤਉਨ ਜਾਮੰ ॥
211.e: When Parashuram heard this that Ram hath conquered Sita, he at that time, in great ire, held up his arms and weapons.

211.g: ਕਹਾ ਜਾਤ, ਭਾਖਿਯੋ; ਰਹੋ ਰਾਮ, ਠਾਢੇ ॥
ਲਖੋ ਆਜ ਕੈਸੇ ਭਏ ਬੀਰ ਗਾਢੇ ॥੧੧੭॥
211.e: He asked Ram to stop there and challenged him saying.”I shall now see, what type of hero thou art.”117.
Gauree, Fifth Mehl:
Worship and adore the Lord, Har, Har, Har.

211.g: ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ; ਭਰਮੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਭਉ. ਸਾਧੀਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
211.e: In the Society of the Saints, He dwells in the mind; doubt, emotional attachment and fear are vanquished. ||1||Pause||
The Vedas, the Puraanas and the Simritees are heard to proclaim
that the Lord's servant dwells as the highest of all. ||1||
All places are filled with fear - know this well.
Only the Lord's servants are free of fear. ||2||
People wander through 8.4 million incarnations.
God's people are not subject to birth and death. ||3||
He has given up power, wisdom, cleverness and egotism.
Nanak has taken to the Sanctuary of the Lord's Holy Saints. ||4||6||144||
Gauree, Fifth Mehl:
Hey, soul: your only Support is the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

211.g: ਅਵਰੁ ਜਿ ਕਰਨ ਕਰਾਵਨੋ; ਤਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਭਉ ਹੈ ਜਾਮ ਕਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
211.e: Whatever else you do or make happen, the fear of death still hangs over you. ||1||Pause||
He is not obtained by any other efforts.
By great good fortune, meditate on the Lord. ||1||
You may know hundreds of thousands of clever tricks,
but not even one will be of any use at all hereafter. ||2||
Good deeds done in the pride of ego are swept away,
Like the house of sand by water. ||3||
When God the Merciful shows His Mercy,
Nanak receives the Naam in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||4||4||142||
Bhakha Pingal Di (The language of prosody):
SUNDARI STANZA
The warriors raised loud shouts and the terrible trumpets resounded.
There were war-cries in the battlefield and the warriors, being pleased began to hurl their shields up and down.118.
The warriors with twined whiskers gathered together for war and fought with each other discharging dreadful shower of arrows.
The fighters drenched with blood began to fell and the horses were being crushed in the battlefield.119.
The sound of the drums of Yoginis was being heard and the double-edged daggers glistened.
The slaves of God are good.
O Nanak, their faces are radiant. ||4||3||141||
Gauree, Fifth Mehl:
O my mind, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord's Name.

211.g: ਨੀਤ ਨੀਤ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵੀਐ; ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
211.e: Serve the Lord continually and continuously; with each and every breath, meditate on the Lord. ||1||Pause||
In the Society of the Saints, the Lord dwells in the mind,
and pain, suffering, darkness and doubt depart. ||1||
That humble being, who meditates on the Lord,
By the Grace of the Saints, is not afflicted with pain. ||2||

211.g: ਜਾ ਕਉ; ਗੁਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਦੇ ॥
211.e: Those unto whom the Guru gives the Mantra of the Lord's Name,
are saved from the fire of Maya. ||3||
Be kind to Nanak, O God;
let the Lord's Name dwell within my mind and body. ||4||7||145||

212.e: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:
Is there anyone, who can shatter his ego,

212.g: ਇਸੁ ਮੀਠੀ ਤੇ; ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਹੋਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
212.e: and turn his mind away from this sweet Maya? ||1||Pause||

212.g: ਅਗਿਆਨੀ ਮਾਨੁਖੁ ਭਇਆ; ਜੋ ਨਾਹੀ. ਸੋ ਲੋਰੈ ॥
212.e: Humanity is in spiritual ignorance; people see things that do not exist.

212.g: ਰੈਣਿ ਅੰਧਾਰੀ ਕਾਰੀਆ; ਕਵਨ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਜਿਤੁ ਭੋਰੈ ॥੧॥
212.e: The night is dark and gloomy; how will the morning dawn? ||1||

212.g: ਭ੍ਰਮਤੋ ਭ੍ਰਮਤੋ ਹਾਰਿਆ; ਅਨਿਕ ਬਿਧੀ ਕਰਿ ਟੋਰੈ ॥
212.e: Wandering, wandering all around, I have grown weary; trying all sorts of things, I have been searching.

212.g: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ. ਕਿਰਪਾ ਭਈ; ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਨਿਧਿ ਮੋਰੈ ॥੨॥੧੨॥੧੫੦॥
212.e: Says Nanak, He has shown mercy to me; I have found the treasure of the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||2||12||150||
MADHUR DHUN STANZA
Parashuram, who had abandoned his desires created a sensation in all the four directions,
And began to discharge arrows like the brave fighers.128.
Observing his fury, the men of wisdom, meditated on the Lord,
And began to repeat the name of Lord, trembling with fear.129.
Agonised by extreme rage, the intellect was destroyed.
A stream of arrows flowed from his hands and with them the life-breath of opponents was removed.130.
Holding their arrows in their hand s and filled with pride,
The warriors are imposing them in the hearts of the enemies like the hoeing of the earth by the gardener.131.
All tremble on account of the fury by the warriors and because of their activities in respect of warfare.
Gauree, Fifth Mehl:
Your pride is so great, but what about your origins?
You cannot remain, no matter how much you try to hold on. ||1||Pause||

212.g: ਬੇਬਰਜਤ, ਬੇਦ ਸੰਤਨਾ; ਉਆਹੂ ਸਿਉ. ਰੇ ਹਿਤਨੋ ॥
212.e: That which is forbidden by the Vedas and the Saints - with that, you are in love.

212.g: ਹਾਰ ਜੂਆਰ ਜੂਆ ਬਿਧੇ; ਇੰਦ੍ਰੀ ਵਸਿ ਲੈ. ਜਿਤਨੋ ॥੧॥
212.e: Like the gambler losing the game of chance, you are held in the power of sensory desires. ||1||

212.g: ਹਰਨ ਭਰਨ ਸੰਪੂਰਨਾ; ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਰੰਗਿ, ਰਿਤਨੋ ॥
212.e: The One who is All-powerful to empty out and fill up - you have no love for His Lotus Feet.

212.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਉਧਰੇ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ; ਕਿਰਪਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਮੈ ਦਿਤਨੋ ॥੨॥੧੦॥੧੪੮॥
212.e: O Nanak, I have been saved, in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. I have been blessed by the Treasure of Mercy. ||2||10||148||
Gauree Poorbee, Fifth Mehl:

212.g: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ; ਸਰਣਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਏ ॥
212.e: O my mind, in the Sanctuary of God, peace is found.

212.g: ਜਾ ਦਿਨਿ ਬਿਸਰੈ. ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ; ਸੋ ਦਿਨੁ ਜਾਤ ਅਜਾਏ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
212.e: That day, when the Giver of life and peace is forgotten - that day passes uselessly. ||1||Pause||

212.g: ਏਕ ਰੈਣ ਕੇ ਪਾਹੁਨ ਤੁਮ ਆਏ; ਬਹੁ ਜੁਗ ਆਸ ਬਧਾਏ ॥
212.e: You have come as a guest for one short night, and yet you hope to live for many ages.

212.g: ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਮੰਦਰ ਸੰਪੈ ਜੋ ਦੀਸੈ; ਜਿਉ ਤਰਵਰ ਕੀ ਛਾਏ ॥੧॥
212.e: Households, mansions and wealth - whatever is seen, is like the shade of a tree. ||1||

212.g: ਤਨੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਸੰਪੈ ਸਭ ਮੇਰੀ; ਬਾਗ ਮਿਲਖ ਸਭ ਜਾਏ ॥
212.e: My body, wealth, and all my gardens and property shall all pass away.

212.g: ਦੇਵਨਹਾਰਾ ਬਿਸਰਿਓ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ; ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਹੋਤ ਪਰਾਏ ॥੨॥
212.e: You have forgotten your Lord and Master, the Great Giver. In an instant, these shall belong to somebody else. ||2||
Gauree, Fifth Mehl:
I am the slave of my Lord and Master.
I eat whatever God gives me. ||1||Pause||
Such is my Lord and Master.
In an instant, He creates and embellishes. ||1||
I do that work which pleases my Lord and Master.

212.g: ਗੀਤ ਚਰਿਤ; ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਾ ॥੨॥
212.e: I sing the songs of God's glory, and His wondrous play. ||2||
I seek the Sanctuary of the Lord's Prime Minister;
beholding Him, my mind is comforted and consoled. ||3||
The One Lord is my support, the One is my steady anchor.

212.g: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ; ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਲਾਗਾ ਕਾਰਾ ॥੪॥੧੧॥੧੪੯॥
212.e: Servant Nanak is engaged in the Lord's work. ||4||11||149||
Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

212.g: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਬਿਸਰੈ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ; ਤਾਹੂ ਕਉ ਪੀਰ ॥
212.e: One who forgets the Lord's Name, suffers in pain.

212.g: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਵਹਿ; ਸੇ ਗੁਣੀ ਗਹੀਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
212.e: Those who join the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, and dwell upon the Lord, find the Ocean of virtue. ||1||Pause||
Those Gurmukhs whose hearts are filled with wisdom,

212.g: ਤਾ ਕੈ ਕਰ ਤਲ; ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ॥੧॥
212.e: hold the nine treasures, and the miraculous spiritual powers of the Siddhas in the palms of their hands. ||1||
Those who know the Lord God as their Master,
do not lack anything. ||2||
Those who realize the Creator Lord,
enjoy all peace and pleasure. ||3||

212.g: ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ; ਜਾ ਕੈ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਵਸੈ ॥
212.e: Those whose inner homes are filled with the Lord's wealth

212.g: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ; ਤਿਨ ਸੰਗਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਨਸੈ ॥੪॥੯॥੧੪੭॥
212.e: - says Nanak, in their company, pain departs. ||4||9||147||
The warriors were mumbling and falling as martyrs and the heroes wearing armours were rolling in dust.120.
The brave fighters thundered and the warriors wearing steel armours, being intoxicated, began to dance.
The terrible trumpets resounded and the warriors with dreadful whiskers began to fight in the war.121.
The warriors were fighting with each other while twisting their whiskers. The chopping heroes were jumping like the winged mountains.
The brave soldiers wearing armours are lying down on the earh.122.
The trumpets resounded upto distant places and the horses began to run hither and thither.
The heavenly damsels began to roam in the sky and bedecking themselves and putting collyrium in their eyes they began to see the war.123.
The thundering musical instruments were played in the war and the brave soldiers roared.
The warriors holding their spears in their hands began to strike them, the arms and weapons of the warriors were put to use.124.
The wounded warriors fell down and their bodies were chopped.
The armies thundered and the trumpets resounded, the restless horses neighed in the battlefield.125.
The vultures shrieked on all the four sides and they began to reduce already chopped bodies into bits.
In the jungle of that battlefield they began to play with the bits of flesh and the adepts and yogis wished for victory.126.
Just as the flowers blossom in the spring, in the same manner are seen the mighty warriors fighting in the war.
The trunks of the elephants began to fell in the battlefield and the whole earth was filled with hacked heads.127.
Gauree, Fifth Mehl:
He is the Wish-fulfilling Jewel, the Embodiment of Mercy. ||1||Pause||

212.g: ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲਾ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ॥ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਣਿ ਸੁਖ ਭਏ ॥੧॥
212.e: The Supreme Lord God is Merciful to the meek; Meditating in remembrance on Him, peace is obtained. ||1||

212.g: ਅਕਾਲ ਪੁਰਖ; ਅਗਾਧਿ ਬੋਧ ॥ ਸੁਨਤ ਜਸੋ; ਕੋਟਿ ਅਘ ਖਏ ॥੨॥
212.e: The Wisdom of the Undying Primal Being is beyond comprehension. Hearing His Praises, millions of sins are erased. ||2||

212.g: ਕਿਰਪਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ; ਮਇਆ ਧਾਰਿ ॥ ਨਾਨਕ; ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਲਏ ॥੩॥੧੩॥੧੫੧॥
212.e: O God, Treasure of Mercy, please bless Nanak with Your kindness, that he may repeat the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||3||13||151||

213.e: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

213.g: ਸਭਹੂ ਕੋ ਰਸੁ; ਹਰਿ ਹੋ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
213.e: The Lord is the essence of all. ||1||Pause||

213.g: ਕਾਹੂ ਜੋਗ ਕਾਹੂ ਭੋਗ; ਕਾਹੂ ਗਿਆਨ ਕਾਹੂ ਧਿਆਨ ॥ ਕਾਹੂ ਹੋ; ਡੰਡ ਧਰਿ ਹੋ ॥੧॥
213.e: Some practice Yoga, some indulge in pleasures; some live in spiritual wisdom, some live in meditation. Some are bearers of the staff. ||1||

213.g: ਕਾਹੂ ਜਾਪ ਕਾਹੂ ਤਾਪ; ਕਾਹੂ ਪੂਜਾ ਹੋਮ ਨੇਮ ॥ ਕਾਹੂ ਹੋ; ਗਉਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਹੋ ॥੨॥
213.e: Some chant in meditation, some practice deep, austere meditation; some worship Him in adoration, some practice daily rituals. Some live the life of a wanderer. ||2||

213.g: ਕਾਹੂ ਤੀਰ ਕਾਹੂ ਨੀਰ; ਕਾਹੂ ਬੇਦ ਬੀਚਾਰ ॥ ਨਾਨਕਾ; ਭਗਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਹੋ ॥੩॥੨॥੧੫੫॥
213.e: Some live by the shore, some live on the water; some study the Vedas. Nanak loves to worship the Lord. ||3||2||155||
The masters of the horses were being destroyed.132.
Every limb of the warriors was pierced by arrows,
And Parashuram began to shower a volley of his arms.133.
He who advances to that side goes straight to the feet of the Lord (i.e. he is killed).
Hearing the knocks on the shields, the god of death came down.134.
The superb enemies were killed and the eminent men were destroyed.
On the bodies of the enduring warriors, the arrows waved.135.
The eminent persons were destroyed and the remaining sped away.
The repeated Shiva’s name and created confusion.136.
Parashuram, the wielder of axe,
Had power of to destroy all in the war, his arms were long.137.
The brave fighters struck blows and the rosary of skulls on the neck of Shiva looked impressive.

213.g: ਪਹਿਰੈ ਬਾਗਾ. ਕਰਿ ਇਸਨਾਨਾ; ਚੋਆ ਚੰਦਨ ਲਾਏ ॥
213.e: You wear white clothes and take cleansing baths, and anoint yourself with sandalwood oil.

213.g: ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ਨਹੀ ਚੀਨਿਆ; ਜਿਉ ਹਸਤੀ ਨਾਵਾਏ ॥੩॥
213.e: But you do not remember the Fearless, Formless Lord - you are like an elephant bathing in the mud. ||3||

213.g: ਜਉ ਹੋਇ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ. ਤ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲੈ; ਸਭਿ ਸੁਖ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਨਾਏ ॥
213.e: When God becomes merciful, He leads you to meet the True Guru; all peace is in the Name of the Lord.

213.g: ਮੁਕਤੁ ਭਇਆ. ਬੰਧਨ ਗੁਰਿ ਖੋਲੇ; ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ. ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ॥੪॥੧੪॥੧੫੨॥
213.e: The Guru has liberated me from bondage; servant Nanak sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||4||14||152||
Raag Gauree, Fifth Mehl:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

213.g: ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ. ਬਿਰਲੇ ਹੀ ਕੀ; ਬੁਝੀ ਹੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
213.e: The thirst of only a few is quenched. ||1||Pause||

213.g: ਕੋਟਿ ਜੋਰੇ ਲਾਖ ਕ੍ਰੋਰੇ; ਮਨੁ ਨ ਹੋਰੇ ॥ ਪਰੈ ਪਰੈ ਹੀ ਕਉ; ਲੁਝੀ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
213.e: People may accumulate hundreds of thousands, millions, tens of millions, and yet the mind is not restrained. They only yearn for more and more. ||1||

213.g: ਸੁੰਦਰ ਨਾਰੀ ਅਨਿਕ ਪਰਕਾਰੀ; ਪਰ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਬਿਕਾਰੀ ॥ ਬੁਰਾ ਭਲਾ ਨਹੀ ਸੁਝੀ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
213.e: They may have all sorts of beautiful women, but still, they commit adultery in the homes of others. They do not distinguish between good and bad. ||2||

213.g: ਅਨਿਕ ਬੰਧਨ ਮਾਇਆ, ਭਰਮਤੁ ਭਰਮਾਇਆ; ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਿ. ਨਹੀ ਗਾਇਆ ॥ ਮਨ ਬਿਖੈ ਹੀ ਮਹਿ ਲੁਝੀ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
213.e: They wander around lost, trapped in the myriad bonds of Maya; they do not sing the Praises of the Treasure of Virtue. Their minds are engrossed in poison and corruption. ||3||

213.g: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਰੇ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੈ, ਜੀਵਤ ਸੋਈ ਮਰੈ; ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਤਰੈ ॥ ਨਾਨਕ. ਸੋ ਜਨੁ; ਦਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਝੀ ਹੇ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੫੪॥
213.e: Those, unto whom the Lord shows His Mercy, remain dead while yet alive. In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, they cross over the ocean of Maya. O Nanak, those humble beings are honored in the Court of the Lord. ||4||1||154||
Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

213.g: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ; ਗੁਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ. ਸਦ ਕਰੀਐ ॥
213.e: O my mind, dwell always upon the Guru, Guru, Guru.

213.g: ਰਤਨ ਜਨਮੁ ਸਫਲੁ ਗੁਰਿ ਕੀਆ; ਦਰਸਨ ਕਉ ਬਲਿਹਰੀਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
213.e: The Guru has made the jewel of this human life prosperous and fruitful. I am a sacrifice to the Blessed Vision of His Darshan. ||1||Pause||

213.g: ਜੇਤੇ ਸਾਸ ਗ੍ਰਾਸ ਮਨੁ ਲੇਤਾ; ਤੇਤੇ ਹੀ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਈਐ ॥
213.e: As many breaths and morsels as you take, O my mind - so many times, sing His Glorious Praises.

213.g: ਜਉ ਹੋਇ ਦੈਆਲੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਅਪੁਨਾ; ਤਾ ਇਹ ਮਤਿ ਬੁਧਿ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੧॥
213.e: When the True Guru becomes merciful, then this wisdom and understanding is obtained. ||1||

213.g: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਏ. ਜਮ ਬੰਧ ਤੇ ਛੂਟਹਿ; ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖਾ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
213.e: O my mind, taking the Naam, you shall be released from the bondage of death, and the peace of all peace will be found.

213.g: ਸੇਵਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਦਾਤਾ; ਮਨ ਬੰਛਤ ਫਲ ਆਈਐ ॥੨॥
213.e: Serving your Lord and Master, the True Guru, the Great Giver, you shall obtain the fruits of your mind's desires. ||2||

213.g: ਨਾਮੁ ਇਸਟੁ ਮੀਤ ਸੁਤ ਕਰਤਾ; ਮਨ ਸੰਗਿ ਤੁਹਾਰੈ ਚਾਲੈ ॥
213.e: The Name of the Creator is your beloved friend and child; it alone shall go along with you, O my mind.

213.g: ਕਰਿ ਸੇਵਾ. ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਕੀ; ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਈਐ ਪਾਲੈ ॥੩॥
213.e: So serve your True Guru, and you shall receive the Name from the Guru. ||3||

213.g: ਗੁਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾਲਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਧਾਰੀ; ਬਿਨਸੇ ਸਰਬ ਅੰਦੇਸਾ ॥
213.e: When God, the Merciful Guru, showered His Mercy upon me, all my anxieties were dispelled.

213.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨਿ; ਮਿਟਿਓ ਸਗਲ ਕਲੇਸਾ ॥੪॥੧੫॥੧੫੩॥
213.e: Nanak has found the peace of the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises. All his sorrows have been dispelled. ||4||15||153||
Gauree, Fifth Mehl:
To sing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises is my treasure. ||1||Pause||

213.g: ਤੂੰਹੀ ਰਸ ਤੂੰਹੀ ਜਸ; ਤੂੰਹੀ ਰੂਪ ਤੂਹੀ ਰੰਗ ॥ ਆਸ ਓਟ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੋਰੀ ॥੧॥
213.e: You are my delight, You are my praise. You are my beauty, You are my love. O God, You are my hope and support. ||1||

213.g: ਤੂਹੀ ਮਾਨ ਤੂੰਹੀ ਧਾਨ; ਤੂਹੀ ਪਤਿ ਤੂਹੀ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ॥ ਗੁਰਿ; ਤੂਟੀ ਲੈ ਜੋਰੀ ॥੨॥
213.e: You are my pride, You are my wealth. You are my honor, You are my breath of life. The Guru has repaired that which was broken. ||2||

213.g: ਤੂਹੀ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ. ਤੂਹੀ ਬਨਿ ਤੂਹੀ; ਗਾਉ ਤੂਹੀ ਸੁਨਿ ॥ ਹੈ ਨਾਨਕ. ਨੇਰ ਨੇਰੀ ॥੩॥੩॥੧੫੬॥
213.e: You are in the household, and You are in the forest. You are in the village, and You are in the wilderness. Nanak: You are near, so very near! ||3||3||156||

214.g: ਚਰਪਟ ਛੀਗਾ ਕੇ ਆਦਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਤ ਛੰਦ ॥
214.e: CHARPAT CHHIGA KE AAD KRIT STANZA
In the use of the sword the noteworthy and greatly wise persons are being seen.
Those with beautiful bodies are wearing armours which seen like portraits.139.
Those who are specialists in arm and scholars of Shastras
And also the famous warriors are busy in warfare in great rage.140.
The eminent warriors are filling others with fear
Wearing their arms they are destroying the enemies.141.
The brave fighters piercing the armours are boring the bodies
With the use of arms, the canopies of the kings are being destroyed.142.
Those who marched towards the battlefield,
They know the secrets of arms and wepons.143.
The warriors wandered in the battlefield like the gardeners of the forest who prune the plants, they began to destroy the reputation of the heroes.
In that battlefield the beautiful Ram, who is the abode of righteousness is looking glorious.144.
He is a hero with the quality of forbearance, he is the destroyer of warriors
Conqueror of war and eminently specialist in the use of weapons.145.
He has the gait of an elephant and an abode of Dharma
He is the master of yoga-fire and protector of the supreme light.146.
Ram stood firmly and within the whole place, there was turmoil.138.
Gauree, Fifth Mehl:
I am intoxicated, intoxicated with the Love of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

214.g: ਓੁਹੀ ਪੀਓ ਓੁਹੀ ਖੀਓ; ਗੁਰਹਿ ਦੀਓ. ਦਾਨੁ ਕੀਓ ॥ ਉਆਹੂ ਸਿਉ; ਮਨੁ ਰਾਤੋ ॥੧॥
214.e: I drink it in - I am drunk with it. The Guru has given it to me in charity. My mind is drenched with it. ||1||

214.g: ਓੁਹੀ ਭਾਠੀ. ਓੁਹੀ ਪੋਚਾ; ਉਹੀ ਪਿਆਰੋ. ਉਹੀ ਰੂਚਾ ॥ ਮਨਿ ਓਹੋ ਸੁਖੁ ਜਾਤੋ ॥੨॥
214.e: It is my furnace, it is the cooling plaster. It is my love, it is my longing. My mind knows it as peace. ||2||

214.g: ਸਹਜ ਕੇਲ ਅਨਦ ਖੇਲ; ਰਹੇ ਫੇਰ. ਭਏ ਮੇਲ ॥ ਨਾਨਕ; ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਰਾਤੋ ॥੩॥੪॥੧੫੭॥
214.e: I enjoy intuitive peace, and I play in bliss; the cycle of reincarnation is ended for me, and I am merged with the Lord. Nanak is pierced through with the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||3||4||157||
Raag Gauree Maalwaa, Fifth Mehl:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

214.g: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਲੇਹੁ. ਮੀਤਾ ਲੇਹੁ; ਆਗੈ. ਬਿਖਮ ਪੰਥੁ ਭੈਆਨ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
214.e: Chant the Lord's Name; O my friend, chant it. Hereafter, the path is terrifying and treacherous. ||1||Pause||

214.g: ਸੇਵਤ ਸੇਵਤ ਸਦਾ ਸੇਵਿ; ਤੇਰੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਬਸਤੁ ਹੈ ਕਾਲੁ ॥
214.e: Serve, serve, forever serve the Lord. Death hangs over your head.

214.g: ਕਰਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੂੰ. ਸਾਧ ਕੀ; ਹੋ. ਕਾਟੀਐ ਜਮ ਜਾਲੁ ॥੧॥
214.e: Do seva, selfless service, for the Holy Saints, and the noose of Death shall be cut away. ||1||

214.g: ਹੋਮ ਜਗ ਤੀਰਥ ਕੀਏ; ਬਿਚਿ ਹਉਮੈ, ਬਧੇ ਬਿਕਾਰ ॥
214.e: You may make burnt offerings, sacrificial feasts and pilgrimages to sacred shrines in egotism, but your corruption only increases.

214.g: ਨਰਕੁ ਸੁਰਗੁ ਦੁਇ ਭੁੰਚਨਾ; ਹੋਇ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਅਵਤਾਰ ॥੨॥
214.e: You are subject to both heaven and hell, and you are reincarnated over and over again. ||2||

214.g: ਸਿਵ ਪੁਰੀ. ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਇੰਦ੍ਰ ਪੁਰੀ; ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਕੋ ਥਾਉ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
214.e: The realm of Shiva, the realms of Brahma and Indra as well - no place anywhere is permanent.

214.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਾ. ਸੁਖੁ ਨਹੀ; ਹੋ, ਸਾਕਤ ਆਵਹਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥੩॥
214.e: Without serving the Lord, there is no peace at all. The faithless cynic comes and goes in reincarnation. ||3||

214.g: ਜੈਸੋ ਗੁਰਿ ਉਪਦੇਸਿਆ; ਮੈ ਤੈਸੋ ਕਹਿਆ ਪੁਕਾਰਿ ॥
214.e: As the Guru has taught me, so have I spoken.

214.g: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਕਹੈ. ਸੁਨਿ ਰੇ ਮਨਾ; ਕਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਹੋਇ ਉਧਾਰੁ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੫੮॥
214.e: Says Nanak, listen, people: sing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises, and you shall be saved. ||4||1||158||
Raag Gauree Maalaa, Fifth Mehl:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
Adopting the innocent mind of a child, I have found peace.

214.g: ਹਰਖ ਸੋਗ. ਹਾਨਿ ਮਿਰਤੁ, ਦੂਖ ਸੁਖ; ਚਿਤਿ ਸਮਸਰਿ. ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
214.e: Joy and sorrow, profit and loss, birth and death, pain and pleasure - they are all the same to my consciousness, since I met the Guru. ||1||Pause||

214.g: ਜਉ ਲਉ. ਹਉ ਕਿਛੁ ਸੋਚਉ ਚਿਤਵਉ; ਤਉ ਲਉ. ਦੁਖਨੁ ਭਰੇ ॥
214.e: As long as I plotted and planned things, I was full of frustration.

214.g: ਜਉ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਭੇਟਿਆ; ਤਉ ਆਨਦ ਸਹਜੇ ॥੧॥
214.e: When I met the Kind, Perfect Guru, then I obtained bliss so easily. ||1||

214.g: ਜੇਤੀ ਸਿਆਨਪ ਕਰਮ ਹਉ ਕੀਏ; ਤੇਤੇ ਬੰਧ ਪਰੇ ॥
214.e: The more clever tricks I tried, the more bonds I was saddled with.

214.g: ਜਉ ਸਾਧੂ ਕਰੁ. ਮਸਤਕਿ ਧਰਿਓ; ਤਬ ਹਮ ਮੁਕਤ ਭਏ ॥੨॥
214.e: When the Holy Saint placed His Hand upon my forehead, then I was liberated. ||2||

214.g: ਜਉ ਲਉ. ਮੇਰੋ ਮੇਰੋ ਕਰਤੋ; ਤਉ ਲਉ. ਬਿਖੁ ਘੇਰੇ ॥
214.e: As long as I claimed, "Mine, mine!", I was surrounded by wickedness and corruption.

214.g: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਬੁਧਿ. ਅਰਪੀ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕਉ; ਤਬ ਹਮ. ਸਹਜਿ ਸੋਏ ॥੩॥
214.e: But when I dedicated my mind, body and intellect to my Lord and Master, then I began to sleep in peace. ||3||

214.g: ਜਉ ਲਉ. ਪੋਟ ਉਠਾਈ ਚਲਿਅਉ; ਤਉ ਲਉ ਡਾਨ ਭਰੇ ॥
214.e: As long as I walked along, carrying the load, I continued to pay the fine.

214.g: ਪੋਟ ਡਾਰਿ. ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਮਿਲਿਆ; ਤਉ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਿਰਭਏ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੫੯॥
214.e: But I threw away that bundle, when I met the Perfect Guru; O Nanak, then I became fearless. ||4||1||159||
Speech of the Poet:

214.g: ਯੌ ਜਬ ਬੈਨ ਸੁਨੇ ਅਰਿ ਕੇ; ਤਬ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਰਘੁਬੀਰ ਬਲੀ ਬਲਕਾਨੇ ॥
214.e: Hearing these words of the enemy (Parashuram), Ram looked like a mighty hero.
The Speech of Parachuram :
SWAYYA

214.g: ਤੂਣਿ ਕਸੇ ਕਟ ਚਾਪ ਧਰੇ; ਕਰ ਕੋਪ ਕਹੀ ਦਿਜ ਰਾਮ ਅਹੋ ॥
214.e: Wearnig his bow and quiver, the Brahmin Parshuram in great rage said to Ram :

214.g: ਗ੍ਰਹ ਤੋਰਿ ਸਰਾਸਨ ਸੰਕਰ ਕੋ; ਸੀਅ ਜਾਤ ਹਰੇ, ਤੁਮ ਕਉਨ, ਕਹੋ ॥
214.e: “O the breaker of the bow of Shiva and the conqueror of Sita, who ate you?

214.g: ਬਿਨ ਸਾਚ ਕਹੇ, ਨੇਹੀ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਬਚੇ; ਜਿਨਿ ਕੰਠ ਕੁਠਾਰ ਕੀ ਧਾਰ ਸਹੋ ॥
214.e: “Tell me the truth otherwise you will not he able to save yourself and you will have to bear the blow of the sharp edge of my axe on your neck.

214.g: ਘਰ ਜਾਹੁ ਚਲੇ, ਤਜ ਰਾਮ, ਰਣੰ; ਜਿਨਿ ਜੂਝਿ ਮਰੋ, ਪਲ ਠਾਢ ਰਹੋ ॥੧੪੭॥
214.e: “It will be appropriate, if you leave the war-arena and run away to your home, otherwise if you stay here for another instant, you will have to die.”147.
Gauree Maalaa, Fifth Mehl:
I have renounced my desires; I have renounced them.
I have renounced them; meeting the Guru, I have renounced them.

214.g: ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖ ਆਨੰਦ ਮੰਗਲ ਰਸ; ਮਾਨਿ ਗੋਬਿੰਦੈ ਆਗਿਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
214.e: All peace, joy, happiness and pleasures have come since I surrendered to the Will of the Lord of the Universe. ||1||Pause||
SWAYYA

214.g: ਜਾਨਤ ਹੋ, ਅਵਿਲੋਕ ਮੁਝੈ ਹਠਿ; ਏਕ ਬਲੀ ਨਹੀ ਠਾਢ ਰਹੈਂਗੇ ॥
214.e: “You know that no mighty warrior can stay here firmly on seeing me

214.g: ਤਾਤਿ ਗਹਯੋ ਜਿਨ ਕੋ ਤ੍ਰਿਣ ਦਾਤਨ; ਤੇਨ ਕਹਾ ਰਣ ਆਜ ਗਹੈਂਗੇ ॥
214.e: “Those whose fathers and grandfathers held the blades of grass within their teeth on seeing me (i.e. they accepted defeat) what type of war will they wage with me now?

214.g: ਬੰਬ ਬਜੇ ਰਣ ਖੰਡ ਗਡੇ; ਗਹਿ ਹਾਥ ਹਥਿਆਰ ਕਹੂੰ ਉਮਹੈਂਗੇ ॥
214.e: “Even if there is waged a terrible war how can they be bold enough now to march forward for war by taking hold of their weapons again?

214.g: ਭੂਮ ਅਕਾਸ ਪਤਾਲ ਦੁਰੈਬੇ ਕਉ; ਰਾਮ, ਕਹੋ, ਕਹਾ ਠਾਮ ਲਹੈਂਗੇ ॥੧੪੮॥
214.e: “Then tell me, O Ram, where will you find a place one earth, sky or netherworld to hide yourself?”148.

215.g: ਕਬਿ ਬਾਚ ॥
215.e: Speech of the Poet :

215.g: ਸ੍ਵੈਯਾ ॥
215.e: SWAYYA

215.g: ਸ੍ਰੀ ਰਘੁਬੀਰ ਸਿਰੋਮਨ ਸੂਰ; ਕੁਵੰਡ ਲਯੋ ਕਰ ਮੈ ਹਸਿ ਕੈ ॥
215.e: Ram, the supreme hero took the bow in his hand smilingly

215.g: ਲੀਅ ਚਾਪ ਚਟਾਕ ਚੜਾਇ ਬਲੀ; ਖਟ ਟੂਕ ਕਰਯੋ ਛਿਨ ਮੈ ਕਸਿ ਕੈ ॥
215.e: Pulled its string and tightening the arrow, broke it into two pieces.

215.g: ਨਭ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਤਾਹਿ ਹਤੀ ਸਰ ਸੋ; ਅਧ ਬੀਚ ਹੀ ਬਾਤ ਰਹੀ ਬਸਿ ਕੈ ॥
215.e: On breaking, the bow produced such a dreadful sound as if the arrow had struck the chest of the sky which gad burst.

215.g: ਨ ਬਸਾਤ ਕਛੂ ਨਟ ਕੇ ਬਟ ਜਯੋਂ ਭਵ ਪਾਸ ਨਿਸੰਗਿ ਰਹੈ ਫਸਿ ਕੈ ॥੧੫੩॥
215.e: The manner in which the dancer jumps on the rope, in the same way the whole universe shook on the breaking of the bow and remained entangled within the two pieces of the bow.153.

215.g: ਇਤਿ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਰਾਮ ਜੁਧ ਜਯਤ ॥੨॥
215.e: End of the description of Ram’s victory in war.2.

215.g: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਾਲਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
215.e: Gauree Maalaa, Fifth Mehl:

215.g: ਉਬਰਤ; ਰਾਜਾ ਰਾਮ ਕੀ ਸਰਣੀ ॥
215.e: Those who take to the Sanctuary of the Lord, the King, are saved.

215.g: ਸਰਬ ਲੋਕ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੇ ਮੰਡਲ; ਗਿਰਿ ਗਿਰਿ ਪਰਤੇ ਧਰਣੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
215.e: All other people, in the mansion of Maya, fall flat on their faces on the ground. ||1||Pause||

215.g: ਸਾਸਤ ਸਿੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਬੇਦ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ; ਮਹਾ ਪੁਰਖਨ ਇਉ ਕਹਿਆ ॥
215.e: The great men have studied the Shaastras, the Simritees and the Vedas, and they have said this:

215.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਭਜਨ. ਨਾਹੀ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਾ; ਸੂਖੁ. ਨ ਕਿਨਹੂੰ ਲਹਿਆ ॥੧॥
215.e: "Without the Lord's meditation, there is no emancipation, and no one has ever found peace." ||1||

215.g: ਤੀਨਿ ਭਵਨ ਕੀ ਲਖਮੀ ਜੋਰੀ; ਬੂਝਤ ਨਾਹੀ. ਲਹਰੇ ॥
215.e: People may accumulate the wealth of the three worlds, but the waves of greed are still not subdued.

215.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ. ਕਹਾ ਥਿਤਿ ਪਾਵੈ; ਫਿਰਤੋ ਪਹਰੇ ਪਹਰੇ ॥੨॥
215.e: Without devotional worship of the Lord, where can anyone find stability? People wander around endlessly. ||2||

215.g: ਅਨਿਕ ਬਿਲਾਸ ਕਰਤ ਮਨ ਮੋਹਨ; ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਤ ਨ ਕਾਮਾ ॥
215.e: People engage in all sorts of mind-enticing pastimes, but their passions are not fulfilled.

215.g: ਜਲਤੋ ਜਲਤੋ. ਕਬਹੂ ਨ ਬੂਝਤ; ਸਗਲ ਬ੍ਰਿਥੇ. ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਮਾ ॥੩॥
215.e: They burn and burn, and are never satisfied; without the Lord's Name, it is all useless. ||3||

215.g: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ. ਜਪਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਮੀਤਾ; ਇਹੈ ਸਾਰ ਸੁਖੁ ਪੂਰਾ ॥
215.e: Chant the Name of the Lord, my friend; this is the essence of perfect peace.

215.g: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ. ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣੁ ਨਿਵਾਰੈ; ਨਾਨਕ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਧੂਰਾ ॥੪॥੪॥੧੬੨॥
215.e: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, birth and death are ended. Nanak is the dust of the feet of the humble. ||4||4||162||

215.g: ਰਾਮ ਬਾਚ ਪਰਸੁਰਾਮ ਸੋ ॥
215.e: Speech of Ram addressed to Parashuram:

215.g: ਸ੍ਵੈਯਾ ॥
215.e: SWAYYA

215.g: ਬੋਲ ਕਹੇ ਸੁ ਸਹੇ ਦਿਸ ਜੂ, ਜੁ ਪੈ ਫੇਰਿ ਕਹੇ, ਤੇ ਪੈ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਖ੍ਵੈਹੋ ॥
215.e: “O Brahmin! you have already said whatever you wanted to say and if you say anything more now, you will have to risk your life.

215.g: ਬੋਲਤ ਐਂਠ ਕਹਾ ਸਠ ਜਿਉ, ਸਭ ਦਾਤ ਤੁਰਾਇ, ਅਬੈ ਘਰਿ ਜੈਹੋ ॥
215.e: “O fool! why do you speak with such pride, you will have to go now to your home after getting your teeth broken and after receiving good tharashin.

215.g: ਧੀਰ ਤਬੈ ਲਹਿਹੈ ਤੁਮ ਕਉ; ਜਦ ਭੀਰ ਪਰੀ ਇਕ ਤੀਰ ਚਲੈਹੋ ॥
215.e: “I am seeing you with patience  if I consider it necessary, then I shall have to discharge only one arrow.

215.g: ਬਾਤ ਸੰਭਾਰ ਕਹੋ ਮੁਖਿ ਤੇ; ਇਨ ਬਾਤਨ ਕੋ ਅਬ ਹੀ ਫਲਿ ਪੈਹੋ ॥੧੫੧॥
215.e: “Therefore talk with restraint, otherwise you will receive the reward for such talk just now.”151.

215.g: ਪਰਸੁ ਰਾਮ ਬਾਚ ॥
215.e: Speech of Parashuram :

215.g: ਸ੍ਵੈਯਾ ॥
215.e: SWAYYA

215.g: ਤਉ ਤੁਮ ਸਾਚ ਲਖੋ ਮਨ ਮੈ ਪ੍ਰਭ; ਜਉ ਤੁਮ ਰਾਮ ਵਤਾਰ ਕਹਾਓ ॥
215.e: “You should then deem it true that if you are called Ramvtar,

215.g: ਰੁਦ੍ਰ ਕੁਵੰਡ ਬਿਹੰਡੀਯ ਜਿਉ ਕਰਿ; ਤਿਉ ਅਪਨੋ ਬਲ ਮੋਹਿ ਦਿਖਾਓ ॥
215.e: “Then the way you have broken the bow of Shiva, show me your strength in the same way

215.g: ਤਉ ਹੀ ਗਦਾ ਕਰ ਸਾਰੰਗ ਚਕ੍ਰ ਲਤਾ ਭ੍ਰਿਗਾ ਕੀ ਉਰ ਮਧ ਸੁਹਾਓ ॥
215.e: “Show me your mace, discus, bow and also the mark of the stroke of the foot of sage Bhrigu.

215.g: ਮੇਰੋ ਉਤਾਰ ਕੁਵੰਡ ਮਹਾਬਲ; ਮੋਹੂ ਕਉ ਆਜ ਚੜਾਇ ਦਿਖਾਓ ॥੧੫੨॥
215.e: “Alongwith this dismount my mighty bow and pull its string.”152.

215.g: ਪਰਸੁ ਰਾਮ ਬਾਚ ਰਾਮ ਸੋ ॥
215.e: Speech of Parashuram addressed to Ram :

215.g: ਜੇਤਕ ਬੈਨ ਕਹੇ, ਸੁ ਕਹੇ; ਜੁ ਪੈ ਫੇਰਿ ਕਹੇ, ਤੁ ਪੈ ਜੀਤ ਨ ਜੈਹੋ ॥
215.e: “O Ram! whatever you have said, you have said and now if you say anything further, then you will not remain alive

215.g: ਹਾਥਿ ਹਥਿਆਰ ਗਹੇ, ਸੁ ਗਹੇ; ਜੁ ਪੈ ਫੇਰਿ ਗਹੇ, ਤੁ ਪੈ ਫੇਰਿ ਨ ਲੈਹੋ ॥
215.e: “The weapon that you had to wield, you have wielded and if you try to wield anything more, your effort will be of no avail.”

215.g: ਰਾਮ ਰਿਸੈ ਰਣ ਮੈ ਰਘੁਬੀਰ, ਕਹੋ ਭਜਿ ਕੈ, ਕਤ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਬਚੈਹੋ ॥
215.e: Then getting furious Parashuram said to Ram, “Say, where will you run away now from war and how will you save your life?

215.g: ਤੋਰ ਸਰਾਸਨ ਸੰਕਰ ਕੋ; ਹਰਿ ਸੀਅ ਚਲੇ, ਘਰਿ ਜਾਨ ਨ ਪੈਹੋ ॥੧੫੦॥
215.e: “O Ram! breaking the bow of Shiva and now wedding Sita you will not be able to reach your home.”150.

215.g: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਾਲਾ₂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
215.e: Gauree Maalaa, Fifth Mehl:

215.g: ਪਾਇਆ ਲਾਲੁ ਰਤਨੁ; ਮਨਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
215.e: I have found the jewel of my Beloved within my mind.

215.g: ਤਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ. ਮਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਥੀਆ; ਸਤਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
215.e: My body is cooled, my mind is cooled and soothed, and I am absorbed into the Shabad, the Word of the True Guru. ||1||Pause||

215.g: ਲਾਥੀ ਭੂਖ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨ ਸਭ ਲਾਥੀ; ਚਿੰਤਾ ਸਗਲ ਬਿਸਾਰੀ ॥
215.e: My hunger has departed, my thirst has totally departed, and all my anxiety is forgotten.

215.g: ਕਰੁ ਮਸਤਕਿ. ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਧਰਿਓ; ਮਨੁ ਜੀਤੋ ਜਗੁ ਸਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
215.e: The Perfect Guru has placed His Hand upon my forehead; conquering my mind, I have conquered the whole world. ||1||

215.g: ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਅਘਾਇ ਰਹੇ ਰਿਦ ਅੰਤਰਿ; ਡੋਲਨ ਤੇ. ਅਬ ਚੂਕੇ ॥
215.e: Satisfied and satiated, I remain steady within my heart, and now, I do not waver at all.

215.g: ਅਖੁਟੁ ਖਜਾਨਾ, ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਆ; ਤੋਟਿ ਨਹੀ ਰੇ ਮੂਕੇ ॥੨॥
215.e: The True Guru has given me the inexhaustible treasure; it never decreases, and never runs out. ||2||

215.g: ਅਚਰਜੁ ਏਕੁ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਰੇ ਭਾਈ; ਗੁਰਿ. ਐਸੀ ਬੂਝ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥
215.e: Listen to this wonder, O Siblings of Destiny: the Guru has given me this understanding.

215.g: ਲਾਹਿ ਪਰਦਾ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਜਉ ਭੇਟਿਓ; ਤਉ ਬਿਸਰੀ ਤਾਤਿ ਪਰਾਈ ॥੩॥
215.e: I threw off the veil of illusion, when I met my Lord and Master; then, I forgot my jealousy of others. ||3||

215.g: ਕਹਿਓ ਨ ਜਾਈ. ਏਹੁ ਅਚੰਭਉ; ਸੋ ਜਾਨੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਚਾਖਿਆ ॥
215.e: This is a wonder which cannot be described. They alone know it, who have tasted it.

215.g: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ. ਸਚ ਭਏ ਬਿਗਾਸਾ; ਗੁਰਿ. ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਲੈ ਰਾਖਿਆ ॥੪॥੩॥੧੬੧॥
215.e: Says Nanak, the Truth has been revealed to me. The Guru has given me the treasure; I have taken it and enshrined it within my heart. ||4||3||161||

215.g: ਚੌਪਈ ॥
215.e: CHAUPAI

215.g: ਸਭਹੂ ਮਿਲਿ ਗਿਲ ਕੀਯੋ ਉਛਾਹਾ ॥
ਪੂਤ ਤਿਹੂੰ ਕਉ ਰਚਯੋ ਬਿਯਾਹਾ ॥
215.e: With great enthusiasm the marriage of the three remaining sons was fixed.

215.g: ਅਥ ਅਉਧ ਪ੍ਰਵੇਸ ਕਥਨੰ ॥
215.e: Now begins the description of the Entry in Oudh :

215.g: ਸ੍ਵੈਯਾ ॥
215.e: SWAYYA

215.g: ਭੇਟ ਭੁਜਾ ਭਰਿ ਅੰਕਿ ਭਲੇ; ਭਰਿ ਨੈਨ ਦੋਊ ਨਿਰਖੇ ਰਘੁਰਾਈ ॥
215.e: With tears of joy in both his eyes and meeting affectionately with his people Ram entered Ayodhya.

215.g: ਗੁੰਜਤ ਭ੍ਰਿੰਗ ਕਪੋਲਨ ਊਪਰ; ਨਾਗ ਲਵੰਗ ਰਹੇ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥
215.e: The black bees were humming on the cheeks and the braids of long hair of Sita were hanging like the Nagas looking towards her face.

215.g: ਕੰਜ ਕੁਰੰਗ ਕਲਾ ਨਿਧ ਕੇਹਰਿ; ਕੋਕਿਲ ਹੇਰ ਹੀਏ ਹਹਰਾਈ ॥
215.e: The lotus, deer, moon, lioness and nightingale were perplexed in their minds and seeing her (eyes, agility, beauty, courage and sweet voice respectively).

215.g: ਬਾਲ ਲਖੈਂ ਛਬਿ, ਖਾਟ ਪਰੈਂ ਨਹਿ; ਬਾਟ ਚਲੈ ਨਿਰਖੇ ਅਧਿਕਾਈ ॥੧੫੪॥
215.e: The children, seeing her beauty, also were falling unconscious and the travelers abandoning their path, were looking at her.154.

215.g: ਸੀਅ ਰਹੀ ਮੁਰਛਾਇ ਮਨੈ; ਰਨਿ ਰਾਮ ਕਹਾ ਮਨ ਬਾਤ ਧਰੈਂਗੇ ॥
215.e: Sita was getting worried on reflecting whether Ram will agree with her sayings or not

215.g: ਤੋਰਿ ਸਰਾਸਨਿ ਸੰਕਰ ਕੋ ਜਿਮ; ਮੋਹਿ ਬਰਿਓ, ਤਿਮ ਅਉਰ ਬਰੈਂਗੇ ॥
215.e: And also whether it can happen that Ram may wed another woman like wedding me on breaking the bow of Shiva.

215.g: ਦੂਸਰ ਬਯਾਹ ਬਧੂ ਅਬ ਹੀ; ਮਨ ਤੇ ਮੁਹਿ ਨਾਥ ਬਿਸਾਰ ਡਰੈਂਗੇ ॥
215.e: If he thinks another marriage in his mind, then her Lord on forgetting her, will fill her life definitely with unrest.

215.g: ਦੇਖਤ ਹੌ ਨਿਜ ਭਾਗ ਭਲੇ; ਬਿਧ ਆਜ ਕਹਾ ਇਹ ਠੌਰ ਕਰੈਂਗੇ ॥੧੫੫॥
215.e: Let us see that is recorded in my fate and what he will do in future?155.

215.g: ਤਉ ਹੀ ਲਉ ਰਾਮ ਜਿਤੇ ਦਿਜ ਕਉ; ਅਪਨੇ ਦਲ ਆਇ ਬਜਾਇ ਬਧਾਈ ॥
215.e: At that same time, the groups of Brahmins came forward and began and thither in joy.

215.g: ਭਗੁਲ ਲੋਕ ਫਿਰੈ ਸਭ ਹੀ ਰਣ ਮੋ ਲਖਿ ਰਾਘਵ ਕੀ ਅਧਕਾਈ ॥
215.e: Hearing about the victory of Ram in the war, all the people ran hither and thither in joy.

215.g: ਸੀਅ ਰਹੀ, ਰਨ ਰਾਮ ਜਿਤੇ; ਅਵਧੇਸਰ ਬਾਤ ਜਬੈ ਸੁਨਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
215.e: When Dasrath came to know that after conquering Sita, Ram has also conquered the war,

215.g: ਫੂਲਿ ਗ︀ਯੋ ਅਤਿ ਹੀ ਮਨ ਮੈ ਧਨ ਕੇ ਘਨ ਕੀ ਬਰਖਾ ਬਰਖਾਈ ॥੧੫੬॥
215.e: Then his delight knew no bounds and he showered the wealth like the rain of clouds.156.

215.g: ਬੰਦਨਵਾਰ ਬਧੀ ਸਭ ਹੀ ਦਰ; ਚੰਦਨ ਸੌ ਛਿਰਕੇ ਗ੍ਰਹ ਸਾਰੇ ॥
215.e: The doors of all the subjects were bedecked with greetings and the sandalwood was sprinkled over all the houses.

215.g: ਕੇਸਰ ਡਾਰਿ ਬਰਾਤਨ ਪੈ; ਸਭ ਹੀ ਜਨ ਹੁਇ ਪੁਰਹੂਤ ਪਧਾਰੇ ॥
215.e: Saffron was sprinkled over all the companions (of Ram) and it seemed that Indra was entering his city.

215.g: ਬਾਜਤ ਤਾਲ ਮੁਚੰਗ ਪਖਾਵਜ; ਨਾਚਤ ਕੋਟਨਿ ਕੋਟਿ ਅਖਾਰੇ ॥
215.e: The drums and other musical instruments resounded and the dances of various kinds were arranged.

215.g: ਆਨਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਸਭ ਹੀ ਅਗੂਆ; ਸੁਤ ਕਉ ਪਿਤੁ ਲੈ ਪੁਰ ਅਉਧ ਸਿਧਾਰੇ ॥੧੫੭॥
215.e: All the people advanced to meet Ram and the father Dasrath took his son with him and reached Oudhpuri (in his palaces).157.

215.g: ਸਾਤ ਸਮੁੰਦ੍ਰਨ ਲੌ ਗਰਵੇ ਗਿਰ; ਭੂਮਿ ਅਕਾਸ ਦੋਊ ਥਹਰਾਨੇ ॥
215.e: Visualising the serene posture of Ram, exhibiting the serenity of seven seas, the mountains, Sky and the whole world trembled.

215.g: ਜਛ ਭੁਜੰਗ ਦਿਸਾ ਬਿਦਿਸਾਨ ਕੇ ਦਾਨਵ ਦੇਵ ਦੁਹੂੰ ਡਰ ਮਾਨੇ ॥
215.e: The Yakshas, Nagas, gods gods demons of all the four directions were frightened.

215.g: ਸ੍ਰੀ ਰਘੁਨਾਥ ਕਮਾਨ ਲੇ ਹਾਥ; ਕਹੋ ਰਿਸ ਕੈ, ਕਿਹ ਪੈ ਸਰ ਤਾਨੇ ॥੧੪੯॥
215.e: Getting hold of his bow in his hand, Ram said to Parashuram, “On whom you have stretched this arrow in anger?”149.

215.g: ਮਾਨੁ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ਦੋਊ ਸਮਾਨੇ; ਮਸਤਕੁ ਡਾਰਿ. ਗੁਰ ਪਾਗਿਓ ॥
215.e: Honor and dishonor are the same to me; I have placed my forehead upon the Guru's Feet.

215.g: ਸੰਪਤ ਹਰਖੁ ਨ ਆਪਤ ਦੂਖਾ; ਰੰਗੁ ਠਾਕੁਰੈ ਲਾਗਿਓ ॥੧॥
215.e: Wealth does not excite me, and misfortune does not disturb me; I have embraced love for my Lord and Master. ||1||

215.g: ਬਾਸ ਬਾਸਰੀ ਏਕੈ ਸੁਆਮੀ; ਉਦਿਆਨ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਾਗਿਓ ॥
215.e: The One Lord and Master dwells in the home; He is seen in the wilderness as well.

215.g: ਨਿਰਭਉ ਭਏ ਸੰਤ. ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਡਾਰਿਓ; ਪੂਰਨ ਸਰਬਾਗਿਓ ॥੨॥
215.e: I have become fearless; the Saint has removed my doubts. The All-knowing Lord is pervading everywhere. ||2||

215.g: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰਤੈ ਕਾਰਣੁ ਕੀਨੋ; ਮਨਿ. ਬੁਰੋ ਨ ਲਾਗਿਓ ॥
215.e: Whatever the Creator does, my mind is not troubled.

215.g: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੈ; ਸੋਇਓ ਮਨੁ ਜਾਗਿਓ ॥੩॥
215.e: By the Grace of the Saints and the Company of the Holy, my sleeping mind has been awakened. ||3||

215.g: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ. ਓੜਿ ਤੁਹਾਰੀ ਪਰਿਓ; ਆਇਓ ਸਰਣਾਗਿਓ ॥
215.e: Servant Nanak seeks Your Support; he has come to Your Sanctuary.

215.g: ਨਾਮ ਰੰਗ ਸਹਜ ਰਸ ਮਾਣੇ; ਫਿਰਿ. ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਲਾਗਿਓ ॥੪॥੨॥੧੬੦॥
215.e: In the Love of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, he enjoys intuitive peace; pain no longer touches him. ||4||2||160||

215.g: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਾਲਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
215.e: Gauree Maalaa, Fifth Mehl:

215.g: ਮੋ ਕਉ; ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਕੋ ਸਮਝਾਵੈ ॥
215.e: Who can help me understand my condition?

215.g: ਕਰਤਾ ਹੋਇ ਜਨਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
215.e: Only the Creator knows it. ||1||Pause||

215.g: ਅਨਜਾਨਤ ਕਿਛੁ ਇਨਹਿ ਕਮਾਨੋ; ਜਪ ਤਪ ਕਛੂ. ਨ ਸਾਧਾ ॥
215.e: This person does things in ignorance; he does not chant in meditation, and does not perform any deep, self-disciplined meditation.

215.g: ਦਹ ਦਿਸਿ ਲੈ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਦਉਰਾਇਓ; ਕਵਨ ਕਰਮ ਕਰਿ ਬਾਧਾ ॥੧॥
215.e: This mind wanders around in the ten directions - how can it be restrained? ||1||

215.g: ਮਨ ਤਨ ਧਨ ਭੂਮਿ ਕਾ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ; ਹਉ ਇਸ ਕਾ ਇਹੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
215.e: "I am the lord, the master of my mind, body, wealth and lands. These are mine."

216.e: Gauree Maalaa, Fifth Mehl:
Without the Lord, other actions are useless.

216.g: ਜਪ ਤਪ ਸੰਜਮ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਣੇ; ਇਹਿ ਓਰੈ ਮੂਸੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
216.e: Meditative chants, intense deep meditation, austere self-discipline and rituals - these are plundered in this world. ||1||Pause||

216.g: ਬਰਤ ਨੇਮ ਸੰਜਮ ਮਹਿ ਰਹਤਾ; ਤਿਨ ਕਾ. ਆਢੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
216.e: Fasting, daily rituals, and austere self-discipline - those who keep the practice of these, are rewarded with less than a shell.

216.g: ਆਗੈ ਚਲਣੁ. ਅਉਰੁ ਹੈ ਭਾਈ; ਊਂਹਾ. ਕਾਮਿ ਨ ਆਇਆ ॥੧॥
216.e: Hereafter, the way is different, O Siblings of Destiny. There, these things are of no use at all. ||1||

216.g: ਤੀਰਥਿ ਨਾਇ ਅਰੁ ਧਰਨੀ ਭ੍ਰਮਤਾ; ਆਗੈ. ਠਉਰ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
216.e: Those who bathe at sacred shrines of pilgrimage, and wander over the earth, find no place of rest hereafter.

216.g: ਊਹਾ. ਕਾਮਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ, ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ; ਓਹੁ ਲੋਗਨ. ਹੀ ਪਤੀਆਵੈ ॥੨॥
216.e: There, these are of no use at all. By these things, they only please other people. ||2||

216.g: ਚਤੁਰ ਬੇਦ ਮੁਖ ਬਚਨੀ ਉਚਰੈ; ਆਗੈ ਮਹਲੁ. ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
216.e: Reciting the four Vedas from memory, they do not obtain the Mansion of the Lord's Presence hereafter.

216.g: ਬੂਝੈ ਨਾਹੀ. ਏਕੁ ਸੁਧਾਖਰੁ; ਓਹੁ ਸਗਲੀ ਝਾਖ ਝਖਾਈਐ ॥੩॥
216.e: Those who do not understand the One Pure Word, utter total nonsense. ||3||

216.g: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਕਹਤੋ. ਇਹੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਾ; ਜਿ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਸੁ ਪਾਰ ਗਰਾਮੀ ॥
216.e: Nanak voices this opinion: those who practice it, swim across.

216.g: ਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਹੁ ਅਰੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ; ਤਿਆਗਹੁ ਮਨਹੁ ਗੁਮਾਨੀ ॥੪॥੬॥੧੬੪॥
216.e: Serve the Guru, and meditate on the Naam; renounce the egotistical pride from your mind. ||4||6||164||
Raag Gauree Maajh, Fifth Mehl:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
O Merciful to the meek, O Dear Lord King,

216.g: ਕੋਟਿ ਜਨਾ ਕਰਿ; ਸੇਵ ਲਗਾਇਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
216.e: You have engaged millions of people in Your Service.

216.g: ਭਗਤ ਵਛਲੁ; ਤੇਰਾ ਬਿਰਦੁ ਰਖਾਇਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
216.e: You are the Lover of Your devotees; this is Your Nature.
You are totally pervading all places. ||1||

216.g: ਕਿਉ ਪੇਖਾ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ; ਕਵਣ ਸੁਕਰਣੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
216.e: How can I behold my Beloved? What is that way of life?
Become the slave of the Saints, and serve at their feet.

216.g: ਇਹੁ ਜੀਉ ਵਤਾਈ; ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥
216.e: I dedicate this soul; I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice to them.

216.g: ਤਿਸੁ; ਨਿਵਿ ਨਿਵਿ ਲਾਗਉ ਪਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
216.e: Bowing low, I fall at the Feet of the Lord. ||2||
The Pandits, the religious scholars, study the books of the Vedas.
Some become renunciates, and bathe at sacred shrines of pilgrimage.
Some sing tunes and melodies and songs.
But I meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Fearless Lord. ||3||
My Lord and Master has become merciful to me.

216.g: ਪਤਿਤ. ਪਵਿਤ; ਲਗਿ ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਪੈਰੇ ਜੀਉ ॥
216.e: I was a sinner, and I have been sanctified, taking to the Guru's Feet.

216.g: ਰਾਮ ਸੀਆ ਬਰ ਕੈ ਘਰਿ ਆਏ ॥

216.e: After the marriage of Ram and Sita, the congratulatory messages were received from various countries, when they returned to their home.158.
There was atmosphere of zest on all sides and the arrangements were being made for the celebration of the marriage of three sons.
On all sides the drums resounded in various tunes and many companies of dancers began to dance.159.
The warriors decorated with armours and the youthful soldiers marched forward.

216.g: ਭਏ ਜਾਇ ਇਸਥਤ ਨ੍ਰਿਪ ਦਰ ਪਰ ॥

216.e: All these great charioteers and archers came and stood at the gate of the king Dasrath.160.
Many types of musical instruments resounded and the melodious sounds of the drums were heard.
The energetic women began to sing and reveal their joy by dancing their eyes and clapping their hands.161.

216.g: ਭਿਛਕਨ ਹਵਸ ਨ ਧਨ ਕੀ ਰਹੀ ॥

216.e: The beggars had no more desire for wealth because the gift of gold flowed like a stream.
Anyone who asked for one thing, he would return to his home with twenty things.162.
The sons of king Dasrath playing in the forests appeared like the flowers bloomed in spring season.
The saffron sprinkled on the limbs appeared like the bliss gushing forth form the heart.163.

216.g: ਉਮਡ ਚਲਤ ਜਿਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਕਰਿ ਗੰਗਾ ॥
216.e: They are gathering their limitless fourfold army like the gushing forth of the Ganges.

216.g: ਭਰਮ ਮੋਹ ਕਛੁ ਸੂਝਸਿ ਨਾਹੀ; ਇਹ ਪੈਖਰ ਪਏ ਪੈਰਾ ॥੨॥
216.e: In doubt and emotional attachment, this person understands nothing; with this leash, these feet are tied up. ||2||

216.g: ਤਬ ਇਹੁ ਕਹਾ ਕਮਾਵਨ ਪਰਿਆ; ਜਬ ਇਹੁ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਹੋਤਾ ॥
216.e: What did this person do, when he did not exist?

216.g: ਜਬ ਏਕ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ਪ੍ਰਭ; ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਆਪਹਿ ਕਰਤਾ ॥੩॥
216.e: When the Immaculate and Formless Lord God was all alone, He did everything by Himself. ||3||

216.g: ਅਪਨੇ ਕਰਤਬ ਆਪੇ ਜਾਨੈ; ਜਿਨਿ ਇਹੁ ਰਚਨੁ ਰਚਾਇਆ ॥
216.e: He alone knows His actions; He created this creation.

216.g: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ. ਕਰਣਹਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਆਪੇ; ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ. ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੫॥੧੬੩॥
216.e: Says Nanak, the Lord Himself is the Doer. The True Guru has dispelled my doubts. ||4||5||163||
Gauree Maalaa, Fifth Mehl:

216.g: ਮਾਧਉ; ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ. ਮੁਖਿ ਕਹੀਐ ॥
216.e: O Lord, I chant Your Name, Har, Har, Har.

216.g: ਹਮ ਤੇ ਕਛੂ. ਨ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੁਆਮੀ; ਜਿਉ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਤਿਉ ਰਹੀਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
216.e: I cannot do anything by myself, O Lord and Master. As You keep me, so I remain. ||1||Pause||

216.g: ਕਿਆ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰੈ. ਕਿ ਕਰਣੈਹਾਰਾ; ਕਿਆ ਇਸੁ ਹਾਥਿ ਬਿਚਾਰੇ ॥
216.e: What can the mere mortal do? What is in the hands of this poor creature?

216.g: ਜਿਤੁ ਤੁਮ ਲਾਵਹੁ. ਤਿਤ ਹੀ ਲਾਗਾ; ਪੂਰਨ ਖਸਮ ਹਮਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
216.e: As You attach us, so we are attached, O my Perfect Lord and Master. ||1||

216.g: ਕਰਹੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ. ਸਰਬ ਕੇ ਦਾਤੇ; ਏਕ ਰੂਪ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਵਹੁ ॥
216.e: Take pity on me, O Great Giver of all, that I may enshrine love for Your Form alone.

216.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਪਹਿ; ਅਪੁਨਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਾਵਹੁ ॥੨॥੭॥੧੬੫॥
216.e: Nanak offers this prayer to the Lord, that he may chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||2||7||165||

217.g: ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਕਾਟਿ; ਕੀਏ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੇ ਜੀਉ ॥
217.e: Dispelling my doubts and fears, the Guru has rid me of hatred.

217.g: ਗੁਰ; ਮਨ ਕੀ ਆਸ ਪੂਰਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥
217.e: The Guru has fulfilled the desires of my mind. ||4||

217.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਨਾਉ ਪਾਇਆ; ਸੋ ਧਨਵੰਤਾ ਜੀਉ ॥
217.e: One who has obtained the Name is wealthy.

217.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ; ਸੁ ਸੋਭਾਵੰਤਾ ਜੀਉ ॥
217.e: One who meditates on God is glorified.

217.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਤਿ; ਤਿਸੁ ਸਭ ਸੁਕਰਣੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
217.e: Sublime are all the actions of those who join the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

217.g: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ; ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੫॥੧॥੧੬੬॥
217.e: Servant Nanak is intuitively absorbed into the Lord. ||5||1||166||

217.g: ਭਲ ਭਲ ਕੁਅਰ ਚੜੇ ਸਜ ਸੈਨਾ ॥
ਕੋਟਕ ਚੜੇ ਸੂਰ ਜਨੁ ਗੈਨਾ ॥੧੬੪॥
217.e: With their armed forces the princes appear glorious like millions of suns in the sky.164.

217.g: ਭਰਥ ਸਹਿਤ ਸੋਭਤ ਸਭ ਭ੍ਰਾਤਾ ॥
ਕਹਿ ਨ ਪਰਤ ਮੁਖ ਤੇ ਕਛੁ ਬਾਤਾ ॥
217.e: All the brothers blongwith Bharat seem in such splendour which cannot be described.

217.g: ਮਾਤਨ ਮਨ ਸੁੰਦਰ ਸੁਤ ਮੋਹੈਂ ॥
ਜਨੁ ਦਿਤ ਗ੍ਰਹ ਰਵਿ ਸਸ ਦੋਊ ਸੋਹੈਂ ॥੧੬੫॥
217.e: The beautiful princes are alluring the minds of their mothers and appear like the sun and moon born in the house of Diti, increasing its magnificence.165.

217.g: ਇਹ ਬਿਧ ਕੈ ਸਜ ਸੁਧ ਬਰਾਤਾ ॥
ਕਛੁ ਨ ਪਰਤ ਕਹਿ ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਬਾਤਾ ॥
217.e: In this way the beautiful wedding parties were emblished. Which are indescribable

217.g: ਬਾਢਤ ਕਹਤ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਬਾਤਨ ਕਰ ॥
ਬਿਦਾ ਹੋਨ ਸਿਸ ਚਲੇ ਤਾਤ ਘਰ ॥੧੬੬॥
217.e: By saying all this the volume of the book will be increased And all these children moved towards the place of their father for getting his permission to depart.166.

217.g: ਆਇ ਪਿਤਾ ਕਹੁ ਕੀਨ ਪ੍ਰਨਾਮਾ ॥
ਜੋਰਿ ਪਾਨ ਠਾਢੇ ਬਨਿ ਧਾਮਾ ॥
217.e: They ll came and bowed before their father and stood there with folded hands.

217.g: ਨਿਰਖਿ ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਆਨੰਦ ਮਨ ਭਰੇ ॥
ਦਾਨ ਬਹੁਤ ਬਿਪਨ ਕਹ ਕਰੇ ॥੧੬੭॥
217.e: The king was filled with joy on seeing his sons and he gave many things in charity to the Brahmins.167.

217.g: ਤਾਤ ਮਾਤ ਲੈ ਕੰਠਿ ਲਗਾਏ ॥
ਜਨ ਦੁਇ ਰਤਨ ਨਿਰਧਨੀ ਪਾਏ ॥
217.e: Hugging their children to their bosom the parents felt great pleasure like a poor man on acquiring the gems.

217.g: ਬਿਦਾ ਮਾਗ ਜਬ ਗਏ ਰਾਮ ਘਰ ॥
ਸੀਸ ਰਹੇ ਧਰਿ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਪਰ ॥੧੬੮॥
217.e: After taking permission for departure they reached the place of Ram and bowed their on his feet.168.

217.g: ਅਸ੍ਵ ਬਰਨਨੰ ॥
217.e: The description of horses :

217.g: ਕਬਿਤੁ ॥
217.e: KABIT

217.g: ਨਾਗਰਾ ਕੇ ਨੈਨ ਹੈਂ, ਕਿ ਚਾਤਰਾ ਕੇ ਬੈਨ ਹੈਂ; ਬਘੂਲਾ ਮਾਨੋ ਗੈਨ ਕੈਸੇ ਤੈਸੇ ਥਹਰਤ ਹੈਂ ॥
217.e: The horses, restless like the eyes of a women, swift like the swift utterances of a shrewd person an mercurial like the crane rising up in the sky, are vibrating hither and thither.

217.g: ਨ੍ਰਿਤਕਾ ਕੇ ਪਾਉ ਹੈਂ, ਕਿ ਜੂਪ ਕੈਸੇ ਦਾਉ ਹੈਂ; ਕਿ ਛਲ ਕੋ ਦਿਖਾਉ ਕੋਊ, ਤੈਸੇ ਬਿਹਰਤ ਹੈਂ ॥
217.e: They are swift like the feet of a dancer, they are the tactics of throwing the dice or even some hallucination.

217.g: ਹਾਕੇ ਬਾਜ ਬੀਰ ਹੈਂ, ਤੁਫੰਗ ਕੈਸੇ ਤੀਰ ਹੈਂ; ਕਿ ਅੰਜਨੀ ਕੇ ਧੀਰ ਹੈਂ, ਕਿ ਧੁਜਾ ਸੇ ਫਹਰਤ ਹੈਂ ॥
217.e: These brave horses are swift like arrow and gunshot, shrewd and mighty like Hanuman, the son of Anjani  they are roaming like the fluttering banners.

217.g: ਲਹਰੈਂ ਅਨੰਗ ਕੀ ਤਰੰਗ ਜੈਸੇ ਗੰਗ ਕੀ ਅਨੰਗ ਕੈਸੇ ਅੰਗ ਜਯੋਂ ਨ ਕਹੂੰ ਠਹਰਤ ਹੈਂ ॥੧੭੧॥
217.e: These horses are like the intense emotions of the god of love, or the swift waves of the Ganges. They have beautiful limbs like the limbs of cupid and are not stable at any one place.171.

217.g: ਨਿਸਾ ਨਿਸਨਾਥਿ ਜਾਨੈ ਦਿਨ ਦਿਨਪਤਿ ਮਾਨੈ ਭਿਛਕਨ ਦਾਤਾ ਕੈ ਪ੍ਰਮਾਨੇ ਮਹਾ ਦਾਨ ਹੈਂ ॥
217.e: All the princes are being considered as moon by the night and sun by the day, they are known as great donors for the beggars, the ailments consider them as medicine.

217.g: ਅਉਖਧੀ ਕੇ ਰੋਗਨ, ਅਨੰਤ ਰੂਪ ਜੋਗਨ; ਸਮੀਪ ਕੈ ਬਿਯੋਗਨ, ਮਹੇਸ ਮਹਾ ਮਾਨ ਹੈਂ ॥
217.e: When they, consisting of endless beauty are nearby, them there is suspicion about their impending separation. They are all most honourable like Shiva.

217.g: ਸਤ੍ਰੈ ਖਗ ਖਯਾਤਾ ਸਿਸ ਰੂਪਨ ਕੇ ਮਾਤਾ ਮਹਾ ਗਯਾਨੀ ਗਯਾਨ ਗਯਾਤਾ ਕੈ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ਕੈ ਸਮਾਨ ਹੈਂ ॥
217.e: They are famous swordsmen, childlike for their mothers, the supreme knowledgeable for great sages, they appear apparently like probvidence.

217.g: ਗਨਨ ਗਨੇਸ ਮਾਨੈ, ਸੁਰਨ ਸੁਰੇਸ ਜਾਨੈ; ਜੈਸੇ ਪੇਖੈ ਤੈਸੇ ਈ ਲਖੇ ਬਿਰਾਜਮਾਨ ਹੈਂ ॥੧੭੨॥
217.e: All the Ganas consider them as Ganesh and all the gods as Indra. The sum and substance is this that they manifest themselves in the same form as one thinks about.172.

217.g: ਸੁਧਾ ਸੌ ਸੁਧਾਰੇ ਰੂਪ, ਸੋਭਤ ਉਜਿਯਾਰੇ ਕਿਧੌ; ਸਾਚੇ ਬੀਚ ਢਾਰੇ, ਮਹਾ ਸੋਭਾ ਕੈ ਸੁਧਾਰ ਕੈ ॥
217.e: Having bathed in ambrosia and the manifestation of beauty and glory, these very winsome princes appear as having been created in special mould.

217.g: ਕਿਧੌ ਮਹਾ ਮੋਹਨੀ ਕੇ ਮੋਹਬੇ ਨਮਿਤ ਬੀਰ ਬਿਧਨਾ ਬਨਾਏ ਮਹਾ ਬਿਧ ਸੋ ਬਿਚਾਰ ਕੈ ॥
217.e: It seems that in order to allure some most beautiful damsel the providence created these great heroes in a special way.

217.g: ਕਿਧੌ ਦੇਵ ਦੈਤਨ ਬਿਬਾਦ ਛਾਡ ਬਡੇ ਚਿਰ; ਮਥ ਕੈ ਸਮੁੰਦ੍ਰ ਛੀਰ ਲੀਨੇ ਹੈ ਨਿਕਾਰ ਕੈ ॥
217.e: They appear as having been taken out as gems by churning the ocean by the gods and demons on abandoning their disputes.

217.g: ਕਿਧੌ ਬਿਸ੍ਵਨਾਥ ਜੂ ਬਨਾਏ ਨਿਜ ਪੇਖਬੇ ਕਉ; ਅਉਰ ਨ ਸਕਤ ਐਸੀ ਸੂਰਤੈ ਸੁਧਾਰ ਕੈ ॥੧੭੩॥
217.e: Or it seems that the Lord of the universe made improvement in the creation of their faces himself for having their continuous sight.173.

217.g: ਸੀਮ ਤਜਿ ਆਪਨੀ, ਬਿਰਾਨੇ ਦੇਸ ਲਾਘ ਲਾਘ; ਰਾਜਾ ਮਿਥਲੇਸ ਕੇ ਪਹੂਚੇ ਦੇਸ ਆਨ ਕੈ ॥
217.e: Crossing the frontier of their kingdom and passing through other countries, all these princes reached the abode of king Janak of Mithila.

217.g: ਤੁਰਹੀ ਅਨੰਤ ਬਾਜੈ, ਦੁੰਦਭੀ ਅਪਾਰ ਗਾਜੈ; ਭਾਤਿ ਭਾਤਿ ਬਾਜਨ ਬਜਾਏ ਜੋਰ ਜਾਨ ਕੈ ॥
217.e: On reaching there they caused the high-pitch resonance of the drums and other musical instruments.

217.g: ਆਗੈ ਆਨਿ ਤੀਨੈ ਨ੍ਰਿਪ ਕੰਠ ਲਾਇ ਲੀਨੇ ਰੀਤ; ਰੂੜ ਸਭੈ ਕੀਨੇ ਬੈਠੇ ਬੇਦ ਕੈ ਬਿਧਾਨ ਕੈ ॥
217.e: The king came forward and hugged the all three to his bosom, all the Vedic rites were performed.

217.g: ਬਰਿਖਯੋ ਧਨ ਕੀ ਧਾਰ ਪਾਇਯਤ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰ ਭਿਛਕ ਭਏ ਨ੍ਰਿਪਾਰ ਐਸੇ ਪਾਇ ਦਾਨ ਕੈ ॥੧੭੪॥
217.e: There was continuous chartable flow of wealth and on acquiring the alsm, the beggars became king-like.174.

217.g: ਬਾਨੇ ਫਹਰਾਨੇ ਘਹਰਾਨੇ ਦੁੰਦਭ ਅਰਰਾਨੇ; ਜਨਕ ਪੁਰੀ ਕੌ ਨੀਅਰਾਨੇ ਬੀਰ ਜਾਇ ਕੈ ॥
217.e: The banners were unfurled and the drums resounded, the brave heroes began to shout loudly on reaching Janakpuri.

217.g: ਕਹੂੰ ਚਉਰ ਢਾਰੈ, ਕਹੂੰ ਚਾਰਣ ਉਚਾਰੈ; ਕਹੂੰ ਭਾਟ ਜੁ ਪੁਕਾਰੈ ਛੰਦ ਸੁੰਦਰ ਬਨਾਇ ਕੈ ॥
217.e: Somewhere the whisks are being swung, somewhere the minstrels are singing eulogies and somewhere the poets are reciting their beautiful stanza.

217.g: ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
217.e: Raag Gauree Maajh, Fifth Mehl:

217.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
217.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

217.g: ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰਾ ਬਹੁ ਮਾਣੁ ਕਰਤੇ; ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰਾ ਬਹੁ ਮਾਣੁ ॥
217.e: I am so proud of You, O Creator; I am so proud of You.

217.g: ਜੋਰਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੈ. ਸੁਖਿ ਵਸਾ; ਸਚੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
217.e: Through Your Almighty Power, I dwell in peace. The True Word of the Shabad is my banner and insignia. ||1||Pause||

217.g: ਸਭੇ ਗਲਾ ਜਾਤੀਆ; ਸੁਣਿ ਕੈ ਚੁਪ ਕੀਆ ॥
217.e: He hears and knows everything, but he keeps silent.

217.g: ਕਦ ਹੀ ਸੁਰਤਿ. ਨ ਲਧੀਆ; ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੜਿਆ ॥੧॥
217.e: Bewitched by Maya, he never regains awareness. ||1||

217.g: ਦੇਇ ਬੁਝਾਰਤ ਸਾਰਤਾ; ਸੇ ਅਖੀ ਡਿਠੜਿਆ ॥
217.e: The riddles and hints are given, and he sees them with his eyes.

217.g: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
217.e: Gauree Maajh, Fifth Mehl:

217.g: ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਸਾਜਨ; ਮਨ ਮਿਤ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਜੀਉ ॥
217.e: Listen, listen, O my friend and companion, O Beloved of my mind:

217.g: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਤੇਰਾ; ਇਹੁ ਜੀਉ ਭਿ. ਵਾਰੇ ਜੀਉ ॥
217.e: my mind and body are Yours. This life is a sacrifice to You as well.

217.g: ਵਿਸਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ; ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਅਧਾਰੇ ਜੀਉ ॥
217.e: May I never forget God, the Support of the breath of life.

217.g: ਸਦਾ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
217.e: I have come to Your Eternal Sanctuary. ||1||

217.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਮਿਲਿਐ; ਮਨੁ ਜੀਵੈ ਭਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥
217.e: Meeting Him, my mind is revived, O Siblings of Destiny.

217.g: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ; ਸੋ. ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥
217.e: By Guru's Grace, I have found the Lord, Har, Har.

217.g: ਸਭ ਕਿਛੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਾ; ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀਆ ਜਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥
217.e: All things belong to God; all places belong to God.

217.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ; ਸਦ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
217.e: I am forever a sacrifice to God. ||2||

217.g: ਏਹੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ; ਜਪੈ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
217.e: Very fortunate are those who meditate on this treasure.

217.g: ਨਾਮ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ; ਏਕ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
217.e: They enshrine love for the Naam, the Name of the One Immaculate Lord.

217.g: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਇਆ; ਸਭੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਮਿਟਾਇਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
217.e: Finding the Perfect Guru, all suffering is dispelled.

217.g: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ; ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇਆ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
217.e: Twenty-four hours a day, I sing the Glories of God. ||3||

217.g: ਰਤਨ ਪਦਾਰਥ; ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੁਮਾਰਾ ਜੀਉ ॥
217.e: Your Name is the treasure of jewels, Lord.

217.g: ਤੂੰ ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹੁ; ਭਗਤੁ ਵਣਜਾਰਾ ਜੀਉ ॥
217.e: You are the True Banker; Your devotee is the trader.

217.g: ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਰਾਸਿ; ਸਚੁ ਵਾਪਾਰਾ ਜੀਉ ॥
217.e: True is the trade of those who have the wealth of the Lord's assets.

217.g: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ; ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੩॥੧੬੮॥
217.e: Servant Nanak is forever a sacrifice. ||4||3||168||

217.g: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਮਾਝ ॥
217.e: Gauree, Fifth Mehl, Maajh:

217.g: ਆਉ ਹਮਾਰੈ; ਰਾਮ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਜੀਉ ॥
217.e: Come to me, O my Beloved Lord.

217.g: ਰੈਣਿ ਦਿਨਸੁ; ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਚਿਤਾਰੇ ਜੀਉ ॥
217.e: Night and day, with each and every breath, I think of You.

217.g: ਸੰਤ ਦੇਉ ਸੰਦੇਸਾ; ਪੈ ਚਰਣਾਰੇ ਜੀਉ ॥
217.e: O Saints, give Him this message; I fall at Your Feet.

217.g: ਤੁਧੁ ਬਿਨੁ; ਕਿਤੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਤਰੀਐ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
217.e: Without You, how can I be saved? ||1||

217.g: ਸੰਗਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੈ; ਮੈ ਕਰੇ ਅਨੰਦਾ ਜੀਉ ॥
217.e: In Your Company, I am in ecstasy.

217.g: ਵਣਿ ਤਿਣਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣਿ; ਸੁਖ ਪਰਮਾਨੰਦਾ ਜੀਉ ॥
217.e: In the forest, the fields and the three worlds, there is peace and supreme bliss.

217.g: ਸੇਜ ਸੁਹਾਵੀ; ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਬਿਗਸੰਦਾ ਜੀਉ ॥
217.e: My bed is beautiful, and my mind blossoms forth in ecstasy.

217.g: ਪੇਖਿ ਦਰਸਨੁ; ਇਹੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਲਹੀਐ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
217.e: Beholding the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan, I have found this peace. ||2||

217.g: ਚਰਣ ਪਖਾਰਿ; ਕਰੀ ਨਿਤ ਸੇਵਾ ਜੀਉ ॥
217.e: I wash Your Feet, and constantly serve You.

217.g: ਪੂਜਾ ਅਰਚਾ ਬੰਦਨ ਦੇਵਾ ਜੀਉ ॥
217.e: O Divine Lord, I worship and adore You; I bow down before You.

217.g: ਦਾਸਨਿ ਦਾਸੁ; ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿ ਲੇਵਾ ਜੀਉ ॥
217.e: I am the slave of Your slaves; I chant Your Name.

217.g: ਬਿਨਉ; ਠਾਕੁਰ ਪਹਿ ਕਹੀਐ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
217.e: I offer this prayer to my Lord and Master. ||3||

217.g: ਇਛ ਪੁੰਨੀ ਮੇਰੀ; ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਹਰਿਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
217.e: My desires are fulfilled, and my mind and body are rejuvenated.

217.g: ਦਰਸਨ ਪੇਖਤ; ਸਭ ਦੁਖ ਪਰਹਰਿਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
217.e: Beholding the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan, all my pains have been taken away.

217.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ; ਜਪੇ ਜਪਿ ਤਰਿਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
217.e: Chanting and meditating on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, I have been saved.

217.g: ਇਹੁ ਅਜਰੁ. ਨਾਨਕ; ਸੁਖੁ ਸਹੀਐ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੨॥੧੬੭॥
217.e: Nanak endures this unendurable celestial bliss. ||4||2||167||

217.g: ਕਬਿਤ ॥
217.e: KABIT

217.g: ਅਉਧ ਤੇ ਨਿਸਰ ਚਲੇ, ਲੀਨੇ ਸੰਗਿ ਸੂਰ ਭਲੇ; ਰਨ ਤੇ ਨ ਟਲੇ ਪਲੇ, ਸੋਭਾ ਹੂੰ ਕੇ ਧਾਮ ਕੇ ॥
217.e: All have moved out of Oudhpuri and all of them taken along with them the winsome warriors, who never retrace their steps in war.

217.g: ਸੁੰਦਰ ਕੁਮਾਰ ਉਰ ਹਾਰ ਸੋਭਤ ਅਪਾਰ ਤੀਨੋ ਲੋਗ ਮਧ ਕੀ ਮੁਹਯਾ ਸਭ ਬਾਮ ਕੇ ॥
217.e: They are beautiful princes, bedecked with necklaces around their necks. They are all going to bring their wedded women.

217.g: ਦੁਰਜਨ ਦਲਯਾ ਤੀਨੋ ਲੋਕ ਕੇ ਜਿਤਯਾ ਤੀਨੋ ਰਾਮ ਜੂ ਕੇ ਭਯਾ ਹੈਂ ਚਹਯਾ ਹਰ ਨਾਮ ਕੇ ॥
217.e: They are all the mashers of the tyrants, capable of conquering the three worlds, lovers of the name of the Lord and brothers of Ram.

217.g: ਬੁਧ ਕੇ ਉਦਾਰ ਹੈਂ ਸਿੰਗਾਰ ਅਵਤਾਰ ਦਾਨ ਸੀਲ ਕੇ ਪਹਾਰ ਕੈ ਕੁਮਾਰ ਬਨੇ ਕਾਮ ਕੇ ॥੧੭੦॥
217.e: They are magnanimous in wisdom, the incarnation of embellishment, the mountain of munificence and are just like Ram.170.

217.g: ਕਬਿਤ ॥
217.e: KABIT

217.g: ਰਾਮ ਬਿਦਾ ਕਰੇ, ਸਿਰ ਚੂਮਯੋ ਪਾਨ ਪੀਠ ਧਰੇ; ਆਨੰਦ ਸੋ ਭਰੇ, ਲੈ ਤੰਬੋਰ ਆਗੇ ਧਰੇ ਹੈਂ ॥
217.e: Ram kissed the heads of all and placed his hand on their back with love, He presented with betel leaf etc. and affectionately bade them farewell.

217.g: ਦੁੰਦਭੀ ਬਜਾਇ, ਤੀਨੋ ਭਾਈ ਯੌ ਚਲਤ ਭਏ; ਮਾਨੋ ਸੂਰ ਚੰਦ ਕੋਟਿ, ਆਨ ਅਵਤਰੇ ਹੈਂ ॥
217.e: Playing on the drums and the musical instruments all the people moved as if millions of suns and moons have manifested on the earth.

217.g: ਕੇਸਰ ਸੋ ਭੀਜੇ ਪਟ, ਸੋਭਾ ਦੇਤ ਐਸੀ ਭਾਤ; ਮਾਨੋ ਰੂਪ ਰਾਗ ਕੇ ਸੁਹਾਗ ਭਾਗ ਭਰੇ ਹੈਂ ॥
217.e: The garments saturated with saffron are looking splendid as if the beauty itself has materialized.

217.g: ਰਾਜਾ ਅਵਧੇਸ ਕੇ ਕੁਮਾਰ ਐਸੇ ਸੋਭਾ ਦੇਤ; ਕਾਮਜੂ ਨੇ ਕੋਟਿਕ ਕਲਿਯੋਰਾ ਕੈਧੌ ਕਰੇ ਹੈਂ ॥੧੬੯॥
217.e: The princes of Dasrath the king of Oudh, appear splendid like the god of love alongwith his arts.169.

218.e: Gauree, Fifth Mehl, Maajh:

218.g: ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨੁ. ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਜੀ; ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨੁ. ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
218.e: The Destroyer of sorrow is Your Name, Lord; the Destroyer of sorrow is Your Name.

218.g: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਆਰਾਧੀਐ; ਪੂਰਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
218.e: Twenty-four hours a day, dwell upon the wisdom of the Perfect True Guru. ||1||Pause||

218.g: ਜਿਤੁ ਘਟਿ ਵਸੈ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ; ਸੋਈ ਸੁਹਾਵਾ ਥਾਉ ॥
218.e: That heart, in which the Supreme Lord God abides, is the most beautiful place.

218.g: ਜਮ ਕੰਕਰੁ. ਨੇੜਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ; ਰਸਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ॥੧॥
218.e: The Messenger of Death does not even approach those who chant the Glorious Praises of the Lord with the tongue. ||1||

218.g: ਸੇਵਾ ਸੁਰਤਿ. ਨ ਜਾਣੀਆ; ਨਾ ਜਾਪੈ ਆਰਾਧਿ ॥
218.e: I have not understood the wisdom of serving Him, nor have I worshipped Him in meditation.

218.g: ਓਟ ਤੇਰੀ ਜਗਜੀਵਨਾ; ਮੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਅਗਮ ਅਗਾਧਿ ॥੨॥
218.e: You are my Support, O Life of the World; O my Lord and Master, Inaccessible and Incomprehensible. ||2||

218.g: ਭਏ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਗੁਸਾਈਆ; ਨਠੇ ਸੋਗ ਸੰਤਾਪ ॥
218.e: When the Lord of the Universe became merciful, sorrow and suffering departed.

218.g: ਤਤੀ ਵਾਉ. ਨ ਲਗਈ; ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਰਖੇ ਆਪਿ ॥੩॥
218.e: The hot winds do not even touch those who are protected by the True Guru. ||3||

218.g: ਗੁਰੁ ਨਾਰਾਇਣੁ. ਦਯੁ ਗੁਰੁ; ਗੁਰੁ ਸਚਾ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
218.e: The Guru is the All-pervading Lord, the Guru is the Merciful Master; the Guru is the True Creator Lord.

218.g: ਗੁਰਿ ਤੁਠੈ. ਸਭ ਕਿਛੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ. ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰ ॥੪॥੨॥੧੭੦॥
218.e: When the Guru was totally satisfied, I obtained everything. Servant Nanak is forever a sacrifice to Him. ||4||2||170||
Gauree Maajh, Fifth Mehl:
The Lord, the Lord, Raam, Raam, Raam:
meditating on Him, all affairs are resolved. ||1||Pause||

218.g: ਰਾਮ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਜਪੇਦਿਆ; ਹੋਆ ਮੁਖੁ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰੁ ॥
218.e: Chanting the Name of the Lord of the Universe, one's mouth is sanctified.

218.g: ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਸੁਣੀਐ ਜਿਸ ਤੇ; ਸੋਈ ਭਾਈ ਮਿਤ੍ਰੁ ॥੧॥
218.e: One who recites to me the Praises of the Lord is my friend and brother. ||1||

218.g: ਸਭਿ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਸਭਿ ਫਲਾ; ਸਰਬ ਗੁਣਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
218.e: All treasures, all rewards and all virtues are in the Lord of the Universe.

218.g: ਕਿਉ ਗੋਬਿੰਦੁ ਮਨਹੁ ਵਿਸਾਰੀਐ; ਜਿਸੁ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਦੁਖ ਜਾਹਿ ॥੨॥
218.e: Why forget Him from your mind? Remembering Him in meditation, pain departs. ||2||

218.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਲੜਿ ਲਗਿਐ ਜੀਵੀਐ; ਭਵਜਲੁ ਪਈਐ ਪਾਰਿ ॥
218.e: Grasping the hem of His robe, we live, and cross over the terrifying world-ocean.

218.g: ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਉਧਾਰੁ ਹੋਇ; ਮੁਖ ਊਜਲ ਦਰਬਾਰਿ ॥੩॥
218.e: Joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, one is saved, and one's face becomes radiant in the Court of the Lord. ||3||

218.g: ਜੀਵਨ ਰੂਪ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਜਸੁ; ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
218.e: The Praise of the Sustainer of the Universe is the essence of life, and the wealth of His Saints.

218.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਉਬਰੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿ; ਦਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਸਾਬਾਸਿ ॥੪॥੩॥੧੭੧॥
218.e: Nanak is saved, chanting the Naam, the Name of the Lord; in the True Court, he is cheered and applauded. ||4||3||171||
SAMAANKA STANZA

218.g: ਕਹੂੰ ਬੀਨ ਬਾਜੈ ਕੋਊ ਬਾਸੁਰੀ ਮ੍ਰਿਦੰਗ ਸਾਜੈ ਦੇਖੇ ਕਾਮ ਲਾਜੈ ਰਹੇ ਭਿਛਕ ਅਘਾਇ ਕੈ ॥
218.e: Somewhere the lyre is being played, somewhere flutes, drum and other musical instruments. On seeing all this the god of love is feeling shy and so mush charity was donated that the beggars feel satisfied.

218.g: ਰੰਕ ਤੇ ਸੁ ਰਾਜਾ ਭਏ, ਆਸਿਖ ਅਸੇਖ ਦਏ; ਮਾਗਤ ਨ ਭਏ ਫੇਰ, ਐਸੋ ਦਾਨ ਪਾਇ ਕੈ ॥੧੭੫॥
218.e: The poor became king-like and began to give blessings  after receiving alms, no tendency for begging was left.175.

218.g: ਆਨ ਕੈ ਜਨਕ ਲੀਨੋ ਕੰਠ ਸੋ ਲਗਾਇ ਤਿਹੂੰ; ਆਦਰ ਦੁਰੰਤ ਕੈ ਅਨੰਤ ਭਾਤਿ ਲਏ ਹੈਂ ॥
218.e: Janak came and hugged all the three to his bosom and honoured them in various ways.

218.g: ਬੇਦ ਕੇ ਬਿਧਾਨ ਕੈ ਕੈ ਬਯਾਸ ਤੇ ਬਧਾਈ ਬੇਦ; ਏਕ ਏਕ ਬਿਪ੍ਰ ਕਉ ਬਿਸੇਖ ਸ੍ਵਰਨ ਦਏ ਹੈਂ ॥
218.e: The Vedic discipline was observed and the Brahmins recited the congratulatory Vedic mantras.

218.g: ਰਾਜਕੁਆਰ ਸਭੈ ਪਹਿਰਾਇ ਸਿਰਪਾਇਨ ਤੇ; ਮੋਤੀਮਾਨ ਕਰਕੇ ਬਰਖ ਮੇਘ ਗਏ ਹੈਂ ॥
218.e: The king gave the gift of gold to each Brahmin, the princes were given presents and there was shower of gems.

218.g: ਦੰਤੀ ਸ੍ਵੇਤ ਦੀਨੇ ਕੇਤੇ ਸਿੰਧਲੀ ਤੁਰੇ ਨਵੀਨੇ; ਰਾਜਾ ਕੇ ਕੁਮਾਰ ਤੀਨੋ ਬਯਾਹ ਕੈ ਪਠਏ ਹੈਂ ॥੧੭੬॥
218.e: The white elephants and the brisk horses of Sindhu were presented to the princes, in this way all the three princes moved black after their wedding.176.

218.g: ਕੋਈ ਜਿ ਮੂਰਖੁ ਲੋਭੀਆ; ਮੂਲਿ. ਨ ਸੁਣੀ ਕਹਿਆ ॥੨॥
218.e: But he is foolish and greedy, and he never listens to what he is told. ||2||

218.g: ਇਕਸੁ ਦੁਹੁ ਚਹੁ ਕਿਆ ਗਣੀ; ਸਭ ਇਕਤੁ ਸਾਦਿ ਮੁਠੀ ॥
218.e: Why bother to count one, two, three, four? The whole world is defrauded by the same enticements.

218.g: ਇਕੁ ਅਧੁ. ਨਾਇ ਰਸੀਅੜਾ; ਕਾ ਵਿਰਲੀ ਜਾਇ ਵੁਠੀ ॥੩॥
218.e: Hardly anyone loves the Lord's Name; how rare is that place which is in bloom. ||3||

218.g: ਭਗਤ ਸਚੇ ਦਰਿ ਸੋਹਦੇ; ਅਨਦ ਕਰਹਿ ਦਿਨ ਰਾਤਿ ॥
218.e: The devotees look beautiful in the True Court; night and day, they are happy.

218.g: ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤੇ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੈ; ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ. ਤਿਨ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਤ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੬੯॥
218.e: They are imbued with the Love of the Transcendent Lord; servant Nanak is a sacrifice to them. ||4||1||169||
DODHAK STANZA
After marrying the daughter of King Janak, the princes soon asked for permission to depart.
This group of kings accompanied by elephants and horses, having many desires in their mind, started (for back journey).177.
The dowry was given in such a great measure that even the Brahmins could not keep the same collectively.
Many types of horses and the thundering elephants in many garbs started moving.178.
The sound of fifes resounded and the mighty warriors thundered.
When Oudhpuri was nearby, then all were welcomed by Ram.179.
The mother drank water after its propitiatory offering to princes and the King Dasrath was highly pleased in his mind seeing this splendour.
On seeing the princes, the king hugged them to his bosom and all the people entered the city while dancing and singing.180.
When the princes came home after their marriage, then many kinds of congratulatory songs were sung.
Dasrath called Vasishtha and Sumantra and with them came several other sages.181.

218.g: ਚਾਰੋ ਦਿਸ ਦਿਗ ਦਾਹ ਲਖਿਯੋ ਸਭ ॥
218.e: At that time the clouds gathered on all the four sides and all saw apparently the flames of fire in all the four directions.
On seeing this all the ministers and friends became worried and request the king in the following manner.182.
“O King! There are many cases of providential wrath, tumult on all the four sides, therefore give thought to them by calling all the sages and advisers.
“Call the Brahmins without delay and begin Krit Yajna.183.
“O King! give instant orders for starting the Krit Yajna without delay,
“In view of the great wisdom of friends and ministers.”184.

218.g: ਬੋਲਿ ਬਡੇ ਰਿਖ ਲੀਨ ਮਹਾ ਦਿਜ ॥
ਹੈ ਤਿਨ ਬੋਲ ਲਯੋ ਜੁਤ ਰਿਤਜ ॥
218.e: The king called he eminent sages and great friends soon.
The sacrificial pit was dug up there and a pillar of righteousness was established.185.
A horse was let off from the stable so that ending the glory of other king they may be conquered.
The kings several countries were sent alongwith the horse and all of them were persons of beauteous limbs and the enhancer of glory.186.
Gauree Maajh, Fifth Mehl:

218.g: ਮੀਠੇ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ, ਗਾਉ ਜਿੰਦੂ; ਤੂੰ ਮੀਠੇ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ॥
218.e: Sing the Sweet Praises of the Lord, O my soul, sing the Sweet Praises of the Lord.

218.g: ਸਚੇ ਸੇਤੀ ਰਤਿਆ; ਮਿਲਿਆ ਨਿਥਾਵੇ ਥਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
218.e: Attuned to the True One, even the homeless find a home. ||1||Pause||

218.g: ਹੋਰਿ ਸਾਦ ਸਭਿ ਫਿਕਿਆ; ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਫਿਕਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
218.e: All other tastes are bland and insipid; through them, the body and mind are rendered insipid as well.

218.g: ਵਿਣੁ ਪਰਮੇਸਰ ਜੋ ਕਰੇ; ਫਿਟੁ ਸੁ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥
218.e: Without the Transcendent Lord, what can anyone do? Cursed is his life, and cursed his reputation. ||1||

218.g: ਅੰਚਲੁ ਗਹਿ ਕੈ ਸਾਧ ਕਾ; ਤਰਣਾ ਇਹੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
218.e: Grasping the hem of the robe of the Holy Saint, we cross over the world-ocean.
Worship and adore the Supreme Lord God, and all your family will be saved as well. ||2||

218.g: ਸਾਜਨੁ ਬੰਧੁ ਸੁਮਿਤ੍ਰੁ ਸੋ; ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਦੇਇ ॥
218.e: He is a companion, a relative, and a good friend of mine, who implants the Lord's Name within my heart.

218.g: ਅਉਗਣ ਸਭਿ ਮਿਟਾਇ ਕੈ; ਪਰਉਪਕਾਰੁ ਕਰੇਇ ॥੩॥
218.e: He washes off all my demerits, and is so generous to me. ||3||

218.g: ਮਾਲੁ ਖਜਾਨਾ ਥੇਹੁ ਘਰੁ; ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ ਨਿਧਾਨ ॥
218.e: Wealth, treasures, and household are all just ruins; the Lord's Feet are the only treasure.

218.g: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜਾਚਕੁ. ਦਰਿ ਤੇਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਭ; ਤੁਧਨੋ ਮੰਗੈ ਦਾਨੁ ॥੪॥੪॥੧੭੨॥
218.e: Nanak is a beggar standing at Your Door, God; he begs for Your charity. ||4||4||172||

219.e: Gauree, Ninth Mehl:
O mother, if only someone would instruct my wayward mind.
Gauree, Ninth Mehl:

219.g: ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ਕਉ; ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ. ਮਨਿ ਨਹੀ ਆਵੈ ॥
219.e: The Praise of the Lord does not come to dwell in the minds of the mortal beings.

219.g: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਮਗਨੁ ਰਹੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੈ; ਕਹੁ ਕੈਸੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
219.e: Day and night, they remain engrossed in Maya. Tell me, how can they sing God's Glories? ||1||Pause||

219.g: ਪੂਤ ਮੀਤ ਮਾਇਆ ਮਮਤਾ ਸਿਉ; ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਆਪੁ ਬੰਧਾਵੈ ॥
219.e: In this way, they bind themselves to children, friends, Maya and possessiveness.

219.g: ਮ੍ਰਿਗ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਜਿਉ, ਝੂਠੋ ਇਹੁ ਜਗ; ਦੇਖਿ ਤਾਸਿ. ਉਠਿ ਧਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
219.e: Like the deer's delusion, this world is false; and yet, beholding it, they chase after it. ||1||

219.g: ਭੁਗਤਿ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕਾ ਕਾਰਨੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ; ਮੂੜ ਤਾਹਿ ਬਿਸਰਾਵੈ ॥
219.e: Our Lord and Master is the source of pleasures and liberation; and yet, the fool forgets Him.

219.g: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ. ਕੋਟਨ ਮੈ ਕੋਊ; ਭਜਨੁ ਰਾਮ ਕੋ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੨॥੩॥
219.e: O servant Nanak, among millions, there is scarcely anyone who attains the Lord's meditation. ||2||3||
The king Dasrath made selection of other efficient kings and sent them with the horse.
They went having been completely embellished. These brave men were of very gentle demeanour.187.
They roamed in several countries, both inland and foreign and at all the places they destroyed (the pride of) all with the blaze of their glory.
They caused their horse to revolve on all the four sides and in this way they enhanced the royal prestige of king Dasrath.188.
Many kings bowed at his feet and he removed all their agonies.
He completed his Yajna and in this way destroyed the anguish of his subjects.189.
Receiving the gifts of many kinds the Brahmins pleased and satisfied in their mind  they moved back to their places.
Giving the blessing of various kinds and singing the Vedic mantras.190.
The kings of the inland and foreign countries decorate themselves in various garbs,
And noticing the significant glory of the warriors, the beautiful and cultured women were allured towards them.191.
Millions of musical instruments were played and all the bedecked persons were full of love.
The idols of gods were established and all were bowing with respect to the gods, expressing their gratitude.192.
All the people prostrated and bowed at the feet of gods and were assuming significant emotions in their minds.
Therefore was recitation of mantras and yantras and the idols of Ganas were being fixed.193.
Beautiful women and heavenly damsels began to dance.
In this way there was the sway of Ram Rajya and there was no dearth of anything.194.
Gauree, Ninth Mehl:
Holy Saadhus: the Lord fashioned the creation.

219.g: ਇਕਿ ਬਿਨਸੈ. ਇਕ ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਮਾਨੈ; ਅਚਰਜੁ. ਲਖਿਓ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
219.e: One person passes away, and another thinks that he will live forever - this is a wonder beyond understanding! ||1||Pause||

219.g: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਮੋਹ ਬਸਿ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ; ਹਰਿ; ਮੂਰਤਿ ਬਿਸਰਾਈ ॥
219.e: The mortal beings are held in the power of sexual desire, anger and emotional attachment; they have forgotten the Lord, the Immortal Form.

219.g: ਝੂਠਾ ਤਨੁ. ਸਾਚਾ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨਿਓ; ਜਿਉ ਸੁਪਨਾ ਰੈਨਾਈ ॥੧॥
219.e: The body is false, but they believe it to be true; it is like a dream in the night. ||1||

219.g: ਜੋ ਦੀਸੈ ਸੋ ਸਗਲ ਬਿਨਾਸੈ; ਜਿਉ ਬਾਦਰ ਕੀ ਛਾਈ ॥
219.e: Whatever is seen, shall all pass away, like the shadow of a cloud.

219.g: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ. ਜਗੁ ਜਾਨਿਓ ਮਿਥਿਆ; ਰਹਿਓ ਰਾਮ ਸਰਨਾਈ ॥੨॥੨॥
219.e: O servant Nanak, one who knows the world to be unreal, dwells in the Sanctuary of the Lord. ||2||2||
SARSWATI STANZA

219.g: ਦੇਸ ਦੇਸਨ ਕੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਆ; ਸਿਖਵੰਤ ਹੈਂ ਦਿਜ ਏਕ ॥
219.e: On one side the Brahmins are teaching about the activities of various countries,

219.g: ਬਾਨ ਅਉਰ ਕਮਾਨ ਕੀ; ਬਿਧ ਦੇਤ ਆਨਿ ਅਨੇਕ ॥
219.e: And on the other side the methods of archery are being reveled.

219.g: ਭਾਤ ਭਾਤਨ ਸੋਂ ਪੜਾਵਤ ਬਾਰ ਨਾਰਿ ਸਿੰਗਾਰ ॥
219.e: Instructions are being given about various types of the embellishments of women.

219.g: ਕੋਕ ਕਾਬਯ ਪੜੈ ਕਹੂੰ; ਬਯਾਕਰਨ ਬੇਦ ਬਿਚਾਰ ॥੧੯੫॥
219.e: The art of love, poetry, grammar and Vedic learning are being taught side by side.195.

219.g: ਰਾਮ ਪਰਮ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਹੈ; ਰਘੁਬੰਸ ਕੇ ਅਵਤਾਰ ॥
219.e: The incarnation of Ram of the clan of Raghu is extremely pure.

219.g: ਦੁਸਟ ਦੈਤਨ ਕੇ ਸੰਘਾਰਕ; ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਅਧਾਰ ॥
219.e: He is the destroyer of tyrants and demons and is thus the support of the life-breath of the saints.

219.g: ਦੇਸਿ ਦੇਸਿ ਨਰੇਸ ਜੀਤ; ਅਸੇਸ ਕੀਨ ਗੁਲਾਮ ॥
219.e: He has subordinate the king of various countries by conquering them,

219.g: ਜਤ੍ਰ ਤਤ੍ਰ ਧੁਜਾ ਬਧੀ ਜੈ ਪਤ੍ਰ ਕੀ ਸਭ ਧਾਮ ॥੧੯੬॥
219.e: And his banners of victory are fluttering here, there and everywhere.196.

219.g: ਬਾਟਿ ਤੀਨ ਦਿਸਾ ਤਿਹੂੰ ਸੁਤ; ਰਾਜਧਾਨੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
219.e: The king gave his three sons the kingdoms of three directions and gave Ram the kingdom of his capital Ayodhya,

219.g: ਬੋਲ ਰਾਜ ਬਿਸਿਸਟ ਕੀਨ; ਬਿਚਾਰ ਕੇਤਕ ਜਾਮ ॥
219.e: After discussing for a long time with Vasishtha,

219.g: ਸਾਜ ਰਾਘਵ ਰਾਜ ਕੇ; ਘਟ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਾਖਸਿ ਏਕ ॥
219.e: There lived a demoness in the house of Dasrath in disguise,

219.g: ਆਂਬ੍ਰ ਮਉਲਨ ਦੀਸੁ ਉਦਕੰ ਅਉਰ ਪੁਹਪ ਅਨੇਕ ॥੧੯੭॥
219.e: Who had asked for all this activity the fructifying mango dust, pure water of the stream and many flowers.197.

219.g: ਥਾਰ ਚਾਰ ਅਪਾਰ ਕੁੰਕਮ; ਚੰਦਨਾਦਿ ਅਨੰਤ ॥
219.e: Four adorned slavers containing saffron, sandalwood etc.,

219.g: ਰਾਜ ਸਾਜ ਧਰੇ ਸਭੈ ਤਹ; ਆਨ ਆਨ ਦੁਰੰਤ ॥
219.e: Were kept with the king for the fulfillment of this function.

219.g: ਮੰਥਰਾ ਇਕ ਗਾਧ੍ਰਬੀ; ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਪਠੀ ਤਿਹ ਕਾਲ ॥
219.e: At the same time Brahma sent a Gandharva woman named Manthra to the place,
Gauree, Ninth Mehl:

219.g: ਸਾਧੋ; ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਗਹਿਓ. ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
219.e: Holy Saadhus: this mind cannot be restrained.

219.g: ਚੰਚਲ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਸੰਗਿ ਬਸਤੁ ਹੈ; ਯਾ ਤੇ. ਥਿਰੁ ਨ ਰਹਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
219.e: Fickle desires dwell with it, and so it cannot remain steady. ||1||Pause||

219.g: ਕਠਨ ਕਰੋਧ. ਘਟ ਹੀ ਕੇ ਭੀਤਰਿ; ਜਿਹ ਸੁਧਿ ਸਭ ਬਿਸਰਾਈ ॥
219.e: The heart is filled with anger and violence, which cause all sense to be forgotten.

219.g: ਰਤਨੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ. ਸਭ ਕੋ ਹਿਰਿ ਲੀਨਾ; ਤਾ ਸਿਉ. ਕਛੁ ਨ ਬਸਾਈ ॥੧॥
219.e: The jewel of spiritual wisdom has been taken away from everyone; nothing can withstand it. ||1||

219.g: ਜੋਗੀ ਜਤਨ ਕਰਤ ਸਭਿ ਹਾਰੇ; ਗੁਨੀ ਰਹੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਈ ॥
219.e: The Yogis have tried everything and failed; the virtuous have grown weary of singing God's Glories.

219.g: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ. ਹਰਿ ਭਏ ਦਇਆਲਾ; ਤਉ ਸਭ ਬਿਧਿ ਬਨਿ ਆਈ ॥੨॥੪॥
219.e: O servant Nanak, when the Lord becomes merciful, then every effort is successful. ||2||4||
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
Raag Gauree, Ninth Mehl:
Holy Saadhus: forsake the pride of your mind.

219.g: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ. ਸੰਗਤਿ ਦੁਰਜਨ ਕੀ; ਤਾ ਤੇ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਭਾਗਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
219.e: Sexual desire, anger and the company of evil people - run away from them, day and night. ||1||Pause||

219.g: ਸੁਖੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਦੋਨੋ. ਸਮ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਨੈ; ਅਉਰੁ ਮਾਨੁ ਅਪਮਾਨਾ ॥
219.e: One who knows that pain and pleasure are both the same, and honor and dishonor as well,

219.g: ਹਰਖ ਸੋਗ ਤੇ. ਰਹੈ ਅਤੀਤਾ; ਤਿਨਿ ਜਗਿ ਤਤੁ ਪਛਾਨਾ ॥੧॥
219.e: who remains detached from joy and sorrow, realizes the true essence in the world. ||1||

219.g: ਉਸਤਤਿ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਦੋਊ ਤਿਆਗੈ; ਖੋਜੈ ਪਦੁ ਨਿਰਬਾਨਾ ॥
219.e: Renounce both praise and blame; seek instead the state of Nirvaanaa.

219.g: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ. ਇਹੁ ਖੇਲੁ ਕਠਨੁ ਹੈ; ਕਿਨਹੂੰ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਨਾ ॥੨॥੧॥
219.e: O servant Nanak, this is such a difficult game; only a few Gurmukhs understand it! ||2||1||
Gauree, Ninth Mehl:
Holy Saadhus: sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe.

219.g: ਮਾਨਸ ਜਨਮੁ ਅਮੋਲਕੁ ਪਾਇਓ; ਬਿਰਥਾ ਕਾਹਿ ਗਵਾਵਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
219.e: You have obtained the priceless jewel of this human life; why are you uselessly wasting it? ||1||Pause||

219.g: ਪਤਿਤ. ਪੁਨੀਤ ਦੀਨ ਬੰਧ ਹਰਿ; ਸਰਨਿ ਤਾਹਿ ਤੁਮ ਆਵਉ ॥
219.e: He is the Purifier of sinners, the Friend of the poor. Come, and enter the Lord's Sanctuary.

219.g: ਗਜ ਕੋ ਤ੍ਰਾਸੁ ਮਿਟਿਓ ਜਿਹ ਸਿਮਰਤ; ਤੁਮ ਕਾਹੇ ਬਿਸਰਾਵਉ ॥੧॥
219.e: Remembering Him, the elephant's fear was removed; so why do you forget Him? ||1||

219.g: ਤਜਿ ਅਭਿਮਾਨ ਮੋਹ ਮਾਇਆ; ਫੁਨਿ ਭਜਨ ਰਾਮ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਵਉ ॥
219.e: Renounce your egotistical pride and your emotional attachment to Maya; focus your consciousness on the Lord's meditation.

219.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਹਤ. ਮੁਕਤਿ ਪੰਥ ਇਹੁ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਇ ਤੁਮ ਪਾਵਉ ॥੨॥੫॥
219.e: Says Nanak, this is the path to liberation. Become Gurmukh, and attain it. ||2||5||

220.g: ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਨ. ਸਾਧ ਮਗ ਸੁਨਿ ਕਰਿ; ਨਿਮਖ. ਨ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
220.e: This mind listens to the Vedas, the Puraanas, and the ways of the Holy Saints, but it does not sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, for even an instant. ||1||Pause||

220.g: ਦੁਰਲਭ ਦੇਹ ਪਾਇ ਮਾਨਸ ਕੀ; ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਸਿਰਾਵੈ ॥
220.e: Having obtained this human body, so very difficult to obtain, it is now being uselessly wasted.

220.g: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ, ਮਹਾ ਸੰਕਟ ਬਨ; ਤਾ ਸਿਉ ਰੁਚ ਉਪਜਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
220.e: Emotional attachment to Maya is such a treacherous wilderness, and yet, people are in love with it. ||1||

220.g: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੰਗਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ; ਤਾ ਸਿਉ. ਨੇਹੁ ਨ ਲਾਵੈ ॥
220.e: Inwardly and outwardly, God is always with them, and yet, they do not enshrine Love for Him.

220.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਮੁਕਤਿ ਤਾਹਿ ਤੁਮ ਮਾਨਹੁ; ਜਿਹ ਘਟਿ ਰਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥੨॥੬॥
220.e: O Nanak, know that those whose hearts are filled with the Lord are liberated. ||2||6||

220.g: ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ॥
220.e: Raag Gauree, Ashtpadheeyaa, First Mehl: Gauree Gwaarayree:

220.g: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
220.e: One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. By Guru's Grace:

220.g: ਨਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ; ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਾਮੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
220.e: The nine treasures and the miraculous spiritual powers come by contemplating the Immaculate Naam, the Name of the Lord.

220.g: ਪੂਰਨ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ; ਬਿਖੁ ਮਾਰਿ ॥
220.e: The Perfect Lord is All-pervading everywhere; He destroys the poison of Maya.

220.g: ਤ੍ਰਿਕੁਟੀ ਛੂਟੀ; ਬਿਮਲ ਮਝਾਰਿ ॥
220.e: I am rid of the three-phased Maya, dwelling in the Pure Lord.

220.g: ਨਗ ਸਰੂਪੀ ਛੰਦ ॥
220.e: NAG SWAROOPI STANZA

220.g: ਨਰ ਦੇਵ ਦੇਵ ਰਾਮ ਹੈ ॥
ਅਭੇਵ ਧਰਮ ਧਾਮ ਹੈ ॥
220.e: “The superb god amongst men is Ram who is certainly the abode of Dhrma,

220.g: ਅਬੁਧ ਨਾਰਿ ਤੈ ਮਨੈ ॥
ਬਿਸੁਧ ਬਾਤ ਕੋ ਭਨੈ ॥੨੦੩॥
220.e: “O foolish woman! why are you uttering such contrary words?203.

220.g: ਅਗਾਧਿ ਦੇਵ ਅਨੰਤ ਹੈ ॥
ਅਭੂਤ ਸੋਭਵੰਤ ਹੈ ॥
220.e: “He is unfathomable and infinite god and is highly seated beyond all elements.

220.g: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
220.e: Gauree, Ninth Mehl:

220.g: ਸਾਧੋ; ਰਾਮ ਸਰਨਿ ਬਿਸਰਾਮਾ ॥
220.e: Holy Saadhus: rest and peace are in the Sanctuary of the Lord.

220.g: ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਨ ਪੜੇ ਕੋ ਇਹ ਗੁਨ; ਸਿਮਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਕੋ ਨਾਮਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
220.e: This is the blessing of studying the Vedas and the Puraanas, that you may meditate on the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

220.g: ਲੋਭ ਮੋਹ. ਮਾਇਆ ਮਮਤਾ ਫੁਨਿ; ਅਉ ਬਿਖਿਅਨ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ॥
220.e: Greed, emotional attachment to Maya, possessiveness, the service of evil, pleasure and pain,

220.g: ਹਰਖ ਸੋਗ ਪਰਸੈ ਜਿਹ ਨਾਹਨਿ; ਸੋ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਹੈ ਦੇਵਾ ॥੧॥
220.e: - those who are not touched by these, are the very embodiment of the Divine Lord. ||1||

220.g: ਸੁਰਗ ਨਰਕ. ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਿਖੁ, ਏ ਸਭ; ਤਿਉ ਕੰਚਨ ਅਰੁ ਪੈਸਾ ॥
220.e: Heaven and hell, ambrosial nectar and poison, gold and copper - these are all alike to them.

220.g: ਉਸਤਤਿ ਨਿੰਦਾ. ਏ ਸਮ ਜਾ ਕੈ; ਲੋਭੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਫੁਨਿ ਤੈਸਾ ॥੨॥
220.e: Praise and slander are all the same to them, as are greed and attachment. ||2||

220.g: ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ. ਏ ਬਾਧੇ ਜਿਹ ਨਾਹਨਿ; ਤਿਹ ਤੁਮ ਜਾਨਉ ਗਿਆਨੀ ॥
220.e: They are not bound by pleasure and pain - know that they are truly wise.

220.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਮੁਕਤਿ ਤਾਹਿ ਤੁਮ ਮਾਨਉ; ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਕੋ ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ॥੩॥੭॥
220.e: O Nanak, recognize those mortal beings as liberated, who live this way of life. ||3||7||

220.g: ਬਾਜ ਸਾਜ ਸਣੈ ਚੜੀ, ਸਭ ਸੁਭ੍ਰ ਧਉਲ ਉਤਾਲ ॥੧੯੮॥
220.e: Who embellished with all kinds of arts and wearing white garments started very quickly.198.

220.g: ਬੇਣ ਬੀਣ ਮ੍ਰਦੰਗ ਬਾਦ; ਸੁਣੇ ਰਹੀ ਚਕ ਬਾਲ ॥
220.e: She was surprised to listen to the sound of lyre, drum and other musical instruments,

220.g: ਰਾਮਰਾਜ ਉਠੀ ਜਯਤ ਧੁਨਿ; ਭੂਮਿ ਭੂਰ ਬਿਸਾਲ ॥
220.e: And also saw on that wide plain the sound hailing the victory of ram Rajya was being heard.

220.g: ਜਾਤ ਹੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਕੇਕਈ; ਇਹ ਭਾਤਿ ਬੋਲੀ ਬਾਤਿ ॥
220.e: Going near Kaikeyi she addressed her in this way :

220.g: ਹਾਥ ਬਾਤ ਛੁਟੀ ਚਲੀ; ਬਰ ਮਾਗ ਹੈਂ ਕਿਹ ਰਾਤਿ ॥੧੯੯॥
220.e: “When the opportunity will go out of hand, then for whom you will ask for the boons?”199.

220.g: ਕੇਕਈ ਇਮ ਜਉ ਸੁਨੀ ਭਈ ਦੁਖਤਾ ਸਰਬੰਗ ॥
220.e: When Kaikeye heard all the account, she was completely full of anguish,

220.g: ਝੂਮ ਭੂਮ ਗਿਰੀ ਮ੍ਰਿਗੀ ਜਿਮ; ਲਾਗ ਬਣ ਸੁਰੰਗ ॥
220.e: And fell down unconscious on the earth like the doe pierced by an arrow.

220.g: ਜਾਤ ਹੀ ਅਵਧੇਸ ਕਉ; ਇਹ ਭਾਤਿ ਬੋਲੀ ਬੈਨ ॥
220.e: Going in the presence of king of Oudh, she said this :

220.g: ਦੀਜੀਏ ਬਰ ਭੂਪ, ਮੋ ਕਉ; ਜੋ ਕਹੇ ਦੁਇ ਦੈਨ ॥੨੦੦॥
220.e: “O king! You had promised to grant me two boons, grant them to me just now.200.

220.g: ਰਾਮ ਕੋ ਬਨ ਦੀਜੀਐ; ਮਮ ਪੂਤ ਕਉ ਨਿਜ ਰਾਜ ॥
220.e: “Give exile to Ram and your kingdom, wealth, whisk an canopy-everything.

220.g: ਰਾਜ ਸਾਜ ਸੁ ਸੰਪਦਾ ਦੋਊ ਚਉਰ ਛਤ੍ਰ ਸਮਾਜ ॥
220.e: Give him ( Bharat) the kingdom, wealth, whisk and canopy-everything

220.g: ਦੇਸ ਅਉਰਿ ਬਿਦੇਸ ਕੀ; ਠਕੁਰਾਇ ਦੈ ਸਭ ਮੋਹਿ ॥
220.e: “When you will grant me the ruling power over the inland and foreign countries,

220.g: ਸਤ ਸੀਲ ਸਤੀ ਜਤ ਬ੍ਰਤ ਤਉ ਪਛਾਨੋ ਤੋਹਿ ॥੨੦੧॥
220.e: “Then I shall consider you the observer of truthfulness and recognizer of righteousness.”201.

220.g: ਪਾਪਨੀ, ਬਨ ਰਾਮ ਕੋ; ਪੈ ਹੈਂ ਕਹਾ ਜਸ, ਕਾਢ ॥
220.e: The king replied, “O sinful woman! What approbation you will gain by sending Ram to the forest?

220.g: ਭਸਮ ਆਨਨ ਤੇ ਗਈ; ਕਹਿ ਕੈ ਸਕੇ ਅਸਿ ਬਾਢ ॥
220.e: “By such surpassing utterance of yours the ash of magnificence on my forehead has flown down with the upcoming perspiration.”

220.g: ਕੋਪ ਭੂਪ ਕੁਅੰਡ ਲੈ; ਤੁਹਿ ਕਾਟੀਐ ਇਹ ਕਾਲ ॥
220.e: The king taking his bow in his hand said this angrily, “I would have chopped and thrown you just now,

220.g: ਨਾਸ ਤੋਰਨ ਕੀਜੀਐ; ਤਕ ਛਾਡੀਐ ਤੁਹਿ ਬਾਲ ॥੨੦੨॥
