220.e: “And destroyed you, but I let you go because you are a woman.”202.

220.g: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
220.e: Gauree, Ninth Mehl:

220.g: ਮਨ ਰੇ; ਕਹਾ ਭਇਓ ਤੈ ਬਉਰਾ ॥
220.e: O mind, why have you gone crazy?

220.g: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਅਉਧ ਘਟੈ. ਨਹੀ ਜਾਨੈ; ਭਇਓ ਲੋਭ ਸੰਗਿ ਹਉਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
220.e: Don't you know that your life is decreasing, day and night? Your life is made worthless with greed. ||1||Pause||

220.g: ਜੋ ਤਨੁ ਤੈ ਅਪਨੋ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨਿਓ; ਅਰੁ ਸੁੰਦਰ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਨਾਰੀ ॥
220.e: That body, which you believe to be your own, and your beautiful home and spouse

220.g: ਇਨ ਮੈਂ. ਕਛੁ ਤੇਰੋ ਰੇ ਨਾਹਨਿ; ਦੇਖੋ ਸੋਚ ਬਿਚਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
220.e: - none of these is yours to keep. See this, reflect upon it and understand. ||1||

220.g: ਰਤਨ ਜਨਮੁ ਅਪਨੋ. ਤੈ ਹਾਰਿਓ; ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਗਤਿ. ਨਹੀ ਜਾਨੀ ॥
220.e: You have wasted the precious jewel of this human life; you do not know the Way of the Lord of the Universe.

220.g: ਨਿਮਖ. ਨ ਲੀਨ ਭਇਓ ਚਰਨਨ ਸਿਂਉ; ਬਿਰਥਾ ਅਉਧ ਸਿਰਾਨੀ ॥੨॥
220.e: You have not been absorbed in the Lord's Feet, even for an instant. Your life has passed away in vain! ||2||

220.g: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ. ਸੋਈ ਨਰੁ ਸੁਖੀਆ; ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
220.e: Says Nanak, that man is happy, who sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord's Name.

220.g: ਅਉਰ ਸਗਲ ਜਗੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿਆ; ਨਿਰਭੈ ਪਦੁ. ਨਹੀ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੩॥੮॥
220.e: All the rest of the world is enticed by Maya; they do not obtain the state of fearless dignity. ||3||8||

220.g: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
220.e: Gauree, Ninth Mehl:

220.g: ਨਰ; ਅਚੇਤ ਪਾਪ ਤੇ ਡਰੁ ਰੇ ॥
220.e: You people are unconscious; you should be afraid of sin.

220.g: ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਸਗਲ ਭੈ ਭੰਜਨ; ਸਰਨਿ ਤਾਹਿ ਤੁਮ ਪਰੁ ਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
220.e: Seek the Sanctuary of the Lord, Merciful to the meek, Destroyer of all fear. ||1||Pause||

220.g: ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਨ ਜਾਸ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਤ; ਤਾ ਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ. ਹੀਐ ਮੋ ਧਰੁ ਰੇ ॥
220.e: The Vedas and the Puraanas sing His Praises; enshrine His Name within your heart.

220.g: ਪਾਵਨ ਨਾਮੁ. ਜਗਤਿ ਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਕੋ; ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ. ਕਸਮਲ ਸਭ ਹਰੁ ਰੇ ॥੧॥
220.e: Pure and sublime is the Name of the Lord in the world. Remembering it in meditation, all sinful mistakes shall be washed away. ||1||

220.g: ਮਾਨਸ ਦੇਹ. ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨਹ ਪਾਵੈ; ਕਛੂ ਉਪਾਉ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕਾ ਕਰੁ ਰੇ ॥
220.e: You shall not obtain this human body again; make the effort - try to achieve liberation!

220.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਹਤ. ਗਾਇ ਕਰੁਨਾ ਮੈ; ਭਵ ਸਾਗਰ ਕੈ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਰੁ ਰੇ ॥੨॥੯॥੨੫੧॥
220.e: Says Nanak, sing of the Lord of compassion, and cross over the terrifying world-ocean. ||2||9||251||

221.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਮਤਿ; ਜੀਇ ਆਈ ਕਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
221.e: The Guru's Teachings are useful to my soul. ||1||

221.g: ਇਨ ਬਿਧਿ; ਰਾਮ ਰਮਤ. ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥
221.e: Chanting the Lord's Name in this way, my mind is satisfied.

221.g: ਗਿਆਨ ਅੰਜਨੁ; ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਨਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
221.e: I have obtained the ointment of spiritual wisdom, recognizing the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||1||Pause||
Blended with the One Lord, I enjoy intuitive peace.
Through the Immaculate Bani of the Word, my doubts have been dispelled.
Instead of the pale color of Maya, I am imbued with the deep crimson color of the Lord's Love.
By the Lord's Glance of Grace, the poison has been eliminated. ||2||
When I turned away, and became dead while yet alive, I was awakened.

221.g: ਸਬਦਿ ਰਵੇ; ਮਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਲਾਗਿਆ ॥
221.e: Chanting the Word of the Shabad, my mind is attached to the Lord.
I have gathered in the Lord's sublime essence, and cast out the poison.

221.g: ਭਾਇ ਬਸੇ; ਜਮ ਕਾ ਭਉ ਭਾਗਿਆ ॥੩॥
221.e: Abiding in His Love, the fear of death has run away. ||3||
My taste for pleasure ended, along with conflict and egotism.

221.g: ਚਿਤੁ. ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਰਾਤਾ; ਹੁਕਮਿ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
221.e: My consciousness is attuned to the Lord, by the Order of the Infinite.
My pursuit for worldy pride and honour is over.
When He blessed me with His Glance of Grace, peace was established in my soul. ||4||

221.g: ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ; ਕੋਇ ਨ ਦੇਖਉ ਮੀਤੁ ॥
221.e: Without You, I see no friend at all.
Whom should I serve? Unto whom should I dedicate my consciousness?
Whom should I ask? At whose feet should I fall?
By whose teachings will I remain absorbed in His Love? ||5||
I serve the Guru, and I fall at the Guru's Feet.
I worship Him, and I am absorbed in the Lord's Name.
The Lord's Love is my instruction, sermon and food.
Enjoined to the Lord's Command, I have entered the home of my inner self. ||6||
With the extinction of pride, my soul has found peace and meditation.
The Divine Light has dawned, and I am absorbed in the Light.
Pre-ordained destiny cannot be erased; the Shabad is my banner and insignia.
I know the Creator, the Creator of His Creation. ||7||
I am not a learned Pandit, I am not clever or wise.
I do not wander; I am not deluded by doubt.
I do not speak empty speech; I have recognized the Hukam of His Command.
Nanak is absorbed in intuitive peace through the Guru's Teachings. ||8||1||
“He is merciful and kind towards all and mercifully gives support to helpless and ferries them across.204.
“He is the saviour of many saints and is the basic cause of the gods and demons.
“He is also the king of gods and is the store of all powers.”205.
The queen said, “O king! Grant me the boons and fulfil thy sayins.
“Adandon the position of duality from your mind and do not fail in your promise.”206.
UGAADH STANZA
With tears in his eyes and anguish in his utterance,
The kin said to Kaikeyi, “You are a mean and evil woman.212.
“You are a blemish on womankind and a store of vices.
“You have no shame in your eyes and your words are ignominious.213.
“You are evil woman and are the destroyer of enhancement.
“You are performer of evil deeds and shameless in your Dharma.214.
“You are the abode of shamelessness and a woman forsaking hesitation (shyness).
“You are the performer of misdeeds and destroyer of glory.215.
NAG SWAROOPI ARDH STANZA
“O king! Do not hesitate and run away from your promise, give exile to Ram.207.
“Bid farewell to Ram and take back the proposed rule from him. Don’t run away from your promise and be seated peacefully.208.
“O king! Cal Vasishtha and the royal priest and send Ram to the forest.”209.
The king heaved a long sigh, moved hither and thither and then fell down.210.
The king again came to his senses from the stupor and grievously heaved a long breath.211.
Gauree Gwaarayree, First Mehl:
The mind is an elephant in the forest of the body.
The Guru is the controlling stick; when the Insignia of the True Shabad is applied,
One obtains honor in the Court of God the King. ||1||
He cannot be known through clever tricks.

221.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਮਾਰੇ; ਕਿਉ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
221.e: Without subduing the mind, how can His value be estimated? ||1||Pause||
In the house of the self is the Ambrosial Nectar, which is being stolen by the thieves.
No one can say no to them.
He Himself protects us, and blesses us with greatness. ||2||
There are billions, countless billions of fires of desire at the seat of the mind.
They are extinguished only with the water of understanding, imparted by the Guru.

221.g: ਮਨੁ ਦੇ ਲੀਆ; ਰਹਸਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਈ ॥੩॥
221.e: Offering my mind, I have attained it, and I joyfully sing His Glorious Praises. ||3||
Just as He is within the home of the self, so is He beyond.
But how can I describe Him, sitting in a cave?
The Fearless Lord is in the oceans, just as He is in the mountains. ||4||
Tell me, who can kill someone who is already dead?
What does he fear? Who can frighten the fearless one?
He recognizes the Word of the Shabad, throughout the three worlds. ||5||
One who speaks, merely describes speech.
But one who understands, intuitively realizes.
Seeing and reflecting upon it, my mind surrenders. ||6||
Praise, beauty and liberation are in the One Name.
In it, the Immaculate Lord is permeating and pervading.

221.g: ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਬਿਆਪਿ ਰਹਿਆ; ਨਿਜ ਠਾਈ ॥੭॥
221.e: He dwells in the home of the self, and in His own sublime place. ||7||
The many silent sages lovingly praise Him.

222.e: UGAATHA STANZA
(The poet says that the woman) conquered the unconquered, destroyed the indestructible, broke the unbreakable and (with her blaze) reduced to ashes the indeclinable.
She has slandered him who cannot be calumniated, she has given him a blow who cannot be farmed. She has deceived them who is beyond deception and has disjointed the compact one.225.
She has engrossed the detached one in action and her vision is so sharp that she can see providence. She can cause the unpunishable to be punished and uneatable to be eaten.
She has fathomed the unfathomable and has destroyed the indestructible. She has destroyed the indestructible and has moved the immovable as her vehicles.226.
She has dyed the dried one, blazed the incombustible. She has destroyed the indestructible and has moved the immovable.
“O shameless woman! you are the doer of evil acts,
“Impiety-incarnate and store of vicious works.216.
“O the basket of sins! evil-doer,
“You do not die even we wish you to die, you are the performer of misdeeds.”217.
Gauree Gwaarayree, First Mehl:

222.g: ਨਾ ਮਨੁ ਮਰੈ; ਨ ਕਾਰਜੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
222.e: The mind does not die, so the job is not accomplished.
The mind is under the power of the demons of evil intellect and duality.

222.g: ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨੈ; ਗੁਰ ਤੇ. ਇਕੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
222.e: But when the mind surrenders, through the Guru, it becomes one. ||1||
The Lord is without attributes; the attributes of virtue are under His control.
One who eliminates selfishness contemplates Him. ||1||Pause||
The deluded mind thinks of all sorts of corruption.
When the mind is deluded, the load of wickedness falls on the head.
But when the mind surrenders to the Lord, it realizes the One and Only Lord. ||2||
The deluded mind enters the house of Maya.
Engrossed in sexual desire, it does not remain steady.
O mortal, lovingly vibrate the Lord's Name with your tongue. ||3||
Elephants, horses, gold, children and spouses
in the anxious affairs of all these, people lose the game and depart.
In the game of chess, their pieces do not reach their destination. ||4||
They gather wealth, but only evil comes from it.
Pleasure and pain stand in the doorway.
Intuitive peace comes by meditating on the Lord, within the heart. ||5||
When the Lord bestows His Glance of Grace, then He unites us in His Union.
Through the Word of the Shabad, merits are gathered in, and demerits are burned away.
The Gurmukh obtains the treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||6||
Without the Name, all live in pain.
The consciousness of the foolish, self-willed manmukh is the dwelling place of Maya.
The Gurmukh obtains spiritual wisdom, according to pre-ordained destiny. ||7||
The fickle mind continuously runs after fleeting things.
The Pure True Lord is not pleased by filth.
O Nanak, the Gurmukh sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||8||3||
The Speech of Kaikeyi:
“O king! Accept my saying and remember your words
“Whatever you have promised, grant me two boons according to that.218.
“Remember rightly and give whatever you have said.
“Do not forsake your Dharma and do not shatter my trust.219.
“Call Vasishtha, your unique spiritual head,
“Order the husband of Sita for his exile.220.
“Do not cuase any delay in the task and accept my saying
“Making Ram a sage, turn him out of the home ”221.
(The poet says) She was stubborn like a child and verged on madness.
She did not keep silent and was continuously speaking.222.
She was worthy of reproach and store of man acts.
She was evil-tongued queen and the cause of weakening the strength of the king.223.
She got the ouster of Ram, who was the pillar (support) of the house
And in this way she performed the evil act of killing her husband.224.

222.g: ਤਨਿ ਮਨਿ ਸੂਚੈ; ਸਾਚੁ ਸੁ ਚੀਤਿ ॥
222.e: Their bodies and minds are purified, as they enshrine the True Lord in their consciousness.
O Nanak, meditate on the Lord, each and every day. ||8||2||
Gauree Gwaarayree, First Mehl:
Acting in egotism, peace is not obtained.
The intellect of the mind is false; only the Lord is True.
All who love duality are ruined.
People act as they are pre-ordained. ||1||
I have seen the world to be such a gambler;

222.g: ਸਭਿ ਸੁਖ ਮਾਗੈ; ਨਾਮੁ ਬਿਸਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
222.e: all beg for peace, but they forget the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||
If the Unseen Lord could be seen, then He could be described.
Without seeing Him, all descriptions are useless.
The Gurmukh sees Him with intuitive ease.
So serve the One Lord, with loving awareness. ||2||
People beg for peace, but they receive severe pain.
They are all weaving a wreath of corruption.

222.g: ਏਕ ਬਿਨਾ. ਝੂਠੇ; ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
222.e: You are false - without the One, there is no liberation.
The Creator created the creation, and He watches over it. ||3||
The fire of desire is quenched by the Word of the Shabad.
Duality and doubt are automatically eliminated.
Following the Guru's Teachings, the Naam abides in the heart.
Through the True Word of His Bani, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||4||
The True Lord abides within the body of that Gurmukh who enshrines love for Him.
Without the Naam, none obtain their own place.
The Beloved Lord King is dedicated to love.
If He bestows His Glance of Grace, then we realize His Name. ||5||
Emotional attachment to Maya is total entanglement.
The self-willed manmukh is filthy, cursed and dreadful.
Serving the True Guru, these entanglements are ended.
In the Ambrosial Nectar of the Naam, you shall abide in lasting peace. ||6||
The Gurmukhs understand the One Lord, and enshrine love for Him.
They dwell in the home of their own inner beings, and merge in the True Lord.
The cycle of birth and death is ended.

222.g: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ; ਇਹ ਮਤਿ ਪਾਏ ॥੭॥
222.e: This understanding is obtained from the Perfect Guru. ||7||
Speaking the speech, there is no end to it.

223.e: She has disjoined the compact one and has punished the unpunishable. She can do whatever is not to be done and can corroborate the irrefutable.227.
She has blemished the unblemishabel and has stained the pure one  she as made thieves and thus the persons who are never deceptive
She has discriminated the indiscriminate and has broken the unbreakable. She has covered the naked ones and united the disjointed.228.
She has burnt the incombustible and can bend the unbendable. She has pulled the pulled the annullable and has untited the disjointed.
She has taken out those which can never be taken our and fashioned the unfashionable, she has wounded the unconquerable and has entrapped those who cannot be entrapped.229.
She performs all forbidden works and she protects all vicious acts. She creates the sense of friendship in detached ones and the stable one run away when they face her.
She teases the peaceful person and reveals a very mysterious one, she conquers the unconquerable and kills those cannot be killed.230.
She rips and breaks the hardest one, she establishes the unestablished and tears that which can’t be torn

She drives the immobile and makes a leper of a healthy person, she engages herself in battle with mighty ones an with whomsoever supremely strong person she fights, she lays obstructions in their art of war and finishes.231.
She has defeated the mighty ones and injured the invincible, she crushes those who cannot be crushed, she deceives the undeceivable
She frightens the fearless and destroys the indestructible, she break the unbreakable and turns into lepers those of healthy bodies.232.
She routs those who take a stand and pulls down those who are firm and stable  she breaks the unbreakable and ride over many, making them her slaves,
Gauree, First Mehl:
The duality of Maya dwells in the consciousness of the people of the world.
They are destroyed by sexual desire, anger and egotism. ||1||
Whom should I call the second, when there is only the One?

223.g: ਸਭ ਮਹਿ; ਏਕੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਸੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
223.e: The One Immaculate Lord is pervading among all. ||1||Pause||
The dual-minded evil intellect speaks of a second.
One who harbors duality comes and goes and dies. ||2||
In the earth and in the sky, I do not see any second.
Among all the women and the men, His Light is shining. ||3||
In the lamps of the sun and the moon, I see His Light.
Dwelling among all is my ever-youthful Beloved. ||4||
In His Mercy, He attuned my consciousness to the Lord.
The True Guru has led me to understand the One Lord. ||5||
The Gurmukh knows the One Immaculate Lord.
Subduing duality, one comes to realize the Word of the Shabad. ||6||
The Command of the One Lord prevails throughout all the worlds.
From the One, all have arisen. ||7||
There are two routes, but remember that their Lord and Master is only One.
Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, recognize the Hukam of the Lord's Command. ||8||
He is contained in all forms, colors and minds.
Says Nanak, praise the One Lord. ||9||5||
Gauree, First Mehl:
To practice forgiveness is the true fast, good conduct and contentment.

223.g: ਰੋਗੁ ਨ ਬਿਆਪੈ; ਨਾ ਜਮ ਦੋਖੰ ॥
223.e: Disease does not afflict me, nor does the pain of death.

223.g: ਮੁਕਤ ਭਏ; ਪ੍ਰਭ ਰੂਪ ਨ ਰੇਖੰ ॥੧॥
223.e: I am liberated, and absorbed into God, who has no form or feature. ||1||
What fear does the Yogi have?

223.g: ਰੂਖਿ ਬਿਰਖਿ; ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
223.e: The Lord is among the trees and the plants, within the household and outside as well. ||1||Pause||
The Yogis meditate on the Fearless, Immaculate Lord.
Night and day, they remain awake and aware, embracing love for the True Lord.
Those Yogis are pleasing to my mind. ||2||
The trap of death is burnt by the Fire of God.
Old age, death and pride are conquered.
They swim across, and save their ancestors as well. ||3||
Those who serve the True Guru are the Yogis.

223.g: ਭੈ ਰਚਿ ਰਹੈ; ਸੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਹੋਇ ॥
223.e: Those who remain immersed in the Fear of God become fearless.
They become just like the One they serve. ||4||
Gauree, First Mehl:
Those who live a spiritual lifestyle - they alone are true.
What can the false know about the secrets of liberation? ||1||
Those who contemplate the Way are Yogis.

223.g: ਪੰਚ ਮਾਰਿ; ਸਾਚੁ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
223.e: They conquer the five thieves, and enshrine the True Lord in the heart. ||1||Pause||
Those who enshrine the True Lord deep within,
realize the value of the Way of Yoga. ||2||
The sun and the moon are one and the same for them, as are household and wilderness.
The karma of their daily practice is to praise the Lord. ||3||
They beg for the alms of the one and only Shabad.
They remain awake and aware in spiritual wisdom and meditation, and the true way of life. ||4||

223.g: ਭੈ ਰਚਿ ਰਹੈ; ਨ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
223.e: They remain absorbed in the fear of God; they never leave it.
Who can estimate their value? They remain lovingly absorbed in the Lord. ||5||
The Lord unites them with Himself, dispelling their doubts.
By Guru's Grace, the supreme status is obtained. ||6||
In the Guru's service is reflection upon the Shabad.
Subduing ego, practice pure actions. ||7||
Chanting, meditation, austere self-discipline and the reading of the Puraanas,
says Nanak, are contained in surrender to the Unlimited Lord. ||8||6||

223.g: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਛਿ ਦੇਖਿਆ; ਨਾਹੀ ਦਰੁ ਹੋਰੁ ॥
223.e: I have consulted the Guru, and I have seen that there is no other door than His.
Pain and pleasure reside in the Pleasure of His Will and His Command.
Nanak, the lowly, says embrace love for the Lord. ||8||4||

224.e: She deceives those who are undeceivable and makes the chaste ones licentious  the house in which the woman has the apprehension, how can there be peace?233.
SORTHA

224.g: ਗ੍ਰਹਿ ਆਵਤ ਰਘੁਰਾਇ; ਸਭੁ ਧਨ ਦੀਯੋ ਲੁਟਾਇ ਕੈ ॥
224.e: On reaching his place Ram gave all his wealth in charity,

224.g: ਕਟਿ ਤਰਕਸੀ ਸੁਹਾਇ; ਬੋਲਤ ਭੇ ਸੀਅ ਸੋ ਬਚਨ ॥੨੪੪॥
224.e: And binding his quiver to his waist he said to Sita 244

224.g: ਸੁਨਿ ਸੀਅ ਸੁਜਸ ਸੁਜਾਨ ਰਹੌ ਕੌਸਲਿਆ ਤੀਰ ਤੁਮ ॥
224.e: “O wise Sita! You stay with Kaushalya.

224.g: ਰਾਜ ਕਰਉ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਨ; ਤੋਹਿ ਸਹਿਤ ਬਨਬਾਸ ਬਸਿ ॥੨੪੫॥
224.e: “And I shall rule again alongwith you after exile.”245.
DOHRA

224.g: ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਕੇਕਈ ਹਠ ਗਹਯੋ; ਬਰ ਮਾਗਨ ਨ੍ਰਿਪ ਤੀਰ ॥
224.e: In this way Kaikeyi persisted in her demand for boons from the king

224.g: ਅਤਿ ਆਤਰ ਕਿਆ ਕਹਿ ਸਕੈ, ਬਿਧਯੋ ਕਾਮ ਕੇ ਤੀਰ ॥੨੩੪॥
224.e: The king became greatly agitated but because of the attachment with the winsome wife and under the impact of the god of love (Kamdev), he could not say anything.234.
Speech of Sita addressed to Ram :
MANOHAR STANZA
Speech of Sita addressed to Ram :
SORTHA

224.g: ਮੈ ਨ ਤਜੋ ਪੀਅ ਸੰਗਿ; ਕੈਸੋਈ ਦੁਖ ਜੀਅ ਪੈ ਪਰੋ ॥
224.e: “I cannot forsake the company of my beloved even if I have to undergo a great suffering.

224.g: ਤਨਕ ਨ ਮੋਰਉ ਅੰਗਿ; ਅੰਗਿ ਤੇ ਹੋਇ ਅਨੰਗ ਕਿਨ ॥੨੪੬॥
224.e: “For this, undoubtedly, if my limbs are chopped, I shall not turn back a little and shall not deem it and anguish.”246.
Gauree, First Mehl:
Brahma acted in pride, and did not understand.
Only when he was faced with the downfall of the Vedas did he repent.

224.g: ਜਹ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਿਮਰੇ; ਤਹੀ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥੧॥
224.e: Remembering God in meditation, the mind is conciliated. ||1||
Such is the horrible pride of the world.

224.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ; ਤਿਸੁ ਗਰਬੁ ਨਿਵਾਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
224.e: The Guru eliminates the pride of those who meet Him. ||1||Pause||
Bal the King, in Maya and egotism,
held his ceremonial feasts, but he was puffed up with pride.
Without the Guru's advice, he had to go to the underworld. ||2||
Hari Chand gave in charity, and earned public praise.

224.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ. ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇ; ਅਭੇਵੈ ॥
224.e: But without the Guru, he did not find the limits of the Mysterious Lord.
The Lord Himself misleads people, and He Himself imparts understanding. ||3||
The evil-minded Harnaakhash committed evil deeds.
God, the Lord of all, is the Destroyer of pride.
He bestowed His Mercy, and saved Prahlaad. ||4||
Raawan was deluded, foolish and unwise.
Sri Lanka was plundered, and he lost his head.
He indulged in ego, and lacked the love of the True Guru. ||5||
The Lord killed the thousand-armed Arjun, and the demons Madhu-keetab and Meh-khaasaa.
He seized Harnaakhash and tore him apart with his nails.
The demons were slain; they did not practice devotional worship. ||6||
The demons Jaraa-sandh and Kaal-jamun were destroyed.
Rakat-beej and Kaal-naym were annihilated.
Slaying the demons, the Lord saved His Saints. ||7||
He Himself, as the True Guru, contemplates the Shabad.
Speech of Ram addressed to Sita :
MANOHAR STANZA

224.g: ਜਉ ਨ ਰਹਉ ਸਸੁਰਾਰ ਕ੍ਰਿਸੋਦਰ, ਜਾਹਿ ਪਿਤਾ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਤੋਹਿ ਪਠੈ ਦਿਉ ॥
224.e: “O lady of slim waist! If you do not like to stay with your in-laws, then I shall send you to your father’s house,

224.g: ਨੈਕ ਸੇ ਭਾਨਨ ਤੇ ਹਮ ਕਉ; ਜੋਈ ਠਾਟ ਕਹੋ, ਸੋਈ ਗਾਠ ਗਿਠੈ ਦਿਉ ॥
224.e: “And I shall make the arrangements that you like, there shall be no objection on my part

224.g: ਜੇ ਕਿਛੁ ਚਾਹ ਕਰੋ ਧਨ ਕੀ; ਟੁਕ ਮੋਹ ਕਹੋ, ਸਭ ਤੋਹਿ ਉਠੈ ਦਿਉ ॥
224.e: “If you want to have some wealth, then tell me clearly, I shall give you wealth according to your wishes

224.g: ਕੇਤਕ ਅਉਧ ਕੋ ਰਾਜ ਸਲੋਚਨ, ਰੰਕ ਕੋ ਲੰਕ ਨਿਸੰਕ ਲੁਟੈ ਦਿਉ ॥੨੪੭॥
224.e: “O lady of beautiful eyes! There is only a time factor. If you agree, I shall give in charity to the poor a city full of riches like the city of Lanka.247.

224.g: ਘੋਰ ਸੀਆ ਬਨ ਤੂੰ ਸੁ ਕੁਮਾਰ ਕਹੋ ਹਮ ਸੋਂ ਕਸ ਤੈ ਨਿਬਹੈ ਹੈ ॥
224.e: “O Sita! The forest life is full of troubles and you are a princess  you may tell me, how will you carry on there?

224.g: ਗੁੰਜਤ ਸਿੰਘ, ਡਕਾਰਤ ਕੋਲ; ਭਯਾਨਕ ਭੀਲ ਲਖੈ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਐਹੈ ॥
224.e: “The lions roar there, there are dreadful Kauls, Bhils, seeing whom one is frightened.

224.g: ਸੁੰਕਤ ਸਾਪ, ਬਕਾਰਤ ਬਾਘ; ਭਕਾਰਤ ਭੂਤ, ਮਹਾ ਦੁਖ ਪੈਹੈ ॥
224.e: “The serpents hiss there, the tiger thunder and there are also extremely agonizing ghosts and fiends.

224.g: ਤੂੰ ਸੁ ਕੁਮਾਰ, ਰਚੀ ਕਰਤਾਰ; ਬਿਚਾਰ ਚਲੇ, ਤੁਹਿ ਕਿਉਾਂ ਬਨਿ ਐਹੈ ॥੨੪੮॥
224.e: “The Lord had made you a delicate one, think for a little while, why should you go to the forest?”248.
Gauree, First Mehl:
Meeting such a slave, peace is obtained.
Pain is forgotten, when the True Lord is found. ||1||
Beholding the blessed vision of his darshan, my understanding has become perfect.
The cleansing baths at the sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage are in the dust of his feet. ||1||Pause||
My eyes are contented with the constant love of the One Lord.
My tongue is purified by the most sublime essence of the Lord. ||2||
True are my actions, and deep within my being, I serve Him.
My mind is satisfied by the Inscrutable, Mysterious Lord. ||3||

224.g: ਜਹ ਜਹ ਦੇਖਉ; ਤਹ ਤਹ ਸਾਚਾ ॥
224.e: Wherever I look, there I find the True Lord.
Without understanding, the world argues in falsehood. ||4||
When the Guru instructs, understanding is obtained.
How rare is that Gurmukh who understands. ||5||
Show Your Mercy, and save me, O Savior Lord!
Without understanding, people become beasts and demons. ||6||
The Guru has said that there is no other at all.

224.g: ਕਿਸੁ ਕਹੁ ਦੇਖਿ; ਕਰਉ ਅਨ ਪੂਜਾ ॥੭॥
224.e: So tell me, who should I see, and who should I worship? ||7||
For the sake of the Saints, God has established the three worlds.
One who understands his own soul, contemplates the essence of reality. ||8||
One whose heart is filled with Truth and true love

224.g: ਪ੍ਰਣਵਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ; ਹਮ ਤਾ ਕੇ ਦਾਸ ॥੯॥੮॥
224.e: - prays Nanak, I am his servant. ||9||8||
The Name makes a man pure and fearless.
It makes the masterless become the master of all. I am a sacrifice to him.
Such a person is not reincarnated again; he sings the Glories of God. ||5||
Inwardly and outwardly, he knows the One Lord;
through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, he realizes himself.
He bears the Banner and Insignia of the True Shabad in the Lord's Court. ||6||

224.g: ਸਬਦਿ ਮਰੈ; ਤਿਸੁ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ॥
224.e: One who dies in the Shabad abides in his own home within.
He does not come or go in reincarnation, and his hopes are subdued.
Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, his heart-lotus blossoms forth. ||7||
Whoever is seen, is driven by hope and despair,
by sexual desire, anger, corruption, hunger and thirst.
O Nanak, those detached recluses who meet the Lord are so very rare. ||8||7||
The speeches of Kaikeyi and the King.
Addressed to Vasihthea :
DOHRA

224.g: ਰਾਮ ਪਯਾਨੋ ਬਨ ਕਰੈ; ਭਰਥ ਕਰੈ ਠਕੁਰਾਇ ॥
224.e: “Exile Ram and give the kingdom to Bharat

224.g: ਬਰਖ ਚਤਰ ਦਸ ਕੇ ਬਿਤੇ; ਫਿਰਿ ਰਾਜਾ ਰਘੁਰਾਇ ॥੨੪੧॥
224.e: After fourteen year Ram will again become the king.”241.

224.g: ਕਹੀ ਬਸਿਸਟ ਸੁਧਾਰ ਕਰਿ; ਸ੍ਰੀ ਰਘੁਬਰ ਸੋ ਜਾਇ ॥
224.e: Vasishtha said the same thing to Ram in an improved way,

224.g: ਬਰਖ ਚਤੁਰਦਸ ਭਰਥ ਨ੍ਰਿਪ; ਪੁਨਿ ਨ੍ਰਿਪ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਰਘੁਰਾਇ ॥੨੪੨॥
224.e: That for fourteen years Bharat shall rule and after that you will be the king.242.

224.g: ਸੁਨਿ ਬਸਿਸਟ ਕੋ ਬਚ ਸ੍ਰਵਣ; ਰਘੁਪਤਿ ਫਿਰੇ ਸਸੋਗ ॥
224.e: Listening to the words of Vasishtha, Ram (Raghuvir) left with a sad heart,

224.g: ਉਤ ਦਸਰਥ ਤਨ ਕੋ ਤਜਯੋ; ਸ੍ਰੀ ਰਘੁਬੀਰ ਬਿਯੋਗ ॥੨੪੩॥
224.e: And on this side the king. Not enduring the separation of Ram, breathed his last.243.
DOHRA

224.g: ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਪਰ ਪਾਇਨ ਰਹੇ; ਮੋਰੇ ਬਚਨ ਅਨੇਕ ॥
ਗਹਿਅਉ ਹਠਿ ਅਬਲਾ ਰਹੀ; ਮਾਨਯੋ ਬਚਨ ਨ ਏਕ ॥੨੩੫॥
224.e: The king in many ways holding the feet of the queen to back out from his promise, but that woman, showing her weakness (of fair sex) persisted in her demand and did not accept any request of the king.235.

224.g: ਬਰ ਦਯੋ ਮੈ ਛੋਰੇ ਨਹੀ; ਤੈਂ ਕਰਿ ਕੋਟਿ ਉਪਾਇ ॥
ਘਰ ਮੋ ਸੁਤ ਕਉ ਦੀਜੀਐ; ਬਨਬਾਸੈ ਰਘੁਰਾਇ ॥੨੩੬॥
224.e: “I shall not leave you without getting the boons, though you may make millions of efforts. Give the kingdom to my son and exile Ram.”236.

224.g: ਭੂਪ ਧਰਨਿ ਬਿਨ ਬੁਧਿ ਗਿਰਯੋ ਸੁਨਤ ਬਚਨ ਤ੍ਰਿਯ ਕਾਨ ॥
ਜਿਮ ਮ੍ਰਿਗੇਸ ਬਨ ਕੇ ਬਿਖੈ; ਬਧਯੋ ਬਧ ਕਰਿ ਬਾਨ ॥੨੩੭॥
224.e: Hearing these words of his wife, the king became unconscious and fell down on the earth like a lion pierced by arrow in the forest.237.

224.g: ਤਰਫਰਾਤ ਪ੍ਰਿਥਵੀ ਪਰਯੋ; ਸੁਨਿ ਬਨ ਰਾਮ ਉਚਾਰ ॥
ਪਲਕ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਤਯਾਗੇ ਤਜਤ ਮਧਿ ਸਫਰਿ ਸਰ ਬਾਰ ॥੨੩੮॥
224.e: Hearing about the exile or ram the king writhed and fell down on the earth like the pining of the fish out of water and breathing her last.238.

224.g: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਸ੍ਰਵਨਨ ਸੁਣਯੋ; ਉਠਿ ਥਿਰ ਭਯੋ ਸੁਚੇਤ ॥
ਜਨੁ ਰਣ ਸੁਭਟ ਗਿਰਯੋ ਉਠਯੋ; ਗਹਿ ਅਸ ਨਿਡਰ ਸੁਚੇਤ ॥੨੩੯॥
224.e: Hearing again the name of Ram the king came to his senses and stood up like a warrior becoming unconscious and falling in war and standing up again holding his sword after becoming conscious.239.

224.g: ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਪਤਨ ਨ੍ਰਿਪ ਬਰ ਸਹੋ; ਧਰਮ ਨ ਛੋਰਾ ਜਾਇ ॥
ਦੈਨ ਕਹੇ ਜੋ ਬਰ ਹੁਤੇ; ਤਨ ਜੁਤ ਦਏ ਉਠਾਇ ॥੨੪੦॥
224.e: The king accepted death rather than abandonment of his Dharma and the boons which he had promised, he granted them and exiled Ram.240.

225.g: ਰਾਮ ਬਾਚ ਮਾਤਾ ਪ੍ਰਤਿ ॥
225.e: Speech of Ram addressed to the Mother :

225.g: ਤਾਤ ਦਯੋ ਬਨਬਾਸ ਹਮੈ; ਤੁਮ ਦੇਹ ਰਜਾਇ, ਅਬੈ ਤਹ ਜਾਊ ॥
ਕੰਟਕ ਕਾਨ ਬੇਹੜ ਗਾਹਿ; ਤ੍ਰਿਯੋਦਸ ਬਰਖ ਬਿਤੇ ਫਿਰ ਆਊ ॥
225.e: “The father has exiled me and now you permit us to depart for the forest, I shall come back on the fourteenth year after roaming in the forest stuffed with thorns for thirteen years.

225.g: ਜੀਤ ਰਹੇ ਤੁ ਮਿਲੋ ਫਿਰਿ ਮਾਤ, ਮਰੇ ਗਏ ਭੂਲਿ ਪਰੀ ਬਖਸਾਊ ॥
ਭੂਪਹ ਕੈ ਅਰਿਣੀ ਬਰ ਤੇ; ਬਸ ਕੇ ਬਲ ਮੋ ਫਿਰਿ ਰਾਜ ਕਮਾਊ ॥੨੫੫॥
225.e: “O mother! if I live, we shall meet again and if I die then for that purpose I have come to request you for forgiveness of my mistakes. On account of the boons granted by the king after residing in the forest, I shall rule again.”255.

225.g: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
225.e: Gauree, First Mehl:

225.g: ਸੇਵਾ ਏਕ; ਨ ਜਾਨਸਿ ਅਵਰੇ ॥
225.e: Those who serve the One Lord, do not know any other.

225.g: ਪਰਪੰਚ ਬਿਆਧਿ; ਤਿਆਗੈ ਕਵਰੇ ॥
225.e: They abandon the bitter worldly conflicts.

225.g: ਭਾਇ ਮਿਲੈ; ਸਚੁ ਸਾਚੈ ਸਚੁ ਰੇ ॥੧॥
225.e: Through love and truth, they meet the Truest of the True. ||1||

225.g: ਐਸਾ ਰਾਮ ਭਗਤੁ; ਜਨੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
225.e: Such are the humble devotees of the Lord.

225.g: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ਮਿਲੈ; ਮਲੁ ਧੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
225.e: They sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and their pollution is washed away. ||1||Pause||

225.g: ਊਂਧੋ ਕਵਲੁ; ਸਗਲ ਸੰਸਾਰੈ ॥
225.e: The heart-lotus of the entire universe is upside-down.

225.g: ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਅਗਨਿ; ਜਗਤ ਪਰਜਾਰੈ ॥
225.e: The fire of evil-mindedness is burning up the world.

225.g: ਸੋ ਉਬਰੈ; ਗੁਰਸਬਦੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੈ ॥੨॥
225.e: They alone are saved, who contemplate the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||2||

225.g: ਭ੍ਰਿੰਗ ਪਤੰਗੁ ਕੁੰਚਰੁ ਅਰੁ ਮੀਨਾ ॥
225.e: The bumble bee, the moth, the elephant, the fish

225.g: ਮਿਰਗੁ ਮਰੈ; ਸਹਿ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਕੀਨਾ ॥
225.e: and the deer - all suffer for their actions, and die.

225.g: ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਰਾਚਿ; ਤਤੁ ਨਹੀ ਬੀਨਾ ॥੩॥
225.e: Trapped by desire, they cannot see reality. ||3||

225.g: ਕਾਮੁ ਚਿਤੈ; ਕਾਮਣਿ ਹਿਤਕਾਰੀ ॥
225.e: The lover of women is obsessed with sex.

225.g: ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਬਿਨਾਸੈ; ਸਗਲ ਵਿਕਾਰੀ ॥
225.e: All the wicked are ruined by their anger.

225.g: ਪਤਿ ਮਤਿ ਖੋਵਹਿ; ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰੀ ॥੪॥
225.e: Honor and good sense are lost, when one forgets the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||4||

225.g: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
225.e: Gauree, First Mehl:

225.g: ਚੋਆ ਚੰਦਨੁ; ਅੰਕਿ ਚੜਾਵਉ ॥
225.e: I may anoint my limbs with sandalwood oil.

225.g: ਪਾਟ ਪਟੰਬਰ; ਪਹਿਰਿ ਹਢਾਵਉ ॥
225.e: I may dress up and wear silk and satin clothes.

225.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ; ਕਹਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਉ ॥੧॥
225.e: But without the Lord's Name, where would I find peace? ||1||

225.g: ਕਿਆ ਪਹਿਰਉ; ਕਿਆ ਓਢਿ ਦਿਖਾਵਉ ॥
225.e: So what should I wear? In what clothes should I display myself?

225.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਜਗਦੀਸ; ਕਹਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
225.e: Without the Lord of the Universe, how can I find peace? ||1||Pause||

225.g: ਕਾਨੀ ਕੁੰਡਲ; ਗਲਿ ਮੋਤੀਅਨ ਕੀ ਮਾਲਾ ॥
225.e: I may wear ear-rings, and a pearl necklace around my neck;

225.g: ਲਾਲ ਨਿਹਾਲੀ; ਫੂਲ ਗੁਲਾਲਾ ॥
225.e: my bed may be adorned with red blankets, flowers and red powder;

225.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਜਗਦੀਸ; ਕਹਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਭਾਲਾ ॥੨॥
225.e: but without the Lord of the Universe, where can I search for peace? ||2||

225.g: ਨੈਨ ਸਲੋਨੀ; ਸੁੰਦਰ ਨਾਰੀ ॥
225.e: I may have a beautiful woman with fascinating eyes;

225.g: ਖੋੜ ਸੀਗਾਰ ਕਰੈ; ਅਤਿ ਪਿਆਰੀ ॥
225.e: she may decorate herself with the sixteen adornments, and make herself appear gorgeous.

225.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਜਗਦੀਸ ਭਜੇ; ਨਿਤ ਖੁਆਰੀ ॥੩॥
225.e: But without meditating on the Lord of the Universe, there is only continual suffering. ||3||

225.g: ਦਰ ਘਰ ਮਹਲਾ; ਸੇਜ ਸੁਖਾਲੀ ॥
225.e: In his hearth and home, in his palace, upon his soft and comfortable bed,

225.g: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ; ਫੂਲ ਬਿਛਾਵੈ ਮਾਲੀ ॥
225.e: day and night, the flower-girls scatter flower petals;

225.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ; ਸੁ ਦੇਹ ਦੁਖਾਲੀ ॥੪॥
225.e: but without the Lord's Name, the body is miserable. ||4||

225.g: ਹੈਵਰ ਗੈਵਰ; ਨੇਜੇ ਵਾਜੇ ॥
225.e: Horses, elephants, lances, marching bands,

225.g: ਲਸਕਰ ਨੇਬ; ਖਵਾਸੀ ਪਾਜੇ ॥
225.e: armies, standard bearers, royal attendants and ostentatious displays

225.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਜਗਦੀਸ; ਝੂਠੇ ਦਿਵਾਜੇ ॥੫॥
225.e: - without the Lord of the Universe, these undertakings are all useless. ||5||

225.g: ਸਿਧੁ ਕਹਾਵਉ; ਰਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਬੁਲਾਵਉ ॥
225.e: He may be called a Siddha, a man of spiritual perfection, and he may summon riches and supernatural powers;

225.g: ਤਾਜ ਕੁਲਹ; ਸਿਰਿ ਛਤ੍ਰੁ ਬਨਾਵਉ ॥
225.e: he may place a crown upon his head, and carry a royal umbrella;

225.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਜਗਦੀਸ; ਕਹਾ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਵਉ ॥੬॥
225.e: but without the Lord of the Universe, where can Truth be found? ||6||

225.g: ਖਾਨੁ ਮਲੂਕੁ; ਕਹਾਵਉ ਰਾਜਾ ॥
225.e: He may be called an emperor, a lord, and a king;

225.g: ਅਬੇ ਤਬੇ; ਕੂੜੇ ਹੈ ਪਾਜਾ ॥
225.e: he may give orders - "Do this now, do this then" - but this is a false display.

225.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰਸਬਦ ਨ; ਸਵਰਸਿ ਕਾਜਾ ॥੭॥
225.e: Without the Word of the Guru's Shabad, his works are not accomplished. ||7||

225.g: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਮਤਾ; ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਵਿਸਾਰੀ ॥
225.e: Egotism and possessiveness are dispelled by the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

225.g: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਜਾਨਿਆ; ਰਿਦੈ ਮੁਰਾਰੀ ॥
225.e: With the Guru's Teachings in my heart, I have come to know the Lord.

225.g: ਪ੍ਰਣਵਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ; ਸਰਣਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ॥੮॥੧੦॥
225.e: Prays Nanak, I seek Your Sanctuary. ||8||10||

225.g: ਮਾਤਾ ਬਾਚ ਰਾਮ ਸੋਂ ॥
225.e: Speech of the Mother addressed to Ram:

225.g: ਮਨੋਹਰ ਛੰਦ ॥
225.e: MANOHAR STANZA

225.g: ਮਾਤ ਸੁਨੀ ਇਹ ਬਾਤ ਜਬੈ; ਤਬ ਰੋਵਤ ਹੀ ਸੁਤ ਕੇ ਉਰ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
ਹਾ ਰਘੁਬੀਰ ਸਿਰੋਮਣ ਰਾਮ, ਚਲੇ ਬਨ ਕਉ, ਮੁਹਿ ਕਉ ਕਤ ਤਿਆਗੀ ॥
225.e: When the mother heard these words, she clung to the neck of her son and said, “Alas, O Ram the superb person of Raghu clan! why are you going to the forest, leaving me here?”

225.g: ਨੀਰ ਬਿਨਾ ਜਿਮ ਮੀਨ ਦਸਾ; ਤਿਮ ਭੂਖ ਪਿਆਸ ਗਈ ਸਭ ਭਾਗੀ ॥
ਝੂਮ ਝਰਾਕ ਝਰੀ ਝਟ ਬਾਲ; ਬਿਸਾਲ ਦਵਾ ਉਨ ਕੀ ਉਰ ਲਾਗੀ ॥੨੫੬॥
225.e: The position which is felt by the fish on forsaking water, who was in the same condition and all her hunger and thurst ended, she fell unconscious with a jerk and her heart felt scorching blaze.256.

225.g: ਜੀਵਤ ਪੂਤ, ਤਵਾਨਨ ਪੇਖ; ਸੀਆ, ਤੁਮਰੀ ਦੁਤ ਦੇਖ ਅਘਾਤੀ ॥
ਚੀਨ ਸੁਮਿਤ੍ਰਜ ਕੀ ਛਬ ਕੋ; ਸਭ ਸੋਕ ਬਿਸਾਰ ਹੀਏ ਹਰਖਾਤੀ ॥
225.e: “O son! I live only on seeing your face and Sita also remains pleased on visualizing your divinity, on seeing the beauty of Lakshman, Sumitra remains pleased, forgetting all her sorrows.”

225.g: ਕੇਕਈ ਆਦਿਕ ਸਉਤਨ ਕਉ ਲਖਿ; ਭਉਹ ਚੜਾਇ ਸਦਾ ਗਰਬਾਤੀ ॥
ਤਾਕਹੁ ਤਾਤ, ਅਨਾਥ ਜਿਉ ਆਜ; ਚਲੇ ਬਨ ਕੋ ਤਜਿ ਕੈ ਬਿਲਲਾਤੀ ॥੨੫੭॥
225.e: These queens seeing Kaikeyi and other co-wives, and expressing their contempt, felt pride on account of their self-respect, felt pride on account of their self-respect, but see, today their sons are going to the forest, leaving them weeping like orphans,

225.g: ਹੋਰ ਰਹੇ ਜਨ ਕੋਰ ਕਈ ਮਿਲਿ; ਜੋਰ ਰਹੇ ਕਰ, ਏਕ ਨ ਮਾਨੀ ॥
ਲਛਨ ਮਾਤ ਕੇ ਧਾਮ ਬਿਦਾ ਕਹੁ ਜਾਤ ਭਏ ਜੀਅ ਮੋ ਇਹ ਠਾਨੀ ॥
225.e: There were many other people also who collectively laid emphasis on not allowing Ram to leave for the forest, but he did not agree with anyone. Lakshman also went to the palace of her mother in order to bid farewell to her.

225.g: ਸੋ ਸੁਨਿ ਬਾਤ ਪਪਾਤ ਧਰਾ ਪਰ; ਘਾਤ ਭਲੀ ਇਹ ਬਾਤ ਬਖਾਨੀ ॥
ਜਾਨੁਕ ਸੇਲ ਸੁਮਾਰ ਲਗੇ; ਛਿਤ ਸੋਵਤ ਸੂਰ ਵਡੇ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੀ ॥੨੫੮॥
225.e: He said to his mother, The earth is full of sinful acts and this is the opportune time to live with Ram.” After hearing such words his mother fell down like the great and proud warrior who falls down with the blow of the spear and sleeps.258.

225.g: ਕਉਨ ਕੁਜਾਤ ਕੁਕਾਜ ਕੀਯੋ, ਜਿਨ ਰਾਘਵ ਕੋ ਇਹ ਭਾਤ ਬਖਾਨਯੋ ॥
ਲੋਕ ਅਲੋਕ ਗਵਾਇ ਦੁਰਾਨਨ; ਭੂਪ ਸੰਘਾਰ ਤਹਾ ਸੁਖ ਮਾਨਯੋ ॥
225.e: “Which mean person has done this deed and said such things to Ram? He has lost his merit in this and the next world and who killing the king, has thought about the acquisition of supreme comfort.

225.g: ਭਰਮ ਗਯੋ ਉਡ, ਕਰਮ ਕਰਯੋ ਘਟ; ਧਰਮ ਕੋ ਤਿਆਗਿ, ਅਧਰਮ ਪ੍ਰਮਾਨਯੋ ॥
ਸੂਲ ਸਹੋਂ ਤਨ ਸੂਕ ਰਹੋਂ ਪਰ ਸੀ ਨ ਕਹੋਂ ਸਿਰ ਸੂਲ ਸਹੋਂਗੀ ॥
225.e: “If the thorns sting and the body pines away, I shall endure the hardship of the thorn on my head.

225.g: ਬਾਘ ਬੁਕਾਰ ਫਨੀਨ ਫੁਕਾਰ ਸੁ ਸੀਸ ਗਿਰੋ ਪਰ ਸੀ ਨ ਕਹੋਂਗੀ ॥
225.e: ”If the tigers and serpents fall on my head, even then I shall not utter ‘oh’ or ‘alas’.

225.g: ਬਾਸ ਕਹਾ ਬਨਬਾਸ ਭਲੋ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਸ ਤਜੋ ਪੀਯ ਪਾਇ ਗਹੋਂਗੀ ॥
225.e: “For me the exile in the forest is good for me than the palace, O beloved! bow at your feet.

225.g: ਹਾਸ ਕਹਾ ਇਹ ਉਦਾਸ ਸਮੈ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਆਸ ਰਹੋ ਪਰ ਮੈ ਨ ਰਹੋਂਗੀ ॥੨੪੯॥
225.e: “Do not joke with me at this sad hour, I shall have hope and return to our home if I shall be with you, but I shall not live here without you.”249.

225.g: ਰਾਮ ਬਾਚ ਸੀਤਾ ਪ੍ਰਤਿ ॥
225.e: Speech of ram addressed to Sita :

225.g: ਰਾਸ ਕਹੋ ਤੁਹਿ ਬਾਸ ਕਰੋ; ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਸਾਸੁ ਕੀ ਸੇਵ ਭਲੀ ਬਿਧਿ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
225.e: “O Sita! I am telling you the truth that you will be able to serve your mother-inlaw nicely while living in your home.

225.g: ਕਾਲ ਹੀ ਬਾਸ ਬਨੈ ਮ੍ਰਿਗ ਲੋਚਨਿ ਰਾਜ ਕਰੋਂ ਤੁਮ ਸੋ ਸੁਨ ਲੀਜੈ ॥
225.e: “O doe-eyed! The time will pass away quickly, I shall rule alongwith you.

225.g: ਜੌ ਨ ਲਗੈ ਜੀਯ ਅਉਧ ਸੁਭਾਨਨਿ, ਜਾਹਿ ਪਿਤਾ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ, ਸਾਚ ਭਨੀਜੈ ॥
225.e: “If indeed, your mind does does not feel at home in Oudh, O winsome-faced! You go to your father’s house.

225.g: ਤਾਤ ਕੀ ਬਾਤ ਗਡੀ ਜੀਯ ਜਾਤ; ਸਿਧਾਤ ਬਨੈ, ਮੁਹਿ ਆਇਸ ਦੀਜੈ ॥੨੫੦॥
225.e: “In my mind the instruction of my father abides, therefore you permit me to go to go to the forest.”250.

225.g: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ; ਦੈਤ ਸੰਘਾਰੇ ॥
225.e: Because of the love of duality, God killed the demons.

225.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ; ਸਾਚਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੇ ॥੮॥
225.e: By their true devotion, the Gurmukhs have been saved. ||8||

225.g: ਬੂਡਾ ਦੁਰਜੋਧਨੁ; ਪਤਿ ਖੋਈ ॥
225.e: Sinking down, Durodhan lost his honor.

225.g: ਰਾਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਨਿਆ; ਕਰਤਾ ਸੋਈ ॥
225.e: He did not know the Creator Lord.

225.g: ਜਨ ਕਉ ਦੂਖਿ ਪਚੈ; ਦੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥੯॥
225.e: One who makes the Lord's humble servant suffer, shall himself suffer and rot. ||9||

225.g: ਜਨਮੇਜੈ; ਗੁਰਸਬਦੁ. ਨ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥
225.e: Janameja did not know the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

225.g: ਕਿਉ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ; ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਨਿਆ ॥
225.e: Deluded by doubt, how could he find peace?

225.g: ਇਕੁ ਤਿਲੁ ਭੂਲੇ; ਬਹੁਰਿ ਪਛੁਤਾਨਿਆ ॥੧੦॥
225.e: Making a mistake, for even an instant, you shall regret and repent later on. ||10||

225.g: ਕੰਸੁ ਕੇਸੁ ਚਾਂਡੂਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
225.e: Kansa the King and his warriors Kays and Chandoor had no equals.

225.g: ਰਾਮੁ. ਨ ਚੀਨਿਆ; ਅਪਨੀ ਪਤਿ ਖੋਈ ॥
225.e: But they did not remember the Lord, and they lost their honor.

225.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਜਗਦੀਸ; ਨ ਰਾਖੈ ਕੋਈ ॥੧੧॥
225.e: Without the Lord of the Universe, no one can be saved. ||11||

225.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ; ਗਰਬੁ. ਨ ਮੇਟਿਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
225.e: Without the Guru, pride cannot be eradicated.

225.g: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਧਰਮੁ ਧੀਰਜੁ; ਹਰਿ ਨਾਇ ॥
225.e: Following the Guru's Teachings, one obtains Dharmic faith, composure and the Lord's Name.

225.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ; ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ॥੧੨॥੯॥
225.e: O Nanak, singing the Glories of God, His Name is received. ||12||9||

225.g: ਲਛਮਣ ਬਾਚ ॥
225.e: Speech of Lakshman :

225.g: ਬਾਤ ਇਤੈ ਇਹੁ ਭਾਤ ਭਈ ਸੁਨਿ; ਆਇਗੇ ਭ੍ਰਾਤ ਸਰਾਸਨ ਲੀਨੇ ॥
ਕਉਨ ਕੁਪੂਤ ਭਯੋ ਕੁਲ ਮੈ, ਜਿਨ ਰਾਮਹਿ ਬਾਸ ਬਨੈ ਕਹੁ ਦੀਨੇ ॥
225.e: This talk was going on when hearing it, Lakshman came with his bow in his hand and said, “Who can be that undutiful son in our clan who has asked for exile of Ram?

225.g: ਕਾਮ ਕੇ ਬਾਨ ਬਧਿਯੋ ਬਸ ਕਾਮਨਿ; ਕੂਰ ਕੁਚਾਲ ਮਹਾ ਮਤਿ ਹੀਨੇ ॥
ਰਾਡ ਕੁਭਾਡ ਕੇ ਹਾਥ ਬਿਕਿਯੋ; ਕਪਿ ਨਾਚਤ ਨਾਚ ਛਰੀ ਜਿਮ ਚੀਨੇ ॥੨੫੧॥
225.e: “This foolish person (king) pierced by the arrows of the god of love, entrapped in cruel misconduct, under the impact of a foolish woman is dancing like a monkey understanding the sign of a stick.251.

225.g: ਕਾਮ ਕੋ ਡੰਡ ਲੀਏ ਕਰ ਕੇਕਈ; ਬਾਨਰ ਜਿਉ ਨ੍ਰਿਪ ਨਾਚ ਨਚਾਵੈ ॥
ਐਠਨ ਐਠ ਅਮੈਠ ਲੀਏ; ਢਿਗ ਬੈਠ ਸੂਆ ਜਿਮ ਪਾਠ ਪੜਾਵੈ ॥
225.e: “Taking the stick of lust in her hand Kaikeyi is causing the king to dance like a monkey  that proud woman has caught hold of the king and sitting with him she is teaching him lessons like a parrot.

225.g: ਸਉਤਨ ਸੀਸ ਹ੍ਵੈ ਈਸਕ ਈਸ; ਪ੍ਰਿਥੀਸ ਜਿਉ ਚਾਮ ਕੇ ਦਾਮ ਚਲਾਵੈ ॥
ਕੂਰ ਕੁਜਾਤ ਕੁਪੰਥ ਦੁਰਾਨਨ; ਲੋਗ ਗਏ ਪਰਲੋਕ ਗਵਾਵੈ ॥੨੫੨॥
225.e: This woman is riding over the heads of her co-wives like a god of hods and for a short while is making current the coins of leather like the king (i.e. she is behaving to her liking). This cruel, inferior, ill-disciplined and ill-mouthed woman has not onl

225.g: ਲੋਗ ਕੁਟੇਵ ਲਗੇ ਉਨ ਕੀ; ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਾਵ ਤਜੇ, ਮੁਹਿ ਕਯੋ ਬਨ ਐਹੈ ॥
ਜਉ ਹਟ ਬੈਠ ਰਹੋ ਘਰਿ ਮੋ; ਜਸ ਕਯੋ ਚਲਿਹੈ, ਰਘੁਬੰਸ ਲਜੈਹੈ ॥
225.e: “The people have begun to talk ill of both the king and the queen, how can I live by forsaking the feet of Ram, therefore I shall also go to the forests

225.g: ਕਾਲ ਹੀ ਕਾਲ ਉਚਾਰਤ ਕਾਲ; ਗਯੋ ਇਹ ਕਾਲ ਸਭੋ ਛਲ ਜੈਹੈ ॥
ਧਾਮ ਰਹੋ ਨਹੀ ਸਾਚ ਕਹੋਂ ਇਹ ਘਾਤ ਗਈ ਫਿਰ ਹਾਥਿ ਨ ਐਹੈ ॥੨੫੩॥
225.e: “The whole time has passed in seeking an opportunity to serve ram and in this way the time will deceive all. I am telling the truth that I shall not stay at home and if this opportunity of service is lost, then I cannot avail it.”253.

225.g: ਚਾਪ ਧਰੈ ਕਰ ਚਾਰ ਕੁ ਤੀਰ; ਤੁਨੀਰ ਕਸੇ ਦੋਊ ਬੀਰ ਸੁਹਾਏ ॥
ਆਵਧ ਰਾਜ ਤ੍ਰੀਯਾ ਜਿਹ ਸੋਭਤ; ਹੋਨ ਬਿਦਾ ਤਿਹ ਤੀਰ ਸਿਧਾਏ ॥
225.e: Holding the bow in one hand and tightening the quiver and holding three-four arrows in the other hand both the brothers are looking impressive  the side on which the

225.g: ਪਾਇ ਪਰੇ ਭਰ ਨੈਨ ਰਹੇ; ਭਰ ਮਾਤ ਭਲੀ ਬਿਧ ਕੰਠ ਲਗਾਏ ॥
ਬੋਲੇ ਤੇ ਪੂਤ, ਨ ਆਵਤ ਧਾਮਿ; ਬੁਲਾਇ ਲਿਉ ਆਪਨ ਤੇ ਕਿਮੁ ਆਏ ॥੨੫੪॥
225.e: They bowed before the mothers who hugging them with their bosoms said, “O son! you come with great hesitation when you are called but how you have come today yourself.”254.

226.e: The self-willed manmukh is lured by another man's wife.
The noose is around his neck, and he is entangled in petty conflicts.
The Gurmukh is emancipated, singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||5||

226.g: ਜਿਉ ਤਨੁ ਬਿਧਵਾ; ਪਰ ਕਉ ਦੇਈ ॥
226.e: The lonely widow gives her body to a stranger;

226.g: ਕਾਮਿ ਦਾਮਿ; ਚਿਤੁ ਪਰ ਵਸਿ ਸੇਈ ॥
226.e: she allows her mind to be controlled by others for lust or money

226.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਪਿਰ. ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ; ਨ ਕਬਹੂੰ ਹੋਈ ॥੬॥
226.e: , but without her husband, she is never satisfied. ||6||
You may read, recite and study the scriptures,
The Simritees, Vedas and Puraanas;

226.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਰਸ ਰਾਤੇ; ਮਨੁ ਬਹੁ ਨਾਟਾ ॥੭॥
226.e: but without being imbued with the Lord's essence, the mind wanders endlessly. ||7||
As the rainbird thirsts longingly for the drop of rain,
and as the fish delights in the water,
Nanak is satisfied by the sublime essence of the Lord. ||8||11||

226.g: ਨਾਕ ਕਟੀ ਨਿਰਲਾਜ ਨਿਸਾਚਰ; ਨਾਹ ਨਿਪਾਤਤ ਨੇਹੁ ਨ ਮਾਨਯੋ ॥੨੫੯॥
226.e: The trust and rightful acts have flown away from the world and authentically there remains only the impiety. This demoness has put the clan to disgrace and she does not feel sorrow on the death of her husband.”259.
Gauree, First Mehl:
Acting in egotism, the Lord is not known, even by wearing religious robes.
How rare is that Gurmukh, who surrenders his mind in devotional worship. ||1||

226.g: ਹਉ ਹਉ ਕਰਤ; ਨਹੀ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
226.e: By actions done in egotism, selfishness and conceit, the True Lord is not obtained.

226.g: ਹਉਮੈ ਜਾਇ; ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
226.e: But when egotism departs, then the state of supreme dignity is obtained. ||1||Pause||
The kings act in egotism, and undertake all sorts of expeditions.
But through their egotism, they are ruined; they die, only to be reborn over and over again. ||2||
Egotism is overcome only by contemplating the Word of the Guru's Shabad.
One who restrains his fickle mind subdues the five passions. ||3||
With the True Lord deep within the self, the Celestial Mansion is intuitively found.
Understanding the Sovereign Lord, the state of supreme dignity is obtained. ||4||
The Guru dispels the doubts of those whose actions are true.
They focus their attention on the Home of the Fearless Lord. ||5||

226.g: ਹਉ ਹਉ ਕਰਿ ਮਰਣਾ; ਕਿਆ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
226.e: Those who act in egotism, selfishness and conceit die; what do they gain?

226.g: ਪੂਰਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟੇ; ਸੋ ਝਗਰੁ ਚੁਕਾਵੈ ॥੬॥
226.e: Those who meet the Perfect Guru are rid of all conflicts. ||6||
Whatever exists, is in reality nothing.
Obtaining spiritual wisdom from the Guru, I sing the Glories of God. ||7||
Speech of Sumitra,  Addressed to Lakshman :

226.g: ਦਾਸ ਕੋ ਭਾਵ ਧਰੇ ਰਹੀਯੋ ਸੁਤ, ਮਾਤ ਸਰੂਪ ਸੀਆ ਪਹਿਚਾਨੋ ॥
ਤਾਤ ਕੀ ਤੁਲਿ ਸੀਆਪਤਿ ਕਉ ਕਰਿ ਕੈ ਇਹ ਬਾਤ ਸਹੀ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨੋ ॥
226.e: “O son! always live like a servant (with your brother) and consider Sita as your mother and her husband Ram as your father and always keep these rightful facts in your mind.

226.g: ਜੇਤਕ ਕਾਨਨ ਕੇ ਦੁਖ ਹੈ; ਸਭ ਸੋ ਸੁਖ ਕੈ ਤਨ ਪੈ ਅਨਮਾਨੋ ॥
ਰਾਮ ਕੇ ਪਾਇ ਗਹੇ ਰਹੀਯੋ; ਬਨ ਕੈ ਘਰ ਕੋ, ਘਰ ਕੈ ਬਨੁ ਜਾਨੋ ॥੨੬੦॥
226.e: “Endure all the troubles of the forest as comfort-like. Think always of the feet of Ram and consider the forest as home and the home as forest.”260.

226.g: ਰਾਜੀਵ ਲੋਚਨ ਰਾਮ ਕੁਮਾਰ; ਚਲੇ ਬਨ ਕਉ ਸੰਗਿ ਭ੍ਰਾਤਿ ਸੁਹਾਯੋ ॥
ਦੇਵ ਅਦੇਵ ਨਿਛਤ੍ਰ ਸਚੀਪਤ ਚਉਕੇ ਚਕੇ ਮਨ ਮੋਦ ਬਢਾਯੋ ॥
226.e: The lotus-eyed Ram moved alongwith his brother to the forest, on seeing this the gods were startled and the demons wondered,

226.g: ਆਨਨ ਬਿੰਬ ਪਰਯੋ ਬਸੁਧਾ ਪਰ; ਫੈਲਿ ਰਹਿਯੋ ਫਿਰਿ ਹਾਥਿ ਨ ਆਯੋ ॥
ਬੀਚ ਅਕਾਸ ਨਿਵਾਸ ਕੀਯੋ ਤਿਨ; ਤਾਹੀ ਤੇ ਨਾਮ ਮਯੰਕ ਕਹਾਯੋ ॥੨੬੧॥
226.e: And visualizing the end of demons Indra felt highly pleased, the moon also being pleased began to spread his reflection on the earth and being a resident within the sky, he became famous with the name of “Mayank.’261.
End of the description of Exile of Ram.
Now begins the description of the Exile:
Speect about the charm of Sita:
BIJAI STANZA

226.g: ਚੰਦ ਕੀ ਅੰਸ ਚਕੋਰਨ ਕੈ ਕਰਿ ਮੋਰਨ ਬਿਦੁਲਤਾ ਅਨਮਾਨੀ ॥
226.e: She was looking like moon to chakors and lightning in clouds to the peacocks.

226.g: ਮਤ ਗਇੰਦਨ ਇੰਦ੍ਰ ਬਧੂ ਭੁਨਸਾਰ ਛਟਾ ਰਵਿ ਕੀ ਜੀਅ ਜਾਨੀ ॥
226.e: She appeared as power-incarnate and the beauty of the sun at dawn to the intoxicated elephants.

226.g: ਦੇਵਨ ਦੋਖਨ ਕੀ ਹਰਤਾ; ਅਰ ਦੇਵਨ ਕਾਲ ਕ੍ਰਿਯਾ ਕਰ ਮਾਨੀ ॥
226.e: To the gods she seemed like the destroyer of sufferings and the performer of the religious activities of all kinds.

226.g: ਦੇਸਨ ਸਿੰਧ ਦਿਸੇਸਨ ਬ੍ਰਿੰਧ; ਜੋਗੇਸਨ ਗੰਗ ਕੈ ਰੰਗ ਪਛਾਨੀ ॥੨੬੩॥
226.e: She appeared as the ocean to the earth, all-pervading to all the directions and pure like Ganges to the Yogis.263.
Gauree, First Mehl:

226.g: ਹਠੁ ਕਰਿ ਮਰੈ; ਨ ਲੇਖੈ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
226.e: One who dies in stubbornness shall not be approved,
even though he may wear religious robes and smear his body all over with ashes.
Forgetting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, he comes to regret and repent in the end. ||1||

226.g: ਤੂੰ ਮਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ; ਤੂੰ ਮਨਿ ਸੂਖ ॥
226.e: Believe in the Dear Lord, and you shall find peace of mind.

226.g: ਨਾਮੁ ਬਿਸਾਰਿ; ਸਹਹਿ ਜਮ ਦੂਖ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
226.e: Forgetting the Naam, you shall have to endure the pain of death. ||1||Pause||
The smell of musk, sandalwood and camphor,
and the intoxication of Maya, takes one far away from the state of supreme dignity.
Forgetting the Naam, one becomes the most false of all the false. ||2||
Lances and swords, marching bands, thrones and the salutes of others
only increase his desire; he is engrossed in sexual desire.

226.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਚੇ; ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੩॥
226.e: Without seeking the Lord, neither devotional worship nor the Naam are obtained. ||3||
Union with God is not obtained by arguments and egotism.
But by offering your mind, the comfort of the Naam is obtained.
In the love of duality and ignorance, you shall suffer. ||4||

226.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਦਮ ਕੇ; ਸਉਦਾ ਨਹੀ ਹਾਟ ॥
226.e: Without money, you cannot buy anything in the store.
Without a boat, you cannot cross over the ocean.
Without serving the Guru, everything is lost. ||5||

226.g: ਤਿਸ ਕਉ ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ; ਜਿ ਵਾਟ ਦਿਖਾਵੈ ॥
226.e: Waaho! Waaho! - Hail, hail, to the one who shows us the Way.

226.g: ਤਿਸ ਕਉ ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ; ਜਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਣਾਵੈ ॥
226.e: Waaho! Waaho! - Hail, hail, to the one who teaches the Word of the Shabad.

226.g: ਤਿਸ ਕਉ ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ; ਜਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ ॥੬॥
226.e: Waaho! Waaho! - Hail, hail, to the one who unites me in the Lord's Union. ||6||

226.g: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਤਿਸ ਕਉ; ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਇਹੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
226.e: Waaho! Waaho! - Hail, hail, to the one who is the Keeper of this soul.
Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, contemplate this Ambrosial Nectar.
The Glorious Greatness of the Naam is bestowed according to the Pleasure of Your Will. ||7||
Without the Naam, how can I live, O mother?
Night and day, I chant it; I remain in the Protection of Your Sanctuary.
O Nanak, attuned to the Naam, honor is attained. ||8||12||
DOHRA

226.g: ਉਤ ਰਘੁਬਰ ਬਨ ਕੋ ਚਲੇ; ਸੀਅ ਸਹਿਤ ਤਜਿ ਗ੍ਰੇਹ ॥
226.e: On that side leaving home alongwith Sita, Ram went to the foest,

226.g: ਇਤੈ ਦਸਾ ਜਿਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਭਈ; ਸਕਲ ਸਾਧ, ਸੁਨਿ ਲੇਹ ॥੨੬੪॥
226.e: And on this side in Ayodhyapuri whatever happened, the saints may listen to that.264.
DOHRA

226.g: ਪਿਤ ਆਗਿਆ ਤੇ ਬਨ ਚਲੇ; ਤਜਿ ਗ੍ਰਹਿ ਰਾਮ ਕੁਮਾਰ ॥
ਸੰਗ ਸੀਆ ਮ੍ਰਿਗ ਲੋਚਨੀ; ਜਾ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰਭਾ ਅਪਾਰ ॥੨੬੨॥
226.e: With the permission of his father Ram left his home and with him went the doe-eyed Sita infinite glory.262.

227.e: Speech of the Mother :
KABIT

227.g: ਸਭੈ ਸੁਖ ਲੈ ਕੇ ਗਏ, ਗਾੜੋ ਦੁਖ ਦੇਤ ਭਏ; ਰਾਜਾ ਦਸਰਥ ਜੂ ਕਉ ਕੈ ਕੈ ਆਜ ਪਾਤ ਹੋ ॥
227.e: They had taken all the comforts with them and giving us great agony, they have left us to see also the agony of the death of king Dasrath.

227.g: ਅਜ ਹੂੰ ਨ ਛੀਜੈ ਬਾਤ, ਮਾਨ ਲੀਜੈ ਰਾਜ ਕੀਜੈ; ਕਹੋ ਕਾਜ ਕਉਨ ਕੌ ਹਮਾਰੇ ਸ੍ਰੋਣ ਨਾਤ ਹੋ ॥
227.e: The king ram, seeing and listening to all this, is not softening, O Ram! accept now whatever we say, please tell, who is the survivor Lord here?

227.g: ਰਾਜਸੀ ਕੇ ਧਾਰੌ ਸਾਜ, ਸਾਧਨ ਕੈ ਕੀਜੈ ਕਾਜ; ਕਹੋ ਰਘੁਰਾਜ, ਆਜ ਕਾਹੇ ਕਉ ਸਿਧਾਤ ਹੋ ॥
227.e: O Ram! take the reins of kingdom and do all the work. Tell us, why are you going now?

227.g: ਤਾਪਸੀ ਕੇ ਭੇਸ ਕੀਨੇ, ਜਾਨਕੀ ਕੌ ਸੰਗ ਲੀਨੇ; ਮੇਰੇ ਬਨਬਾਸੀ, ਮੋ ਉਦਾਸੀ ਦੀਏ ਜਾਤ ਹੋ ॥੨੬੫॥
227.e: O exiled Ram in the garb of an ascetic and taking Janaki (Sita) with you, why are you giving me sadness?265.

227.g: ਕਾਰੇ ਕਾਰੇ ਕਰਿ ਬੇਸ, ਰਾਜਾ ਜੂ ਕੌ ਛੋਰਿ ਦੇਸ; ਤਾਪਸੀ ਕੋ ਕੈ ਭੇਸ, ਸਾਥਿ ਹੀ ਸਿਧਾਰਿ ਹੌ ॥
227.e: I shall also put on the black garb leaving the country of the king, and becoming an ascetic, I shall accompany you.

227.g: ਕੁਲ ਹੂੰ ਕੀ ਕਾਨ ਛੋਰੋਂ ਰਾਜਸੀ ਕੇ ਸਾਜ ਤੋਰੋਂ ਸੰਗਿ ਤੇ ਨ ਮੋਰੋਂ ਮੁਖ ਐਸੋ ਕੈ ਬਿਚਾਰਿ ਹੌ ॥
227.e: I shall leave the family practice and abandon the royal splendour, but shall not turn my face away from you.

227.g: ਮੁੰਦ੍ਰਾ ਕਾਨ ਧਾਰੌ ਸਾਰੇ ਮੁਖ ਪੈ ਬਿਭੂਤਿ ਡਾਰੌਂ ਹਠਿ ਕੋ ਨ ਹਾਰੌਂ ਪੂਤ ਰਾਜ ਸਾਜ ਜਾਰਿ ਹੌਂ ॥
227.e: I shall wear the rings in the ear and smear the ashes over my body. I shall live in persistence, O my son! I shall forsake all the royal paraphernalia.

227.g: ਜੁਗੀਆ ਕੋ ਕੀਨੋ ਬੇਸ ਕਉਸਲ ਕੇ ਛੋਰ ਦੇਸ ਰਾਜਾ ਰਾਮਚੰਦ ਜੂ ਕੇ ਸੰਗਿ ਹੀ ਸਿਧਾਰਿ ਹੌਂ ॥੨੬੬॥
227.e: I shall adopt the garb of a yogi, and leaving Kaushal (country), I shall go with the king Ram.266.
APOORAV STANZA
Ram, the abode of religious action, went to the forest alongwith Lakshman and Janaki (Sita).267.
On that side the father breathed his last and left for heaven in and air-vehicle of gods. On this side, the ministers reflected on the situation.268.
The advice of vasishtha, the eminent Brahmin amongst all the Brahmins, was accepted. A letter was written and sent to Magadh.269.
A very brief discussion was held and several fast-moving messengers like Hanuman were sent.270.
Ten messengers, who were specialist in their task, were searched and sent to the place where Bharat resided.271.
Those messengers delivered the message and told that the king Dasrath had died, Bharat read the letter and accompanied them.272.
The anger blazed in his mind and the sense of Dharma and respect disappeared from it. They left Kashmir (and started on return journey) and began to remember the Lord.273.
The brave hero Bharat reached Oudh and saw the king Dasrath as dead.274.
Gauree, First Mehl:
First, Brahma entered the house of Death.
Brahma entered the lotus, and searched the nether regions, but he did not find the end of it.
He did not accept the Lord's Order - he was deluded by doubt. ||1||
Whoever is created, shall be destroyed by Death.

227.g: ਹਮ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ; ਗੁਰਸਬਦੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
227.e: But I am protected by the Lord; I contemplate the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||1||Pause||
All the gods and goddesses are enticed by Maya.

227.g: ਕਾਲੁ ਨ ਛੋਡੈ; ਬਿਨੁ. ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ॥
227.e: Death cannot be avoided, without serving the Guru.
That Lord is Imperishable, Invisible and Inscrutable. ||2||
The sultans, emperors and kings shall not remain.

227.g: ਨਾਮਹੁ ਭੂਲੈ; ਜਮ ਕਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਸਹਨਾ ॥
227.e: Forgetting the Name, they shall endure the pain of death.

227.g: ਮੈ ਧਰ ਨਾਮੁ; ਜਿਉ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਰਹਨਾ ॥੩॥
227.e: My only Support is the Naam, the Name of the Lord; as He keeps me, I survive. ||3||
The leaders and kings shall not remain.
The bankers shall die, after accumulating their wealth and money.

227.g: ਮੈ ਧਨੁ ਦੀਜੈ; ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੪॥
227.e: Grant me, O Lord, the wealth of Your Ambrosial Naam. ||4||
The people, rulers, leaders and chiefs
none of them shall be able to remain in the world.
Death is inevitable; it strikes the heads of the false. ||5||
Only the One Lord, the Truest of the True, is permanent.

227.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਕਰਿ ਸਾਜੀ; ਤਿਨਹਿ ਸਭ ਗੋਈ ॥
227.e: He who created and fashioned everything, shall destroy it.

227.g: ਓਹੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਪੈ; ਤਾਂ ਪਤਿ ਹੋਈ ॥੬॥
227.e: One who becomes Gurmukh and meditates on the Lord is honored. ||6||
The Qazis, Shaykhs and Fakeers in religious robes
call themselves great; but through their egotism, their bodies are suffering in pain.

227.g: ਕਾਲੁ ਨ ਛੋਡੈ; ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਧੀਰਾ ॥੭॥
227.e: Death does not spare them, without the Support of the True Guru. ||7||
The trap of Death is hanging over their tongues and eyes.
Death is over their ears, when they hear talk of evil.
Without the Shabad, they are plundered, day and night. ||8||
Death cannot touch those whose hearts are filled with the True Name of the Lord,

227.g: ਕਾਲੁ. ਨ ਜੋਹਿ ਸਕੈ; ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ॥
227.e: And who sing the Glories of God.
O Nanak, the Gurmukh is absorbed in the Word of the Shabad. ||9||14||
Egotism binds people in bondage, and causes them to wander around lost.
O Nanak, peace is obtained through devotional worship of the Lord. ||8||13||
Speech of Bharat addressed to Kaikeyi :
“O mother! when you saw that the worst had happened and then you called your son  you must be reproached, I feel ashamed. 275.
Gauree, First Mehl:
They speak the Truth - not an iota of falsehood.
The Gurmukhs walk in the Way of the Lord's Command.
They remain unattached, in the Sanctuary of the True Lord. ||1||

227.g: ਸਚ ਘਰਿ ਬੈਸੈ; ਕਾਲੁ ਨ ਜੋਹੈ ॥
227.e: They dwell in their true home, and Death does not touch them.

227.g: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਕਉ; ਆਵਤ ਜਾਵਤ ਦੁਖੁ ਮੋਹੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
227.e: The self-willed manmukhs come and go, in the pain of emotional attachment. ||1||Pause||
So, drink deeply of this Nectar, and speak the Unspoken Speech.

227.g: ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਬੈਸਿ; ਸਹਜ ਘਰੁ ਲਹੀਐ ॥
227.e: Dwelling in the home of your own being within, you shall find the home of intuitive peace.

227.g: ਹਰਿ ਰਸਿ ਮਾਤੇ; ਇਹੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਕਹੀਐ ॥੨॥
227.e: One who is imbued with the Lord's sublime essence, is said to experience this peace. ||2||
Following the Guru's Teachings, one becomes perfectly stable, and never wavers.
Following the Guru's Teachings, one intuitively chants the Name of the True Lord.
Drinking in this Ambrosial Nectar, and churning it, the essential reality is discerned. ||3||
Beholding the True Guru, I have received His Teachings.
I have offered my mind and body, after searching deep within my own being.
I have come to realize the value of understanding my own soul. ||4||
The Naam, the Name of the Immaculate Lord, is the most excellent and sublime food.
The pure swan-souls see the True Light of the Infinite Lord.
Wherever I look, I see the One and Only Lord. ||5||
One who remains pure and unblemished and practices only true deeds,

227.g: ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਸੇਵਾ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ॥
227.e: obtains the supreme status, serving at the Guru's Feet.

227.g: ਮਨ ਤੇ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ; ਚੂਕੀ ਅਹੰ ਭ੍ਰਮਣੀ ॥੬॥
227.e: The mind is reconciliated with the mind, and the ego's wandering ways come to an end. ||6||

227.g: ਇਨ ਬਿਧਿ; ਕਉਣੁ ਕਉਣੁ ਨਹੀ ਤਾਰਿਆ ॥
227.e: In this way, who - who has not been saved?
The Lord's Praises have saved His Saints and devotees.

228.e: Gauree Bairaagan, First Mehl:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

228.g: ਜਿਉ ਗਾਈ ਕਉ ਗੋਇਲੀ; ਰਾਖਹਿ ਕਰਿ ਸਾਰਾ ॥
228.e: As the dairy farmer watches over and protects his cows, so does the Lord cherish and protect us, night and day. He blesses the soul with peace. ||1||

228.g: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਪਾਲਹਿ ਰਾਖਿ ਲੇਹਿ; ਆਤਮ ਸੁਖੁ ਧਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
228.e: Please protect me here and hereafter, O Lord, Merciful to the meek.
I seek Your Sanctuary; please bless me with Your Glance of Grace. ||1||Pause||
Wherever I look, there You are. Save me, O Savior Lord!

228.g: ਜਹ ਦੇਖਉ. ਤਹ ਰਵਿ ਰਹੇ; ਰਖੁ ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰਾ ॥
228.e: You are the Giver, and You are the Enjoyer;

228.g: ਤੂੰ ਦਾਤਾ. ਭੁਗਤਾ ਤੂੰਹੈ; ਤੂੰ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਅਧਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
228.e: You are the Support of the breath of life. ||2||

228.g: ਕਿਰਤੁ ਪਇਆ, ਅਧ ਊਰਧੀ; ਬਿਨੁ ਗਿਆਨ ਬੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
228.e: According to the karma of past actions, people descend to the depths or rise to the heights, unless they contemplate spiritual wisdom.

228.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਉਪਮਾ ਜਗਦੀਸ ਕੀ; ਬਿਨਸੈ ਨ. ਅੰਧਿਆਰਾ ॥੩॥
228.e: Without the Praises of the Lord of the Universe, the darkness is not dispelled. ||3||

228.g: ਜਗੁ ਬਿਨਸਤ. ਹਮ ਦੇਖਿਆ; ਲੋਭੇ ਅਹੰਕਾਰਾ ॥
228.e: I have seen the world being destroyed by greed and egotism.

228.g: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਸਚੁ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਦੁਆਰਾ ॥੪॥
228.e: Only by serving the Guru is God obtained, and the true gate of liberation found. ||4||

228.g: ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਮਹਲੁ. ਅਪਾਰ ਕੋ; ਅਪਰੰਪਰੁ ਸੋਈ ॥
228.e: The Mansion of the Infinite Lord's Presence is within the home of one's own being. He is beyond any boundaries.

228.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ. ਥਿਰੁ ਕੋ ਨਹੀ; ਬੂਝੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥੫॥
228.e: Without the Word of the Shabad, nothing shall endure. Through understanding, peace is obtained. ||5||

228.g: ਕਿਆ ਲੈ ਆਇਆ, ਲੇ ਜਾਇ ਕਿਆ; ਫਾਸਹਿ ਜਮ ਜਾਲਾ ॥
228.e: What have you brought, and what will you take away, when you are caught by the noose of Death?

228.g: ਡੋਲੁ ਬਧਾ ਕਸਿ ਜੇਵਰੀ; ਆਕਾਸਿ ਪਤਾਲਾ ॥੬॥
228.e: Like the bucket tied to the rope in the well, you are pulled up to the Akaashic Ethers, and then lowered down to the nether regions of the underworld. ||6||

228.g: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ. ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ; ਸਹਜੇ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
228.e: Follow the Guru's Teachings, and do not forget the Naam, the Name of the Lord; you shall automatically obtain honor.

228.g: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹੈ; ਮਿਲਿ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਈਐ ॥੭॥
228.e: Deep within the self is the treasure of the Shabad; it is obtained only by eradicating selfishness and conceit. ||7||

228.g: ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ. ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪਣੀ; ਗੁਣ ਅੰਕਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥
228.e: When God bestows His Glance of Grace, people settle in the Lap of the Virtuous Lord.

228.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਮੇਲੁ. ਨ ਚੂਕਈ; ਲਾਹਾ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੮॥੧॥੧੭॥
228.e: O Nanak, this Union cannot be broken; the true profit is obtained. ||8||1||17||
KUSMA BACCHITAR STANZA

228.g: ਦੁਖ ਸੁਖ ਸਮ ਕਰ ਸੁਖ ਦੁਖ ਮਾਨੈ ॥
228.e: “The people residing in the forest, know Raghuvir Ram and consider his suffering and comfort as their own.

228.g: ਬਲਕਲ ਧਰ ਕਰ ਅਬ ਬਨ ਜੈਹੈਂ ॥
ਰਘੁਪਤ ਸੰਗ ਹਮ ਬਨ ਫਲ ਖੈਹੈਂ ॥੨੭੭॥
228.e: “Now I shall wear the rind of the tree and go to the forest and shall eat the forest fruit with ram.”277.

228.g: ਇਮ ਕਹਾ ਬਚਨਾ ਘਰ ਬਰ ਛੋਰੇ ॥

228.e: Saying this Bharat left his home and breaking the ornaments he threw them away and wore the bark-peel.

228.g: ਰਘੁਪਤਿ ਪਗ ਤਰ ਕਰ ਘਰ ਮਾਡਿਯੋ ॥੨੭੮॥
228.e: He performed the death ceremony of king Dasrath and left Oudh and concentrated on abiding at the feet of Ram.278.

228.g: ਲਖਿ ਜਲ ਥਲ ਕਹ ਤਜਿ ਕੁਲ ਧਾਏ ॥
ਮਨੁ ਮਨ ਸੰਗਿ ਲੈ ਤਿਹ ਠਾ ਆਏ ॥
228.e: The forest-dwellers, seeing the strong army of Bharat, came alongwith the sages and reached the place where Ram was staying.

228.g: ਲਖਿ ਬਲ ਰਾਮੰ ਖਲ ਦਲ ਭੀਰੰ ॥
ਗਹਿ ਧਨ ਪਾਣੰ ਸਿਤ ਧਰ ਤੀਰੰ ॥੨੭੯॥
228.e: Seeing the strong force ram thought that some tyrants had come to attack, therefore he held the bow and arrows in his hands.279.

228.g: ਗਹਿ ਧਨੁ ਰਾਮੰ ਸਰ ਬਰ ਪੂਰੰ ॥

228.e: Ram taking his bow in his hand began to discharge arrow and seeing this Indra, sun etc. trembled with fear.

228.g: ਨਰ ਬਰ ਹਰਖੇ ਘਰ ਘਰ ਅਮਰੰ ॥

228.e: Seeing this the forest-dwellers felt pleased in their dwelling places, but the gods of Amarpura seeing this battle became anxious.280.
Then Bharat reflected in his mind that ram was thinking of starting the battle,

228.g: ਦਲ ਬਲ ਤਜਿ ਕਰਿ ਇਕਲੇ ਨਿਸਰੇ ॥

228.e: Therefore he left all his forces, went forward alone and seeing Ram all his sufferings ended.281.

228.g: ਦ੍ਰਿਗ ਜਬ ਨਿਰਖੇ ਭਟ ਮਣ ਰਾਮੰ ॥
ਸਿਰ ਧਰ ਟੇਕਯੰ ਤਜ ਕਰ ਕਾਮੰ ॥
228.e: When Bharat saw with his own eyes the mighty Ram, then abandoning all his desires, Bharat prostrated before him.

228.g: ਇਮ ਗਤਿ ਲਖਿ ਕਰ ਰਘੁਪਤਿ ਜਾਨੀ ॥

228.e: Seeing this, Ram realized that it was Bharat who had come leaving his capital.282.
Seeing Shatrughan and Bharat, Ram recognized them and it came into the mind of ram and Lakshman that king Dasrath had left this world
They abandoned their arrow and effacing their displeasure came down from the mountain.283.

228.g: ਦਲ ਬਲ ਤਜਿ ਕਰਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਗਲ ਰੋਏ ॥
ਦੁਖ ਕਸਿ ਬਿਧਿ ਦੀਆ, ਸੁਖ ਸਭ ਖੋਏ ॥
228.e: Leaving the army aside they hugged each other and wept. The providence had given such agony that they had lost all comforts.

228.g: ਤਜਿ ਹਠਿ ਲਾਗੇ ਸਭ ਪਗ ਤੇਰੇ ॥੨੮੪॥
228.e: Bharat said, “O Rahguvir, abandon your persistence and return to your home, because for this very reason all the people had fallen at your feet.”284.
Gauree, First Mehl:

228.g: ਰਾਮਿ ਨਾਮਿ; ਚਿਤੁ ਰਾਪੈ ਜਾ ਕਾ ॥
228.e: One whose consciousness is permeated with the Lord's Name
- receive the blessing of his darshan in the early light of dawn. ||1||
If you do not meditate on the Lord, it is your own misfortune.

228.g: ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਦਾਤਾ; ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਰਾਮੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
228.e: In each and every age, the Great Giver is my Lord God. ||1||Pause||
Following the Guru's Teachings, the perfect humble beings meditate on the Lord.
Within their hearts, the unstruck melody vibrates. ||2||

228.g: ਜੋ ਜਨ; ਰਾਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥
228.e: Those who worship the Lord and love the Lord
- showering His Mercy, God protects them. ||3||

228.g: ਜਿਨ ਕੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ; ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੋਈ ॥
228.e: Those whose hearts are filled with the Lord, Har, Har

228.g: ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਦਰਸੁ ਪਰਸਿ; ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥੪॥
228.e: - gazing upon the blessed vision of their darshan, peace is obtained. ||4||
Among all beings, the One Lord is pervading.
The eogtistical, self-willed manmukhs wander in reincarnation. ||5||
They alone understand, who have found the True Guru.
Subduing their ego, they receive the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||6||

228.g: ਅਰਧ ਉਰਧ ਕੀ ਸੰਧਿ; ਕਿਉ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
228.e: How can anyone know of the Union between the being below and the Supreme Being above?
The Gurmukhs obtain this Union; their minds are reconciliated. ||7||

228.g: ਹਮ ਪਾਪੀ ਨਿਰਗੁਣ ਕਉ; ਗੁਣੁ ਕਰੀਐ ॥
228.e: I am a worthless sinner, without merit. What merit do I have?

228.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਹੋਇ ਦਇਆਲੁ; ਨਾਨਕ ਜਨ ਤਰੀਐ ॥੮॥੧੬॥
228.e: When God showers His Mercy, servant Nanak is emancipated. ||8||16||
Sixteen Ashtpadheeyaa Of Gwaarayree Gauree||
Speech of Bharat addressed to Ram :
How is it that you lost all sense of shame ? That you have done such a bad deed; I shall go now where Ram has gone. '276.
Speech of Ram addressed to Bharat :
KANTH AABHUSHAN STANZA

228.g: ਜਾਹ ਘਰੈ, ਨ ਹਮੈ ਦੁਖ ਦੀਜੈ ॥
228.e: “O Bharat! do not be obstinate, go to your home, do not give me more anguish by staying here

228.g: ਰਾਜ ਕਹਯੋ ਜੁ, ਹਮੈ ਹਮ ਮਾਨੀ ॥

228.e: “Whatever permission has been given to me, I am acting according to that and accordingly I shall remain in the forest for thirteen years (and return in the fourteenth year).285.
“I shall return after thirteen years and sit on the throne under a canopy.
“Listen to my instruction and return home, your mothers must be weeping there.”286.

228.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਾਏ; ਹਮ. ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਭਾਰਿਆ ॥੭॥
228.e: I have found God - I am not searching for any other. ||7||
The Guru has shown me the unseen Mansion of the True Lord.
His Mansion is eternal and unchanging; it is not a mere reflection of Maya.
Through truth and contentment, doubt is dispelled. ||8||

228.g: ਜਿਨ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਈ ॥
228.e: That person, within whose mind the True Lord dwells
in his company, one becomes Gurmukh.
O Nanak, the True Name washes off the pollution. ||9||15||

229.e: Gauree, Third Mehl:
Selfless service is the support of the breath of life of the Gurmukh.

229.g: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ; ਰਾਖਹੁ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਾ ॥
229.e: Keep the Dear Lord enshrined in your heart.
The Gurmukh is honored in the Court of the True Lord. ||1||
O Pandit, O religious scholar, read about the Lord, and renounce your corrupt ways.
The Gurmukh crosses over the terrifying world-ocean. ||1||Pause||
Gauree, First Mehl:

229.g: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਬੂਝਿ ਲੇ; ਤਉ ਹੋਇ ਨਿਬੇਰਾ ॥
229.e: By Guru's Grace, one comes to understand, and then, the account is settled.

229.g: ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨਾ; ਸੋ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥੧॥
229.e: In each and every heart is the Name of the Immaculate Lord; He is my Lord and Master. ||1||

229.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰਸਬਦ. ਨ ਛੂਟੀਐ; ਦੇਖਹੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
229.e: Without the Word of the Guru's Shabad, no one is emancipated. See this, and reflect upon it.

229.g: ਜੇ ਲਖ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵਹੀ; ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ. ਅੰਧਿਆਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
229.e: Even though you may perform hundreds of thousands of rituals, without the Guru, there is only darkness. ||1||Pause||

229.g: ਅੰਧੇ ਅਕਲੀ ਬਾਹਰੇ; ਕਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਸਿਉ ਕਹੀਐ ॥
229.e: What can you say, to one who is blind and without wisdom?

229.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ. ਪੰਥੁ ਨ ਸੂਝਈ; ਕਿਤੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਨਿਰਬਹੀਐ ॥੨॥
229.e: Without the Guru, the Path cannot be seen. How can anyone proceed? ||2||

229.g: ਖੋਟੇ ਕਉ ਖਰਾ ਕਹੈ; ਖਰੇ. ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
229.e: He calls the counterfeit genuine, and does not know the value of the genuine.

229.g: ਅੰਧੇ ਕਾ ਨਾਉ ਪਾਰਖੂ; ਕਲੀ ਕਾਲ ਵਿਡਾਣੈ ॥੩॥
229.e: The blind man is known as an appraiser; this Dark Age of Kali Yuga is so strange! ||3||

229.g: ਸੂਤੇ ਕਉ ਜਾਗਤੁ ਕਹੈ; ਜਾਗਤ ਕਉ ਸੂਤਾ ॥
229.e: The sleeper is said to be awake, and those who are awake are like sleepers.

229.g: ਜੀਵਤ ਕਉ. ਮੂਆ ਕਹੈ; ਮੂਏ ਨਹੀ ਰੋਤਾ ॥੪॥
229.e: The living are said to be dead, and no one mourns for those who have died. ||4||

229.g: ਆਵਤ ਕਉ ਜਾਤਾ ਕਹੈ; ਜਾਤੇ ਕਉ ਆਇਆ ॥
229.e: One who is coming is said to be going, and one who is gone is said to have come.

229.g: ਪਰ ਕੀ ਕਉ. ਅਪੁਨੀ ਕਹੈ; ਅਪੁਨੋ ਨਹੀ ਭਾਇਆ ॥੫॥
229.e: That which belongs to others, he calls his own, but he has no liking for that which is his. ||5||

229.g: ਮੀਠੇ ਕਉ ਕਉੜਾ ਕਹੈ; ਕੜੂਏ ਕਉ ਮੀਠਾ ॥
229.e: That which is sweet is said to be bitter, and the bitter is said to be sweet.

229.g: ਰਾਤੇ ਕੀ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਕਰਹਿ; ਐਸਾ ਕਲਿ ਮਹਿ ਡੀਠਾ ॥੬॥
229.e: One who is imbued with the Lord's Love is slandered - this is what I have seen in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga. ||6||

229.g: ਚੇਰੀ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰਹਿ; ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਦੀਸੈ ॥
229.e: He serves the maid, and does not see his Lord and Master.

229.g: ਪੋਖਰੁ ਨੀਰੁ ਵਿਰੋਲੀਐ; ਮਾਖਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਰੀਸੈ ॥੭॥
229.e: Churning the water in the pond, no butter is produced. ||7||

229.g: ਇਸੁ ਪਦ ਜੋ ਅਰਥਾਇ ਲੇਇ; ਸੋ ਗੁਰੂ ਹਮਾਰਾ ॥
229.e: One who understands the meaning of this verse is my Guru.

229.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਚੀਨੈ ਆਪ ਕਉ; ਸੋ ਅਪਰ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥੮॥
229.e: O Nanak, one who knows his own self, is infinite and incomparable. ||8||

229.g: ਸਭੁ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਵਰਤਦਾ; ਆਪੇ ਭਰਮਾਇਆ ॥
229.e: He Himself is All-pervading; He Himself misleads the people.

229.g: ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਬੂਝੀਐ; ਸਭੁ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੯॥੨॥੧੮॥
229.e: By Guru's Grace, one comes to understand, that God is contained in all. ||9||2||18||
JHOOLANA STANZA

229.g: ਚੜੈ ਪਾਨ ਬਾਨੀ, ਧਰੇ ਸਾਨ ਮਾਨੋ; ਚਛਾ ਬਾਨ ਸੋਹੈ ਦੋਊ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਨੀ ॥
229.e: Ram looks glorious with the sharp arrows in his hands and Sita, the queen of Ram appears elegant with the beautiful arrows of her eyes.

229.g: ਫਿਰੈ ਖਿਆਲ ਸੋ ਏਕ ਹਵਾਲ ਸੇਤੀ; ਛੁਟੇ ਇੰਦ੍ਰ ਸੇਤੀ ਮਨੋ ਇੰਦ੍ਰ ਧਾਨੀ ॥
229.e: She roams with Ram, being absorbed into such thoughts as if having been ousted from his capital Indra was staggering hither and thither.

229.g: ਮਨੋ ਨਾਗ ਬਾਕੇ ਲਜੀ ਆਬ ਫਾਕੈ; ਰੰਗੇ ਰੰਗ ਸੁਹਾਬ ਸੌ ਰਾਮ ਬਾਰੇ ॥
229.e: The loose hair of her braids, causing shyness to the glory of nagas, are becoming a sacrifice to Ram.

229.g: ਮ੍ਰਿਗਾ ਦੇਖਿ ਮੋਹੇ ਲਖੇ ਮੀਨ ਰੋਹੇ; ਜਿਨੈ ਨੈਕ ਚੀਨੇ ਤਿਨੋ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਵਾਰੇ ॥੨੯੭॥
229.e: The deers looking at her are allured by her, the fishes looking at her beauty are feeling jealous of her  he, whoever had seen her, had sacrified himself for her.297.

229.g: ਸੁਨੇ ਕੂਕ ਕੇ ਕੋਕਲਾ ਕੋਪ ਕੀਨੇ; ਮੁਖੰ ਦੇਖ ਕੈ ਚੰਦ ਦਾਰੇਰ ਖਾਈ ॥
229.e: The nightingale, listening to her speech, is getting angry on account of jealousy and the moon looking at her face is feeling shy like women,
KANTH AABHUSHAN STANZA

229.g: ਜਾਉ ਕਹਾ, ਪਗ ਭੇਟ ਕਹਉ ਤੁਹ ॥
ਲਾਜ ਨ ਲਾਗਤ, ਰਾਮ, ਕਹੋ ਮੁਹ ॥
229.e: “O Ram! where should I go now after touching your feet? Shall I not be ashmed?

229.g: ਮੈ ਅਤਿ ਦੀਨ ਮਲੀਨ ਬਿਨਾ ਗਤ ॥

229.e: “I am extremely low, dirty and motionless. O Ram! manage your kingdom and glorify it with your ambrosial feet.”287.

229.g: ਤਿਉ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੀਰ ਗਿਰਯੋ ਪਗ ਭਰਥਰ ॥
229.e: Just as a bird become sightless fells down, in the same way Bharat fell down before Ram.

229.g: ਅੰਕ ਰਹੇ ਗਹ ਰਾਮ ਤਿਸੈ ਤਬ ॥

229.e: At the same time Ram hugged him to his bosom and there Lakshman and all the brother wept.288.
The brave Bharat was brought to his senses by giving water. Ram again said smilingly :
“After the elapse of thirteen years we shall return, now you go back because I have to fulfil some tasks in the forest.”289.

229.g: ਚੀਨ ਗਏ ਚਤੁਰਾ ਚਿਤ ਮੋ ਸਭ ॥
ਸ੍ਰੀ ਰਘੁਬੀਰ ਕਹੀ ਅਸ ਕੈ ਜਬ ॥
229.e: When Ram said this, then all the people understood its substance (that he had to kill the demons in the forest).

229.g: ਅਉਰ ਬਸੇ ਪੁਰ ਅਉਧ ਨ ਚੀਨੀ ॥੨੯੦॥
229.e: Submitting reverently to the instructions of Ram and with pleased mind Bharat took the sandals of Ram and forgetting the recognition of Ayodhya, he began to live out of its limits.290.

229.g: ਸੀਸ ਜਟਾਨ ਕੋ ਜੂਟ ਧਰੇ ਬਰ ॥

229.e: Wearing matted hair on his head he dedicated all the royal task to those sandals.
During the day he used to fulfil his royal duties with the support of those sandals and during the night he protected them.291.

229.g: ਜਜਰ ਭਯੋ ਝੁਰ ਝੰਝਰ ਜਿਉ ਤਨ ॥

229.e: The body of Bharat withered and become decrepit, but still he always kept the memory of Ram in his mind.
Alongwith this he destroyed the groups of enemies and instead of ornaments he wore rosaries as necklaces.292.
Raag Gauree Gwaarayree, Third Mehl, Ashtpadheeyaa:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
The pollution of the mind is the love of duality.
Deluded by doubt, people come and go in reincarnation. ||1||
The pollution of the self-willed manmukhs will never go away,

229.g: ਜਿਚਰੁ ਸਬਦਿ. ਨ ਭੀਜੈ; ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਨਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
229.e: as long as they do not dwell on the Shabad, and the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||
All the created beings are contaminated by emotional attachment;
they die and are reborn, only to die over and over again. ||2||
Fire, air and water are polluted.
The food which is eaten is polluted. ||3||
The actions of those who do not worship the Lord are polluted.
Attuned to the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the mind becomes immaculate. ||4||
Serving the True Guru, pollution is eradicated,

229.g: ਮਰੈ ਨ ਜਨਮੈ; ਕਾਲੁ ਨ ਖਾਇ ॥੫॥
229.e: and then, one does not suffer death and rebirth, or get devoured by death. ||5||
You may study and examine the Shaastras and the Simritees,

229.g: ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ; ਕੋ ਮੁਕਤਿ. ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥੬॥
229.e: but without the Name, no one is liberated. ||6||

229.g: ਜੁਗ ਚਾਰੇ; ਨਾਮੁ ਉਤਮੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
229.e: Throughout the four ages, the Naam is the ultimate; reflect upon the Word of the Shabad.
In this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, only the Gurmukhs cross over. ||7||
The True Lord does not die; He does not come or go.
O Nanak, the Gurmukh remains absorbed in the Lord. ||8||1||
JHOOLA STANZA
On this side the king ram is doing the duties of gods by killing the demons  he looks like a mighty hero by taking the bow in his hand.293.
Where there were the trees of saal in the forest alongwith other trees and tans etc. its glory seemed heaven-like and was destroyer of all sorrows.294.
Ram stayed at that spot and looked like a mighty warrior, Sita was with him who was like a divine song.295.
She was a lady of sweet speech and her eyes were like the queen of deer, she had a slim and she looked like a fairy, a Padmini (amongst women).296.

230.e: Gauree, Third Mehl:

230.g: ਇਸੁ ਜੁਗ ਕਾ ਧਰਮੁ; ਪੜਹੁ ਤੁਮ ਭਾਈ ॥
230.e: Learn the Dharma of this age, O Siblings of Destiny;
all understanding is obtained from the Perfect Guru.
Here and hereafter, the Lord's Name is our Companion. ||1||
Learn of the Lord, and contemplate Him in your mind.
By Guru's Grace, your filth shall be washed away. ||1||Pause||
Through argument and debate, He cannot be found.
The mind and body are made insipid through the love of duality.

230.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ; ਸਚਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੨॥
230.e: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, lovingly attune yourself to the True Lord. ||2||
This world is polluted with egotism.

230.g: ਨਿਤ ਤੀਰਥਿ ਨਾਵੈ; ਨ ਜਾਇ ਅਹੰਕਾਰਾ ॥
230.e: By taking cleansing baths daily at sacred shrines of pilgrimage, egotism is not eliminated.

230.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਭੇਟੇ; ਜਮੁ ਕਰੇ ਖੁਆਰਾ ॥੩॥
230.e: Without meeting the Guru, they are tortured by Death. ||3||

230.g: ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਸਾਚਾ; ਜਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰੈ ॥
230.e: Those humble beings are true, who conquer their ego.
Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, they conquer the five thieves.
They save themselves, and save all their generations as well. ||4||
The Actor has staged the drama of emotional attachment to Maya.
The self-willed manmukhs cling blindly to it.
The Gurmukhs remain detached, and lovingly attune themselves to the Lord. ||5||
The disguisers put on their various disguises.
Desire rages within them, and they carry on egotistically.
They do not understand themselves, and they lose the game of life. ||6||
Putting on religious robes, they act so clever,
but they are totally deluded by doubt and emotional attachment to Maya.

230.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ; ਬਹੁਤੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਈ ॥੭॥
230.e: Without serving the Guru, they suffer in terrible pain. ||7||
Those who are attuned to the Naam, the Name of the Lord, remain detached forever.
Even as householders, they lovingly attune themselves to the True Lord.
O Nanak, those who serve the True Guru are blessed and very fortunate. ||8||3||
The Gurmukh eradicates egotism from within.
No filth sticks to the Gurmukh.
The Naam, the Name of the Lord, comes to dwell within the mind of the Gurmukh. ||2||
Through karma and Dharma, good actions and righteous faith, the Gurmukh becomes true.
The Gurmukh burns away egotism and duality.
The Gurmukh is attuned to the Naam, and is at peace. ||3||
Instruct your own mind, and understand Him.
You may preach to other people, but no one will listen.
The Gurmukh understands, and is always at peace. ||4||
The self-willed manmukhs are such clever hypocrites.

230.g: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ; ਸੁ ਥਾਇ. ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
230.e: No matter what they do, it is not acceptable.
They come and go in reincarnation, and find no place of rest. ||5||
The manmukhs perform their rituals, but they are totally selfish and conceited.

230.g: ਬਗ ਜਿਉ; ਲਾਇ ਬਹੈ ਨਿਤ ਧਿਆਨਾ ॥
230.e: They sit there, like storks, pretending to meditate.
Caught by the Messenger of Death, they shall regret and repent in the end. ||6||

230.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ; ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
230.e: Without serving the True Guru, liberation is not obtained.
By Guru's Grace, one meets the Lord.
The Guru is the Great Giver, throughout the four ages. ||7||
For the Gurmukh, the Naam is social status, honor and glorious greatness.
Maya, the daughter of the ocean, has been slain.
O Nanak, without the Name, all clever tricks are false. ||8||2||

230.g: ਲਖੇ ਨੈਨ ਬਾਕੇ ਮਨੈ ਮੀਨ ਮੋਹੈ; ਲਖੇ ਜਾਤ ਕੇ ਸੂਰ ਕੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਛਾਈ ॥
230.e: The fish is allured by seeing her eyes and her beauty seems like the extension of sunlight.

230.g: ਮਨੋ ਫੂਲ ਫੂਲੇ ਲਗੇ ਨੈਨ ਝੂਲੇ, ਲਖੇ ਲੋਗ ਭੂਲੇ ਬਨੇ ਜੋਰ ਐਸੇ ॥
230.e: Seeing her eyes they appear like the blossomed lotus and all the people in the forest are extremely enchanted by her beauty.

230.g: ਲਖੇ ਨੈਨ ਥਾਰੇ ਬਿਧੇ ਰਾਮ ਪਿਆਰੇ; ਰੰਗੇ ਰੰਗ ਸਾਰਾਬ ਸੁਹਾਬ ਜੈਸੇ ॥੨੯੮॥
230.e: O Sita! seeing your intoxicated eyes Ram himself seems pierced by them.298.

230.g: ਰੰਗੇ ਰੰਗ ਰਾਤੇ ਮਯੰ ਮਤ ਮਾਤੇ ਮਕਬੂਲਿ ਗੁਲਾਬ ਕੇ ਫੂਲ ਸੋਹੈਂ ॥
230.e: Your eyes are intoxicated, having been dyed in your love and it seems that they are lovely roses.

230.g: ਨਰਗਸ ਨੇ ਦੇਖ ਕੈ ਨਾਕ ਐਂਠਾ; ਮ੍ਰਿਗੀਰਾਜ ਕੇ ਦੇਖਤੈਂ ਮਾਨ ਮੋਹੈਂ ॥
230.e: The narcissus flowers are expressing contempt with jealousy and the does on seeing her are feeling blow at their self-respect,

230.g: ਸਬੋ ਰੋਜ ਸਰਾਬ ਨੇ ਸੋਰ ਲਾਇਆ; ਪ੍ਰਜਾ ਆਮ ਜਾਹਾਨ ਕੇ ਪੇਖ ਵਾਰੇ ॥
230.e: The wine in spite of all its strength is not feeling itself equivalent to thhe ardent passion of Sita in the whole world,

230.g: ਭਵਾ ਤਾਨ ਕਮਾਨ ਕੀ ਭਾਤ ਪਿਆਰੀਨਿ ਕਮਾਨ ਹੀ ਨੈਨ ਕੇ ਬਾਨ ਮਾਰੇ ॥੨੯੯॥
230.e: Her eyebrows are lovely like the bow and from those eyebrows she is discharging the arrows of her eyes.299.
Gauree, Third Mehl:
Brahma is the founder of the study of the Vedas.

230.g: ਤਿਸ ਤੇ ਉਪਜੇ; ਦੇਵ ਮੋਹ ਪਿਆਸਾ ॥
230.e: From him emanated the gods, enticed by desire.

230.g: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਭਰਮੇ; ਨਾਹੀ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ॥੧॥
230.e: They wander in the three qualities, and they do not dwell within their own home. ||1||
The Lord has saved me; I have met the True Guru.

230.g: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਭਗਤਿ; ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
230.e: He has implanted devotional worship of the Lord's Name, night and day. ||1||Pause||
The songs of Brahma entangle people in the three qualities.

230.g: ਪੜਿ ਵਾਦੁ ਵਖਾਣਹਿ; ਸਿਰਿ ਮਾਰੇ ਜਮਕਾਲਾ ॥
230.e: Reading about the debates and disputes, they are hit over the head by the Messenger of Death.
APOORAV STANZA
Seeing the ignorant persons )Ram-Laksman) as good food, a demon named Viradh came forwards and in this way there came a calamitous situation in their peaceful lives.301.
Ram saw him and holding his wapons he went towards him  keeping control of their weapons both the warriors began their battle.302.
KABIT

230.g: ਊਚੇ ਦ੍ਰੁਮ ਸਾਲ ਜਹਾ, ਲਾਬੇ ਬਟ ਤਾਲ ਤਹਾ; ਐਸੀ ਠਉਰ ਤਪ ਕਉ ਪਧਾਰੈ ਐਸੋ ਕਉਨ ਹੈ ॥
230.e: Where there are high saal trees and Banyan trees and the large tanks, who is the person who performs austerities

230.g: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਛਬ ਦੇਖ ਦੁਤ ਖਾਡਵ ਕੀ ਫੀਕੀ ਲਾਗੈ; ਆਭਾ ਤਕੀ ਨੰਦਨ ਬਿਲੋਕ ਭਜੇ ਮੌਨ ਹੈ ॥
230.e: And seeing whose beauty, the beauty of Pandavas seems devoid of radiance and the forests of heaven feel it better to keep silent on observing his beauty?

230.g: ਤਾਰਨ ਕੀ ਕਹਾ ਨੈਕ, ਨਭ ਨ ਨਿਹਰਾਯੋ ਜਾਇ; ਸੂਰਜ ਕੀ ਜੋਤ ਤਹਾ ਚੰਦ੍ਰਕੀ ਨ ਜਉਨ ਹੈ ॥
230.e: There is so much dense shade there that not to speak of the stars, the sky is also not seen there, the light of the sun and moon does not reach there.

230.g: ਦੇਵ ਨ ਨਿਹਾਰਯੋ ਕੋਊ, ਦੈਤ ਨ ਬਿਹਾਰਯੋ ਤਹਾ; ਪੰਛੀ ਕੀ ਨ ਗੰਮ ਜਹਾ ਚੀਟੀ ਕੋ ਨ ਗਉਨ ਹੈ ॥੩੦੦॥
230.e: No god or demon lives and the birds and even an ant has no access there.300.

231.g: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
231.e: Gauree, Third Mehl:

231.g: ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਵੇਦੁ ਪੜੈ; ਵਾਦੁ ਵਖਾਣੈ ॥
231.e: Brahma studied the Vedas, but these lead only to debates and disputes.

231.g: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਤਾਮਸੁ; ਆਪੁ. ਨ ਪਛਾਣੈ ॥
231.e: He is filled with darkness; he does not understand himself.

231.g: ਤਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਏ; ਗੁਰਸਬਦੁ ਵਖਾਣੈ ॥੧॥
231.e: And yet, if he chants the Word of the Guru's Shabad, he finds God. ||1||

231.g: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰਉ; ਫਿਰਿ. ਕਾਲੁ ਨ ਖਾਇ ॥
231.e: So serve the Guru, and you shall not be consumed by death.

231.g: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਖਾਧੇ; ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
231.e: The self-willed manmukhs have been consumed by the love of duality. ||1||Pause||

231.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ; ਅਪਰਾਧੀ ਸੀਧੇ ॥
231.e: Becoming Gurmukh, the sinful mortals are purified.

231.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ; ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਰੀਧੇ ॥
231.e: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, they find intuitive peace and poise deep within.

231.g: ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੀਧੇ ॥੨॥
231.e: I have found my God, through the Guru's Shabad, and I have been reformed. ||2||

231.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮੇਲੇ; ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
231.e: God Himself unites us in Union with the True Guru,

231.g: ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਾਚੇ ਕੈ; ਮਨਿ ਭਾਏ ॥
231.e: when we become pleasing to the Mind of my True God.

231.g: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹਿ; ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਏ ॥੩॥
231.e: They sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, in the poise of celestial peace. ||3||

231.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਾਚੇ; ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਏ ॥
231.e: Without the True Guru, they are deluded by doubt.

231.g: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਅੰਧੇ; ਸਦਾ ਬਿਖੁ ਖਾਏ ॥
231.e: The blind, self-willed manmukhs constantly eat poison.

231.g: ਜਮ ਡੰਡੁ ਸਹਹਿ; ਸਦਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ॥੪॥
231.e: They are beaten by the Messenger of Death with his rod, and they suffer in constant pain. ||4||

231.g: ਜਮੂਆ. ਨ ਜੋਹੈ; ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥
231.e: The Messenger of Death does not catch sight of those who enter the Sanctuary of the Lord.

231.g: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ; ਸਚਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥
231.e: Subduing egotism, they lovingly center their consciousness on the True Lord.

231.g: ਸਦਾ ਰਹੈ; ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥੫॥
231.e: They keep their consciousness constantly focused on the Lord's Name. ||5||

231.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਹਿ; ਸੇ ਜਨ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਪਵਿਤਾ ॥
231.e: Those humble beings who serve the True Guru are pure and immaculate.

231.g: ਮਨ ਸਿਉ ਮਨੁ ਮਿਲਾਇ; ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਜੀਤਾ ॥
231.e: Merging their minds into the Mind, they conquer the entire world.

231.g: ਇਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਕੁਸਲੁ ਤੇਰੈ; ਮੇਰੇ ਮੀਤਾ ॥੬॥
231.e: In this way, you too shall find happiness, O my friend. ||6||

231.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਸੇਵੇ; ਸੋ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
231.e: Those who serve the True Guru are blessed with fruitful rewards.

231.g: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਨਾਮੁ; ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਏ ॥
231.e: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, abides in their hearts; selfishness and conceit depart from within them.
