231.g: ਅਨਹਦ ਬਾਣੀ; ਸਬਦੁ ਵਜਾਏ ॥੭॥
231.e: The unstruck melody of the Shabad vibrates for them. ||7||

231.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ; ਕਵਨੁ ਕਵਨੁ. ਨ ਸੀਧੋ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥
231.e: Who - who has not been purified by the True Guru, O my Siblings of Destiny?

231.g: ਭਗਤੀ ਸੀਧੇ; ਦਰਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਈ ॥
231.e: The devotees are purified, and honored in His Court.

231.g: ਨਾਨਕ; ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੮॥੫॥
231.e: O Nanak, greatness is in the Lord's Name. ||8||5||

231.g: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
231.e: Gauree, Third Mehl:

231.g: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਵਖਾਣੈ; ਭਰਮੁ. ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
231.e: Those who speak of the three qualities - their doubts do not depart.

231.g: ਬੰਧਨ. ਨ ਤੂਟਹਿ; ਮੁਕਤਿ. ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
231.e: Their bonds are not broken, and they do not obtain liberation.

231.g: ਮੁਕਤਿ ਦਾਤਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ; ਜੁਗ ਮਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
231.e: The True Guru is the Bestower of liberation in this age. ||1||

231.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ; ਭਰਮੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
231.e: Those mortals who become Gurmukh give up their doubts.

231.g: ਸਹਜ ਧੁਨਿ ਉਪਜੈ; ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
231.e: The celestial music wells up, when they lovingly attune their consciousness to the Lord. ||1||Pause||

231.g: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ; ਕਾਲੈ ਕੀ ਸਿਰਿ ਕਾਰਾ ॥
231.e: Those who are controlled by the three qualities have death hovering over their heads.

231.g: ਤਤੁ ਨ ਚੀਨਹਿ; ਬੰਨਹਿ ਪੰਡ ਪਰਾਲਾ ॥੨॥
231.e: They do not understand the essence of reality, and they gather their worthless bundles of straw. ||2||

231.g: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਅਗਿਆਨਿ; ਕੁਮਾਰਗਿ ਪਾਏ ॥
231.e: The self-willed manmukhs, in ignorance, take the path of evil.

231.g: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਬਿਸਾਰਿਆ; ਬਹੁ ਕਰਮ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਏ ॥
231.e: They forget the Lord's Name, and in its place, they establish all sorts of rituals.

231.g: ਭਵਜਲਿ ਡੂਬੇ; ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਏ ॥੩॥
231.e: They drown in the terrifying world-ocean, in the love of duality. ||3||

231.g: ਮਾਇਆ ਕਾ ਮੁਹਤਾਜੁ; ਪੰਡਿਤੁ ਕਹਾਵੈ ॥
231.e: Driven crazy, infatuated by Maya, they call themselves Pandits - religious scholars;

231.g: ਬਿਖਿਆ ਰਾਤਾ; ਬਹੁਤੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
231.e: stained with corruption, they suffer terrible pain.

231.g: ਜਮ ਕਾ ਗਲਿ ਜੇਵੜਾ; ਨਿਤ ਕਾਲੁ ਸੰਤਾਵੈ ॥੪॥
231.e: The noose of the Messenger of Death is around their necks; they are constantly tormented by death. ||4||

231.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ; ਜਮਕਾਲੁ. ਨੇੜਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
231.e: The Messenger of Death does not even approach the Gurmukhs.

231.g: ਹਉਮੈ ਦੂਜਾ; ਸਬਦਿ ਜਲਾਵੈ ॥
231.e: Through the Word of the Shabad, they burn away their ego and duality.

231.g: ਨਾਮੇ ਰਾਤੇ; ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ॥੫॥
231.e: Attuned to the Name, they sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||5||

231.g: ਮਾਇਆ ਦਾਸੀ; ਭਗਤਾ ਕੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵੈ ॥
231.e: Maya is the slave of the Lord's devotees; it works for them.

231.g: ਚਰਣੀ ਲਾਗੈ; ਤਾ ਮਹਲੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
231.e: One who falls at their feet attains the Mansion of the Lord's Presence.

231.g: ਸਦ ਹੀ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ; ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥੬॥
231.e: He is forever immaculate; he is absorbed in intuitive peace. ||6||

231.g: ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਸੁਣਹਿ; ਸੇ ਧਨਵੰਤ ਦਿਸਹਿ ਜੁਗ ਮਾਹੀ ॥
231.e: Those who listen to the Lord's Sermon are seen to be the wealthy people in this world.

231.g: ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਸਭਿ ਨਿਵਹਿ; ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਪੂਜ ਕਰਾਹੀ ॥
231.e: Everyone bows down to them, and adores them, night and day.

231.g: ਸਹਜੇ ਗੁਣ ਰਵਹਿ ਸਾਚੇ; ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ ॥੭॥
231.e: They intuitively savor the Glories of the True Lord within their minds. ||7||

231.g: ਪੂਰੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ; ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਣਾਇਆ ॥
231.e: The Perfect True Guru has revealed the Shabad;

231.g: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਮੇਟੇ; ਚਉਥੈ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
231.e: it eradicates the three qualities, and attunes the consciousness to the fourth state.

231.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ; ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥੮॥੪॥
231.e: O Nanak, subduing egotism, one is absorbed into God. ||8||4||

231.g: ਅਛਰੋ ਉਛਾਹ ॥੩੦੩॥
231.e: The vultures shirked and the warriors faced each other. They were bedecked nicely and there was unending zeal in them.303.

231.g: ਪਖਰੇ ਪਵੰਗ ॥
ਮੋਹਲੇ ਮਤੰਗ ॥
ਚਾਵਡੀ ਚਿੰਕਾਰ ॥
ਉਝਰੇ ਲੁਝਾਰ ॥੩੦੪॥
231.e: There were horses and intoxicated elephants bedecked with armours. The shrieks of the vultures were heard and the warriors were seen entangled with each other.304.

231.g: ਸਿੰਧਰੇ ਸੰਧੂਰ ॥
ਬਜਏ ਤੰਦੂਰ ॥
ਸਜੀਏ ਸੁਬਾਹ ॥
ਅਛਰੋ ਉਛਾਹ ॥੩੦੫॥
231.e: The elephants serene like sea were there and the trumpets were resounding, the long-armed warriors with unparalleled enthusiasm looked impressive.305.

231.g: ਬਿਝੁੜੇ ਉਝਾੜ ॥
ਸੰਮਲੇ ਸੁਮਾਰ ॥
231.e: The warriors who never fell began to fall and also regain their control

231.g: ਹਾਹਲੇ ਹੰਕਾਰ ॥
ਅੰਕੜੇ ਅੰਗਾਰ ॥੩੦੬॥
231.e: There were egoistic attacks from all the four sides and the warriors blazed like embers.306.

231.g: ਸੰਮਲੇ ਲੁਝਾਰ ॥
ਛੁਟਕੇ ਬਿਸਿਯਾਰ ॥
ਹਾਹਲੇਹੰ ਬੀਰ ॥
ਸੰਘਰੇ ਸੁ ਬੀਰ ॥੩੦੭॥
231.e: The warriors were keeping their control and the weapons began to slip away from their hands like serpents.307.

231.g: ਅਨੂਪ ਨਰਾਜ ਛੰਦ ॥
231.e: ANOOP NARAAJ STANZA

231.g: ਗਜੰ ਗਜੇ ਹਯੰ ਹਲੇ; ਹਲਾ ਹਲੀ ਹਲੋ ਹਲੰ ॥
ਬਬਜ ਸਿੰਧਰੇ ਸੁਰੰ ਛੁਟੰਤ ਬਾਣ ਕੇਵਲੰ ॥
231.e: The horses began to move and elephant roared, there was confusion on all the four-sides, the musical instruments resounded and the harmonious sound of the discharge of arrows was heard

231.g: ਪਪਕ ਪਖਰੇ ਤੁਰੇ ਭਭਖ ਘਾਇ ਨਿਰਮਲੰ ॥
ਪਲੁਥ ਲੁਥ ਬਿਥਰੀ ਅਮਥ ਜੁਥ ਉਥਲੰ ॥੩੦੮॥
231.e: The horses vied with one another in speed and the pure blood gushed out of the wounds. In the turmoil of the war, the corpses rolling in dust, scattered hither and thither.308.

231.g: ਅਜੁਥ ਲੁਥ ਬਿਥਰੀ ਮਿਲੰਤ ਹਥ ਬਖਯੰ ॥
ਅਘੁਮ ਘਾਇ ਘੁਮ ਏ ਬਬਕ ਬੀਰ ਦੁਧਰੰ ॥
231.e: Because of the blows of the sword being stuck on the waists, the corpses were scattered and the warriors, turning with difficulty, began to strike bows with double-edged dagger.

231.g: ਕਿਲੰ ਕਰੰਤ ਖਪਰੀ ਪਿਪੰਤ ਸ੍ਰੋਣ ਪਾਣਯੰ ॥
231.e: The Yoginis while shrieking, and taking the blood in their hands began to drink it

231.g: ਹਹਕ ਭੈਰਵੰ ਸ੍ਰੁਤੰ ਉਠੰਤ ਜੁਧ ਜ੍ਵਾਲਯੰ ॥੩੦੯॥
231.e: The Bhairvas roamed themselves in the field and the fires of war blazed.309.

231.g: ਫਿਕੰਤ ਫਿੰਕਤੀ ਫਿਰੰ ਰੜੰਤ ਗਿਧ ਬ੍ਰਿਧਣੰ ॥
231.e: The jackals and big vultures roamed in the battlefield hither and thither

231.g: ਡਹਕ ਡਾਮਰੀ ਉਠੰ ਬਕਾਰ ਬੀਰ ਬੈਤਲੰ ॥
231.e: The vampires bellowed and the Baitals (ghosts) raised their shrill voice.

231.g: ਖਹਤ ਖਗ ਖਤ੍ਰੀਯੰ ਖਿਮੰਤ ਧਾਰ ਉਜਲੰ ॥
ਘਣੰਕ ਜਾਣ ਸਾਵਲੰ ਲਸੰਤ ਬੇਗ ਬਿਜੁਲੰ ॥੩੧੦॥
231.e: The white-edged dagger in the hands of the Kshatriyas (Ram and Lakshman) was well-placed in their hands like the lightning in the dark clouds.310.

231.g: ਪਿਪੰਤ ਸ੍ਰੋਣ ਖਪਰੀ ਭਖੰਤ ਮਾਸ ਚਾਵਡੰ ॥
ਹਕਾਰ ਵੀਰ ਸੰਭਿੜੈ ਲੁਝਾਰ ਧਾਰ ਦੁਧਰੰ ॥
231.e: The Yoginis with the bowls were drinking blood and the kites were eating flesh, the warriors keeping control of their double-edged spears were fighting, while shouting at their companions.

231.g: ਪੁਕਾਰ ਮਾਰ ਕੈ ਪਰੇ; ਸਹੰਤ ਅੰਗ ਭਾਰਯੰ ॥
ਬਿਹਾਰ ਦੇਵ ਮੰਡਲੰ ਕਟੰਤ ਖਗ ਧਾਰਯੰ ॥੩੧੧॥
231.e: They were shouting “kill, kill” and bearing the burden of their weapons, some warriors were there in the cities of gods (i.e. they had died) and some are chopping other warriors.311.

231.g: ਪ੍ਰਚਾਰ ਵਾਰ ਪੈਜ ਕੈ; ਖੁਮਾਰਿ ਘਾਇ ਘੂਮਹੀ ॥
ਤਪੀ ਮਨੋ ਅਧੋ ਮੁਖੰ; ਸੁ ਧੂਮ ਆਗ ਧੂਮ ਹੀ ॥
231.e: The warriors, hurling their blows, were roaming in intoxication like the ascetics performing austerities and swinging with their faces bent downward over the smoke

231.g: ਤੁਟੰਤ ਅੰਗ ਭੰਗਯੰ; ਬਹੰਤ ਅਸਤ੍ਰ ਧਾਰਯੰ ॥
ਉਠੰਤ ਛਿਛ ਇਛਯੰ ਪਿਪੰਤ ਮਾਸ ਹਾਰਯੰ ॥੩੧੨॥
231.e: There is flow of arms and the broken limbs were falling down, the waves of the desire of victory are rising and the chopped flesh is falling.312.

231.g: ਅਘੋਰ ਘਾਇ ਅਘਏ ਕਟੇ ਪਰੇ ਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਾਸਨੰ ॥
ਘੁਮੰਤ ਜਾਣ ਰਾਵਲੰ ਲਗੇ ਸੁ ਸਿਧ ਆਸਣੰ ॥
231.e: The Aghori (Sadhus) seem pleased in eating the chopped limbs and the Siddhas and Rawalpanthis, the devourers of flesh and blood have taken seats with postures

231.g: ਪਰੰਤ ਅੰਗ ਭੰਗ ਹੁਇ; ਬਕੰਤ ਮਾਰ ਮਾਰਯੰ ॥
ਬਦੰਤ ਜਾਣ ਬੰਦੀਯੰ; ਸੁਕ੍ਰਿਤ ਕ੍ਰਿਤ ਅਪਾਰਯੰ ॥੩੧੩॥
231.e: Shouting “kill, kill” the warriors are falling with broken limbs and because of their bravery, they are being greeted.313.

231.g: ਬਜੰਤ ਤਾਲ ਤੰਬੂਰੰ; ਬਿਸੇਖ ਬੀਨ ਬੇਣਯੰ ॥
ਮ੍ਰਿਦੰਗ ਝਾਲਨਾ ਫਿਰੰ; ਸਨਾਇ ਭੇਰ ਭੈ ਕਰੰ ॥
231.e: The special sound obstructing the blows on the shields is being heard, the mixed sound of the harp, flute, drum, kettle-drum etc. is creating a dreadful atmosphere.

231.g: ਉਠੰਤ ਨਾਦਿ ਨਿਰਮਲੰ ਤੁਟੰਤ ਤਾਲ ਤਥਿਯੰ ॥
ਬਦੰਤ ਕਿਤ ਬੰਦੀਅੰ ਕਬਿੰਦ੍ਰ ਕਾਬਯ ਕਥਿਯੰ ॥੩੧੪॥
231.e: The beautiful sounds also rearing the tunes of the blows of different kinds of weapons are arising in the battlefield, somewhere the servitors are busy in prayers and somewhere the poets are reciting their compositions.314.

231.g: ਢਲੰਤ ਢਾਲ ਮਾਲਯੰ ਖਹੰਤ ਖਗ ਖੇਤਯੰ ॥
ਚਲੰਤ ਬਾਣ ਤੀਛਣੰ; ਅਨੰਤ ਅੰਤ ਕੰਕਯੰ ॥
231.e: The sound of obstructing the shields and the sound of the striking swords are being heard and the sharp arrows destroying innumerable people are being discharged

232.e: They do not remember the Name of the Creator Lord.
They die, and are reborn, over and over, again and again. ||2||

232.g: ਅੰਧੇ ਗੁਰੂ ਤੇ; ਭਰਮੁ. ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
232.e: Those whose guru is spiritually blind - their doubts are not dispelled.
Abandoning the Source of all, they have become attached to the love of duality.

232.g: ਬਿਖੁ ਕਾ ਮਾਤਾ; ਬਿਖੁ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੩॥
232.e: Infected with poison, they are immersed in poison. ||3||
Believing Maya to be the source of all, they wander in doubt.
They have forgotten the Dear Lord, and they are in love with duality.

232.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ; ਸੋ ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਏ ॥੪॥
232.e: The supreme status is obtained only by those who are blessed with His Glance of Grace. ||4||
One who has Truth pervading within, radiates Truth outwardly as well.

232.g: ਸਾਚੁ. ਨ ਛਪੈ; ਜੇ ਕੋ ਰਖੈ ਛਪਾਏ ॥
232.e: The Truth does not remain hidden, even though one may try to hide it.
The spiritually wise know this intuitively. ||5||
The Gurmukhs keep their consciousness lovingly centered on the Lord.
Ego and Maya are burned away by the Word of the Shabad.
My True God unites them in His Union. ||6||
The True Guru, The Giver, preaches the Shabad.
He controls, and restrains, and holds still the wandering mind.
Understanding is obtained through the Perfect Guru. ||7||

232.g: ਆਪੇ ਕਰਤਾ; ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸਿਰਜਿ ਜਿਨਿ ਗੋਈ ॥
232.e: The Creator Himself has created the universe; He Himself shall destroy it.

232.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੂਜਾ; ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
232.e: Without Him, there is no other at all.
O Nanak, how rare are those who, as Gurmukh, understand this! ||8||6||
Gauree, Third Mehl:

232.g: ਮਨ ਹੀ ਮਨੁ ਸਵਾਰਿਆ; ਭੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
232.e: The mind has intuitively healed itself, through the Fear of God.
SUKHDA STANZA
The king Ram went to the went to the hermitage of the sage Agastya and Sita was with him, who is the abode of Dharma.324.
Seeing the great hero Ram, the sage advised him to kill all the enemies and remove the anguish of all the people.325.
In this way giving his blessing, the sage recognizing the beauty and power of Ram dexterously in his mind, bade him farewell.326.
Now begins the description regarding entry in the forest :
DOHRA

232.g: ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਮਾਰ ਬਿਰਾਧ ਕਉ; ਬਨ ਮੇ ਧਸੇ ਨਿਸੰਗ ॥
232.e: In this way killing Viradh, Ram and Lakshman penetrated further into the forest.

232.g: ਸੁ ਕਬਿ ਸਯਾਮ ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਕਹਿਯੋ ਰਘੁਬਰ ਜੁਧ ਪ੍ਰਸੰਗ ॥੩੨੩॥
232.e: The poet Shyam has described this incident in the above-mentioned way.323.

232.g: ਸਿਮਟਿ ਸਾਗ ਸੁੰਕੜੰ ਸਟਕ ਸੂਲ ਸੇਲਯੰ ॥
ਰੁਲੰਤ ਰੁੰਡ ਮੁੰਡਯੰ ਝਲੰਤ ਝਾਲ ਅਝਲੰ ॥੩੧੫॥
232.e: The daggers and spears are producing rustling sound and the chopped dead heads, having rolled in dust, are scattered here and there.315.

232.g: ਬਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਚਿਤ੍ਰਤੰ ਸਰੰ ਬਹੰਤ ਦਾਰੁਣੰ ਰਣੰ ॥
ਢਲੰਤ ਢਾਲ ਅਢਲੰ ਢੁਲੰਤ ਚਾਰੁ ਚਾਮਰੰ ॥
232.e: The peculiar types of arrows, drawing pictures are being discharged in the battlefield and the knocking of the spears in the battlefield and the knocking of the spears in the shields is being heard.

232.g: ਦਲੰਤ ਨਿਰਦਲੋ ਦਲੰ; ਪਪਾਤ ਭੂਤਲੰ ਦਿਤੰ ॥
ਉਠੰਤ ਗਦਿ ਸਦਯੰ ਨਿਨਦਿ ਨਦਿ ਦੁਭਰੰ ॥੩੧੬॥
232.e: The armies are being mashed and the earth is getting hot (because of the hot blood), the dreadful sound is being heard continuously form all four sides.316.

232.g: ਭਰੰਤ ਪਤ੍ਰ ਚਉਸਠੀ ਕਿਲੰਕ ਖੇਚਰੀ ਕਰੰ ॥
ਫਿਰੰਤ ਹੂਰ ਪੂਰਯੰ ਬਰੰਤ ਦੁਧਰੰ ਨਰੰ ॥
232.e: Sixty-four Yoginis, shouting loudly, are filling their pots with colour and the heavenly damsels are moving on the earth in order to wed the great horses

232.g: ਸਨਧ ਬਧ ਗੋਧਯੰ ਸੁ ਸੋਭ ਅੰਗੁਲੰ ਤ੍ਰਿਣੰ ॥
ਡਕੰਤ ਡਾਕਣੀ ਭ੍ਰਮੰ; ਭਖੰਤ ਆਮਿਖੰ ਰਣੰ ॥੩੧੭॥
232.e: The heroes, bedecking themselves are wearing armours on their hands and the vampires are roaring in the battlefield, eating flesh and bellowing.317.

232.g: ਕਿਲੰਕ ਦੇਵੀਯੰ ਕਰੰਡ ਹਕ ਡਾਮਰੂ ਸੁਰੰ ॥
ਕੜਕ ਕਤੀਯੰ ਉਠੰ ਪਰੰਤ ਧੂਰ ਪਖਰੰ ॥
232.e: The loud voice of the goddess Kali, who drinks blood, and the sound of tabor are being heard, the dreadful laughter is being heard in the battlefield and the dust settled on armours is also being seen

232.g: ਬਬਜਿ ਸਿੰਧਰੇ ਸੁਰੰ ਨ੍ਰਿਘਾਤ ਸੂਲ ਸੈਹਥੀਯੰ ॥
ਭਭਜਿ ਕਾਤਰੋ ਰਣੰ ਨਿਲਜ ਭਜ ਭੂ ਭਰੰ ॥੩੧੮॥
232.e: The elephants and horses are creating noise on being struck with the blows of sword and abandoning their shyness and being helpless, they are running away from the war.318.

232.g: ਸੁ ਸਸਤ੍ਰ ਅਸਤ੍ਰ ਸੰਨਿਧੰ ਜੁਝੰਤ ਜੋਧਣੋ ਜੁਧੰ ॥
ਅਰੁਝ ਪੰਕ ਲਜਣੰ ਕਰੰਤ ਦ੍ਰੋਹ ਕੇਵਲੰ ॥
232.e: Having been bedecked with arms and weapons the warriors are busy in war and not being stuck in the mud of shyness they are waging war

232.g: ਪਰੰਤ ਅੰਗ ਭੰਗ ਹੁਐ; ਉਠੰਤ ਮਾਸ ਕਰਦਮੰ ॥
ਖਿਲੰਤ ਜਾਣੁ ਕਦਵੰ ਸੁ ਮਝ ਕਾਨ੍ਰਹ ਗੋਪਿਕੰ ॥੩੧੯॥
232.e: Being filled with ire, the limbs and the bits of flesh of the warriors are falling on the earth like Krishna playing amongst Gopis by throwing up the ball from this to that side.319.

232.g: ਡਹਕ ਡਉਰ ਡਾਕਣੰ ਝਲੰਤ ਝਾਲ ਰੋਸੁਰੰ ॥
ਨਿਨਦ ਨਾਦ ਨਾਫਿਰੰ ਬਜੰਤ ਭੇਰਿ ਭੀਖਣੰ ॥
232.e: The tabors and famous gestures of the vampires are being seen and the dreadful sound of drums and fifes is being heard.

232.g: ਘੁਰੰਤ ਘੋਰ ਦੁੰਦਭੀ; ਕਰੰਤ ਕਾਨਰੇ ਸੁਰੰ ॥
ਕਰੰਤ ਝਾਝਰੋ ਝੜੰ; ਬਜੰਤ ਬਾਸੁਰੀ ਬਰੰ ॥੩੨੦॥
232.e: The terrible sound of big drums is being heard in the ears. The jingling of anklets and the sweet voice of flutes are also being heard in the battlefield.320.

232.g: ਨਚੰਤ ਬਾਜ ਤੀਛਣੰ; ਚਲੰਤ ਚਾਚਰੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਤੰ ॥
ਲਿਖੰਤ ਲੀਕ ਉਰਬੀਅੰ; ਸੁਭੰਤ ਕੁੰਡਲੀ ਕਰੰ ॥
232.e: The swift horses are dancing and moving swiftly and with their gait they are creating coiled marks on the earth.

232.g: ਉਡੰਤ ਧੂਰ ਭੂਰਿਯੰ; ਖੁਰੀਨ ਨਿਰਦਲੀ ਨਭੰ ॥
ਪਰੰਤ ਭੂਰ ਭਉਰਣੰ; ਸੁ ਭਉਰ ਠਉਰ ਜਿਉ ਜਲੰ ॥੩੨੧॥
232.e: Because of the sound of their hoofs, the dust is rising upto the sky and seems like the whirlpool in water.321.

232.g: ਭਜੰਤ ਧੀਰ ਬੀਰਣੰ; ਚਲੰਤ ਮਾਨ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਲੈ ॥
ਦਲੰਤ ਪੰਤ ਦੰਤੀਯੰ; ਭਜੰਤ ਹਾਰ ਮਾਨ ਕੈ ॥
232.e: The enduring warriors are fleeing with their honour and life-breath and the lines of the elephants have been destroyed

232.g: ਮਿਲੰਤ ਦਾਤ ਘਾਸ ਲੈ ਰਰਛ ਸਬਦ ਉਚਰੰ ॥
ਬਿਰਾਧ ਦਾਨਵੰ ਜੁਝਯੋ ਸੁ ਹਥਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਿਰਮਲੰ ॥੩੨੨॥
232.e: The demons inimical to Ram, taking the blades of grass in their teeth, have uttered the words “Protect us” and in this way the demons named Viradh has been killed.322.

232.g: ਇਤਿ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਬਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਨਾਟਕੇ ਰਾਮਵਤਾਰ ਕਥਾ ਬਿਰਾਧ ਦਾਨਵ ਬਧਹ ॥
232.e: End of the description of killing of the demon VIRADH in Ramavtar in BACHITTAR NATAK.
Gauree, Third Mehl:
The Gurmukhs obtain the Naam, the Priceless Name of the Lord.
They serve the Name, and through the Name, they are absorbed in intuitive peace and poise.
With their tongues, they continually sing the Ambrosial Naam.

232.g: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ; ਸੋ. ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
232.e: They obtain the Lord's Name; the Lord showers His Mercy upon them. ||1||
Night and day, within your heart, meditate on the Lord of the Universe.

232.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਵਉ; ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਸੂਖਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
232.e: The Gurmukhs obtain the supreme state of peace. ||1||Pause||
Peace comes to fill the hearts of those
who, as Gurmukh, sing of the True Lord, the treasure of excellence.
They become the constant slaves of the slaves of the Lord's slaves.
Within their households and families, they remain always detached. ||2||
How rare are those who, as Gurmukh, become Jivan Mukta - liberated while yet alive.
They alone obtain the supreme treasure.
Eradicating the three qualities, they become pure.
They are intuitively absorbed in the True Lord God. ||3||

232.g: ਮੋਹ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਸਿਉ; ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
232.e: Emotional attachment to family does not exist,
when the True Lord abides within the heart.
The mind of the Gurmukh is pierced through and held steady.
One who recognizes the Hukam of the Lord's Command understands the True Lord. ||4||

232.g: ਤੂੰ ਕਰਤਾ; ਮੈ. ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
232.e: You are the Creator Lord - there is no other for me.

232.g: ਤੁਝੁ ਸੇਵੀ; ਤੁਝ ਤੇ ਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
232.e: I serve You, and through You, I obtain honor.
God showers His Mercy, and I sing His Praises.

232.g: ਨਾਮ ਰਤਨੁ; ਸਭ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਲੋਇ ॥੫॥
232.e: The light of the jewel of the Naam permeates the entire world. ||5||
To the Gurmukhs, the Word of God's Bani seems so sweet.
Deep within, their hearts blossom forth; night and day, they lovingly center themselves on the Lord.
The True Lord is intuitively obtained, by His Grace.
The True Guru is obtained by the destiny of perfect good fortune. ||6||
Egotism, possessiveness, evil-mindedness and suffering depart,
when the Lord's Name, the Ocean of Virtue, comes to dwell within the heart.
The intellect of the Gurmukhs is awakened, and they praise God,
when the Lord's Lotus Feet come to dwell within the heart. ||7||

232.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਇ; ਸੋਈ ਜਨੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
232.e: They alone receive the Naam, unto whom it is given.
The Gurmukhs shed their ego, and merge with the Lord.
The True Name abides within their hearts.
O Nanak, they are intuitively absorbed in the True Lord. ||8||7||

233.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
Raag Gauree Bairaagan, Third Mehl:

233.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ. ਜੋ ਮੁਹ ਫੇਰੇ; ਤੇ ਵੇਮੁਖ. ਬੁਰੇ ਦਿਸੰਨਿ ॥
233.e: Those who turn their faces away from the True Guru, are seen to be unfaithful and evil.

233.g: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਬਧੇ ਮਾਰੀਅਨਿ; ਫਿਰਿ. ਵੇਲਾ ਨਾ ਲਹੰਨਿ ॥੧॥
233.e: They shall be bound and beaten night and day; they shall not have this opportunity again. ||1||
O Lord, please shower Your Mercy upon me, and save me!

233.g: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮੇਲਾਇ ਪ੍ਰਭ; ਹਰਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
233.e: O Lord God, please lead me to meet the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, that I may dwell upon the Glorious Praises of the Lord within my heart. ||1||Pause||

233.g: ਸੇ ਭਗਤ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਵਦੇ; ਜੋ. ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭਾਇ ਚਲੰਨਿ ॥
233.e: Those devotees are pleasing to the Lord, who as Gurmukh, walk in harmony with the Way of the Lord's Will.

233.g: ਆਪੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰਨਿ; ਜੀਵਤ ਮੁਏ ਰਹੰਨਿ ॥੨॥
233.e: Subduing their selfishness and conceit, and performing selfless service, they remain dead while yet alive. ||2||

233.g: ਜਿਸ ਦਾ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਪਰਾਣ ਹੈ; ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਸਿਰਿ ਕਾਰ ॥
233.e: The body and the breath of life belong to the One - perform the greatest service to Him.

233.g: ਓਹੁ ਕਿਉ. ਮਨਹੁ ਵਿਸਾਰੀਐ; ਹਰਿ ਰਖੀਐ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਧਾਰਿ ॥੩॥
233.e: Why forget Him from your mind? Keep the Lord enshrined in your heart. ||3||

233.g: ਨਾਮਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ. ਪਤਿ ਪਾਈਐ; ਨਾਮਿ ਮੰਨਿਐ. ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
233.e: Receiving the Naam, the Name of the Lord, one obtains honor; believing in the Naam, one is at peace.

233.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ. ਨਾਮੁ ਪਾਈਐ; ਕਰਮਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਇ ॥੪॥
233.e: The Naam is obtained from the True Guru; by His Grace, God is found. ||4||

233.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ, ਜੋ ਮੁਹੁ ਫੇਰੇ; ਓਇ ਭ੍ਰਮਦੇ. ਨਾ ਟਿਕੰਨਿ ॥
233.e: They turn their faces away from the True Guru; they continue to wander aimlessly.

233.g: ਧਰਤਿ ਅਸਮਾਨੁ. ਨ ਝਲਈ; ਵਿਚਿ ਵਿਸਟਾ ਪਏ ਪਚੰਨਿ ॥੫॥
233.e: They are not accepted by the earth or the sky; they fall into manure, and rot. ||5||

233.g: ਇਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਇਆ; ਮੋਹ ਠਗਉਲੀ ਪਾਇ ॥
233.e: This world is deluded by doubt - it has taken the drug of emotional attachment.

233.g: ਜਿਨਾ. ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟਿਆ; ਤਿਨ ਨੇੜਿ. ਨ ਭਿਟੈ ਮਾਇ ॥੬॥
233.e: Maya does not draw near those who have met with the True Guru. ||6||

233.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਨਿ ਸੋ ਸੋਹਣੇ; ਹਉਮੈ ਮੈਲੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
233.e: Those who serve the True Guru are very beautiful; they cast off the filth of selfishness and conceit.
The mind is attuned to the Word of the Shabad; it is lovingly attuned to the Lord.

233.g: ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਸਿਆ; ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਰਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
233.e: It abides within its own home, in harmony with the Lord's Will. ||1||
Serving the True Guru, egotistical pride departs,
and the Lord of the Universe, the Treasure of Excellence, is obtained. ||1||Pause||

233.g: ਮਨੁ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ; ਜਾ ਸਬਦਿ ਭਉ ਖਾਇ ॥
233.e: The mind becomes detached and free of desire, when it experiences the Fear of God, through the Shabad.

233.g: ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਨਿਰਮਲਾ; ਸਭ ਤੈ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
233.e: My Immaculate God is pervading and contained among all.
By Guru's Grace, one is united in His Union. ||2||

233.g: ਹਰਿ ਦਾਸਨ ਕੋ ਦਾਸੁ; ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
233.e: The slave of the Lord's slave attains peace.

233.g: ਮੇਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ; ਇਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਏ ॥
233.e: My Lord God is found in this way.

233.g: ਹਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ; ਰਾਮ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ॥੩॥
233.e: By the Grace of the Lord, one comes to sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||3||

233.g: ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਬਹੁ ਜੀਵਣੁ; ਜਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ. ਨ ਲਗੈ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
233.e: Cursed is that long life, during which love for the Lord's Name is not enshrined.

233.g: ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਸੇਜ ਸੁਖਾਲੀ; ਕਾਮਣਿ ਮੋਹ ਗੁਬਾਰੁ ॥
233.e: Cursed is that comfortable bed which lures one into the darkness of attachment to sexual desire.

233.g: ਤਿਨ ਸਫਲੁ ਜਨਮੁ; ਜਿਨ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥੪॥
233.e: Fruitful is the birth of that person who takes the Support of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||4||

233.g: ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਗ੍ਰਿਹੁ ਕੁਟੰਬੁ; ਜਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ. ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
233.e: Cursed, cursed is that home and family, in which the love of the Lord is not embraced.

233.g: ਸੋਈ ਹਮਾਰਾ ਮੀਤੁ; ਜੋ. ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਸੋਇ ॥
233.e: He alone is my friend, who sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

233.g: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ; ਮੈ. ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥੫॥
233.e: Without the Lord's Name, there is no other for me. ||5||

233.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਹਮ; ਗਤਿ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
233.e: From the True Guru, I have obtained salvation and honor.

233.g: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ; ਦੂਖੁ ਸਗਲ ਮਿਟਾਈ ॥
233.e: I have meditated on the Name of the Lord, and all my sufferings have been erased.

233.g: ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦੁ; ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥੬॥
233.e: I am in constant bliss, lovingly attuned to the Lord's Name. ||6||

233.g: ਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ; ਹਮ ਕਉ. ਸਰੀਰ ਸੁਧਿ ਭਈ ॥
233.e: Meeting the Guru, I came to understand my body.
The fires of ego and desire have been totally quenched.
Anger has been dispelled, and I have grasped hold of tolerance. ||7||

233.g: ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ; ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਵੈ ॥
233.e: The Lord Himself showers His Mercy, and bestows the Naam.
How rare is that Gurmukh, who receives the jewel of the Naam.

233.g: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ; ਹਰਿ ਅਲਖ ਅਭੇਵੈ ॥੮॥੮॥
233.e: O Nanak, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, the Unknowable, the Incomprehensible. ||8||8||
Ram, alongwith his winsome wife Sita and his brother moved fearlessly in the dense forest, forsaking all his anxieties.327.
With his sword tied by the waist and holding the arrows in him hand, the long-armed heroes started for the bath at pilgrim-stations.328.
He reached on the bank of Godavari alongwith his heroic brother and there Ram put off his clothes and took a bath, thus cleansing his body.329.­
Ram had a marvellous body, when he came out after bath, on seeing his beauty the official of the place went to the royal lady Surapanakha.330.
They said to her, “Please listen to us O royal lady! two strangers of unique bodies have come to our kingeom.”331.
SUNDARI STANZA
When Surapanakha heard these words, she immediately started and reaching there,

234.g: ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੇ. ਸੇ ਨਿਰਮਲੇ; ਚਲਹਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਾਇ ॥੭॥
234.e: Those who are attuned to the Shabad are immaculate and pure. They walk in harmony with the Will of the True Guru. ||7||

234.g: ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਾਤਾ ਏਕੁ ਤੂੰ; ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
234.e: O Lord God, You are the One and Only Giver; You forgive us, and unite us with Yourself.

234.g: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ; ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ. ਤਿਵੈ ਛਡਾਇ ॥੮॥੧॥੯॥
234.e: Servant Nanak seeks Your Sanctuary; if it is Your Will, please save him! ||8||1||9||

234.g: ਅਥ ਖਰਦੂਖਨ ਦਈਤ ਜੁਧ ਕਥਨੰ ॥
234.e: The beginning of the description of the battle with the demons Khar and Dusman :

234.g: ਸੁੰਦਰੀ ਛੰਦ ॥
234.e: SUNDARI STANZA

234.g: ਰਾਵਨ ਤੀਰ ਰੁਰੋਤ ਭਈ ਜਬ ॥
ਰੋਸ ਭਰੇ ਦਨੁ ਬੰਸ ਬਲੀ ਸਭ ॥
234.e: When Surapanakha went weeping near Ravana, then the whole demon-clan was filled with fury.

234.g: ਲੰਕਸ ਧੀਰ ਬਜੀਰ ਬੁਲਾਏ ॥
ਦੂਖਨ ਔ ਖਰ ਦਈਤ ਪਠਾਏ ॥੩੩੭॥
234.e: The king of Lanka called his ministers for consultations and sent two demons Khar and Dushan for killing ram etc. 337.

234.g: ਸਾਜ ਸਨਾਹ ਸੁਬਾਹ ਦੁਰੰ ਗਤ ॥
ਬਾਜਤ ਬਾਜ ਚਲੇ ਗਜ ਗਜਤ ॥
234.e: Wearing their armours all the long-armed warriors marched forward with the resounding of musical instruments and the roaring of elephants.

234.g: ਮਾਰ ਹੀ ਮਾਰ ਦਸੋ ਦਿਸ ਕੂਕੇ ॥
ਸਾਵਨ ਕੀ ਘਟ ਜਯੋਂ ਘੁਰ ਢੂਕੇ ॥੩੩੮॥
234.e: There was noise of “kill, kill” from all the four sides and the army gushed forward like the clouds of the month of sawan.338.

234.g: ਗਜਤ ਹੈ ਰਣਬੀਰ ਮਹਾ ਮਨ ॥
ਤਜਤ ਹੈਂ ਨਹੀ ਭੂਮਿ ਅਯੋਧਨ ॥
234.e: The mighty warriors thundered and stood firmly on the ground.

234.g: ਛਾਜਤ ਹੈ ਚਖ ਸ੍ਰੋਣਤ ਸੋ ਸਰ ॥
ਨਾਦਿ ਕਰੈਂ ਕਿਲਕਾਰ ਭਯੰਕਰ ॥੩੩੯॥
234.e: The pools of blood flourished and the warriors raised terrible shrieks.339.

234.g: ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ਪੂਰਬੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਕਰਹਲੇ ॥
234.e: Raag Gauree Poorbee, Fourth Mehl, Karhalay:

234.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
234.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

234.g: ਕਰਹਲੇ ਮਨ ਪਰਦੇਸੀਆ; ਕਿਉ ਮਿਲੀਐ. ਹਰਿ ਮਾਇ ॥
234.e: O my wandering mind, you are like a camel - how will you meet the Lord, your Mother?

234.g: ਗੁਰੁ. ਭਾਗਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਪਾਇਆ; ਗਲਿ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਆਇ ॥੧॥
234.e: When I found the Guru, by the destiny of perfect good fortune, my Beloved came and embraced me. ||1||

234.g: ਮਨ ਕਰਹਲਾ; ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
234.e: O camel-like mind, meditate on the True Guru, the Primal Being. ||1||Pause||

234.g: ਮਨ ਕਰਹਲਾ ਵੀਚਾਰੀਆ; ਹਰਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਧਿਆਇ ॥
234.e: O camel-like mind, contemplate the Lord, and meditate on the Lord's Name.

234.g: ਜਿਥੈ ਲੇਖਾ ਮੰਗੀਐ; ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਲਏ ਛਡਾਇ ॥੨॥
234.e: When you are called to answer for your account, the Lord Himself shall release you. ||2||

234.g: ਮਨ ਕਰਹਲਾ ਅਤਿ ਨਿਰਮਲਾ; ਮਲੁ ਲਾਗੀ ਹਉਮੈ ਆਇ ॥
234.e: O camel-like mind, you were once very pure; the filth of egotism has now attached itself to you.

234.g: ਪਰਤਖਿ ਪਿਰੁ ਘਰਿ ਨਾਲਿ ਪਿਆਰਾ; ਵਿਛੁੜਿ ਚੋਟਾ ਖਾਇ ॥੩॥
234.e: Your Beloved Husband is now manifest before you in your own home, but you are separated from Him, and you suffer such pain! ||3||

234.g: ਮਨ ਕਰਹਲਾ. ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮਾ; ਹਰਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਭਾਲਿ ਭਾਲਾਇ ॥
234.e: O my beloved camel-like mind, search for the Lord within your own heart.

234.g: ਉਪਾਇ ਕਿਤੈ. ਨ ਲਭਈ; ਗੁਰੁ. ਹਿਰਦੈ ਹਰਿ ਦੇਖਾਇ ॥੪॥
234.e: He cannot be found by any device; the Guru will show you the Lord within your heart. ||4||

234.g: ਮਨ ਕਰਹਲਾ. ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮਾ; ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਣਿ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
234.e: O my beloved camel-like mind, day and night, lovingly attune yourself to the Lord.

234.g: ਘਰੁ ਜਾਇ. ਪਾਵਹਿ ਰੰਗ ਮਹਲੀ; ਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲੇ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲਾਇ ॥੫॥
234.e: Return to your own home, and find the palace of love; meet the Guru, and meet the Lord. ||5||

234.g: ਮਨ ਕਰਹਲਾ. ਤੂੰ ਮੀਤੁ ਮੇਰਾ; ਪਾਖੰਡੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਤਜਾਇ ॥
234.e: O camel-like mind, you are my friend; abandon hypocrisy and greed.

234.g: ਪਾਖੰਡਿ ਲੋਭੀ ਮਾਰੀਐ; ਜਮ ਡੰਡੁ ਦੇਇ ਸਜਾਇ ॥੬॥
234.e: The hypocritical and the greedy are struck down; the Messenger of Death punishes them with his club. ||6||

234.g: ਮਨ ਕਰਹਲਾ. ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਤੂੰ; ਮੈਲੁ ਪਾਖੰਡੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
234.e: O camel-like mind, you are my breath of life; rid yourself of the pollution of hypocrisy and doubt.

234.g: ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਸਰੁ ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰਿਆ; ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਗਤੀ. ਮਲੁ ਲਹਿ ਜਾਇ ॥੭॥
234.e: The Perfect Guru is the Ambrosial Pool of the Lord's Nectar; join the Holy Congregation, and wash away this pollution. ||7||

234.g: ਮਨ ਕਰਹਲਾ. ਮੇਰੇ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ; ਇਕ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਿਖ ਸੁਣਾਇ ॥
234.e: O my dear beloved camel-like mind, listen only to the Teachings of the Guru.

234.g: ਇਹੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਪਸਰਿਆ; ਅੰਤਿ ਸਾਥਿ. ਨ ਕੋਈ ਜਾਇ ॥੮॥
234.e: This emotional attachment to Maya is so pervasive. Ultimately, nothing shall go along with anyone. ||8||

234.g: ਮਨ ਕਰਹਲਾ. ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਜਨਾ; ਹਰਿ ਖਰਚੁ ਲੀਆ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਇ ॥
234.e: O camel-like mind, my good friend, take the supplies of the Lord's Name, and obtain honor.

234.g: ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਪੈਨਾਇਆ; ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਲਇਆ ਗਲਿ ਲਾਇ ॥੯॥
234.e: In the Court of the Lord, you shall be robed with honor, and the Lord Himself shall embrace you. ||9||

234.g: ਮਨ ਕਰਹਲਾ. ਗੁਰਿ ਮੰਨਿਆ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
234.e: O camel-like mind, one who surrenders to the Guru becomes Gurmukh, and works for the Lord.

234.g: ਗੁਰ ਆਗੈ. ਕਰਿ ਜੋਦੜੀ; ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ. ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲਾਇ ॥੧੦॥੧॥
234.e: Offer your prayers to the Guru; O servant Nanak, He shall unite you with the Lord. ||10||1||

234.g: ਰੂਪ ਅਨੂਪ ਤਿਹੂੰ ਪੁਰ ਮਾਨੈ ॥੩੩੨॥
234.e: She considered all of them as Cupid-incarnate and believed in her mind that no one equaled them in beauty.332.

234.g: ਧਾਇ ਕਹਯੋ ਰਘੁਰਾਇ ਭਏ ਤਿਹ ॥
ਜੈਸ ਨ੍ਰਿਲਾਜ ਕਹੈ ਨ ਕੋਊ ਕਿਹ ॥
234.e: Coming before Ram, without feeling ashamed, she said :

234.g: ਹਉ ਅਟਕੀ ਤੁਮਰੀ ਛਬਿ ਕੇ ਬਰ ॥
ਰੰਗ ਰੰਗੀ ਰੰਗਏ ਦ੍ਰਿਗ ਦੂਪਰ ॥੩੩੩॥
234.e: “I have halted here because of your beauty and my mind is dyed with the dye of your intoxicated eyes.”333.

234.g: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
234.e: Gauree, Fourth Mehl:

234.g: ਮਨ ਕਰਹਲਾ. ਵੀਚਾਰੀਆ; ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ਦੇਖੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥
234.e: O contemplative camel-like mind, contemplate and look carefully.

234.g: ਬਨ ਫਿਰਿ ਥਕੇ ਬਨ ਵਾਸੀਆ; ਪਿਰੁ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਨਿਹਾਲਿ ॥੧॥
234.e: The forest-dwellers have grown weary of wandering in the forests; following the Guru's Teachings, see your Husband Lord within your heart. ||1||

234.g: ਮਨ ਕਰਹਲਾ; ਗੁਰ ਗੋਵਿੰਦੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
234.e: O camel-like mind, dwell upon the Guru and the Lord of the Universe. ||1||Pause||

234.g: ਮਨ ਕਰਹਲਾ. ਵੀਚਾਰੀਆ; ਮਨਮੁਖ ਫਾਥਿਆ ਮਹਾ ਜਾਲਿ ॥
234.e: O camel-like contemplative mind, the self-willed manmukhs are caught in the great net.

234.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਹੈ; ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥੨॥
234.e: The mortal who becomes Gurmukh is liberated, dwelling upon the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||2||

234.g: ਮਨ ਕਰਹਲਾ. ਮੇਰੇ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ; ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭਾਲਿ ॥
234.e: O my dear beloved camel-like mind, seek the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, and the True Guru.

234.g: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਲਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਈਐ; ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ. ਚਲੈ ਤੇਰੈ ਨਾਲਿ ॥੩॥
234.e: Joining the Sat Sangat, meditate on the Lord, and the Lord, Har, Har, shall go along with you. ||3||

234.g: ਮਨ ਕਰਹਲਾ. ਵਡਭਾਗੀਆ; ਹਰਿ ਏਕ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲਿ ॥
234.e: O very fortunate camel-like mind, with one Glance of Grace from the Lord, you shall be enraptured.

234.g: ਰਾਮ ਬਾਚ ॥
234.e: Speech of Ram

234.g: ਸੁੰਦਰੀ ਛੰਦ ॥
234.e: SUNDARI STANZA

234.g: ਜਾਹ ਤਹਾ ਜਹ ਭ੍ਰਾਤਿ ਹਮਾਰੇ ॥
ਵੈ ਰਿਝਹੈ, ਲਖ ਨੈਨ ਤਿਹਾਰੇ ॥
234.e: “You go to the place of my brother who will be bewitched on seeing your beautiful eyes

234.g: ਸੰਗ ਸੀਆ ਅਵਿਲੋਕ ਕ੍ਰਿਸੋਦਰ ॥
ਕੈਸੇ ਕੈ ਰਾਖ ਸਕੋ ਤੁਮ ਕਉ ਘਰਿ ॥੩੩੪॥
234.e: “You can see that with me there is Sita of beautiful waist and in such a situation how can I keep you in my house.334.

234.g: ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਕਹ ਮੋਹ ਤਜਯੋ ਮਨ ॥
ਸੰਗ ਫਿਰੀ ਹਮਰੇ ਬਨ ਹੀ ਬਨ ॥
234.e: “She has abandoned the attachment towards her parents and is roaming with me in the forest

234.g: ਤਾਹਿ ਤਜੌ ਕਸ ਕੈ, ਸੁਨਿ ਸੁੰਦਰ ॥
ਜਾਹੁ ਤਹਾ ਜਹਾ ਭ੍ਰਾਤ, ਕ੍ਰਿਸੋਦਰਿ ॥੩੩੫॥
234.e: “O beautiful lady! How can I forsake her, you go there where my brother is sitting.”335.

234.g: ਜਾਤ ਭਈ ਸੁਨ ਬੈਨ ਤ੍ਰਿਯਾ ਤਹ ॥
ਬੈਠ ਹੁਤੇ ਰਣਧੀਰ ਜਤੀ ਜਹ ॥
234.e: Hearing these words of Ram, that lady Surpanakha went there were Lakshman was sitting.

234.g: ਸੋ ਨ ਬਰੈ ਅਤਿ ਰੋਸ ਭਰੀ ਤਬ ॥
ਨਾਕ ਕਟਾਇ ਗਈ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਕੋ ਸਭ ॥੩੩੬॥
234.e: When he also refused to wed her, then she was filled with great rage and went to her home after getting her nose chopped.336.

234.g: ਇਤਿ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਬਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਨਾਟਕੇ ਰਾਮ ਅਵਤਾਰ ਕਥਾ ਸੂਪਨਖਾ ਕੋ ਨਾਕ ਕਾਟਬੋ ਧਯਾਇ ਸਮਾਪਤਮ ਸਤੁ ਸੁਭਮ ਸਤੁ ॥੫॥
234.e: End of the chapter regarding the Chopping of the Nose of Surapanakha in the story of Rama Incarnation in BACHITTAR NATAK.

234.g: ਤਾਰਕਾ ਛੰਦ ॥
234.e: TAARKAA STANZA

234.g: ਰਨਿ ਰਾਜ ਕੁਮਾਰ ਬਿਰਚਹਿਗੇ ॥
ਸਰ ਸੇਲ ਸਰਾਸਨ ਨਚਹਿਗੇ ॥
234.e: When the princes will begin the battle, there will be the dance of lances and shafts.

234.g: ਸੁ ਬਿਰੁਧ ਅਵਧਿ ਸੁ ਗਾਜਹਿਗੇ ॥
ਰਣ ਰੰਗਹਿ ਰਾਮ ਬਿਰਾਜਹਿਗੇ ॥੩੪੦॥
234.e: The warriors will roar on seeing the opposing forces and Ram will be absorbed in the fighting mood.340.

234.g: ਸਰ ਓਘ ਪ੍ਰਓਘ ਪ੍ਰਹਾਰੈਗੇ ॥
ਰਣਿ ਰੰਗ ਅਭੀਤ ਬਿਹਾਰੈਗੇ ॥
234.e: There will be showers of arrows and the fighters will roam in the battlefield fearlessly.

234.g: ਸਰ ਸੂਲ ਸਨਾਹਰਿ ਛੁਟਹਿਗੇ ॥
ਦਿਤ ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਪਰਾ ਪਰ ਲੁਟਹਿਗੇ ॥੩੪੧॥
234.e: The tridents and arrows will be struck and the sons of demons will roll in dust.341.

234.g: ਸਰ ਸੰਕ ਅਸੰਕਤ ਬਾਹਹਿਗੇ ॥
ਬਿਨੁ ਭੀਤ ਭਯਾ ਦਲ ਦਾਹਹਿਗੇ ॥
234.e: They will discharge arrows undoubtedly and destroy the forces of the enemy.

234.g: ਛਿਤਿ ਲੁਥ ਬਿਲੁਥ ਬਿਥਾਰਹਿਗੇ ॥
ਤਰੁ ਸਣੈ ਸਮੂਲ ਉਪਾਰਹਿਗੇ ॥੩੪੨॥
234.e: The corpses will be scattered on the earth and the great warriors will uproot the trees.342.

234.g: ਨਵ ਨਾਦ ਨਫੀਰਨ ਬਾਜਤ ਭੇ ॥

235.g: ਮਰੀਚ ਬਾਚ ॥
235.e: Speech of Marich :

235.g: ਮਨੋਹਰ ਛੰਦ ॥
235.e: MANOHAR STANZA

235.g: ਨਾਥ, ਅਨਾਥ ਸਨਾਥ ਕੀਯੋ; ਕਰਿ ਕੈ ਅਤਿ ਮੋਰ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਹ ਆਏ ॥
235.e: “O my Lord! You had been very kind to came to my place.

235.g: ਭਉਨ ਭੰਡਾਰ ਅਟੀ ਬਿਕਟੀ; ਪ੍ਰਭ, ਆਜ ਸਭੈ ਘਰ ਬਾਰ ਸੁਹਾਏ ॥
235.e: “My stores are overflowing on your arrival, O my Lord!

235.g: ਦ੍ਵੈ ਕਰਿ ਜੋਰ ਕਰਉ ਬਿਨਤੀ; ਸੁਨਿ ਕੈ ਨ੍ਰਿਪਨਾਥ, ਬੁਰੋ ਮਤ ਮਾਨੋ ॥
235.e: “But with folded hands I request and kindly do not mind,

235.g: ਸ੍ਰੀ ਰਘੁਬੀਰ ਸਹੀ ਅਵਤਾਰ; ਤਿਨੈ ਤੁਮ ਮਾਨਸ ਕੈ ਨ ਪਛਾਨੋ ॥੨੪੯॥
235.e: “That is my supplication that Ram is in reality an incarnation, do not consider him as a man like yourself.”349.

235.g: ਰੋਸ ਭਰਯੋ ਸਭ ਅੰਗ ਜਰਯੋ ਮੁਖ ਰਤ ਕਰਯੋ ਜੁਗ ਨੈਨ ਤਚਾਏ ॥
235.e: Hearing these words, Ravan was filled with anger and his limbs began to burn, his face turned red and his eyes expanded with anger.

235.g: ਤੈ ਨ ਲਗੈ ਹਮਰੇ ਸਠ, ਬੋਲਨ; ਮਾਨਸ ਦੁਐ ਅਵਤਾਰ ਗਨਾਏ ॥
235.e: He said, “O fool! what are you speaking before me and considering those two men as incarnations

235.g: ਮਾਤ ਕੀ ਏਕ ਹੀ ਬਾਤ ਕਹੇ; ਤਜਿ ਤਾਤ, ਘ੍ਰਿਣਾ ਬਨਬਾਸ ਨਿਕਾਰੇ ॥
235.e: “Their mother spoke only once and their father indignantly sent them to the forest

235.g: ਤੇ ਦੋਊ ਦੀਨ ਅਧੀਨ ਜੁਗੀਯਾ; ਕਸ ਕੈ ਭਿਰਹੈਂ ਸੰਗ ਆਨ ਹਮਾਰੇ ॥੩੫੦॥
235.e: “Both of them are lowly and helpless, how will they be able to fight against me.350.

235.g: ਜਉ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਤ ਤਹਾ ਕਹ ਤੈ ਸਠਿ, ਤੋਰ ਜਟਾਨ ਕੋ ਜੂਟ ਪਟੈ ਹੌ ॥
235.e: “O fool! if I had not come to ask you for going there, I would have uprooted and thrown your matted hair,

235.g: ਕੰਚਨ ਕੋਟ ਕੇ ਊਪਰ ਤੇ ਡਰ; ਤੋਹਿ ਨਦੀਸਰ ਬੀਚ ਡੁਬੈ ਹੌ ॥
235.e: “And from the top of this golden citadel I would have thrown you in the sea and get you drowned.”

235.g: ਚਿਤ ਚਿਰਾਤ ਬਸਾਤ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਰਿਸਾਤ ਚਲਯੋ ਮੁਨ ਘਾਤ ਪਛਾਨੀ ॥
235.e: Hearing these world and pining in his mind and in anger, realizing the gravity of the occasion, Marich left that place

235.g: ਰਾਵਨ ਨੀਚ ਕੀ ਮੀਚ ਅਧੋਗਤ; ਰਾਘਵ ਪਾਨ ਪੁਰੀ ਸੁਰਿ ਮਾਨੀ ॥੩੫੧॥
235.e: He felt that the death and decadence of the vile Ravan is certain at the hands of Ram.351.

235.g: ਕੰਚਨ ਕੋ ਹਰਨਾ ਬਨ ਕੇ; ਰਘੁਬੀਰ ਬਲੀ ਜਹ ਥੋ ਤਹ ਆਯੋ ॥
235.e: He transformed himself into a golden deer and reached at the abode of Ram.

235.g: ਰਾਵਨ ਹ੍ਵੈ ਉਤ ਕੇ ਜੁਗੀਆ; ਸੀਅ ਲੈਨ ਚਲਯੋ ਜਨੁ ਮੀਚ ਚਲਾਯੋ ॥
235.e: On the other side Ravana put on the garb of a Yogi and went to abduct Sita, it seemed that death was driving him there.

235.g: ਸੀਅ ਬਿਲੋਕ ਕੁਰੰਕ ਪ੍ਰਭਾ; ਕਹ ਮੋਹਿ ਰਹੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੀਰ ਉਚਾਰੀ ॥
235.e: Seeing the beauty of the golden deer, Sita came near Ram and said :

235.g: ਆਨ ਦਿਜੈ ਹਮ ਕਉ ਮ੍ਰਿਗ ਵਾਸੁਨ; ਸ੍ਰੀ ਅਵਧੇਸ, ਮੁਕੰਦ, ਮੁਰਾਰੀ ॥੩੫੨॥
235.e: “O the king of Oudh and the destroyer of demons! Go and bring that deer for me.”352.

235.g: ਅਥ ਸੀਤਾ ਹਰਨ ਕਥਨੰ ॥
235.e: Now begins the description of the abduction of Sita :

235.g: ਮਨੋਹਰ ਛੰਦ ॥
235.e: MANOHAR STANZA

235.g: ਰਾਵਣ ਨੀਚ ਮਰੀਚ ਹੂੰ ਕੇ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਬੀਚ ਗਏ ਬਧ ਬੀਰ ਸੁਨੈਹੈ ॥
235.e: Hearing about the killing of Khar and Dushan the vile Ravan went to the house of Marich.

235.g: ਬੀਸਹੂੰ ਬਾਹਿ ਹਥਿਆਰ ਗਹੇ; ਰਿਸ ਮਾਰ ਮਨੈ ਦਸ ਸੀਸ ਧੁਨੈ ਹੈ ॥
235.e: He held his weapons in all his twenty hands and was furiously muzzling his ten heads.

235.g: ਨਾਕ ਕਟਯੋ ਜਿਨ ਸੂਪਨਖਾ; ਕਹਤਉ, ਤਿਹ ਕੋ ਦੁਖ ਦੋਖ ਲਗੈ ਹੈ ॥
235.e: He said, “Those who have chopped the nose of Surapankha, their such action has agonised me

235.g: ਰਾਵਲ ਕੋ ਬਨੁ ਕੈ ਪਲ ਮੋ; ਛਲ ਕੈ ਤਿਹ ਕੀ ਘਰਨੀ ਧਰਿ ਲਯੈ ਹੈ ॥੩੪੮॥
235.e: “I shall steal their wife in the garb of a Yogi form the forest in your company.”348.

235.g: ਰਾਮ ਬਾਚ ॥
235.e: Speech of Ram :

235.g: ਸੀਅ, ਮ੍ਰਿਗਾ ਕਹੂੰ ਕੰਚਨ ਕੋ; ਨਹਿ ਕਾਨ ਸੁਨਯੋ ਬਿਧਿ ਨੈ ਨ ਬਨਾਯੋ ॥
235.e: “O Sita! no one had heard about the golden deer and even the Lord hath not created it

235.g: ਬੀਸ ਬਿਸਵੇ ਛਲ ਦਾਨਵ ਕੋ; ਬਨ ਮੈ ਜਿਹ ਆਨ ਤੁਮੈ ਡਹਕਾਯੋ ॥
235.e: “This is certainly the deceit of some demon, who has caused this deception in you.”

235.g: ਪਿਆਰੀ ਕੋ ਆਇਸ ਮੇਟ ਸਕੈ ਨ; ਬਿਲੋਕ ਸੀਆ ਕਹੁ ਆਤੁਰ ਭਾਰੀ ॥
235.e: Seeing the affliction of Sita, Ram could not put aside her wish

235.g: ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ ॥
235.e: Raag Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehl, Ashtpadheeyaa:

235.g: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
235.e: One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. By Guru's Grace:

235.g: ਜਬ ਇਹੁ; ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਕਰਤ ਗੁਮਾਨਾ ॥
235.e: When this mind is filled with pride,

235.g: ਤਬ ਇਹੁ; ਬਾਵਰੁ ਫਿਰਤ ਬਿਗਾਨਾ ॥
235.e: then it wanders around like a madman and a lunatic.

235.g: ਜਬ ਇਹੁ ਹੂਆ; ਸਗਲ ਕੀ ਰੀਨਾ ॥
235.e: But when it becomes the dust of all,

235.g: ਤਾ ਤੇ ਰਮਈਆ; ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਚੀਨਾ ॥੧॥
235.e: then it recognizes the Lord in each and every heart. ||1||

235.g: ਸਹਜ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ; ਫਲੁ ਮਸਕੀਨੀ ॥
235.e: The fruit of humility is intuitive peace and pleasure.

235.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਅਪੁਨੈ; ਮੋਹਿ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੀਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
235.e: My True Guru has given me this gift. ||1||Pause||

235.g: ਜਬ ਕਿਸ ਕਉ; ਇਹੁ ਜਾਨਸਿ ਮੰਦਾ ॥
235.e: When he believes others to be bad,

235.g: ਤਬ ਸਗਲੇ; ਇਸੁ ਮੇਲਹਿ ਫੰਦਾ ॥
235.e: then everyone lays traps for him.

235.g: ਮੇਰ ਤੇਰ; ਜਬ ਇਨਹਿ ਚੁਕਾਈ ॥
235.e: But when he stops thinking in terms of 'mine' and 'yours',

235.g: ਤਾ ਤੇ ਇਸੁ ਸੰਗਿ; ਨਹੀ ਬੈਰਾਈ ॥੨॥
235.e: then no one is angry with him. ||2||

235.g: ਜਬ ਇਨਿ; ਅਪੁਨੀ ਅਪਨੀ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
235.e: When he clings to 'my own, my own',

235.g: ਤਬ ਇਸ ਕਉ; ਹੈ ਮੁਸਕਲੁ ਭਾਰੀ ॥
235.e: then he is in deep trouble.

235.g: ਜਬ ਇਨਿ; ਕਰਣੈਹਾਰੁ ਪਛਾਤਾ ॥
235.e: But when he recognizes the Creator Lord,

235.g: ਤਬ ਇਸ ਨੋ; ਨਾਹੀ ਕਿਛੁ ਤਾਤਾ ॥੩॥
235.e: then he is free of torment. ||3||

235.g: ਜਬ ਇਨਿ; ਅਪੁਨੋ ਬਾਧਿਓ ਮੋਹਾ ॥
235.e: When he entangles himself in emotional attachment,

235.g: ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ; ਸਦਾ ਜਮਿ ਜੋਹਾ ॥
235.e: he comes and goes in reincarnation, under the constant gaze of Death.

235.g: ਜਬ ਇਸ ਤੇ; ਸਭ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਭਰਮਾ ॥
235.e: But when all his doubts are removed,

235.g: ਭੇਦੁ ਨਾਹੀ; ਹੈ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ॥੪॥
235.e: then there is no difference between him and the Supreme Lord God. ||4||

235.g: ਜਬ ਇਨਿ; ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨੇ ਭੇਦਾ ॥
235.e: When he perceives differences,

235.g: ਤਬ ਤੇ ਦੂਖ; ਡੰਡ ਅਰੁ ਖੇਦਾ ॥
235.e: then he suffers pain, punishment and sorrow.

235.g: ਜਬ ਇਨਿ; ਏਕੋ ਏਕੀ ਬੂਝਿਆ ॥
235.e: But when he recognizes the One and Only Lord,

235.g: ਤਬ ਤੇ ਇਸ ਨੋ; ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਸੂਝਿਆ ॥੫॥
235.e: he understands everything. ||5||

235.g: ਜਬ ਇਹੁ ਧਾਵੈ; ਮਾਇਆ ਅਰਥੀ ॥
235.e: When he runs around for the sake of Maya and riches,

235.g: ਨਹ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਵੈ; ਨਹ ਤਿਸ ਲਾਥੀ ॥
235.e: he is not satisfied, and his desires are not quenched.

235.g: ਜਬ ਇਸ ਤੇ; ਇਹੁ ਹੋਇਓ ਜਉਲਾ ॥
235.e: But when he runs away from Maya,

235.g: ਪੀਛੈ ਲਾਗਿ ਚਲੀ; ਉਠਿ ਕਉਲਾ ॥੬॥
235.e: then the Goddess of Wealth gets up and follows him. ||6||

235.g: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ; ਜਉ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲਿਓ ॥
235.e: When, by His Grace, the True Guru is met,

235.g: ਮਨ ਮੰਦਰ ਮਹਿ; ਦੀਪਕੁ ਜਲਿਓ ॥
235.e: the lamp is lit within the temple of the mind.

235.g: ਜੀਤ ਹਾਰ ਕੀ, ਸੋਝੀ ਕਰੀ ॥
235.e: When he realizes what victory and defeat really are,

235.g: ਤਉ ਇਸੁ ਘਰ ਕੀ; ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਰੀ ॥੭॥
235.e: then he comes to appreciate the true value of his own home. ||7||

235.g: ਆਪਿ ਛਡਾਏ ਛੁਟੀਐ; ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਚਰਣ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥੪॥
235.e: If the Lord Himself saves you, then you shall be saved. Dwell upon the Feet of the True Guru. ||4||

235.g: ਮਨ ਕਰਹਲਾ. ਮੇਰੇ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ; ਵਿਚਿ ਦੇਹੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥
235.e: O my dear beloved camel-like mind, dwell upon the Divine Light within the body.

235.g: ਗੁਰਿ. ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਖਾਲਿਆ; ਹਰਿ ਦਾਤਿ ਕਰੀ ਦਇਆਲਿ ॥੫॥
235.e: The Guru has shown me the nine treasures of the Naam. The Merciful Lord has bestowed this gift. ||5||

235.g: ਮਨ ਕਰਹਲਾ. ਤੂੰ ਚੰਚਲਾ; ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ਛਡਿ ਵਿਕਰਾਲਿ ॥
235.e: O camel-like mind, you are so fickle; give up your cleverness and corruption.

235.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ਤੂੰ; ਹਰਿ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਅੰਤ ਕਾਲਿ ॥੬॥
235.e: Dwell upon the Name of the Lord, Har, Har; at the very last moment, the Lord shall liberate you. ||6||

235.g: ਮਨ ਕਰਹਲਾ. ਵਡਭਾਗੀਆ; ਤੂੰ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥
235.e: O camel-like mind, you are so very fortunate; dwell upon the jewel of spiritual wisdom.

235.g: ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਖੜਗੁ. ਹਥਿ ਧਾਰਿਆ; ਜਮੁ ਮਾਰਿਅੜਾ ਜਮਕਾਲਿ ॥੭॥
235.e: You hold in your hands the sword of the Guru's spiritual wisdom; with this destroyer of death, kill the Messenger of Death. ||7||

235.g: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ. ਮਨ ਕਰਹਲੇ; ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਭਵਹਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਭਾਲਿ ॥
235.e: The treasure is deep within, O camel-like mind, but you wander around outside in doubt, searching for it.

235.g: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਭੇਟਿਆ; ਹਰਿ ਸਜਣੁ ਲਧੜਾ ਨਾਲਿ ॥੮॥
235.e: Meeting the Perfect Guru, the Primal Being, you shall discover that the Lord, your Best Friend, is with you. ||8||

235.g: ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤੜੇ. ਮਨ ਕਰਹਲੇ; ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥
235.e: You are engrossed in pleasures, O camel-like mind; dwell upon the Lord's lasting love instead!

235.g: ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ. ਕਦੇ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ; ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥੯॥
235.e: The color of the Lord's Love never fades away; serve the Guru, and dwell upon the Word of the Shabad. ||9||

235.g: ਹਮ ਪੰਖੀ ਮਨ ਕਰਹਲੇ; ਹਰਿ ਤਰਵਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਕਾਲਿ ॥
235.e: We are birds, O camel-like mind; the Lord, the Immortal Primal Being, is the tree.

235.g: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਇਆ; ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥੧੦॥੨॥
235.e: The Gurmukhs are very fortunate - they find it. O servant Nanak, dwell upon the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||10||2||

235.g: ਗਲ ਗਜਿ ਹਠੀ ਰਣ ਰੰਗ ਫਿਰੇ ॥
235.e: The musical notes of fifes were played and the persistent warriors began to roar like lions and roam in the fields.

235.g: ਲਗਿ ਬਾਨ ਸਨਾਹ ਦੁਸਾਰ ਕਢੇ ॥
ਸੂਅ ਤਛਕ ਕੇ ਜਨੁ ਰੂਪ ਮਢੇ ॥੩੪੩॥
235.e: The shafts were being taken out from quivers and the serpent-like arrows were struck like the messengers of death.343.

235.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਸੰਕ ਸਨਾਹਰਿ ਝਾਰਤ ਹੈ ॥
ਰਣਬੀਰ ਨਵੀਰ ਪ੍ਰਚਾਰਤ ਹੈ ॥
235.e: The warriors are spraying arrows fearlessly and are challenging one another.

235.g: ਸਰ ਸੁਧ ਸਿਲਾ ਸਿਤ ਛੋਰਤ ਹੈ ॥
ਜੀਅ ਰੋਸ ਹਲਾਹਲ ਘੋਰਤ ਹੈ ॥੩੪੪॥
235.e: They are discharging shafts and stones and are drinking in the gearts the poison of indignation.344.

235.g: ਰਨ ਧੀਰ ਅਯੋਧਨੁ ਲੁਝਤ ਹੈਂ ॥
ਰਦ ਪੀਸ ਭਲੋ ਕਰ ਜੁਝਤ ਹੈਂ ॥
235.e: The conquering warriors have fought with one another in the battle and are fighting furiously.

235.g: ਰਣ ਦੇਵ ਅਦੇਵ ਨਿਹਾਰਤ ਹੈਂ ॥
ਜਯ ਸਦ ਨਿਨਦਿ ਪੁਕਾਰਤ ਹੈਂ ॥੩੪੫॥
235.e: Both the gods and demons are viewing the battle and are raising the sound of victory.345.

235.g: ਗਣ ਗਿਧਣ ਬ੍ਰਿਧ ਰੜੰਤ ਨਭੰ ॥
ਕਿਲਕੰਤ ਸੁ ਡਾਕਣ ਉਚ ਸੁਰੰ ॥
235.e: The Ganas and large vultures are roaming in the sky and the vampires are shrieking violently.

235.g: ਭ੍ਰਮ ਛਾਡ ਭਕਾਰਤ ਭੂਤ ਭੂਅੰ ॥
ਰਣ ਰੰਗ ਬਿਹਾਰਤ ਭ੍ਰਾਤ ਦੂਅੰ ॥੩੪੬॥
235.e: The ghosts are laughing fearlessly and both the brother Ram and Lakshman are looking at this continued fight.346.

235.g: ਖਰਦੂਖਣ ਮਾਰ ਬਿਹਾਇ ਦਏ ॥
ਜਯ ਸਦ ਨਿਨਦ ਬਿਹਦ ਭਏ ॥
235.e: Ram caused both Khar and Dushan flow down in the stream of death after killing them. The victory was greatly hailed from all the four sides.

235.g: ਸੁਰ ਫੂਲਨ ਕੀ ਬਰਖਾ ਬਰਖੇ ॥
ਰਣ ਧੀਰ ਅਧੀਰ ਦੋਊ ਪਰਖੇ ॥੩੪੭॥
235.e: The gods showered the flowers and enjoyed the sight of both the victorious warriors Ram and Lakshman.347.

235.g: ਇਤਿ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਬਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਨਾਟਕੇ ਰਾਮ ਅਵਤਾਰ ਕਥਾ ਖਰ ਦੂਖਣ ਦਈਤ ਬਧਹ ਧਿਆਇ ਸਮਾਪਤਮ ਸਤੁ ॥੬॥
235.e: End of the story of the killing of KHAR and DUSHMAN in Ramvatar in BACHITTAR NATAK.

236.e: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

236.g: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ; ਰਿਦ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਧਾਰੈ ॥
236.e: Those who implant the Word of the Guru's Shabad within their hearts
cut their connections with the five passions.
They keep the ten organs under their control;
their souls are enlightened. ||1||
They alone acquire such stability,

236.g: ਜਾ ਕਉ; ਦਇਆ ਮਇਆ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
236.e: whom God blesses with His Mercy and Grace. ||1||Pause||

236.g: ਸਾਜਨੁ ਦੁਸਟੁ; ਜਾ ਕੈ ਏਕ ਸਮਾਨੈ ॥
236.e: Friend and foe are one and the same to them.
Whatever they speak is wisdom.
Whatever they hear is the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
Whatever they see is meditation. ||2||
They awaken in peace and poise; they sleep in peace and poise.
That which is meant to be, automatically happens.
In peace and poise, they remain detached; in peace and poise, they laugh.
In peace and poise, they remain silent; in peace and poise, they chant. ||3||
In peace and poise they eat; in peace and poise they love.
The illusion of duality is easily and totally removed.
They naturally join the Saadh Sangat, the Society of the Holy.
In peace and poise, they meet and merge with the Supreme Lord God. ||4||
They are at peace in their homes, and they are at peace while detached.
Gauree, Fifth Mehl:
Serving the Guru, one is committed to the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

236.g: ਤਿਸ ਕਉ ਮਿਲਿਆ; ਜਿਸੁ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਭਾਗਾ ॥
236.e: It is received only by those who have such good destiny inscribed upon their foreheads.
The Lord dwells within their hearts.
Their minds and bodies become peaceful and stable. ||1||
O my mind, sing such Praises of the Lord,

236.g: ਈਹਾ ਊਹਾ; ਜੋ ਕਾਮਿ ਤੇਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
236.e: which shall be of use to you here and hereafter. ||1||Pause||
Meditating on Him, fear and misfortune depart,
and the wandering mind is held steady.

236.g: ਜਾਸੁ ਜਪਤ; ਫਿਰਿ. ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
236.e: Meditating on Him, suffering shall never again overtake you.
Meditating on Him, this ego runs away. ||2||
Meditating on Him, the five passions are overcome.
Meditating on Him, Ambrosial Nectar is collected in the heart.
Meditating on Him, this desire is quenched.
Meditating on Him, one is approved in the Court of the Lord. ||3||
Meditating on Him, millions of mistakes are erased.
Meditating on Him, one becomes Holy, blessed by the Lord.
Meditating on Him, the mind is cooled and soothed.
Meditating on Him, all filth is washed away. ||4||
Meditating on Him, the jewel of the Lord is obtained.

236.g: ਬਹੁਰਿ. ਨ ਛੋਡੈ; ਹਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਹਿਲੈ ॥
236.e: One is reconciled with the Lord, and shall not abandon Him again.
Meditating on Him, many acquire a home in the heavens.
Meditating on Him, one abides in intuitive peace. ||5||

236.g: ਜਾਸੁ ਜਪਤ; ਇਹ ਅਗਨਿ. ਨ ਪੋਹਤ ॥
236.e: Meditating on Him, one is not affected by this fire.

236.g: ਜਾਸੁ ਜਪਤ; ਇਹੁ ਕਾਲੁ. ਨ ਜੋਹਤ ॥
236.e: Meditating on Him, one is not under the gaze of Death.
Meditating on Him, your forehead shall be immaculate.
Meditating on Him, all pains are destroyed. ||6||

236.g: ਜਾਸੁ ਜਪਤ; ਮੁਸਕਲੁ ਕਛੂ. ਨ ਬਨੈ ॥
236.e: Meditating on Him, no difficulties are encountered.
Meditating on Him, one hears the unstruck melody.
Meditating on Him, one acquires this pure reputation.
Meditating on Him, the heart-lotus is turned upright. ||7||

236.g: ਗੁਰਿ ਸੁਭ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ; ਸਭ ਊਪਰਿ ਕਰੀ ॥
236.e: The Guru has bestowed His Glance of Grace upon all,

236.g: ਜਿਸ ਕੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ; ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਦੇ ਹਰੀ ॥
236.e: within whose hearts the Lord has implanted His Mantra.
The unbroken Kirtan of the Lord's Praises is their food and nourishment.
Says Nanak, they have the Perfect True Guru. ||8||2||
Now begin the description about the search for Sita :
TOTAK STANZA

236.g: ਗਹਿ ਬਾਨ ਸਿਲਾ ਸਿਤ ਸਜਿ ਧਨੰ ॥
236.e: When Ram visualized in his mind about the abduction of Sita, he caught hold of his bow and arrows in his hand and sat down on a white rock.
He saw once again on all the four sides, but ultimately he fell down on the earth in disappontment.356.

236.g: ਲਘੁ ਬੀਰ ਉਠਾਇ ਸੁ ਅੰਕ ਭਰੇ ॥

236.e: His younger brother clasped him and raised him and said while cleansing his face :

236.g: ਕਸ ਅਧੀਰ ਪਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਧੀਰ ਧਰੋ ॥
ਸੀਅ ਜਾਇ ਕਹਾ, ਤਿਹ ਸੋਧ ਕਰੋ ॥੩੫੭॥
236.e: “O my Lord! Do not be impatient, keep your composure. Ruminate on the fact where Sita has gone.?”357.

236.g: ਉਠ ਠਾਢਿ ਭਏ ਫਿਰਿ ਭੂਮ ਗਿਰੇ ॥

236.e: Ram got up but again swooned and came to consciousness again after some time.

236.g: ਤਨ ਚੇਤ ਸੁਚੇਤ ਉਠੇ ਹਰਿ ਯੌਂ ॥
ਰਣ ਮੰਡਲ ਮਧਿ ਗਿਰਯੋ ਭਟ ਜਯੋਂ ॥੩੫੮॥
236.e: He got up from the earth like a warrior slowly regaining consciousness in the battlefield.358.
He grew tired on shouting on all the four sides and experienced great anguish alongwith his younger brother.

236.g: ਉਠ ਕੈ ਪੁਨ ਪ੍ਰਾਤ ਇਸਨਾਨ ਗਏ ॥
ਜਲ ਜੰਤ ਸਭੈ ਜਰਿ ਛਾਰਿ ਭਏ ॥੩੫੯॥
236.e: He went to take bath early in the morning and with the impact of the heat of his agony, all the creatures in the water were burnt down and reduced to ashes.359.

236.g: ਬਿਰਹੀ ਜਿਹ ਓਰ ਸੁ ਦਿਸਟ ਧਰੈ ॥

236.e: The direction to which Ram saw in his state separation from his beloved, all the flowers and fruit as well us the trees of Palas and the sky burnt with the heat of his vision.

236.g: ਕਰ ਸੌ ਧਰ ਜਉਨ ਛੁਅੰਤ ਭਈ ॥
ਕਚ ਬਾਸਨ ਜਯੋਂ ਪਕ ਫੂਟ ਗਈ ॥੩੬੦॥
236.e: Whenever he touched the earth with his hands, the earth cracked like a brittle vessel with his touch.360.

236.g: ਜਿਹ ਭੂਮ ਥਲੀ ਪਰ ਰਾਮ ਫਿਰੇ ॥
ਦਵ ਜਯੋਂ ਜਲ ਪਾਤ ਪਲਾਸ ਗਿਰੇ ॥
236.e: The ground on which Ram rested, the Palas trees (on that ground) were burnt down and reduced to ashes like the grass.

236.g: ਮਨੋ ਤਾਤ ਤਵਾ ਪਰ ਬੂੰਦ ਪਰੀ ॥੩੬੧॥
236.e: The continuous flow of his tears evaporated on falling down on the earth like the drops of water falling on the got plate.361.
Even the cold mind burnt when it touched his body and controlling its coolness and forsaking its patience, it merged into the pool of water

236.g: ਨਹਿ ਤਤ੍ਰ ਥਲੀ ਸਤ ਪਤ੍ਰ ਰਹੇ ॥

236.e: Even there the leaves of lotus could not survive and the creatures of water, grass, leaves etc. all were reduced to ashes with the geat of the state of separation of Ram.362.
On this side Ram was roaming in the forest in search of Sita, on the other side Ravana was surrounded by Jatayu.

236.g: ਰਣ ਛੋਰ ਹਠੀ ਪਗ ਦੁਐ ਨ ਭਜਯੋ ॥
ਉਡ ਪਛ ਗਏ ਪੈ ਨ ਪਛ ਤਜਯੋ ॥੩੬੩॥
236.e: The persistent Jatayu did not yield in its fierce fighting even though its wings were chopped.363.
GEETA MALTI STANZA

236.g: ਪਛਰਾਜ, ਰਾਵਨ ਮਾਰਿ ਕੈ; ਰਘੁਰਾਜ ਸੀਤਹਿ ਲੈ ਗਯੋ ॥
236.e: Ravana took away Sita after killing Jatayu,

236.g: ਨਭਿ ਓਰ ਖੋਰ ਨਿਹਾਰ ਕੈ; ਸੁ ਜਟਾਉ ਸੀਅ ਸੰਦੇਸ ਦਯੋ ॥
236.e: This message was communicated by Jatayu, when Ram saw towards the sky.

236.g: ਤਬ ਜਾਨ ਰਾਮ ਗਏ ਬਲੀ ਸੀਅ ਸਤ ਰਾਵਨ ਹੀ ਹਰੀ ॥
236.e: On meeting Jatayu Ram came to know for certain that Ravana had abducted Sita.

236.g: ਬਾਧ ਨਿਖੰਗ ਚਲੇ ਕਟਿ ਸੌ; ਕਹਿ ਭ੍ਰਾਤ ਈਹਾ ਕਰਿਜੈ ਰਖਵਾਰੀ ॥੩੫੩॥
236.e: He tied his quiver and left for bringing the golden deer, leaving behind Lakshman for Sita’s protection.353.

236.g: ਓਟ ਥਕਯੋ ਕਰਿ ਕੋਟਿ ਨਿਸਾਚਰ; ਸ੍ਰੀ ਰਘੁਬੀਰ ਨਿਦਾਨ ਸੰਘਾਰਯੋ ॥
236.e: The demon Marich tried to put Ram in uncertainty by running away at a high speed, but ultimately he was tired and Ram killed him.

236.g: ਹੇ ਲਹੁ ਬੀਰ, ਉਬਾਰ ਲੈ ਮੋਕਹ; ਯੌ ਕਹਿ ਕੈ ਪੁਨਿ ਰਾਮ ਪੁਕਾਰਯੋ ॥
236.e: But at the time of death he shouted loudly in the voice of Ram, “O Brother, save me.”

236.g: ਜਾਨਕੀ ਬੋਲ ਕੁਬੋਲ ਸੁਨਯੋ ਤਬ ਹੀ ਤਿਹ ਓਰ ਸੁਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਪਠਾਯੋ ॥
236.e: When Sita heard this frightening cry, she sent the mighty Lakshman to that side,

236.g: ਰੇਖ ਕਮਾਨ ਕੀ ਕਾਢ ਮਹਾਬਲ; ਜਾਤ ਭਏ, ਇਤ ਰਾਵਨ ਆਯੋ ॥੩੫੪॥
236.e: Who before leaving drew a line there and then Ravana came in.354.

236.g: ਭੇਖ ਅਲੇਖ ਉਚਾਰ ਕੈ ਰਾਵਣ; ਜਾਤ ਭਏ ਸੀਅ ਕੇ ਢਿਗ ਯੌ ॥
236.e: Wearing the garb of a Yogi and uttering the traditional invocation for alms, Ravan went near Sita,

236.g: ਅਵਿਲੋਕ ਧਨੀ ਧਨਵਾਨ ਬਡੋ; ਤਿਹ ਜਾਇ ਮਿਲੈ ਮਗ ਮੋ ਠਗ ਜਯੋ ॥
236.e: Like a thug visiting a wealthy person and said,

236.g: ਕਛੁ ਦੇਹੁ ਭਿਛਾ ਮ੍ਰਿਗ ਨੈਨ, ਹਮੈ; ਇਹ ਰੇਖ ਮਿਟਾਇ ਹਮੈ ਅਬ ਹੀ ॥
236.e: “O doe-eyed, cross this line and give me some alms,”

236.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਰੇਖ ਭਈ, ਅਵਿਲੋਕ ਲਈ; ਹਰਿ ਸੀਅ, ਉਡਯੋ ਨਭਿ ਕਉ ਤਬ ਹੀ ॥੩੫੫॥
236.e: And when Ravan saw Sita crossing the line, he seized her and began to fly towards the sky.355.

236.g: ਇਤਿ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਬਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਨਾਟਕ ਰਾਮ ਵਤਾਰ ਕਥਾ ਸੀਤਾ ਹਰਨ ਧਿਆਇ ਸਮਾਪਤਮ ॥
236.e: End of the chapter entitled ‘Abduction of Sita’ in Ramavtar in BACHITTAR NATAK.
The One Lord is the Creator of all things, the Cause of causes.
He Himself is wisdom, contemplation and discerning understanding.

236.g: ਦੂਰਿ ਨ ਨੇਰੈ; ਸਭ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਾ ॥
236.e: He is not far away; He is near at hand, with all.
So praise the True One, O Nanak, with love! ||8||1||

237.e: In peace, their bodies' duality is eliminated.

237.g: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸਹਜਿ; ਮਨਿ ਭਇਆ ਅਨੰਦੁ ॥
237.e: Bliss comes naturally to their minds.
They meet the Lord, the Embodiment of Supreme Bliss. ||5||
In peaceful poise, they drink in the Ambrosial Nectar of the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
In peace and poise, they give to the poor.
Their souls naturally delight in the Lord's Sermon.
The Imperishable Lord abides with them. ||6||
In peace and poise, they assume the unchanging position.
In peace and poise, the unstruck vibration of the Shabad resounds.
In peace and poise, the celestial bells resound.
Within their homes, the Supreme Lord God is pervading. ||7||
With intuitive ease, they meet the Lord, according to their karma.
With intuitive ease, they meet with the Guru, in the true Dharma.

237.g: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸਹਜੁ ਭਇਆ; ਸੋ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
237.e: Those who know, attain the poise of intuitive peace.
Slave Nanak is a sacrifice to them. ||8||3||

237.g: ਹਨਵੰਤ ਮਾਰਗ ਮੋ ਮਿਲੇ ਤਬ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਤਾ ਤਾ ਸੋਂ ਕਰੀ ॥੩੬੪॥
237.e: Roaming on the paths (of the forest) Ram met Hanuman and they both became friends.364.

237.g: ਤਿਨ ਆਨ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਰਘੁਰਾਜ ਕੇ; ਕਪਿਰਾਜ ਪਾਇਨ ਡਾਰਯੋ ॥
237.e: Hanuman brought Sugriva the king of monkeys to fall at the feet of Ram.

237.g: ਤਿਨ ਬੈਠ ਗੈਠ ਇਕੈਠ ਹ੍ਵੈ; ਇਹ ਭਾਤਿ ਮੰਤ੍ਰ ਬਿਚਾਰਯੋ ॥
237.e: And all of them unitedly held consultation amongst themselves,

237.g: ਕਪਿ ਬੀਰ ਧੀਰ ਸਧੀਰ ਕੇ; ਭਟ ਮੰਤ੍ਰ ਬੀਰ ਬਿਚਾਰ ਕੈ ॥
237.e: All the ministers sat down and gave their personal views.

237.g: ਅਪਨਾਇ ਸੁਗ੍ਰਿਵ ਕਉ ਚਲੁ; ਕਪਿਰਾਜ ਬਾਲ ਸੰਘਾਰ ਕੈ ॥੩੬੫॥
237.e: Ram killed Bali, the king of monkeys and made Sugriva his permanent ally.365.

237.g: ਇਤਿ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਬਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਨਾਟਕ ਗ੍ਰੰਥੇ ਬਾਲ ਬਧਹ ਧਿਆਇ ਸਮਾਪਤਮ ॥੮॥
237.e: End of the chapter entitled Killing of Bali’ in BACHITTAR NATAK.
Now begins the description of sending of Hanuman in search of Sita :
GEETA MALTI STANZA

237.g: ਦਲ ਬਾਟ ਚਾਰ ਦਿਸਾ ਪਠਯੋ; ਹਨਵੰਤ ਲੰਕ ਪਠੈ ਦਏ ॥
237.e: The army of monkeys was divided into four parts and sent in all the four directions and Hanuman was sent to Lanka.

237.g: ਲੈ ਮੁਦ੍ਰਕਾ ਲਖ ਬਾਰਿਧੈ ਜਹ ਸੀ ਹੁਤੀ ਤਹ ਜਾਤ ਭੇ ॥
237.e: Hanuman took the ring (of Rama) and immediately went and crossed the sea, he reached the place where Sita was kept (by Ravana).

237.g: ਪੁਰ ਜਾਰਿ ਅਛ ਕੁਮਾਰ ਛੈ ਬਨ ਟਾਰਿ ਕੈ ਫਿਰ ਆਇਯੋ ॥
237.e: Destroying Lanka, killing Akshay Kumar and devastating Ashok Vatika, Hanuman came back,

237.g: ਕ੍ਰਿਤ ਚਾਰ ਜੋ ਅਮਰਾਰਿ ਕੋ; ਸਭ ਰਾਮ ਤੀਰ ਜਤਾਇਯੋ ॥੩੬੬॥
237.e: And presented before Ram the creations of Ravana, the ememy of gods.366.

237.g: ਦਲ ਜੋਰ ਕੋਰ ਕਰੋਰ ਲੈ; ਬਡ ਘੋਰ ਤੋਰ ਸਭੈ ਚਲੇ ॥
237.e: Now combining all the forces they all proceeded (with millions of fighters),

237.g: ਰਾਮਚੰਦ੍ਰ ਸੁਗ੍ਰੀਵ ਲਛਮਨ; ਅਉਰ ਸੂਰ ਭਲੇ ਭਲੇ ॥
237.e: And there were mighty warriors like Ram, Sugriva, Lakshman,

237.g: ਜਾਮਵੰਤ ਸੁਖੈਨ ਨੀਲ; ਹਣਵੰਤ ਅੰਗਦ ਕੇਸਰੀ ॥
237.e: Jamvant, Sukhen, Neel, Hanuman, Angad etc. in their army.

237.g: ਕਪਿ ਪੂਤ ਜੂਥ ਪਜੂਥ ਲੈ; ਉਮਡੇ ਚਹੂੰ ਦਿਸ ਕੈ ਝਰੀ ॥੩੬੭॥
237.e: The swarms of troops of the sons of monkeys, gushed forward like clouds from all the four directions.367.

237.g: ਪਾਟਿ ਬਾਰਿਧ ਰਾਜ ਕਉ ਕਰਿ; ਬਾਟਿ ਲਾਘ ਗਏ ਜਬੈ ॥
237.e: When after splitting the sea and forming a passage they all crossed the sea.

237.g: ਦੂਤ ਦਈਤਨ ਕੇ ਹੁਤੇ; ਤਬ ਦਉਰ ਰਾਵਨ ਪੈ ਗਏ ॥
237.e: Then the messengers of Ravana fled towards him to convey the news.

237.g: ਰਨ ਸਾਜ ਬਾਜ ਸਭੈ ਕਰੋ; ਇਕ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਮਨ ਮਾਨੀਐ ॥
237.e: They request him to get ready for war.

237.g: ਗੜ ਲੰਕ ਬੰਕ ਸੰਭਾਰੀਐ; ਰਘੁਬੀਰ ਆਗਮ ਜਾਨੀਐ ॥੩੬੮॥
237.e: And protect the beautiful city of Lanka from the entry of Ram.368.

237.g: ਧੂਮ੍ਰ ਅਛ ਸੁ ਜਾਬਮਾਲ ਬੁਲਾਇ ਵੀਰ ਪਠੈ ਦਏ ॥
237.e: Ravana called Dhumraksha and Jambumali and sent them for war.

237.g: ਸੋਰ ਕੋਰ ਕ੍ਰੋਰ ਕੈ; ਜਹਾ ਰਾਮ ਥੇ ਤਹਾ ਜਾਤ ਭੇ ॥
237.e: Both them shouting terribly reached near Ram.

237.g: ਰੋਸ ਕੈ ਹਨਵੰਤ ਥਾ; ਪਗ ਰੋਪ ਪਾਵ ਪ੍ਰਹਾਰੀਯੰ ॥
237.e: Hanuman in great rage firmly stood on the earth on one foot,

237.g: ਜੂਝਿ ਭੂਮਿ ਗਿਰਯੋ ਬਲੀ; ਸੁਰ ਲੋਕ ਮਾਝਿ ਬਿਹਾਰੀਯੰ ॥੩੬੯॥
237.e: And attacked violently with his second foot with which the mighty Dhumraksha fell down and died.369.
Gauree, Fifth Mehl:
First, they come forth from the womb.
They become attached to their children, spouses and families.
The foods of various sorts and appearances,
will surely pass away, O wretched mortal! ||1||

237.g: ਕਵਨੁ ਅਸਥਾਨੁ; ਜੋ. ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਟਰੈ ॥
237.e: What is that place which never perishes?

237.g: ਕਵਨੁ ਸਬਦੁ; ਜਿਤੁ. ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
237.e: What is that Word by which the dirt of the mind is removed? ||1||Pause||
In the Realm of Indra, death is sure and certain.
The Realm of Brahma shall not remain permanent.
The Realm of Shiva shall also perish.
The three dispositions, Maya and the demons shall vanish. ||2||

237.g: ਗਿਰਿ ਤਰ ਧਰਣਿ; ਗਗਨ ਅਰੁ ਤਾਰੇ ॥
237.e: The mountains, the trees, the earth, the sky and the stars;
the sun, the moon, the wind, water and fire;
day and night, fasting days and their determination;
the Shaastras, the Simritees and the Vedas shall pass away. ||3||
The sacred shrines of pilgrimage, gods, temples and holy books;
rosaries, ceremonial tilak marks on the forehead, meditative people, the pure, and the performers of burnt offerings;
wearing loin cloths, bowing in reverence and the enjoyment of sacred foods
- all these, and all people, shall pass away. ||4||
Social classes, races, Muslims and Hindus;
beasts, birds and the many varieties of beings and creatures;
the entire world and the visible universe
- all forms of existence shall pass away. ||5||
Through the Praises of the Lord, devotional worship, spiritual wisdom and the essence of reality,
eternal bliss and the imperishable true place are obtained.
There, in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, the Lord's Glorious Praises are sung with love.
There, in the city of fearlessness, He dwells forever. ||6||

237.g: ਤਹ ਭਉ ਭਰਮਾ; ਸੋਗੁ ਨ ਚਿੰਤਾ ॥
237.e: There is no fear, doubt, suffering or anxiety there;
there is no coming or going, and no death there.
There is eternal bliss, and the unstruck celestial music there.
The devotees dwell there, with the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises as their support. ||7||
There is no end or limitation to the Supreme Lord God.
Who can embrace His contemplation?
Says Nanak, when the Lord showers His Mercy,
the imperishable home is obtained; in the Saadh Sangat, you shall be saved. ||8||4||
Gauree, Fifth Mehl:
One who kills this is a spiritual hero.
One who kills this is perfect.
One who kills this obtains glorious greatness.

237.g: ਜੋ ਇਸੁ ਮਾਰੇ; ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥
237.e: One who kills this is freed of suffering. ||1||

237.g: ਐਸਾ ਕੋਇ; ਜਿ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਮਾਰਿ ਗਵਾਵੈ ॥
237.e: How rare is such a person, who kills and casts off duality.

237.g: ਇਸਹਿ ਮਾਰਿ; ਰਾਜ ਜੋਗੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
237.e: Killing it, he attains Raja Yoga, the Yoga of meditation and success. ||1||Pause||

238.g: ਜਾਬਮਾਲ ਭਿਰੇ ਕਛੂ; ਪੁਨ ਮਾਰਿ ਐਸੇ ਈ ਕੈ ਲਏ ॥
238.e: Then Jambumali fought in the war but he was also killed in the same manner

238.g: ਭਾਜ ਕੀਨ ਪ੍ਰਵੇਸ ਲੰਕ; ਸੰਦੇਸ ਰਾਵਨ ਸੋ ਦਏ ॥
238.e: The demons accompanying him sped towards Lanka to give the news to Ravana,

238.g: ਧੂਮਰਾਛ ਸੁ ਜਾਬਮਾਲ; ਦੁਹਹੂੰ ਰਾਘਵ ਜੂ ਹਰਿਓ ॥
238.e: That both Dhumraksha and Jambumali had been killed at the hands of Rama.

238.g: ਹੈ ਕਛੂ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਕੇ ਹੀਏ; ਸੁਭ ਮੰਤ੍ਰ ਆਵਤ, ਸੋ ਕਰੋ ॥੩੭੦॥
238.e: They requested him, “O Lord! now whatever please you, take any other measure.”370.

238.g: ਪੇਖ ਤੀਰ ਅਕੰਪਨੈ; ਦਲ ਸੰਗਿ ਦੈ ਸੁ ਪਠੈ ਦਯੋ ॥
238.e: Seeing Akampan near him, Ravana sent him alongwith the forces.

238.g: ਭਾਤਿ ਭਾਤਿ ਬਜੇ ਬਜੰਤ੍ਰ ਨਿਨਦ ਸਦ ਪੁਰੀ ਭਯੋ ॥
238.e: On his departure, many kinds of musical instruments were played, which resounded in the whole city of Lanka.

238.g: ਸੁਰ ਰਾਇ ਆਦਿ ਪ੍ਰਹਸਤ ਤੇ; ਇਹ ਭਾਤਿ ਮੰਤ੍ਰ ਬਿਚਾਰਿਯੋ ॥
238.e: The ministers including Prahasta held consultation

238.g: ਸੀਅ ਦੇ ਮਿਲੋ ਰਘੁਰਾਜ ਕੋ; ਕਸ ਰੋਸ ਰਾਵ, ਸੰਭਾਰਿਯੋ ॥੩੭੧॥
238.e: And thought that Ravana should return Sita to Ram and not offend him more.371.

238.g: ਰਾਵਨ ਬਾਚ ਅੰਗਦ ਸੋ ॥
238.e: Speech of Ravana addressed to Angad :

238.g: ਛਪੈ ਛੰਦ ॥
238.e: CHHAPAI STANZA

238.g: ਅਗਨ ਪਾਕ ਕਹ ਕਰੈ; ਪਵਨ ਮੁਰ ਬਾਰ ਬੁਹਾਰੈ ॥
238.e: The god of fire is my cook and the god of wind is my sweeper,

238.g: ਚਵਰ ਚੰਦ੍ਰਮਾ ਧਰੈ ਸੂਰ ਛਤ੍ਰਹਿ ਸਿਰ ਢਾਰੈ ॥
238.e: The moon-god swings the fly-whisk over my head and the sun-god wields the canopy over my head

238.g: ਮਦ ਲਛਮੀ ਪਿਆਵੰਤ; ਬੇਦ ਮੁਖ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਉਚਾਰਤ ॥
238.e: Lakshmi, the goddess of wealth, serves drinks to me and Brahma recites the Vedic mantras for me.

238.g: ਬਰਨ ਬਾਰ ਨਿਤ ਭਰੇ; ਔਰ ਕੁਲੁਦੇਵ ਜੁਹਾਰਤ ॥
238.e: Varuna is my water-carrier and pays obeisance in front of my family-god

238.g: ਨਿਜ ਕਹਤਿ ਸੁ ਬਲ ਦਾਨਵ ਪ੍ਰਬਲ; ਦੇਤ ਧਨੁਦਿ ਜਛ ਮੋਹਿ ਕਰ ॥
238.e: This is my whole power-formation, besides them all the demon-forces are with me, for which reason the Yakshas etc. gladly present present all types of their wealth to me.

238.g: ਛਪਯ ਛੰਦ ॥
238.e: CHHAPAI STANZA

238.g: ਝਲ ਹਲੰਤ ਤਰਵਾਰ; ਬਜਤ ਬਾਜੰਤ੍ਰ ਮਹਾ ਧੁਨ ॥
238.e: The sound of musical instruments and the striking sound of the swords resounded,

238.g: ਖੜ ਹੜੰਤ ਖਹ ਖੋਲ; ਧਯਾਨ ਤਜਿ ਪਰਤ ਚਵਧ ਮੁਨ ॥
238.e: And the meditation of the ascetics was distracted by the horrible voices of the battlefield.

238.g: ਇਕ ਇਕ ਲੈ ਚਲੈ ਇਕ ਤਨ ਇਕ ਅਰੁਝੈ ॥
238.e: The warriors came forward after one another and began to fight one to one.

238.g: ਅੰਧ ਧੁੰਧ ਪਰ ਗਈ ਹਥਿ ਅਰ ਮੁਖ ਨ ਸੁਝੈ ॥
238.e: There was such a terrible destruction that nothing could be recognized,

238.g: ਸੁਮੁਹੇ ਸੂਰ ਸਾਵੰਤ ਸਭ; ਫਉਜ ਰਾਜ ਅੰਗਦ ਸਮਰ ॥
238.e: The mighty forces alongwith Angad are being seen,

238.g: ਜੈ ਸਦ ਨਿਨਦ ਬਿਹਦ ਹੂਅ ਧਨੁ ਜੰਪਤ ਸੁਰਪੁਰ ਅਮਰ ॥੩੭੨॥
238.e: And the hails of victory began to resound in the sky.372.

238.g: ਇਤ ਅੰਗਦ ਯੁਵਰਾਜ; ਦੁਤੀਅ ਦਿਸ ਬੀਰ ਅਕੰਪਨ ॥
238.e: On this side the crown prince Angad and on that side the mighty Akampan,

238.g: ਕਰਤ ਬ੍ਰਿਸਟ ਸਰ ਧਾਰ; ਤਜਤ ਨਹੀ ਨੈਕ ਅਯੋਧਨ ॥
238.e: Are not feeling tired of showering their arrows.

238.g: ਹਥ ਬਥ ਮਿਲ ਗਈ ਲੁਥ ਬਿਥਰੀ ਅਹਾੜੰ ॥
238.e: The hands are meeting hands and the corpses are lying scattered,

238.g: ਘੁਮੇ ਘਾਇ ਅਘਾਇ ਬੀਰ ਬੰਕੜੇ ਬਬਾੜੰ ॥
238.e: The brave fighters are roaming and killing one another after challenging them.

238.g: ਪਿਖਤ ਬੈਠ ਬਿਬਾਣ ਬਰ ਧੰਨ ਧੰਨ ਜੰਪਤ ਅਮਰ ॥
238.e: The gods are hailing them while sitting in their air-vehicles.

238.g: ਭਵ ਭੂਤ ਭਵਿਖਯ ਭਵਾਨ ਮੋ ਅਬ ਲਗ ਲਖਯੋ ਨ ਅਸ ਸਮਰ ॥੩੭੩॥
238.e: They are saying that they have never seen such-like horrible war earlier.373.

238.g: ਕਹੂੰ ਮੁੰਡ ਪਿਖੀਅਹ ਕਹੂੰ; ਭਕ ਰੁੰਡ ਪਰੇ ਧਰ ॥
238.e: Somewhere the heads are being seen and somewhere the headless trunks are visible

238.g: ਕਿਤਹੀ ਜਾਘ ਤਰਫੰਤ ਕਹੂੰ; ਉਛਰੰਤ ਸੁ ਛਬ ਕਰ ॥
238.e: Somewhere the legs are writhing and jumping

238.g: ਭਰਤ ਪਤ੍ਰ ਖੇਚਰੰ ਕਹੂੰ ਚਾਵੰਡ ਚਿਕਾਰੈਂ ॥
238.e: Somewhere the vampires are filling their vessels with blood

238.g: ਕਿਲਕਤ ਕਤਹ ਮਸਾਨ ਕਹੂੰ; ਭੈਰਵ ਭਭਕਾਰੈਂ ॥
238.e: Somewhere the shrieks of vultures are being heard

238.g: ਇਹ ਭਾਤਿ ਬਿਜੈ ਕਪਿ ਕੀ ਭਈ; ਹਣਯੋ ਅਸੁਰ ਰਾਵਣ ਤਣਾ ॥
238.e: Somewhere the ghosts are shouting violently and somewhere the Bhairavas are laughing.

238.g: ਭੈ ਦਗ ਅਦਗ ਭਗੇ ਹਠੀ ਗਹਿ ਗਹਿ ਕਰ ਦਾਤਨ ਤ੍ਰਿਣਾ ॥੩੭੪॥
238.e: In this way there was victory of Angad and he killed Akampan, the son of Ravana. On his death the frightened demons fled with the blades of grass in their mouths.374.

238.g: ਉਤੈ ਦੂਤ ਰਾਵਣੈ ਜਾਇ; ਹਤ ਬੀਰ ਸੁਣਾਯੋ ॥
238.e: On that side the messengers gave the news of the death of Akampan to Ravana,

238.g: ਇਤ ਕਪਿਪਤ ਅਰੁ ਰਾਮ; ਦੂਤ ਅੰਗਦਹਿ ਪਠਾਯੋ ॥
238.e: And on this side Angand the lord of monkeys was sent as envoy of Ram to Ravna.

238.g: ਕਹੀ ਕਥ ਤਿਹ ਸਥ ਗਥ ਕਰਿ ਤਥ ਸੁਨਾਯੋ ॥
238.e: He was sent to tell all the facts to Ravna

238.g: ਮਿਲਹੁ ਦੇਹੁ ਜਾਨਕੀ; ਕਾਲ ਨਾਤਰ ਤੁਹਿ ਆਯੋ ॥
238.e: And also advise him to return Sita in order to stall his death.

238.g: ਪਗ ਭੇਟ ਚਲਤ ਭਯੋ ਬਾਲ ਸੁਤ; ਪ੍ਰਿਸਟ ਪਾਨ ਰਘੁਬਰ ਧਰੇ ॥
238.e: Angad, the son of Bali, went on his errand after touching the feet of Ram,

238.g: ਭਰ ਅੰਕ ਪੁਲਕਤ ਨ ਸਪਜਿਯੋ; ਭਾਤ ਅਨਿਕ ਆਸਿਖ ਕਰੇ ॥੩੭੫॥
238.e: Who bade him farewell by patting on his back and expressing many types of benedictions.375.

238.g: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
238.e: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

238.g: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਜੁਰੈ; ਤ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਮੀਤੁ ॥
238.e: When someone attaches himself to the Lord, then everyone is his friend.

238.g: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਜੁਰੈ; ਤ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਚੀਤੁ ॥
238.e: When someone attaches himself to the Lord, then his consciousness is steady.

238.g: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਜੁਰੈ; ਨ ਵਿਆਪੈ ਕਾੜੑਾ ॥
238.e: When someone attaches himself to the Lord, he is not afflicted by worries.

238.g: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਜੁਰੈ; ਤ ਹੋਇ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
238.e: When someone attaches himself to the Lord, he is emancipated. ||1||

238.g: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ; ਤੂੰ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਜੋਰੁ ॥
238.e: O my mind, unite yourself with the Lord.

238.g: ਕਾਜਿ ਤੁਹਾਰੈ; ਨਾਹੀ ਹੋਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
238.e: Nothing else is of any use to you. ||1||Pause||

238.g: ਵਡੇ ਵਡੇ; ਜੋ ਦੁਨੀਆਦਾਰ ॥
238.e: The great and powerful people of the world

238.g: ਕਾਹੂ ਕਾਜਿ ਨਾਹੀ; ਗਾਵਾਰ ॥
238.e: are of no use, you fool!

238.g: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਦਾਸੁ; ਨੀਚ ਕੁਲੁ ਸੁਣਹਿ ॥
238.e: The Lord's slave may be born of humble origins,

238.g: ਤਿਸ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ; ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਉਧਰਹਿ ॥੨॥
238.e: but in his company, you shall be saved in an instant. ||2||

238.g: ਕੋਟਿ ਮਜਨ; ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸੁਣਿ ਨਾਮ ॥
238.e: Hearing the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is equal to millions of cleansing baths.

238.g: ਕੋਟਿ ਪੂਜਾ; ਜਾ ਕੈ ਹੈ ਧਿਆਨ ॥
238.e: Meditating on it is equal to millions of worship ceremonies.

238.g: ਕੋਟਿ ਪੁੰਨ; ਸੁਣਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
238.e: Hearing the Word of the Lord's Bani is equal to giving millions in alms.

238.g: ਕੋਟਿ ਫਲਾ; ਗੁਰ ਤੇ. ਬਿਧਿ ਜਾਣੀ ॥੩॥
238.e: To know the way, through the Guru, is equal to millions of rewards. ||3||

238.g: ਮਨ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਮਹਿ; ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਚੇਤ ॥
238.e: Within your mind, over and over again, think of Him,

238.g: ਬਿਨਸਿ ਜਾਹਿ; ਮਾਇਆ ਕੇ ਹੇਤ ॥
238.e: and your love of Maya shall depart.

238.g: ਹਰਿ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ; ਤੁਮਰੈ ਸੰਗਿ ॥
238.e: The Imperishable Lord is always with you.

238.g: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ; ਰਚੁ ਰਾਮ ਕੈ ਰੰਗਿ ॥੪॥
238.e: O my mind, immerse yourself in the Love of the Lord. ||4||

238.g: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਕਾਮਿ; ਉਤਰੈ ਸਭ ਭੂਖ ॥
238.e: Working for Him, all hunger departs.

238.g: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਕਾਮਿ; ਨ ਜੋਹਹਿ ਦੂਤ ॥
238.e: Working for Him, the Messenger of Death will not be watching you.

238.g: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਕਾਮਿ; ਤੇਰਾ ਵਡ ਗਮਰੁ ॥
238.e: Working for Him, you shall obtain glorious greatness.

238.g: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਕਾਮਿ; ਹੋਵਹਿ ਤੂੰ ਅਮਰੁ ॥੫॥
238.e: Working for Him, you shall become immortal. ||5||

238.g: ਜਾ ਕੇ ਚਾਕਰ ਕਉ; ਨਹੀ ਡਾਨ ॥
238.e: His servant does not suffer punishment.

238.g: ਜਾ ਕੇ ਚਾਕਰ ਕਉ; ਨਹੀ ਬਾਨ ॥
238.e: His servant suffers no loss.

238.g: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਦਫਤਰਿ; ਪੁਛੈ ਨ ਲੇਖਾ ॥
238.e: In His Court, His servant does not have to answer for his account.

238.g: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਚਾਕਰੀ; ਕਰਹੁ ਬਿਸੇਖਾ ॥੬॥
238.e: So serve Him with distinction. ||6||

238.g: ਜਾ ਕੈ; ਊਨ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਾਹੂ ਬਾਤ ॥
238.e: He is not lacking in anything.

238.g: ਏਕਹਿ ਆਪਿ; ਅਨੇਕਹਿ ਭਾਤਿ ॥
238.e: He Himself is One, although He appears in so many forms.

238.g: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ; ਹੋਇ ਸਦਾ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥
238.e: By His Glance of Grace, you shall be happy forever.

238.g: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ; ਕਰਿ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਘਾਲ ॥੭॥
238.e: So work for Him, O my mind. ||7||

238.g: ਨਾ ਕੋ ਚਤੁਰੁ; ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋ ਮੂੜਾ ॥
238.e: No one is clever, and no one is foolish.

238.g: ਨਾ ਕੋ ਹੀਣੁ; ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋ ਸੂਰਾ ॥
238.e: No one is weak, and no one is a hero.

238.g: ਪ੍ਰਤਿ ਉਤਰ ਸੰਬਾਦ ॥
238.e: Responsive Dialogue :

238.g: ਛਪੈ ਛੰਦ ॥
238.e: CHHAPAI STANZA

238.g: ਦੇਹ ਸੀਆ ਦਸਕੰਧ, ਛਾਹਿ ਨਹੀ ਦੇਖਨ ਪੈਹੋ ॥
238.e: Angad says, “O ten-headed Ravana! Return Sita, you will not be able to see her shadow (i.e. you will be killed).

238.g: ਲੰਕ ਛੀਨ ਲੀਜੀਐ; ਲੰਕ ਲਖਿ ਜੀਤ ਨ ਜੈਹੋ ॥
238.e: Ravana says, “None can conquer me ever after the seixure of Lanka.”

238.g: ਕ੍ਰੁਧ ਬਿਖੈ ਜਿਨ ਘੋਰੁ ਪਿਖ ਕਸ ਜੁਧੁ ਮਚੈ ਹੈ ॥
238.e: Angad says again, “Your intellect has been spoiled by your rage, how will you be able to wage the war.”

238.g: ਰਾਮ ਸਹਿਤ ਕਪਿ ਕਟਕ; ਆਜ ਮ੍ਰਿਗ ਸਯਾਰ ਖਵੈ ਹੈ ॥
238.e: Ravana replies, “I shall cause even today all the army of monkeys alongwith Ram to be devoured by the animals and jackals.”

238.g: ਜਿਨ ਕਰ ਸੁ ਗਰਬੁ, ਸੁਣ ਮੂੜ ਮਤ, ਗਰਬ ਗਵਾਇ ਘਨੇਰ ਘਰ ॥
238.e: Angad says, “O Ravana, do not be egoistic, this ego has destroyed many houses.”

238.g: ਬਸ ਕਰੇ ਸਰਬ ਘਰ ਗਰਬ, ਹਮ; ਏ ਕਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਦ੍ਵੈ ਦੀਨ ਨਰ ॥੩੭੬॥
238.e: Ravana replies. “I am proud because I have brought under control all with my own power, then what power these two human beings Ram and Lakshman can wield.”376.

238.g: ਜੋ ਇਸੁ ਮਾਰੇ; ਤਿਸ ਕਉ ਭਉ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
238.e: One who kills this has no fear.

238.g: ਜੋ ਇਸੁ ਮਾਰੇ; ਸੁ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਹਿ ॥
238.e: One who kills this is absorbed in the Naam.

238.g: ਜੋ ਇਸੁ ਮਾਰੇ; ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਬੁਝੈ ॥
238.e: One who kills this has his desires quenched.

238.g: ਜੋ ਇਸੁ ਮਾਰੇ; ਸੁ ਦਰਗਹ ਸਿਝੈ ॥੨॥
238.e: One who kills this is approved in the Court of the Lord. ||2||

238.g: ਜੋ ਇਸੁ ਮਾਰੇ; ਸੋ ਧਨਵੰਤਾ ॥
238.e: One who kills this is wealthy and prosperous.

238.g: ਜੋ ਇਸੁ ਮਾਰੇ; ਸੋ ਪਤਿਵੰਤਾ ॥
238.e: One who kills this is honorable.

238.g: ਜੋ ਇਸੁ ਮਾਰੇ; ਸੋਈ ਜਤੀ ॥
238.e: One who kills this is truly a celibate.

238.g: ਜੋ ਇਸੁ ਮਾਰੇ; ਤਿਸੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਗਤੀ ॥੩॥
238.e: One who kills this attains salvation. ||3||

238.g: ਜੋ ਇਸੁ ਮਾਰੇ; ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਆਇਆ ਗਨੀ ॥
238.e: One who kills this - his coming is auspicious.

238.g: ਜੋ ਇਸੁ ਮਾਰੇ; ਸੁ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਧਨੀ ॥
238.e: One who kills this is steady and wealthy.

238.g: ਜੋ ਇਸੁ ਮਾਰੇ; ਸੋ ਵਡਭਾਗਾ ॥
238.e: One who kills this is very fortunate.

238.g: ਜੋ ਇਸੁ ਮਾਰੇ; ਸੁ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਜਾਗਾ ॥੪॥
238.e: One who kills this remains awake and aware, night and day. ||4||

238.g: ਜੋ ਇਸੁ ਮਾਰੇ; ਸੁ ਜੀਵਨ ਮੁਕਤਾ ॥
238.e: One who kills this is Jivan Mukta, liberated while yet alive.

238.g: ਜੋ ਇਸੁ ਮਾਰੇ; ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਜੁਗਤਾ ॥
238.e: One who kills this lives a pure lifestyle.

238.g: ਜੋ ਇਸੁ ਮਾਰੇ; ਸੋਈ ਸੁਗਿਆਨੀ ॥
238.e: One who kills this is spiritually wise.

238.g: ਜੋ ਇਸੁ ਮਾਰੇ; ਸੁ ਸਹਜ ਧਿਆਨੀ ॥੫॥
238.e: One who kills this meditates intuitively. ||5||

238.g: ਇਸੁ ਮਾਰੀ ਬਿਨੁ; ਥਾਇ ਨ ਪਰੈ ॥
238.e: Without killing this, one is not acceptable,

238.g: ਕੋਟਿ ਕਰਮ; ਜਾਪ ਤਪ ਕਰੈ ॥
238.e: Even though one may perform millions of rituals, chants and austerities.

238.g: ਇਸੁ ਮਾਰੀ ਬਿਨੁ; ਜਨਮੁ ਨ ਮਿਟੈ ॥
238.e: Without killing this, one does not escape the cycle of reincarnation.

238.g: ਇਸੁ ਮਾਰੀ ਬਿਨੁ; ਜਮ ਤੇ. ਨਹੀ ਛੁਟੈ ॥੬॥
238.e: Without killing this, one does not escape death. ||6||

238.g: ਇਸੁ ਮਾਰੀ ਬਿਨੁ; ਗਿਆਨੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
238.e: Without killing this, one does not obtain spiritual wisdom.

238.g: ਇਸੁ ਮਾਰੀ ਬਿਨੁ; ਜੂਠਿ ਨ ਧੋਈ ॥
238.e: Without killing this, one's impurity is not washed off.

238.g: ਇਸੁ ਮਾਰੀ ਬਿਨੁ; ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਮੈਲਾ ॥
238.e: Without killing this, everything is filthy.

238.g: ਇਸੁ ਮਾਰੀ ਬਿਨੁ; ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਜਉਲਾ ॥੭॥
238.e: Without killing this, everything is a losing game. ||7||

238.g: ਜਾ ਕਉ; ਭਏ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਨਿਧਿ ॥
238.e: When the Lord, the Treasure of Mercy, bestows His Mercy,

238.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਭਈ ਖਲਾਸੀ; ਹੋਈ ਸਗਲ ਸਿਧਿ ॥
238.e: one obtains release, and attains total perfection.

238.g: ਗੁਰਿ; ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਹੈ ਮਾਰੀ ॥
238.e: One whose duality has been killed by the Guru,

238.g: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ; ਸੋ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ॥੮॥੫॥
238.e: says Nanak, contemplates God. ||8||5||

239.g: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
239.e: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

239.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਿਮਰਨ; ਜੈਸੇ ਸਰਪ ਆਰਜਾਰੀ ॥
239.e: Without meditating in remembrance on the Lord, one's life is like that of a snake.

239.g: ਤਿਉ ਜੀਵਹਿ ਸਾਕਤ; ਨਾਮੁ ਬਿਸਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
239.e: This is how the faithless cynic lives, forgetting the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||

239.g: ਏਕ ਨਿਮਖ; ਜੋ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਮਹਿ ਜੀਆ ॥
239.e: One who lives in meditative remembrance, even for an instant,

239.g: ਕੋਟਿ ਦਿਨਸ ਲਾਖ; ਸਦਾ ਥਿਰੁ ਥੀਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
239.e: lives for hundreds of thousands and millions of days, and becomes stable forever. ||1||Pause||

239.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਿਮਰਨ; ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਕਰਮ ਕਰਾਸ ॥
239.e: Without meditating in remembrance on the Lord, one's actions and works are cursed.

239.g: ਕਾਗ ਬਤਨ; ਬਿਸਟਾ ਮਹਿ ਵਾਸ ॥੨॥
239.e: Like the crow's beak, he dwells in manure. ||2||

239.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਿਮਰਨ; ਭਏ ਕੂਕਰ ਕਾਮ ॥
239.e: Without meditating in remembrance on the Lord, one acts like a dog.

239.g: ਸਾਕਤ. ਬੇਸੁਆ ਪੂਤ; ਨਿਨਾਮ ॥੩॥
239.e: The faithless cynic is nameless, like the prostitute's son. ||3||

239.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਿਮਰਨ; ਜੈਸੇ ਸੀਙ ਛਤਾਰਾ ॥
239.e: Without meditating in remembrance on the Lord, one is like a horned ram.

239.g: ਬੋਲਹਿ ਕੂਰੁ; ਸਾਕਤ ਮੁਖੁ ਕਾਰਾ ॥੪॥
239.e: The faithless cynic barks out his lies, and his face is blackened. ||4||

239.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਿਮਰਨ; ਗਰਧਭ ਕੀ ਨਿਆਈ ॥
239.e: Without meditating in remembrance on the Lord, one is like a donkey.

239.g: ਸਾਕਤ; ਥਾਨ ਭਰਿਸਟ. ਫਿਰਾਹੀ ॥੫॥
239.e: The faithless cynic wanders around in polluted places. ||5||

239.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਿਮਰਨ; ਕੂਕਰ ਹਰਕਾਇਆ ॥
239.e: Without meditating in remembrance on the Lord, one is like a mad dog.

239.g: ਸਾਕਤ ਲੋਭੀ; ਬੰਧੁ. ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੬॥
239.e: The greedy, faithless cynic falls into entanglements. ||6||

239.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਿਮਰਨ; ਹੈ ਆਤਮ ਘਾਤੀ ॥
239.e: Without meditating in remembrance on the Lord, he murders his own soul.

239.g: ਸਾਕਤ ਨੀਚ; ਤਿਸੁ ਕੁਲੁ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਤੀ ॥੭॥
239.e: The faithless cynic is wretched, without family or social standing. ||7||

239.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਭਇਆ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ; ਤਿਸੁ ਸਤਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥
239.e: When the Lord becomes merciful, one joins the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation.

239.g: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ; ਗੁਰਿ. ਜਗਤੁ ਤਰਾਇਆ ॥੮॥੭॥
239.e: Says Nanak, the Guru has saved the world. ||8||7||

239.g: ਵੇ ਜੁਧ ਜੀਤ ਤੇ ਜਾਹਿਗੇ ਕਹਾ ਦੋਇ ਤੇ ਦੀਨ ਨਰ ॥੩੭੭॥
239.e: The person about whom you are talking, both of them are very low and helpless men, how shall then they win the war?377.

239.g: ਕਹਿ ਹਾਰਯੋ ਕਪਿ ਕੋਟਿ; ਦਈਤ ਪਤਿ ਏਕ ਨ ਮਾਨੀ ॥
239.e: Angad, the monkey-chief, advice Ravana several times, but he did not accept his advice.

239.g: ਉਠਤ ਪਾਵ ਰੁਪਿਯੋ ਸਭਾ ਮਧਿ; ਸੋ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੀ ॥
239.e: When he got up, he firmly planted his foot in the assembly and challenged them to remove his foot (from the floor)

239.g: ਥਕੇ ਸਕਲ ਅਸੁਰਾਰ ਪਾਵ ਕਿਨਹੂੰ ਨ ਉਚਕਯੋ ॥
239.e: None of the demons could do that and accepted defeat

239.g: ਗਿਰੇ ਧਰਨ ਮੁਰਛਾਇ ਬਿਮਨ ਦਾਨਵ ਦਲ ਥਕਯੋ ॥
239.e: Many of them fell down unconscious because of their spent-up strength.

239.g: ਲੈ ਚਲਯੋ ਬਭੀਛਨ ਭ੍ਰਾਤ ਤਿਹ; ਬਾਲ ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਧੂਸਰ ਬਰਨ ॥
239.e: That earthen-coloured Angad left the court of Ravana alongwith Vibhishan.

239.g: ਭਟ ਹਟਕ ਬਿਕਟ ਤਿਹ ਨਾ ਸਕੇ; ਚਲਿ ਆਯੋ ਜਿਤ ਰਾਮ ਰਨ ॥੩੭੮॥
239.e: When the demons tried to obstruct him, he routed and destroyed them and winning the battle in favour of Ram, he came to him.378.

239.g: ਕਹਿ ਬੁਲਯੋ ਲੰਕੇਸ ਤਾਹਿ; ਪ੍ਰਭ ਰਾਜੀਵ ਲੋਚਨ ॥
239.e: Angad said on reaching, “O lotus-eyed Ram! the king of Lanka has called you for war.”

239.g: ਕੁਟਲ ਅਲਕ ਮੁਖ ਛਕੇ; ਸਕਲ ਸੰਤਨ ਦੁਖ ਮੋਚਨ ॥
239.e: At that time some curly locks of hair were walking and looking at the beauty of his anguished face

239.g: ਕੁਪੈ ਸਰਬ ਕਪਿਰਾਜ ਬਿਜੈ ਪਹਲੀ ਰਣ ਚਖੀ ॥
239.e: The monkeys who had been victorious over Ravana earlier, were highly enraged on listening to the word of Angad about Ravana.

239.g: ਫਿਰੈ ਲੰਕ ਗੜਿ ਘੇਰਿ ਦਿਸਾ ਦਛਣੀ ਪਰਖੀ ॥
239.e: They marched towards the South in order to advance towards Lanka.

239.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਰੈ ਬਭੀਛਨ ਲੰਕਪਤਿ; ਸੁਣੀ ਬਾਤਿ ਰਾਵਣ ਘਰਣਿ ॥
239.e: When, on this side Mandodari, the wife of Ravana, learnt about the scheme of Ram for making Vibhishana the king of Lanka,

239.g: ਸੁਧਿ ਸਤ ਤਬਿ ਬਿਸਰਤ ਭਈ ਗਿਰੀ ਧਰਣ ਪਰ ਹੁਐ ਬਿਮਣ ॥੩੭੯॥
239.e: She fell down unconscious on the earth.379.

239.g: ਮਦੋਦਰੀ ਬਾਚ ॥
239.e: The Speech of Mandodari :

239.g: ਉਟੰਙਣ ਛੰਦ ॥
239.e: UTANGAN STANZA

239.g: ਸੂਰਬੀਰਾ ਸਜੇ, ਘੋਰ ਬਾਜੇ ਬਜੇ; ਭਾਜ ਕੰਤਾ, ਸੁਣੇ ਰਾਮ ਆਏ ॥
239.e: The warriors are decorating themselves and the horrible battle-drums are resounding, O my husband! You may flee for your safety because Ram has arrived

239.g: ਬਾਲ ਮਾਰਯੋ ਬਲੀ, ਸਿੰਧ ਪਾਟਯੋ ਜਿਨੈ; ਤਾਹਿ ਸੌ ਬੈਰਿ ਕੈਸੇ ਰਚਾਏ ॥
239.e: He who has killed Bali, who has splitted the sea and created the passage, why have you created enmity with him?

239.g: ਬਯਾਧ ਜੀਤਯੋ ਜਿਨੈ, ਜੰਭ ਮਾਰਯੋ ਉਨੈ; ਰਾਮ ਅਉਤਾਰ ਸੋਈ ਸੁਹਾਏ ॥
239.e: He, who has killed Byadh and Jambasur, it is the same power, which has manifested itself as Ram

239.g: ਦੇ ਮਿਲੋ ਜਾਨਕੀ, ਬਾਤ ਹੈ ਸਿਆਨ ਕੀ; ਚਾਮ ਕੇ ਦਾਮ ਕਾਹੇ ਚਲਾਏ ॥੩੮੦॥
239.e: Return Sita to him and see him, this is the only wise thing, do not try to introduce the coins of leather.380.

239.g: ਜਿਤੁ ਕੋ ਲਾਇਆ; ਤਿਤ ਹੀ ਲਾਗਾ ॥
239.e: As the Lord attaches someone, so is he attached.

239.g: ਸੋ ਸੇਵਕੁ; ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਸੁ ਭਾਗਾ ॥੮॥੬॥
239.e: He alone is the Lord's servant, O Nanak, who is so blessed. ||8||6||

239.g: ਰਾਵਣ ਬਾਚ ॥
239.e: Speech of Ravana :

239.g: ਬਾਵਰੀ ਰਾਡ, ਕਿਆ ਭਾਡਿ ਬਾਤੈ ਬਕੈ, ਰੰਕ ਸੇ ਰਾਮ ਕਾ ਛੋਡ ਰਾਸਾ ॥
239.e: O foolish prostitute! why do you prattle Stop the praises of Ram

239.g: ਕਾਢਹੋ ਬਾਸਿ ਦੈ ਬਾਨ ਬਾਜੀਗਰੀ; ਦੇਖਿਹੋ ਆਜ ਤਾ ਕੋ ਤਮਾਸਾ ॥
239.e: He will only discharge very small arrows like incense-stick towards me, I shall see this sport today.

239.g: ਬੀਸ ਬਾਹੇ ਧਰੰ, ਸੀਸ ਦਸਯੰ ਸਿਰੰ; ਸੈਣ ਸੰਬੂਹ ਹੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਮੇਰੇ ॥
239.e: I have twenty arms and ten heads and all the forces are with me

239.g: ਭਾਜ ਜੈ ਹੈ ਕਹਾ ਬਾਟਿ ਪੈਹੈਂ, ਊਹਾ ਮਾਰਿਹੌ, ਬਾਜ ਜੈਸੇ ਬਟੇਰੇ ॥੩੮੬॥
239.e: Ram will not even get passage for running away, wherever I shall find him, I shall kill him there like a flacon killing a quil.386.

239.g: ਮਦੋਦਰੀ ਬਾਚ ॥
239.e: Speech of Mandodari :

239.g: ਤਾਰਕਾ ਜਾਤ ਹੀ ਘਾਤ ਕੀਨੀ ਜਿਨੈ; ਅਉਰ ਸੁਬਾਹ ਮਾਰੀਚ ਮਾਰੇ ॥
239.e: He who has killed Taraka, Subahu and Marich,

239.g: ਬਯਾਧ ਬਧਯੋ ਖਰੰਦੂਖਣੰ ਖੇਤ ਥੈ ਏਕ ਹੀ ਬਾਣ ਸੋਂ ਬਾਲ ਮਾਰੇ ॥
239.e: And also killed Viradh and Khar-Dushan, and killed Bali with one arrow

239.g: ਧੁਮ੍ਰ ਅਛਾਦ ਅਉ ਜਾਬੁਮਾਲੀ ਬਲੀ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਹੀਣੰ ਕਰਯੋ ਜੁਧ ਜੈ ਕੈ ॥
239.e: He who has destroyed Dhumraksha and Jambumali in the war,

239.g: ਮਾਰਿਹੈਂ ਤੋਹਿ ਯੌ, ਸਯਾਰ ਕੇ ਸਿੰਘ ਜਯੋ; ਲੇਹਿਗੇ ਲੰਕ ਕੋ ਡੰਕ ਦੈ ਕੈ ॥੩੮੨॥
239.e: He will conquer you by challenging you and kill you like a lion killing a jackal.382.

239.g: ਮਦੋਦਰੀ ਬਾਚ ॥
239.e: Speech of Mandodari :

239.g: ਤਾਸ ਨੇਜੇ ਢੁਲੈ, ਘੋਰ ਬਾਜੇ ਬਜੈ; ਰਾਮ ਲੀਨੇ ਦਲੈ ਆਨ ਢੂਕੇ ॥
239.e: Look there, the swinging lances are visible, the terrible instruments are resounding and Ram has arrived with his mighty forces

239.g: ਬਾਨਰੀ ਪੂਤ ਚਿੰਕਾਰ ਅਪਾਰੰ ਕਰੰ; ਮਾਰ ਮਾਰੰ ਚਹੂੰ ਓਰ ਕੂਕੇ ॥
239.e: The sound of “kill, kill” is emanating form the army of monkeys from all the four sides

239.g: ਭੀਮ ਭੇਰੀ ਬਜੈ, ਜੰਗ ਜੋਧਾ ਗਜੈ; ਬਾਨ ਚਾਪੈ ਚਲੈ ਨਾਹਿ ਜਉ ਲੌ ॥
239.e: O Ravana! till the time the war-drums resound and the thundering warriors discharge their arrows

239.g: ਬਾਤ ਕੋ ਮਾਨੀਐ, ਘਾਤੁ ਪਹਿਚਾਨੀਐ; ਰਾਵਰੀ ਦੇਹ ਕੀ ਸਾਤ ਤਉ ਲੌ ॥੩੮੪॥
239.e: Recognising the opportunity before that, accept my saying for the protection of your body (and leave the idea of war).384.

239.g: ਘਾਟ ਘਾਟੈ ਰੁਕੌ, ਬਾਟ ਬਾਟੈ ਤੁਪੋ; ਐਂਠ ਬੈਠੇ ਕਹਾ, ਰਾਮ ਆਏ ॥
239.e: Obstruct the movement of the armies on the sea-shore and other routes, because now ram has arrived,

239.g: ਖੋਰ ਹਰਾਮ ਹਰੀਫ ਕੀ ਆਂਖ ਤੈ ਚਾਮ ਕੇ ਜਾਤ ਕੈਸੇ ਚਲਾਏ ॥
239.e: Do all the work by removing the veil of heresy form your eyes and do not become self-willed.

239.g: ਹੋਇਗੋ ਖੁਆਰ, ਬਿਸੀਆਰ ਖਾਨਾ ਤੁਰਾ; ਬਾਨਰੀ ਪੂਤ ਜਉ ਲੌ ਨ ਗਜਿ ਹੈ ॥
239.e: If you remain in distress, your family will be destroyed  you can feel yourself protected till the army of monkeys does not begin its violent thunderings

239.g: ਲੰਕ ਕੋ ਛਾਡਿ ਕੈ, ਕੋਟਿ ਕੇ ਫਾਧ ਕੈ; ਆਸੁਰੀ ਪੂਤ ਲੈ ਘਾਸਿ ਭਜਿ ਹੈ ॥੩੮੫॥
239.e: After that all the son demos will flee, after jumping over the walls of th citadel and pressing the blades of grass in their mouths.385.

239.g: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
239.e: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

239.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ; ਮੋਹਿ. ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
239.e: Through the Guru's Word, I have attained the supreme status.

239.g: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ; ਮੇਰੀ ਪੈਜ ਰਖਾਈ ॥੧॥
239.e: The Perfect Guru has preserved my honor. ||1||

239.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ; ਧਿਆਇਓ ਮੋਹਿ ਨਾਉ ॥
239.e: Through the Guru's Word, I meditate on the Name.

239.g: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ; ਮੋਹਿ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਥਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
239.e: By Guru's Grace, I have obtained a place of rest. ||1||Pause||

239.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ; ਸੁਣਿ ਰਸਨ ਵਖਾਣੀ ॥
239.e: I listen to the Guru's Word, and chant it with my tongue.

239.g: ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ; ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਮੇਰੀ ਬਾਣੀ ॥੨॥
239.e: By Guru's Grace, my speech is like nectar. ||2||

239.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ; ਮਿਟਿਆ ਮੇਰਾ ਆਪੁ ॥
239.e: Through the Guru's Word, my selfishness and conceit have been removed.

239.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਦਇਆ ਤੇ; ਮੇਰਾ ਵਡ ਪਰਤਾਪੁ ॥੩॥
239.e: Through the Guru's kindness, I have obtained glorious greatness. ||3||

239.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ; ਮਿਟਿਆ ਮੇਰਾ ਭਰਮੁ ॥
239.e: Through the Guru's Word, my doubts have been removed.

239.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ; ਪੇਖਿਓ ਸਭੁ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ॥੪॥
239.e: Through the Guru's Word, I see God everywhere. ||4||

239.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ; ਕੀਨੋ ਰਾਜੁ ਜੋਗੁ ॥
239.e: Through the Guru's Word, I practice Raja Yoga, the Yoga of meditation and success.

239.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ; ਤਰਿਆ ਸਭੁ ਲੋਗੁ ॥੫॥
239.e: In the Company of the Guru, all the people of the world are saved. ||5||

239.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ; ਮੇਰੇ ਕਾਰਜ ਸਿਧਿ ॥
239.e: Through the Guru's Word, my affairs are resolved.

239.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ; ਪਾਇਆ ਨਾਉ ਨਿਧਿ ॥੬॥
239.e: Through the Guru's Word, I have obtained the nine treasures. ||6||

239.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਨੀ; ਮੇਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਆਸਾ ॥
239.e: Whoever places his hopes in my Guru,

239.g: ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਕਟੀਐ; ਜਮ ਕੀ ਫਾਸਾ ॥੭॥
239.e: has the noose of death cut away. ||7||

239.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ; ਜਾਗਿਆ ਮੇਰਾ ਕਰਮੁ ॥
239.e: Through the Guru's Word, my good karma has been awakened.

239.g: ਨਾਨਕ; ਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ॥੮॥੮॥
239.e: O Nanak, meeting with the Guru, I have found the Supreme Lord God. ||8||8||

239.g: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
239.e: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

239.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਕਉ; ਸਿਮਰਉ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ॥
239.e: I remember the Guru with each and every breath.

239.g: ਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ; ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਰੀ ਰਾਸਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
239.e: The Guru is my breath of life, the True Guru is my wealth. ||1||Pause||

239.g: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਦਰਸਨੁ; ਦੇਖਿ ਦੇਖਿ ਜੀਵਾ ॥
239.e: Beholding the Blessed Vision of the Guru's Darshan, I live.

239.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ; ਧੋਇ ਧੋਇ ਪੀਵਾ ॥੧॥
239.e: I wash the Guru's Feet, and drink in this water. ||1||

239.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਰੇਣੁ; ਨਿਤ ਮਜਨੁ ਕਰਉ ॥
239.e: I take my daily bath in the dust of the Guru's Feet.

239.g: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੀ; ਹਉਮੈ ਮਲੁ ਹਰਉ ॥੨॥
239.e: The egotistical filth of countless incarnations is washed off. ||2||

239.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਕਉ; ਝੂਲਾਵਉ ਪਾਖਾ ॥
239.e: I wave the fan over the Guru.
