249.e: The discs glittered, the lances moved and the fighters with matted hair sped up to fight as if they are going to take a bath in the Ganges.

249.g: ਸੰਘਰੇ ਸੂਰ ਆਘਾਇ ਘਾਇ ॥
ਬਰਖੰਤ ਬਾਣ ਚੜ ਚਉਪ ਚਾਇ ॥੪੭੨॥
249.e: The wounded warriors were killed and on the other hand the warriors began to shower arrows with fourfold zeal.472.

249.g: ਸਮੁਲੇ ਸੂਰ ਆਰੁਹੇ ਜੰਗ ॥
ਬਰਖੰਤ ਬਾਣ ਬਿਖ ਧਰ ਸੁਰੰਗ ॥
249.e: The frightful warriors entangled in war are showering arrows like poisonous serpents

249.g: ਨਭਿ ਹ੍ਵੈ ਅਲੋਪ ਸਰ ਬਰਖ ਧਾਰ ॥
ਸਭ ਊਚ ਨੀਚ ਕਿੰਨੇ ਸੁਮਾਰ ॥੪੭੩॥
249.e: With the shower of arrows the sky is not visible and there in no differentiation between high and low.473.

249.g: ਸਭ ਸਸਤ੍ਰ ਅਸਤ੍ਰ ਬਿਦਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਬੀਨ ॥
ਸਰ ਧਾਰ ਬਰਖ ਸਰਦਾਰ ਚੀਨ ॥
249.e: All the warriors specialize in the science of weaponry and locating the general they are showering arrows on them

249.g: ਰਘੁਰਾਜ ਆਦਿ ਮੋਹੇ ਸੁ ਬੀਰ ॥
ਦਲ ਸਹਿਤ ਭੂਮ ਡਿਗੇ ਅਧੀਰ ॥੪੭੪॥
249.e: Even Ram, the king of Raghu clan was beguiled and fell on the earth alongwith his army.474.

249.g: ਤਬ ਕਹੀ ਦੂਤ ਰਾਵਣਹਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
ਕਪਿ ਕਟਕ ਆਜੁ ਜੀਤਯੋ ਬਨਾਇ ॥
249.e: Then the messengers went to give the news to Ravana that the forces of monkeys have been defeated

249.g: ਸੀਅ ਭਜਹੁ ਆਜੁ ਹੁਐ ਕੈ ਨਿਚੀਤ ॥
ਸੰਘਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਰਣ ਇੰਦ੍ਰਜੀਤ ॥੪੭੫॥
249.e: And he could certainly wed Sita on that day because Inderjit has killed ram in the war.475.

249.g: ਤਬ ਕਹੇ ਬੈਣ ਤ੍ਰਿਜਟੀ ਬੁਲਾਇ ॥
ਰਣ ਮ੍ਰਿਤਕ ਰਾਮ ਸੀਤਹਿ ਦਿਖਾਇ ॥
249.e: Then Ravana called the demoness named Trajata and asked her to show the dead Ram to Sita

249.g: ਲੈ ਗਈ ਨਾਥ ਜਹਿ ਗਿਰੇ ਖੇਤ ॥
ਮ੍ਰਿਗ ਮਾਰ ਸਿੰਘ ਜਯੋ ਸੁਪਤ ਅਚੇਤ ॥੪੭੬॥
249.e: She rook away Sita from that place with her tantric power to the place where ram was sleeping in unconscious state like a lion after killing the deer.476.

249.g: ਸੀਅ ਨਿਰਖ ਨਾਥ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਰਿਸਾਨ ॥
ਦਸ ਅਉਰ ਚਾਰ ਬਿਦਿਆ ਨਿਧਾਨ ॥
249.e: Seeing Ram in such a state, the mind of Sita was filled with extreme agony because Ram was the store-house of fourteen arts and it was impossible to make her believe in such an event

249.g: ਪੜ ਨਾਗ ਮੰਤ੍ਰ ਸੰਘਰੀ ਪਾਸ ॥
ਪਤਿ ਭ੍ਰਾਤ ਜਯਾਇ ਚਿਤ ਭਯੋ ਹੁਲਾਸ ॥੪੭੭॥
249.e: Sita went near Ram reciting Nagmantra and reviving both Ram and Lakshman her mind was filled with joy.477.

249.g: ਸੀਅ ਗਈ ਜਗੇ ਅੰਗਰਾਇ ਰਾਮ ॥
ਦਲ ਸਹਿਤ ਭ੍ਰਾਤ ਜੁਤ ਧਰਮ ਧਾਮ ॥
249.e: When Sita went back, Ram woke up alongwith his brother and forces.

249.g: ਬਜੇ ਸੁ ਨਾਦਿ ਗਜੇ ਸੁ ਬੀਰ ॥
ਸਜੇ ਹਥਿਯਾਰ ਭਜੇ ਅਧੀਰ ॥੪੭੮॥
249.e: The brave fighters thundered bedecking themselves with weapons and the great warriors with power of endurance began to run away from the battlefield.478.

249.g: ਸੰਮੁਲੇ ਸੂਰ ਸਰ ਬਰਖ ਜੁਧ ॥
ਹਨ ਸਾਲ ਤਾਲ ਬਿਕ੍ਰਾਲ ਕ੍ਰੂਧ ॥
249.e: The warriors with frightful prowess began to shower arrows in the war and being highly infuriated began to destroy even the trees

249.g: ਤਜਿ ਜੁਧ ਸੁਧ ਸੁਰ ਮੇਘ ਧਰਣ ॥
ਵਜੇ ਸੰਗਲੀਆਲੇ ਹਾਠਾ ਜੁਟੀਆਂ ॥
ਖੇਤ ਬਹੇ ਮੁਛਾਲੇ ਕਹਰ ਤਤਾਰਚੇ ॥
249.e: The big chained trumpets sounded and the rows of soldiers began to fight with one another, the long-whiskered and tyrannical warriors marched forward

249.g: ਡਿਗੇ ਵੀਰ ਜੁਝਾਰੇ ਹੂੰਗਾ ਫੁਟੀਆਂ ॥
ਬਕੇ ਜਾਣ ਮਤਵਾਲੇ ਭੰਗਾ ਖਾਇ ਕੈ ॥੪੬੮॥
249.e: Alongwith them the powerful fighters began to sob on falling in the battlefield.The warriors being intoxicated are shouting like someone shrieking in inebriation after eating hemp. 468

249.g: ਓਰੜਏ ਹੰਕਾਰੀ ਧਗਾ ਵਾਇ ਕੈ ॥
ਵਾਹਿ ਫਿਰੇ ਤਰਵਾਰੀ ਸੂਰੇ ਸੂਰਿਆਂ ॥
249.e: The proud warriors marched forward after causing the resonance of big trumpets and began to strike blows with their swords.

249.g: ਵਗੈ ਰਤੁ ਝੁਲਾਰੀ ਝਾੜੀ ਕੈਬਰੀ ॥
ਪਾਈ ਧੂੰਮ ਲੁਝਾਰੀ, ਰਾਵਣ ਰਾਮ ਦੀ ॥੪੬੯॥
249.e: With the shower of arrows a continuous stream of blood flowed and this war of Ram and Ravana became famours on all the four sides.469.

249.g: ਚੋਬੀ ਧਉਸ ਵਜਾਈ ਸੰਘੁਰ ਮਚਿਆ ॥
ਬਾਹਿ ਫਿਰੈ ਵੈਰਾਈ, ਤੁਰੇ ਤਤਾਰਚੇ ॥
249.e: With the sounding of trumpets a terrible war began and the enemies wandered here and there on the fast-moving steeds

249.g: ਹੂਰਾ ਚਿਤ ਵਧਾਈ ਅੰਬਰ ਪੂਰਿਆ ॥
ਜੋਧਿਯਾ ਦੇਖਣ ਤਾਈ ਹੂਲੇ ਹੋਈਆਂ ॥੪੭੦॥
249.e: There on the sky the heavenly damsels gathered together with the zeal of wedding the brave warriors and came nearer in order to see them waging the war.470.

249.g: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
249.e: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

249.g: ਸੁਣਿ ਸਖੀਏ. ਮਿਲਿ ਉਦਮੁ ਕਰੇਹਾ; ਮਨਾਇ ਲੈਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੰਤੈ ॥
249.e: Listen, O my companions: let's join together and make the effort, to surrender to our Husband Lord.

249.g: ਮਾਨੁ ਤਿਆਗਿ. ਕਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਠਗਉਰੀ; ਮੋਹਹ ਸਾਧੂ ਮੰਤੈ ॥
249.e: Renouncing our pride, let's charm Him with the potion of devotional worship, and the mantra of the Holy Saints.

249.g: ਸਖੀ ਵਸਿ ਆਇਆ. ਫਿਰਿ ਛੋਡਿ, ਨ ਜਾਈ; ਇਹ ਰੀਤਿ ਭਲੀ ਭਗਵੰਤੈ ॥
249.e: O my companions, when He comes under our power, He shall never leave us again. This is the good nature of the Lord God.

249.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਜਰਾ ਮਰਣ, ਭੈ ਨਰਕ ਨਿਵਾਰੈ; ਪੁਨੀਤ ਕਰੈ. ਤਿਸੁ ਜੰਤੈ ॥੧॥
249.e: O Nanak, God dispels the fear of old age, death and hell; He purifies His beings. ||1||

249.g: ਸੁਣਿ ਸਖੀਏ. ਇਹ ਭਲੀ ਬਿਨੰਤੀ; ਏਹੁ ਮਤਾਂਤੁ ਪਕਾਈਐ ॥
249.e: Listen, O my companions, to my sincere prayer: let's make this firm resolve.

249.g: ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ. ਉਪਾਧਿ ਰਹਤ ਹੋਇ; ਗੀਤ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਹਿ ਗਾਈਐ ॥
249.e: In the peaceful poise of intuitive bliss, violence will be gone, as we sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe.

249.g: ਕਲਿ ਕਲੇਸ ਮਿਟਹਿ. ਭ੍ਰਮ ਨਾਸਹਿ; ਮਨਿ ਚਿੰਦਿਆ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
249.e: Our pains and troubles shall be eradicated, and our doubts shall be dispelled; we will receive the fruits of our minds' desires.

249.g: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪੂਰਨ ਪਰਮੇਸਰ; ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥੨॥
249.e: O Nanak, meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Supreme Lord God, the Perfect, Transcendent Lord. ||2||

249.g: ਸਖੀ ਇਛ ਕਰੀ, ਨਿਤ ਸੁਖ ਮਨਾਈ; ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਰੀ ਆਸ ਪੁਜਾਏ ॥
249.e: O my companions, I yearn for Him continually; I invoke His Blessings, and pray that God may fulfill my hopes.

249.g: ਚਰਨ ਪਿਆਸੀ ਦਰਸ ਬੈਰਾਗਨਿ; ਪੇਖਉ ਥਾਨ ਸਬਾਏ ॥
249.e: I thirst for His Feet, and I long for the Blessed Vision of His Darshan; I look for Him everywhere.

249.g: ਖੋਜਿ ਲਹਉ. ਹਰਿ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਸੰਗੁ; ਸੰਮ੍ਰਿਥ ਪੁਰਖ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
249.e: I search for traces of the Lord in the Society of the Saints; they will unite me with the All-powerful Primal Lord God.

249.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਤਿਨ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਸੁਰਿਜਨੁ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ; ਸੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਮਾਏ ॥੩॥
249.e: O Nanak, those humble, noble beings who meet the Lord, the Giver of peace, are very blessed, O my mother. ||3||

249.g: ਸਖੀ ਨਾਲਿ ਵਸਾ, ਅਪੁਨੇ ਨਾਹ ਪਿਆਰੇ; ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ. ਹਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਹਿਲਿਆ ॥
249.e: O my companions, now I dwell with my Beloved Husband; my mind and body are attuned to the Lord.

249.g: ਸੁਣਿ ਸਖੀਏ ਮੇਰੀ ਨੀਦ ਭਲੀ; ਮੈ ਆਪਨੜਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ॥
249.e: Listen, O my companions: now I sleep well, since I found my Husband Lord.

249.g: ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਖੋਇਓ. ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ, ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ਭਇਆ; ਕਉਲੁ ਖਿਲਿਆ ॥
249.e: My doubts have been dispelled, and I have found intuitive peace and tranquility through my Lord and Master. I have been enlightened, and my heart-lotus has blossomed forth.

249.g: ਵਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਸੋਹਾਗੁ ਨ ਟਲਿਆ ॥੪॥੪॥੨॥੫॥੧੧॥
249.e: I have obtained God, the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts, as my Husband; O Nanak, my marriage shall last forever. ||4||4||2||5||11||

250.e: Salok:

250.g: ਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਕਹਾ ਪੁਕਾਰਤੇ; ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਸਭ ਕੂਰ ॥
250.e: Why are you crying out for riches and wealth? All this emotional attachment to Maya is false.
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
Gauree, Baavan Akhree ~ The 52 Letters, Fifth Mehl:
Salok:

250.g: ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਮਾਤਾ. ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਪਿਤਾ; ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰਾ ॥
250.e: The Divine Guru is my mother, the Divine Guru is my father; the Divine Guru is my Transcendent Lord and Master.

250.g: ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਸਖਾ. ਅਗਿਆਨ ਭੰਜਨੁ; ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਬੰਧਿਪ ਸਹੋਦਰਾ ॥
250.e: The Divine Guru is my companion, the Destroyer of ignorance; the Divine Guru is my relative and brother.

250.g: ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਦਾਤਾ. ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਉਪਦੇਸੈ; ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਮੰਤੁ. ਨਿਰੋਧਰਾ ॥
250.e: The Divine Guru is the Giver, the Teacher of the Lord's Name. The Divine Guru is the Mantra which never fails.

250.g: ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਬੁਧਿ ਮੂਰਤਿ; ਗੁਰਦੇਵ. ਪਾਰਸ ਪਰਸ ਪਰਾ ॥
250.e: The Divine Guru is the Image of peace, truth and wisdom. The Divine Guru is the Philosopher's Stone - touching it, one is transformed.

250.g: ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਤੀਰਥੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਸਰੋਵਰੁ; ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨ ਮਜਨੁ ਅਪਰੰਪਰਾ ॥
250.e: The Divine Guru is the sacred shrine of pilgrimage, and the pool of divine ambrosia; bathing in the Guru's wisdom, one experiences the Infinite.

250.g: ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਕਰਤਾ. ਸਭਿ ਪਾਪ ਹਰਤਾ; ਗੁਰਦੇਵ. ਪਤਿਤ ਪਵਿਤ ਕਰਾ ॥
250.e: The Divine Guru is the Creator, and the Destroyer of all sins; the Divine Guru is the Purifier of sinners.

250.g: ਗੁਰਦੇਵ. ਆਦਿ ਜੁਗਾਦਿ ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ; ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਮੰਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਉਧਰਾ ॥
250.e: The Divine Guru existed at the primal beginning, throughout the ages, in each and every age. The Divine Guru is the Mantra of the Lord's Name; chanting it, one is saved.

250.g: ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਸੰਗਤਿ. ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਲਿ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ; ਹਮ ਮੂੜ ਪਾਪੀ. ਜਿਤੁ ਲਗਿ ਤਰਾ ॥
250.e: O God, please be merciful to me, that I may be with the Divine Guru; I am a foolish sinner, but holding onto Him, I am carried across.

250.g: ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ; ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਨਮਸਕਰਾ ॥੧॥
250.e: The Divine Guru is the True Guru, the Supreme Lord God, the Transcendent Lord; Nanak bows in humble reverence to the Lord, the Divine Guru. ||1||
Salok:

250.g: ਆਪਹਿ ਕੀਆ ਕਰਾਇਆ; ਆਪਹਿ ਕਰਨੈ ਜੋਗੁ ॥
250.e: He Himself acts, and causes others to act; He Himself can do everything.

250.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਏਕੋ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ; ਦੂਸਰ. ਹੋਆ ਨ ਹੋਗੁ ॥੧॥
250.e: O Nanak, the One Lord is pervading everywhere; there has never been any other, and there never shall be. ||1||
Salok:

250.g: ਸੇਈ ਸਾਹ. ਭਗਵੰਤ ਸੇ; ਸਚੁ ਸੰਪੈ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
250.e: Those who gather Truth, and the riches of the Lord's Name, are rich and very fortunate.

250.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਸਚੁ ਸੁਚਿ ਪਾਈਐ; ਤਿਹ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੈ ਪਾਸਿ ॥੧॥
250.e: O Nanak, truthfulness and purity are obtained from Saints such as these. ||1||
Now begins the description of the war with the demon Atkaaye :
SANGEET PADHISTAKA STANZA
The demon-king in great fury, began the war,
Calling his innumerable warriors, full of resentment and very wrathful.483.
Very swift-moving horses were brought who jumped hither and thither like and actor
Taking out their frightening weapons, the warriors began to fight with one another.484.
Pauree:
ONG: I humbly bow in reverence to the One Universal Creator, to the Holy True Guru.
In the beginning, in the middle, and in the end, He is the Formless Lord.
He Himself is in the absolute state of primal meditation; He Himself is in the seat of peace.
He Himself listens to His Own Praises.
He Himself created Himself.
He is His Own Father, He is His Own Mother.
He Himself is subtle and etheric; He Himself is manifest and obvious.
O Nanak, His wondrous play cannot be understood. ||1||
O God, Merciful to the meek, please be kind to me,

250.g: ਤੇਰੇ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੀ; ਮਨੁ ਹੋਇ ਰਵਾਲਾ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
250.e: that my mind might become the dust of the feet of Your Saints. ||Pause||
Salok:

250.g: ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ਆਕਾਰ ਆਪਿ; ਨਿਰਗੁਨ ਸਰਗੁਨ ਏਕ ॥
250.e: He Himself is formless, and also formed; the One Lord is without attributes, and also with attributes.

250.g: ਏਕਹਿ ਏਕ ਬਖਾਨਨੋ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਏਕ ਅਨੇਕ ॥੧॥
250.e: Describe the One Lord as One, and Only One; O Nanak, He is the One, and the many. ||1||
At this time Inderjit Mehgnad forsook the war-arena and returned to perform the Hom Yajna (Sacrifice).479.

250.g: ਇਮ ਕਹੈ ਬੈਣ ਤਜ ਭ੍ਰਾਤ ਕਾਨ ॥
250.e: Coming near the younger brother Vibhishan said that,

250.g: ਆਇ ਹੈ ਸਤ੍ਰੁ ਇਹ ਘਾਤ ਹਾਥ ॥

250.e: At that time his supreme enemy and the mighty warrior Inderjit is wwithing your ambush.480.

250.g: ਨਿਜ ਮਾਸ ਕਾਟ ਕਰ ਕਰਤ ਹੋਮ ॥

250.e: He is performing havana (sacrifice) by chopping his flesh, with which the whole earth is trembling and the sky is wondering.

250.g: ਕਰ ਧਰੇ ਧਨੁਖ ਕਟ ਕਸਿ ਨਿਖੰਗ ॥੪੮੧॥
250.e: Hearing this, Lakshman went there fearlessly with bow in his hand and quiver tied to his back.481.
Inderjit began to recite for the manifestation of the goddess and Lakshman discharged his arrows and killed Inderjit into two halves.
Lakshman returned with his forces, playing on the drum and on the other side the demons ran away on seeing their general dead.482.

250.g: ਇਤਿ ਇੰਦ੍ਰਜੀਤ ਬਧਹਿ ਧਿਆਇ ਸਮਾਪਤਮ ਸਤੁ ॥
250.e: End of the chapter entitled “The Killing of Inderjit’ in Ramavtar in BACHITTAR NATAK.
Pauree:
SASSA: True, True, True is that Lord.

250.g: ਸਤਿ ਪੁਰਖ ਤੇ; ਭਿੰਨ ਨ ਕੋਊ ॥
250.e: No one is separate from the True Primal Lord.
They alone enter the Lord's Sanctuary, whom the Lord inspires to enter.
Meditating, meditating in remembrance, they sing and preach the Glorious Praises of the Lord.
Doubt and skepticism do not affect them at all.
They behold the manifest glory of the Lord.
They are the Holy Saints - they reach this destination.
Nanak is forever a sacrifice to them. ||3||
Pauree:
ONG: The One Universal Creator created the Creation through the Word of the Primal Guru.
He strung it upon His one thread.
He created the diverse expanse of the three qualities.
From formless, He appeared as form.
The Creator has created the creation of all sorts.
The attachment of the mind has led to birth and death.
He Himself is above both, untouched and unaffected.
O Nanak, He has no end or limitation. ||2||

251.e: Pauree:
The One Lord Himself is the Cause of all actions.
He Himself distributes sins and noble acts.

251.g: ਇਆ ਜੁਗ; ਜਿਤੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਆਪਹਿ ਲਾਇਓ ॥
251.e: In this age, people are attached as the Lord attaches them.

251.g: ਸੋ ਸੋ ਪਾਇਓ; ਜੁ ਆਪਿ ਦਿਵਾਇਓ ॥
251.e: They receive that which the Lord Himself gives.

251.g: ਉਆ ਕਾ ਅੰਤੁ; ਨ ਜਾਨੈ ਕੋਊ ॥
251.e: No one knows His limits.

251.g: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਕਰੈ; ਸੋਊ ਫੁਨਿ ਹੋਊ ॥
251.e: Whatever He does, comes to pass.
From the One, the entire expanse of the Universe emanated.
O Nanak, He Himself is our Saving Grace. ||8||
Pauree:
This soul has lived in many wombs.
Enticed by sweet attachment, it has been trapped in reincarnation.

251.g: ਇਨਿ ਮਾਇਆ; ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਬਸਿ ਕੀਨੇ ॥
251.e: This Maya has subjugated beings through the three qualities.
Maya has infused attachment to itself in each and every heart.
O friend, tell me some way,

251.g: ਜਾ ਤੇ ਤਰਉ; ਬਿਖਮ ਇਹ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
251.e: by which I may swim across this treacherous ocean of Maya.
The Lord showers His Mercy, and leads us to join the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation.

251.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਤਾ ਕੈ; ਨਿਕਟਿ ਨ ਮਾਏ ॥੭॥
251.e: O Nanak, Maya does not even come near. ||7||
Salok:

251.g: ਆਵਤ ਹੁਕਮਿ. ਬਿਨਾਸ ਹੁਕਮਿ; ਆਗਿਆ. ਭਿੰਨ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
251.e: By His Command, we come, and by His Command, we go; no one is beyond His Command.

251.g: ਆਵਨ ਜਾਨਾ ਤਿਹ ਮਿਟੈ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਜਿਹ ਮਨਿ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥
251.e: Coming and going in reincarnation is ended, O Nanak, for those whose minds are filled with the Lord. ||1||

251.g: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਹੂਨੇ ਨਾਨਕਾ; ਹੋਤ ਜਾਤ ਸਭੁ ਧੂਰ ॥੧॥
251.e: Without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, O Nanak, all are reduced to dust. ||1||
Pauree:
DHADHA: The dust of the feet of the Saints is sacred.

251.g: ਧਨਿ ਤੇਊ; ਜਿਹ ਰੁਚ ਇਆ ਮਨੂਆ ॥
251.e: Blessed are those whose minds are filled with this longing.

251.g: ਧਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਬਾਛਹਿ; ਸੁਰਗ ਨ ਆਛਹਿ ॥
251.e: They do not seek wealth, and they do not desire paradise.

251.g: ਅਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ; ਸਾਧ ਰਜ ਰਾਚਹਿ ॥
251.e: They are immersed in the deep love of their Beloved, and the dust of the feet of the Holy.
How can worldly affairs affect those,

251.g: ਜੋ ਏਕ ਛਾਡਿ; ਅਨ ਕਤਹਿ. ਨ ਜਾਹੂ ॥
251.e: Who do not abandon the One Lord, and who go nowhere else?

251.g: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਹੀਐ; ਦੀਓ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਾਮ ॥
251.e: One whose heart is filled with God's Name,
O Nanak, is a perfect spiritual being of God. ||4||
On this side, the warriors in the army of Ram, started fighting in great rage
The foolish Makrachh thundered, carrying his new banner.485.
There was one demon named Atkaaye in the demon forces who rushed with serious fury
Many warriors confronted him and began to fight with discriminating intellect.486.
There was huge shower of arrows which fell like rain-drops
The army looked like locusts and array of ants.487.
The warriors reached near Atkaaye in order to see him fighting.
The gods hailed him and the king uttered “Bravo, Bravo!”.488.
The terrible goddess Kali began to shout and great number of Yoginis roamed in the battlefield.
Innumerable Bhairvas and ghosts began to drink blood.489.
The tabors of vampires sounded and the inauspicious crows began to caw
On all the four sides there were heard and seen shrieks of vultures and leapings and hopping of ghosts and fiends.490.
Salok:

251.g: ਆਵਨ ਆਏ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਮਹਿ; ਬਿਨੁ ਬੂਝੇ. ਪਸੁ ਢੋਰ ॥
251.e: Those who have come into the world without understanding are like animals and beasts.

251.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੋ ਬੁਝੈ; ਜਾ ਕੈ ਭਾਗ ਮਥੋਰ ॥੧॥
251.e: O Nanak, those who become Gurmukh understand; upon their foreheads is such pre-ordained destiny. ||1||
Pauree:

251.g: ਯਾ ਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ; ਏਕਹਿ ਕਉ ਆਇਆ ॥
251.e: They have come into this world to meditate on the One Lord.
But ever since their birth, they have been enticed by the fascination of Maya.

251.g: ਗਰਭ ਕੁੰਟ ਮਹਿ; ਉਰਧ ਤਪ ਕਰਤੇ ॥
251.e: Upside-down in the chamber of the womb, they performed intense meditation.
They remembered God in meditation with each and every breath.
But now, they are entangled in things which they must leave behind.
They forget the Great Giver from their minds.
O Nanak, those upon whom the Lord showers His Mercy,

251.g: ਇਤ ਉਤ ਨਾਨਕ; ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਸਰਹੁ ਨਾਹੀ ॥੬॥
251.e: do not forget Him, here or hereafter. ||6||
Pauree:
NGANGA: Spiritual wisdom is not obtained by mere words of mouth.
It is not obtained through the various debates of the Shaastras and scriptures.

251.g: ਙਿਆਨੀ ਸੋਇ; ਜਾ ਕੈ ਦ੍ਰਿੜ ਸੋਊ ॥
251.e: They alone are spiritually wise, whose minds are firmly fixed on the Lord.

251.g: ਕਹਤ ਸੁਨਤ; ਕਛੁ ਜੋਗੁ ਨ ਹੋਊ ॥
251.e: Hearing and telling stories, no one attains Yoga.

251.g: ਙਿਆਨੀ ਰਹਤ; ਆਗਿਆ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੁ ਜਾ ਕੈ ॥
251.e: They alone are spiritually wise, who remain firmly committed to the Lord's Command.

251.g: ਉਸਨ ਸੀਤ ਸਮਸਰਿ ਸਭ; ਤਾ ਕੈ ॥
251.e: Heat and cold are all the same to them.
The true people of spiritual wisdom are the Gurmukhs, who contemplate the essence of reality;
O Nanak, the Lord showers His Mercy upon them. ||5||
Salok:

251.g: ਕਿਰਤ ਕਮਾਵਨ ਸੁਭ ਅਸੁਭ; ਕੀਨੇ ਤਿਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪਿ ॥
251.e: God Himself causes one to perform good and bad actions.

251.g: ਪਸੁ. ਆਪਨ ਹਉ ਹਉ ਕਰੈ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ, ਕਹਾ ਕਮਾਤਿ ॥੧॥
251.e: The beast indulges in egotism, selfishness and conceit; O Nanak, without the Lord, what can anyone do? ||1||
Salok:

251.g: ਅਨਿਕ ਭੇਖ ਅਰੁ ਙਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ; ਮਨਹਠਿ. ਮਿਲਿਅਉ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
251.e: By all sorts of religious robes, knowledge, meditation and stubborn-mindedness, no one has ever met God.

251.g: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ. ਕਿਰਪਾ ਭਈ; ਭਗਤੁ ਙਿਆਨੀ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥
251.e: Says Nanak, those upon whom God showers His Mercy, are devotees of spiritual wisdom. ||1||
HOHA STANZA
The warriors felt weakness and then regained strength and in rage caught hold of their swords.491.
Seeing the discharge of arrows the clouds wondered  because of the arrows all the sides were hindered.492.
The arrows are being discharged in fury and the warriors are falling on the earth like the earth like the effacement of the through ones.493.
The frightened warriors, while wandering, are being wounded and great heroes are flying fast.494.
They are reciting the name of Shiva in order to kill the enemies with jealousy in their mind and they are tighting in the field wandering with fear.495.
The people are getting delighted with the falling of demons on the earth
Salok:

251.g: ਰਾਚਿ ਰਹੇ. ਬਨਿਤਾ ਬਿਨੋਦ; ਕੁਸਮ ਰੰਗ ਬਿਖ ਸੋਰ ॥
251.e: Man remains engrossed in women and playful pleasures; the tumult of his passion is like the dye of the safflower, which fades away all too soon.

251.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਹ ਸਰਨੀ ਪਰਉ; ਬਿਨਸਿ ਜਾਇ ਮੈ ਮੋਰ ॥੧॥
251.e: O Nanak, seek God's Sanctuary, and your selfishness and conceit shall be taken away. ||1||

252.e: CHHAPAI STANZA

252.g: ਇਕ ਇਕ ਆਰੁਹੇ ਇਕ ਇਕਨ ਕਹ ਤਕੈ ॥
252.e: The warriors excelling one another are coming and looking at each other one by one

252.g: ਇਕ ਇਕ ਲੈ ਚਲੈ ਇਕ ਕਹ ਇਕ ਉਚਕੈ ॥
252.e: They are moving with each one and are being startle by each one

252.g: ਇਕ ਇਕ ਸਰ ਬਰਖ ਇਕ ਧਨ ਕਰਖ ਰੋਸ ਭਰ ॥
252.e: On one side they are discharging arrows and on the other they are pulling their bows in rage

252.g: ਇਕ ਇਕ ਤਰਫੰਤ ਇਕ ਭਵ ਸਿੰਧ ਗਏ ਤਰਿ ॥
252.e: On one side the fighters are writing and on the other side the dead ones are ferrying across the world-ocean

252.g: ਰਣਿ ਇਕ ਇਕ ਸਾਵੰਤ ਭਿੜੈਂ ਇਕ ਇਕ ਹੁਐ ਬਿਝੜੇ ॥
252.e: The warriors excelling one another have fought and died

252.g: ਨਰ ਇਕ ਅਨਿਕ ਸਸਤ੍ਰਣ ਭਿੜੇ ਇਕ ਇਕ ਅਵਝੜ ਝੜੇ ॥੪੯੯॥
252.e: All the warriors are alike, but the weapons are many and these weapons are striking blows on the soldiers like rain.499.

252.g: ਇਕ ਜੂਝ ਭਟ ਗਿਰੈਂ ਇਕ ਬਬਕੰਤ ਮਧ ਰਣ ॥
252.e: On one side the warriors have fallen and on the other they are shouting

252.g: ਇਕ ਦੇਵਪੁਰ ਬਸੈ ਇਕ ਭਜ ਚਲਤ ਖਾਇ ਬ੍ਰਣ ॥
252.e: On one side they have entered the city of gods and on the other, having been wounded, they have sped away

252.g: ਇਕ ਜੁਝ ਉਝੜੇ ਇਕ ਮੁਕਤੰਤ ਬਾਨ ਕਸਿ ॥
252.e: Some are fighting in the war firmly and on the other side they are falling down having been chopped like trees

252.g: ਇਕ ਅਨਿਕ ਬ੍ਰਣ ਝਲੈਂ ਇਕ ਮੁਕਤੰਤ ਬਾਨ ਕਸਿ ॥
252.e: On one side many wounded are being endured and on the other the arrows are being discharged with full strength

252.g: ਰਣ ਭੂੰਮ ਘੂਮ ਸਾਵੰਤ ਮੰਡੈ, ਦੀਰਘੁ ਕਾਇ ਲਛਮਣ ਪ੍ਰਬਲ ॥
252.e: Diraghkaya and Lakshman have wounded and created such a situation in the battlefield,

252.g: ਥਿਰ ਰਹੇ ਬ੍ਰਿਛ ਉਪਵਨ ਕਿਧੋ ਉਤਰ ਦਿਸ ਦੁਐ ਅਚਲ ॥੫੦੦॥
252.e: As if they are large trees in a forest or eternal and immovable pole-stars in the north.500.
Pauree:

252.g: ਲਲਾ; ਤਾ ਕੈ ਲਵੈ. ਨ ਕੋਊ ॥
252.e: LALLA: There is no one equal to Him.
He Himself is the One; there shall never be any other.
He is now, He has been, and He shall always be.

252.g: ਉਆ ਕਾ ਅੰਤੁ; ਨ ਕਾਹੂ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
252.e: No one has ever found His limit.
In the ant and in the elephant, He is totally pervading.
The Lord, the Primal Being, is known by everyone everywhere.

252.g: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਦੀਨੋ; ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਅਪਨਾ ॥
252.e: That one, unto whom the Lord has given His Love

252.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ; ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਤਿਹ ਜਪਨਾ ॥੧੨॥
252.e: - O Nanak, that Gurmukh chants the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||12||
AJBA STANZA
The warriors fought, the arrows were discharged, there was knocking on the shields and the death-like warriors were infuriated.501.
The drums sounded, the blows of the swords were heard and the weapons and arrows were struck.502.
Highly infuriated and with great understanding, the forces are being mashed, the warriors are thundering and showering arrows.503.
The warriors with red eyes are shouting, having been intoxicated they are fighting and the heavenly damsels are looking at them.504.
Having been pierced by arrows, the warriors are fleeing and (some) are fighting with arms, being highly enraged.505.
The warriors are swinging and the heavenly damsels, while wandering, are looking at them and are wondering on listening to their shouts of “Kill, Kill”.506.
Salok:

252.g: ਲਾਲ ਗੁਪਾਲ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਪ੍ਰਭ; ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰ ਅਥਾਹ ॥
252.e: My Beloved God, the Sustainer of the World, the Lord of the Universe, is deep, profound and unfathomable.

252.g: ਦੂਸਰ ਨਾਹੀ ਅਵਰ ਕੋ; ਨਾਨਕ ਬੇਪਰਵਾਹ ॥੧॥
252.e: There is no other like Him; O Nanak, He is not worried. ||1||
Pauree:

252.g: ਰੇ ਮਨ. ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ, ਜਹ ਰਚਹੁ; ਤਹ ਤਹ ਬੰਧਨ ਪਾਹਿ ॥
252.e: O mind: without the Lord, whatever you are involved in shall bind you in chains.

252.g: ਜਿਹ ਬਿਧਿ. ਕਤਹੂ ਨ ਛੂਟੀਐ; ਸਾਕਤ ਤੇਊ ਕਮਾਹਿ ॥
252.e: The faithless cynic does those deeds which will never allow him to be emancipated.

252.g: ਹਉ ਹਉ ਕਰਤੇ. ਕਰਮ ਰਤ; ਤਾ ਕੋ ਭਾਰੁ ਅਫਾਰ ॥
252.e: Acting in egotism, selfishness and conceit, the lovers of rituals carry the unbearable load.

252.g: ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਨਹੀ. ਜਉ ਨਾਮ ਸਿਉ; ਤਉ ਏਊ ਕਰਮ ਬਿਕਾਰ ॥
252.e: When there is no love for the Naam, then these rituals are corrupt.

252.g: ਬਾਧੇ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਜੇਵਰੀ; ਮੀਠੀ ਮਾਇਆ ਰੰਗ ॥
252.e: The rope of death binds those who are in love with the sweet taste of Maya.

252.g: ਭ੍ਰਮ ਕੇ ਮੋਹੇ. ਨਹ ਬੁਝਹਿ; ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਦਹੂ ਸੰਗ ॥
252.e: Deluded by doubt, they do not understand that God is always with them.

252.g: ਲੇਖੈ ਗਣਤ. ਨ ਛੂਟੀਐ; ਕਾਚੀ ਭੀਤਿ. ਨ ਸੁਧਿ ॥
252.e: When their accounts are called for, they shall not be released; their wall of mud cannot be washed clean.

252.g: ਜਿਸਹਿ ਬੁਝਾਏ ਨਾਨਕਾ; ਤਿਹ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਬੁਧਿ ॥੯॥
252.e: One who is made to understand - O Nanak, that Gurmukh obtains immaculate understanding. ||9||
Salok:

252.g: ਟੂਟੇ ਬੰਧਨ ਜਾਸੁ ਕੇ; ਹੋਆ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗੁ ॥
252.e: One whose bonds are cut away joins the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

252.g: ਜੋ ਰਾਤੇ ਰੰਗ ਏਕ ਕੈ; ਨਾਨਕ ਗੂੜਾ ਰੰਗੁ ॥੧॥
252.e: Those who are imbued with the Love of the One Lord, O Nanak, take on the deep and lasting color of His Love. ||1||
Salok:

252.g: ਆਤਮ ਰਸੁ ਜਿਹ ਜਾਨਿਆ; ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗ ਸਹਜੇ ਮਾਣੁ ॥
252.e: One who knows the taste of the Lord's sublime essence, intuitively enjoys the Lord's Love.

252.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਧਨਿ ਧਨਿ ਧੰਨਿ ਜਨ; ਆਏ ਤੇ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥੧॥
252.e: O Nanak, blessed, blessed, blessed are the Lord's humble servants; how fortunate is their coming into the world! ||1||
Pauree:
How fruitful is the coming into the world, of those

252.g: ਜਾਸੁ ਰਸਨ; ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਭਨੀਐ ॥
252.e: whose tongues celebrate the Praises of the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.
They come and dwell with the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy;
night and day, they lovingly meditate on the Naam.
Blessed is the birth of those humble beings who are attuned to the Naam;
the Lord, the Architect of Destiny, bestows His Kind Mercy upon them.

252.g: ਏਕਹਿ ਆਵਨ; ਫਿਰਿ ਜੋਨਿ. ਨ ਆਇਆ ॥
252.e: They are born only once - they shall not be reincarnated again.
O Nanak, they are absorbed into the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan. ||13||
Pauree:
LALLA: People are entangled in the love of corrupt pleasures;
they are drunk with the wine of egotistical intellect and Maya.
In this Maya, they are born and die.

252.g: ਜਿਉ ਜਿਉ ਹੁਕਮੁ; ਤਿਵੈ ਤਿਉ ਕਰਨਾ ॥
252.e: People act according to the Hukam of the Lord's Command.
No one is perfect, and no one is imperfect.
No one is wise, and no one is foolish.

252.g: ਜਿਤੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਲਾਵਹੁ; ਤਿਤੁ ਤਿਤੁ ਲਗਨਾ ॥
252.e: Wherever the Lord engages someone, there he is engaged.
O Nanak, our Lord and Master is forever detached. ||11||
Pauree:
RARRA: Dye this heart of yours in the color of the Lord's Love.

252.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ; ਜਪਹੁ ਜਪੁ ਰਸਨਾ ॥
252.e: Meditate on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har - chant it with your tongue.

252.g: ਰੇ ਰੇ ਦਰਗਹ; ਕਹੈ ਨ ਕੋਊ ॥
252.e: In the Court of the Lord, no one shall speak harshly to you.
Everyone shall welcome you, saying, "Come, and sit down."
In that Mansion of the Lord's Presence, you shall find a home.
There is no birth or death, or destruction there.

252.g: ਮਸਤਕਿ ਕਰਮੁ ਲਿਖਿਓ; ਧੁਰਿ ਜਾ ਕੈ ॥
252.e: One who has such karma written on his forehead,

252.g: ਹਰਿ ਸੰਪੈ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਘਰਿ ਤਾ ਕੈ ॥੧੦॥
252.e: O Nanak, has the wealth of the Lord in his home. ||10||
Salok:

252.g: ਯਾਸੁ ਜਪਤ ਮਨਿ ਹੋਇ ਅਨੰਦੁ; ਬਿਨਸੈ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ॥
252.e: Chanting it, the mind is filled with bliss; love of duality is eliminated, and pain, distress and desires are quenched.

252.g: ਦੂਖ ਦਰਦ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਬੁਝੈ; ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਉ ॥੧॥
252.e: O Nanak, immerse yourself in the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||
Salok:

252.g: ਲਾਲਚ ਝੂਠ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਮੋਹ; ਬਿਆਪਤ ਮੂੜੇ ਅੰਧ ॥
252.e: Greed, falsehood, corruption and emotional attachment entangle the blind and the foolish.

252.g: ਲਾਗਿ ਪਰੇ. ਦੁਰਗੰਧ ਸਿਉ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਮਾਇਆ ਬੰਧ ॥੧॥
252.e: Bound down by Maya, O Nanak, a foul odor clings to them. ||1||
The arrows are penetrating into the demons and the warriors are being crushed.496.
The wounded warriors are wandering and writhing in the battlefield
They are feeling shy in being entrapped, having been girdled.497.
The throbbing of the hearts continues, the arrows are being discharged intermittently and the directions are being hindered.498.

253.e: PAADHARI STANZA
In this way, the war ensued and many warriors fell in the field
On one side there is Lakshman, brother of Ram and on the other there is the demon Atkaaye and both these princes are fighting with each other.510.

253.g: ਤਬ ਰਾਮ ਭ੍ਰਾਤ ਅਤਿ ਕੀਨ ਰੋਸ ॥
ਜਿਮ ਪਰਤ ਅਗਨ ਘ੍ਰਿਤ ਕਰਤ ਜੋਸ ॥
253.e: Then Lakshman became highly infuriated and increased it with zeal like the fire blazing fiercely when the ghee is poured over it
He discharged the scorching arrows like the terrible sunrays of eh month of Jyestha.511.

253.g: ਬਰਣੈ ਨ ਜਾਹਿ ਕਹਿ ਏਕ ਏਕ ॥
253.e: Getting himself wounded he discharged so many arrows which are indescribable
These brave fighters are absorbed in fight and on the other hand, the gods are raising the sound of victory.512.
The weapons, coming into contact with armours, are piercing the bodies
The spars are breaking and the sparks of fire are coming out from them.507.
The horses are dancing and the warriors are thundering
They are falling while discharging the arrows.508.
Seeing the heavenly damsels moving, the warriors are swinging and, being intoxicated, are discharging arrows.509.
Salok:

253.g: ਕੁੰਟ ਚਾਰਿ ਦਹ ਦਿਸਿ ਭ੍ਰਮੇ; ਕਰਮ ਕਿਰਤਿ ਕੀ ਰੇਖ ॥
253.e: He wanders around in the four quarters and in the ten directions, according to the dictates of his karma.

253.g: ਸੂਖ ਦੂਖ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਜੋਨਿ; ਨਾਨਕ ਲਿਖਿਓ ਲੇਖ ॥੧॥
253.e: Pleasure and pain, liberation and reincarnation, O Nanak, come according to one's pre-ordained destiny. ||1||
Salok:

253.g: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਮਨ ਤਨ ਬਸਿ ਰਹੇ; ਈਤ ਊਤ ਕੇ ਮੀਤ ॥
253.e: The One who dwells deep within the mind and body is your friend here and hereafter.

253.g: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਉਪਦੇਸਿਆ; ਨਾਨਕ ਜਪੀਐ ਨੀਤ ॥੧॥
253.e: The Perfect Guru has taught me, O Nanak, to chant His Name continually. ||1||
Pauree:
YAYYA: Burn away duality and evil-mindedness.
Give them up, and sleep in intuitive peace and poise.
Yaya: Go, and seek the Sanctuary of the Saints;
with their help, you shall cross over the terrifying world-ocean.
Yaya: One who weaves the One Name into his heart,
Does not have to take birth again.

253.g: ਯਯਾ. ਜਨਮੁ ਨ ਹਾਰੀਐ; ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਕੀ ਟੇਕ ॥
253.e: Yaya: This human life shall not be wasted, if you take the Support of the Perfect Guru.

253.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਤਿਹ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਜਾ ਕੈ ਹੀਅਰੈ ਏਕ ॥੧੪॥
253.e: O Nanak, one whose heart is filled with the One Lord finds peace. ||14||
Pauree:
KAKKA: He is the Creator, the Cause of causes.
No one can erase His pre-ordained plan.
Nothing can be done a second time.
The Creator Lord does not make mistakes.
To some, He Himself shows the Way.
While He causes others to wander miserably in the wilderness.
He Himself has set His own play in motion.

253.g: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਦੀਨੋ; ਸੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਲੀਨੋ ॥੧੭॥
253.e: Whatever He gives, O Nanak, that is what we receive. ||17||
Salok:

253.g: ਅਤਿ ਸੁੰਦਰ. ਕੁਲੀਨ ਚਤੁਰ; ਮੁਖਿ ਙਿਆਨੀ, ਧਨਵੰਤ ॥
253.e: He may be very handsome, born into a highly respected family, very wise, a famous spiritual teacher, prosperous and wealthy;

253.g: ਮਿਰਤਕ ਕਹੀਅਹਿ ਨਾਨਕਾ; ਜਿਹ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਨਹੀ. ਭਗਵੰਤ ॥੧॥
253.e: but even so, he is looked upon as a corpse, O Nanak, if he does not love the Lord God. ||1||
Pauree:

253.g: ਖਖਾ. ਖੂਨਾ ਕਛੁ ਨਹੀ; ਤਿਸੁ ਸੰਮ੍ਰਥ ਕੈ ਪਾਹਿ ॥
253.e: KHAKHA: The All-powerful Lord lacks nothing;

253.g: ਜੋ ਦੇਨਾ ਸੋ ਦੇ ਰਹਿਓ; ਭਾਵੈ ਤਹ ਤਹ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
253.e: whatever He is to give, He continues to give - let anyone go anywhere he pleases.

253.g: ਖਰਚੁ ਖਜਾਨਾ ਨਾਮ ਧਨੁ; ਇਆ ਭਗਤਨ ਕੀ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
253.e: The wealth of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is a treasure to spend; it is the capital of His devotees.

253.g: ਖਿਮਾ ਗਰੀਬੀ ਅਨਦ ਸਹਜ; ਜਪਤ ਰਹਹਿ ਗੁਣਤਾਸ ॥
253.e: With tolerance, humility, bliss and intuitive poise, they continue to meditate on the Lord, the Treasure of excellence.

253.g: ਖੇਲਹਿ ਬਿਗਸਹਿ. ਅਨਦ ਸਿਉ; ਜਾ ਕਉ ਹੋਤ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ॥
253.e: Those, unto whom the Lord shows His Mercy, play happily and blossom forth.

253.g: ਸਦੀਵ ਗਨੀਵ ਸੁਹਾਵਨੇ; ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਮਾਲ ॥
253.e: Those who have the wealth of the Lord's Name in their homes are forever wealthy and beautiful.

253.g: ਖੇਦੁ ਨ ਦੂਖੁ, ਨ ਡਾਨੁ ਤਿਹ; ਜਾ ਕਉ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੀ ॥
253.e: Those who are blessed with the Lord's Glance of Grace suffer neither torture, nor pain, nor punishment.

253.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਣਿਆ; ਪੂਰੀ ਤਿਨਾ ਪਰੀ ॥੧੮॥
253.e: O Nanak, those who are pleasing to God become perfectly successful. ||18||
Pauree:
NGANGA: He may be a scholar of the six Shaastras.
He may practice inhaling, exhaling and holding the breath.
He may practice spiritual wisdom, meditation, pilgrimages to sacred shrines and ritual cleansing baths.
He may cook his own food, and never touch anyone else's; he may live in the wilderness like a hermit.

253.g: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਸੰਗਿ; ਮਨਿ ਨਹੀ ਹੇਤਾ ॥
253.e: But if he does not enshrine love for the Lord's Name within his heart,
then everything he does is transitory.
Even an untouchable pariah is superior to him,
O Nanak, if the Lord of the World abides in his mind. ||16||
Pauree:

253.g: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਿਮਰਹੁ. ਤਾਸੁ ਕਉ; ਜੋ ਅੰਤਿ ਸਹਾਈ ਹੋਇ ॥
253.e: Night and day, meditate in remembrance on the One who will be your Help and Support in the end.

253.g: ਇਹ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਦਿਨ ਚਾਰਿ ਛਿਅ; ਛਾਡਿ ਚਲਿਓ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
253.e: This poison shall last for only a few days; everyone must depart, and leave it behind.

253.g: ਕਾ ਕੋ; ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਸੁਤ ਧੀਆ ॥
253.e: Who is our mother, father, son and daughter?

253.g: ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਬਨਿਤਾ; ਕਛੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਲੀਆ ॥
253.e: Household, wife, and other things shall not go along with you.
So gather that wealth which shall never perish,
so that you may go to your true home with honor.
In this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, those who sing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy

253.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਤੇ ਤੇ; ਬਹੁਰਿ. ਨ ਆਇਆ ॥੧੫॥
253.e: - O Nanak, they do not have to endure reincarnation again. ||15||
Salok:

253.g: ਖਾਤ ਖਰਚਤ ਬਿਲਛਤ ਰਹੇ; ਟੂਟਿ ਨ ਜਾਹਿ. ਭੰਡਾਰ ॥
253.e: People continue to eat and consume and enjoy, but the Lord's warehouses are never exhausted.

253.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਤ ਅਨੇਕ ਜਨ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਾਹਿ ਸੁਮਾਰ ॥੧॥
253.e: So many chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har; O Nanak, they cannot be counted. ||1||

254.e: Salok:

254.g: ਚਿਤਿ ਚਿਤਵਉ. ਚਰਣਾਰਬਿੰਦ; ਊਧ ਕਵਲ. ਬਿਗਸਾਂਤ ॥
254.e: Focus your consciousness on His Lotus Feet, and the inverted lotus of your heart shall blossom forth.

254.g: ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਭਏ ਆਪਹਿ ਗੋੁਬਿੰਦ; ਨਾਨਕ ਸੰਤ ਮਤਾਂਤ ॥੧॥
254.e: The Lord of the Universe Himself becomes manifest, O Nanak, through the Teachings of the Saints. ||1||
Ultimately Lakshman deprived Atkaaye, the specialist in many sciences of weapons and arms, of his weapons and arms

254.g: ਹਯ ਮੁਕਟ ਸੂਤ ਬਿਨੁ ਭਯੋ ਗਵਾਰ ॥
ਕਛੁ ਚਪੇ ਚੋਰ ਜਿਮ ਬਲ ਸੰਭਾਰ ॥੫੧੩॥
254.e: He was deprived of his horse, crown and garments and he tried ot conceal himself like a thief mustering his strength.513.

254.g: ਸਮ ਚਲੇ ਕਾਲ ਕੀ ਜੁਆਲ ਤਾਤ ॥
254.e: He discharged arrows causing destruction like Indra’s Vajra and they were striking like the advancing fire of death

254.g: ਜਨ ਪ੍ਰਲੈ ਕਾਲ ਕੋ ਮੇਘ ਜੈਸ ॥੫੧੪॥
254.e: The hero Atkaaye become highly infuriated like the clouds of doomsday.514.
He began to prattle like a man without the energy of a youth, clinging to a woman without satisfying her,

254.g: ਜਿਮ ਦੰਤ ਰਹਤ ਗਹ ਸ੍ਵਾਨ ਸਸਕ ॥
ਜਿਮ ਗਏ ਬੈਸ ਬਲ ਬੀਰਜ ਰਸਕ ॥੫੧੫॥
254.e: Or like a teethless dog on catching a rabbit whom he can do no harm, or like a libertine without the semen.515.

254.g: ਜਿਮ ਦਰਬ ਹੀਣ ਕਛੁ ਕਰਿ ਬਪਾਰ ॥

254.e: Atkaaye was in such a situation which is experienced by a trader without money or a warriors without weapons.

254.g: ਜਣ ਬਾਜ ਹੀਣ ਰਥ ਕੋ ਚਲਾਵ ॥੫੧੬॥
254.e: He looked like and ugly prostitute or a chariot without horses.516.
Then the benevolent Lakshman stuck his sharp-edged sword and chopped the demon into two halves.
That warriors named Atkaaye fell in the battlefield and on seeing him (falling) many warriors fled away.517.

254.g: ਇਤਿ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਬਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਨਾਟਕੇ ਰਾਮਵਤਾਰ ਅਤਕਾਇ ਬਧਹਿ ਧਿਆਇ ਸਮਾਪਤਮ ਸਤੁ ॥੧੪॥
254.e: End of the chapter entitled ‘Killing of Atkaaye’ in Ramavtar in BACHITTAR NATAK.
Pauree:

254.g: ਘਘਾ. ਘਾਲਹੁ ਮਨਹਿ ਏਹ; ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ. ਦੂਸਰ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
254.e: GHAGHA: Put this into your mind, that there is no one except the Lord.

254.g: ਨਹ ਹੋਆ. ਨਹ ਹੋਵਨਾ; ਜਤ ਕਤ ਓਹੀ ਸਮਾਹਿ ॥
254.e: There never was, and there never shall be. He is pervading everywhere.

254.g: ਘੂਲਹਿ ਤਉ ਮਨ; ਜਉ ਆਵਹਿ ਸਰਨਾ ॥
254.e: You shall be absorbed into Him, O mind, if you come to His Sanctuary.
In this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, only the Naam, the Name of the Lord, shall be of any real use to you.
So many work and slave continually, but they come to regret and repent in the end.

254.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ; ਕਹਾ ਥਿਤਿ ਪਾਵਹਿ ॥
254.e: Without devotional worship of the Lord, how can they find stability?

254.g: ਘੋਲਿ ਮਹਾ ਰਸੁ; ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਤਿਹ ਪੀਆ ॥
254.e: They alone taste the supreme essence, and drink in the Ambrosial Nectar,

254.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰਿ; ਜਾ ਕਉ ਦੀਆ ॥੨੦॥
254.e: O Nanak, unto whom the Lord, the Guru, gives it. ||20||
Pauree:

254.g: ਙੰਙਾ. ਙ੍ਰਾਸੈ ਕਾਲੁ ਤਿਹ; ਜੋ ਸਾਕਤ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕੀਨ ॥
254.e: NGANGA: Death seizes those whom God has made into faithless cynics.

254.g: ਅਨਿਕ ਜੋਨਿ ਜਨਮਹਿ ਮਰਹਿ; ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮੁ. ਨ ਚੀਨ ॥
254.e: They are born and they die, enduring countless incarnations; they do not realize the Lord, the Supreme Soul.
They alone find spiritual wisdom and meditation,
whom the Lord blesses with His Mercy;
no one is emancipated by counting and calculating.
The vessel of clay shall surely break.
They alone live, who, while alive, meditate on the Lord.
They are respected, O Nanak, and do not remain hidden. ||21||
Pauree:
CHHACHHA: I am Your child-slave.
I am the water-carrier of the slave of Your slaves.
Chhachha: I long to become the dust under the feet of Your Saints.
Salok:

254.g: ਛਾਤੀ ਸੀਤਲ. ਮਨੁ ਸੁਖੀ; ਛੰਤ ਗੋਬਿਦ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਇ ॥
254.e: The heart is cooled and soothed, and the mind is at peace, chanting and singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe.

254.g: ਐਸੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ; ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਦਸਾਇ ॥੧॥
254.e: Show such Mercy, O God, that Nanak may become the slave of Your slaves. ||1||
Salok:

254.g: ਙਣਿ ਘਾਲੇ. ਸਭ ਦਿਵਸ ਸਾਸ; ਨਹ ਬਢਨ ਘਟਨ. ਤਿਲੁ ਸਾਰ ॥
254.e: He has counted all the days and the breaths, and placed them in people's destiny; they do not increase or decrease one little bit.

254.g: ਜੀਵਨ ਲੋਰਹਿ ਭਰਮ ਮੋਹ; ਨਾਨਕ ਤੇਊ ਗਵਾਰ ॥੧॥
254.e: Those who long to live in doubt and emotional attachment, O Nanak, are total fools. ||1||
Salok:

254.g: ਗਨਿ ਮਿਨਿ ਦੇਖਹੁ. ਮਨੈ ਮਾਹਿ; ਸਰਪਰ ਚਲਨੋ ਲੋਗ ॥
254.e: See, that even by calculating and scheming in their minds, people must surely depart in the end.

254.g: ਆਸ ਅਨਿਤ. ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਿਟੈ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਾਮ ਅਰੋਗ ॥੧॥
254.e: Hopes and desires for transitory things are erased for the Gurmukh; O Nanak, the Name alone brings true health. ||1||
AJBA STANZA
The horses jumped, the warriors thundered and began to strike blows, being bedecked with weapons and arms.521.
The bows broke, the arrows were discharged, the warriors became firm and the shafts were showered.522.
Pauree:
CHACHA: Blessed, blessed is that day,

254.g: ਧਨਿ ਧਨਿ ਉਆ ਦਿਨ; ਸੰਜੋਗ ਸਭਾਗਾ ॥
254.e: when I became attached to the Lord's Lotus Feet.

254.g: ਚਾਰਿ ਕੁੰਟ; ਦਹ ਦਿਸਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਆਇਓ ॥
254.e: After wandering around in the four quarters and the ten directions,
God showed His Mercy to me, and then I obtained the Blessed Vision of His Darshan.
By pure lifestyle and meditation, all duality is removed.
In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, the mind becomes immaculate.
Anxieties are forgotten, and the One Lord alone is seen,
O Nanak, by those whose eyes are anointed with the ointment of spiritual wisdom. ||22||
Salok:

254.g: ਘੋਖੇ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ. ਬੇਦ ਸਭ; ਆਨ. ਨ ਕਥਤਉ ਕੋਇ ॥
254.e: I have searched all the Shaastras and the Vedas, and they say nothing except this:

254.g: ਆਦਿ ਜੁਗਾਦੀ ਹੁਣਿ ਹੋਵਤ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਏਕੈ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥
254.e: "In the beginning, throughout the ages, now and forevermore, O Nanak, the One Lord alone exists." ||1||
Pauree:

254.g: ਗਗਾ. ਗੋਬਿਦ ਗੁਣ ਰਵਹੁ; ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਜਪਿ ਨੀਤ ॥
254.e: GAGGA: Chant the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe with each and every breath; meditate on Him forever.

254.g: ਕਹਾ ਬਿਸਾਸਾ ਦੇਹ ਕਾ; ਬਿਲਮ. ਨ ਕਰਿਹੋ ਮੀਤ ॥
254.e: How can you rely on the body? Do not delay, my friend;

254.g: ਨਹ ਬਾਰਿਕ. ਨਹ ਜੋਬਨੈ; ਨਹ ਬਿਰਧੀ ਕਛੁ ਬੰਧੁ ॥
254.e: there is nothing to stand in Death's way - neither in childhood, nor in youth, nor in old age.

254.g: ਓਹ ਬੇਰਾ. ਨਹ ਬੂਝੀਐ; ਜਉ ਆਇ ਪਰੈ ਜਮ ਫੰਧੁ ॥
254.e: That time is not known, when the noose of Death shall come and fall on you.

254.g: ਗਿਆਨੀ ਧਿਆਨੀ ਚਤੁਰ ਪੇਖਿ; ਰਹਨੁ ਨਹੀ. ਇਹ ਠਾਇ ॥
254.e: See, that even spiritual scholars, those who meditate, and those who are clever shall not stay in this place.

254.g: ਛਾਡਿ ਛਾਡਿ ਸਗਲੀ ਗਈ; ਮੂੜ ਤਹਾ ਲਪਟਾਹਿ ॥
254.e: Only the fool clings to that, which everyone else has abandoned and left behind.

254.g: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਰਹੈ; ਜਾਹੂ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਭਾਗ ॥
254.e: By Guru's Grace, one who has such good destiny written on his forehead remembers the Lord in meditation.

254.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਆਏ ਸਫਲ ਤੇ; ਜਾ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰਿਅਹਿ ਸੁਹਾਗ ॥੧੯॥
254.e: O Nanak, blessed and fruitful is the coming of those who obtain the Beloved Lord as their Husband. ||19||
Now begins the description of the war with Makrachh :
PAADHRI STANZA

254.g: ਕਹ ਜਾਹੁ ਰਾਮ, ਨਹੀ ਪੈਹੋ ਜਾਨ ॥
254.e: After that Makrachh joined the army and said. “O Ram! You cannot save yourself now

254.g: ਜਿਨ ਹਤਯੋ ਤਾਤ ਰਣ ਮੋ ਅਖੰਡ ॥
ਸੋ ਲਰੋ ਆਨ ਮੋ ਸੋਂ ਪ੍ਰਚੰਡ ॥੫੧੮॥
254.e: He who has killed my father, that mighty warriors should come forward and wage war with me.”518.
Ram heard these crooked words and in great rage he held his weapons and arms in his hands

254.g: ਬਹੁ ਤਾਣ ਬਾਣ ਤਿਹ ਹਣੇ ਅੰਗ ॥

254.e: He pulled (his bow) discharged his arrows, and fearlessly killed Makrachh.519.

254.g: ਜਬ ਹਤੇ ਬੀਰ ਅਰ ਹਣੀ ਸੈਨ ॥
ਤਬ ਭਜੌ ਸੂਰ ਹੁਐ ਕਰ ਨਿਚੈਨ ॥
254.e: When this hero and his army were killed, then all the warriors, becoming weaponsless, ran away (from the filed)

254.g: ਦਲ ਰੁਕਯੋ ਰਾਮ ਕੋ ਤਯਾਗ ਕਾਨ ॥੫੨੦॥
254.e: After that Kumbh and Ankumbh came forward and obstructed the army of Ram.520.

255.e: Salok:

255.g: ਠਾਕ. ਨ ਹੋਤੀ, ਤਿਨਹੁ ਦਰਿ; ਜਿਹ ਹੋਵਹੁ ਸੁਪ੍ਰਸੰਨ ॥
255.e: Those beings, with whom the Lord is thoroughly pleased, meet with no obstacles at His Door.

255.g: ਜੋ ਜਨ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਕਰੇ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਤੇ ਧਨਿ ਧੰਨਿ ॥੧॥
255.e: Those humble beings whom God has made His own, O Nanak, are blessed, so very blessed. ||1||
Pauree:
JHAJHA: Your sorrows shall depart,
when you deal with the Lord's Name.
The faithless cynic dies in sorrow and pain;

255.g: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਰਿਦੈ; ਹੋਤ ਭਾਉ ਬੀਆ ॥
255.e: his heart is filled with the love of duality.
Your evil deeds and sins shall fall away, O my mind,
listening to the ambrosial speech in the Society of the Saints.
Sexual desire, anger and wickedness fall away,
O Nanak, from those who are blessed by the Mercy of the Lord of the World. ||25||
Pauree:

255.g: ਟਹਲ ਕਰਹੁ. ਤਉ ਏਕ ਕੀ; ਜਾ ਤੇ. ਬ੍ਰਿਥਾ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
255.e: Work for the One Lord; no one returns empty-handed from Him.

255.g: ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਹੀਐ ਬਸੈ; ਜੋ ਚਾਹਹੁ ਸੋ ਹੋਇ ॥
255.e: When the Lord abides within your mind, body, mouth and heart, then whatever you desire shall come to pass.

255.g: ਟਹਲ ਮਹਲ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਮਿਲੈ; ਜਾ ਕਉ ਸਾਧ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ॥
255.e: He alone obtains the Lord's service, and the Mansion of His Presence, unto whom the Holy Saint is compassionate.

255.g: ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਤਉ ਬਸੈ; ਜਉ ਆਪਨ ਹੋਹਿ ਦਇਆਲ ॥
255.e: He joins the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, only when the Lord Himself shows His Mercy.

255.g: ਟੋਹੇ ਟਾਹੇ ਬਹੁ ਭਵਨ; ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ. ਸੁਖੁ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
255.e: I have searched and searched, across so many worlds, but without the Name, there is no peace.

255.g: ਟਲਹਿ ਜਾਮ ਕੇ ਦੂਤ ਤਿਹ; ਜੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਮਾਹਿ ॥
255.e: The Messenger of Death retreats from those who dwell in the Saadh Sangat.
Again and again, I am forever devoted to the Saints.
O Nanak, my sins from so long ago have been erased. ||27||
Please shower me with Your Mercy, O Lord God!
I have given up my excessive cleverness and scheming,
and I have taken the support of the Saints as my mind's support.

255.g: ਛਾਰੁ ਕੀ ਪੁਤਰੀ; ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
255.e: Even a puppet of ashes attains the supreme status,
O Nanak, if it has the help and support of the Saints. ||23||
Pauree:
JAJJA: When someone, in his ego, believes that he has become something,
he is caught in his error, like a parrot in a trap.
When he believes, in his ego, that he is a devotee and a spiritual teacher,
then, in the world hereafter, the Lord of the Universe shall have no regard for him at all.
When he believes himself to be a preacher,
he is merely a peddler wandering over the earth.
But one who conquers his ego in the Company of the Holy,
O Nanak, meets the Lord. ||24||
The warriors wandered after getting wounded and their zeal grew, with fury, they began to lose their senses.523.
The warriors covered with armours, began to fight in the battlefield and fell down unconscious.524.
The foppish warriors besieged Lanka
The demons army sped away feeling ashamed.525.
The brave fighters fell and their faces shone
They wedded the heavenly damsels and fulfilled their wishes.526.

255.g: ਇਤਿ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਬਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਨਾਟਕੇ ਰਾਮਵਤਾਰ ਮਕਰਾਛ ਕੁੰਭ ਅਨਕੁੰਭ ਬਧਹਿ ਧਯਾਇ ਸਮਾਪਤਮ ਸਤੁ ॥
255.e: End of the chapter entitled ‘Killing of Makrachh, Kumbh and Ankumbh’ in Ramavtar in BACHITTAR NATAK.
TRINANIN STANZA
The arrows were discharged and the warriors were wounded.
The shields were slipping down and the fires blazed.533.
Salok:

255.g: ਞਤਨ ਕਰਹੁ ਤੁਮ ਅਨਿਕ ਬਿਧਿ; ਰਹਨੁ. ਨ ਪਾਵਹੁ ਮੀਤ ॥
255.e: You can try all sorts of things, but you still cannot remain here, my friend.

255.g: ਜੀਵਤ ਰਹਹੁ. ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਜਹੁ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਾਮ ਪਰੀਤਿ ॥੧॥
255.e: But you shall live forevermore, O Nanak, if you vibrate and love the Naam, the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||1||
Pauree:

255.g: ਞੰਞਾ ਞਾਣਹੁ. ਦ੍ਰਿੜੁ ਸਹੀ; ਬਿਨਸਿ; ਜਾਤ ਏਹ ਹੇਤ ॥
255.e: NYANYA: Know this as absolutely correct, that that this ordinary love shall come to an end.

255.g: ਗਣਤੀ ਗਣਉ. ਨ ਗਣਿ ਸਕਉ; ਊਠਿ ਸਿਧਾਰੇ ਕੇਤ ॥
255.e: You may count and calculate as much as you want, but you cannot count how many have arisen and departed.

255.g: ਞੋ ਪੇਖਉ. ਸੋ ਬਿਨਸਤਉ; ਕਾ ਸਿਉ ਕਰੀਐ ਸੰਗੁ ॥
255.e: Whoever I see shall perish. With whom should I associate?

255.g: ਞਾਣਹੁ ਇਆ ਬਿਧਿ. ਸਹੀ ਚਿਤ; ਝੂਠਉ ਮਾਇਆ ਰੰਗੁ ॥
255.e: Know this as true in your consciousness, that the love of Maya is false.

255.g: ਞਾਣਤ ਸੋਈ. ਸੰਤੁ ਸੁਇ; ਭ੍ਰਮ ਤੇ. ਕੀਚਿਤ ਭਿੰਨ ॥
255.e: He alone knows, and he alone is a Saint, who is free of doubt.

255.g: ਅੰਧ ਕੂਪ ਤੇ. ਤਿਹ ਕਢਹੁ; ਜਿਹ ਹੋਵਹੁ ਸੁਪ੍ਰਸੰਨ ॥
255.e: He is lifted up and out of the deep dark pit; the Lord is totally pleased with him.

255.g: ਞਾ ਕੈ ਹਾਥਿ ਸਮਰਥ; ਤੇ ਕਾਰਨ ਕਰਨੈ ਜੋਗ ॥
255.e: God's Hand is All-powerful; He is the Creator, the Cause of causes.

255.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਤਿਹ ਉਸਤਤਿ ਕਰਉ; ਞਾਹੂ ਕੀਓ ਸੰਜੋਗ ॥੨੬॥
255.e: O Nanak, praise the One, who joins us to Himself. ||26||
Salok:

255.g: ਟੂਟੇ ਬੰਧਨ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ; ਸਾਧ ਸੇਵ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇ ॥
255.e: The bondage of birth and death is broken and peace is obtained, by serving the Holy.

255.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਮਨਹੁ ਨ ਬੀਸਰੈ; ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਿ ਗੋਬਿਦ ਰਾਇ ॥੧॥
255.e: O Nanak, may I never forget from my mind, the Treasure of Virtue, the Sovereign Lord of the Universe. ||1||
Salok:

255.g: ਝਾਲਾਘੇ. ਉਠਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿ; ਨਿਸਿ ਬਾਸੁਰ ਆਰਾਧਿ ॥
255.e: Rise early in the morning, and chant the Naam; worship and adore the Lord, night and day.

255.g: ਕਾਰ੍ਹਾ ਤੁਝੈ. ਨ ਬਿਆਪਈ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਮਿਟੈ ਉਪਾਧਿ ॥੧॥
255.e: Anxiety shall not afflict you, O Nanak, and your misfortune shall vanish. ||1||
Salok:

255.g: ਜੋਰ ਜੁਲਮ ਫੂਲਹਿ ਘਨੋ; ਕਾਚੀ ਦੇਹ ਬਿਕਾਰ ॥
255.e: Practicing oppression and tyranny, he puffs himself up; he acts in corruption with his frail, perishable body.

255.g: ਅਹੰਬੁਧਿ ਬੰਧਨ ਪਰੇ; ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮ ਛੁਟਾਰ ॥੧॥
255.e: He is bound by his egotistical intellect; O Nanak, salvation comes only through the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||
Now begins the description of the war with Ravna :
HOHA STANZA
Ravna heard about the victory (of Ram), he being highly infuriated in his mind, began to shout violently.527.
Seeing his citadel besieged his ire grew more and he saw women running away in fear.528.
All the women are running away in illusion and Ravana obstructed them catching their hair.529.
They were lamenting profusely and praying to God and were asking for forgiveness for their sins.530.
That persistent Ravana got up on listening to such sounds and it seemed that a fire cauldron was blazing.531.
He began to kill the human army and with his arrows all the directions were obstructed.532.

256.e: Pauree:

256.g: ਡਡਾ. ਡੇਰਾ ਇਹੁ ਨਹੀ; ਜਹ ਡੇਰਾ ਤਹ ਜਾਨੁ ॥
256.e: DADDA: This is not your true place; you must know where that place really is.

256.g: ਉਆ ਡੇਰਾ ਕਾ ਸੰਜਮੋ; ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਨੁ ॥
256.e: You shall come to realize the way to that place, through the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

256.g: ਇਆ ਡੇਰਾ ਕਉ; ਸ੍ਰਮੁ ਕਰਿ ਘਾਲੈ ॥
256.e: This place, here, is established by hard work,

256.g: ਜਾ ਕਾ ਤਸੂ; ਨਹੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਚਾਲੈ ॥
256.e: but not one iota of this shall go there with you.

256.g: ਉਆ ਡੇਰਾ ਕੀ; ਸੋ ਮਿਤਿ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
256.e: The value of that place beyond is known only to those,
upon whom the Perfect Lord God casts His Glance of Grace.
That permanent and true place is obtained in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy;
O Nanak, those humble beings do not waver or wander. ||29||
Salok:

256.g: ਜਹ ਸਾਧੂ ਗੋਬਿਦ ਭਜਨੁ; ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਨੀਤ ॥
256.e: Where the Holy people constantly vibrate the Kirtan of the Praises of the Lord of the Universe, O Nanak

256.g: ਣਾ ਹਉ. ਣਾ ਤੂੰ. ਣਹ ਛੁਟਹਿ; ਨਿਕਟਿ. ਨ ਜਾਈਅਹੁ ਦੂਤ ॥੧॥
256.e: - the Righteous Judge says, "Do not approach that place, O Messenger of Death, or else neither you nor I shall escape!" ||1||
Pauree:
T'HAT'HA: Those who have abandoned all else,
and who cling to the One Lord alone, do not make trouble for anyone's mind.
Those who are totally absorbed and preoccupied with Maya are dead;

256.g: ਉਆ ਕੈ ਕੁਸਲ; ਨ ਕਤਹੂ ਹੂਏ ॥
256.e: they do not find happiness anywhere.
One who dwells in the Society of the Saints finds a great peace;
the Ambrosial Nectar of the Naam becomes sweet to his soul.
That humble being, who is pleasing to his Lord and Master
- O Nanak, his mind is cooled and soothed. ||28||
Salok:

256.g: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਅਰਪਉ ਤਿਸੈ; ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ ਮੋਹਿ ॥
256.e: I offer my body, mind and wealth to anyone who can unite me with God.

256.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਭ੍ਰਮ ਭਉ ਕਾਟੀਐ; ਚੂਕੈ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਜੋਹ ॥੧॥
256.e: O Nanak, my doubts and fears have been dispelled, and the Messenger of Death does not see me any longer. ||1||
The helmets were knocked and the wounds were caused, the warriors were infuriated and their zeal grew.534.
The fast-moving horses began to run and the warriors obtained salvation after severe fighting.535.
The elephants ran like deer and the warriors took refuge with their comrades
The enemies ran and felt shy of fighting.536.
The bodies and the armours were cut, the ears and eyes were amputated.537.
The warriors breathed their last and ferried across the world-ocean, some were burnt in the fire of ire and took rufuge.538.
The gods moved in their air-vehicles and saw the scene
The heavenly damsels wandered and began to wed the warriors.539.
Various types of musical instruments resounded and the elephants thundered
The warriors took refuge while some began to fight.,540.
Pauree:

256.g: ਢਢਾ. ਢੂਢਤ ਕਹ ਫਿਰਹੁ; ਢੂਢਨੁ ਇਆ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
256.e: DHADHA: Where are you going, wandering and searching? Search instead within your own mind.

256.g: ਸੰਗਿ ਤੁਹਾਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਬਸੈ; ਬਨੁ ਬਨੁ ਕਹਾ ਫਿਰਾਹਿ ॥
256.e: God is with you, so why do you wander around from forest to forest?
In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, tear down the mound of your frightful, egotistical pride.

256.g: ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹੁ ਸਹਜੇ ਬਸਹੁ; ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥
256.e: You shall find peace, and abide in intuitive bliss; gazing upon the Blessed Vision of God's Darshan, you shall be delighted.

256.g: ਢੇਰੀ ਜਾਮੈ, ਜਮਿ ਮਰੈ; ਗਰਭ ਜੋਨਿ. ਦੁਖ ਪਾਇ ॥
256.e: One who has such a mound as this, dies and suffers the pain of reincarnation through the womb.

256.g: ਮੋਹ ਮਗਨ ਲਪਟਤ ਰਹੈ; ਹਉ ਹਉ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
256.e: One who is intoxicated by emotional attachment, entangled in egotism, selfishness and conceit, shall continue coming and going in reincarnation.

256.g: ਢਹਤ ਢਹਤ ਅਬ ਢਹਿ ਪਰੇ; ਸਾਧ ਜਨਾ ਸਰਨਾਇ ॥
256.e: Slowly and steadily, I have now surrendered to the Holy Saints; I have come to their Sanctuary.

256.g: ਦੁਖ ਕੇ ਫਾਹੇ ਕਾਟਿਆ; ਨਾਨਕ ਲੀਏ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੩੦॥
256.e: God has cut away the noose of my pain; O Nanak, He has merged me into Himself. ||30||
Salok:

256.g: ਢਾਹਨ ਲਾਗੇ. ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ; ਕਿਨਹਿ. ਨ ਘਾਲਿਓ ਬੰਧ ॥
256.e: When the Righteous Judge of Dharma begins to destroy someone, no one can place any obstacle in His Way.

256.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਉਬਰੇ ਜਪਿ ਹਰੀ; ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਸਨਬੰਧ ॥੧॥
256.e: O Nanak, those who join the Saadh Sangat and meditate on the Lord are saved. ||1||
Salok:

256.g: ਡੰਡਉਤਿ ਬੰਦਨ ਅਨਿਕ ਬਾਰ; ਸਰਬ ਕਲਾ ਸਮਰਥ ॥
256.e: I bow down, and fall to the ground in humble adoration, countless times, to the All-powerful Lord, who possesses all powers.

256.g: ਡੋਲਨ ਤੇ. ਰਾਖਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਦੇ ਕਰਿ ਹਥ ॥੧॥
256.e: Please protect me, and save me from wandering, God. Reach out and give Nanak Your Hand. ||1||
TRIGTAA STANZA
The arrows began to kill warriors and the fire came out of the shelds.541.
The horses began to run and the warriors began to roar
They began to kill one another and ferry across the worls-ocean.542.
After gaining victory in war, the enemies were being made allies,
The cleavage was caused amongst the warriors and they were also being forsaken.543.
The king Ravana thundered violently and with great zeal marched forward.544.
The warriors began to fall after being saturated with blood and th blood was flowing like water.545.
There is lot of discipline and lot of obstruction
Pauree:

256.g: ਣਾਣਾ. ਰਣ ਤੇ ਸੀਝੀਐ; ਆਤਮ ਜੀਤੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
256.e: NANNA: One who conquers his own soul, wins the battle of life.

256.g: ਹਉਮੈ ਅਨ ਸਿਉ. ਲਰਿ ਮਰੈ; ਸੋ ਸੋਭਾ ਦੂ ਹੋਇ ॥
256.e: One who dies, while fighting against egotism and alienation, becomes sublime and beautiful.

256.g: ਮਣੀ ਮਿਟਾਇ. ਜੀਵਤ ਮਰੈ; ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਉਪਦੇਸ ॥
256.e: One who eradicates his ego, remains dead while yet alive, through the Teachings of the Perfect Guru.

256.g: ਮਨੂਆ ਜੀਤੈ. ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲੈ; ਤਿਹ ਸੂਰਤਣ ਵੇਸ ॥
256.e: He conquers his mind, and meets the Lord; he is dressed in robes of honor.

256.g: ਣਾ ਕੋ ਜਾਣੈ ਆਪਣੋ; ਏਕਹਿ ਟੇਕ ਅਧਾਰ ॥
256.e: He does not claim anything as his own; the One Lord is his Anchor and Support.

256.g: ਰੈਣਿ ਦਿਣਸੁ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਰਹੈ; ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
256.e: Night and day, he continually contemplates the Almighty, Infinite Lord God.

256.g: ਰੇਣ ਸਗਲ. ਇਆ ਮਨੁ ਕਰੈ; ਏਊ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
256.e: He makes his mind the dust of all; such is the karma of the deeds he does.

256.g: ਹੁਕਮੈ ਬੂਝੈ. ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਲਿਖਿਆ ਪਾਇ ॥੩੧॥
256.e: Understanding the Hukam of the Lord's Command, he attains everlasting peace. O Nanak, such is his pre-ordained destiny. ||31||
Pauree:

256.g: ਤਤਾ. ਤਾ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਕਰਿ; ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਿ ਗੋਬਿਦ ਰਾਇ ॥
256.e: TATTA: Embrace love for the Treasure of Excellence, the Sovereign Lord of the Universe.

256.g: ਫਲ ਪਾਵਹਿ. ਮਨ ਬਾਛਤੇ; ਤਪਤਿ ਤੁਹਾਰੀ ਜਾਇ ॥
256.e: You shall obtain the fruits of your mind's desires, and your burning thirst shall be quenched.

257.e: Salok:

257.g: ਧਰ ਜੀਅਰੇ ਇਕ ਟੇਕ ਤੂ; ਲਾਹਿ ਬਿਡਾਨੀ ਆਸ ॥
257.e: O my soul, grasp the Support of the One Lord; give up your hopes in others.

257.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ; ਕਾਰਜੁ ਆਵੈ ਰਾਸਿ ॥੧॥
257.e: O Nanak, meditating on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, your affairs shall be resolved. ||1||
Pauree:
NANNA: Those whose minds and bodies are filled with the Naam,

257.g: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ; ਨਾਮੁ ਬਸਾਹੀ ॥
257.e: The Name of the Lord, shall not fall into hell.
Those Gurmukhs who chant the treasure of the Naam,

257.g: ਬਿਖੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਮਹਿ; ਨਾ ਓਇ ਖਪਤੇ ॥
257.e: are not destroyed by the poison of Maya.
Those who have been given the Mantra of the Naam by the Guru,

257.g: ਨਾਮੁ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ; ਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਨੋ ਜਾ ਕਹੁ ॥
257.e: Shall not be turned away.
Pauree:

257.g: ਥਥਾ. ਥਿਰੁ ਕੋਊ ਨਹੀ; ਕਾਇ ਪਸਾਰਹੁ ਪਾਵ ॥
257.e: T'HAT'HA: Nothing is permanent - why do you stretch out your feet?

257.g: ਅਨਿਕ ਬੰਚ. ਬਲ ਛਲ ਕਰਹੁ; ਮਾਇਆ ਏਕ ਉਪਾਵ ॥
257.e: You commit so many fraudulent and deceitful actions as you chase after Maya.

257.g: ਥੈਲੀ ਸੰਚਹੁ. ਸ੍ਰਮੁ ਕਰਹੁ; ਥਾਕਿ ਪਰਹੁ ਗਾਵਾਰ ॥
257.e: You work to fill up your bag, you fool, and then you fall down exhausted.

257.g: ਮਨ ਕੈ ਕਾਮਿ. ਨ ਆਵਈ; ਅੰਤੇ ਅਉਸਰ ਬਾਰ ॥
257.e: But this shall be of no use to you at all at that very last instant.

257.g: ਥਿਤਿ ਪਾਵਹੁ ਗੋਬਿਦ ਭਜਹੁ; ਸੰਤਹ ਕੀ ਸਿਖ ਲੇਹੁ ॥
257.e: You shall find stability only by vibrating upon the Lord of the Universe, and accepting the Teachings of the Saints.

257.g: ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਕਰਹੁ ਸਦ ਏਕ ਸਿਉ; ਇਆ ਸਾਚਾ ਅਸਨੇਹੁ ॥
257.e: Embrace love for the One Lord forever - this is true love!

257.g: ਕਾਰਨ ਕਰਨ ਕਰਾਵਨੋ; ਸਭ ਬਿਧਿ ਏਕੈ ਹਾਥ ॥
257.e: He is the Doer, the Cause of causes. All ways and means are in His Hands alone.

257.g: ਜਿਤੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਲਾਵਹੁ, ਤਿਤੁ ਤਿਤੁ ਲਗਹਿ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਜੰਤ ਅਨਾਥ ॥੩੩॥
257.e: Whatever You attach me to, to that I am attached; O Nanak, I am just a helpless creature. ||33||
Pauree:

257.g: ਧਧਾ, ਧਾਵਤ ਤਉ ਮਿਟੈ; ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿ ਹੋਇ ਬਾਸੁ ॥
257.e: DHADHA: The mind's wanderings cease, when one comes to dwell in the Society of the Saints.

257.g: ਧੁਰ ਤੇ. ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਆਪਿ; ਤਉ ਹੋਇ ਮਨਹਿ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ॥
257.e: If the Lord is Merciful from the very beginning, then one's mind is enlightened.
Those who have the true wealth are the true bankers.
The Lord, Har, Har, is their wealth, and they trade in His Name.
Patience, glory and honor come to those

257.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ; ਸ੍ਰਵਨ ਜਿਹ ਸੁਨਿਆ ॥
257.e: who listen to the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.
That Gurmukh whose heart remains merged with the Lord,
O Nanak, obtains glorious greatness. ||35||
Salok:

257.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਾਮੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੁ ਜਪਿਆ; ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ॥
257.e: O Nanak, one who chants the Naam, and meditates on the Naam with love inwardly and outwardly,

257.g: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਉਪਦੇਸਿਆ; ਨਰਕੁ ਨਾਹਿ. ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ॥੧॥
257.e: receives the Teachings from the Perfect Guru; he joins the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, and does not fall into hell. ||1||
Salok:

257.g: ਥਾਕੇ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਘਾਲਤੇ; ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਨ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਲਾਥ ॥
257.e: They have grown weary, struggling in all sorts of ways; but they are not satisfied, and their thirst is not quenched.

257.g: ਸੰਚਿ ਸੰਚਿ ਸਾਕਤ ਮੂਏ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਮਾਇਆ ਨ ਸਾਥ ॥੧॥
257.e: Gathering in and hoarding what they can, the faithless cynics die, O Nanak, but the wealth of Maya does not go with them in the end. ||1||
Pauree:

257.g: ਦਦਾ. ਦਾਤਾ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ; ਸਭ ਕਉ ਦੇਵਨਹਾਰ ॥
257.e: DADDA: The One Lord is the Great Giver; He is the Giver to all.

257.g: ਦੇਂਦੇ. ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ; ਅਗਨਤ ਭਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰ ॥
257.e: There is no limit to His Giving. His countless warehouses are filled to overflowing.
The Great Giver is alive forever.
O foolish mind, why have you forgotten Him?
No one is at fault, my friend.
God created the bondage of emotional attachment to Maya.
He Himself removes the pains of the Gurmukh;
O Nanak, he is fulfilled. ||34||
ANAAD STANZA
The sky is torn with arrows and the eyes of the warriors are getting red
The knocking on the shields is being heard and the rising flames re being seen.551.
The limbs are being chopped in the war. 546
There is lot of discipline and lot of obstruction
The limbs are being chopped in the war.547.
The sky is becoming full of heavenly damsels.548.
The warriors are pulling bows and discharging arrows.549.
The musical instruments are resounding, the warriors are thundering and are falling on the ground after swinging.550.

257.g: ਤ੍ਰਾਸ ਮਿਟੈ. ਜਮ ਪੰਥ ਕੀ; ਜਾਸੁ ਬਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਨਾਉ ॥
257.e: One whose heart is filled with the Name shall have no fear on the path of death.

257.g: ਗਤਿ ਪਾਵਹਿ. ਮਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ਮਹਲੀ; ਪਾਵਹਿ ਠਾਉ ॥
257.e: He shall obtain salvation, and his intellect shall be enlightened; he will find his place in the Mansion of the Lord's Presence.

257.g: ਤਾਹੂ ਸੰਗਿ. ਨ ਧਨੁ ਚਲੈ; ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਜੋਬਨ ਨਹ ਰਾਜ ॥
257.e: Neither wealth, nor household, nor youth, nor power shall go along with you.

257.g: ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਰਹਹੁ; ਇਹੈ ਤੁਹਾਰੈ ਕਾਜ ॥
257.e: In the Society of the Saints, meditate in remembrance on the Lord. This alone shall be of use to you.

257.g: ਤਾਤਾ. ਕਛੂ ਨ ਹੋਈ ਹੈ; ਜਉ ਤਾਪ ਨਿਵਾਰੈ ਆਪ ॥
257.e: There will be no burning at all, when He Himself takes away your fever.

257.g: ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਮਹਿ; ਆਪਹਿ ਮਾਈ ਬਾਪ ॥੩੨॥
257.e: O Nanak, the Lord Himself cherishes us; He is our Mother and Father. ||32||
Salok:

257.g: ਦਾਸਹ ਏਕੁ ਨਿਹਾਰਿਆ; ਸਭੁ ਕਛੁ ਦੇਵਨਹਾਰ ॥
257.e: His slaves have gazed upon the One Lord, the Giver of everything.

257.g: ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਰਹਹਿ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਦਰਸ ਅਧਾਰ ॥੧॥
257.e: They continue to contemplate Him with each and every breath; O Nanak, the Blessed Vision of His Darshan is their Support. ||1||

258.e: Pauree:
PAPPA: He is beyond estimation; His limits cannot be found.
The Sovereign Lord King is inaccessible;
He is the Purifier of sinners. Millions of sinners are purified;
they meet the Holy, and chant the Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord.
Deception, fraud and emotional attachment are eliminated,
by those who are protected by the Lord of the World.
He is the Supreme King, with the royal canopy above His Head.
O Nanak, there is no other at all. ||37||
Pauree:
BABBA: One who knows God is a Brahmin.
A Vaishnaav is one who, as Gurmukh, lives the righteous life of Dharma.
One who eradicates his own evil is a brave warrior;
no evil even approaches him.
Man is bound by the chains of his own egotism, selfishness and conceit.
The spiritually blind place the blame on others.
But all debates and clever tricks are of no use at all.
O Nanak, he alone comes to know, whom the Lord inspires to know. ||39||
Pauree:
BHABHA: Cast out your doubt and delusion
this world is just a dream.
The angelic beings, goddesses and gods are deluded by doubt.
The Siddhas and seekers, and even Brahma are deluded by doubt.
Wandering around, deluded by doubt, people are ruined.
It is so very difficult and treacherous to cross over this ocean of Maya.
That Gurmukh who has eradicated doubt, fear and attachment,
O Nanak, obtains supreme peace. ||40||
They are filled and fulfilled with the Ambrosial Nectar of the Lord, the Treasure of sublime wealth;
O Nanak, the unstruck celestial melody vibrates for them. ||36||
Pauree:
MAMMA: The beggar is so ignorant
the Great Giver continues to give. He is All-knowing.
Whatever He gives, He gives once and for all.
O foolish mind, why do you complain, and cry out so loud?
Whenever you ask for something, you ask for worldly things;

258.g: ਜਾ ਤੇ ਕੁਸਲ; ਨ ਕਾਹੂ ਥੀਆ ॥
258.e: no one has obtained happiness from these.
If you must ask for a gift, then ask for the One Lord.
O Nanak, by Him, you shall be saved. ||41||
BAHRAA STANZA

258.g: ਅਧਿਕ ਰੋਸ ਕਰ ਰਾਜ; ਪਖਰੀਆ ਧਾਵਹੀ ॥
ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਸੰਕ; ਪੁਕਾਰਤ ਆਵਹੀ ॥
258.e: The demon warriors wearing armours, march forward in great fury, but on reaching within the forces of Ram, they become like followers of Ram and begin to shout the name of Ram

258.g: ਰੁਝ ਜੁਝ ਝੜ ਪੜਤ ਭਯਾਨਕ ਭੂਮ ਪਰ ॥
ਰਾਮਚੰਦ੍ਰ ਕੇ ਹਾਥ; ਗਏ ਭਵਸਿੰਧ ਤਰ ॥੫੫੯॥
258.e: While fighting they fall down on the earth in a dreadful posture and ferring across the world-ocean at the hands of Ram.559.

258.g: ਸਿਮਟ ਸਾਗ ਸੰਗ੍ਰਹੈ; ਸਮੁਹ ਹੁਐ ਜੂਝਹੀ ॥
ਟੂਕ ਟੂਕ ਹੁਐ ਗਿਰਤ; ਨ ਘਰ ਕਹ ਬੂਝਹੀ ॥
258.e: After revolving and holding the lance the warriors come forward and fight and fall down on being chopped into bits

258.g: ਖੰਡ ਖੰਡ ਹੁਐ ਗਿਰਤ; ਖੰਡ ਧਨ ਖੰਡ ਰਨ ॥
ਤਨਕ ਤਨਕ ਲਗ ਜਾਹਿ; ਅਸਨ ਕੀ ਧਾਰ ਤਨ ॥੫੬੦॥
258.e: On receiving only the small blows of the edge of swords the brave fighters fall down in numerous part.560.
Salok:

258.g: ਭੈ ਭੰਜਨ ਅਘ ਦੂਖ ਨਾਸ; ਮਨਹਿ ਅਰਾਧਿ ਹਰੇ ॥
258.e: The Destroyer of fear, the Eradicator of sin and sorrow - enshrine that Lord in your mind.

258.g: ਸੰਤਸੰਗ ਜਿਹ ਰਿਦ ਬਸਿਓ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਤੇ ਨ ਭ੍ਰਮੇ ॥੧॥
258.e: One whose heart abides in the Society of the Saints, O Nanak, does not wander around in doubt. ||1||
Salok:

258.g: ਪਤਿ ਰਾਖੀ ਗੁਰਿ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ; ਤਜਿ ਪਰਪੰਚ ਮੋਹ ਬਿਕਾਰ ॥
258.e: The Guru, the Supreme Lord God, preserved my honor, when I renounced hypocrisy, emotional attachment and corruption.

258.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਸੋਊ ਆਰਾਧੀਐ; ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
258.e: O Nanak, worship and adore the One, who has no end or limitation. ||1||
Salok:

258.g: ਬਿਨਉ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਤੁਮ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ; ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਗੁਪਾਲ ॥
258.e: Hear my prayer, O Supreme Lord God, Merciful to the meek, Lord of the World.

258.g: ਸੁਖ ਸੰਪੈ ਬਹੁ ਭੋਗ ਰਸ; ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਧ ਰਵਾਲ ॥੧॥
258.e: The dust of the feet of the Holy is peace, wealth, great enjoyment and pleasure for Nanak. ||1||
The warriors saturated with blood, are falling down on the earth and the heavenly damsels are roaming
The sky is filled with the sounds of conches, other tunes and drums.552.
The armours of the warriors have been torn and they are fighting in the war
The brave fighters are confronting one another and the heavenly damsels are dancing  there is talk of war on the earth.553.
The headless trunks arose in the war and were opening their gauzy armour
With garbs like lions the warriors are highly infuriated and their hair have loosened.554.
The helmets have broken and the kings have fled away
The warriors, having been wounded, are falling on the earth after swinging and with a bang they are falling.555.
The large trumpets have resounded and the bedecked warriors are being seen
They are dying in the war being chopped in bits and being intoxicated in war-frenzy, they are becoming unconscious.556.
Innumerable weapons and arms are being used and the earth is coloured with blood upto a great distance
The weapons are being struck indiscreetly and the terrible warriors are shouting.557.
The clusters of corpses are lying scattered  the warriors are engrossed in a horrible war on one side and on the other, some of them are running away.
The ghosts and friends are laughing in the cemeteries and here the brave fighters are fighting after receiving blows of swords.558.
Salok:

258.g: ਮਾਇਆ ਡੋਲੈ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧੀ; ਮਨੁ ਲਪਟਿਓ ਤਿਹ ਸੰਗ ॥
258.e: Maya clings to the mind, and causes it to waver in so many ways.

258.g: ਮਾਗਨ. ਤੇ ਜਿਹ ਤੁਮ ਰਖਹੁ; ਸੁ ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਾਮਹਿ ਰੰਗ ॥੧॥
258.e: When You, O Lord, restrain someone from asking for wealth, then, O Nanak, he comes to love the Name. ||1||
Salok:

258.g: ਫਾਹੇ ਕਾਟੇ. ਮਿਟੇ ਗਵਨ; ਫਤਿਹ ਭਈ ਮਨਿ ਜੀਤ ॥
258.e: The noose of Death is cut, and one's wanderings cease; victory is obtained, when one conquers his own mind.

258.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਥਿਤ ਪਾਈ; ਫਿਰਨ ਮਿਟੇ ਨਿਤ ਨੀਤ ॥੧॥
258.e: O Nanak, eternal stability is obtained from the Guru, and one's day-to-day wanderings cease. ||1||
Pauree:
FAFFA: After wandering and wandering for so long, you have come;
in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, you have obtained this human body, so very difficult to obtain.

258.g: ਫਿਰਿ ਇਆ ਅਉਸਰੁ; ਚਰੈ ਨ ਹਾਥਾ ॥
258.e: This opportunity shall not come into your hands again.
So chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and the noose of Death shall be cut away.

258.g: ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਵਨ ਜਾਨੁ; ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
258.e: You shall not have to come and go in reincarnation over and over again,
if you chant and meditate on the One and Only Lord.
Shower Your Mercy, O God, Creator Lord,
and unite poor Nanak with Yourself. ||38||
SANGEET BAHRA STANZA

258.g: ਸਾਗੜਦੀ ਸਾਗ ਸੰਗ੍ਰਹੈ; ਤਾਗੜਦੀ ਰਣ ਤੁਰੀ ਨਚਾਵਹਿ ॥
ਝਾਗੜਦੀ ਝੂਮ ਗਿਰ ਭੂਮਿ; ਸਾਗੜਦੀ ਸੁਰਪੁਰਹਿ ਸਿਧਾਵਹਿ ॥
258.e: Holding the lances the warriors are causing them to dance in the war and after swinging and falling on the earth, they are leaving for the abode of gods

258.g: ਆਗੜਦੀ ਅੰਗ ਹੁਐ ਭੰਗ; ਆਗੜਦੀ ਆਹਵ ਮਹਿ ਡਿਗਹੀ ॥
ਹੋ ਬਾਗੜਦੀ ਵੀਰ ਬਿਕ੍ਰਾਰ; ਸਾਗੜਦੀ ਸ੍ਰੋਣਤ ਤਨ ਭਿਗਹੀ ॥੫੬੧॥
258.e: The brave fighters are falling with chopped limbs in the battlefield and their dreadful bodies are saturated with blood.561.

258.g: ਰਾਗੜਦੀ ਰੋਸ ਰਿਪ ਰਾਜ; ਲਾਗੜਦੀ ਲਛਮਣ ਪੈ ਧਾਯੋ ॥
ਕਾਗੜਦੀ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਤਨ ਕੁੜਯੋ; ਪਾਗੜਦੀ ਹੁਐ ਪਵਨ ਸਿਧਾਯੋ ॥
258.e: The enemy-king Ravana fell in great fury on lakshman and went towards him with wind speed and great ire

258.g: ਆਗੜਦੀ ਅਨੁਜ ਉਰ ਤਾਤ; ਘਾਗੜਦੀ ਗਹਿ ਘਾਇ ਪ੍ਰਹਾਰਯੋ ॥
ਝਾਗੜਦੀ ਝੂਮਿ ਭੂਅ ਗਿਰਯੋ; ਸਾਗੜਦੀ ਸੁਤ ਬੈਰ ਉਤਾਰਯੋ ॥੫੬੨॥
258.e: He inflicted a wound on the heart of Lakshman and in this way wreaking vengeance on him for the killing of his son, he cused the fall of Lakshman.562.

258.g: ਚਾਗੜਦੀ ਚਿੰਕ ਚਾਵਡੀ ਡਾਗੜਦੀ ਡਾਕਣ ਡਕਾਰੀ ॥
258.e: The vultures shriked and the vampires belched

258.g: ਭਾਗੜਦੀ ਭੂਤ ਭਰ ਹਰੇ; ਰਾਗੜਦੀ ਰਣ ਰੋਸ ਪ੍ਰਜਾਰੀ ॥
258.e: Burning in this fire of fury in the battlefield the ghosts and others were filled with joy

258.g: ਮਾਗੜਦੀ ਮੂਰਛਾ ਭਯੋ; ਲਾਗੜਦੀ ਲਛਮਣ ਰਣ ਜੁਝਯੋ ॥
258.e: Lakshman while fighting in the field became unconscious and Ram,

259.e: ARDH NARAAJ STANZA
The double-edged swords came out and Ram seemed greatly impressive
The sound of the kettle-drums was heard and the imprisoned people began to cry.565.
A queer scene was created and the forces of men and monkey fell on the demon forces with sharp nails like the rising clouds of the month of Sawan.566.
The warriors are roaming on all the four sides for the destruction of sins and are challenging one another
The brave fighters are leaving their bodies the gods are shouting “Bravo, Bravo”.567.
The sharp arrows are being discharged and the terrible kettle-drums are resounding
The intoxicating sounds are being heard from all the four sides.568.
Shiva and his Ganas (attendants) are seen dancing and it seems that the female ghosts are laughing and bowing their heads before Parvati.569.
Salok:

259.g: ਰੋਸੁ. ਨ ਕਾਹੂ ਸੰਗ ਕਰਹੁ; ਆਪਨ ਆਪੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
259.e: Do not be angry with anyone else; look within your own self instead.

259.g: ਹੋਇ ਨਿਮਾਨਾ. ਜਗਿ ਰਹਹੁ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਦਰੀ ਪਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
259.e: Be humble in this world, O Nanak, and by His Grace you shall be carried across. ||1||
ANOOP NIRAAJ STANZA
The vampires are roaming and the horses are moving creating a circular spectacle
The warriors are being made prisoners and are hailing.570.
There are knockings of the blows of the swords on the shields and with the arrows being discharged by the kings the humans and monkeys are falling on the earth.571.
On the other side the monkeys are shrieking
On account of what the demons are fleeing   the sounds of arrows and other weapons are creating the terrible and tumultuous resonance.572.
The groups of ghosts are feeling frightened and perplexed
The armoured horses and roaring elephants are moving in the battlefield.573.
The gods are also becoming fearful on seeing the terrible war of the warriors
Pauree:
WAWWA: Do not harbor hatred against anyone.
In each and every heart, God is contained.
The All-pervading Lord is permeating and pervading the oceans and the land.
How rare are those who, by Guru's Grace, sing of Him.

259.g: ਵੈਰ ਵਿਰੋਧ ਮਿਟੇ; ਤਿਹ ਮਨ ਤੇ ॥
259.e: Hatred and alienation depart from those
who, as Gurmukh, listen to the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises.
O Nanak, one who becomes Gurmukh chants the Name of the Lord,
Pauree:
YAYYA: People try all sorts of things,

259.g: ਏਕ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ; ਕਹ ਲਉ ਸਿਧੀਆ ॥
259.e: but without the One Name, how far can they succeed?
Those efforts, by which emancipation may be attained
those efforts are made in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.
Everyone has this idea of salvation,

259.g: ਉਆਹਿ ਜਪੇ ਬਿਨੁ; ਉਬਰ ਨ ਹੋਊ ॥
259.e: but without meditation, there can be no salvation.
The All-powerful Lord is the boat to carry us across.
O Lord, please save these worthless beings!

259.g: ਮਨ ਬਚ ਕ੍ਰਮ; ਜਿਹ ਆਪਿ ਜਨਾਈ ॥
259.e: Those whom the Lord Himself instructs in thought, word and deed
- O Nanak, their intellect is enlightened. ||43||
Salok:

259.g: ਮਤਿ ਪੂਰੀ ਪਰਧਾਨ ਤੇ; ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਮਨ ਮੰਤ ॥
259.e: Perfect is the intellect, and most distinguished is the reputation, of those whose minds are filled with the Mantra of the Perfect Guru.

259.g: ਜਿਹ ਜਾਨਿਓ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪੁਨਾ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਤੇ ਭਗਵੰਤ ॥੧॥
259.e: Those who come to know their God, O Nanak, are very fortunate. ||1||
Salok:

259.g: ਵਾਸੁਦੇਵ ਸਰਬਤ੍ਰ ਮੈ; ਊਨ ਨ ਕਤਹੂ ਠਾਇ ॥
259.e: The All-pervading Lord is in all places. There is no place where He does not exist.

259.g: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਹੈ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਕਾਇ ਦੁਰਾਇ ॥੧॥
259.e: Inside and outside, He is with you. O Nanak, what can be hidden from Him? ||1||
Pauree:

259.g: ਰਾਰਾ; ਰੇਨ ਹੋਤ ਸਭ ਜਾ ਕੀ ॥
259.e: RARRA: Be the dust under the feet of all.
Give up your egotistical pride, and the balance of your account shall be written off.
Then, you shall win the battle in the Court of the Lord, O Siblings of Destiny.

259.g: ਜਉ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ; ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥
259.e: As Gurmukh, lovingly attune yourself to the Lord's Name.
Your evil ways shall be slowly and steadily blotted out,
By the Shabad, the Incomparable Word of the Perfect Guru.
You shall be imbued with the Lord's Love, and intoxicated with the Nectar of the Naam.
O Nanak, the Lord, the Guru, has given this gift. ||44||
Salok:

259.g: ਯਾਰ ਮੀਤ ਸੁਨਿ ਸਾਜਨਹੁ; ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ. ਛੂਟਨੁ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
259.e: Listen, my dear friends and companions: without the Lord, there is no salvation.

259.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਤਿਹ ਬੰਧਨ ਕਟੇ; ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਚਰਨੀ ਪਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
259.e: O Nanak, one who falls at the Feet of the Guru, has his bonds cut away. ||1||
SANGEET BAHRAA STANZA

259.g: ਕਾਗੜਦੀ ਕਟਕ ਕਪਿ ਭਜਯੋ ਲਾਗੜਦੀ ਲਛਮਣ ਜੁਝਯੋ ਜਬ ॥
ਰਾਗੜਦੀ ਰਾਮ ਰਿਸ ਭਰਯੋ; ਸਾਗੜਦੀ ਗਹਿ ਅਸਤ੍ਰ ਸਸਤ੍ਰ ਸਭ ॥
259.e: The force of monkeys ran helter-skelter when Lakshman fell down and catching hold of his weapons and arms in his hand Ram was highly infuriated

259.g: ਧਾਗੜਦੀ ਧਉਲ ਧੜ ਹੜਯੋ ਕਾਗੜਦੀ ਕੋੜੰਭ ਕੜਕਯੋ ॥
ਭਾਗੜਦੀ ਭੂੰਮਿ ਭੜਹੜੀ ਪਾਗੜਦੀ ਜਨ ਪਲੈ ਪਲਟਯੋ ॥੫੬੪॥
259.e: With the clattering sound of the weapons of Ram, the Bull, the support of the earth trembled and the earth shook as if the doomsday had arrived.564.
Pauree:
MAMMA: Those who understand God's mystery are satisfied,
joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

259.g: ਦੁਖ ਸੁਖ ਉਆ ਕੈ; ਸਮਤ ਬੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
259.e: They look upon pleasure and pain as the same.
They are exempt from incarnation into heaven or hell.
They live in the world, and yet they are detached from it.
The Sublime Lord, the Primal Being, is totally pervading each and every heart.

259.g: ਉਆ ਰਸ ਮਹਿ; ਉਆਹੂ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
259.e: In His Love, they find peace.
O Nanak, Maya does not cling to them at all. ||42||

259.g: ਜਾਗੜਦੀ ਜਾਣ ਜੁਝਿ ਗਯੋ; ਰਾਗੜਦੀ ਰਘੁਪਤ ਇਮ ਬੁਝਯੋ ॥੫੬੩॥
259.e: The king of Raghava clan, considering him dead, became pale.563.

259.g: ਇਤਿ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਬਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਨਾਟਕੇ ਰਾਮਵਤਾਰ ਲਛਮਨ ਮੂਰਛਨਾ ਭਵੇਤ ਧਿਆਇ ਸਮਾਪਤਮ ਸਤੁ ॥
259.e: End of the chapter entitled ‘Lakshman becoming Unconscious’ in Ramvtar in BACHITTAR NATAK.
Salok:

259.g: ਲਾਲਚ ਝੂਠ ਬਿਖੈ ਬਿਆਧਿ; ਇਆ ਦੇਹੀ ਮਹਿ ਬਾਸ ॥
259.e: The afflictions of greed, falsehood and corruption abide in this body.

259.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪੀਆ; ਨਾਨਕ ਸੂਖਿ ਨਿਵਾਸ ॥੧॥
259.e: Drinking in the Ambrosial Nectar of the Lord's Name, Har, Har, O Nanak, the Gurmukh abides in peace. ||1||
Pauree:
LALLA: One who takes the medicine of the Naam, the Name of the Lord,
is cured of his pain and sorrow in an instant.
One whose heart is filled with the medicine of the Naam,
is not infested with disease, even in his dreams.

259.g: ਹਰਿ ਅਉਖਧੁ; ਸਭ ਘਟ ਹੈ ਭਾਈ ॥
259.e: The medicine of the Lord's Name is in all hearts, O Siblings of Destiny.

259.g: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਬਿਨੁ; ਬਿਧਿ ਨ ਬਨਾਈ ॥
259.e: Without the Perfect Guru, no one knows how to prepare it.
When the Perfect Guru gives the instructions to prepare it,

259.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਤਉ ਫਿਰਿ; ਦੂਖ ਨ ਥੀਆ ॥੪੫॥
259.e: then, O Nanak, one does not suffer illness again. ||45||

260.e: SANGEET BHUJANG PRAYAAT STANZA
Ram saw his brother Lakshman fighting,
And he discharged the arrows touching the sky.575.
These arrows chopped the riders on chariots and horses, but still the warriors stood firmly in the field
Ram killed the brave fighters who were wedded by the heavenly damsels.576.
In this way the war was conquered and in this war many warriors fled away
Wherever the brave fighters saw one another, they cleared the account only on sacrificing their lives.577.
The army felt ashamed on remembering the defeat

260.g: ਸਾਗੜਦੰਗ ਸੁਗ੍ਰੀਵ ਤੇ ਆਦਿ ਲੈ ਕੈ ॥

260.e: Sugriva and others got highly enraged.578.
Hanuman was also greatly infuriated and he stood firmly in the battlefield

260.g: ਤਾਗੜਦੰਗ ਤੈ ਕੈ ਹਨੂ ਤਉ ਪੁਕਾਰੇ ॥੫੭੯॥
260.e: All those who fought with him suffered defeat and for this reason Hanuman is called the “killer of all”.579.
Hanuman said to Ram, “Kindly stretch your hand towards me and bless me,
The white swords and sharp arrows are being showered.574.

260.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜੋ ਕਹਤਾ ॥੪੬॥
260.e: Har, Har, and rises above all social classes and status symbols. ||46||
Salok:

260.g: ਸਤਿ ਕਹਉ. ਸੁਨਿ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ; ਸਰਨਿ ਪਰਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇ ॥
260.e: I speak the Truth - listen, O my mind: take to the Sanctuary of the Sovereign Lord King.

260.g: ਉਕਤਿ ਸਿਆਨਪ ਸਗਲ ਤਿਆਗਿ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਲਏ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥
260.e: Give up all your clever tricks, O Nanak, and He shall absorb you into Himself. ||1||
Pauree:
SASSA: Give up your clever tricks, you ignorant fool!
God is not pleased with clever tricks and commands.
You may practice a thousand forms of cleverness,
but not even one will go along with you in the end.
Meditate on that Lord, that Lord, day and night.
O soul, He alone shall go along with you.
Those whom the Lord Himself commits to the service of the Holy,

260.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਤਾ ਕਉ; ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਬਿਆਪੈ ॥੫੦॥
260.e: O Nanak, are not afflicted by suffering. ||50||
Salok:

260.g: ਹਉ ਹਉ ਕਰਤ ਬਿਹਾਨੀਆ; ਸਾਕਤ ਮੁਗਧ ਅਜਾਨ ॥
260.e: Acting in egotism, selfishness and conceit, the foolish, ignorant, faithless cynic wastes his life.

260.g: ੜੜਕਿ ਮੁਏ. ਜਿਉ ਤ੍ਰਿਖਾਵੰਤ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਕਿਰਤਿ ਕਮਾਨ ॥੧॥
260.e: He dies in agony, like one dying of thirst; O Nanak, this is because of the deeds he has done. ||1||
Salok:

260.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮੁਖ ਤੇ ਬੋਲਨਾ; ਮਨਿ ਵੂਠੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
260.e: Chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, and keeping it in your mind, you shall find peace.

260.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ; ਥਾਨ ਥਨੰਤਰਿ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥
260.e: O Nanak, the Lord is pervading everywhere; He is contained in all spaces and interspaces. ||1||
Pauree:
RARRA: Conflict is eliminated in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy;
meditate in adoration on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the essence of karma and Dharma.
When the Beautiful Lord abides within the heart,
conflict is erased and ended.
The foolish, faithless cynic picks arguments
his heart is filled with corruption and egotistical intellect.
RARRA: For the Gurmukh, conflict is eliminated in an instant,
O Nanak, through the Teachings. ||47||
Pauree:
KHAKHA: Praise and extol Him on High,

260.g: ਜੋ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ; ਊਨੇ. ਸੁਭਰ ਭਰਾਹੂ ॥
260.e: who fills the empty to over-flowing in an instant.
When the mortal being becomes totally humble,
then he meditates night and day on God, the Detached Lord of Nirvaanaa.

260.g: ਭਾਵੈ ਖਸਮ; ਤ ਉਆ ਸੁਖੁ ਦੇਤਾ ॥
260.e: If it pleases the Will of our Lord and Master, then He blesses us with peace.
Such is the Infinite, Supreme Lord God.
He forgives countless sins in an instant.
O Nanak, our Lord and Master is merciful forever. ||49||
Salok:

260.g: ਸਾਧੂ ਕੀ ਮਨ ਓਟ ਗਹੁ; ਉਕਤਿ ਸਿਆਨਪ ਤਿਆਗੁ ॥
260.e: O mind, grasp the Support of the Holy Saint; give up your clever arguments.

260.g: ਗੁਰ ਦੀਖਿਆ ਜਿਹ ਮਨਿ ਬਸੈ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਮਸਤਕਿ ਭਾਗੁ ॥੧॥
260.e: One who has the Guru's Teachings within his mind, O Nanak, has good destiny inscribed upon his forehead. ||1||
Salok:

260.g: ਖੁਦੀ ਮਿਟੀ. ਤਬ ਸੁਖ ਭਏ; ਮਨ ਤਨ ਭਏ ਅਰੋਗ ॥
260.e: When selfishness and conceit are erased, peace comes, and the mind and body are healed.

260.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟੀ ਆਇਆ; ਉਸਤਤਿ ਕਰਨੈ ਜੋਗੁ ॥੧॥
260.e: O Nanak, then He comes to be seen - the One who is worthy of praise. ||1||
Pauree:
SASSA: I have now entered Your Sanctuary, Lord;
I am so tired of reciting the Shaastras, the Simritees and the Vedas.
I searched and searched and searched, and now I have come to realize,
that without meditating on the Lord, there is no emancipation.
With each and every breath, I make mistakes.
You are All-powerful, endless and infinite.
I seek Your Sanctuary - please save me, Merciful Lord!
Nanak is Your child, O Lord of the World. ||48||
Pauree:

260.g: ਹੇਰਉ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਸਗਲ ਕੈ; ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹੇ ਭਗਵਾਨ ॥
260.e: Behold! The Lord God is totally pervading each and every heart.

260.g: ਹੋਵਤ ਆਏ ਸਦ ਸਦੀਵ; ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨ. ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨ ॥
260.e: Forever and ever, the Guru's wisdom has been the Destroyer of pain.

260.g: ਹਉ ਛੁਟਕੈ. ਹੋਇ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਤਿਹ; ਹਉ ਨਾਹੀ. ਤਹ ਆਪਿ ॥
260.e: Quieting the ego, ecstasy is obtained. Where the ego does not exist, God Himself is there.

260.g: ਹਤੇ ਦੂਖ ਜਨਮਹ ਮਰਨ; ਸੰਤਸੰਗ ਪਰਤਾਪ ॥
260.e: The pain of birth and death is removed, by the power of the Society of the Saints.
He becomes kind to those who lovingly enshrine the Name of the Merciful Lord within their hearts,
In the Society of the Saints.

261.g: ਹਰੋ ਆਜ ਪਾਨੰ ਸੁਰੰ ਮੋਹ ਲੋਕੋ ॥੫੮੦॥
261.e: “By patting me on my back and I shall conquer all the abodes of gods today.”580.
Uttering these words Hanuman flew and it seemed that he had become one with the sky.
Ram sat down disappointed, keeping the hope in his mind.581.
Whosoever came in front of Hanuman, he killed him,
And thus killing (the forces) he reached on the bank of a tank.582.
There a terrible-looking demon was hiding

261.g: ਆਗੜਦੰਗ ਹੈ ਏਕ ਤੇ ਏਕ ਜੂਟੀ ॥੫੮੩॥
261.e: And at the same place Hanuman saw many herbs clustered with one another.583.
The highly radiant Hanuman, seeing this, was perturbed and felt confused about the herb to be taken away
He uprooted the whole mountain and returned with the medicinal herbs.584.
He reached that battlefield with the mountain where Lakshman was lying unconscious
The apothecary Sushan put the required herb in the month of Lakshman.585.
The mighty warrior Lakshman regained his senses and the roaming heavenly damsels went back
The great trumpets resounded in the battlefield.586.
The arrows were discharged and the warriors began to fight again with one another.
The brave fighters dying in the battlefield became true martyrs.587.
TRIBHANGI STANZA

261.g: ਉਜਲ ਅਸ ਧਾਰੰ ਲਸਤ ਅਪਾਰੰ ਕਰਣ ਲੁਝਾਰੰ ਛਬਿ ਧਾਰੰ ॥
261.e: The white edges of the swords, increasing splendour, looked impressive

261.g: ਸੋਭਿਤ ਜਿਮੁ ਆਰੰ, ਅਤ ਛਬਿ ਧਾਰੰ; ਸੁ ਬਧ ਸੁਧਾਰੰ ਅਰ ਗਾਰੰ ॥
261.e: These sword are the destroyers of the enemies and appear like saws
