261.g: ਜੈਪਤ੍ਰੰ ਦਾਤੀ ਮਦਿਣੰ ਮਾਤੀ ਸ੍ਰੋਣੰ ਰਾਤੀ ਜੈ ਕਰਣੰ ॥
261.e: They frighten the enemy by granting victory, by bathing in the blood,

261.g: ਦੁਜਨ ਦਲ ਹੰਤੀ ਅਛਲ ਜਯੰਤੀ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਹੰਤੀ ਭੈ ਹਰਣੰ ॥੫੮੯॥
261.e: By destroying the intoxicated tyrants and by perishing all the vices.589.
Pauree:

261.g: ਹੇ ਅਚੁਤ. ਹੇ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ; ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਅਘਨਾਸ ॥
261.e: O Immovable Lord, O Supreme Lord God, Imperishable, Destroyer of sins:

261.g: ਹੇ ਪੂਰਨ. ਹੇ ਸਰਬ ਮੈ; ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨ ਗੁਣਤਾਸ ॥
261.e: O Perfect, All-pervading Lord, Destroyer of pain, Treasure of virtue:

261.g: ਹੇ ਸੰਗੀ. ਹੇ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ; ਹੇ ਨਿਰਗੁਣ ਸਭ ਟੇਕ ॥
261.e: O Companion, Formless, Absolute Lord, Support of all:

261.g: ਹੇ ਗੋਬਿਦ. ਹੇ ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਾਨ; ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸਦਾ ਬਿਬੇਕ ॥
261.e: O Lord of the Universe, Treasure of excellence, with clear eternal understanding:

261.g: ਹੇ ਅਪਰੰਪਰ. ਹਰਿ ਹਰੇ; ਹਹਿ ਭੀ ਹੋਵਨਹਾਰ ॥
261.e: Most Remote of the Remote, Lord God: You are, You were, and You shall always be.

261.g: ਹੇ ਸੰਤਹ ਕੈ ਸਦਾ ਸੰਗਿ; ਨਿਧਾਰਾ ਆਧਾਰ ॥
261.e: O Constant Companion of the Saints, You are the Support of the unsupported.

261.g: ਹੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਹਉ ਦਾਸਰੋ; ਮੈ ਨਿਰਗੁਨ. ਗੁਨੁ, ਨਹੀ ਕੋਇ ॥
261.e: O my Lord and Master, I am Your slave. I am worthless, I have no worth at all.
Salok:
With pen in hand, the Inaccessible Lord writes man's destiny on his forehead.

261.g: ਉਰਝਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਸਭ ਸੰਗਿ; ਅਨੂਪ ਰੂਪਾਵਤੀ ॥
261.e: The Lord of Incomparable Beauty is involved with all.

261.g: ਉਸਤਤਿ ਕਹਨੁ. ਨ ਜਾਇ; ਮੁਖਹੁ ਤੁਹਾਰੀਆ ॥
261.e: I cannot describe Your Praises with my mouth, O Lord.
Nanak is fascinated, gazing upon the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan; he is a sacrifice to You. ||1||
KALAS
There was consternation, the warriors ran and their bodies wearing armour trembled
The trumpets resounded violently in the war and seeing the mighty warriors the heavenly damsels advanced towards them again.590.
Pauree:

261.g: ਲੂਣ ਹਰਾਮੀ ਗੁਨਹਗਾਰ; ਬੇਗਾਨਾ ਅਲਪ ਮਤਿ ॥
261.e: The sinner is unfaithful to himself; he is ignorant, with shallow understanding.

261.g: ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਸੁਖ ਦੀਏ; ਤਾਹਿ. ਨ ਜਾਨਤ ਤਤ ॥
261.e: He does not know the essence of all, the One who gave him body, soul and peace.

261.g: ਲਾਹਾ ਮਾਇਆ ਕਾਰਨੇ; ਦਹ ਦਿਸਿ ਢੂਢਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
261.e: For the sake of personal profit and Maya, he goes out, searching in the ten directions.

261.g: ਦੇਵਨਹਾਰ ਦਾਤਾਰ ਪ੍ਰਭ; ਨਿਮਖ. ਨ ਮਨਹਿ ਬਸਾਇ ॥
261.e: He does not enshrine the Generous Lord God, the Great Giver, in his mind, even for an instant.

261.g: ਲਾਲਚ ਝੂਠ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਮੋਹ; ਇਆ ਸੰਪੈ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
261.e: Greed, falsehood, corruption and emotional attachment - these are what he collects within his mind.

261.g: ਲੰਪਟ ਚੋਰ ਨਿੰਦਕ ਮਹਾ; ਤਿਨਹੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਬਿਹਾਇ ॥
261.e: The worst perverts, thieves and slanderers - he passes his time with them.

261.g: ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ. ਤਾ ਬਖਸਿ ਲੈਹਿ; ਖੋਟੇ. ਸੰਗਿ ਖਰੇ ॥
261.e: But if it pleases You, Lord, then You forgive the counterfeit along with the genuine.

261.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਭਾਵੈ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ; ਪਾਹਨ ਨੀਰਿ ਤਰੇ ॥੫੨॥
261.e: O Nanak, if it pleases the Supreme Lord God, then even a stone will float on water. ||52||
TRIBHANGI STANZA

261.g: ਘੁੰਮੀ ਰਣ ਹੂਰੰ, ਨਭ ਝੜ ਪੂਰੰ; ਲਖ ਲਖ ਸੂਰੰ ਮਨ ਮੋਹੀ ॥
261.e: Returning from heaven the damsels moved towards the warriors and enchanted their mind

261.g: ਆਰੁਣ ਤਨ ਬਾਣੰ, ਛਬ ਅਪ੍ਰਮਾਣੰ; ਅਤਿਦੁਤ ਖਾਣੰ ਤਨ ਸੋਹੀ ॥
261.e: Their bodies were red like the arrows saturated with blood and their beauty was unparalleled
Pauree:
In the Word, God established the three worlds.
Created from the Word, the Vedas are contemplated.
From the Word, came the Shaastras, Simritees and Puraanas.
From the Word, came the sound current of the Naad, speeches and explanations.
From the Word, comes the way of liberation from fear and doubt.
From the Word, come religious rituals, karma, sacredness and Dharma.
In the visible universe, the Word is seen.
O Nanak, the Supreme Lord God remains unattached and untouched. ||54||
Salok:

261.g: ਆਏ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਨਾਗਤੀ; ਕਿਰਪਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਦਇਆਲ ॥
261.e: O God, I have come to Your Sanctuary, O Merciful Lord, Ocean of compassion.

261.g: ਏਕ ਅਖਰੁ ਹਰਿ. ਮਨਿ ਬਸਤ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਹੋਤ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥੧॥
261.e: One whose mind is filled with the One Word of the Lord, O Nanak, becomes totally blissful. ||1||
Salok:

261.g: ਖਾਤ ਪੀਤ ਖੇਲਤ ਹਸਤ; ਭਰਮੇ ਜਨਮ ਅਨੇਕ ॥
261.e: Eating, drinking, playing and laughing, I have wandered through countless incarnations.

261.g: ਭਵਜਲ ਤੇ. ਕਾਢਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਤੇਰੀ ਟੇਕ ॥੧॥
261.e: Please, God, lift me up and out of the terrifying world-ocean. Nanak seeks Your Support. ||1||
Pauree:

261.g: ਖੇਲਤ ਖੇਲਤ ਆਇਓ; ਅਨਿਕ ਜੋਨਿ ਦੁਖ ਪਾਇ ॥
261.e: Playing, playing, I have been reincarnated countless times, but this has only brought pain.

261.g: ਖੇਦ ਮਿਟੇ ਸਾਧੂ ਮਿਲਤ; ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬਚਨ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
261.e: Troubles are removed, when one meets with the Holy; immerse yourself in the Word of the True Guru.

261.g: ਖਿਮਾ ਗਹੀ. ਸਚੁ ਸੰਚਿਓ; ਖਾਇਓ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਨਾਮ ॥
261.e: Adopting an attitude of tolerance, and gathering truth, partake of the Ambrosial Nectar of the Name.

261.g: ਖਰੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਭਈ; ਅਨਦ ਸੂਖ ਬਿਸ੍ਰਾਮ ॥
261.e: When my Lord and Master showed His Great Mercy, I found peace, happiness and bliss.

261.g: ਖੇਪ ਨਿਬਾਹੀ. ਬਹੁਤੁ ਲਾਭ; ਘਰਿ ਆਏ ਪਤਿਵੰਤ ॥
261.e: My merchandise has arrived safely, and I have made a great profit; I have returned home with honor.

261.g: ਖਰਾ ਦਿਲਾਸਾ. ਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਆ; ਆਇ ਮਿਲੇ ਭਗਵੰਤ ॥
261.e: The Guru has given me great consolation, and the Lord God has come to meet me.

261.g: ਆਪਨ ਕੀਆ. ਕਰਹਿ ਆਪਿ; ਆਗੈ ਪਾਛੈ ਆਪਿ ॥
261.e: He Himself has acted, and He Himself acts. He was in the past, and He shall be in the future.

261.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਸੋਊ ਸਰਾਹੀਐ; ਜਿ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਬਿਆਪਿ ॥੫੩॥
261.e: O Nanak, praise the One, who is contained in each and every heart. ||53||
KALAS
The terrible warriors were absorbed in fighting the ghosts, fiends and Baitals began to dance
The blows were struck with many hands creating knocking sounds and the white edges of the swords glittered.588.
In this world, no one accomplishes anything by himself.

261.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਸਭੁ ਕਛੁ; ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇ ਹੂਆ ॥੫੧॥
261.e: O Nanak, everything is done by God. ||51||
Salok:

261.g: ਲੇਖੈ. ਕਤਹਿ ਨ ਛੂਟੀਐ; ਖਿਨੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਭੂਲਨਹਾਰ ॥
261.e: Because of the balance due on his account, he can never be released; he makes mistakes each and every moment.

261.g: ਬਖਸਨਹਾਰ ਬਖਸਿ ਲੈ; ਨਾਨਕ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰ ॥੧॥
261.e: O Forgiving Lord, please forgive me, and carry Nanak across. ||1||

262.e: KALAS
Their faces were like lotus, eyes like deer and utterance like nightingale, these heavenly damsels were stores of elegance
With gait of elephants, with slim waists of lion and were captivators of mind with the side glances of their eyes.592.

262.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਦੀਜੈ ਨਾਮ ਦਾਨੁ; ਰਾਖਉ ਹੀਐ ਪਰੋਇ ॥੫੫॥
262.e: Nanak: grant me the Gift of Your Name, Lord, that I may string it and keep it within my heart. ||55||
Gauree Sukhmani, Fifth Mehl,
Salok:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
I bow to the Primal Guru.
I bow to the Guru of the ages.
I bow to the True Guru.
I bow to the Great, Divine Guru. ||1||
TRIBHANGI STANZA

262.g: ਸੋਭਿਤ ਛਬਿ ਧਾਰੰ, ਕਚ ਘੁੰਘਰਾਰੰ; ਰਸਨ ਰਸਾਰੰ ਉਜਿਆਰੰ ॥
ਪਹੁੰਚੀ ਗਜਰਾਰੰ, ਸੁਬਿਧ ਸੁਧਾਰੰ; ਮੁਕਤ ਨਿਹਾਰੰ ਉਰ ਧਾਰੰ ॥
262.e: With black hair sweet speech they appear very impressive and moving freely, they are roaming within the jostling of the elephants.

262.g: ਸੋਹਤ ਚਖ ਚਾਰੰ ਰੰਗ ਰੰਗਾਰੰ ਬਿਬਿਧ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਰੰ ਅਤਿ ਆਂਜੇ ॥
ਬਿਖ ਧਰ ਮ੍ਰਿਗ ਜੈਸੇ, ਜਲ ਜਨ ਵੈਸੇ; ਸਸੀਅਰ ਜੈਸੇ ਸਰ ਮਾਜੇ ॥੫੯੫॥
262.e: With antimony in their eyes and dyed in various coulurs they look splendid with their beautiful eyes. In this way, their eyes, assaulting like poisonous serpents, but innocent like deer, they are winsome like lotus and moon.595.
TRIBHANGI STANZA

262.g: ਧਾਯੋ ਕਰ ਕ੍ਰੁਧੰ ਸੁਭਟ ਬਿਰੁਧੰ ਗਲਿਤ ਸੁਬੁਧੰ ਗਹਿ ਬਾਣੰ ॥
262.e: That demon of vicious intellect, holding arrows in his hand and highly enraged marched forward to wage a war.

262.g: ਕੀਨੋ ਰਣ ਸੁਧੰ ਨਚਤ ਕਬੁਧੰ ਅਤ ਧੁਨ ਉਧੰ ਧਨੁ ਤਾਣੰ ॥
262.e: He fought a terrible war and amidst the pulled up bows in the battlefield, the headless trunks began to dance.

262.g: ਧਾਏ ਰਜਵਾਰੇ ਦੁਧਰ ਹਕਾਰੇ ਸੁ ਬ੍ਰਣ ਪ੍ਰਹਾਰੇ ਕਰ ਕੋਪੰ ॥
262.e: The king moved forward while challenging and inflicting wounds on the warriors, they were in great ire

262.g: ਘਾਇਨ ਤਨ ਰਜੇ ਦੁ ਪਗ ਨ ਭਜੇ ਜਨੁ ਹਰ ਗਜੇ ਪਗ ਰੋਪੰ ॥੫੯੭॥
262.e: The wounds were inflicted on the bodies of the fighters, but still they are not fleeing and thundering like clouds, they are firmly standing and fighti
KALAS
With the increase of indignation the warriors attacked each other and
The armours and helmets were shattered,
The arrows were discharged from bows and
The bits of flesh fell on being chopped form the bodies of the enemies.598.
TRIBHANGI STANZA

262.g: ਸਾਇਕ ਜਣੁ ਛੂਟੇ, ਤਿਮ ਅਰਿ ਜੂਟੇ; ਬਖਤਰ ਫੂਟੇ ਜੇਬ ਜਿਰੇ ॥
262.e: As soon as the arrows are discharged, the enemies in still greather numbers gather and prepare to fight even with the shattered armour

262.g: ਮਸਹਰ ਭੁਖਿਆਏ ਤਿਮੁ ਅਰਿ ਧਾਏ ਸਸਤ੍ਰ ਨਚਾਇਨ ਫੇਰਿ ਫਿਰੇਾਂ ॥
262.e: They move forward and run like a hungry person here and there  they are roaming hither and thither, striking their weapons.

262.g: ਸਨਮੁਖਿ ਰਣ ਗਾਜੈਂ, ਕਿਮਹੂੰ ਨ ਭਾਜੈਂ; ਲਖ ਸੁਰ ਲਾਜੈਂ ਰਣ ਰੰਗੰ ॥
262.e: They fight face to face and don not run away  seeing them waging war even the gods feel shy.

262.g: ਜੈ ਜੈ ਧੁਨ ਕਰਹੀ, ਪੁਹਪਨ ਡਰਹੀ; ਸੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਉਚਰਹੀ ਜੈ ਜੰਗੰ ॥੫੯੯॥
262.e: The gods seeing the terrible war shower flowers with the sound of ‘hail, hail  they also hail the fight in the war arena.599.
KALAS
These heavenly damsels of elegant cheeks and unique beauty, have wreaths of gems on various parts of their bodies

262.g: ਨਿਰਖ ਮਦਨ ਦੁਤ ਹੋਤ ਸੁ ਮਾਰੰ ॥੫੯੪॥
262.e: The bracelets of their hands are spreading brightness and seeing such elegance the beauty of the god of love is getting dim.594.

262.g: ਕਾਛਨੀ ਸੁਰੰਗੰ, ਛਬਿ ਅੰਗ ਅੰਗੰ; ਲਜਤ ਅਨੰਗੰ ਲਖ ਰੂਪੰ ॥
262.e: Seeing the beauty of these heavenly damsels, who were wearing elegantly coloured raiments, t

262.g: ਸਾਇਕ ਦ੍ਰਿਗ ਹਰਣੀ, ਕੁਮਤ ਪ੍ਰਜਰਣੀ; ਬਰਬਰ ਬਰਣੀ ਬੁਧ ਕੂਪੰ ॥੫੯੧॥
262.e: He cupid was felling shy and these were the intellingent heavenly damsels, doe-eyed, destroyers of bad intellect and wedders of mighty warriors.591.
TRIBHANGI STANZA

262.g: ਸੁੰਦਰ ਮ੍ਰਿਗ ਨੈਣੀ, ਸੁਰ ਪਿਕ ਬੈਣੀ; ਚਿਤ ਹਰ ਲੈਣੀ ਗਜ ਗੈਣੰ ॥
262.e: They have splendid eyes, their utterance is sweet like nightingale and they captivate the mind like the gait of the elephant

262.g: ਮਾਧੁਰ ਬਿਧਿ ਬਦਨੀ ਸੁਬੁਧਿਨ ਸਦਨੀ ਕੁਮਤਿਨ ਕਦਨੀ ਛਬਿ ਮੈਣੰ ॥
262.e: They are all-pervading, have charming faces, with elegance of the god of love, they are the store-house of good intellect, the destroyer of evil intellect,

262.g: ਅੰਗਕਾ ਸੁਰੰਗੀ, ਨਟਵਰ ਰੰਗੀ; ਝਾਝ ਉਤੰਗੀ ਪਗ ਧਾਰੰ ॥
262.e: Have godly limbs  they stand slantingly on one side, wear anklets in their feet,

262.g: ਬੇਸਰ ਗਜਰਾਰੰ, ਪਹੂਚ ਅਪਾਰੰ; ਕਚਿ ਘੁੰਘਰਾਰੰ ਆਹਾਰੰ ॥੫੯੩॥
262.e: Ivory-ornament in their nose and have black curly hair.593.
KALAS
There is betel in the mouth of Ravana an the colour of his body is red, he is moving fearlessly in the battlefield
He has plastered his body with sandalwood
He is bright like the sun and is moving with a superior gait.600.

262.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ; ਰਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ॥
262.e: In the remembrance of God are wealth, miraculous spiritual powers and the nine treasures.

262.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ; ਗਿਆਨੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਤਤੁ ਬੁਧਿ ॥
262.e: In the remembrance of God are knowledge, meditation and the essence of wisdom.

262.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ; ਜਪ ਤਪ ਪੂਜਾ ॥
262.e: In the remembrance of God are chanting, intense meditation and devotional worship.
In the remembrance of God, duality is removed.
In the remembrance of God are purifying baths at sacred shrines of pilgrimage.
In the remembrance of God, one attains honor in the Court of the Lord.

262.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ; ਹੋਇ ਸੁ ਭਲਾ ॥
262.e: In the remembrance of God, one becomes good.
In the remembrance of God, one flowers in fruition.
They alone remember Him in meditation, whom He inspires to meditate.
KALAS
The foolish Ravana was highly infuriated in the war  when the terrible war began amidst violent resonance,

262.g: ਅਰ ਦਲ ਮਧਿ ਸਬਦ ਕਰ ਉਧੰ ॥੫੯੬॥
262.e: All the warriors began to fight and roam shouting violently among the enemy forces.596.
Ashtapadee:
Meditate, meditate, meditate in remembrance of Him, and find peace.
Worry and anguish shall be dispelled from your body.
Remember in praise the One who pervades the whole Universe.
His Name is chanted by countless people, in so many ways.
The Vedas, the Puraanas and the Simritees, the purest of utterances,
were created from the One Word of the Name of the Lord.
That one, in whose soul the One Lord dwells

262.g: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਮਹਿਮਾ; ਗਨੀ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
262.e: the praises of his glory cannot be recounted.
Those who yearn only for the blessing of Your Darshan
- Nanak: save me along with them! ||1||
Salok:

262.g: ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਮਾਤਾ. ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਪਿਤਾ; ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰਾ ॥
262.e: The Divine Guru is our mother, the Divine Guru is our father; the Divine Guru is our Lord and Master, the Transcendent Lord.

262.g: ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਸਖਾ. ਅਗਿਆਨ ਭੰਜਨੁ; ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਬੰਧਿਪ ਸਹੋਦਰਾ ॥
262.e: The Divine Guru is my companion, the Destroyer of ignorance; the Divine Guru is my relative and brother.

262.g: ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਦਾਤਾ. ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਉਪਦੇਸੈ; ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਮੰਤੁ ਨਿਰੋਧਰਾ ॥
262.e: The Divine Guru is the Giver, the Teacher of the Lord's Name. The Divine Guru is the Mantra which never fails.

262.g: ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਸਾਂਤਿ. ਸਤਿ ਬੁਧਿ ਮੂਰਤਿ; ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਪਾਰਸ ਪਰਸ ਪਰਾ ॥
262.e: The Divine Guru is the image of peace, truth and wisdom. The Divine Guru is the Philosopher's Stone - touching it, one is transformed.

262.g: ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਤੀਰਥੁ. ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਸਰੋਵਰੁ; ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨ ਮਜਨੁ ਅਪਰੰਪਰਾ ॥
262.e: The Divine Guru is the sacred shrine of pilgrimage, and the pool of divine nectar; bathing in the Guru's wisdom, one experiences the Infinite.

262.g: ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਕਰਤਾ. ਸਭਿ ਪਾਪ ਹਰਤਾ; ਗੁਰਦੇਵ. ਪਤਿਤ, ਪਵਿਤ ਕਰਾ ॥
262.e: The Divine Guru is the Creator, and the Destroyer of all sins; the Divine Guru is the Purifier of sinners.

262.g: ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਆਦਿ ਜੁਗਾਦਿ ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ; ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਮੰਤੁ. ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਉਧਰਾ ॥
262.e: The Divine Guru existed in the very beginning, throughout the ages, in each and every age. The Divine Guru is the Mantra of the Lord's Name; chanting it, one is saved.

262.g: ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਸੰਗਤਿ. ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਲਿ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ; ਹਮ ਮੂੜ ਪਾਪੀ. ਜਿਤੁ ਲਗਿ ਤਰਾ ॥
262.e: O God, please be merciful to me, that I may be with the Divine Guru; I am a foolish sinner, but holding onto Him, I will be carried across.

262.g: ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ; ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਨਾਨਕ. ਹਰਿ ਨਮਸਕਰਾ ॥੧॥
262.e: The Divine Guru is the True Guru, the Supreme Lord God, the Transcendent Lord; Nanak bows in humble reverence to the Lord, the Divine Guru. ||1||
Read this Salok at the beginning, and at the end. ||
TRIBHANGI STANZA
Sukhmani: Peace of Mind, the Nectar of the Name of God.

262.g: ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੈ; ਮਨਿ ਬਿਸ੍ਰਾਮ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
262.e: The minds of the devotees abide in a joyful peace. ||Pause||

262.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ; ਗਰਭਿ ਨ ਬਸੈ ॥
262.e: Remembering God, one does not have to enter into the womb again.

262.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ; ਦੂਖੁ ਜਮੁ ਨਸੈ ॥
262.e: Remembering God, the pain of death is dispelled.
Remembering God, death is eliminated.
Remembering God, one's enemies are repelled.

262.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਿਮਰਤ; ਕਛੁ ਬਿਘਨੁ. ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
262.e: Remembering God, no obstacles are met.
Remembering God, one remains awake and aware, night and day.

262.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ; ਭਉ ਨ ਬਿਆਪੈ ॥
262.e: Remembering God, one is not touched by fear.

262.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ; ਦੁਖੁ ਨ ਸੰਤਾਪੈ ॥
262.e: Remembering God, one does not suffer sorrow.

262.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਾ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ; ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ॥
262.e: The meditative remembrance of God is in the Company of the Holy.
All treasures, O Nanak, are in the Love of the Lord. ||2||

263.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ; ਸੇ ਪਰਉਪਕਾਰੀ ॥
263.e: Those who remember God generously help others.

263.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ; ਤਿਨ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ॥
263.e: Those who remember God - to them, I am forever a sacrifice.

263.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ; ਸੇ ਮੁਖ ਸੁਹਾਵੇ ॥
263.e: Those who remember God - their faces are beautiful.

263.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ; ਤਿਨ ਸੂਖਿ ਬਿਹਾਵੈ ॥
263.e: Those who remember God abide in peace.

263.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ; ਤਿਨ ਆਤਮੁ ਜੀਤਾ ॥
263.e: Those who remember God conquer their souls.

263.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ; ਤਿਨ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਰੀਤਾ ॥
263.e: Those who remember God have a pure and spotless lifestyle.

263.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ; ਤਿਨ ਅਨਦ ਘਨੇਰੇ ॥
263.e: Those who remember God experience all sorts of joys.

263.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ; ਬਸਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਨੇਰੇ ॥
263.e: Those who remember God abide near the Lord.

263.g: ਸੰਤ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਤੇ; ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਜਾਗਿ ॥
263.e: By the Grace of the Saints, one remains awake and aware, night and day.

263.g: ਨਾਨਕ; ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ॥੬॥
263.e: O Nanak, this meditative remembrance comes only by perfect destiny. ||6||

263.g: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਕਰਿ; ਭਗਤ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਾਏ ॥
263.e: Remembering the Lord, His devotees are famous and radiant.

263.g: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਲਗਿ; ਬੇਦ ਉਪਾਏ ॥
263.e: Remembering the Lord, the Vedas were composed.

263.g: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ; ਭਏ ਸਿਧ ਜਤੀ ਦਾਤੇ ॥
263.e: Remembering the Lord, we become Siddhas, celibates and givers.

263.g: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ; ਨੀਚ ਚਹੁ ਕੁੰਟ ਜਾਤੇ ॥
263.e: Remembering the Lord, the lowly become known in all four directions.

263.g: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ; ਧਾਰੀ ਸਭ ਧਰਨਾ ॥
263.e: For the remembrance of the Lord, the whole world was established.

263.g: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਹਰਿ; ਕਾਰਨ ਕਰਨਾ ॥
263.e: Remember, remember in meditation the Lord, the Creator, the Cause of causes.

263.g: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ; ਕੀਓ ਸਗਲ ਅਕਾਰਾ ॥
263.e: For the remembrance of the Lord, He created the whole creation.

263.g: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਮਹਿ; ਆਪਿ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰਾ ॥
263.e: In the remembrance of the Lord, He Himself is Formless.

263.g: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ; ਜਿਸੁ ਆਪਿ ਬੁਝਾਇਆ ॥
263.e: By His Grace, He Himself bestows understanding.

263.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ; ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਤਿਨਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੮॥੧॥
263.e: O Nanak, the Gurmukh attains the remembrance of the Lord. ||8||1||

263.g: ਚੌਬੋਲਾ ਸ੍ਵੈਯਾ ॥
263.e: CHABOLA SWAYYA

263.g: ਸ੍ਰੀ ਰਘੁਰਾਜ ਸਰਾਸਨ ਲੈ; ਰਿਸ ਠਾਟ ਘਨੀ ਰਨ ਬਾਨ ਪ੍ਰਹਾਰੇ ॥
ਬੀਰਨ ਮਾਰ ਦੁਸਾਰ ਗਏ; ਸਰ ਅੰਬਰ ਤੇ ਬਰਸੇ ਜਨ ਓਰੇ ॥
263.e: Ram took his bow in his hand and in great ire, discharged many arrows which killed the warriors and penetrating on the other side, came in shower again from the sky.

263.g: ਬਾਜ ਗਜੀ ਰਥ ਸਾਜ ਗਿਰੇ ਧਰ; ਪਤ੍ਰ ਅਨੇਕ ਸੁ ਕਉਨ ਗਨਾਵੈ ॥
ਫਾਗਨ ਪਉਨ ਪ੍ਰਚੰਡ ਬਹੇ ਬਨ ਪਤ੍ਰਨ ਤੇ ਜਨ ਪਤ੍ਰ ਉਡਾਨੇ ॥੬੦੯॥
263.e: Innumerable elephants, horses and chariots fell in the battlefield and it appeared that with the flow of the violent wind the leaves are seen flying.609.

263.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਾ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ; ਸਭ ਤੇ ਊਚਾ ॥
263.e: The remembrance of God is the highest and most exalted of all.

263.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ; ਉਧਰੇ ਮੂਚਾ ॥
263.e: In the remembrance of God, many are saved.

263.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ; ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਬੁਝੈ ॥
263.e: In the remembrance of God, thirst is quenched.

263.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ; ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਸੁਝੈ ॥
263.e: In the remembrance of God, all things are known.

263.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ; ਨਾਹੀ ਜਮ ਤ੍ਰਾਸਾ ॥
263.e: In the remembrance of God, there is no fear of death.

263.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ; ਪੂਰਨ ਆਸਾ ॥
263.e: In the remembrance of God, hopes are fulfilled.

263.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ; ਮਨ ਕੀ ਮਲੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
263.e: In the remembrance of God, the filth of the mind is removed.

263.g: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ; ਰਿਦ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
263.e: The Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord, is absorbed into the heart.

263.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀ ਬਸਹਿ; ਸਾਧ ਕੀ ਰਸਨਾ ॥
263.e: God abides upon the tongues of His Saints.

263.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਜਨ ਕਾ; ਦਾਸਨਿ ਦਸਨਾ ॥੪॥
263.e: Nanak is the servant of the slave of His slaves. ||4||

263.g: ਤ੍ਰਿਭੰਗੀ ਛੰਦ ॥
263.e: TRIBHANGI STANZA

263.g: ਪਚਏ ਹਨਵੰਤੰ, ਲਖ ਦੁਤ ਮੰਤੰ; ਸੁ ਬਲ ਦੁਰੰਤੰ ਤਜਿ ਕਲਿਣੰ ॥
ਛਠਏ ਲਖਿ ਭ੍ਰਾਤੰ, ਤਕਤ ਪਪਾਤੰ; ਲਗਤ ਨ ਘਾਤੰ ਜੀਅ ਜਲਿਣੰ ॥
263.e: From his fifth face he was looking at Hanuman and repeating the mantra at great speed and was trying to pull his strength. From his sixth head he was seeing his fallen brother Kumbhkarn and his heart was burning.

263.g: ਸਤਏ ਲਖਿ ਰਘੁਪਤਿ, ਕਪ ਦਲ ਅਧਪਤਿ; ਸੁਭਟ ਬਿਕਟ ਮਤ ਜੁਤ ਭ੍ਰਾਤੰ ॥
ਅਠਿਓ ਸਿਰਿ ਢੋਰੈਂ, ਨਵਮਿ ਨਿਹੋਰੈਂ; ਦਸਯਨ ਬੋਰੈਂ ਰਿਸ ਰਾਤੰ ॥੬੦੫॥
263.e: From his seventh head he was seeing Ram and the army of monkeys and other mighty warriors. He was shaking his eight head and surveying everything from his ninth head and he was getting highly infuriated with rage.605.

263.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ; ਸੇ ਧਨਵੰਤੇ ॥
263.e: Those who remember God are wealthy.

263.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ; ਸੇ ਪਤਿਵੰਤੇ ॥
263.e: Those who remember God are honorable.

263.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ; ਸੇ ਜਨ ਪਰਵਾਨ ॥
263.e: Those who remember God are approved.

263.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ; ਸੇ ਪੁਰਖ ਪ੍ਰਧਾਨ ॥
263.e: Those who remember God are the most distinguished persons.

263.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ; ਸਿ ਬੇਮੁਹਤਾਜੇ ॥
263.e: Those who remember God are not lacking.

263.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ; ਸਿ ਸਰਬ ਕੇ ਰਾਜੇ ॥
263.e: Those who remember God are the rulers of all.

263.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ; ਸੇ ਸੁਖਵਾਸੀ ॥
263.e: Those who remember God dwell in peace.

263.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ; ਸਦਾ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ॥
263.e: Those who remember God are immortal and eternal.

263.g: ਸਿਮਰਨ. ਤੇ ਲਾਗੇ; ਜਿਨ ਆਪਿ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
263.e: They alone hold to the remembrance of Him, unto whom He Himself shows His Mercy.

263.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਜਨ ਕੀ; ਮੰਗੈ ਰਵਾਲਾ ॥੫॥
263.e: Nanak begs for the dust of their feet. ||5||

263.g: ਕਲਸ ॥
263.e: KALAS

263.g: ਚੰਦ੍ਰਹਾਸ ਏਕੰ ਕਰ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
263.e: In one of his hands there was the sword named Chandrahaas

263.g: ਦੁਤੀਆ ਧੋਪੁ ਗਹਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਤੀ ਕਟਾਰੀ ॥
263.e: In the second hand was another arm named Dhop and in the third hand there was spear

263.g: ਚਤ੍ਰਥ ਹਾਥ ਸੈਹਥੀ ਉਜਿਆਰੀ ॥
263.e: In his fourth hand there was a weapons named Saihathi having sharp glimmer,

263.g: ਗੋਫਨ ਗੁਰਜ ਕਰਤ ਚਮਕਾਰੀ ॥੬੦੨॥
263.e: In his fifth hand and sixth hand there was a glittering mace and a weapon named Gophan.602.

263.g: ਅਨੰਤਤੁਕਾ ॥
263.e: (OF INNUMERABLE VERSES)

263.g: ਰੋਸ ਭਰਯੋ ਤਜ ਹੋਸ ਨਿਸਾਚਰ; ਸ੍ਰੀ ਰਘੁਰਾਜ ਕੋ ਘਾਇ ਪ੍ਰਹਾਰੇ ॥
263.e: Ravana, abandoning his senses, became very furious and attacked Ramchander,

263.g: ਜੋਸ ਬਡੋ ਕਰ ਕਉਸਲਿਸੰ; ਅਧ ਬੀਚ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਸਰ ਕਾਟ ਉਤਾਰੇ ॥
263.e: The king of Raghu clan  on this side Ram intercepted midway his arrows

263.g: ਫੇਰ ਬਡੋ ਕਰ ਰੋਸ ਦਿਵਾਰਦਨ; ਧਾਇ ਪਰੈਂ ਕਪਿ ਪੁੰਜ ਸੰਘਾਰੈ ॥
ਪਟਸ ਲੋਹ ਹਥੀ ਪਰ ਸੰਗੜੀਏ ਜੰਬੁਵੇ ਜਮਦਾੜ ਚਲਾਵੈ ॥੬੦੮॥
263.e: Then he began to destroy collectively the army of monkeys and struck various types of terrible arms.608.

263.g: ਕਲਸ ॥
263.e: KALAS

263.g: ਸਿਵ ਸਿਵ ਸਿਵ ਮੁਖ ਏਕ ਉਚਾਰੰ ॥
263.e: He was repeating the name of Shiva from one face,

263.g: ਦੁਤੀਅ ਪ੍ਰਭਾ ਜਾਨਕੀ ਨਿਹਾਰੰ ॥
263.e: From the second he was looking at the beauty of Sita

263.g: ਤ੍ਰਿਤੀਅ ਝੁੰਡ ਸਭ ਸੁਭਟ ਪਚਾਰੰ ॥
263.e: From the third he was seeing his own warriors and

263.g: ਚਤ੍ਰਥ ਕਰਤ ਮਾਰ ਹੀ ਮਾਰੰ ॥੬੦੪॥
263.e: From the fourth he was shouting “Kill, Kill”.604.

263.g: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
263.e: Salok:

263.g: ਦੀਨ ਦਰਦ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨਾ; ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਨਾਥ ਅਨਾਥ ॥
263.e: O Destroyer of the pains and the suffering of the poor, O Master of each and every heart, O Masterless One:

263.g: ਸਰਣਿ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੀ ਆਇਓ; ਨਾਨਕ ਕੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਾਥ ॥੧॥
263.e: I have come seeking Your Sanctuary. O God, please be with Nanak! ||1||

263.g: ਸ੍ਵੈਯਾ ਛੰਦ ॥
263.e: SWAYYA STANZA

263.g: ਰੋਸ ਭਰਯੋ ਰਨ ਮੌ ਰਘੁਨਾਥ; ਸੁ ਰਾਵਨ ਕੋ ਬਹੁ ਬਾਨ ਪ੍ਰਹਾਰੇ ॥
ਸ੍ਰੋਣਨ ਨੈਕ ਲਗਯੋ ਤਿਨ ਕੇ; ਤਨ ਫੋਰ ਜਿਰੈ ਤਨ ਪਾਰ ਪਧਾਰੇ ॥
263.e: On being enraged, Ram discharged many arrows on Ravana and those arrows saturated slightly with blood, penetrated through the body to the other side

263.g: ਬਾਜ ਗਜੀ ਰਥ ਰਾਜ ਰਥੀ; ਰਣ ਭੂਮਿ ਗਿਰੇ ਇਹ ਭਾਤਿ ਸੰਘਾਰੇ ॥
ਤ੍ਰਿਭੰਗੀ ਛੰਦ ॥
263.e: TRIBHANGI STANZA

263.g: ਸਤਏ ਅਸ ਭਾਰੀ, ਗਦਹਿ ਉਭਾਰੀ; ਤ੍ਰਿਸੂਲ ਸੁਧਾਰੀ ਛੁਰਕਾਰੀ ॥
263.e: In his seventh hand there was another heavy and swollen mace and

263.g: ਜੰਬੂਵਾ ਅਰ ਬਾਨੰ, ਸੁ ਕਸਿ ਕਮਾਨੰ; ਚਰਮ ਅਪ੍ਰਮਾਨੰ ਧਰ ਭਾਰੀ ॥
263.e: In other hands there were trident, pincers, arrows, bow etc. as weapons and arms.

263.g: ਪੰਦ੍ਰਏ ਗਲੋਲੰ, ਪਾਸ ਅਮੋਲੰ; ਪਰਸ ਅਡੋਲੰ ਹਥਿ ਨਾਲੰ ॥
263.e: In his fifteenth hand there were an arm-like pellet bow and weapons named Pharsa.

263.g: ਬਿਛੂਆ ਪਹਰਾਯੰ, ਪਟਾ ਭ੍ਰਮਾਯੰ; ਜਿਮ ਜਮ ਧਾਯੰ ਬਿਕਰਾਲੰ ॥੬੦੩॥
263.e: He had worn in his hands steel-hooked weapons shaped like tiger’s claws and he was roaming like dreadful Yama.603.

263.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਤਾ ਕੈ; ਲਾਗਉ ਪਾਏ ॥੩॥
263.e: Nanak grasps the feet of those humble beings. ||3||

263.g: ਤਨ ਸੁਭਤ ਸੁਰੰਗੰ, ਛਬਿ ਅੰਗ ਅੰਗੰ; ਲਜਤ ਅਨੰਗੰ ਲਖ ਨੈਣੰ ॥
ਸੋਭਿਤ ਕਚਕਾਰੇ, ਅਤ ਘੁੰਘਰਾਰੇ; ਰਸਨ ਰਸਾਰੇ ਮ੍ਰਿਦ ਬੈਣੰ ॥
263.e: Seeing his winsome body and elegant limbs, the god of love is feeling shy, he has back curly hair and sweet speech

263.g: ਮੁਖਿ ਛਕਤ ਸੁਬਾਸੰ, ਦਿਨਸ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਸੰ; ਜਨੁ ਸਸ ਭਾਸੰ ਤਸ ਸੋਭੰ ॥
263.e: His face is fragranted and appears shining like sun and glorifying like moon.

263.g: ਰੀਝਤ ਚਖ ਚਾਰੰ, ਸੁਰਪੁਰ ਪਯਾਰੰ; ਦੇਵ ਦਿਵਾਰੰ ਲਖਿ ਲੋਭੰ ॥੬੦੧॥
263.e: On seeing him all feel delighted and the people of the abode of gods also do not hesitate to see him.601.

263.g: ਚੌਬੋਲਾ ਛੰਦ ॥
263.e: CHABOLA STANZA

263.g: ਧਾਏ ਮਹਾ ਬੀਰ, ਸਾਧੇ ਸਿਤੰ ਤੀਰ; ਕਾਛੇ ਰਣੰ ਚੀਰ ਬਾਨਾ ਸੁਹਾਏ ॥
263.e: Settling their whit arrows the mighty warriors moved with beautiful dress on their bodies

263.g: ਰਵਾ ਕਰਦ ਮਰਕਬ, ਯਲੋ ਤੇਜ ਇਮ ਸਭ; ਚੂੰ ਤੁੰਦ ਅਜਦ ਹੋਓ ਮਿਆ ਜੰਗਾਹੇ ॥
263.e: Their were very swift-moving and were exhibiting complete quickness in the battlefield

263.g: ਭਿੜੇ ਆਇ ਈਹਾ ਬੁਲੇ ਬੈਣ ਕੀਹਾ ਕਰੇਾਂ ਘਾਇ ਜੀਹਾ ਭਿੜੇ ਭੇੜ ਭਜੇ ॥
263.e: Sometimes they fight on this side and challenging on the other and whenever they strike the blows, the enemies flee

263.g: ਪੀਯੋ ਪੋਸਤਾਨੇ, ਭਛੋ ਰਾਬੜੀਨੇ; ਕਹਾ ਛੈਅਣੀ ਰੋਧਣੀਨੇ ਨਿਹਾਰੈਂ ॥੬੦੬॥
263.e: They appear like one intoxicated on eating hemp and roaming hither and thither.606.

263.g: ਗਾਜੇ ਮਹਾ ਸੂਰ, ਘੁਮੀ ਰਣੰ ਹੂਰ; ਭਰਮੀ ਨਭੰ ਪੂਰ ਬੇਖੰ ਅਨੂਪੰ ॥
ਵਲੇ ਵਲ ਸਾਈ ਜੀਵੀ ਜੁਗਾ ਤਾਈ ਤੈਂਡੇ ਘੋਲੀ ਜਾਈ ਅਲਾਵੀਤ ਐਸੇ ॥
263.e: The warriors roared and the heavenly damsels roamed in the sky in order to see the unique war. They prayed that this warrior waging the dreadful war should live for ages

263.g: ਲਗੋ ਲਾਰ ਥਾਨੇ, ਬਰੋ ਰਾਜ, ਮਾਨੇ; ਕਹੋ ਅਉਰ ਕਾਨੇ, ਹਠੀ ਛਾਡ ਥੇਸੋ ॥
ਬਰੋ ਆਨ ਮੋ ਕੋ, ਭਜੋ ਆਨ ਤੋ ਕੋ; ਚਲੋ ਦੇਵ ਲੋਕੋ ਤਜੋ ਬੇਗ ਲੰਕਾ ॥੬੦੭॥
263.e: And should firmly enjoy his rule. O warriors! forsake this Lanka and come to wed us and depart for heaven.607.

263.g: ਸ੍ਵੈਯਾ ॥
263.e: SWAYYA

263.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ; ਕਾਰਜ ਪੂਰੇ ॥
263.e: Remembering God, one's works are accomplished.

263.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ; ਕਬਹੁ. ਨ ਝੂਰੇ ॥
263.e: Remembering God, one never grieves.

263.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ; ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਬਾਨੀ ॥
263.e: Remembering God, one speaks the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

263.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ; ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਨੀ ॥
263.e: Remembering God, one is absorbed into the state of intuitive ease.

263.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ; ਨਿਹਚਲ ਆਸਨੁ ॥
263.e: Remembering God, one attains the unchanging position.

263.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ; ਕਮਲ ਬਿਗਾਸਨੁ ॥
263.e: Remembering God, the heart-lotus blossoms forth.

263.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ; ਅਨਹਦ ਝੁਨਕਾਰ ॥
263.e: Remembering God, the unstruck melody vibrates.

263.g: ਸੁਖੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਕਾ; ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰ ॥
263.e: The peace of the meditative remembrance of God has no end or limitation.

263.g: ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਸੇ ਜਨ; ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਇਆ ॥
263.e: They alone remember Him, upon whom God bestows His Grace.

263.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਤਿਨ ਜਨ; ਸਰਨੀ ਪਇਆ ॥੭॥
263.e: Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of those humble beings. ||7||

264.g: ਛੂਟਤ ਨਹੀ; ਕੋਟਿ ਲਖ ਬਾਹੀ ॥
264.e: You shall not be saved by hundreds of thousands and millions of helping hands.

264.g: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ; ਤਹ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਰਾਹੀ ॥
264.e: Chanting the Naam, you shall be lifted up and carried across.

264.g: ਅਨਿਕ ਬਿਘਨ; ਜਹ ਆਇ ਸੰਘਾਰੈ ॥
264.e: Where countless misfortunes threaten to destroy you,

264.g: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ; ਤਤਕਾਲ ਉਧਾਰੈ ॥
264.e: the Name of the Lord shall rescue you in an instant.

264.g: ਅਨਿਕ ਜੋਨਿ; ਜਨਮੈ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਮ ॥
264.e: Through countless incarnations, people are born and die.

264.g: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ; ਪਾਵੈ ਬਿਸ੍ਰਾਮ ॥
264.e: Chanting the Name of the Lord, you shall come to rest in peace.

264.g: ਹਉ ਮੈਲਾ ਮਲੁ; ਕਬਹੁ. ਨ ਧੋਵੈ ॥
264.e: The ego is polluted by a filth which can never be washed off.

264.g: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ; ਕੋਟਿ ਪਾਪ ਖੋਵੈ ॥
264.e: The Name of the Lord erases millions of sins.

264.g: ਐਸਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ; ਮਨ ਰੰਗਿ ॥
264.e: Chant such a Name with love, O my mind.

264.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਪਾਈਐ; ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ॥੩॥
264.e: O Nanak, it is obtained in the Company of the Holy. ||3||

264.g: ਸਗਲ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਕੋ ਰਾਜਾ; ਦੁਖੀਆ ॥
264.e: The rulers of the all the world are unhappy;

264.g: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ; ਹੋਇ ਸੁਖੀਆ ॥
264.e: one who chants the Name of the Lord becomes happy.

264.g: ਲਾਖ ਕਰੋਰੀ; ਬੰਧੁ ਨ ਪਰੈ ॥
264.e: Acquiring hundreds of thousands and millions, your desires shall not be contained.

264.g: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ; ਨਿਸਤਰੈ ॥
264.e: Chanting the Name of the Lord, you shall find release.

264.g: ਅਨਿਕ ਮਾਇਆ ਰੰਗ; ਤਿਖ ਨ ਬੁਝਾਵੈ ॥
264.e: By the countless pleasures of Maya, your thirst shall not be quenched.

264.g: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ; ਆਘਾਵੈ ॥
264.e: Chanting the Name of the Lord, you shall be satisfied.

264.g: ਜਿਹ ਮਾਰਗਿ; ਇਹੁ ਜਾਤ ਇਕੇਲਾ ॥
264.e: Upon that path where you must go all alone,

264.g: ਤਹ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੰਗਿ; ਹੋਤ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ ॥
264.e: there, only the Lord's Name shall go with you to sustain you.

264.g: ਐਸਾ ਨਾਮੁ; ਮਨ ਸਦਾ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥
264.e: On such a Name, O my mind, meditate forever.

264.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ; ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੨॥
264.e: O Nanak, as Gurmukh, you shall obtain the state of supreme dignity. ||2||

264.g: ਜਾਨੋ ਬਸੰਤ ਕੇ ਅੰਤ ਸਮੈ; ਕਦਲੀ ਦਲ ਪਉਨ ਪ੍ਰਚੰਡ ਉਖਾਰੇ ॥੬੧੦॥
264.e: The elephants, horses, chariots and charioteers fell down in the battlefield after having been chopped like the trees of banana uprooted and thrown around by the violent wind at the end of spring.610.

264.g: ਧਾਇ ਪਰੇ ਕਰ ਕੋਪ ਬਨੇਚਰ; ਹੈ ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਜੀਅ ਰੋਸ ਜਗਯੋ ॥
ਕਿਲਕਾਰ ਪੁਕਾਰ ਪਰੇ ਚਹੂੰ ਘਾਰਣ; ਛਾਡਿ ਹਠੀ ਨਹਿ ਏਕ ਭਗਯੋ ॥
264.e: The forces of monkeys also fell on the enemy, having been greatly enraged in the heart and gushed forward from all the four sides, shouting violently without retreating form its position.

264.g: ਗਹਿ ਬਾਨ ਕਮਾਨ ਗਦਾ ਬਰਛੀ; ਉਤ ਤੇ ਦਲ ਰਾਵਨ ਕੋ ਉਮਗਯੋ ॥
ਭਟ ਜੂਝਿ ਅਰੂਝਿ ਗਿਰੇ ਧਰਣੀ; ਦਿਜਰਾਜ ਭ੍ਰਮਯੋ ਸਿਵ ਧਯਾਨ ਡਿਗਯੋ ॥੬੧੧॥
264.e: From the other side, the army of Ravana rushed forward taking its weapons and arms like arrows, bows, maces, fell in such a way that the moon taking its course got illusioned and the contemplation of Shiva was obstructed.611.

264.g: ਜੂਝਿ ਅਰੂਝਿ ਗਿਰੇ ਭਟਵਾ ਤਨ; ਘਾਇਨ ਘਾਇ ਘਨੇ ਭਿਭਰਾਨੇ ॥
ਜੰਬੁਕ ਗਿਧ ਪਿਸਾਚ ਨਿਸਾਚਰ ਫੂਲ ਫਿਰੇ ਰਨ ਮੌ ਰਹਸਾਨੇ ॥
264.e: After receiving wounds on the body, the warriors swung and began to fall and the jackals, vultures, ghosts and fiends were delighted in mind.

264.g: ਕਾਪ ਉਠੀ ਸੁ ਦਿਸਾ ਬਿਦਿਸਾ; ਦਿਗਪਾਲਨ ਫੇਰ ਪ੍ਰਲੈ ਅਨੁਮਾਨੇ ॥
264.e: All the directions trembled on seeing the terrible war and the digpals (supervisors and directors) guessed the arrival of doomsday

264.g: ਭੂਮਿ ਅਕਾਸ ਉਦਾਸ ਭਏ; ਗਨ ਦੇਵ ਅਦੇਵ ਭ੍ਰਮੇ ਭਹਰਾਨੇ ॥੬੧੨॥
264.e: The earth and sky became anxious and seeing the dreadfulness of the war the gods and demons were both bewildered.612.

264.g: ਰਾਵਨ ਰੋਸ ਭਰਯੋ ਰਨ ਮੋ; ਰਿਸ ਸੌ ਸਰ ਓਘ ਪ੍ਰਓਘ ਪ੍ਰਹਾਰੇ ॥
264.e: Being highly infuriated in mind Ravana began to discharge arrows collectively and

264.g: ਭੂਮਿ ਅਕਾਸ ਦਿਸਾ ਬਿਦਿਸਾ; ਸਭ ਓਰ ਰੁਕੇ ਨਹਿ ਜਾਤ ਨਿਹਾਰੇ ॥
264.e: With his arrows the earth, sky and all directions were torn asunder

264.g: ਸ੍ਰੀ ਰਘੁਰਾਜ ਸਰਾਸਨ ਲੈ; ਛਿਨ ਮੌ ਛੁਭ ਕੈ ਸਰ ਪੁੰਜ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ ॥
264.e: On this side Ram was enraged for and instant and destroyed the collective discharging of all those arrows and

264.g: ਜਾਨਕ ਭਾਨ ਉਦੈ ਨਿਸ ਕਉ; ਲਖਿ ਕੈ ਸਭ ਹੀ ਤਪ ਤੇਜ ਪਧਾਰੇ ॥੬੧੩॥
264.e: The darkness that had spread on account of arrows, got cleared by the spread of the sunshine again on all the four sides.613.

264.g: ਰੋਸ ਭਰੇ ਰਨ ਮੋ ਰਘੁਨਾਥ; ਕਮਾਨ ਲੈ ਬਾਨ ਅਨੇਕ ਚਲਾਏ ॥
264.e: Filled with anger Ram discharged many arrows and

264.g: ਬਾਜ ਗਜੀ ਗਜਰਾਜ ਘਨੇ; ਰਥ ਰਾਜ ਬਨੇ ਕਰਿ ਰੋਸ ਉਡਾਏ ॥
264.e: Caused the elephants, horses and charioteers to fly away

264.g: ਜੇ ਦੁਖ ਦੇਹ ਕਟੇ ਸੀਅ ਕੇ ਹਿਤ ਤੇ ਰਨ ਆਜ ਪ੍ਰਤਖ ਦਿਖਾਏ ॥
264.e: The way in which the anguish of Sita could be removed and she could be set free,

264.g: ਰਾਜੀਵ ਲੋਚਨ ਰਾਮ ਕੁਮਾਰ; ਘਨੋ ਰਨ ਘਾਲ ਘਨੋ ਘਰ ਘਾਏ ॥੬੧੪॥
264.e: Ram made today all such efforts and that lotus-eyed one caused the desertion of many homes with his terrible warfare.614.

264.g: ਰਾਵਨ ਰੋਸ ਭਰਯੋ ਗਰਜਯੋ; ਰਨ ਮੋ ਲਹਿ ਕੈ ਸਭ ਸੈਨ ਭਜਾਨਯੋ ॥
264.e: Ravana thundered in rage and causing his army to rush forward,

264.g: ਆਪ ਹੀ ਹਾਕ ਹਥਿਯਾਰ ਹਠੀ; ਗਹਿ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਰਘੁਨੰਦਨ ਸੋ ਰਣ ਠਾਨਯੋ ॥
264.e: Shouting loudly and holding his weapons in his hands, he came straight towards Ram and fought with him

264.g: ਚਾਬਕ ਮਾਰ ਕੁਦਾਇ ਤੁਰੰਗਨ; ਜਾਇ ਪਰਯੋ ਕਛੁ ਤ੍ਰਾਸ ਨ ਮਾਨਯੋ ॥
264.e: He caused his horses to gallop fearlessly by whipping them.

264.g: ਬਾਨਨ ਤੇ ਬਿਧੁ ਬਾਹਨ ਤੇ; ਮਨ ਮਾਰਤ ਕੋ ਰਥ ਛੋਰਿ ਸਿਧਾਨਯੋ ॥੬੧੫॥
264.e: He left his chariot I order to kill Ram with his arrows and came forward.615.

264.g: ਸ੍ਰੀ ਰਘੁਨੰਦਨ ਕੀ ਭੁਜ ਕੇ; ਜਬ ਛੋਰ ਸਰਾਸਨ ਬਾਨ ਉਡਾਨੇ ॥
264.e: When the arrows were discharged form the hands of Ram the earth,

264.g: ਭੂੰਮਿ ਅਕਾਸ ਪਤਾਰ ਚਹੂੰ ਚਕ; ਪੂਰ ਰਹੇ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਤ ਪਛਾਨੇ ॥
264.e: Sky, netherworld and four directions could hardly be recognized

264.g: ਤੋਰ ਸਨਾਹ ਸੁਬਾਹਨ ਕੇ ਤਨ; ਆਹ ਕਰੀ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਰ ਪਰਾਨੇ ॥
264.e: Those arrows, piercing through the armours of warriors and killing them without the utterance of a sigh,

264.g: ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ; ਬਰਤਨਿ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
264.e: Unto the devotee, the Naam is an article of daily use.

264.g: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੈ; ਮਨਿ ਬਿਸ੍ਰਾਮੁ ॥
264.e: The minds of the humble Saints are at peace.

264.g: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ; ਦਾਸ ਕੀ ਓਟ ॥
264.e: The Name of the Lord is the Support of His servants.

264.g: ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਨਾਮਿ; ਉਧਰੇ ਜਨ ਕੋਟਿ ॥
264.e: By the Name of the Lord, millions have been saved.

264.g: ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਕਰਤ; ਸੰਤ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤਿ ॥
264.e: The Saints chant the Praises of the Lord, day and night.

264.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਅਉਖਧੁ; ਸਾਧ ਕਮਾਤਿ ॥
264.e: Har, Har - the Lord's Name - the Holy use it as their healing medicine.

264.g: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਕੈ; ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ॥
264.e: The Lord's Name is the treasure of the Lord's servant.

264.g: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮਿ; ਜਨ ਕੀਨੋ ਦਾਨ ॥
264.e: The Supreme Lord God has blessed His humble servant with this gift.

264.g: ਮਨ ਤਨ ਰੰਗਿ; ਰਤੇ ਰੰਗ ਏਕੈ ॥
264.e: Mind and body are imbued with ecstasy in the Love of the One Lord.

264.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਜਨ ਕੈ; ਬਿਰਤਿ ਬਿਬੇਕੈ ॥੫॥
264.e: O Nanak, careful and discerning understanding is the way of the Lord's humble servant. ||5||

264.g: ਜਿਹ ਮਾਰਗ ਕੇ; ਗਨੇ ਜਾਹਿ ਨ. ਕੋਸਾ ॥
264.e: On that path where the miles cannot be counted,

264.g: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ; ਊਹਾ ਸੰਗਿ ਤੋਸਾ ॥
264.e: there, the Name of the Lord shall be your sustenance.

264.g: ਜਿਹ ਪੈਡੈ; ਮਹਾ ਅੰਧ ਗੁਬਾਰਾ ॥
264.e: On that journey of total, pitch-black darkness,

264.g: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ; ਸੰਗਿ ਉਜੀਆਰਾ ॥
264.e: the Name of the Lord shall be the Light with you.

264.g: ਜਹਾ ਪੰਥਿ; ਤੇਰਾ. ਕੋ ਨ ਸਿਞਾਨੂ ॥
264.e: On that journey where no one knows you,

264.g: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ; ਤਹ ਨਾਲਿ ਪਛਾਨੂ ॥
264.e: with the Name of the Lord, you shall be recognized.

264.g: ਜਹ ਮਹਾ ਭਇਆਨ; ਤਪਤਿ ਬਹੁ ਘਾਮ ॥
264.e: Where there is awesome and terrible heat and blazing sunshine,

264.g: ਤਹ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ; ਤੁਮ ਊਪਰਿ ਛਾਮ ॥
264.e: there, the Name of the Lord will give you shade.

264.g: ਜਹਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਖਾ; ਮਨ ਤੁਝੁ ਆਕਰਖੈ ॥
264.e: Where thirst, O my mind, torments you to cry out,

264.g: ਤਹ ਨਾਨਕ; ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਬਰਖੈ ॥੪॥
264.e: there, O Nanak, the Ambrosial Name, Har, Har, shall rain down upon you. ||4||

264.g: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ; ਜਨ ਕਉ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਜੁਗਤਿ ॥
264.e: The Name of the Lord is the path of liberation for His humble servants.

264.g: ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਨਾਮਿ; ਜਨ ਕਉ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਭੁਗਤਿ ॥
264.e: With the food of the Name of the Lord, His servants are satisfied.

264.g: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ; ਜਨ ਕਾ ਰੂਪ ਰੰਗੁ ॥
264.e: The Name of the Lord is the beauty and delight of His servants.

264.g: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ; ਕਬ. ਪਰੈ ਨ ਭੰਗੁ ॥
264.e: Chanting the Lord's Name, one is never blocked by obstacles.

264.g: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ; ਜਨ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
264.e: The Name of the Lord is the glorious greatness of His servants.

264.g: ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਨਾਮਿ; ਜਨ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਈ ॥
264.e: Through the Name of the Lord, His servants obtain honor.

264.g: ਅਸਟਪਦੀ ॥
264.e: Ashtapadee:

264.g: ਜਹ ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ; ਸੁਤ ਮੀਤ ਨ ਭਾਈ ॥
264.e: Where there is no mother, father, children, friends or siblings

264.g: ਮਨ ਊਹਾ; ਨਾਮੁ ਤੇਰੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਹਾਈ ॥
264.e: O my mind, there, only the Naam, the Name of the Lord, shall be with you as your help and support.

264.g: ਜਹ ਮਹਾ ਭਇਆਨ; ਦੂਤ ਜਮ ਦਲੈ ॥
264.e: Where the great and terrible Messenger of Death shall try to crush you,

264.g: ਤਹ ਕੇਵਲ ਨਾਮੁ; ਸੰਗਿ ਤੇਰੈ ਚਲੈ ॥
264.e: there, only the Naam shall go along with you.

264.g: ਜਹ ਮੁਸਕਲ ਹੋਵੈ; ਅਤਿ ਭਾਰੀ ॥
264.e: Where the obstacles are so very heavy,

264.g: ਹਰਿ ਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ; ਖਿਨ ਮਾਹਿ ਉਧਾਰੀ ॥
264.e: the Name of the Lord shall rescue you in an instant.

264.g: ਅਨਿਕ ਪੁਨਹਚਰਨ ਕਰਤ; ਨਹੀ ਤਰੈ ॥
264.e: By performing countless religious rituals, you shall not be saved.

264.g: ਹਰਿ ਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ; ਕੋਟਿ ਪਾਪ ਪਰਹਰੈ ॥
264.e: The Name of the Lord washes off millions of sins.

264.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ; ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ॥
264.e: As Gurmukh, chant the Naam, O my mind.

264.g: ਨਾਨਕ; ਪਾਵਹੁ ਸੂਖ ਘਨੇਰੇ ॥੧॥
264.e: O Nanak, you shall obtain countless joys. ||1||

265.g: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
265.e: Salok:

265.g: ਬਹੁ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ. ਬਹੁ ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤੀ; ਪੇਖੇ ਸਰਬ ਢਢੋਲਿ ॥
265.e: The many Shaastras and the many Simritees - I have seen and searched through them all.

265.g: ਪੂਜਸਿ ਨਾਹੀ. ਹਰਿ ਹਰੇ; ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮ ਅਮੋਲ ॥੧॥
265.e: They are not equal to Har, Haray - O Nanak, the Lord's Invaluable Name. ||1||

265.g: ਮਨ ਕਾਮਨਾ; ਤੀਰਥ ਦੇਹ ਛੁਟੈ ॥
265.e: With your mind filled with desire, you may give up your body at a sacred shrine of pilgrimage;

265.g: ਗਰਬੁ ਗੁਮਾਨੁ; ਨ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਹੁਟੈ ॥
265.e: but even so, egotistical pride shall not be removed from your mind.

265.g: ਸੋਚ ਕਰੈ; ਦਿਨਸੁ ਅਰੁ ਰਾਤਿ ॥
265.e: You may practice cleansing day and night,

265.g: ਮਨ ਕੀ ਮੈਲੁ; ਨ ਤਨ ਤੇ ਜਾਤਿ ॥
265.e: but the filth of your mind shall not leave your body.

265.g: ਇਸੁ ਦੇਹੀ ਕਉ; ਬਹੁ ਸਾਧਨਾ ਕਰੈ ॥
265.e: You may subject your body to all sorts of disciplines,

265.g: ਮਨ ਤੇ ਕਬਹੂ; ਨ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਟਰੈ ॥
265.e: but your mind will never be rid of its corruption.

265.g: ਜਲਿ ਧੋਵੈ ਬਹੁ; ਦੇਹ ਅਨੀਤਿ ॥
265.e: You may wash this transitory body with loads of water,

265.g: ਸੁਧ ਕਹਾ ਹੋਇ; ਕਾਚੀ ਭੀਤਿ ॥
265.e: but how can a wall of mud be washed clean?

265.g: ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ; ਮਹਿਮਾ ਊਚ ॥
265.e: O my mind, the Glorious Praise of the Name of the Lord is the highest;

265.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਉਧਰੇ; ਪਤਿਤ ਬਹੁ ਮੂਚ ॥੩॥
265.e: O Nanak, the Naam has saved so many of the worst sinners. ||3||

265.g: ਪਾਰਜਾਤੁ ਇਹੁ; ਹਰਿ ਕੋ ਨਾਮ ॥
265.e: This Elysian Tree of miraculous powers is the Name of the Lord.

265.g: ਕਾਮਧੇਨ; ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਮ ॥
265.e: The Khaamadhayn, the cow of miraculous powers, is the singing of the Glory of the Lord's Name, Har, Har.

265.g: ਸਭ ਤੇ ਊਤਮ; ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਕਥਾ ॥
265.e: Highest of all is the Lord's Speech.

265.g: ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਨਤ; ਦਰਦ ਦੁਖ ਲਥਾ ॥
265.e: Hearing the Naam, pain and sorrow are removed.

265.g: ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਮਹਿਮਾ; ਸੰਤ ਰਿਦ ਵਸੈ ॥
265.e: The Glory of the Naam abides in the hearts of His Saints.

265.g: ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਤਾਪਿ; ਦੁਰਤੁ ਸਭੁ ਨਸੈ ॥
265.e: By the Saint's kind intervention, all guilt is dispelled.

265.g: ਸੰਤ ਕਾ ਸੰਗੁ; ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
265.e: The Society of the Saints is obtained by great good fortune.

265.g: ਸੰਤ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ; ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥
265.e: Serving the Saint, one meditates on the Naam.

265.g: ਨਾਮ ਤੁਲਿ; ਕਛੁ ਅਵਰੁ. ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
265.e: There is nothing equal to the Naam.

265.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ; ਨਾਮੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਜਨੁ ਕੋਇ ॥੮॥੨॥
265.e: O Nanak, rare are those, who, as Gurmukh, obtain the Naam. ||8||2||

265.g: ਨਉ ਖੰਡ ਪ੍ਰਿਥਮੀ ਫਿਰੈ; ਚਿਰੁ ਜੀਵੈ ॥
265.e: You may roam over the nine continents of the world and live a very long life;

265.g: ਮਹਾ ਉਦਾਸੁ; ਤਪੀਸਰੁ ਥੀਵੈ ॥
265.e: you may become a great ascetic and a master of disciplined meditation

265.g: ਅਗਨਿ ਮਾਹਿ; ਹੋਮਤ ਪਰਾਨ ॥
265.e: and burn yourself in fire;

265.g: ਕਨਿਕ ਅਸ੍ਵ ਹੈਵਰ; ਭੂਮਿ ਦਾਨ ॥
265.e: you may give away gold, horses, elephants and land;

265.g: ਨਿਉਲੀ ਕਰਮ ਕਰੈ ਬਹੁ ਆਸਨ ॥
265.e: you may practice techniques of inner cleansing and all sorts of Yogic postures;

265.g: ਜੈਨ ਮਾਰਗ; ਸੰਜਮ ਅਤਿ ਸਾਧਨ ॥
265.e: you may adopt the self-mortifying ways of the Jains and great spiritual disciplines;

265.g: ਨਿਮਖ ਨਿਮਖ ਕਰਿ; ਸਰੀਰੁ ਕਟਾਵੈ ॥
265.e: piece by piece, you may cut your body apart;

265.g: ਤਉ ਭੀ; ਹਉਮੈ ਮੈਲੁ. ਨ ਜਾਵੈ ॥
265.e: but even so, the filth of your ego shall not depart.

265.g: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਸਮਸਰਿ; ਕਛੁ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
265.e: There is nothing equal to the Name of the Lord.

265.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ; ਗਤਿ ਪਾਹਿ ॥੨॥
265.e: O Nanak, as Gurmukh, chant the Naam, and obtain salvation. ||2||

265.g: ਛੋਦ ਕਰੋਟਨ ਓਟਨ ਕੋਟ; ਅਟਾਨਮੋ ਜਾਨਕੀ ਬਾਨ ਪਛਾਨੇ ॥੬੧੬॥
265.e: They penetrated to the other side, when the arrows fell after piercing the steel-armours, Sita realized that these arrows were discharged by Ram.616.

265.g: ਸ੍ਰੀ ਅਸੁਰਾਰਦਨ ਕੇ ਕਰ ਕੋ; ਜਿਨ ਏਕ ਹੀ ਬਾਨ ਬਿਖੈ ਤਨ ਚਾਖਯੋ ॥
ਭਾਜ ਸਰਯੋ ਨ ਭਿਰਯੋ ਹਠ ਕੈ; ਭਟ ਏਕ ਹੀ ਘਾਇ ਧਰਾ ਪਰ ਰਾਖਯੋ ॥
265.e: He, who was struck by arrows of Ram, that warrior could neither run away from that place nor could fight but fell dead on the ground.

265.g: ਛੇਦ ਸਨਾਹ ਸੁਬਾਹਨ ਕੋ ਸਰ; ਓਟਨ ਕੋਟ ਕਰੋਟਨ ਨਾਖਯੋ ॥
ਸੁਆਰ ਜੁਝਾਰ ਅਪਾਰ ਹਠੀ; ਰਨ ਹਾਰ ਗਿਰੇ ਧਰ, ਹਾਇ ਨ ਭਾਖਯੋ ॥੬੧੭॥
265.e: The arrows of Ram pierced through the armour of warriors and then mighty fighters fell down on the earth without uttering a sign.617.

265.g: ਆਨ ਅਰੇ ਸੁ ਮਰੇ ਸਭ ਹੀ ਭਟ; ਜੀਤ ਬਚੇ ਰਨ ਛਾਡਿ ਪਰਾਨੇ ॥
265.e: Ravana called all his warriors, but those remaining fighters fled away

265.g: ਦੇਵ ਅਦੇਵਨ ਕੇ ਜਿਤੀਯਾ ਰਨ; ਕੋਟ ਹਤੇ ਕਰ ਏਕ ਨ ਜਾਨੇ ॥
265.e: Ravna killed millions of gods and demons, but it made no difference in the battlefield.

265.g: ਸ੍ਰੀ ਰਘੁਰਾਜ ਪ੍ਰਾਕ੍ਰਮ ਕੋ; ਲਖ ਤੇਜ ਸੰਬੂਹ ਸਭੈ ਭਹਰਾਨੇ ॥
265.e: Seeing the power of Ram the illustrious persons were perturbed and

265.g: ਓਟਨ ਕੂਦ ਕਰੋਟਨ ਫਾਧ ਸੁ; ਲੰਕਹਿ ਛਾਡਿ ਬਿਲੰਕ ਸਿਧਾਨੇ ॥੬੧੮॥
265.e: Jumping over the walls of the citadel, they ran away.618.

265.g: ਰਾਵਨ ਰੋਸ ਭਰਯੋ ਰਨ ਮੋ; ਗਹਿ ਬੀਸ ਹੂੰ ਬਾਹਿ ਹਥਯਾਰ ਪ੍ਰਹਾਰੇ ॥
ਭੂੰਮਿ ਅਕਾਸ ਦਿਸਾ ਬਿਦਿਸਾ; ਚਕਿ ਚਾਰ ਰੁਕੇ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਤ ਨਿਹਾਰੇ ॥
265.e: In great fury Ravana attacked with weapons from all the twenty arms and with his blows the earth, sky and all the four directions became invisible

265.g: ਫੋਕਨ ਤੈ ਫਲ ਤੈ ਮਧ ਤੈ ਅਧ ਤੈ ਬਧ ਕੈ ਰਣ ਮੰਡਲ ਡਾਰੇ ॥
ਛੰਤ੍ਰ ਧੁਜਾ ਬਰ ਬਾਜ ਰਥੀ ਰਥ; ਕਾਟਿ ਸਭੈ ਰਘੁਰਾਜ ਉਤਾਰੇ ॥੬੧੯॥
265.e: Ram threw away the enemies from the war-arena, chopping them easily like a fruit. Ram chopped and threw all the canopies, banners, horses and charioteers belonging to Ravana.619.

265.g: ਰਾਵਨ ਚਉਪ ਚਲਯੋ ਚਪ ਕੈ; ਨਿਜ ਬਾਜ ਬਿਹੀਨ ਜਬੈ ਰਥ ਜਾਨਯੋ ॥
ਢਾਲ ਤ੍ਰਿਸੂਲ ਗਦਾ ਬਰਛੀ ਗਹਿ; ਸ੍ਰੀ ਰਘੁਨੰਦਨ ਸੋ ਰਨ ਠਾਨਯੋ ॥
265.e: When Ravana saw his chariot deprived of the horses, he marched forward quickly and holding his shield, trident mace and spear in his hands he fought with Ram.

265.g: ਧਾਇ ਪਰਯੋ ਲਲਕਾਰ ਹਠੀ; ਕਪ ਪੁੰਜਨ ਕੋ ਕਛੁ ਤ੍ਰਾਸ ਨ ਮਾਨਯੋ ॥
265.e: The persistent Ravana, without any fear of the forces of the monkeys

265.g: ਅੰਗਦ ਆਦਿ ਹਨਵੰਤ ਤੇ ਲੈ ਭਟ; ਕੋਟ ਹੁਤੇ ਕਰ ਏਕ ਨ ਜਾਨਯੋ ॥੬੨੦॥
265.e: Moved forward fearlessly, shouting violently. There were many warriors those like Angad, Hanuman etc., but he did not fear anyone.620.

265.g: ਰਾਵਨ ਕੋ ਰਘੁਰਾਜ ਜਬੈ ਰਣ ਮੰਡਲ ਆਵਤ ਮਧਿ ਨਿਹਾਰਯੋ ॥
ਬੀਸ ਸਿਲਾ ਸਿਤ ਸਾਇਕ ਲੈ ਕਰਿ ਕੋਪੁ ਬਡੋ ਉਰ ਮਧ ਪ੍ਰਹਾਰਯੋ ॥
265.e: When the king of Raghava clan saw Ravna coming forward, he (Ram) attacked him by discharging his twenty arrows like slabs on his chest.

265.g: ਭੇਦ ਚਲੇ ਮਰਮ ਸਥਲ ਕੋ ਸਰ ਸ੍ਰੋਣ ਨਦੀ ਸਰ ਬੀਚ ਪਖਾਰਯੋ ॥
ਆਗੇ ਹੀ ਰੇਾਂਗ ਚਲਯੋ ਹਠਿ ਕੈ ਭਟ; ਧਾਮ ਕੋ ਭੂਲ ਨ ਨਾਮ ਉਚਾਰਯੋ ॥੬੨੧॥
265.e: These arrows penetrated through his vital parts and he bathed in the stream of blood. Ravana fell down and crawled forward, he forgot even the location of his house.621.

265.g: ਰੋਸ ਭਰਯੋ ਰਨ ਮੌ ਰਘੁਨਾਥ; ਸੁ ਪਾਨ ਕੇ ਬੀਚ ਸਰਾਸਨ ਲੈ ਕੈ ॥
ਪਾਚਕ ਪਾਇ ਹਟਾਇ ਦਯੋ ਤਿਹ; ਬੀਸਹੂੰ ਬਾਹਿ ਬਿਨਾ ਓਹ ਕੈ ਕੈ ॥
265.e: Ram, the king of Raghava clan, in great fury, taking his bow in his hand and taking five steps backward, chopped all his twenty arms

265.g: ਦੈ ਦਸ ਬਾਨ ਬਿਮਾਨ ਦਸੋ; ਸਿਰ ਕਾਟ ਦਏ ਸਿਵ ਲੋਕ ਪਠੈ ਕੈ ॥
265.e: With ten arrows be chopped his ten heads for dispatching them to the abode of Shiva

265.g: ਸ੍ਰੀ ਰਘੁਰਾਜ ਬਰਯੋ ਸੀਅ ਕੋ ਬਹੁਰੋ ਜਨੁ ਜੁਧ ਸੁਯੰਬਰ ਜੈ ਕੈ ॥੬੨੨॥
265.e: After the war Ram wedded Sita again as if he had conquered her in the ceremony of Swayyamvara.622.

265.g: ਅਲਕਾ ਛੰਦ ॥
265.e: ALKA STANZA

265.g: ਚਟਪਟ ਸੈਣੰ ਖਟਪਟ ਭਾਜੇ ॥
ਝਟਪਟ ਜੁਝਯੋ ਲਖ ਰਣ ਰਾਜੇ ॥
265.e: The forces ran quickly and began to fight, the warriors ran speedily and

265.g: ਸਟਪਟ ਭਾਜੇ ਅਟਪਟ ਸੂਰੰ ॥
ਝਟਪਟ ਬਿਸਰੀ ਘਟ ਪਟ ਹੂਰੰ ॥੬੨੪॥
265.e: They forgot their thoughts about the heavenly damsels.624.

265.g: ਚਟਪਟ ਪੈਠੇ ਖਟਪਟ ਲੰਕੰ ॥
ਰਣ ਤਜ ਸੂਰੰ ਸਰ ਧਰ ਬੰਕੰ ॥
265.e: The warriors abandoning the field and the arrows entered Lanka

265.g: ਝਲਹਲ ਬਾਰੰ ਨਰਬਰ ਨੈਣੰ ॥
ਧਕਿ ਧਕਿ ਉਚਰੇ ਭਕਿ ਭਕਿ ਬੈਣੰ ॥੬੨੫॥
265.e: Seeing Ram with their own eyes they raised utterances of lamentation.625.

265.g: ਨਰ ਬਰ ਰਾਮੰ ਬਰਨਰ ਮਾਰੋ ॥
ਝਟਪਟ ਬਾਹੰ ਕਟਿ ਕਟਿ ਡਾਰੋ ॥
265.e: The superb Ram killed all of them and chopped their arms

265.g: ਤਬ ਸਭ ਭਾਜੇ ਰਖ ਰਖ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੰ ॥
ਖਟਪਟ ਮਾਰੇ ਝਟਪਟ ਬਾਣੰ ॥੬੨੬॥
265.e: Then all (others) saving themselves, fled away and Ram showered arrows on those running fighters.626.

265.g: ਚਟਪਟ ਰਾਨੀ ਸਟਪਟ ਧਾਈ ॥
ਰਟਪਟ ਰੋਵਤ ਅਟਪਟ ਆਈ ॥
265.e: All the queen ran weeping instantly and came to fall at the feet of Ram

265.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਕੈ; ਮਾਲੁ ਖਜੀਨਾ ॥
265.e: The Lord's Name, Har, Har, is the treasure of wealth of His servants.

265.g: ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਜਨ ਕਉ; ਆਪਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਦੀਨਾ ॥
265.e: The treasure of the Lord has been bestowed on His servants by God Himself.

265.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਕੈ; ਓਟ ਸਤਾਣੀ ॥
265.e: The Lord, Har, Har is the All-powerful Protection of His servants.

265.g: ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਤਾਪਿ; ਜਨ ਅਵਰ ਨ ਜਾਣੀ ॥
265.e: His servants know no other than the Lord's Magnificence.

265.g: ਓਤਿ ਪੋਤਿ; ਜਨ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਿ ਰਾਤੇ ॥
265.e: Through and through, His servants are imbued with the Lord's Love.

265.g: ਸੁੰਨ ਸਮਾਧਿ; ਨਾਮ ਰਸ ਮਾਤੇ ॥
265.e: In deepest Samaadhi, they are intoxicated with the essence of the Naam.

265.g: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ; ਜਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪੈ ॥
265.e: Twenty-four hours a day, His servants chant Har, Har.

265.g: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਭਗਤੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਟ; ਨਹੀ ਛਪੈ ॥
265.e: The devotees of the Lord are known and respected; they do not hide in secrecy.

265.g: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਭਗਤਿ; ਮੁਕਤਿ ਬਹੁ ਕਰੇ ॥
265.e: Through devotion to the Lord, many have been liberated.

265.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਨ ਸੰਗਿ; ਕੇਤੇ ਤਰੇ ॥੭॥
265.e: O Nanak, along with His servants, many others are saved. ||7||

265.g: ਇਤਿ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਬਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਨਾਟਕੇ ਰਾਮਵਤਾਰ ਦਸ ਸਿਰ ਬਧਹ ਧਿਆਇ ਸਮਾਪਤਮ ਸਤੁ ॥
265.e: End of the chapter entitled ‘Killing of the Ten-headed (Ravana) in Ramavtar in BACHITTAR NATAK.

265.g: ਬਹੁਤੁ ਸਿਆਣਪ; ਜਮ ਕਾ ਭਉ ਬਿਆਪੈ ॥
265.e: Even with great cleverness, the fear of death clings to you.

265.g: ਸ੍ਵੈਯਾ ਛੰਦ ॥
265.e: SWAYYA STANZA

265.g: ਇੰਦ੍ਰ ਡਰਾਕੁਲ ਥੋ ਜਿਹ ਕੇ ਡਰ ਸੂਰਜ ਚੰਦ੍ਰ ਹੁਤੋ ਭਯ ਭੀਤੋ ॥
ਲੂਟ ਲਯੋ ਧਨ ਜਉਨ ਧਨੇਸ ਕੋ; ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਹੁਤੋ ਚਿਤ ਮੋਨਨਿ ਚੀਤੋ ॥
265.e: He, from whom Indra, moon and sun felt baffled, he who had plundered the stores of Kuber and he before whom Brahma kept silent

265.g: ਇੰਦ੍ਰ ਸੇ ਭੂਪ ਅਨੇਕ ਲਰੈ; ਇਨ ਸੌ, ਫਿਰਿ ਕੈ ਗ੍ਰਹ ਜਾਤ ਨ ਜੀਤੋ ॥
265.e: He with whom many beings like Indra fought, but who could not be conquered

265.g: ਸੋ ਰਨ ਆਜ ਭਲੈਂ ਰਘੁਰਾਜ ਸੁ ਜੁਧ ਸੁਯੰਬਰ ਕੈ ਸੀਅ ਜੀਤੋ ॥੬੨੩॥
265.e: Conquering him today in the battlefield, Ram also conquered Sita as in the ceremony of Svayyamvara.623.

265.g: ਸੀਤਾ ਮਿਲਬੋ ਕਥਨੰ ॥
265.e: Description of the Union with Sita :

265.g: ਅਸਟਪਦੀ ॥
265.e: Ashtapadee:

265.g: ਜਾਪ ਤਾਪ; ਗਿਆਨ ਸਭਿ ਧਿਆਨ ॥
265.e: Chanting, intense meditation, spiritual wisdom and all meditations;

265.g: ਖਟ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ; ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਵਖਿਆਨ ॥
265.e: the six schools of philosophy and sermons on the scriptures;

265.g: ਜੋਗ ਅਭਿਆਸ; ਕਰਮ ਧ੍ਰਮ ਕਿਰਿਆ ॥
265.e: the practice of Yoga and righteous conduct;

265.g: ਸਗਲ ਤਿਆਗਿ; ਬਨ ਮਧੇ ਫਿਰਿਆ ॥
265.e: the renunciation of everything and wandering around in the wilderness;

265.g: ਅਨਿਕ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਰ; ਕੀਏ ਬਹੁ ਜਤਨਾ ॥
265.e: the performance of all sorts of works;

265.g: ਪੁੰਨ ਦਾਨ; ਹੋਮੇ ਬਹੁ ਰਤਨਾ ॥
265.e: donations to charities and offerings of jewels to fire;

265.g: ਸਰੀਰੁ ਕਟਾਇ; ਹੋਮੈ ਕਰਿ ਰਾਤੀ ॥
265.e: cutting the body apart and making the pieces into ceremonial fire offerings;

265.g: ਵਰਤ ਨੇਮ ਕਰੈ; ਬਹੁ ਭਾਤੀ ॥
265.e: keeping fasts and making vows of all sorts

265.g: ਨਹੀ ਤੁਲਿ; ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਬੀਚਾਰ ॥
265.e: - none of these are equal to the contemplation of the Name of the Lord,

265.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ; ਜਪੀਐ ਇਕ ਬਾਰ ॥੧॥
265.e: O Nanak, if, as Gurmukh, one chants the Naam, even once. ||1||

265.g: ਅਥ ਮਦੋਦਰੀ ਸਮੋਧ ਬਭੀਛਨ ਕੋ ਲੰਕ ਰਾਜ ਦੀਬੋ ॥
265.e: Now begins the description of contemporaneous knowledge to Mandodari and the bestowal of the kingdom of Lanka to Vibhishana:

265.g: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ; ਜਨ ਕਉ ਭੋਗ ਜੋਗ ॥
265.e: The Name of the Lord is the enjoyment and Yoga of His servants.

265.g: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ; ਕਛੁ ਨਾਹਿ ਬਿਓਗੁ ॥
265.e: Chanting the Lord's Name, there is no separation from Him.

265.g: ਜਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ; ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ॥
265.e: His servants are imbued with the service of the Lord's Name.

265.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਪੂਜੈ; ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਦੇਵਾ ॥੬॥
265.e: O Nanak, worship the Lord, the Lord Divine, Har, Har. ||6||

266.e: Among all persons, the supreme person is the one
who gives up his egotistical pride in the Company of the Holy.
One who sees himself as lowly,
shall be accounted as the highest of all.

266.g: ਜਾ ਕਾ ਮਨੁ; ਹੋਇ ਸਗਲ ਕੀ ਰੀਨਾ ॥
266.e: One whose mind is the dust of all,

266.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ; ਤਿਨਿ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਚੀਨਾ ॥
266.e: recognizes the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, in each and every heart.
One who eradicates cruelty from within his own mind,
looks upon all the world as his friend.
One who looks upon pleasure and pain as one and the same,
O Nanak, is not affected by sin or virtue. ||6||
RASAAVAL STANZA
When all of them saw the most beautiful Ram, they bowed their heads and stood before him.630.
They were allured to see the beauty of Ram
There was talk about Ram on all the four sides and they all gave Ram the kingdom of Lanka like the tax-payer setting tax with the authority.631.
Ram bowed down his eyes filled with grace
Seeing him, the tears of joy flowed down from the eyes of people like the rain falling from the clouds.632.
The woman allured by lust, were delighted to see Ram and they all ended their identity in Ram, the abode of Dharma. 633.
They all absorbed their minds in Ram, forsaking the love of their husbands and looking towards him resolutely, they began to talk with one another.634.
Ram, the Lord of Sita, is winsome and abductor of the mind
He is stealing the conscious mind like a thief.635.
All the wives of Ravana were told to abandon the sorrow of their husband and touch the feet of Ram
All of them came forward and fell on his feet.636.
The most beautiful Ram recognized their feelings
He absorbed himself in the minds of all and all of them pursued him like shadow.637.
Ram appeared to them in golden hue and looked like king of all kings
The eyes of all were dyed in his love and the gods were delighted to see him from the sky.638.
To the poor, Your Name is wealth.
To the homeless, Your Name is home.
To the dishonored, You, O God, are honor.
To all, You are the Giver of gifts.
O Creator Lord, Cause of causes, O Lord and Master,
Inner-knower, Searcher of all hearts:
You alone know Your own condition and state.
You Yourself, God, are imbued with Yourself.
You alone can celebrate Your Praises.
O Nanak, no one else knows. ||7||
Ashtapadee:
Think of the Glory of the All-pervading Lord, O mortal;
what is your origin, and what is your appearance?
He who fashioned, adorned and decorated you
in the fire of the womb, He preserved you.
In your infancy, He gave you milk to drink.
In the flower of your youth, He gave you food, pleasure and understanding.
As you grow old, family and friends,
Of all religions, the best religion

266.g: ਹਰਿ ਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿ; ਨਿਰਮਲ ਕਰਮੁ ॥
266.e: is to chant the Name of the Lord and maintain pure conduct.
Of all religious rituals, the most sublime ritual
is to erase the filth of the dirty mind in the Company of the Holy.
Of all efforts, the best effort

266.g: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ; ਜਪਹੁ ਜੀਅ ਸਦਾ ॥
266.e: is to chant the Name of the Lord in the heart, forever.
Of all speech, the most ambrosial speech

266.g: ਹਰਿ ਕੋ ਜਸੁ ਸੁਨਿ; ਰਸਨ ਬਖਾਨੀ ॥
266.e: is to hear the Lord's Praise and chant it with the tongue.

266.g: ਸਗਲ ਥਾਨ ਤੇ; ਓਹੁ ਊਤਮ ਥਾਨੁ ॥
266.e: Of all places, the most sublime place,

266.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਹ ਘਟਿ; ਵਸੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੮॥੩॥
266.e: O Nanak, is that heart in which the Name of the Lord abides. ||8||3||
Ram saw all the spectacle.627.
The queens rolled on the earth and began to weep and lament in various ways

266.g: ਬਟ ਹਰਿ ਕੂਕੈਂ ਨਟ ਵਰ ਭੇਸੰ ॥੬੨੮॥
266.e: They pulled their hair and garments and cried and shrieked in various ways.628.
They began to tear their raiments and put the dust on their heads
They in great sorrow cried, threw themselves down and rolled.629.

266.g: ਅਨਿਕ ਜਤਨ ਕਰਿ; ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨ ਨਾ ਧ੍ਰਾਪੈ ॥
266.e: You try all sorts of things, but your thirst is still not satisfied.
Wearing various religious robes, the fire is not extinguished.
Even making millions of efforts, you shall not be accepted in the Court of the Lord.
You cannot escape to the heavens, or to the nether regions,
if you are entangled in emotional attachment and the net of Maya.
All other efforts are punished by the Messenger of Death,

266.g: ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਭਜਨ ਬਿਨੁ; ਤਿਲੁ ਨਹੀ ਮਾਨੈ ॥
266.e: which accepts nothing at all, except meditation on the Lord of the Universe.

266.g: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ; ਦੁਖੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
266.e: Chanting the Name of the Lord, sorrow is dispelled.
O Nanak, chant it with intuitive ease. ||4||
One who prays for the four cardinal blessings
should commit himself to the service of the Saints.
If you wish to erase your sorrows,

266.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ; ਰਿਦੈ ਸਦ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
266.e: sing the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, within your heart.
If you long for honor for yourself,
then renounce your ego in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

266.g: ਜੇ ਕੋ; ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਤੇ ਡਰੈ ॥
266.e: If you fear the cycle of birth and death,
then seek the Sanctuary of the Holy.

266.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਕਉ; ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਰਸ ਪਿਆਸਾ ॥
266.e: Those who thirst for the Blessed Vision of God's Darshan

266.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਤਾ ਕੈ; ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਸਾ ॥੫॥
266.e: - Nanak is a sacrifice, a sacrifice to them. ||5||
Salok:

266.g: ਨਿਰਗੁਨੀਆਰ ਇਆਨਿਆ; ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ. ਸਦਾ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥
266.e: You worthless, ignorant fool - dwell upon God forever.

266.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਆ. ਤਿਸੁ ਚੀਤਿ ਰਖੁ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਿਬਹੀ ਨਾਲਿ ॥੧॥
266.e: Cherish in your consciousness the One who created you; O Nanak, He alone shall go along with you. ||1||

267.e: He, who saw Ram even once, she was completely allured.639.
She forgot the consciousness of all else seeing the beauty of Ram and began to talk to supremely mighty Ram.640.
The speech of Ram addressed to Mandodari :
They belong to the human species, but they act like animals.
They curse others day and night.
Outwardly, they wear religious robes, but within is the filth of Maya.
They cannot conceal this, no matter how hard they try.
Outwardly, they display knowledge, meditation and purification,
but within clings the dog of greed.
The fire of desire rages within; outwardly they apply ashes to their bodies.
There is a stone around their neck - how can they cross the unfathomable ocean?

267.g: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਅੰਤਰਿ; ਬਸੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪਿ ॥
267.e: Those, within whom God Himself abides
- O Nanak, those humble beings are intuitively absorbed in the Lord. ||5||
Forsaking the jewel, they are engrossed with a shell.
They renounce Truth and embrace falsehood.

267.g: ਜੋ ਛਡਨਾ; ਸੁ ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨੈ ॥
267.e: That which passes away, they believe to be permanent.
That which is immanent, they believe to be far off.

267.g: ਛੋਡਿ ਜਾਇ; ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਸ੍ਰਮੁ ਕਰੈ ॥
267.e: They struggle for what they must eventually leave.
They turn away from the Lord, their Help and Support, who is always with them.
They wash off the sandalwood paste;
like donkeys, they are in love with the mud.
They have fallen into the deep, dark pit.
Nanak: lift them up and save them, O Merciful Lord God! ||4||
RASAAVAL STANZA
“O queen! I have not committed a mistake in killing your husband, think rightly in your mind about it and the blame me.641.
“I should get my Sita back, so that the work of righteousness may move forward
” (Saying in this way) Ram sent Hanuman, she son of wind-god, like an envoy (in advance).642.
Searching for Sita, he reached there, where she was sitting in the garden under a tree.643.
From beginning to end, He is our Protector,

267.g: ਤਿਸ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ. ਨ ਕਰੈ; ਗਵਾਰੁ ॥
267.e: and yet, the ignorant do not give their love to Him.

267.g: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ; ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
267.e: Serving Him, the nine treasures are obtained,

267.g: ਤਾ ਸਿਉ ਮੂੜਾ; ਮਨੁ. ਨਹੀ ਲਾਵੈ ॥
267.e: and yet, the foolish do not link their minds with Him.
Our Lord and Master is Ever-present, forever and ever,
and yet, the spiritually blind believe that He is far away.

267.g: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਟਹਲ; ਪਾਵੈ ਦਰਗਹ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
267.e: In His service, one obtains honor in the Court of the Lord,
and yet, the ignorant fool forgets Him.
Forever and ever, this person makes mistakes;
O Nanak, the Infinite Lord is our Saving Grace. ||3||
Are there to feed you as you rest.

267.g: ਇਹੁ ਨਿਰਗੁਨੁ; ਗੁਨੁ ਕਛੂ. ਨ ਬੂਝੈ ॥
267.e: This worthless person has not appreciated in the least, all the good deeds done for him.
If you bless him with forgiveness, O Nanak, only then will he be saved. ||1||

267.g: ਸੰਗਿ ਸਹਾਈ; ਸੁ ਆਵੈ ਨ. ਚੀਤਿ ॥
267.e: The Lord, our Help and Support, is always with us, but the mortal does not remember Him.
He shows love to his enemies.
He lives in a castle of sand.
He enjoys the games of pleasure and the tastes of Maya.
He believes them to be permanent - this is the belief of his mind.
Death does not even come to mind for the fool.
Hate, conflict, sexual desire, anger, emotional attachment,
falsehood, corruption, immense greed and deceit:

267.g: ਜਿਹ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ; ਧਰ ਊਪਰਿ ਸੁਖਿ ਬਸਹਿ ॥
267.e: By His Grace, you abide in comfort upon the earth.

267.g: ਸੁਤ ਭ੍ਰਾਤ ਮੀਤ; ਬਨਿਤਾ ਸੰਗਿ ਹਸਹਿ ॥
267.e: With your children, siblings, friends and spouse, you laugh.
By His Grace, you drink in cool water.
You have peaceful breezes and priceless fire.
By His Grace, you enjoy all sorts of pleasures.
You are provided with all the necessities of life.

267.g: ਦੀਨੇ ਹਸਤ ਪਾਵ; ਕਰਨ ਨੇਤ੍ਰ ਰਸਨਾ ॥
267.e: He gave you hands, feet, ears, eyes and tongue,
and yet, you forsake Him and attach yourself to others.
Such sinful mistakes cling to the blind fools;
Nanak: uplift and save them, God! ||2||
By listening, how can the blind find the path?
Take hold of his hand, and then he can reach his destination.
How can a riddle be understood by the deaf?
Say 'night', and he thinks you said 'day'.
How can the mute sing the Songs of the Lord?

267.g: ਜਤਨ ਕਰੈ; ਤਉ ਭੀ ਸੁਰ ਭੰਗ ॥
267.e: He may try, but his voice will fail him.
How can the cripple climb up the mountain?
He simply cannot go there.

267.g: ਕਰਤਾਰ ਕਰੁਣਾ ਮੈ; ਦੀਨੁ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਕਰੈ ॥
267.e: O Creator, Lord of Mercy - Your humble servant prays;
Nanak: by Your Grace, please save me. ||6||

268.e: Salok:

268.g: ਦੇਨਹਾਰੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਛੋਡਿ ਕੈ; ਲਾਗਹਿ ਆਨ ਸੁਆਇ ॥
268.e: One who renounces God the Giver, and attaches himself to other affairs

268.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਕਹੂ ਨ ਸੀਝਈ; ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ. ਪਤਿ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
268.e: - O Nanak, he shall never succeed. Without the Name, he shall lose his honor. ||1||
Ashtapadee:
He obtains ten things, and puts them behind him;
for the sake of one thing withheld, he forfeits his faith.

268.g: ਏਕ ਭੀ ਨ ਦੇਇ; ਦਸ ਭੀ ਹਿਰਿ ਲੇਇ ॥
268.e: But what if that one thing were not given, and the ten were taken away?
Then, what could the fool say or do?
Our Lord and Master cannot be moved by force.
Unto Him, bow forever in adoration.

268.g: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ; ਲਾਗਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੀਠਾ ॥
268.e: That one, unto whose mind God seems sweet
all pleasures come to abide in his mind.
One who abides by the Lord's Will,
O Nanak, obtains all things. ||1||
False are body, wealth, and all relations.
False are ego, possessiveness and Maya.
False are power, youth, wealth and property.
False are sexual desire and wild anger.
False are chariots, elephants, horses and expensive clothes.

268.g: ਮਿਥਿਆ ਰੰਗ ਸੰਗਿ; ਮਾਇਆ ਪੇਖਿ ਹਸਤਾ ॥
268.e: False is the love of gathering wealth, and reveling in the sight of it.
False are deception, emotional attachment and egotistical pride.
False are pride and self-conceit.
Only devotional worship is permanent, and the Sanctuary of the Holy.

268.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਜੀਵੈ; ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ॥੪॥
268.e: Nanak lives by meditating, meditating on the Lotus Feet of the Lord. ||4||
False are the ears which listen to the slander of others.

268.g: ਮਿਥਿਆ ਹਸਤ; ਪਰ ਦਰਬ ਕਉ ਹਿਰਹਿ ॥
268.e: False are the hands which steal the wealth of others.
MAKRA STANZA
Ram has come and brought Sita with him and
God the Banker gives endless capital to the mortal,
who eats, drinks and expends it with pleasure and joy.

268.g: ਅਪੁਨੀ ਅਮਾਨ; ਕਛੁ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਸਾਹੁ ਲੇਇ ॥
268.e: If some of this capital is later taken back by the Banker,
the ignorant person shows his anger.
He himself destroys his own credibility,

268.g: ਬਹੁਰਿ. ਉਸ ਕਾ; ਬਿਸ੍ਵਾਸੁ. ਨ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
268.e: and he shall not again be trusted.

268.g: ਜਿਸ ਕੀ ਬਸਤੁ; ਤਿਸੁ ਆਗੈ ਰਾਖੈ ॥
268.e: When one offers to the Lord, that which belongs to the Lord,
and willingly abides by the Will of God's Order,
the Lord will make him happy four times over.
O Nanak, our Lord and Master is merciful forever. ||2||
Hanuman, falling at the feet of Sita, said, “O mother Sita! Ram has killed the enemy (Ravana) and now he is standing at your door.644.
“O mother Sita! go to the place of Ram quickly, where he has won and lightened the burden of the earth by killing all the enemie.”645.
Being highly pleased Sita accompanied Hanuman, she saw Ram and found Ram retaining his precious beauty.646.
Sita fell at the feet of Ram who saw towards her and addressed to that lady of lotus eyes and sweet speech 647
“O Sita! enter the fire, so that you may become pure.” She agreed and prepared a pyre of fire.648.
She merged in the fire like the lightning seen in the clouds
She became one with fire like Gita with Shrutis (recorded texts).649.
She entered the fire and came out like pure gold
Ram hold her to his bosom and the poets sang in praise about this fact.650.
All the saints accepted this type of fire-test and the beings of the three worlds accepted this fact
The musical instruments of victory were played and Ram also thundered in great joy.651.
The pure SIta was conquered like a superbly auspicious song
All the gods began to shower flowers from the sky.652.

268.g: ਇਤਿ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਬਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਨਾਟਕੇ ਰਾਮਵਤਾਰ ਬਭੀਛਨ ਕੋ ਲੰਕਾ ਕੋ ਰਾਜ ਦੀਬੋ ਮਦੋਦਰੀ ਸਮੋਧ ਕੀਬੋ ਸੀਤਾ ਮਿਲਬੋ ਧਯਾਇ ਸਮਾਪਤੰ ॥੧੮॥
268.e: End of the chapter entitled The Bestowal of Kingdom on Vibhishan, Imparting of Contemporaneous Knowledge to Mandodari and the Union with Sita’ in Ramavtar in BACHITTAR NATAK.
Now begins the description of the entry into Ayodhya :
RASAAVAL STANZA
Gaining victory in war, then Ram mounted on the air-vehicle Pushpak
All the warriors roared in great joy and the musical instruments of victory resounded.653.
The monkeys in great delight caused the air-vehicle to fly and they saw Avadhpuri, beautiful like heaven.654.
You are our Lord and Master; to You, I offer this prayer.
This body and soul are all Your property.

268.g: ਤੁਮ ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ; ਹਮ ਬਾਰਿਕ ਤੇਰੇ ॥
268.e: You are our mother and father; we are Your children.
In Your Grace, there are so many joys!
No one knows Your limits.
O Highest of the High, Most Generous God,
the whole creation is strung on Your thread.
That which has come from You is under Your Command.

268.g: ਤੁਮਰੀ ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ; ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਜਾਨੀ ॥
268.e: You alone know Your state and extent.
Nanak, Your slave, is forever a sacrifice. ||8||4||
The many forms of attachment to Maya shall surely pass away
- know that they are transitory.

268.g: ਬਿਰਖ ਕੀ ਛਾਇਆ ਸਿਉ; ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਵੈ ॥
268.e: People fall in love with the shade of the tree,
and when it passes away, they feel regret in their minds.
Whatever is seen, shall pass away;
and yet, the blindest of the blind cling to it.
One who gives her love to a passing traveler

268.g: ਤਾ ਕਉ ਹਾਥਿ; ਨ ਆਵੈ ਕੇਹ ॥
268.e: nothing shall come into her hands in this way.

268.g: ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ; ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਸੁਖਦਾਈ ॥
268.e: O mind, the love of the Name of the Lord bestows peace.

268.g: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਨਾਨਕ; ਆਪਿ ਲਏ ਲਾਈ ॥੩॥
268.e: O Nanak, the Lord, in His Mercy, unites us with Himself. ||3||
So many lifetimes are wasted in these ways.

268.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਰਾਖਿ ਲੇਹੁ; ਆਪਨ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਮ ॥੭॥
268.e: Nanak: uplift them, and redeem them, O Lord - show Your Mercy! ||7||

269.e: By His Grace, you wear silks and satins;
why abandon Him, to attach yourself to another?
By His Grace, you sleep in a cozy bed;

269.g: ਮਨ ਆਠ ਪਹਰ; ਤਾ ਕਾ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਵੀਜੈ ॥
269.e: O my mind, sing His Praises, twenty-four hours a day.

269.g: ਜਿਹ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ; ਤੁਝੁ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਊ ਮਾਨੈ ॥
269.e: By His Grace, you are honored by everyone;
Salok:

269.g: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਅਰੁ ਲੋਭ ਮੋਹ; ਬਿਨਸਿ ਜਾਇ ਅਹੰਮੇਵ ॥
269.e: Sexual desire, anger, greed and emotional attachment - may these be gone, and egotism as well.

269.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ; ਕਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦੁ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ॥੧॥
269.e: Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of God; please bless me with Your Grace, O Divine Guru. ||1||
Ashtapadee:
By His Grace, you partake of the thirty-six delicacies;

269.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕਉ; ਰਖੁ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
269.e: enshrine that Lord and Master within your mind.
By His Grace, you apply scented oils to your body;

269.g: ਤਿਸ ਕਉ ਸਿਮਰਤ; ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਵਹਿ ॥
269.e: remembering Him, the supreme status is obtained.
By His Grace, you dwell in the palace of peace;
meditate forever on Him within your mind.

269.g: ਜਿਹ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ; ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਸੰਗਿ ਸੁਖ ਬਸਨਾ ॥
269.e: By His Grace, you abide with your family in peace;
keep His remembrance upon your tongue, twenty-four hours a day.
By His Grace, you enjoy tastes and pleasures;
O Nanak, meditate forever on the One, who is worthy of meditation. ||1||

269.g: ਮਿਥਿਆ ਨੇਤ੍ਰ; ਪੇਖਤ ਪਰ ਤ੍ਰਿਅ ਰੂਪਾਦ ॥
269.e: False are the eyes which gaze upon the beauty of another's wife.
False is the tongue which enjoys delicacies and external tastes.

269.g: ਮਿਥਿਆ ਚਰਨ; ਪਰ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਕਉ ਧਾਵਹਿ ॥
269.e: False are the feet which run to do evil to others.
False is the mind which covets the wealth of others.
False is the body which does not do good to others.
False is the nose which inhales corruption.
Without understanding, everything is false.

269.g: ਸਫਲ ਦੇਹ ਨਾਨਕ; ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਲਏ ॥੫॥
269.e: Fruitful is the body, O Nanak, which takes to the Lord's Name. ||5||
There are rejoicings in the city  the joy is growing in the heart of Avadh.655.
The women are coming at speed, there is endless crowd, all are standing amazed and asking, “Where is our Lord Ram?”656.
“He, whose hair are unique and black like serpents
He whose thinking is wonderful, where is that dear Ram?657.
“He who is ever in blossom like garden and ever thoughtful about his kingdom
He, who hath stolen our mind, where is that Ram.658.
“He, who hath stolen our heart and given as separation from him, were is that flower-faced and alluring Ram?659.
“Someone may tell us and take whatever he wants from us, but he should tell us where is that alluring Ram?660.
“He accepted the orders of his father like a drunkard accepting every word of the giver of intoxicant and he left his country. Where is he, the beauty-incarnation of the world and rose-faced?661.
“The wagtail (birds) were envious of his cruel gestures, he who hath allured our mind, where is that Ram of blossomed face?662.
“His gestures were the gestures of an intoxicated person
All the world is obedient to his personality  someone may tell where is that flower-faced Ram?663.
“The splendour of this face was significant and he was perfect in intellect
He, who is a vessel full of the wine of heart’s love, where is that flower faced Ram?664.
“After conquering the tyrants the beloved Ram has come back from distant lands
Where is he, the perfect one in all arts and who hath flower-like face?665.
“His qualities are known all over the world and he is famous in the seven regions of the world
He whose light hath spread throughout the world, where is that flower-faced Ram?666.
“He who conquered the tyrants with the blows of his arrows
The life of the faithless cynic is totally useless.
Without the Truth, how can anyone be pure?
Useless is the body of the spiritually blind, without the Name of the Lord.
From his mouth, a foul smell issues forth.

269.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਿਮਰਨ; ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਨਿ ਬ੍ਰਿਥਾ ਬਿਹਾਇ ॥
269.e: Without the remembrance of the Lord, day and night pass in vain,
like the crop which withers without rain.

269.g: ਗੋਬਿਦ ਭਜਨ ਬਿਨੁ; ਬ੍ਰਿਥੇ ਸਭ ਕਾਮ ॥
269.e: Without meditation on the Lord of the Universe, all works are in vain,
like the wealth of a miser, which lies useless.

269.g: ਧੰਨਿ ਧੰਨਿ ਤੇ ਜਨ; ਜਿਹ ਘਟਿ. ਬਸਿਓ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਉ ॥
269.e: Blessed, blessed are those, whose hearts are filled with the Name of the Lord.

269.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਾ ਕੈ; ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥੬॥
269.e: Nanak is a sacrifice, a sacrifice to them. ||6||
He says one thing, and does something else.

269.g: ਮਨਿ ਨਹੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ; ਮੁਖਹੁ ਗੰਢ ਲਾਵਤ ॥
269.e: There is no love in his heart, and yet with his mouth he talks tall.
The Omniscient Lord God is the Knower of all.
He is not impressed by outward display.
One who does not practice what he preaches to others,
shall come and go in reincarnation, through birth and death.
One whose inner being is filled with the Formless Lord
by his teachings, the world is saved.

269.g: ਜੋ ਤੁਮ ਭਾਨੇ; ਤਿਨ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
269.e: Those who are pleasing to You, God, know You.
Nanak falls at their feet. ||7||
Offer your prayers to the Supreme Lord God, who knows everything.
He Himself values His own creatures.
He Himself, by Himself, makes the decisions.

269.g: ਕਿਸੈ ਦੂਰਿ ਜਨਾਵਤ; ਕਿਸੈ ਬੁਝਾਵਤ ਨੇਰਾ ॥
269.e: To some, He appears far away, while others perceive Him near at hand.
He is beyond all efforts and clever tricks.

269.g: ਸਭੁ ਕਛੁ ਜਾਨੈ; ਆਤਮ ਕੀ ਰਹਤ ॥
269.e: He knows all the ways and means of the soul.

269.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ; ਤਿਸੁ ਲਏ ਲੜਿ ਲਾਇ ॥
269.e: Those with whom He is pleased are attached to the hem of His robe.
He is pervading all places and interspaces.
Those upon whom He bestows His favor, become His servants.
Each and every moment, O Nanak, meditate on the Lord. ||8||5||

270.g: ਮੁਖਿ ਤਾ ਕੋ ਜਸੁ; ਰਸਨ ਬਖਾਨੈ ॥
270.e: with your mouth and with your tongue, chant His Praises.
By His Grace, you remain in the Dharma;
O mind, meditate continually on the Supreme Lord God.

270.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀ ਜਪਤ; ਦਰਗਹ ਮਾਨੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ॥
270.e: Meditating on God, you shall be honored in His Court;
O Nanak, you shall return to your true home with honor. ||2||
Now begins the description of the Meeting with the Mother :
RASSVAL STANZA
When the people heard that Ram had returned, then all the people ran and fell at his feet
Ram met all of them.669.
Someone swung she fly-whisk, someone offered the betel
Ram fell at the feet of his mother and his mothers hugged him to their bosom.670.
On being hugged he was weeping in order to wash away all his suffering
The brave Ram began to talk and all the mothers listened.671.
Then he met the mother of Lakshman and the brother Bharat and Shatrughan touched his feet. On account of the joy of union, unaccountable charity was given.672.
By His Grace, you listen to the sound current of the Naad.
By His Grace, you behold amazing wonders.
By His Grace, you speak ambrosial words with your tongue.
By His Grace, you abide in peace and ease.
By His Grace, your hands move and work.
By His Grace, you are completely fulfilled.
By His Grace, you obtain the supreme status.
By His Grace, you are absorbed into celestial peace.

270.g: ਐਸਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਤਿਆਗਿ; ਅਵਰ ਕਤ ਲਾਗਹੁ ॥
270.e: Why forsake God, and attach yourself to another?
By Guru's Grace, O Nanak, awaken your mind! ||6||
By His Grace, you are famous all over the world;

270.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ; ਮੂਲਿ. ਨ ਮਨਹੁ ਬਿਸਾਰਿ ॥
270.e: never forget God from your mind.
By His Grace, you have prestige;

270.g: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਮੂੜ; ਤੂ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਜਾਪੁ ॥
270.e: O foolish mind, meditate on Him!
By His Grace, your works are completed;
O mind, know Him to be close at hand.
By His Grace, you find the Truth;

270.g: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ; ਤੂੰ ਤਾ ਸਿਉ ਰਾਚੁ ॥
270.e: O my mind, merge yourself into Him.

270.g: ਜਿਹ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ; ਸਭ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
270.e: By His Grace, everyone is saved;
O Nanak, meditate, and chant His Chant. ||7||
Where is he who mouth the air-vehicle Pushapak and accompanies Sita?667.
“He who sacrificed thousands of his joys in order to please his mother, where is he? The mother Sita may also be congratulate today, but someone may tell us where is that flower-faced Ram?”668.

270.g: ਇਤਿ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਰਾਮ ਅਵਤਾਰ ਸੀਤਾ ਅਯੁਧਿਆ ਆਗਮ ਨਾਮ ਧਿਆਇ ਸਮਾਪਤੰ ॥
270.e: End of the chapter entitled ‘The Entry of Sita in Ayodhya’ in Ramvatar.

270.g: ਜਿਹ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ; ਕਰਹਿ ਪੁੰਨ ਬਹੁ ਦਾਨ ॥
270.e: By His Grace, you give donations in abundance to charities;

270.g: ਮਨ ਆਠ ਪਹਰ; ਕਰਿ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਧਿਆਨ ॥
270.e: O mind, meditate on Him, twenty-four hours a day.
By His Grace, you perform religious rituals and worldly duties;

270.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ; ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਚਿਤਾਰੀ ॥
270.e: think of God with each and every breath.
By His Grace, your form is so beautiful;
constantly remember God, the Incomparably Beautiful One.
By His Grace, you have such high social status;

270.g: ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਿਮਰਿ; ਸਦਾ ਦਿਨ ਰਾਤਿ ॥
270.e: remember God always, day and night.
By His Grace, your honor is preserved;
by Guru's Grace, O Nanak, chant His Praises. ||5||
Those, whom He inspires to chant, chant His Name.

270.g: ਆਪਿ ਗਾਵਾਏ; ਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਉ ॥
270.e: Those, whom He inspires to sing, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.
By His Grace, you wear decorations;

270.g: ਮਨ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਿਮਰਤ; ਕਿਉ ਆਲਸੁ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
270.e: O mind, why are you so lazy? Why don't you remember Him in meditation?
By His Grace, you have horses and elephants to ride;

270.g: ਮਨ ਤਿਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ; ਕਬਹੂ ਨ ਬਿਸਾਰੀ ॥
270.e: O mind, never forget that God.
By His Grace, you have land, gardens and wealth;
keep God enshrined in your heart.
O mind, the One who formed your form
standing up and sitting down, meditate always on Him.
Meditate on Him - the One Invisible Lord;
here and hereafter, O Nanak, He shall save you. ||4||
By His Grace, you have a healthy, golden body;
attune yourself to that Loving Lord.
By His Grace, your honor is preserved;

270.g: ਮਨ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ; ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਕਹਤ ॥
270.e: O mind, chant the Praises of the Lord, Har, Har, and find peace.

270.g: ਜਿਹ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ; ਤੇਰੇ ਸਗਲ ਛਿਦ੍ਰ ਢਾਕੇ ॥
270.e: By His Grace, all your deficits are covered;

270.g: ਮਨ ਸਰਨੀ ਪਰੁ; ਠਾਕੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤਾ ਕੈ ॥
270.e: O mind, seek the Sanctuary of God, our Lord and Master.

270.g: ਜਿਹ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ; ਤੁਝੁ. ਕੋ ਨ ਪਹੂਚੈ ॥
270.e: By His Grace, no one can rival you;

270.g: ਮਨ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ; ਸਿਮਰਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਊਚੇ ॥
270.e: O mind, with each and every breath, remember God on High.
By His Grace, you obtained this precious human body;
O Nanak, worship Him with devotion. ||3||

271.e: In the Company of the Holy, all one's enemies become friends.
In the Company of the Holy, there is great purity.
In the Company of the Holy, no one is hated.

271.g: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ; ਨ ਬੀਗਾ ਪੈਰੁ ॥
271.e: In the Company of the Holy, one's feet do not wander.

271.g: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ; ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋ ਮੰਦਾ ॥
271.e: In the Company of the Holy, no one seems evil.
In the Company of the Holy, supreme bliss is known.

271.g: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ; ਨਾਹੀ ਹਉ ਤਾਪੁ ॥
271.e: In the Company of the Holy, the fever of ego departs.

271.g: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ; ਤਜੈ ਸਭੁ ਆਪੁ ॥
271.e: In the Company of the Holy, one renounces all selfishness.
He Himself knows the greatness of the Holy.
O Nanak, the Holy are at one with God. ||3||
Then Ram met the mother of Bharat and told her all that happened with him
Ram said, “O mother, I am thankful to you because you have made me free from indebtedness.673.
“You are not to be blamed for this, because it was recorded in my destiny, whatever happens, has to happen, none can describe it.”674.
He pacified his mother in this way and then he met his brother Bharat. Bharat on hearing his arrival ran towards him and touched his head with the feet of Ram.675.
Ram hugged him to his bosom and cleared all the doubts
Then he met Shatrugan, who had expert knowledge of weapons and Shastras.676.
The brothers cleansed the dust from the feet and matted hair of Ram. They worlshipped him in royal way and the Brahmins recited the Vedas.677.
All the brothers sang full of love. Ram was made the king and all the works were completed in this way.678.
The Brahmins were called in and with the recitation of Vedic mantras Ram was enthroned
On all the four sides resounded the musical instruments denoting victory.679.

271.g: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ; ਨ ਕਬਹੂ ਧਾਵੈ ॥
271.e: In the Company of the Holy, the mind never wanders.

271.g: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ; ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
271.e: In the Company of the Holy, one obtains everlasting peace.
In the Company of the Holy, one grasps the Incomprehensible.
In the Company of the Holy, one can endure the unendurable.

271.g: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ; ਬਸੈ ਥਾਨਿ ਊਚੈ ॥
271.e: In the Company of the Holy, one abides in the loftiest place.
In the Company of the Holy, one attains the Mansion of the Lord's Presence.

271.g: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ; ਦ੍ਰਿੜੈ ਸਭਿ ਧਰਮ ॥
271.e: In the Company of the Holy, one's Dharmic faith is firmly established.
In the Company of the Holy, one dwells with the Supreme Lord God.

271.g: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ; ਪਾਏ ਨਾਮ ਨਿਧਾਨ ॥
271.e: In the Company of the Holy, one obtains the treasure of the Naam.
O Nanak, I am a sacrifice to the Holy. ||4||
In the Company of the Holy, one meets the Incomprehensible Lord.
In the Company of the Holy, one flourishes forever.

271.g: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ; ਆਵਹਿ ਬਸਿ ਪੰਚਾ ॥
271.e: In the Company of the Holy, the five passions are brought to rest.
In the Company of the Holy, one enjoys the essence of ambrosia.
In the Company of the Holy, one becomes the dust of all.
In the Company of the Holy, one's speech is enticing.

271.g: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ; ਨ ਕਤਹੂੰ ਧਾਵੈ ॥
271.e: In the Company of the Holy, the mind does not wander.
In the Company of the Holy, the mind becomes stable.

271.g: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ; ਮਾਇਆ ਤੇ ਭਿੰਨ ॥
271.e: In the Company of the Holy, one is rid of Maya.
In the Company of the Holy, O Nanak, God is totally pleased. ||2||
BHUJANG PRAYAAT STANZA

271.g: ਧਰੇ ਅਤ੍ਰ ਨੀਕੇ ਪੁਰੀ ਅਉਧ ਆਏ ॥
271.e: The sovereigns were called from all the four directions and they all reached Avadhpuri

271.g: ਗਹੇ ਰਾਮ ਪਾਯੰ ਪਰਮ ਪ੍ਰੀਤ ਕੈ ਕੈ ॥
ਮਿਲੇ ਚਤ੍ਰ ਦੇਸੀ ਬਡੀ ਭੇਟ ਦੈ ਕੈ ॥੬੮੦॥
271.e: They all fell at the feet of Ram, exhibiting their supreme love and met him with great presents.680.
The kings presented gifts from various and beautiful maidens of elegant hair.

271.g: ਕੀਏ ਖੇਜ ਪਈਯੈ ਕਹੂੰ ਏਕ ਏਕੰ ॥੬੮੧॥
271.e: They also presented rare gems. Jewels and garments 681.
They presented winsome horses, jewels, gems, pearls as well as elephants
The chariots, diamonds, raiments and invaluable precious stones were also presented.682.
Somewhere the whit elephants bedecked with gems are being presented

271.g: ਕਿਤੇ ਬਾਜ ਰਾਜੰ ਜਰੀ ਜੀਨ ਸੰਗੰ ॥
ਨਚੈ ਨਟ ਮਾਨੋ ਮਚੇ ਜੰਗ ਰੰਗੰ ॥੬੮੩॥
271.e: Somewhere the horses tightened with brocaded thick cloth are dancing exhibiting a spectacle of war. 683.

271.g: ਦਈ ਰਕਤ ਨੀਲੰ ਮਣੀ ਰੰਗ ਰੰਗੰ ॥

271.e: By God's Grace, enlightenment comes.
By God's Kind Mercy, the heart-lotus blossoms forth.
When God is totally pleased, He comes to dwell in the mind.

271.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਇਆ ਤੇ; ਮਤਿ ਊਤਮ ਹੋਇ ॥
271.e: By God's Kind Mercy, the intellect is exalted.
All treasures, O Lord, come by Your Kind Mercy.
No one obtains anything by himself.

271.g: ਜਿਤੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਲਾਵਹੁ; ਤਿਤੁ ਲਗਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਥ ॥
271.e: As You have delegated, so do we apply ourselves, O Lord and Master.

271.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਇਨ ਕੈ; ਕਛੂ ਨ ਹਾਥ ॥੮॥੬॥
271.e: O Nanak, nothing is in our hands. ||8||6||

271.g: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ; ਸਭ ਕੁਲ ਉਧਾਰੈ ॥
271.e: In the Company of the Holy, all one's family is saved.
In the Company of the Holy, one's friends, acquaintances and relatives are redeemed.

271.g: ਸਾਧੂ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ; ਸੋ ਧਨੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
271.e: In the Company of the Holy, that wealth is obtained.

271.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਧਨ ਤੇ; ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਵਰਸਾਵੈ ॥
271.e: Everyone benefits from that wealth.
In the Company of the Holy, the Lord of Dharma serves.
In the Company of the Holy, the divine, angelic beings sing God's Praises.
In the Company of the Holy, one's sins fly away.
In the Company of the Holy, one sings the Ambrosial Glories.

271.g: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ; ਸ੍ਰਬ ਥਾਨ ਗੰਮਿ ॥
271.e: In the Company of the Holy, all places are within reach.
Salok:
Unapproachable and Unfathomable is the Supreme Lord God;

271.g: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਕਹੈ; ਸੁ ਮੁਕਤਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
271.e: whoever speaks of Him shall be liberated.
Listen, O friends, Nanak prays,
To the wonderful story of the Holy. ||1||
Ashtapadee:

271.g: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ; ਮੁਖ ਊਜਲ ਹੋਤ ॥
271.e: In the Company of the Holy, one's face becomes radiant.
In the Company of the Holy, all filth is removed.
In the Company of the Holy, egotism is eliminated.
In the Company of the Holy, spiritual wisdom is revealed.

271.g: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ; ਬੁਝੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਨੇਰਾ ॥
271.e: In the Company of the Holy, God is understood to be near at hand.
In the Company of the Holy, all conflicts are settled.

271.g: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ; ਪਾਏ ਨਾਮ ਰਤਨੁ ॥
271.e: In the Company of the Holy, one obtains the jewel of the Naam.

271.g: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ; ਏਕ ਊਪਰਿ ਜਤਨੁ ॥
271.e: In the Company of the Holy, one's efforts are directed toward the One Lord.

271.g: ਸਾਧ ਕੀ ਮਹਿਮਾ; ਬਰਨੈ ਕਉਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ॥
271.e: What mortal can speak of the Glorious Praises of the Holy?

271.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਸਾਧ ਕੀ ਸੋਭਾ; ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਨੀ ॥੧॥
271.e: O Nanak, the glory of the Holy people merges into God. ||1||

272.g: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
272.e: Salok:

272.g: ਮਨਿ ਸਾਚਾ; ਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਸੋਇ ॥
272.e: The True One is on his mind, and the True One is upon his lips.

272.g: ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਪੇਖੈ; ਏਕਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
272.e: He sees only the One.

272.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਇਹ ਲਛਣ; ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
272.e: O Nanak, these are the qualities of the God-conscious being. ||1||

272.g: ਲਖਯੋ ਰਾਮ ਕੋ ਅਤ੍ਰ ਧਾਰੀ ਅਭੰਗੰ ॥੬੮੪॥
272.e: The kings, who presented multi-coloured red and blue gems, had a sight of Ram, the wielder of weapons and arms.684.

272.g: ਕਿਤੇ ਪਸਮ ਪਾਟੰਬਰੰ ਸ੍ਵਰਣ ਬਰਣੰ ॥
ਮਿਲੇ ਭੇਟ ਲੈ ਭਾਤਿ ਭਾਤੰ ਅਭਰਣੰ ॥
272.e: Somewhere the kings are meeting Ram with golden colored silken raiments and various types of ornaments

272.g: ਕਿਤੇ ਪਰਮ ਪਾਟੰਬਰੰ ਭਾਨ ਤੇਜੰ ॥
