ਦਏ ਸੀਅ ਧਾਮੰ ਸਭੋ ਭੋਜ ਭੋਜੰ ॥੬੮੫॥
272.e: Somewhere the garments shining like sun are being sent to the abode of Sita.685.

272.g: ਕਿਤੇ ਭੂਖਣੰ ਭਾਨ ਤੇਜੰ ਅਨੰਤੰ ॥
ਪਠੇ ਜਾਨਕੀ ਭੇਟ ਦੈ ਦੈ ਦੁਰੰਤੰ ॥
272.e: Somewhere the ornaments shining like sun are being sent to Sita

272.g: ਘਨੇ ਰਾਮ ਮਾਤਾਨ ਕੀ ਭੇਟ ਭੇਜੇ ॥
ਹਰੇ ਚਿਤ ਕੇ ਜਾਹਿ ਹੇਰੇ ਕਲੇਜੇ ॥੬੮੬॥
272.e: Many ornaments and garments were sent to the mothers of Ram, seeing which many became covetous in their hearts.686.

272.g: ਘਮੰ ਚਕ੍ਰ ਚਕ੍ਰੰ ਫਿਰੀ ਰਾਮ ਦੋਹੀ ॥
ਮਨੋ ਬਯੋਤ ਬਾਗੋ ਤਿਮੰ ਸੀਅ ਸੋਹੀ ॥
272.e: On all the four sides, revolving the canopies, declarations were made regarding Ram and SIta also looked splendid like a decorated garden.

272.g: ਪਠੈ ਛਤ੍ਰ ਦੈ ਦੈ ਛਿਤੰ ਛੋਣ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
ਹਰੇ ਸਰਬ ਗਰਬੰ ਕਰੇ ਪੁਰਬ ਭਾਰੀ ॥੬੮੭॥
272.e: The kings were sent to far off places with to canopy of Ram, they smashed the pride of all and arranged festivities.687.

272.g: ਕਟਯੋ ਕਾਲ ਏਵੰ ਭਏ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜੰ ॥
ਫਿਰੀ ਆਨ ਰਾਮੰ ਸਿਰੰ ਸਰਬ ਰਾਜੰ ॥
272.e: In this way sufficient time elapsed in Ram’s kingdom and Ram began to rule magnificently

272.g: ਫਿਰਿਯੋ ਜੈਤ ਪਤ੍ਰੰ ਸਿਰੰ ਸੇਤ ਛਤ੍ਰੰ ॥
ਕਰੇ ਰਾਜ ਆਗਿਆ ਧਰੈ ਬੀਰ ਅਤ੍ਰੰ ॥੬੮੮॥
272.e: Letters of victory were sent to all sides and under a white canopy and commanding Ram looked greatly impressive.688.

272.g: ਦਯੋ ਏਕ ਏਕੰ ਅਨੇਕੰ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਰੰ ॥
ਲਖੇ ਸਰਬ ਲੋਕੰ ਸਹੀ ਰਾਵਣਾਰੰ ॥
272.e: Everyone was given wealth in various ways and the people saw the real personality of Ram.

272.g: ਸਹੀ ਬਿਸਨ ਦੇਵਾਰਦਨ ਦ੍ਰੋਹ ਹਰਤਾ ॥
ਚਹੂੰ ਚਕ ਜਾਨਯੋ ਸੀਆ ਨਾਥ ਭਰਤਾ ॥੬੮੯॥
272.e: He was known on all four direction as the destroyer of the rebels of Vishnu and the lord of Sita.689.

272.g: ਸਹੀ ਬਿਸਨ ਅਉਤਾਰ ਕੈ ਤਾਹਿ ਜਾਨਯੋ ॥
ਸਭੋ ਲੋਕ ਖਯਾਤਾ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ਪਛਾਨਯੋ ॥
272.e: Everyone considered him as an incarnation of Vishnu and he was famous among the people as the Lord.

272.g: ਫਿਰੀ ਚਾਰ ਚਕ੍ਰੰ ਚਤੁਰ ਚਕ੍ਰ ਧਾਰੰ ॥
ਭਯੋ ਚਕ੍ਰਵਰਤੀ ਭੂਅੰ ਰਾਵਣਾਰੰ ॥੬੯੦॥
272.e: In all the four directions the current of Ram’s praise flowed as he , the enemy of Ravana, was known as the Supreme Soverign.690.

272.g: ਲਖਯੋ ਪਰਮ ਜੋਗਿੰਦ੍ਰਣੋ ਜੋਗ ਰੂਪੰ ॥
ਮਹਾਦੇਵ ਦੇਵੰ ਲਖਯੋ ਭੂਪ ਭੂਪੰ ॥
272.e: He looked like a supreme Yogi amongst Yogis, great god anong gods and a supreme sovereign amongst kings.

272.g: ਮਹਾ ਸਤ੍ਰ ਸਤ੍ਰੰ ਮਹਾ ਸਾਧ ਸਾਧੰ ॥
272.e: He was considered the great enemy of enemies and supreme saint amongst saints

272.g: ਮਹਾ ਰੂਪ ਰੂਪੰ ਲਖਯੋ ਬਯਾਧ ਬਾਧੰ ॥੬੯੧॥
272.e: He was an extremely elegant personality who was the destroyer of all ailments.691.

272.g: ਤ੍ਰੀਯੰ ਦੇਵ ਤੁਲੰ ਨਰੰ ਨਾਰ ਨਾਹੰ ॥
272.e: He was like god for women and like a sovereign for men

272.g: ਮਹਾ ਜੋਧ ਜੋਧੰ ਮਹਾ ਬਾਹ ਬਾਹੰ ॥
272.e: He was a supreme warrior amongst warriors amongst warriors and a great wielder of weapons amongst the weapons-wielders.

272.g: ਸ੍ਰੁਤੰ ਬੇਦ ਕਰਤਾ ਗਣੰ ਰੁਦ੍ਰ ਰੂਪੰ ॥
272.e: He was the creator of Vedas and Shiva for his devotees (ganas).

272.g: ਮਹਾ ਜੋਗ ਜੋਗੰ ਮਹਾ ਭੂਪ ਭੂਪੰ ॥੬੯੨॥
272.e: Among Yogis he was the great Yogi and of the Kings, the great King.692.

272.g: ਪਰੰ ਪਾਰਗੰਤਾ ਸਿਵੰ ਸਿਧ ਰੂਪੰ ॥
ਬੁਧੰ ਬੁਧਿ ਦਾਤਾ ਰਿਧੰ ਰਿਧ ਕੂਪੰ ॥
272.e: He was the giver of salvation, blissful, adept-like, giver of intellect and the store-house of wealth of powers

272.g: ਜਹਾ ਭਾਵ ਕੈ ਜੇਣ ਜੈਸੋ ਬਿਚਾਰੇ ॥
ਤਿਸੀ ਰੂਪ ਸੌ ਤਉਨ ਤੈਸੇ ਨਿਹਾਰੇ ॥੬੯੩॥
272.e: With whatever feeling one looked towards him, he saw him in that form.693.

272.g: ਸਭੋ ਸਸਤ੍ਰਧਾਰੀ ਲਹੇ ਸਸਤ੍ਰ ਗੰਤਾ ॥
ਦੁਰੇ ਦੇਵ ਦ੍ਰੋਹੀ ਲਖੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਹੰਤਾ ॥
272.e: All the weapon-wielders saw him as a specialist in weapon-warfare and all the demons who were spiteful towards gods, visualsing him as destroyer of life, hid themselves

272.g: ਜਿਸੀ ਭਾਵ ਸੋ ਜਉਨ ਜੈਸੇ ਬਿਚਾਰੇ ॥
ਤਿਸੀ ਰੰਗ ਕੈ ਕਾਛ ਕਾਛੇ ਨਿਹਾਰੇ ॥੬੯੪॥
272.e: With whatever feeling one thought of him, Ram seemed to him in the same colour.694.

272.g: ਸਾਧ ਕੀ ਮਹਿਮਾ; ਬੇਦ ਨ ਜਾਨਹਿ ॥
272.e: The glory of the Holy people is not known to the Vedas.

272.g: ਜੇਤਾ ਸੁਨਹਿ; ਤੇਤਾ ਬਖਿਆਨਹਿ ॥
272.e: They can describe only what they have heard.

272.g: ਸਾਧ ਕੀ ਉਪਮਾ; ਤਿਹੁ ਗੁਣ ਤੇ ਦੂਰਿ ॥
272.e: The greatness of the Holy people is beyond the three qualities.

272.g: ਸਾਧ ਕੀ ਉਪਮਾ; ਰਹੀ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ॥
272.e: The greatness of the Holy people is all-pervading.

272.g: ਸਾਧ ਕੀ ਸੋਭਾ ਕਾ; ਨਾਹੀ ਅੰਤ ॥
272.e: The glory of the Holy people has no limit.

272.g: ਸਾਧ ਕੀ ਸੋਭਾ; ਸਦਾ ਬੇਅੰਤ ॥
272.e: The glory of the Holy people is infinite and eternal.

272.g: ਸਾਧ ਕੀ ਸੋਭਾ; ਊਚ ਤੇ ਊਚੀ ॥
272.e: The glory of the Holy people is the highest of the high.

272.g: ਸਾਧ ਕੀ ਸੋਭਾ; ਮੂਚ ਤੇ ਮੂਚੀ ॥
272.e: The glory of the Holy people is the greatest of the great.

272.g: ਸਾਧ ਕੀ ਸੋਭਾ; ਸਾਧ ਬਨਿ ਆਈ ॥
272.e: The glory of the Holy people is theirs alone;

272.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਧ ਪ੍ਰਭ; ਭੇਦੁ ਨ ਭਾਈ ॥੮॥੭॥
272.e: O Nanak, there is no difference between the Holy people and God. ||8||7||

272.g: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ; ਨਿਰਮਲ ਤੇ ਨਿਰਮਲਾ ॥
272.e: The God-conscious being is the purest of the pure;

272.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਮੈਲੁ; ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਜਲਾ ॥
272.e: filth does not stick to water.

272.g: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕੈ; ਮਨਿ ਹੋਇ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੁ ॥
272.e: The God-conscious being's mind is enlightened,

272.g: ਜੈਸੇ; ਧਰ ਊਪਰਿ ਆਕਾਸੁ ॥
272.e: like the sky above the earth.

272.g: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕੈ; ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਸਤ੍ਰੁ ਸਮਾਨਿ ॥
272.e: To the God-conscious being, friend and foe are the same.

272.g: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕੈ; ਨਾਹੀ ਅਭਿਮਾਨ ॥
272.e: The God-conscious being has no egotistical pride.

272.g: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ; ਊਚ ਤੇ ਊਚਾ ॥
272.e: The God-conscious being is the highest of the high.

272.g: ਮਨਿ ਅਪਨੈ ਹੈ; ਸਭ ਤੇ ਨੀਚਾ ॥
272.e: Within his own mind, he is the most humble of all.

272.g: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ; ਸੇ ਜਨ ਭਏ ॥
272.e: They alone become God-conscious beings,

272.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਨ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ; ਆਪਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥੨॥
272.e: O Nanak, whom God Himself makes so. ||2||

272.g: ਅਸਟਪਦੀ ॥
272.e: Ashtapadee:

272.g: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ; ਸਦਾ ਨਿਰਲੇਪ ॥
272.e: The God-conscious being is always unattached,

272.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਜਲ ਮਹਿ; ਕਮਲ ਅਲੇਪ ॥
272.e: as the lotus in the water remains detached.

272.g: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ; ਸਦਾ ਨਿਰਦੋਖ ॥
272.e: The God-conscious being is always unstained,

272.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਸੂਰੁ; ਸਰਬ ਕਉ ਸੋਖ ॥
272.e: like the sun, which gives its comfort and warmth to all.

272.g: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕੈ; ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸਮਾਨਿ ॥
272.e: The God-conscious being looks upon all alike,

272.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਰਾਜ ਰੰਕ ਕਉ; ਲਾਗੈ ਤੁਲਿ ਪਵਾਨ ॥
272.e: like the wind, which blows equally upon the king and the poor beggar.

272.g: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕੈ; ਧੀਰਜੁ ਏਕ ॥
272.e: The God-conscious being has a steady patience,

272.g: ਜਿਉ ਬਸੁਧਾ; ਕੋਊ ਖੋਦੈ. ਕੋਊ ਚੰਦਨ ਲੇਪ ॥
272.e: like the earth, which is dug up by one, and anointed with sandal paste by another.

272.g: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕਾ; ਇਹੈ ਗੁਨਾਉ ॥
272.e: This is the quality of the God-conscious being:

272.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਜਿਉ ਪਾਵਕ ਕਾ; ਸਹਜ ਸੁਭਾਉ ॥੧॥
272.e: O Nanak, his inherent nature is like a warming fire. ||1||

272.g: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ; ਸਗਲ ਕੀ ਰੀਨਾ ॥
272.e: The God-conscious being is the dust of all.

272.g: ਆਤਮ ਰਸੁ; ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਚੀਨਾ ॥
272.e: The God-conscious being knows the nature of the soul.

272.g: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕੀ; ਸਭ ਊਪਰਿ ਮਇਆ ॥
272.e: The God-conscious being shows kindness to all.

272.g: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਤੇ; ਕਛੁ ਬੁਰਾ ਨ ਭਇਆ ॥
272.e: No evil comes from the God-conscious being.

272.g: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ; ਸਦਾ ਸਮਦਰਸੀ ॥
272.e: The God-conscious being is always impartial.

272.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ; ਸਫਲ ਜਨੰਮ ॥੫॥
272.e: O Nanak, in the Company of the Holy, one's life becomes fruitful. ||5||

272.g: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ; ਨਹੀ ਕਛੁ ਘਾਲ ॥
272.e: In the Company of the Holy, there is no suffering.

272.g: ਦਰਸਨੁ ਭੇਟਤ; ਹੋਤ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥
272.e: The Blessed Vision of their Darshan brings a sublime, happy peace.

272.g: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ; ਕਲੂਖਤ ਹਰੈ ॥
272.e: In the Company of the Holy, blemishes are removed.

272.g: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ; ਨਰਕ ਪਰਹਰੈ ॥
272.e: In the Company of the Holy, hell is far away.

272.g: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ; ਈਹਾ ਊਹਾ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ ॥
272.e: In the Company of the Holy, one is happy here and hereafter.

272.g: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ; ਬਿਛੁਰਤ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲਾ ॥
272.e: In the Company of the Holy, the separated ones are reunited with the Lord.

272.g: ਜੋ ਇਛੈ; ਸੋਈ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
272.e: The fruits of one's desires are obtained.

272.g: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ; ਨ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਾਵੈ ॥
272.e: In the Company of the Holy, no one goes empty-handed.

272.g: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ; ਸਾਧ ਰਿਦ ਬਸੈ ॥
272.e: The Supreme Lord God dwells in the hearts of the Holy.

272.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਉਧਰੈ; ਸਾਧ ਸੁਨਿ ਰਸੈ ॥੬॥
272.e: O Nanak, listening to the sweet words of the Holy, one is saved. ||6||

272.g: ਭੁਜੰਗ ਪ੍ਰਯਾਤ ਛੰਦ ॥
272.e: BHUJANG PRAYAAT STANZA

272.g: ਸਭੈ ਬਿਪ ਆਗਸਤ ਤੇ ਆਦਿ ਲੈ ਕੈ ॥
ਅਨੰਤ ਤੁਕਾ ਭੁਜੰਗ ਪ੍ਰਯਾਤ ਛੰਦ ॥
272.e: ANANT-TUKA BHUJANG PRAYAAT STANZA

272.g: ਕਿਤੋ ਕਾਲ ਬੀਤਿਓ ਭਯੋ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜੰ ॥
ਸਭੈ ਸਤ੍ਰ ਜੀਤੇ ਮਹਾ ਜੁਧ ਮਾਲੀ ॥
272.e: A good deal of time passed during the reign of Ram and all the enemies were conquered after great wars

272.g: ਫਿਰਯੋ ਚਕ੍ਰ ਚਾਰੋ ਦਿਸਾ ਮਧ ਰਾਮੰ ॥
ਭਯੋ ਨਾਮ ਤਾ ਤੇ ਮਹਾ ਚਕ੍ਰਵਰਤੀ ॥੬੯੫॥
272.e: Ram’s influence spread in all the four directions and he became the Supreme Soverign.695.

272.g: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ; ਸੁਨਉ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਉ ॥
272.e: In the Company of the Holy, listen to the Name of the Lord.

272.g: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ; ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਉ ॥
272.e: In the Company of the Holy, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

272.g: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ; ਨ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਬਿਸਰੈ ॥
272.e: In the Company of the Holy, do not forget Him from your mind.

272.g: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ; ਸਰਪਰ ਨਿਸਤਰੈ ॥
272.e: In the Company of the Holy, you shall surely be saved.

272.g: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ; ਲਗੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੀਠਾ ॥
272.e: In the Company of the Holy, God seems very sweet.

272.g: ਸਾਧੂ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ; ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਡੀਠਾ ॥
272.e: In the Company of the Holy, He is seen in each and every heart.

272.g: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ; ਭਏ ਆਗਿਆਕਾਰੀ ॥
272.e: In the Company of the Holy, we become obedient to the Lord.

272.g: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ; ਗਤਿ ਭਈ ਹਮਾਰੀ ॥
272.e: In the Company of the Holy, we obtain the state of salvation.

272.g: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ; ਮਿਟੇ ਸਭਿ ਰੋਗ ॥
272.e: In the Company of the Holy, all diseases are cured.

272.g: ਨਾਨਕ; ਸਾਧ ਭੇਟੇ ਸੰਜੋਗ ॥੭॥
272.e: O Nanak, one meets with the Holy, by highest destiny. ||7||

273.e: MRITGAT STANZA
The drum is resounding on the door of the great sage Raghuvir (Ram),
And in the whole world, in all houses and in the abode of gods, he was hailed.703.
Being known with the name of Raghunandan, ram is the lord os the world and is worshipped by the sages..
He identified the people on the earth and comforted them, removing their agony.704.
All the people considered him as the destroyer of enemies, remover of sufferings and the giver of comforts
All the city of Ayodhya is living in comfort because of his unique personality and the fearless blessings.705.
The God-conscious being centers his hopes on the One alone.
The God-conscious being shall never perish.
The God-conscious being is steeped in humility.
The God-conscious being delights in doing good to others.
The God-conscious being has no worldly entanglements.
The God-conscious being holds his wandering mind under control.

273.g: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕੈ; ਹੋਇ ਸੁ ਭਲਾ ॥
273.e: The God-conscious being acts in the common good.
The God-conscious being blossoms in fruitfulness.
In the Company of the God-conscious being, all are saved.

273.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ; ਜਪੈ ਸਗਲ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥੪॥
273.e: O Nanak, through the God-conscious being, the whole world meditates on God. ||4||
The God-conscious being loves the One Lord alone.

273.g: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕੈ; ਬਸੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੰਗ ॥
273.e: The God-conscious being dwells with God.
The God-conscious being takes the Naam as his Support.
The God-conscious being has the Naam as his Family.
The God-conscious being is awake and aware, forever and ever.
The God-conscious being renounces his proud ego.
In the mind of the God-conscious being, there is supreme bliss.

273.g: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕੈ ਘਰਿ; ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦ ॥
273.e: In the home of the God-conscious being, there is everlasting bliss.
The God-conscious being dwells in peaceful ease.

273.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕਾ; ਨਹੀ ਬਿਨਾਸ ॥੫॥
273.e: O Nanak, the God-conscious being shall never perish. ||5||

273.g: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕੀ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ; ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਬਰਸੀ ॥
273.e: Nectar rains down from the glance of the God-conscious being.
The God-conscious being is free from entanglements.
The lifestyle of the God-conscious being is spotlessly pure.
Spiritual wisdom is the food of the God-conscious being.

273.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕਾ; ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥੩॥
273.e: O Nanak, the God-conscious being is absorbed in God's meditation. ||3||
The God-conscious being cannot be appraised.

273.g: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕੈ; ਸਗਲ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
273.e: The God-conscious being has all within his mind.

273.g: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕਾ; ਕਉਨ ਜਾਨੈ ਭੇਦੁ ॥
273.e: Who can know the mystery of the God-conscious being?
Forever bow to the God-conscious being.

273.g: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕਾ; ਕਥਿਆ ਨ ਜਾਇ. ਅਧਾਖੵਰੁ ॥
273.e: The God-conscious being cannot be described in words.
The God-conscious being is the Lord and Master of all.

273.g: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕੀ ਮਿਤਿ; ਕਉਨੁ ਬਖਾਨੈ ॥
273.e: Who can describe the limits of the God-conscious being?

273.g: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ; ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
273.e: Only the God-conscious being can know the state of the God-conscious being.

273.g: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕਾ; ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰੁ ॥
273.e: The God-conscious being has no end or limitation.

273.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕਉ; ਸਦਾ ਨਮਸਕਾਰੁ ॥੭॥
273.e: O Nanak, to the God-conscious being, bow forever in reverence. ||7||
The God-conscious being knows God.
The God-conscious being is in love with the One alone.
The God-conscious being is carefree.
Pure are the Teachings of the God-conscious being.

273.g: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ; ਜਿਸੁ ਕਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪਿ ॥
273.e: The God-conscious being is made so by God Himself.
The God-conscious being is gloriously great.

273.g: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕਾ ਦਰਸੁ; ਬਡਭਾਗੀ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
273.e: The Darshan, the Blessed Vision of the God-conscious being, is obtained by great good fortune.

273.g: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕਉ; ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈਐ ॥
273.e: To the God-conscious being, I make my life a sacrifice.
The God-conscious being is sought by the great god Shiva.
O Nanak, the God-conscious being is Himself the Supreme Lord God. ||6||
ANKA STANZA
That Ram is God, Infinite, Unconquerable and Fearless.706.

273.g: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ; ਸਭ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਕਾ ਕਰਤਾ ॥
273.e: The God-conscious being is the Creator of all the world.

273.g: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ; ਸਦ ਜੀਵੈ. ਨਹੀ ਮਰਤਾ ॥
273.e: The God-conscious being lives forever, and does not die.

273.g: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ; ਮੁਕਤਿ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਜੀਅ ਕਾ ਦਾਤਾ ॥
273.e: The God-conscious being is the Giver of the way of liberation of the soul.
The God-conscious being is the Perfect Supreme Being, who orchestrates all.
The God-conscious being is the helper of the helpless.

273.g: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕਾ; ਸਭ ਊਪਰਿ ਹਾਥੁ ॥
273.e: The God-conscious being extends his hand to all.
The God-conscious being owns the entire creation.

273.g: ਭ੍ਰਿਗੰ ਅੰਗੁਰਾ ਬਿਆਸ ਤੇ ਲੈ ਬਿਸਿਸਟੰ ॥
273.e: All the sages including Agastya, Bhring, Angira, Vyasa, Vasishtha,

273.g: ਦੁਰਬਾਸਾ ਸਭੈ ਕਸਪ ਤੇ ਆਦ ਲੈ ਕੈ ॥੬੯੬॥
273.e: Along with Vishvamitra, Valmiki, Durvasa, Kashyap and Atri came to him.696.

273.g: ਜਭੈ ਰਾਮ ਦੇਖੈ ਸਭੈ ਬਿਪ ਆਏ ॥
ਪਰਯੋ ਧਾਇ ਪਾਯੰ ਸੀਆ ਨਾਥ ਜਗਤੰ ॥
273.e: When Ram saw all the Brahmins coming to him, then Ram, the Lord of Sita and the world ran to touch their feet.

273.g: ਦਯੋ ਆਸਨੰ ਅਰਘੁ ਪਾਦ ਰਘੁ ਤੇਣੰ ॥

273.e: He gave them seats, washes their feet and all the great sages blessed him with delight.697.

273.g: ਭਈ ਰਿਖ ਰਾਮੰ ਬਡੀ ਗਿਆਨ ਚਰਚਾ ॥
ਕਹੋ ਸਰਬ ਜੌਪੈ ਬਢੈ ਏਕ ਗ੍ਰੰਥਾ ॥
273.e: Great discussions pertaining to divine knowledge were held between the sages and ram and if all of it is described, this granth (book) will become voluminous.

273.g: ਬਿਦਾ ਬਿਪ੍ਰ ਕੀਨੇ ਘਨੀ ਦਛਨਾ ਦੈ ॥
ਚਲੇ ਦੇਸ ਦੇਸੰ ਮਹਾ ਚਿਤ ਹਰਖੰ ॥੬੯੮॥
273.e: All the sages were bestowed with suitable presents on bidding farewell to them who went away to their places happily.698.

273.g: ਇਹੀ ਬੀਚ ਆਯੋ ਮ੍ਰਿਤੰ ਸੂਨ ਬਿਪੰ ॥
ਜੀਐ ਬਾਲ ਆਜੈ ਨਹੀ ਤੋਹਿ ਸ੍ਰਾਪੰ ॥
273.e: During this period a sage came with the corpse of his dead son and said to Ram, “If my child is not revived, I shall curse you.”

273.g: ਸਭੈ ਰਾਮ ਜਾਨੀ ਚਿਤੰ ਤਾਹਿ ਬਾਤਾ ॥

273.e: Ram ruminated about it in his mind and started towards the westerly direction in his air-vehicle.699.

273.g: ਹੁਤੋ ਏਕ ਸੂਦ੍ਰੰ ਦਿਸਾ ਉਤ੍ਰ ਮਧੰ ॥
ਝੁਲੈ ਕੂਪ ਮਧੰ ਪਰਯੋ ਔਧ ਮੁਖੰ ॥
273.e: In the north-western direction a Shudra was hanging overturned in a well

273.g: ਮਹਾ ਉਗ੍ਰ ਤੇ ਜਾਪ ਪਸਯਾਤ ਉਗ੍ਰੰ ॥
ਹਨਯੋ ਤਾਹਿ ਰਾਮੰ ਅਸੰ ਆਪ ਹਥੰ ॥੭੦੦॥
273.e: He was performing a penance  Ram killed him with his own hand.700.

273.g: ਜੀਯੋ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪੁਤ੍ਰੰ ਹਰਯੋ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਸੋਗੰ ॥
ਬਢੀ ਕੀਰਤ ਰਾਮੰ ਚਤੁਰ ਕੁੰਟ ਮਧੰ ॥
273.e: The son of Brahmin regained his life and his agony ended. The praise of Ram spread in all the four directions.

273.g: ਕਰਯੋ ਦਸ ਸਹੰਸ੍ਰ ਲਉ ਰਾਜ ਅਉਧੰ ॥
ਫਿਰੀ ਚਕ੍ਰ ਚਾਰੋ ਬਿਖੈ ਰਾਮ ਦੋਹੀ ॥੭੦੧॥
273.e: In this way Ram was eulogized all over and the ruled over his kingdom for ten thousand years.701.

273.g: ਜਿਣੇ ਦੇਸ ਦੇਸੰ ਨਰੇਸੰ ਤ ਰਾਮੰ ॥
ਮਹਾ ਜੁਧ ਜੇਤਾ ਤਿਹੂੰ ਲੋਕ ਜਾਨਯੋ ॥
273.e: Ram conquered the kings of various countries and he was considered a great conqueror in the three worlds.
He made Bharat his ministers and made Lakshman and Shatrughan, the sons of Sumitra, his generals.702.

274.e: The true Vaishnaav, the devotee of Vishnu, is the one with whom God is thoroughly pleased.

274.g: ਬਿਸਨ ਕੀ ਮਾਇਆ ਤੇ; ਹੋਇ ਭਿੰਨ ॥
274.e: He dwells apart from Maya.
Performing good deeds, he does not seek rewards.
Spotlessly pure is the religion of such a Vaishnaav;

274.g: ਕਾਹੂ ਫਲ ਕੀ ਇਛਾ; ਨਹੀ ਬਾਛੈ ॥
274.e: he has no desire for the fruits of his labors.
He is absorbed in devotional worship and the singing of Kirtan, the songs of the Lord's Glory.
Within his mind and body, he meditates in remembrance on the Lord of the Universe.
He is kind to all creatures.
He holds fast to the Naam, and inspires others to chant it.

274.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਓਹੁ ਬੈਸਨੋ; ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
274.e: O Nanak, such a Vaishnaav obtains the supreme status. ||2||
BHUJANG PRAYAAT STANZA
One day Ram sent for the son of Sumitra and said to him :

274.g: ਤਹਾ ਏਕ ਦਈਤੰ ਲਵੰ ਉਗ੍ਰ ਤੇਜੰ ॥
ਦਯੋ ਤਾਹਿ ਅਪੰ ਸਿਵੰ ਸੂਲ ਭੇਜੰ ॥੭੦੮॥
274.e: In a distant land there lives a huge demon named Lavan, who has got the trident of Shiva,708.

274.g: ਪਠਯੋ ਤੀਰ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੰ ਦੀਯੋ ਏਕ ਰਾਮੰ ॥
ਮਹਾ ਜੁਧ ਮਾਲੀ ਮਹਾ ਧਰਮ ਧਾਮੰ ॥
274.e: Ram gave him an arrow after reciting a mantra which was a great weapon from Ram, the abode of Dharma.

274.g: ਸਿਵੰ ਸੂਲ ਹੀਣੰ ਜਵੈ ਸਤ੍ਰ ਜਾਨਯੋ ॥
ਤਬੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਮਹਾ ਜੁਧ ਠਾਨਯੋ ॥੭੦੯॥
274.e: Ram said to him “When you see the enemy without the trident of Shiva, then wage a war with him.”709.

274.g: ਲਯੋ ਮੰਤ੍ਰ ਤੀਰੰ ਚਲਯੋ ਨਿਆਇ ਸੀਸੰ ॥
ਤ੍ਰਿਪੁਰ ਜੁਧ ਜੇਤਾ ਚਲਯੋ ਜਾਣ ਈਸੰ ॥
274.e: Shatrughan taking that charmed arrows and bowing his head started for his errand and it seemed that he was going as conquerer of the three worlds

274.g: ਲਖਯੋ ਸੂਲ ਹੀਣੰ ਰਿਪੰ ਜਉਣ ਕਾਲੰ ॥

274.e: When he saw the enemy without the trident of Shiva, then finding an opportunity, he furiously began to wage war with him.710.

274.g: ਹਸੇ ਕੰਕ ਬੰਕੰ ਘੁਮੀ ਗੈਣ ਹੂਰੰ ॥
274.e: After getting wounded the warriors began to run away and the crows began to caw o seeing the corpse. The heavenly damsels began to wander in the sky

274.g: ਰਣੰ ਰੋਸ ਰਜੇ ਮਹਾ ਛਤ੍ਰ ਧਾਰੇ ॥੭੧੧॥
274.e: The helmets broke with the blow of arrows and the great sovereigns were highly enraged in the battlefield.711.

274.g: ਫਿਰਯੋ ਅਪ ਦਈਤੰ ਮਹਾ ਰੋਸ ਕੈ ਕੈ ॥
ਹਣੇ ਰਾਮ ਭ੍ਰਾਤੰ ਵਹੈ ਬਾਣ ਲੈ ਕੈ ॥
274.e: That demon in great rage revolved and showered a volley of arrows on the brother of Ram

274.g: ਰਿਪੰ ਨਾਸ ਹੇਤੰ ਦੀਯੋ ਰਾਮ ਅਪੰ ॥
ਹਣਿਯੋ ਤਾਹਿ ਸੀਸੰ ਦ੍ਰੁਗਾ ਜਾਪ ਜਪੰ ॥੭੧੨॥
274.e: The arrows which was given by Ram for the destruction of the enemy, Shatrughan discharged it on the demon, repeating the name of Durga.712.

274.g: ਗਿਰਯੋ ਝੂਮ ਭੂਮੰ ਅਘੂਮਯੋ ਅਰਿ ਘਾਯੰ ॥
ਹਣਯੋ ਸਤ੍ਰ ਹੰਤਾ ਤਿਸੈ ਚਉਪ ਚਾਯੰ ॥
274.e: The enemy received a wounded and while revolving, he fell down on the earth and he was killed by Shatrughan

274.g: ਜਿਸ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ; ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕਾ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ॥
274.e: One whose mind is a home for the Supreme Lord God
Ashtapadee:
One whose tongue does not touch falsehood;
whose mind is filled with love for the Blessed Vision of the Pure Lord,

274.g: ਪਰ ਤ੍ਰਿਅ ਰੂਪੁ; ਨ ਪੇਖੈ ਨੇਤ੍ਰ ॥
274.e: whose eyes do not gaze upon the beauty of others' wives,
who serves the Holy and loves the Saints' Congregation,

274.g: ਕਰਨ ਨ ਸੁਨੈ; ਕਾਹੂ ਕੀ ਨਿੰਦਾ ॥
274.e: whose ears do not listen to slander against anyone,

274.g: ਸਭ ਤੇ ਜਾਨੈ; ਆਪਸ ਕਉ ਮੰਦਾ ॥
274.e: who deems himself to be the worst of all,
who, by Guru's Grace, renounces corruption,

274.g: ਮਨ ਕੀ ਬਾਸਨਾ; ਮਨ ਤੇ ਟਰੈ ॥
274.e: who banishes the mind's evil desires from his mind,

274.g: ਇੰਦ੍ਰੀ ਜਿਤ; ਪੰਚ ਦੋਖ ਤੇ ਰਹਤ ॥
274.e: who conquers his sexual instincts and is free of the five sinful passions

274.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਕੋਟਿ ਮਧੇ; ਕੋ ਐਸਾ ਅਪਰਸ ॥੧॥
274.e: - O Nanak, among millions, there is scarcely one such 'touch-nothing Saint'. ||1||
The true Bhagaautee, the devotee of Adi Shakti, loves the devotional worship of God.
He forsakes the company of all wicked people.
All doubts are removed from his mind.
He performs devotional service to the Supreme Lord God in all.
In the Company of the Holy, the filth of sin is washed away.

274.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਭਗਉਤੀ ਕੀ; ਮਤਿ ਊਤਮ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
274.e: The wisdom of such a Bhagaautee becomes supreme.

274.g: ਭਗਵੰਤ ਕੀ ਟਹਲ; ਕਰੈ ਨਿਤ ਨੀਤਿ ॥
274.e: He constantly performs the service of the Supreme Lord God.
He dedicates his mind and body to the Love of God.
The Lotus Feet of the Lord abide in his heart.

274.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਐਸਾ ਭਗਉਤੀ; ਭਗਵੰਤ ਕਉ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੩॥
274.e: O Nanak, such a Bhagaautee attains the Lord God. ||3||
Salok:
One who enshrines the Naam within the heart,
who sees the Lord God in all,
who, each and every moment, bows in reverence to the Lord Master
- O Nanak, such a one is the true 'touch-nothing Saint', who emancipates everyone. ||1||
He is a true Pandit, a religious scholar, who instructs his own mind.
He searches for the Lord's Name within his own soul.
He drinks in the Exquisite Nectar of the Lord's Name.

274.g: ਉਸੁ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਕੈ ਉਪਦੇਸਿ; ਜਗੁ ਜੀਵੈ ॥
274.e: By that Pandit's teachings, the world lives.
He implants the Sermon of the Lord in his heart.

274.g: ਸੋ ਪੰਡਿਤੁ; ਫਿਰਿ ਜੋਨਿ. ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
274.e: Such a Pandit is not cast into the womb of reincarnation again.
He understands the fundamental essence of the Vedas, the Puraanas and the Simritees.
In the unmanifest, he sees the manifest world to exist.
He gives instruction to people of all castes and social classes.

274.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਉਸੁ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਕਉ; ਸਦਾ ਅਦੇਸੁ ॥੪॥
274.e: O Nanak, to such a Pandit, I bow in salutation forever. ||4||
The Beej Mantra, the Seed Mantra, is spiritual wisdom for everyone.

274.g: ਚਹੁ ਵਰਨਾ ਮਹਿ; ਜਪੈ ਕੋਊ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
274.e: Anyone, from any class, may chant the Naam.

274.g: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਜਪੈ; ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
274.e: Whoever chants it, is emancipated.
And yet, rare are those who attain it, in the Company of the Holy.
By His Grace, He enshrines it within.

274.g: ਪਸੁ ਪ੍ਰੇਤ ਮੁਘਦ; ਪਾਥਰ ਕਉ ਤਾਰੈ ॥
274.e: Even beasts, ghosts and the stone-hearted are saved.
The Naam is the panacea, the remedy to cure all ills.
Singing the Glory of God is the embodiment of bliss and emancipation.

274.g: ਕਾਹੂ ਜੁਗਤਿ; ਕਿਤੈ. ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਧਰਮਿ ॥
274.e: It cannot be obtained by any religious rituals.

274.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਿਲੈ; ਜਿਸੁ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਧੁਰਿ ਕਰਮਿ ॥੫॥
274.e: O Nanak, he alone obtains it, whose karma is so pre-ordained. ||5||
He is the Lord of nature, he is Purusha, he is the whole world and higher Brahman.707.
The God-conscious being is himself the Formless Lord.

274.g: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕੀ ਸੋਭਾ; ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਬਨੀ ॥
274.e: The glory of the God-conscious being belongs to the God-conscious being alone.

274.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ; ਸਰਬ ਕਾ ਧਨੀ ॥੮॥੮॥
274.e: O Nanak, the God-conscious being is the Lord of all. ||8||8||

275.e: All places belong to the Supreme Lord God.

275.g: ਜਿਤੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਘਰਿ ਰਾਖੈ; ਤੈਸਾ ਤਿਨ ਨਾਉ ॥
275.e: According to the homes in which they are placed, so are His creatures named.
He Himself is the Doer, the Cause of causes.
Whatever pleases God, ultimately comes to pass.
He Himself is All-pervading, in endless waves.

275.g: ਲਖੇ ਨ ਜਾਹਿ; ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕੇ ਰੰਗ ॥
275.e: The playful sport of the Supreme Lord God cannot be known.
As the understanding is given, so is one enlightened.
The Supreme Lord God, the Creator, is eternal and everlasting.
Forever, forever and ever, He is merciful.
Remembering Him, remembering Him in meditation, O Nanak, one is blessed with ecstasy. ||8||9||
The gods were overjoyed in the sky and began to shower floweres

275.g: ਹਤਯੋ ਦੈਤ ਦ੍ਰੋਹੀ ਮਿਟਯੋ ਸਰਬ ਸੂਲੰ ॥੭੧੩॥
275.e: With the killing of this malignant demon, all their agony ended.713.
All the saints were delighted with the destruction of the demon named Lavan

275.g: ਸਭੈ ਸੰਤ ਹਰਖੇ ਰਿਪੰ ਭੇ ਉਦਾਸੰ ॥
275.e: The enemies became depressed,

275.g: ਭਜੈ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਲੈ ਲੈ ਤਜਯੋ ਨਗਰ ਬਾਸੰ ॥
275.e: And fled away after forsaking the city
Shatrughan stayed in the city of Mathura.714.

275.g: ਸਭੈ ਸਸਤ੍ਰ ਗਾਮੀ ਸੁਭੰ ਸਸਤ੍ਰ ਗੰਤਾ ॥
275.e: After destroying Lavan, Shatrughan ruled over Mathura and all the weapon-wielders gave the blessings of good wishes to him.

275.g: ਭਏ ਦੁਸਟ ਦੂਰੰ ਕਰੂਰੰ ਸੁ ਠਾਮੰ ॥
ਕਰਯੋ ਰਾਜ ਤੈਸੋ ਜਿਮੰ ਅਉਧ ਰਾਮੰ ॥੭੧੫॥
275.e: He ended all the tyrants and ruled over Mathura like Ram ruling over Avadh.715.

275.g: ਉਠੀ ਜੈ ਧੁਨੰ ਪੁਰ ਰਹੀ ਲੋਗ ਪੂਰੰ ॥
275.e: On destroying the tyrant, the people of all directions hailed Shatrughan  his fame spread in all the directions nicely

275.g: ਗਈ ਪਾਰ ਸਿੰਧੰ ਸੁ ਬਿੰਧੰ ਪ੍ਰਹਾਰੰ ॥

275.e: And the people came to know with great zeal that demon Lavan had been killed.716.
- his name is truly Ram Das, the Lord's servant.
He comes to have the Vision of the Lord, the Supreme Soul.
Deeming himself to be the slave of the Lord's slaves, he obtains it.
He knows the Lord to be Ever-present, close at hand.
Such a servant is honored in the Court of the Lord.

275.g: ਅਪੁਨੇ ਦਾਸ ਕਉ; ਆਪਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੈ ॥
275.e: To His servant, He Himself shows His Mercy.

275.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਦਾਸ ਕਉ; ਸਭ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਰੈ ॥
275.e: Such a servant understands everything.
Amidst all, his soul is unattached.
Such is the way, O Nanak, of the Lord's servant. ||6||
One who, in his soul, loves the Will of God,
is said to be Jivan Mukta - liberated while yet alive.
As is joy, so is sorrow to him.
He is in eternal bliss, and is not separated from God.
As is gold, so is dust to him.
As is ambrosial nectar, so is bitter poison to him.
As is honor, so is dishonor.
As is the beggar, so is the king.
Whatever God ordains, that is his way.

275.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਓਹੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ; ਕਹੀਐ ਜੀਵਨ ਮੁਕਤਿ ॥੭॥
275.e: O Nanak, that being is known as Jivan Mukta. ||7||
Many millions are Siddhas, celibates and Yogis.
Many millions are kings, enjoying worldly pleasures.
Many millions of birds and snakes have been created.
Many millions of stones and trees have been produced.
Many millions are the winds, waters and fires.
Many millions are the countries and realms of the world.
Many millions are the moons, suns and stars.
Many millions become self-centered.
Many millions are blinded by ignorance.
Many millions are stone-hearted misers.
Many millions are heartless, with dry, withered souls.

275.g: ਕਈ ਕੋਟਿ; ਪਰ ਦਰਬ ਕਉ ਹਿਰਹਿ ॥
275.e: Many millions steal the wealth of others.
Many millions slander others.
Many millions struggle in Maya.
Many millions wander in foreign lands.

275.g: ਜਿਤੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਲਾਵਹੁ; ਤਿਤੁ ਤਿਤੁ ਲਗਨਾ ॥
275.e: Whatever God attaches them to - with that they are engaged.

275.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਕਰਤੇ ਕੀ; ਜਾਨੈ ਕਰਤਾ ਰਚਨਾ ॥੨॥
275.e: O Nanak, the Creator alone knows the workings of His creation. ||2||
Now begins the description about the Exile of Sita :
It happened then like this and on this side Ram said to Sita with love:

275.g: ਰਚੇ ਏਕ ਬਾਗੰ ਅਭਿਰਾਮੰ ਸੁ ਸੋਭੰ ॥
ਲਖੇ ਨੰਦਨੰ ਜਉਨ ਕੀ ਕ੍ਰਾਤ ਛੋਭੰ ॥੭੧੭॥
275.e: “A forest may be created, seeing which the brightness of Nandan forest (of heaven) be dimmed.”717.

275.g: ਸੁਨੀ ਏਮ ਬਾਨੀ ਸੀਆ ਧਰਮ ਧਾਮੰ ॥

275.e: Listening to the orders of Ram, the abode of Dharma, a very beautiful garden was created

275.g: ਲਖੇ ਇੰਦ੍ਰ ਪਥੰ ਲਜੇ ਸ੍ਰੋਭ ਵੰਤੰ ॥੭੧੮॥
275.e: That garden looked like one bedecked with gems and diamonds and before which the forest of Indra felt shy.718.

275.g: ਸਭੈ ਦੇਵ ਦੇਵੰ ਦੁਤੀ ਸੁਰਗ ਜਾਨੰ ॥
275.e: It was thus decorated with jewels, wreaths and diamonds that all the gods had considered it as a second heaven.

275.g: ਗਏ ਰਾਮ ਤਾ ਮੋ ਸੀਆ ਸੰਗ ਲੀਨੇ ॥
ਕਿਤੀ ਕੋਟ ਸੁੰਦਰੀ ਸਭੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਕੀਨੇ ॥੭੧੯॥
275.e: Ram Chander went to abide there with Sita and many beautiful women.719.

275.g: ਰਚਯੋ ਏਕ ਮੰਦ੍ਰੰ ਮਹਾ ਸੁਭ੍ਰ ਠਾਮੰ ॥
ਕਰਯੋ ਰਾਮ ਸੈਨੰ ਤਹਾ ਧਰਮ ਧਾਮੰ ॥
275.e: A beautiful palace was built there where Ram, the abode of Dharma,

275.g: ਕਰੀ ਕੇਲ ਖੇਲੰ ਸੁ ਬੇਲੰ ਸੁ ਭੋਗੰ ॥
ਹੁਤੋ ਜਉਨ ਕਾਲੰ ਸਮੈ ਜੈਸ ਜੋਗੰ ॥੭੨੦॥
275.e: Used to sleep and enjoyed at different times in various ways.720.

275.g: ਰਹਯੋ ਸੀਅ ਗਰਭੰ ਸੁਨਯੋ ਸਰਬ ਬਾਮੰ ॥
ਕਹੇ ਏਮ ਸੀਤਾ ਪੁਨਰ ਬੈਨ ਰਾਮੰ ॥
275.e: After sometimes all the women heard that Sita was pregnant, then Sita said to Ram :

275.g: ਫਿਰਯੋ ਬਾਗ ਬਾਗੰ ਬਿਦਾ ਨਾਥ ਦੀਜੈ ॥
ਸੁਨੋ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਪਿਆਰੇ, ਇਹੈ ਕਾਜ ਕੀਜੈ ॥੭੨੧॥
275.e: “I have wandered enough in this forest, O my lord, bid me farewell.721.

275.g: ਦਈ ਜਾਨਕੀ ਸੰਗ ਤਾ ਕੇ ਸੁਧਾਰੰ ॥
275.e: Ram sent Sita alongwith Lakshman

275.g: ਤਹਾ ਸੀਅ ਕੋ ਛੋਰ ਆਇਯੋ ਉਤਾਲੰ ॥੭੨੨॥
275.e: Lakshman left her in the Vihar forest, where there were lawful trees of saal and tamaal.722.

275.g: ਬਨੰ ਨਿਰਜਨੰ ਦੇਖ ਕੈ ਕੈ ਅਪਾਰੰ ॥

275.e: Finding herself in a desolate forest, Sita understood that Ram had exiled her

275.g: ਰਣੰ ਜੇਮ ਵੀਰੰ ਲਗੇ ਮਰਮ ਬਾਨੰ ॥੭੨੩॥
275.e: There she began to weep in a fatal sound in a loud voice like a warrior being shot by an arrow on the secret parts.723.

275.g: ਚਲਯੋ ਕਉਕ ਚਿਤੰ ਤਜੀ ਮੋਨ ਧਾਨੀ ॥
275.e: The sage Valmiki heard this voice and forsaking his silence and shouting in wonder went towards Sita

275.g: ਸੀਆ ਸੰਗਿ ਲੀਨੇ ਗਯੋ ਧਾਮ ਆਪੰ ॥
ਮਨੋ ਬਚ ਕਰਮੰ ਦੁਰਗਾ ਜਾਪ ਜਾਪੰ ॥੭੨੪॥
275.e: He returned to his home alongwith Sita repeating the name of Sruga with mind, speech and action.724.
Ashtapadee:
Many millions are His devotees.
Many millions perform religious rituals and worldly duties.
Many millions become dwellers at sacred shrines of pilgrimage.
Many millions wander as renunciates in the wilderness.
Many millions listen to the Vedas.
Many millions become austere penitents.
Many millions enshrine meditation within their souls.
Many millions of poets contemplate Him through poetry.
Many millions meditate on His eternally new Naam.

275.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰਤੇ ਕਾ; ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਵਹਿ ॥੧॥
275.e: O Nanak, none can find the limits of the Creator. ||1||
Salok:

275.g: ਉਸਤਤਿ ਕਰਹਿ. ਅਨੇਕ ਜਨ; ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰ ॥
275.e: Many people praise the Lord. He has no end or limitation.

275.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਰਚਨਾ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਰਚੀ; ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਅਨਿਕ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਰ ॥੧॥
275.e: O Nanak, God created the creation, with its many ways and various species. ||1||

276.g: ਕਈ ਕੋਟਿ. ਦੇਵ ਦਾਨਵ; ਇੰਦ੍ਰ ਸਿਰਿ ਛਤ੍ਰ ॥
276.e: Many millions are the demi-gods, demons and Indras, under their regal canopies.
He has strung the entire creation upon His thread.

276.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਜਿਸੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ; ਤਿਸੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੈ ॥੩॥
276.e: O Nanak, He emancipates those with whom He is pleased. ||3||
Many millions become Bairaagees, who renounce the world.

276.g: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਸੰਗਿ; ਤਿਨਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
276.e: They have attached themselves to the Lord's Name.
Many millions are searching for God.
Within their souls, they find the Supreme Lord God.
Many millions thirst for the Blessing of God's Darshan.
They meet with God, the Eternal.
Many millions pray for the Society of the Saints.
They are imbued with the Love of the Supreme Lord God.
Those with whom He Himself is pleased,

276.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਤੇ ਜਨ; ਸਦਾ ਧਨਿ ਧੰਨਿ ॥੬॥
276.e: O Nanak, are blessed, forever blessed. ||6||
Many millions are the fields of creation and the galaxies.
Many millions are the etheric skies and the solar systems.
Many millions are the divine incarnations.
In so many ways, He has unfolded Himself.
So many times, He has expanded His expansion.
Forever and ever, He is the One, the One Universal Creator.
Many millions are created in various forms.

276.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇ ਹੋਏ; ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਤਿ ॥
276.e: From God they emanate, and into God they merge once again.

276.g: ਤਾ ਕਾ ਅੰਤੁ; ਨ ਜਾਨੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
276.e: His limits are not known to anyone.
Of Himself, and by Himself, O Nanak, God exists. ||7||
Salok:

276.g: ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ; ਦੂਸਰ. ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋਇ ॥
276.e: God alone is the Doer of deeds - there is no other at all.

276.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਤਿਸੁ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਣੈ; ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥
276.e: O Nanak, I am a sacrifice to the One, who pervades the waters, the lands, the sky and all space. ||1||
Many millions abide in heated activity, slothful darkness and peaceful light.

276.g: ਕਈ ਕੋਟਿ. ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਨ; ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਅਰੁ ਸਾਸਤ ॥
276.e: Many millions are the Vedas, Puraanas, Simritees and Shaastras.
Many millions are the pearls of the oceans.
Many millions are the beings of so many descriptions.
Many millions are made long-lived.

276.g: ਕਈ ਕੋਟਿ; ਗਿਰੀ ਮੇਰ ਸੁਵਰਨ ਥੀਵੇ ॥
276.e: Many millions of hills and mountains have been made of gold.
Many millions are the Yakhshas - the servants of the god of wealth, the Kinnars - the gods of celestial music, and the evil spirits of the Pisaach.

276.g: ਕਈ ਕੋਟਿ; ਭੂਤ ਪ੍ਰੇਤ ਸੂਕਰ ਮ੍ਰਿਗਾਚ ॥
276.e: Many millions are the evil nature-spirits, ghosts, pigs and tigers.

276.g: ਸਭ ਤੇ ਨੇਰੈ; ਸਭਹੂ ਤੇ ਦੂਰਿ ॥
276.e: He is near to all, and yet far from all;
O Nanak, He Himself remains distinct, while yet pervading all. ||4||

276.g: ਭਯੋ ਏਕ ਪੁਤ੍ਰੰ ਤਹਾ ਜਾਨਕੀ ਤੈ ॥
ਮਨੋ ਰਾਮ ਕੀਨੋ ਦੁਤੀ ਰਾਮ ਤੇ ਲੈ ॥
276.e: Sita bore a son there who was just a replica of Ram

276.g: ਵਹੈ ਚਾਰ ਚਿਹਨੰ ਵਹੈ ਉਗ੍ਰ ਤੇਜੰ ॥
ਮਨੋ ਅਪ ਅੰਸੰ ਦੁਤੀ ਕਾਢਿ ਭੇਜੰ ॥੭੨੫॥
276.e: He had the same colour, mask and splendour and it seemed that Ram had taken out his part and given to him.725.

276.g: ਦੀਯੋ ਏਕ ਪਾਲੰ ਸੁ ਬਾਲੰ ਰਿਖੀਸੰ ॥
ਲਸੈ ਚੰਦ੍ਰ ਰੂਪੰ ਕਿਧੋ ਦਯੋਸ ਈਸੰ ॥
276.e: The great sage brought up that boy who was moonlike and lookede like the sun during the day.

276.g: ਲਯੋ ਬਾਲ ਸੰਗੰ ਗਈ ਸੀਅ ਨਾਨੰ ॥੭੨੬॥
276.e: One day the sage went for Sandhya-worship and Sita taking the boy with her went to take a bath.726.

276.g: ਰਹੀ ਜਾਤ ਸੀਤਾ ਮਹਾ ਮੋਨ ਜਾਗੇ ॥
ਬਿਨਾ ਬਾਲ ਪਾਲੰ ਲਖਯੋ ਸੋਕੁ ਪਾਗੇ ॥
276.e: When the sage came out of his contemplation after the departure of Sita, he became anxious on not seeing the boy

276.g: ਕੁਸਾ ਹਾਥ ਲੈ ਕੈ ਰਚਯੋ ਏਕ ਬਾਲੰ ॥

276.e: He created another boy quickly of the same colour and form like the first boy out of the Kusha grass held by him in his hand.727.

276.g: ਫਿਰੀ ਨਾਇ ਸੀਤਾ ਕਹਾ ਆਨ ਦੇਖਯੋ ॥

276.e: When Sita came back, she saw another boy of the same form seated there  Sita said :

276.g: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਮੋਨ ਰਾਜੰ ਘਨੀ ਜਾਨ ਕੀਨੋ ॥
ਦੁਤੀ ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਤਾ ਤੇ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਜਾਨ ਦੀਨੋ ॥੭੨੮॥
276.e: “O great sage, you had been highly graceful towards me and given me she gift of two sons gracefully.”728.

276.g: ਇਤਿ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਬਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਨਾਟਕੇ ਰਾਮਵਤਾਰ ਦੁਇ ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਉਤਪੰਨੇ ਧਯਾਇ ਧਯਾਇ ਸਮਾਪਤੰ ॥੨੧॥
276.e: End of the chapter entitled ‘The Birth of two Sons’ in Ramavtar in BACHITTAR NATAK.21.
BHUJANG PRAYAAT STANZA

276.g: ਉਤੈ ਬਾਲ ਪਾਲੈ ਇਤੈ ਅਉਧ ਰਾਜੰ ॥
ਬੁਲੇ ਬਿਪ ਜਗਯੰ ਤਜਯੋ ਏਕ ਬਾਜੰ ॥
276.e: On that side the boys were brought up and on this side Ram, the king of Avadh called the Brahmins and performed a Yajna

276.g: ਰਿਪੰ ਨਾਸ ਹੰਤਾ ਦਯੋ ਸੰਗ ਤਾ ਕੈ ॥
ਬਡੀ ਫਉਜ ਲੀਨੇ ਚਲਯੋ ਸੰਗ ਵਾ ਕੈ ॥੭੨੯॥
276.e: And for this purpose he let off a horse, Shatrughan went with that horse with a huge army.729.

276.g: ਕਿਨੀ ਨਾਹਿ ਬਾਧਯੋ ਮਿਲੇ ਆਨ ਰਾਜੰ ॥
276.e: That horse reached in the territories of various kings, but none of them tied it

276.g: ਮਹਾ ਉਗ੍ਰ ਧਨਿਯਾ ਬਡੀ ਫਉਜ ਲੈ ਕੈ ॥
ਪਰੇ ਆਨ ਪਾਯੰ ਬਡੀ ਭੇਟ ਦੈ ਕੈ ॥੭੩੦॥
276.e: The great kings alongwith their great forces fell at the feet of Shatrughan with presence.730.

276.g: ਦਿਸਾ ਚਾਰ ਜੀਤੀ ਫਿਰਯੋ ਫੇਰਿ ਬਾਜੀ ॥

276.e: Wandering in the four direction the horse also reached the hermitage of the sage Valmiki

276.g: ਜਬੈ ਭਾਲ ਪਤ੍ਰੰ ਲਵੰ ਛੋਰ ਬਾਚਯੋ ॥

276.e: Where Lava and his companions read the letter written on the head of the horse, they in great fury looked like Rudra.731.

276.g: ਬ੍ਰਿਛੰ ਬਾਜ ਬਾਧਯੋ ਲਖਯੋ ਸਸਤ੍ਰ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
ਬਡੋ ਨਾਦ ਕੈ ਸਰਬ ਸੈਨਾ ਪੁਕਾਰੀ ॥
276.e: They tied the horse with a tree and the whole army of Shatrughan saw it, the warriors of the army shouted :

276.g: ਕਹਾ ਜਾਤ ਰੇ ਬਾਲ, ਲੀਨੇ ਤੁਰੰਗੰ ॥
ਤਜੋ, ਨਾਹਿ ਯਾ ਕੋ ਸਜੋ ਆਨ ਜੰਗੰ ॥੭੩੨॥
276.e: “O boy! where are you taking this horse? Either leave it or wage a war with us. “732.

276.g: ਸੁਣਯੋ ਨਾਮ ਜੁਧੰ ਜਬੈ ਸ੍ਰਉਣ ਸੂਰੰ ॥
ਮਹਾ ਸਸਤ੍ਰ ਸਉਡੀ ਮਹਾ ਲੋਹ ਪੂਰੰ ॥
276.e: When those weapon-wielders heard the name of war, they showered arrows extensively

276.g: ਹਠੇ ਬੀਰ ਹਾਠੈ ਸਭੈ ਸਸਤ੍ਰ ਲੈ ਕੈ ॥
ਪਰਯੋ ਮਧਿ ਸੈਣੰ ਬਡੋ ਨਾਦਿ ਕੈ ਕੈ ॥੭੩੩॥
276.e: All the warriors began to fight with persistence, holding their weapons, and here Lava jumped into the army raising a frightening thundering sound.733.

276.g: ਭਲੀ ਭਾਤ ਮਾਰੈ ਪਚਾਰੇ ਸੁ ਸੂਰੰ ॥
ਗਿਰੇ ਜੁਧ ਜੋਧਾ ਰਹੀ ਧੂਰ ਪੂਰੰ ॥
276.e: Many warriors were killed, they fell down on the earth and the dust arose on all the four sides

276.g: ਭ੍ਰਮੇ ਰੁੰਡ ਮੁੰਡ ਤਨੰ ਤਛ ਤੀਰੰ ॥੭੩੪॥
276.e: The warriors began to shower blows of their weapons and the trunks and heads of the warriors began to fly hither and thither.734.

276.g: ਗਿਰੇ ਲੁਥ ਪਥੰ ਸੁ ਜੁਥਤ ਬਾਜੀ ॥
ਭ੍ਰਮੈ ਛੂਛ ਹਾਥੀ ਬਿਨਾ ਸੁਆਰ ਤਾਜੀ ॥
276.e: The path was filled with the corpses of the horses and the elephants,

276.g: ਹਸੇ ਭੂਤ ਪ੍ਰੇਤੰ ਭ੍ਰਮੀ ਗੈਣ ਹੂਰੰ ॥੭੩੫॥
276.e: And horses began to run without drivers, the warriors fell being deprived of weapons and the ghosts, fiends and the heavenly damsels began to wander smilingly.735.
Many millions inhabit the nether regions.
Many millions dwell in heaven and hell.
Many millions are born, live and die.
Many millions are reincarnated, over and over again.
Many millions eat while sitting at ease.
Many millions are exhausted by their labors.
Many millions are created wealthy.
Many millions are anxiously involved in Maya.

276.g: ਜਹ ਜਹ ਭਾਣਾ; ਤਹ ਤਹ ਰਾਖੇ ॥
276.e: Wherever He wills, there He keeps us.

276.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ; ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਹਾਥੇ ॥੫॥
276.e: O Nanak, everything is in the Hands of God. ||5||
Ashtapadee:
The Doer, the Cause of causes, is potent to do anything.
That which pleases Him, comes to pass.
In an instant, He creates and destroys.
Many millions are the servants of the Supreme Lord God.
Their souls are enlightened.
Many millions know the essence of reality.
Their eyes gaze forever on the One alone.
Many millions drink in the essence of the Naam.

276.g: ਅਮਰ ਭਏ; ਸਦ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਜੀਵਹਿ ॥
276.e: They become immortal; they live forever and ever.
Many millions sing the Glorious Praises of the Naam.
They are absorbed in intuitive peace and pleasure.

276.g: ਅਪੁਨੇ ਜਨ ਕਉ; ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਮਾਰੇ ॥
276.e: He remembers His servants with each and every breath.
O Nanak, they are the beloveds of the Transcendent Lord God. ||8||10||

277.g: ਕਹੁ ਮਾਨੁਖ ਤੇ; ਕਿਆ ਹੋਇ ਆਵੈ ॥
277.e: Tell me - what can a mere mortal do?
Whatever pleases God is what He causes us to do.

277.g: ਇਸ ਕੈ ਹਾਥਿ ਹੋਇ; ਤਾ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਲੇਇ ॥
277.e: If it were in our hands, we would grab up everything.
Whatever pleases God - that is what He does.
Through ignorance, people are engrossed in corruption.
If they knew better, they would save themselves.
Deluded by doubt, they wander around in the ten directions.

277.g: ਨਿਮਖ ਮਾਹਿ; ਚਾਰਿ ਕੁੰਟ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਵੈ ॥
277.e: In an instant, their minds go around the four corners of the world and come back again.

277.g: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ; ਜਿਸੁ ਅਪਨੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਦੇਇ ॥
277.e: Those whom the Lord mercifully blesses with His devotional worship
- O Nanak, they are absorbed into the Naam. ||3||
Sometimes, they dance in various ways.
Sometimes, they remain asleep day and night.
Sometimes, they are awesome, in terrible rage.
Sometimes, they are the dust of the feet of all.
Sometimes, they sit as great kings.
Sometimes, they wear the coat of a lowly beggar.
Sometimes, they come to have evil reputations.
Sometimes, they are known as very, very good.

277.g: ਜਿਉ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਰਾਖੈ; ਤਿਵ ਹੀ ਰਹੈ ॥
277.e: As God keeps them, so they remain.
By Guru's Grace, O Nanak, the Truth is told. ||6||

277.g: ਇਸ ਕਾ ਬਲੁ; ਨਾਹੀ ਇਸੁ ਹਾਥ ॥
277.e: There is no power in the hands of mortal beings;
the Doer, the Cause of causes is the Lord of all.
The helpless beings are subject to His Command.

277.g: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ; ਸੋਈ ਫੁਨਿ ਥੀਉ ॥
277.e: That which pleases Him, ultimately comes to pass.
Sometimes, they abide in exaltation; sometimes, they are depressed.
Sometimes, they are sad, and sometimes they laugh with joy and delight.
Sometimes, they are occupied with slander and anxiety.
Sometimes, they are high in the Akaashic Ethers, sometimes in the nether regions of the underworld.
Sometimes, they know the contemplation of God.
O Nanak, God Himself unites them with Himself. ||5||
If it pleases God, one attains salvation.
If it pleases God, then even stones can swim.

277.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵੈ; ਬਿਨੁ ਸਾਸ ਤੇ ਰਾਖੈ ॥
277.e: If it pleases God, the body is preserved, even without the breath of life.

277.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵੈ; ਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਭਾਖੈ ॥
277.e: If it pleases God, then one chants the Lord's Glorious Praises.
If it pleases God, then even sinners are saved.
He Himself acts, and He Himself contemplates.
He Himself is the Master of both worlds.
He plays and He enjoys; He is the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts.
As He wills, He causes actions to be done.
Nanak sees no other than Him. ||2||

277.g: ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ; ਨੀਚ ਕੀਟ ਕਉ ਰਾਜ ॥
277.e: In an instant, the lowly worm is transformed into a king.
The Supreme Lord God is the Protector of the humble.

277.g: ਜਾ ਕਾ; ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਕਛੂ. ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
277.e: Even one who has never been seen at all,
becomes instantly famous in the ten directions.
And that one upon whom He bestows His blessings

277.g: ਤਾ ਕਾ ਲੇਖਾ; ਨ ਗਨੈ. ਜਗਦੀਸ ॥
277.e: the Lord of the world does not hold him to his account.

277.g: ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ; ਸਭ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
277.e: Soul and body are all His property.
Each and every heart is illuminated by the Perfect Lord God.
He Himself fashioned His own handiwork.
Nanak lives by beholding His greatness. ||4||

277.g: ਖਹੇ ਵੀਰ ਧੀਰੰ ਉਠੀ ਸਸਤ੍ਰ ਝਾਰੰ ॥
277.e: The trumpets resounded violently, the warriors began to fight and the blows of weapons were showered
The arrows were discharged creating wondrous type of paintings and the mighty warriors moved in the battlefield being highly infuriated.736.
CHAACHARI STANZA
The sword arose, seemed, danced and was struck.737.
An illusion was created  the sword was shown again and the blow was struck tremblingly.738.
Blows were struck with various.739.
The swords were drawn, the warriors challenged and the blows wre struck with spears.740.
The warriors were raised, caused to fall and run and shown the way . 741.
He has no end or limitation.
By His Order, He established the earth, and He maintains it unsupported.
By His Order, the world was created; by His Order, it shall merge again into Him.
By His Order, one's occupation is high or low.
By His Order, there are so many colors and forms.
Having created the Creation, He beholds His own greatness.
O Nanak, He is pervading in all. ||1||
Sometimes, as scholars, they deliver lectures.
Sometimes, they hold to silence in deep meditation.
Sometimes, they take cleansing baths at places of pilgrimage.
Sometimes, as Siddhas or seekers, they impart spiritual wisdom.

277.g: ਕਬਹੂ; ਕੀਟ ਹਸਤਿ ਪਤੰਗ ਹੋਇ ਜੀਆ ॥
277.e: Sometimes, they becomes worms, elephants, or moths.
They may wander and roam through countless incarnations.

278.e: DOHRA

278.g: ਹਮ ਨਹੀ ਤਯਾਗਤ ਬਾਜ ਬਰ; ਸੁਣਿ ਲਛਮਨਾ ਕੁਮਾਰ ॥
ਅਪਨੋ ਭਰ ਬਲ ਜੁਧ ਕਰ ਅਬ ਹੀ ਸੰਕ ਬਿਸਾਰ ॥੭੫੧॥
278.e: The boys said, “O Lakshman! we shall not unfasten the horse, abandoning all your doubts you come forward to fight with all your might.”751.

278.g: ਸਹਸ ਖਟੇ; ਲਖ ਕਉ ਉਠਿ ਧਾਵੈ ॥
278.e: Earning a thousand, he runs after a hundred thousand.
Ashtapadee:
One who has the pride of power within,
shall dwell in hell, and become a dog.
One who deems himself to have the beauty of youth,
shall become a maggot in manure.
One who claims to act virtuously,
shall live and die, wandering through countless reincarnations.

278.g: ਧਨ ਭੂਮਿ ਕਾ; ਜੋ ਕਰੈ ਗੁਮਾਨੁ ॥
278.e: One who takes pride in wealth and lands
is a fool, blind and ignorant.

278.g: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ; ਜਿਸ ਕੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ. ਗਰੀਬੀ ਬਸਾਵੈ ॥
278.e: One whose heart is mercifully blessed with abiding humility,

278.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਈਹਾ ਮੁਕਤੁ; ਆਗੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
278.e: O Nanak, is liberated here, and obtains peace hereafter. ||1||
If someone does millions of good deeds, while acting in ego,
he shall incur only trouble; all this is in vain.
If someone performs great penance, while acting in selfishness and conceit,
he shall be reincarnated into heaven and hell, over and over again.

278.g: ਅਨਿਕ ਜਤਨ ਕਰਿ; ਆਤਮ ਨਹੀ ਦ੍ਰਵੈ ॥
278.e: He makes all sorts of efforts, but his soul is still not softened
how can he go to the Court of the Lord?
One who calls himself good
goodness shall not draw near him.

278.g: ਸਰਬ ਕੀ ਰੇਨ; ਜਾ ਕਾ ਮਨੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
278.e: One whose mind is the dust of all

278.g: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ; ਤਾ ਕੀ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਸੋਇ ॥੩॥
278.e: - says Nanak, his reputation is spotlessly pure. ||3||
Salok:

278.g: ਸੁਖੀ ਬਸੈ ਮਸਕੀਨੀਆ; ਆਪੁ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ਤਲੇ ॥
278.e: The humble beings abide in peace; subduing egotism, they are meek.

278.g: ਬਡੇ ਬਡੇ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੀਆ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਗਰਬਿ ਗਲੇ ॥੧॥
278.e: The very proud and arrogant persons, O Nanak, are consumed by their own pride. ||1||
ANKA STANZA
When the arrows struck, then all ran away  the generals were killed and the warriors ran hither and thither.743.
Leaving their horses, they ran towards Ram and lamenting in various ways, they had no courage to come face to face.744.
(The soldiers said to Ram :) “Lava, killing the enemies, has defeated your army
Those two boys are fearlessly waging the war and have gained victory,”745.
Ram asked Lakshman to take a huge army and sent him
He said to him, “Do not kill those boys, but catch hold of them and show them to me.”746.
Hearing the words of Raghuvir, Lakshman started, decorating his forces and sharing the waters and the planes.747.
The sky was filled with dust because of the movement of army, all the soldiers rushed forth from all the four directions and began to remember the name of the Lord.748.
The staggering soldiers began to shower arrows, the banners waved and the arms fought with one another.749.
Coming near smilingly they shouted loudly, “O boys! forsake your persistence quickly.”750.

278.g: ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਜਾਨੈ; ਮੁਝ ਤੇ ਕਛੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
278.e: As long as someone thinks that he is the one who acts,

278.g: ਤਬ ਇਸ ਕਉ; ਸੁਖੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋਇ ॥
278.e: he shall have no peace.

278.g: ਜਬ ਇਹ ਜਾਨੈ; ਮੈ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰਤਾ ॥
278.e: As long as this mortal thinks that he is the one who does things,

278.g: ਤਬ ਲਗੁ; ਗਰਭ ਜੋਨਿ ਮਹਿ ਫਿਰਤਾ ॥
278.e: he shall wander in reincarnation through the womb.
As long as he considers one an enemy, and another a friend,
his mind shall not come to rest.

278.g: ਜਬ ਲਗੁ; ਮੋਹ ਮਗਨ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਾਇ ॥
278.e: As long as he is intoxicated with attachment to Maya,

278.g: ਤਬ ਲਗੁ; ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ਦੇਇ ਸਜਾਇ ॥
278.e: the Righteous Judge shall punish him.
By God's Grace, his bonds are shattered;
by Guru's Grace, O Nanak, his ego is eliminated. ||4||
One who becomes wealthy and takes pride in it

278.g: ਤ੍ਰਿਣ ਸਮਾਨਿ; ਕਛੁ ਸੰਗਿ. ਨ ਜਾਵੈ ॥
278.e: not even a piece of straw shall go along with him.

278.g: ਬਹੁ ਲਸਕਰ ਮਾਨੁਖ ਊਪਰਿ; ਕਰੇ ਆਸ ॥
278.e: He may place his hopes on a large army of men,

278.g: ਪਲ ਭੀਤਰਿ; ਤਾ ਕਾ ਹੋਇ ਬਿਨਾਸ ॥
278.e: but he shall vanish in an instant.
One who deems himself to be the strongest of all,
in an instant, shall be reduced to ashes.
One who thinks of no one else except his own prideful self
the Righteous Judge of Dharma shall expose his disgrace.

278.g: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ; ਜਾ ਕਾ ਮਿਟੈ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ॥
278.e: One who, by Guru's Grace, eliminates his ego,
O Nanak, becomes acceptable in the Court of the Lord. ||2||
Sometimes, this being attains the Company of the Holy.

278.g: ਉਸੁ ਅਸਥਾਨ ਤੇ; ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
278.e: From that place, he does not have to come back again.
The light of spiritual wisdom dawns within.
That place does not perish.

278.g: ਮਨ ਤਨ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ; ਇਕ ਰੰਗਿ ॥
278.e: The mind and body are imbued with the Love of the Naam, the Name of the One Lord.
He dwells forever with the Supreme Lord God.

278.g: ਜਿਉ ਜਲ ਮਹਿ ਜਲੁ; ਆਇ ਖਟਾਨਾ ॥
278.e: As water comes to blend with water,
his light blends into the Light.
Reincarnation is ended, and eternal peace is found.
Nanak is forever a sacrifice to God. ||8||11||
The warriors were discharged, endured and the warriors were made fearful.742.

278.g: ਇਤਿ ਲਵ ਬਾਧਵੋ ਸਤ੍ਰੁਘਣ ਬਧਹਿ ਸਮਾਪਤ ॥

278.e: ANKA STANZA
Catching hold of his very huge bow Lakshman thundering like clouds, showered a volley of arrows.752.
In various costumes, like actors, they appear.
As it pleases God, they dance.
Whatever pleases Him, comes to pass.
O Nanak, there is no other at all. ||7||

279.e: Ashtapadee:
Slandering the Saints, one's life is cut short.

279.g: ਸੰਤ ਕੈ ਦੂਖਨਿ; ਜਮ ਤੇ ਨਹੀ ਛੁਟੈ ॥
279.e: Slandering the Saints, one shall not escape the Messenger of Death.

279.g: ਸੰਤ ਕੈ ਦੂਖਨਿ; ਸੁਖੁ ਸਭੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
279.e: Slandering the Saints, all happiness vanishes.

279.g: ਸੰਤ ਕੈ ਦੂਖਨਿ; ਨਰਕ ਮਹਿ ਪਾਇ ॥
279.e: Slandering the Saints, one falls into hell.

279.g: ਸੰਤ ਕੈ ਦੂਖਨਿ; ਮਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਮਲੀਨ ॥
279.e: Slandering the Saints, the intellect is polluted.

279.g: ਸੰਤ ਕੈ ਦੂਖਨਿ; ਸੋਭਾ ਤੇ ਹੀਨ ॥
279.e: Slandering the Saints, one's reputation is lost.

279.g: ਸੰਤ ਕੇ ਹਤੇ ਕਉ; ਰਖੈ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
279.e: One who is cursed by a Saint cannot be saved.

279.g: ਸੰਤ ਕੈ ਦੂਖਨਿ; ਥਾਨ ਭ੍ਰਸਟੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
279.e: Slandering the Saints, one's place is defiled.
But if the Compassionate Saint shows His Kindness,
O Nanak, in the Company of the Saints, the slanderer may still be saved. ||1||
Salok:

279.g: ਸੰਤ ਸਰਨਿ. ਜੋ ਜਨੁ ਪਰੈ; ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਉਧਰਨਹਾਰ ॥
279.e: One who seeks the Sanctuary of the Saints shall be saved.

279.g: ਸੰਤ ਕੀ ਨਿੰਦਾ. ਨਾਨਕਾ; ਬਹੁਰਿ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਅਵਤਾਰ ॥੧॥
279.e: One who slanders the Saints, O Nanak, shall be reincarnated over and over again. ||1||

279.g: ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ; ਮਾਇਆ ਪਾਛੈ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
279.e: Satisfaction is not obtained by chasing after Maya.
He may enjoy all sorts of corrupt pleasures,
but he is still not satisfied; he indulges again and again, wearing himself out, until he dies.
Without contentment, no one is satisfied.
Like the objects in a dream, all his efforts are in vain.
Through the love of the Naam, all peace is obtained.
Only a few obtain this, by great good fortune.
He Himself is Himself the Cause of causes.
Forever and ever, O Nanak, chant the Lord's Name. ||5||
The Doer, the Cause of causes, is the Creator Lord.
What deliberations are in the hands of mortal beings?
As God casts His Glance of Grace, they come to be.
God Himself, of Himself, is unto Himself.

279.g: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕੀਨੋ; ਸੁ ਅਪਨੈ ਰੰਗਿ ॥
279.e: Whatever He created, was by His Own Pleasure.

279.g: ਸਭ ਤੇ ਦੂਰਿ; ਸਭਹੂ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ॥
279.e: He is far from all, and yet with all.
He understands, He sees, and He passes judgment.
He Himself is the One, and He Himself is the many.

279.g: ਮਰੈ ਨ ਬਿਨਸੈ; ਆਵੈ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
279.e: He does not die or perish; He does not come or go.
O Nanak, He remains forever All-pervading. ||6||
APOORAB STANZA
The number of died is unaccountable, how many of them were killed and how many of them were defeated.762.
Feeling ashamed in their mind all ran away and absorbed in fear they went away, saving their lives.763.
He Himself instructs, and He Himself learns.
He Himself mingles with all.
He Himself created His own expanse.

279.g: ਸਭੁ ਕਛੁ ਉਸ ਕਾ; ਓਹੁ ਕਰਨੈਹਾਰੁ ॥
279.e: All things are His; He is the Creator.

279.g: ਉਸ ਤੇ ਭਿੰਨ; ਕਹਹੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
279.e: Without Him, what could be done?
In the spaces and interspaces, He is the One.
In His own play, He Himself is the Actor.
He produces His plays with infinite variety.

279.g: ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਆਪਿ; ਮਨ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
279.e: He Himself is in the mind, and the mind is in Him.
O Nanak, His worth cannot be estimated. ||7||
ANKA STANZA
“O boys! listen and do not wage the war, meet me while bringing the horse, because you have inadequate strength.755.
“Come after forsaking your persistence and do not confront me, have no fear, come and meet me.”756.
The boys did not agree because they were proud their strength, they caught hold of their bows and roared and did not retrace even two steps.757.
AJBA STANZA
Both the brother were absorbed in war and showering their arrows, they tested the strength of the soldiers.758.
The warriors fell in the battlefield being chopped into bits, and the limbs of the fighting soldiers were cut.759.
The pools of blood waved with the shower of arrows
Many enemies were killed and many were filled with fear.760.
The superb warriors began to fall in the battlefield while swinging
The wounds on the bodies were inflicted but still there was no dearth of zeal in them.761.
True, True, True is God, our Lord and Master.
By Guru's Grace, some speak of Him.
True, True, True is the Creator of all.
Out of millions, scarcely anyone knows Him.
Beautiful, Beautiful, Beautiful is Your Sublime Form.
You are Exquisitely Beautiful, Infinite and Incomparable.
Pure, Pure, Pure is the Word of Your Bani,
heard in each and every heart, spoken to the ears.
Holy, Holy, Holy and Sublimely Pure
- chant the Naam, O Nanak, with heart-felt love. ||8||12||

279.g: ਸੰਤ ਕੇ ਦੂਖਨ ਤੇ; ਮੁਖੁ ਭਵੈ ॥
279.e: Slandering the Saints, one becomes a wry-faced malcontent.

279.g: ਸੰਤਨ ਕੈ ਦੂਖਨਿ; ਕਾਗ ਜਿਉ ਲਵੈ ॥
279.e: Slandering the Saints, one croaks like a raven.

279.g: ਸੰਤਨ ਕੈ ਦੂਖਨਿ; ਸਰਪ ਜੋਨਿ ਪਾਇ ॥
279.e: Slandering the Saints, one is reincarnated as a snake.

279.g: ਸੰਤ ਕੈ ਦੂਖਨਿ; ਤ੍ਰਿਗਦ ਜੋਨਿ ਕਿਰਮਾਇ ॥
279.e: Slandering the Saints, one is reincarnated as a wiggling worm.

279.g: ਸੰਤਨ ਕੈ ਦੂਖਨਿ; ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਮਹਿ ਜਲੈ ॥
279.e: Slandering the Saints, one burns in the fire of desire.

279.g: ਸੰਤ ਕੈ ਦੂਖਨਿ; ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਛਲੈ ॥
279.e: Slandering the Saints, one tries to deceive everyone.

279.g: ਸੰਤ ਕੈ ਦੂਖਨਿ; ਤੇਜੁ ਸਭੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
279.e: Slandering the Saints, all one's influence vanishes.
Slandering the Saints, one becomes the lowest of the low.

279.g: ਸੰਤ ਦੋਖੀ ਕਾ; ਥਾਉ ਕੋ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
279.e: For the slanderer of the Saint, there is no place of rest.
From the other side the gods are seeing the war and the sound of “Bravo, Bravo” is being heard. On this side the arrows are being discharged and bits of flesh are being chopped.753.
The warriors are thundering, the drums are resounding, the arrows are being discharge, but still they are not retreating from the war-arena.754.
The speech of Lakshman addressed to the boys :

280.e: The slanderer of the Saint bewails like this
like a fish, out of water, writhing in agony.

280.g: ਸੰਤ ਕਾ ਦੋਖੀ ਭੂਖਾ; ਨਹੀ ਰਾਜੈ ॥
280.e: The slanderer of the Saint is hungry and is never satisfied,
as fire is not satisfied by fuel.
The slanderer of the Saint is left all alone,

280.g: ਜਿਉ ਬੂਆੜੁ ਤਿਲੁ; ਖੇਤ ਮਾਹਿ ਦੁਹੇਲਾ ॥
280.e: like the miserable barren sesame stalk abandoned in the field.

280.g: ਸੰਤ ਕਾ ਦੋਖੀ; ਧਰਮ ਤੇ ਰਹਤ ॥
280.e: The slanderer of the Saint is devoid of faith.

280.g: ਸੰਤ ਕਾ ਦੋਖੀ; ਸਦ ਮਿਥਿਆ ਕਹਤ ॥
280.e: The slanderer of the Saint constantly lies.

280.g: ਕਿਰਤੁ ਨਿੰਦਕ ਕਾ; ਧੁਰਿ ਹੀ ਪਇਆ ॥
280.e: The fate of the slanderer is pre-ordained from the very beginning of time.

280.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ; ਸੋਈ ਥਿਆ ॥੬॥
280.e: O Nanak, whatever pleases God's Will comes to pass. ||6||
Those who returned, were killed, many were wounded and many fled away.764.
The boys were victorious and the warriors were frightened, they being highly infuriated waged the war.765.
Both the brothers who were specialists in swordsmanship, in great fury were engrossed in great war.766.
They pulled their bows and discharged the armour and seeing these warriors absorbed in a terrible war, the clusters of forces fled away.767.
After getting their limbs chopped, the warriors fled away and the remaining ones fought in the war.768.
The army, being confounded, fled away, then Laksman retuned with composure.769.

280.g: ਸਭ ਘਟ ਤਿਸ ਕੇ; ਓਹੁ ਕਰਨੈਹਾਰੁ ॥
280.e: All hearts are His; He is the Creator.
Forever and ever, I bow to Him in reverence.

280.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਉਸਤਤਿ; ਕਰਹੁ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤਿ ॥
280.e: Praise God, day and night.
Meditate on Him with every breath and morsel of food.

280.g: ਸਭੁ ਕਛੁ ਵਰਤੈ; ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਕੀਆ ॥
280.e: Everything happens as He wills.
As He wills, so people become.
He Himself is the play, and He Himself is the actor.
Who else can speak or deliberate upon this?
The slanderer of the Saint is forever impure.

280.g: ਸੰਤ ਕਾ ਦੋਖੀ; ਕਿਸੈ ਕਾ ਨਹੀ ਮਿਤੁ ॥
280.e: The slanderer of the Saint is nobody's friend.

280.g: ਸੰਤ ਕੇ ਦੋਖੀ ਕਉ; ਡਾਨੁ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
280.e: The slanderer of the Saint shall be punished.

280.g: ਸੰਤ ਕੇ ਦੋਖੀ ਕਉ; ਸਭ ਤਿਆਗੈ ॥
280.e: The slanderer of the Saint is abandoned by all.
The slanderer of the Saint is totally egocentric.
The slanderer of the Saint is forever corrupt.
The slanderer of the Saint must endure birth and death.

280.g: ਸੰਤ ਕੀ ਦੂਖਨਾ; ਸੁਖ ਤੇ ਟਰੈ ॥
280.e: The slanderer of the Saint is devoid of peace.

280.g: ਸੰਤ ਕੇ ਦੋਖੀ ਕਉ; ਨਾਹੀ ਠਾਉ ॥
280.e: The slanderer of the Saint has no place of rest.

280.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਸੰਤ ਭਾਵੈ; ਤਾ ਲਏ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੪॥
280.e: O Nanak, if it pleases the Saint, then even such a one may merge in union. ||4||

280.g: ਸੰਤ ਕਾ ਦੋਖੀ; ਅਧ ਬੀਚ ਤੇ ਟੂਟੈ ॥
280.e: The slanderer of the Saint breaks down mid-way.

280.g: ਸੰਤ ਕਾ ਦੋਖੀ; ਕਿਤੈ ਕਾਜਿ. ਨ ਪਹੂਚੈ ॥
280.e: The slanderer of the Saint cannot accomplish his tasks.

280.g: ਸੰਤ ਕੇ ਦੋਖੀ ਕਉ; ਉਦਿਆਨ ਭ੍ਰਮਾਈਐ ॥
280.e: The slanderer of the Saint wanders in the wilderness.
The slanderer of the Saint is misled into desolation.

280.g: ਸੰਤ ਕਾ ਦੋਖੀ; ਅੰਤਰ ਤੇ ਥੋਥਾ ॥
280.e: The slanderer of the Saint is empty inside,

280.g: ਜਿਉ ਸਾਸ ਬਿਨਾ; ਮਿਰਤਕ ਕੀ ਲੋਥਾ ॥
280.e: like the corpse of a dead man, without the breath of life.

280.g: ਸੰਤ ਕੇ ਦੋਖੀ ਕੀ; ਜੜ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
280.e: The slanderer of the Saint has no heritage at all.
He himself must eat what he has planted.

280.g: ਸੰਤ ਕੇ ਦੋਖੀ ਕਉ; ਅਵਰੁ. ਨ ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰੁ ॥
280.e: The slanderer of the Saint cannot be saved by anyone else.

280.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਸੰਤ ਭਾਵੈ; ਤਾ ਲਏ ਉਬਾਰਿ ॥੫॥
280.e: O Nanak, if it pleases the Saint, then even he may be saved. ||5||

280.g: ਸੰਤ ਕਾ ਦੋਖੀ; ਬਿਗੜ ਰੂਪੁ ਹੋਇ ਜਾਇ ॥
280.e: The slanderer of the Saint becomes deformed.

280.g: ਸੰਤ ਕੇ ਦੋਖੀ ਕਉ; ਦਰਗਹ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਜਾਇ ॥
280.e: The slanderer of the Saint receives his punishment in the Court of the Lord.
The slanderer of the Saint is eternally in limbo.

280.g: ਸੰਤ ਕਾ ਦੋਖੀ; ਨ ਮਰੈ. ਨ ਜੀਵਾਈਐ ॥
280.e: He does not die, but he does not live either.

280.g: ਸੰਤ ਕੇ ਦੋਖੀ ਕੀ; ਪੁਜੈ ਨ ਆਸਾ ॥
280.e: The hopes of the slanderer of the Saint are not fulfilled.

280.g: ਸੰਤ ਕਾ ਦੋਖੀ; ਉਠਿ ਚਲੈ ਨਿਰਾਸਾ ॥
280.e: The slanderer of the Saint departs disappointed.

280.g: ਸੰਤ ਕੈ ਦੋਖਿ; ਨ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਟੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
280.e: Slandering the Saint, no one attains satisfaction.
As it pleases the Lord, so do people become;
no one can erase their past actions.
O Nanak, the True Lord alone knows all. ||7||

280.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਸੰਤ ਭਾਵੈ; ਤਾ ਓਇ ਭੀ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਹਿ ॥੨॥
280.e: O Nanak, if it pleases the Saint, even then, he may be saved. ||2||
The slanderer of the Saint is the worst evil-doer.

280.g: ਸੰਤ ਕਾ ਨਿੰਦਕੁ; ਖਿਨੁ. ਟਿਕਨੁ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
280.e: The slanderer of the Saint has not even a moment's rest.
The slanderer of the Saint is a brutal butcher.
The slanderer of the Saint is cursed by the Transcendent Lord.

280.g: ਸੰਤ ਕਾ ਨਿੰਦਕੁ; ਰਾਜ ਤੇ ਹੀਨੁ ॥
280.e: The slanderer of the Saint has no kingdom.

280.g: ਸੰਤ ਕਾ ਨਿੰਦਕੁ; ਦੁਖੀਆ ਅਰੁ ਦੀਨੁ ॥
280.e: The slanderer of the Saint becomes miserable and poor.

280.g: ਸੰਤ ਕੇ ਨਿੰਦਕ ਕਉ; ਸਰਬ ਰੋਗ ॥
280.e: The slanderer of the Saint contracts all diseases.

280.g: ਸੰਤ ਕੇ ਨਿੰਦਕ ਕਉ; ਸਦਾ ਬਿਜੋਗ ॥
280.e: The slanderer of the Saint is forever separated.

280.g: ਸੰਤ ਕੀ ਨਿੰਦਾ; ਦੋਖ ਮਹਿ ਦੋਖੁ ॥
280.e: To slander a Saint is the worst sin of sins.

280.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਸੰਤ ਭਾਵੈ; ਤਾ ਉਸ ਕਾ ਭੀ. ਹੋਇ ਮੋਖੁ ॥੩॥
280.e: O Nanak, if it pleases the Saint, then even this one may be liberated. ||3||

281.e: AKRAA STANZA
“O boys of the sages! forsake your pride, come and meet me
“I shall dress you and take you to (Raghava) Ram.”777.
Hearing these words the boys were filled with pride and being enraged they pulled their bows
They discharged many arrows like the clouds of the month of Sawan.778.
Those, whom those arrows struck, fell down and overturned
Somewhere those arrows chopped the limbs and somewhere they penetrated through the fly-whisk and armour.779.
Somewhere they created portraits on coming out of the beautiful bows and somewhere they pierced the limbs of the warriors
Somewhere the wound of the limbs burst open and somewhere the stream of blood overflowed.780.
Very fortunate are those humble beings in this world,

281.g: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ; ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਹਿ ॥
281.e: who sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, forever and ever.
Those who dwell upon the Lord's Name,
are the most wealthy and prosperous in the world.

281.g: ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਮੁਖਿ; ਬੋਲਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਮੁਖੀ ॥
281.e: Those who speak of the Supreme Lord in thought, word and deed
know that they are peaceful and happy, forever and ever.
One who recognizes the One and only Lord as One,

281.g: ਇਤ ਉਤ ਕੀ; ਓਹੁ ਸੋਝੀ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
281.e: understands this world and the next.

281.g: ਨਾਮ ਸੰਗਿ; ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥
281.e: One whose mind accepts the Company of the Naam,
the Name of the Lord, O Nanak, knows the Immaculate Lord. ||3||
Salok:

281.g: ਤਜਹੁ ਸਿਆਨਪ. ਸੁਰਿ ਜਨਹੁ; ਸਿਮਰਹੁ. ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇ ॥
281.e: Give up your cleverness, good people - remember the Lord God, your King!

281.g: ਏਕ ਆਸ ਹਰਿ. ਮਨਿ ਰਖਹੁ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਦੂਖੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
281.e: Enshrine in your heart, your hopes in the One Lord. O Nanak, your pain, doubt and fear shall depart. ||1||
Lava, stretching his bow, discharge and arrow toward the enemy, which struck Lakshman on the forehead and he fell like a tree.770.
End of the chapter entitled ‘Killing of Lakshman’ in Ramvtar in BACHITTAR NATAK.

281.g: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੈ; ਤਿਸੁ ਆਪਨ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਇ ॥
281.e: He Himself gives His Name to those, upon whom He bestows His Mercy.
Very fortunate, O Nanak, are those people. ||8||13||
AROOHAA STANZA

281.g: ਭਾਗ ਗਯੋ ਦਲ ਤ੍ਰਾਮ ਕੈ ਕੈ ॥

281.e: Making a sacrifice of Lakshman in the war, his army, being frightened fled away
Te warriors reached the place where Ram was standing.771.
When all the events were related to him, he was in great anguish
Hearing their word the mighty sovereign remained silent like a portrait, becoming like a stone-slab.772.
Then sitting down, he held consultations and addressing Bharat, he asked him to go, saying,
“Do not kill the boys of the sages, but bring them and show them to me.”773.
Bharat decorating his army marched to the place where the boys were standing ready (for war)
They were ready to kill the warriors by striking blows with many types of arrows.774.
Alongwith Sugriva, Vibhishan, Hanuman, Angad, Jambvant,
And with their various types of forces, Bharat went forward towards the brave boys.775.
When Bharat reached the battlefield, he saw both the boys of sages
Both boys looked impressive and both the gods and demons were allured on seeing them.776.
Speech of Bharat addressed to Lava :

281.g: ਜਿਸ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ; ਮਨਿ ਚਿਤਿ ਆਵੈ ॥
281.e: One who focuses his conscious mind on the Lord God
- that Saint is at peace; he does not waver.
Those unto whom God has granted His Grace

281.g: ਸੋ ਸੇਵਕੁ; ਕਹੁ ਕਿਸ ਤੇ ਡਰੈ ॥
281.e: who do those servants need to fear?
As God is, so does He appear;
in His Own creation, He Himself is pervading.
Searching, searching, searching, and finally, success!
By Guru's Grace, the essence of all reality is understood.

281.g: ਜਬ ਦੇਖਉ; ਤਬ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਮੂਲੁ ॥
281.e: Wherever I look, there I see Him, at the root of all things.
O Nanak, He is the subtle, and He is also the manifest. ||5||
Ashtapadee:

281.g: ਮਾਨੁਖ ਕੀ ਟੇਕ; ਬ੍ਰਿਥੀ ਸਭ ਜਾਨੁ ॥
281.e: Reliance on mortals is in vain - know this well.
The Great Giver is the One Lord God.
By His gifts, we are satisfied,
and we suffer from thirst no longer.
The One Lord Himself destroys and also preserves.
Nothing at all is in the hands of mortal beings.

281.g: ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਬੂਝਿ; ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
281.e: Understanding His Order, there is peace.

281.g: ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ; ਰਖੁ ਕੰਠਿ ਪਰੋਇ ॥
281.e: So take His Name, and wear it as your necklace.
Remember, remember, remember God in meditation.
O Nanak, no obstacle shall stand in your way. ||1||

281.g: ਨਹ ਕਿਛੁ ਜਨਮੈ; ਨਹ ਕਿਛੁ ਮਰੈ ॥
281.e: Nothing is born, and nothing dies.
He Himself stages His own drama.
Coming and going, seen and unseen,
all the world is obedient to His Will.
Praise the Formless Lord in your mind.
O my mind, make this your true occupation.
Let your tongue become pure, drinking in the Ambrosial Nectar.
Your soul shall be forever peaceful.
With your eyes, see the wondrous play of your Lord and Master.
In the Company of the Holy, all other associations vanish.
With your feet, walk in the Way of the Lord.
Sins are washed away, chanting the Lord's Name, even for a moment.

281.g: ਕਰ ਹਰਿ ਕਰਮ; ਸ੍ਰਵਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ॥
281.e: So do the Lord's Work, and listen to the Lord's Sermon.
In the Lord's Court, O Nanak, your face shall be radiant. ||2||
By Guru's Grace, one understands himself;
know that then, his thirst is quenched.
In the Company of the Holy, one chants the Praises of the Lord, Har, Har.

281.g: ਸਰਬ ਰੋਗ ਤੇ; ਓਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਨੁ ਰਹਤ ॥
281.e: Such a devotee of the Lord is free of all disease.
Night and day, sing the Kirtan, the Praises of the One Lord.
In the midst of your household, remain balanced and unattached.

281.g: ਏਕ ਊਪਰਿ; ਜਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਆਸਾ ॥
281.e: One who places his hopes in the One Lord

281.g: ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਕਟੀਐ; ਜਮ ਕੀ ਫਾਸਾ ॥
281.e: the noose of Death is cut away from his neck.
One whose mind hungers for the Supreme Lord God,
O Nanak, shall not suffer pain. ||4||

282.e: As a palace is supported by its pillars,

282.g: ਤਿਉ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ; ਮਨਹਿ ਅਸਥੰਮਨੁ ॥
282.e: so does the Guru's Word support the mind.
As a stone placed in a boat can cross over the river,
so is the mortal saved, grasping hold of the Guru's Feet.
As the darkness is illuminated by the lamp,

282.g: ਗੁਰ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਖਿ; ਮਨਿ ਹੋਇ ਬਿਗਾਸੁ ॥
282.e: so does the mind blossom forth, beholding the Blessed Vision of the Guru's Darshan.

282.g: ਜਿਉ ਮਹਾ ਉਦਿਆਨ ਮਹਿ; ਮਾਰਗੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
282.e: The path is found through the great wilderness by joining the Saadh Sangat,

282.g: ਤਿਉ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਿ; ਜੋਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਾਵੈ ॥
282.e: The Company of the Holy, and one's light shines forth.
I seek the dust of the feet of those Saints;
O Lord, fulfill Nanak's longing! ||3||
Somewhere the ghosts and fiends shouted and somewhere the headless trunks began to rise in the battlefield
Somewhere the brave Baitals danced and somewhere the Vampires raised flames of fire.781.
The garments of warriors were saturated with blood, on being wounded in the battlefield
On one side the warriors are running away and on the other side they are coming and fighting in the war.782.
On one side, the warriors are stretching their bows and discharging arrows
On the other side they are running away and brathing their last, but not getting a place in the heaven.783.
Many elephants and horses died and not even one was saved
Then Vibhishan, the Lord of Lanka, fought with the boys.784.
ANOOP NIRAAJ STANZA

282.g: ਸੁ ਕੋਪਿ ਦੇਖਿ ਕੈ ਬਲੰ ਸੁ ਕ੍ਰੁਧ ਰਾਘਵੀ ਸਿਸੰ ॥
ਬਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਚਿਤ੍ਰਤ ਸਰੰ ਬਬਰਖ ਬਰਖਣੋ ਰਣੰ ॥
282.e: Seeing the strength and rage of the boys (sons) of Ram and visualizing that volley of arrows in that wonderful type of war,

282.g: ਭਭਜਿ ਆਸੁਰੀ ਸੁਤੰ ਉਠੰਤ ਭੇਕਰੀ ਧੁਨੰ ॥
ਭ੍ਰਮੰਤ ਕੁੰਡਲੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਤੰ; ਪਪੀੜ ਦਾਰਣੰ ਸਰੰ ॥੭੮੯॥
282.e: The army of demons, raising terrible sound, fled away and wandered circularly.789.

282.g: ਘੁਮੰਤ ਘਾਇਲੋ ਘਣੰ ਤਤਛ ਬਾਣਣੋ ਬਰੰ ॥
ਭਭਜ ਕਾਤਰੋ ਕਿਤੰ ਗਜੰਤ ਜੋਧਣੋ ਜੁਧੰ ॥
282.e: Many wounded warriors after being shot by sharp arrows began to wander and many warriors began to wander and many warriors began to roar and many of them becoming helpless breathed their last

282.g: ਚਲੰਤ ਤੀਛਣੋ ਅਸੰ ਖਿਮੰਤ ਧਾਰ ਉਜਲੰ ॥
ਪਪਾਤ ਅੰਗਦ ਕੇਸਰੀ; ਹਨੂ ਵ ਸੁਗ੍ਰਿਵੰ ਬਲੰ ॥੭੯੦॥
282.e: The sharp sword of white edges were struck in the battlefield, the strength of Angad, Hanuman, Sugriva etc. began to wean away.790.

282.g: ਗਿਰੰਤ ਆਮੁਰੰ ਰਣੰ; ਭਭਰਮ ਆਸੁਰੀ ਸਿਸੰ ॥
ਤਜੰਤ ਸੁਆਮਣੋ ਘਰੰ; ਭਜੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਲੇ ਭਟੰ ॥
ਉਠੰਤ ਅੰਧ ਧੁੰਧਣੋ; ਕਬੰਧ ਬੰਧਤੰ ਕਟੰ ॥
ਲਗੰਤ ਬਾਣਾਣੋ ਬਰੰ; ਗਿਰੰਤ ਭੂਮਿ ਅਹਵਯੰ ॥੭੯੧॥
ਪਪਾਤ ਬ੍ਰਿਛਣੰ ਧਰੰ ਬਬੇਗ ਮਾਰ ਤੁਜਣੰ ॥
ਭਰੰਤ ਧੂਰ ਭੂਰਣੰ; ਬਮੰਤ ਸ੍ਰੋਣਤੰ ਮੁਖੰ ॥
282.e: The warriors being shot by arrows quickly began to fall on the earth, the dust clung to their bodies and the blood oozed out from their mouths
O foolish mind, why do you cry and bewail?
Ashtapadee:
The Lord of the World is the Mender of the broken.
He Himself cherishes all beings.

282.g: ਸਗਲ ਕੀ ਚਿੰਤਾ; ਜਿਸੁ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
282.e: The cares of all are on His Mind;
no one is turned away from Him.

282.g: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ; ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਪਿ ॥
282.e: O my mind, meditate forever on the Lord.
The Imperishable Lord God is Himself All-in-all.
By one's own actions, nothing is accomplished,
even though the mortal may wish it so, hundreds of times.

282.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ; ਨਾਹੀ ਤੇਰੈ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਾਮ ॥
282.e: Without Him, nothing is of any use to you.

282.g: ਗਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ; ਜਪਿ ਏਕ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ॥੧॥
282.e: Salvation, O Nanak, is attained by chanting the Name of the One Lord. ||1||

282.g: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰੈ; ਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਰੰਗਿ ॥
282.e: Whatever you do, do it for the Love of God.
Forever and ever, abide with the Lord.
By its own natural course, whatever will be will be.
Acknowledge that Creator Lord;

282.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਾ ਕੀਆ; ਜਨ ਮੀਠ ਲਗਾਨਾ ॥
282.e: God's doings are sweet to His humble servant.
As He is, so does He appear.

282.g: ਜਿਸ ਤੇ ਉਪਜੇ; ਤਿਸੁ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥
282.e: From Him we came, and into Him we shall merge again.

282.g: ਓਇ ਸੁਖ ਨਿਧਾਨ; ਉਨਹੂ ਬਨਿ ਆਏ ॥
282.e: He is the treasure of peace, and so does His servant become.
Unto His own, He has given His honor.
O Nanak, know that God and His humble servant are one and the same. ||8||14||
BAHORA STANZA

282.g: ਲੰਕੇਸ ਕੇ ਉਰ ਮੋ ਤਕ ਬਾਨ ॥

282.e: The sons of Ram pulling their bows shot an arrow in the heart of the king of Lanka

282.g: ਤਬ ਗਿਰਯੋ ਦਾਨਵ ਸੁ ਭੂਮਿ ਮਧ ॥
ਤਿਹ ਬਿਸੁਧ ਜਾਣ ਨਹੀ ਕੀਯੋ ਬਧ ॥੭੮੫॥
282.e: That demon fell down on the earth and considering him unconscious, the boys did not kill him.785.

282.g: ਕਹਾ ਜਾਤ ਬਾਲ ਨਹੀ ਪੈਸ ਜਾਨ ॥
282.e: Then Sugriva came and stopped there and said, “O boys! where are you going? You cannot get away and remain safe.”

282.g: ਤਬ ਹਣਯੋ ਬਾਣ ਤਿਹ ਭਾਲ ਤਕ ॥
ਤਿਹ ਲਗਯੋ ਭਾਲ ਮੋ ਰਹਯੋ ਚਕ ॥੭੮੬॥
282.e: Then the boys of the sage made a target of his forehead and shot his arrow which struck his forehead and feeling the sharpness of the arrow, he became actionless.786.

282.g: ਚਪ ਚਲੀ ਸੈਣ ਕਪਣੀ ਸੁ ਕ੍ਰੁਧ ॥
ਨਲ ਨੀਲ ਹਨੂ ਅੰਗਦ ਸੁ ਜੁਧ ॥
282.e: On seeing this the whole army was pressed and in great fury, they began to fight alongwith Nal, Neel, Hanuman and Angad

282.g: ਤਬ ਤੀਨ ਤੀਨ ਲੈ ਬਾਲ ਬਾਨ ॥
ਤਿਹ ਹਣੋ ਭਾਲ ਮੋ ਰੋਸ ਠਾਨ ॥੭੮੭॥
282.e: Then the boys took three arrows each and shot them on the foreheads of all.787.

282.g: ਜੋ ਗਏ ਸੂਰ ਸੋ ਰਹੇ ਖੇਤ ॥
ਜੋ ਬਚੇ ਭਾਜ ਤੇ ਹੁਇ ਅਚੇਤ ॥
282.e: Those who remained in the field, they embraced death an those who survived lost their senses and ran away

282.g: ਤਬ ਤਕਿ ਤਕਿ ਸਿਸ ਕਸਿ ਬਾਣ ॥

282.e: Then those boys tightly shot their arrows on their arrows on their targets and destroyed fearlessly the forces of Ram.788.
Those who know God are glorious.
The whole world is redeemed by their teachings.
God's servants redeem all.
God's servants cause sorrows to be forgotten.
The Merciful Lord unites them with Himself.

282.g: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਜਪਿ; ਭਏ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥
282.e: Chanting the Word of the Guru's Shabad, they become ecstatic.
He alone is committed to serve them,
upon whom God bestows His Mercy, by great good fortune.
Those who chant the Naam find their place of rest.

282.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਤਿਨ ਪੁਰਖ ਕਉ; ਊਤਮ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨੁ ॥੭॥
282.e: O Nanak, respect those persons as the most noble. ||7||
He Himself is All-in-Himself.
In His many ways, He establishes and disestablishes.
He is Imperishable; nothing can be broken.
He lends His Support to maintain the Universe.
Unfathomable and Inscrutable is the Glory of the Lord.
As He inspires us to meditate, O Nanak, so do we meditate. ||6||
Salok:

282.g: ਸਰਬ ਕਲਾ ਭਰਪੂਰ ਪ੍ਰਭ; ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਾਨਨਹਾਰ ॥
282.e: God is totally imbued with all powers; He is the Knower of our troubles.

282.g: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਉਧਰੀਐ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਤਿਸੁ ਬਲਿਹਾਰ ॥੧॥
282.e: Meditating in remembrance on Him, we are saved; Nanak is a sacrifice to Him. ||1||
One who is good-looking should not be vain;

282.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਜੋਤਿ; ਸਗਲ ਘਟ ਸੋਹੈ ॥
282.e: the Light of God is in all hearts.
Why should anyone be proud of being rich?

282.g: ਜਾ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ; ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਦੀਆ ਦਰਬੈ ॥
282.e: All riches are His gifts.
One may call himself a great hero,

282.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਕਲਾ ਬਿਨਾ; ਕਹ ਧਾਵੈ ॥
282.e: but without God's Power, what can anyone do?
One who brags about giving to charities
the Great Giver shall judge him to be a fool.

282.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ; ਤੂਟੈ ਹਉ ਰੋਗੁ ॥
282.e: One who, by Guru's Grace, is cured of the disease of ego
- O Nanak, that person is forever healthy. ||2||

283.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਵਖਰ ਕਉ; ਲੈਨਿ ਤੂ ਆਇਆ ॥
283.e: This merchandise, which you have come to obtain
- the Lord's Name is obtained in the home of the Saints.
Renounce your egotistical pride, and with your mind,
Purchase the Lord's Name - measure it out within your heart.
Load up this merchandise, and set out with the Saints.
Give up other corrupt entanglements.
"Blessed, blessed", everyone will call you,
and your face shall be radiant in the Court of the Lord.
In this trade, only a few are trading.
Nanak is forever a sacrifice to them. ||5||

283.g: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ; ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਪਰਤੀਤਿ ॥
283.e: One who has faith in the Guru in his mind

283.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਆਵੈ; ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਚੀਤਿ ॥
283.e: comes to dwell upon the Lord God.
He is acclaimed as a devotee, a humble devotee throughout the three worlds.
The One Lord is in his heart.

283.g: ਸਚੁ ਕਰਣੀ; ਸਚੁ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਰਹਤ ॥
283.e: True are his actions; true are his ways.
True is his heart; Truth is what he speaks with his mouth.
True is his vision; true is his form.
He distributes Truth and he spreads Truth.
One who recognizes the Supreme Lord God as True
- O Nanak, that humble being is absorbed into the True One. ||8||15||

283.g: ਚਿਕਾਰ ਚਾਵਡੀ ਨਭੰ; ਫਿਕੰਤ ਫਿੰਕਰੀ ਫਿਰੰ ॥
ਭਕਾਰ ਭੂਤ ਪ੍ਰੇਤਣੰ; ਡਿਕਾਰ ਡਾਕਣੀ ਡੁਲੰ ॥੭੯੨॥
283.e: The vultures shrieked and roamed circularly in the sky , the ghosts and fiends began to shout in the battlefield and the vampires roamed while belching. 792.

283.g: ਗਿਰੈ ਧਰੰ ਧੁਰੰ ਧਰੰ; ਧਰਾ ਧਰੰ ਧਰੰ ਜਿਵੰ ॥
ਭਭਜਿ ਸ੍ਰਉਣਤੰ ਤਣੈ ਉਠੰਤ ਭੈ ਕਰੀ ਧੁਨੰ ॥
283.e: The warriors, on whatever side of the earth they were, began to fal, the blood flowed from the bodies of the fleeing warriors and there were terrible shouts

283.g: ਉਠੰਤ ਗਦ ਸਦਣੰ ਨਨਦ ਨਿਫਿਰੰ ਰਣੰ ॥
ਬਬਰਖ ਸਾਇਕੰ ਸਿਤੰ; ਘੁਮੰਤ ਜੋਧਣੋ ਬ੍ਰਣੰ ॥੭੯੩॥
283.e: The resonance of fifes filled the battlefield and the clusters of warriors showering the arrows and being inflicted with wounds began to wander.793.

283.g: ਭਜੰਤ ਭੈ ਧਰੰ ਭਟੰ; ਬਿਲੋਕ ਭਰਥਣੋ ਰਣੰ ॥
ਚਲਯੋ ਚਿਰਾਇ ਕੈ ਚਪੀ; ਬਬਰਖ ਸਾਇਕੋ ਸਿਤੰ ॥
283.e: Seeing the war of Bharat, many warriors began to run away fearfully. On this side, in great fury, Bharat began to shower arrows.

283.g: ਸੁ ਕ੍ਰੁਧ ਸਾਇਕੰ ਸਿਸੰ ਬਬਧ ਭਾਲਣੋ ਭਟੰ ॥
ਪਪਾਤ ਪ੍ਰਿਥਵੀਯੰ ਹਠੀ; ਮਮੋਹ ਆਸ੍ਰ ਮੰਗਤੰ ॥੭੯੪॥
283.e: The sons of the sage in great ire showered a volley of arrows and caused Bharat to fall on the earth.794.

283.g: ਇਤਿ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਬਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਨਾਟਕੇ ਰਾਮਾਵਤਾਰੇ ਭਰਥ ਬਧਹਿ ਧਿਆਇ ਸਮਾਪਤੰ ॥

283.e: ANOOP NIRAAJ STANZA

283.g: ਭਭਜਿ ਭੀਤਣੋ ਭਟੰ ਤਤਜਿ ਭਰਥਣੋ ਭੂਅੰ ॥
ਗਿਰੰਤ ਲੁਥਤੰ ਉਠੰ ਰੁਰੋਦ ਰਾਘਵੰ ਤਟੰ ॥
283.e: The warriors fled leaving Bharat fallen on the earth and rising and falling over corpses they came to Ram.

283.g: ਜੁਝੇ ਸੁ ਭ੍ਰਾਤ ਭਰਥਣੋ; ਸੁਣੰਤ ਜਾਨਕੀ ਪਤੰ ॥
ਪਪਾਤ ਭੂਮਿਣੋ ਤਲੰ; ਅਪੀੜ ਪੀੜਤੰ ਦੁਖੰ ॥੭੯੫॥
283.e: When Ram came to Know of the death of Bharat, then highly anguished with sorrows he fell down of the earth.795.

283.g: ਸਸਜ ਜੋਧਣੰ ਜੁਧੀ ਸੁ ਕ੍ਰੁਧ ਬਧਣੋ ਬਰੰ ॥
ਤਤਜਿ ਜਗ ਮੰਡਲੰ ਅਦੰਡ ਦੰਡਣੋ ਨਰੰ ॥
283.e: Ram himself started for war in great fury after decorating his army of warriors in order to kill the brave fighters and punish the unpunished

283.g: ਸੁ ਗਜ ਬਜ ਬਾਜਣੋ ਉਠੰਤ ਭੈ ਧਰੀ ਸੁਰੰ ॥
ਸਨਧ ਬਧ ਖੈ ਦਲੰ ਸਬਧ ਜੋਧਣੋ ਬਰੰ ॥੭੯੬॥
283.e: Hearing the voices of the elephants and the horses, the gods also became fearful and in this army there were several heroes who could destroy the bedecked forces.796.

283.g: ਚਚਕ ਚਾਵਡੀ ਨਭੰ ਫਿਕੰਤ ਫਿੰਕਰੀ ਧਰੰ ॥
ਭਖੰਤ ਮਾਸ ਹਾਰਣੰ; ਬਮੰਤ ਜ੍ਵਾਲ ਦੁਰਗਯੰ ॥
283.e: Roaming in he sky, the vultures began to move on the earth, the goddess Durga, appeared showering innumerable fires and eating the flesh.

283.g: ਪੁਅੰਤ ਪਾਰਬਤੀ ਸਿਰੰ; ਨਚੰਤ ਈਸਣੋ ਰਣੰ ॥
ਭਕੰਤ ਭੂਤ ਪ੍ਰੇਤਣੋ; ਬਕੰਤ ਬੀਰ ਬੈਤਲੰ ॥੭੯੭॥
283.e: It seemed that Shiva, the lord of Parvati, was engaged in Tandava dance in the battlefield. The heinous shouts of ghosts, fiends and brave Vaitals are being heard.797.
TILKA STANZA
The warriors began to fight, the arrows were showered, the limbs were chopped and the saddles of the horses were torn.798.
The warriors began to run on being shot by arrows  the sbode of Dharma (Ram) saw all this.799.
Being enraged the warriors began to fight and said, “Arrest and bind these boys quickly.”800.
The soldiers rushed forth and besieged both the death-like radiant boy.801.
The boys fearlessly discharged arrows with which the warriors fell and very enduring ones fled away.802.

283.g: ਚਰਨ ਸਾਧ ਕੇ; ਧੋਇ ਧੋਇ ਪੀਉ ॥
283.e: Wash the feet of the Holy, and drink in this water.
Dedicate your soul to the Holy.
Take your cleansing bath in the dust of the feet of the Holy.
To the Holy, make your life a sacrifice.
Service to the Holy is obtained by great good fortune.
In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, the Kirtan of the Lord's Praise is sung.
From all sorts of dangers, the Saint saves us.

283.g: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਇ; ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖੈ ॥
283.e: Singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, we taste the ambrosial essence.
Seeking the Protection of the Saints, we have come to their door.
All comforts, O Nanak, are so obtained. ||6||
You shall obtain your pre-ordained destiny.
God is the Giver of pain and pleasure.
Abandon others, and think of Him alone.

283.g: ਜੋ ਕਛੁ ਕਰੈ; ਸੋਈ ਸੁਖੁ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
283.e: Whatever He does - take comfort in that.
Why do you wander around, you ignorant fool?
What things did you bring with you?
You cling to worldly pleasures like a greedy moth.
Dwell upon the Lord's Name in your heart.
O Nanak, thus you shall return to your home with honor. ||4||
Ashtapadee:
Keep the Immortal Lord God enshrined within your mind.
Renounce your love and attachment to people.

283.g: ਤਿਸ ਤੇ ਪਰੈ; ਨਾਹੀ ਕਿਛੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
283.e: Beyond Him, there is nothing at all.
The One Lord is pervading among all.
He Himself is All-seeing; He Himself is All-knowing,
Unfathomable, Profound, Deep and All-knowing.
He is the Supreme Lord God, the Transcendent Lord, the Lord of the Universe,
the Treasure of mercy, compassion and forgiveness.
To fall at the Feet of Your Holy Beings
Salok:

283.g: ਰੂਪੁ ਨ ਰੇਖ. ਨ ਰੰਗੁ ਕਿਛੁ; ਤ੍ਰਿਹੁ ਗੁਣ ਤੇ. ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਿੰਨ ॥
283.e: He has no form, no shape, no color; God is beyond the three qualities.

283.g: ਤਿਸਹਿ ਬੁਝਾਏ ਨਾਨਕਾ; ਜਿਸੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੁਪ੍ਰਸੰਨ ॥੧॥
283.e: They alone understand Him, O Nanak, with whom He is pleased. ||1||
He infuses life back into the dead.
He gives food to the hungry.

283.g: ਸਰਬ ਨਿਧਾਨ; ਜਾ ਕੀ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟੀ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
283.e: All treasures are within His Glance of Grace.
People obtain that which they are pre-ordained to receive.

283.g: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ; ਓਹੁ ਕਰਨੈ ਜੋਗੁ ॥
283.e: All things are His; He is the Doer of all.

283.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ; ਦੂਸਰ ਹੋਆ ਨ ਹੋਗੁ ॥
283.e: Other than Him, there has never been any other, and there shall never be.

283.g: ਜਪਿ ਜਨ; ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਣੀ ॥
283.e: Meditate on Him forever and ever, day and night.

283.g: ਸਭ ਤੇ ਊਚ; ਨਿਰਮਲ ਇਹ ਕਰਣੀ ॥
283.e: This way of life is exalted and immaculate.

283.g: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ; ਜਿਸ ਕਉ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੀਆ ॥
283.e: One whom the Lord, in His Grace, blesses with His Name
- O Nanak, that person becomes immaculate and pure. ||7||
