Sita heard the speech and took water in her hand.822.
Time after time, again and again, meditate on God.

286.g: ਪੀ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ; ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਧ੍ਰਪੀਐ ॥
286.e: Drinking in this Nectar, this mind and body are satisfied.
The jewel of the Naam is obtained by the Gurmukhs;
they see no other than God.
Unto them, the Naam is wealth, the Naam is beauty and delight.

286.g: ਨਾਮੋ ਸੁਖੁ; ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਕਾ ਸੰਗੁ ॥
286.e: The Naam is peace, the Lord's Name is their companion.
Those who are satisfied by the essence of the Naam
their minds and bodies are drenched with the Naam.
While standing up, sitting down and sleeping, the Naam,

286.g: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ; ਜਨ ਕੈ ਸਦ ਕਾਮ ॥੬॥
286.e: says Nanak, is forever the occupation of God's humble servant. ||6||
Chant His Praises with your tongue, day and night.
God Himself has given this gift to His servants.
Performing devotional worship with heart-felt love,
they remain absorbed in God Himself.
They know the past and the present.
They recognize God's Own Command.
Who can describe His Glory?

286.g: ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਗੁਨੁ ਕਹਿ; ਏਕ ਨ ਜਾਨਉ ॥
286.e: I cannot describe even one of His virtuous qualities.
Those who dwell in God's Presence, twenty-four hours a day
- says Nanak, they are the perfect persons. ||7||

286.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ; ਸੇਵਕੁ ਜੋ ਰਹੈ ॥
286.e: That selfless servant, who lives in the Guru's household,

286.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਆਗਿਆ; ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਸਹੈ ॥
286.e: is to obey the Guru's Commands with all his mind.

286.g: ਆਪਸ ਕਉ; ਕਰਿ ਕਛੁ ਨ ਜਨਾਵੈ ॥
286.e: He is not to call attention to himself in any way.

286.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ; ਰਿਦੈ ਸਦ ਧਿਆਵੈ ॥
286.e: He is to meditate constantly within his heart on the Name of the Lord.
One who sells his mind to the True Guru
- that humble servant's affairs are resolved.
One who performs selfless service, without thought of reward,
shall attain his Lord and Master.
Salok:

286.g: ਸਤਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ. ਜਿਨਿ ਜਾਨਿਆ; ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ. ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਨਾਉ ॥
286.e: The one who knows the True Lord God, is called the True Guru.

286.g: ਤਿਸ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ. ਸਿਖੁ ਉਧਰੈ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਉ ॥੧॥
286.e: In His Company, the Sikh is saved, O Nanak, singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||1||
Ashtapadee:
The True Guru cherishes His Sikh.
The Guru is always merciful to His servant.

286.g: ਸਿਖ ਕੀ ਗੁਰੁ; ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਮਲੁ ਹਿਰੈ ॥
286.e: The Guru washes away the filth of the evil intellect of His Sikh.
Through the Guru's Teachings, he chants the Lord's Name.
The True Guru cuts away the bonds of His Sikh.

286.g: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਿਖੁ; ਬਿਕਾਰ ਤੇ ਹਾਟੈ ॥
286.e: The Sikh of the Guru abstains from evil deeds.

286.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਿਖ ਕਉ; ਨਾਮ ਧਨੁ ਦੇਇ ॥
286.e: The True Guru gives His Sikh the wealth of the Naam.
The Sikh of the Guru is very fortunate.

286.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ. ਸਿਖ ਕਾ; ਹਲਤੁ ਪਲਤੁ ਸਵਾਰੈ ॥
286.e: The True Guru arranges this world and the next for His Sikh.

286.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਿਖ ਕਉ; ਜੀਅ ਨਾਲਿ ਸਮਾਰੈ ॥੧॥
286.e: O Nanak, with the fullness of His heart, the True Guru mends His Sikh. ||1||
AROOPA STANZA
All the dead were reanimated, the illusion of all was removed and all leaving their persistence fell at the feet of SIta.824.
Sita was accepted as queen of the world and a sati, the source of Dharma.825.
Ram loved her and considering her a sati, he hugged her to his bosom.826.

287.g: ਬੀਸ ਬਿਸਵੇ; ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨੈ ॥
287.e: One who obeys the Guru's Teachings one hundred per cent

287.g: ਸੋ ਸੇਵਕੁ; ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
287.e: that selfless servant comes to know the state of the Transcendent Lord.

287.g: ਸੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ; ਜਿਸੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਉ ॥
287.e: The True Guru's Heart is filled with the Name of the Lord.

287.g: ਅਨਿਕ ਬਾਰ; ਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥
287.e: So many times, I am a sacrifice to the Guru.
He is the treasure of everything, the Giver of life.
Twenty-four hours a day, He is imbued with the Love of the Supreme Lord God.

287.g: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਮਹਿ ਜਨੁ; ਜਨ ਮਹਿ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ॥
287.e: The servant is in God, and God is in the servant.
He Himself is One - there is no doubt about this.
By thousands of clever tricks, He is not found.
O Nanak, such a Guru is obtained by the greatest good fortune. ||3||
Go-medh, Ajmedh and Bhoop-medh several types of Yajnas were performed.832.
Six Nagmedh Yajnas were performed which bring victory in life
To what extent I should enumerate them because there is fear of the Granth becoming voluminous.833.
Ram ruled in Avadphpuri for ten thousand and ten years,
Then according to time schedule, the death beat its drum.834.

287.g: ਜਿਨ ਜਗ ਜੀਤ ਕਰਯੋ ਬਸ ਸਾਰਾ ॥
287.e: I bow before death in various ways, which has conquered the whole world and keeping it under its control.

287.g: ਜੀਤ ਨ ਸਕਾ ਰੰਕ ਅਰੁ ਰਾਜਾ ॥੮੩੫॥
287.e: The drum of death beats on everyone’s head and no king or pauper had been able to conquer it.835.
DOHRA

287.g: ਜੇ ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਸਰਨੀ ਪਰੇ; ਕਰ ਦੈ ਲਏ ਬਚਾਇ ॥
ਜੌ ਨਹੀ ਕੋਊ ਬਾਚਿਆ; ਕਿਸਨ ਬਿਸਨ ਰਘੁਰਾਇ ॥੮੩੬॥
287.e: He, who came under its refuge, it saved him and he, who did not go under its refuge, he could not be saved whether he was Krishna or Vishnu or Ram.836.
CHAUPAI STANZA

287.g: ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਕਰੋ ਰਾਜ ਕੋ ਸਾਜਾ ॥

287.e: Performing his royal duties in many ways and practising Sama, Dama, Dand and Bhed and other methods of administration, Ram conquered other kings of many countries.837.
He caused every caste to do its duties and set in motion Varnashram Dharma
In the burning heat, a soothing coolness prevails.
Happiness ensues and pain departs, O Siblings of Destiny.
The fear of birth and death is dispelled,
by the perfect Teachings of the Holy Saint.
Fear is lifted, and one abides in fearlessness.

287.g: ਸਗਲ ਬਿਆਧਿ; ਮਨ ਤੇ ਖੈ ਨਸੇ ॥
287.e: All evils are dispelled from the mind.

287.g: ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਸਾ; ਤਿਨਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
287.e: He takes us into His favor as His own.
In the Company of the Holy, chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
Stability is attained; doubt and wandering cease,

287.g: ਸੁਨਿ ਨਾਨਕ; ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਸ੍ਰਵਨ ॥੭॥
287.e: O Nanak, listening with one's ears to the Praises of the Lord, Har, Har. ||7||
He Himself is absolute and unrelated; He Himself is also involved and related.
Manifesting His power, He fascinates the entire world.
God Himself sets His play in motion.
Only He Himself can estimate His worth.
There is none, other than the Lord.
Permeating all, He is the One.
Through and through, He pervades in form and color.
He is revealed in the Company of the Holy.

287.g: ਇਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ; ਪਾਵੈ ਜਨੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
287.e: Only a few obtain this ambrosial essence of the Lord's Name.
Drinking in this Nectar, one becomes immortal.

287.g: ਉਸੁ ਪੁਰਖ ਕਾ; ਨਾਹੀ ਕਦੇ ਬਿਨਾਸ ॥
287.e: That person whose mind is illuminated
By the treasure of excellence, never dies.

287.g: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ; ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਲੇਇ ॥
287.e: Twenty-four hours a day, he takes the Name of the Lord.
The Lord gives true instruction to His servant.

287.g: ਮੋਹ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ; ਨ ਲੇਪੁ ॥
287.e: He is not polluted by emotional attachment to Maya.

287.g: ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਖੈ; ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਏਕੁ ॥
287.e: In his mind, he cherishes the One Lord, Har, Har.
In the pitch darkness, a lamp shines forth.

287.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਭਰਮ ਮੋਹ ਦੁਖ; ਤਹ ਤੇ ਨਾਸੇ ॥੬॥
287.e: O Nanak, doubt, emotional attachment and pain are erased. ||6||
He Himself grants His Grace;

287.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਸੋ ਸੇਵਕੁ; ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਮਤਿ ਲੇਇ ॥੨॥
287.e: O Nanak, that selfless servant lives the Guru's Teachings. ||2||
The tongue is one, but His Praises are many.
The True Lord, of perfect perfection
- no speech can take the mortal to Him.
God is Inaccessible, Incomprehensible, balanced in the state of Nirvaanaa.
He is not sustained by food; He has no hatred or vengeance; He is the Giver of peace.

287.g: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ; ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
287.e: No one can estimate His worth.
Countless devotees continually bow in reverence to Him.
In their hearts, they meditate on His Lotus Feet.
Nanak is forever a sacrifice to the True Guru;

287.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਜਿਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ; ਐਸਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਪਨੇ ॥੫॥
287.e: by His Grace, he meditates on God. ||5||
Blessed is His Darshan; receiving it, one is purified.
Touching His Feet, one's conduct and lifestyle become pure.
Abiding in His Company, one chants the Lord's Praise,
and reaches the Court of the Supreme Lord God.
Listening to His Teachings, one's ears are satisfied.
The mind is contented, and the soul is fulfilled.

287.g: ਪੂਰਾ ਗੁਰੁ; ਅਖੵਓ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਮੰਤ੍ਰ ॥
287.e: The Guru is perfect; His Teachings are everlasting.
Beholding His Ambrosial Glance, one becomes saintly.
Endless are His virtuous qualities; His worth cannot be appraised.

287.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ; ਤਿਸੁ ਲਏ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੪॥
287.e: O Nanak, one who pleases Him is united with Him. ||4||

288.e: Speed of Ram in his mind :

288.g: ਯਾ ਕੋ ਕਛੁ ਰਾਵਨ ਸੋ ਹੋਤਾ ॥

288.e: She (Sita) must have had some love for Ravana, that is the reason why she is looking at his portrait drawn by her
Sita became angry on hearing these words and said that even then Ram had been accusing her.845.
DOHRA

288.g: ਇਹ ਜਗੁ ਧੂਅਰੋ ਧਉਲਹਰਿ; ਕਿਹ ਕੇ ਆਯੋ ਕਾਮ ॥
288.e: This world is the palace of smoke which had been of no value to anyone

288.g: ਰਘੁਬਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਸੀਅ ਨਾ ਜੀਐ; ਸੀਅ ਬਿਨ ਜੀਐ ਨ ਰਾਮ ॥੮੪੮॥
288.e: Sita could not live without Ram and it is impossible for Ram to remain alive without Sita.848.
CHAUPAI
The ritual which is performed on the death of someone, the same was performed according to the Vedas
The benign son Ram went to the home (and himself being an incarnation) he had no shortage of any type.842.

288.g: ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਗਤਿ ਕੀਨੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਾਤਾ ॥

288.e: Many rituals were performed for the salvation of the mother and by that time Kaikeyi had also passed away.
After her death, look at the doing of KAL (death). Sumitra also died.843.
One day explaining to women, Sita drew the portrait of Ravana on the wall,
When Ram saw this, he said somewhat angrily.844.
Salok:

288.g: ਸਾਥਿ ਨ ਚਾਲੈ. ਬਿਨੁ ਭਜਨ; ਬਿਖਿਆ ਸਗਲੀ ਛਾਰੁ ॥
288.e: Nothing shall go along with you, except your devotion. All corruption is like ashes.

288.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਮਾਵਨਾ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਇਹੁ ਧਨੁ ਸਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
288.e: Practice the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. O Nanak, this is the most excellent wealth. ||1||
CHAUPAI
Ram said to Lakshman, “You sit on the gate and do not let anyone to come in.” Ram himself went into the palace and abandoning his body left this abode of death.849.
DOHRA

288.g: ਇੰਦ੍ਰ ਮਤੀ ਹਿਤ ਅਜ ਨ੍ਰਿਪਤ; ਜਿਮ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਤਜ ਲੀਅ ਜੋਗ ॥

288.e: DOHRA STANZA

288.g: ਬਹੁ ਬਰਖਨ ਲਉ ਰਾਮ ਜੀ; ਰਾਜ ਕਰਾ ਅਰ ਟਾਲ ॥
ਬ੍ਰਹਮਰੰਧ੍ਰ ਕਹ ਫੋਰ ਕੈ; ਭਯੋ ਕਉਸਲਿਆ ਕਾਲ ॥੮੪੧॥
288.e: In this way, Ram ruled for a long time and on one day Kaushalya breathed her last on the bursting of her nerve Brahm-Randhra.841.
Kshatriyas began to serve the Brahmin and the Vaishyas considered the Kshatriyas as gods.838.

288.g: ਜਹ ਕੋਈ ਕਹੈ ਤਹੀ ਵਹ ਧਾਵੈ ॥
288.e: The Shudras began to serve all and they went wherever they were sent
Ram always talked from his mouth about practicing administration according to Vedas.839.

288.g: ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਰਾਜ ਜਗਤ ਮੈ ਕੀਨੋ ॥੮੪੦॥
288.e: Ram ruled by killing the tyrants like Ravana, by emancipating different devotees and attendants (ganas) and by collecting the taxes of Lanka.840.
Having created the creation, He infuses His own power into it.
So many times, Nanak is a sacrifice to Him. ||8||18||
DOHRA

288.g: ਜਉ ਮੇਰੇ ਬਚ ਕਰਮ ਕਰਿ; ਹ੍ਰਿਦੈ ਬਸਤ ਰਘੁਰਾਇ ॥
288.e: “If Ram the king Raghu clan abides ever in my heart, in my speech and action then,

288.g: ਪ੍ਰਿਥੀ, ਪੈਂਡ ਮੁਹਿ ਦੀਜੀਐ; ਲੀਜੈ ਮੋਹਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੮੪੬॥
288.e: O mother earth! you give me some place and merge me in yourself.”846.
One who contemplates the essence of reality, is said to be the true person.
Birth and death are the lot of the false and the insincere.
Coming and going in reincarnation is ended by serving God.
Give up your selfishness and conceit, and seek the Sanctuary of the Divine Guru.

288.g: ਇਉ ਰਤਨ ਜਨਮ ਕਾ; ਹੋਇ ਉਧਾਰੁ ॥
288.e: Thus the jewel of this human life is saved.
Remember the Lord, Har, Har, the Support of the breath of life.
By all sorts of efforts, people are not saved
not by studying the Simritees, the Shaastras or the Vedas.

288.g: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਭਗਤਿ; ਕਰਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਇ ॥
288.e: Worship the Lord with whole-hearted devotion.
O Nanak, you shall obtain the fruits of your mind's desire. ||4||
Enlighten your mind with the Name of the Lord.
Having wandered around in the ten directions, it comes to its place of rest.

288.g: ਤਾ ਕਉ ਬਿਘਨੁ; ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
288.e: No obstacle stands in the way of one

288.g: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਰਿਦੈ; ਬਸੈ ਹਰਿ ਸੋਇ ॥
288.e: whose heart is filled with the Lord.
The Dark Age of Kali Yuga is so hot; the Lord's Name is soothing and cool.
Remember, remember it in meditation, and obtain everlasting peace.
Your fear shall be dispelled, and your hopes shall be fulfilled.
By devotional worship and loving adoration, your soul shall be enlightened.
You shall go to that home, and live forever.
Says Nanak, the noose of death is cut away. ||3||
Your wealth shall not go with you;
why do you cling to it, you fool?
Children, friends, family and spouse

288.g: ਇਨ ਤੇ. ਕਹਹੁ ਤੁਮ; ਕਵਨ ਸਨਾਥਾ ॥
288.e: who of these shall accompany you?
Power, pleasure, and the vast expanse of Maya
who has ever escaped from these?
Horses, elephants, chariots and pageantry
- false shows and false displays.

288.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਦੀਏ; ਤਿਸੁ ਬੁਝੈ ਨ. ਬਿਗਾਨਾ ॥
288.e: The fool does not acknowledge the One who gave this;
forgetting the Naam, O Nanak, he will repent in the end. ||5||
Ashtapadee:
Joining the Company of the Saints, practice deep meditation.
Remember the One, and take the Support of the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
Forget all other efforts, O my friend

288.g: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ; ਰਿਦ ਮਹਿ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰਹੁ ॥
288.e: - enshrine the Lord's Lotus Feet within your heart.
God is All-powerful; He is the Cause of causes.

288.g: ਦ੍ਰਿੜੁ ਕਰਿ ਗਹਹੁ; ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਵਥੁ ॥
288.e: Grasp firmly the object of the Lord's Name.
Gather this wealth, and become very fortunate.
Pure are the instructions of the humble Saints.
Keep faith in the One Lord within your mind.
All disease, O Nanak, shall then be dispelled. ||1||

288.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਮਤਿ; ਤੂੰ ਲੇਹਿ ਇਆਨੇ ॥
288.e: Take the Guru's advice, you ignorant fool;
without devotion, even the clever have drowned.

288.g: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਭਗਤਿ; ਕਰਹੁ ਮਨ ਮੀਤ ॥
288.e: Worship the Lord with heart-felt devotion, my friend;
your consciousness shall become pure.
Enshrine the Lord's Lotus Feet in your mind;

288.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਧਨ ਕਉ; ਚਾਰਿ ਕੁੰਟ ਉਠਿ ਧਾਵਹਿ ॥
288.e: The wealth which you chase after in the four directions

288.g: ਸੋ ਧਨੁ; ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ ਪਾਵਹਿ ॥
288.e: you shall obtain that wealth by serving the Lord.

288.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਸੁਖ ਕਉ; ਨਿਤ ਬਾਛਹਿ ਮੀਤ ॥
288.e: The peace, which you always yearn for, O friend
that peace comes by the love of the Company of the Holy.

288.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਸੋਭਾ ਕਉ; ਕਰਹਿ ਭਲੀ ਕਰਨੀ ॥
288.e: The glory, for which you perform good deeds

288.g: ਸਾ ਸੋਭਾ; ਭਜੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਸਰਨੀ ॥
288.e: - you shall obtain that glory by seeking the Lord's Sanctuary.
All sorts of remedies have not cured the disease
- the disease is cured only by giving the medicine of the Lord's Name.

288.g: ਸਰਬ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਮਹਿ; ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ॥
288.e: Of all treasures, the Lord's Name is the supreme treasure.
Chant it, O Nanak, and be accepted in the Court of the Lord. ||2||
CHAUPAI
Hearing these words the earth tore asunder and Sita merged in it
Seeing this Ram wondered and in this suffering he ended all hope of ruling.847.

289.e: DOHRA

289.g: ਰਾਮ ਕਥਾ ਜੁਗ ਜੁਗ ਅਟਲ; ਸਭ ਕੋਈ ਭਾਖਤ ਨੇਤ ॥
ਸੁਰਗ ਬਾਸ ਰਘੁਬਰ ਕਰਾ; ਸਗਰੀ ਪੁਰੀ ਸਮੇਤ ॥੮੫੮॥
289.e: The story of Ram remain immortal throughout the ages and in this way Ram went to abide in heaven alongwith (all the resident of) the city.858.

289.g: ਇਤਿ ਰਾਮ ਭਿਰਾਤ ਤ੍ਰੀਅਨ ਸਹਿਤ ਸੁਰਗ ਗਏ ਅਰ ਸਗਰੀ ਪੁਰੀ ਸਹਿਤ ਸੁਰਗ ਗਏ ਧਿਆਇ ਸਮਾਪਤਮ ॥
289.e: End of the chapter entitled ‘Ram went to Heaven alongwith brothers and their wives He went alongwith all the residents of the city’ in Ramavtar in BACHITTAR NATAK.
The wishes of the Lord's servant are fulfilled.
From the True Guru, the pure teachings are obtained.
Unto His humble servant, God has shown His kindness.
He has made His servant eternally happy.
The bonds of His humble servant are cut away, and he is liberated.
The pains of birth and death, and doubt are gone.
Desires are satisfied, and faith is fully rewarded,
imbued forever with His all-pervading peace.

289.g: ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਸਾ; ਤਿਨਿ ਲੀਆ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
289.e: He is His - he merges in Union with Him.
Nanak is absorbed in devotional worship of the Naam. ||3||
Salok:

289.g: ਫਿਰਤ ਫਿਰਤ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਆਇਆ; ਪਰਿਆ ਤਉ ਸਰਨਾਇ ॥
289.e: After wandering and wandering, O God, I have come, and entered Your Sanctuary.

289.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬੇਨਤੀ; ਅਪਨੀ ਭਗਤੀ ਲਾਇ ॥੧॥
289.e: This is Nanak's prayer, O God: please, attach me to Your devotional service. ||1||
CHAUPAI

289.g: ਜੋ ਇਹ ਕਥਾ ਸੁਨੈ ਅਰੁ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
ਦੂਖ ਪਾਪ ਤਿਹ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
ਬਿਸਨ ਭਗਤਿ ਕੀ ਏ ਫਲ ਹੋਈ ॥
ਆਧਿ ਬਯਾਧਿ ਛ੍ਵੈ ਸਕੈ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥੮੫੯॥
289.e: He, who will listen to this story and sing it, he will be free from the sufferings and sins. The reward of the devotion to Vishnu (and his incarnation Ram) that no ailment of any kind will touch him.859.
This Granth (book) has been complete (and improved)
In Vadi first in the month of Asaarh in the year
Seventeen hundred and fifty-five
If there has remained any error in it, then kindly correct it.860.

289.g: ਤਿਮ ਰਘੁਬਰ ਤਨ ਕੋ ਤਜਾ; ਸ੍ਰੀ ਜਾਨਕੀ ਬਿਯੋਗ ॥੮੫੦॥
289.e: The way in which the king Aja had accepted Yoga for Indumati and left his home, in the same manner, Ram abandoned his body on having been separated from Sita.850.

289.g: ਇਤਿ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਬਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਨਾਟਕ ਰਾਮਵਤਾਰੇ ਸੀਤਾ ਕੇ ਹੇਤ ਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਲੋਕ ਸੇ ਗਏ ਧਿਆਇ ਸਮਾਪਤੰ ॥
289.e: End of the chapter entitled ‘Forsaking the abode of Death for Sita’ in Ramavtar in BACHITTAR NATAK.

289.g: ਸੋ ਕਿਉ ਬਿਸਰੈ; ਜਿ. ਘਾਲ ਨ ਭਾਨੈ ॥
289.e: Why forget Him, who does not overlook our efforts?

289.g: ਸੋ ਕਿਉ ਬਿਸਰੈ; ਜਿ. ਕੀਆ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
289.e: Why forget Him, who acknowledges what we do?
Chanting His Glories, your filth shall be washed off.
The all-consuming poison of ego will be gone.
You shall become carefree, and you shall dwell in peace.
With every breath and every morsel of food, cherish the Lord's Name.
Renounce all clever tricks, O mind.
In the Company of the Holy, you shall obtain the true wealth.
So gather the Lord's Name as your capital, and trade in it.
In this world you shall be at peace, and in the Court of the Lord, you shall be acclaimed.
See the One permeating all;

289.g: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ; ਜਾ ਕੈ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲੇਖੁ ॥੭॥
289.e: says Nanak, your destiny is pre-ordained. ||7||
Meditate on the One, and worship the One.
Remember the One, and yearn for the One in your mind.
Sing the endless Glorious Praises of the One.
With mind and body, meditate on the One Lord God.
The One Lord Himself is the One and Only.
The Pervading Lord God is totally permeating all.
The many expanses of the creation have all come from the One.
Adoring the One, past sins are removed.

289.g: ਮਨ ਤਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ; ਏਕੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਰਾਤਾ ॥
289.e: Mind and body within are imbued with the One God.
By Guru's Grace, O Nanak, the One is known. ||8||19||
the sins of countless lifetimes shall depart.
Chant the Naam yourself, and inspire others to chant it as well.
Hearing, speaking and living it, emancipation is obtained.

289.g: ਸਾਰ ਭੂਤ ਸਤਿ; ਹਰਿ ਕੋ ਨਾਉ ॥
289.e: The essential reality is the True Name of the Lord.
With intuitive ease, O Nanak, sing His Glorious Praises. ||6||

289.g: ਅਥ ਤੀਨੋ ਭ੍ਰਾਤਾ ਤ੍ਰੀਅਨ ਸਹਿਤ ਮਰਬੋ ਕਥਨੰ ॥
289.e: The description of the Death of the Three Brothers alongwith their wives :
CHAUPAI
There was great tumult in the whole city and none of the residents was in his senses
The men and women staggered like the warriors writhing after falling during fight in the battlefield.851.

289.g: ਸਗਰ ਨਗਰ ਮਹਿ ਪਰ ਗਈ ਰਉਰਾ ॥

289.e: There was uproar throughout the city and the elephants and horses also began to fall, being worried, what type of sport has been played by Ram?
Thinking about this thing the men and women remained under depression.852.
Bharat also produced Yoga fire in his body by practising Yoga and

289.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੌ ਚਲਤ ਅੰਗ ਨਹੀ ਮੋਰਾ ॥੮੫੩॥
289.e: With a jerk got his Brahmrandhra burst and definitely went towards Ram.853.
Lakshman alos did this, practicing all types of Yoga he gave up his life.
Then the Brahmrandhra of Shatrughan also burst and he breathed his last to be at the feet of the Lord.854.

289.g: ਲਵ ਕੁਸ ਦੋਊ ਤਹਾ ਚਲ ਗਏ ॥

289.e: Lava and Kusha both came forward and performed the funeral rites of Ram and Sita

289.g: ਅਰ ਪਿਤ ਭ੍ਰਾਤ ਤਿਹੂੰ ਕਹ ਦਹਾ ॥
ਰਾਜ ਛਤ੍ਰ ਲਵ ਕੇ ਸਿਰ ਰਹਾ ॥੮੫੫॥
289.e: They also performed the funeral rites of the brothers of their father and in this way Lava assumed the royal canopy over his head.855.
The wives of the three brothers came there and they also became Satis and left for the heavenly abode.

289.g: ਲਵ ਸਿਰ ਧਰਾ ਰਾਜ ਕਾ ਸਾਜਾ ॥

289.e: Lava assumed the kingship and made the three (cousins) the kings of three directions.856.
Kusha himself ruled over the north, the son of Bharat was given the kingship of the south and the son of Shatrughan the kingship of the west.857.
Ashtapadee:
I am a beggar; I beg for this gift from You:
please, by Your Mercy, Lord, give me Your Name.
I ask for the dust of the feet of the Holy.
O Supreme Lord God, please fulfill my yearning;

289.g: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ; ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਉ ॥
289.e: may I sing the Glorious Praises of God forever and ever.
With each and every breath, may I meditate on You, O God.
May I enshrine affection for Your Lotus Feet.

289.g: ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਉ; ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਨਿਤ ਨੀਤਿ ॥
289.e: May I perform devotional worship to God each and every day.
You are my only Shelter, my only Support.
Nanak asks for the most sublime, the Naam, the Name of God. ||1||

289.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ; ਮਹਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
289.e: By God's Gracious Glance, there is great peace.
Rare are those who obtain the juice of the Lord's essence.
Those who taste it are satisfied.
They are fulfilled and realized beings - they do not waver.
They are totally filled to over-flowing with the sweet delight of His Love.
Spiritual delight wells up within, in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.
Taking to His Sanctuary, they forsake all others.
Deep within, they are enlightened, and they center themselves on Him, day and night.
Most fortunate are those who meditate on God.
O Nanak, attuned to the Naam, they are at peace. ||2||
DOHRA

289.g: ਨੇਤ੍ਰ ਤੁੰਗ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ਤਰ ਸਤਦ੍ਰਵ ਤੀਰ ਤਰੰਗ ॥
ਸ੍ਰੀ ਭਗਵਤ ਪੂਰਨ ਕੀਯੋ; ਰਘੁਬਰ ਕਥਾ ਪ੍ਰਸੰਗ ॥੮੬੧॥
289.e: The story of Raghuvir Ram was complete by the Grace of God on the bank of Sutlej in the valley of the mountain.861.

290.e: SWAYYA

290.g: ਅਦ੍ਰ ਸੁਤਾ ਹੂੰ ਕੀ ਜੋ ਤਨਯਾ; ਮਹਿਖਾਸੁਰ ਕੀ ਮਰਤਾ ਫੁਨਿ ਜੋਊ ॥
290.e: She, who is the daughter of the mountain and the destroyer of Mahishasura
CHAUPAI
The sportive plays exhibited by Krishna, have been described in the tenth skandh
There are eleven thousand and ninety-two stanzas in respect of Krishna incarnation in the tenth skandh.4.
SWAYYA

290.g: ਪਾਂਇ ਗਹੇ ਜਬ ਤੇ ਤੁਮਰੇ ਤਬ ਤੇ ਕੋਊ ਆਂਖ ਤਰੇ ਨਹੀਂ ਆਨ︀ਯੋ ॥
290.e: O God! the day when I caught hold of your feet, I do not bring anyone else under my sight

290.g: ਰਾਮ ਰਹੀਮ ਪੁਰਾਨ ਕੁਰਾਨ; ਅਨੇਕ ਕਹੈਂ, ਮਤ ਏਕ ਨ ਮਾਨ︀ਯੋ ॥
290.e: None other is liked by me now   the Puranas and the Quran try to know Thee by the names of Ram and Rahim and talk about you through several stories,

290.g: ਸਿੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਬੇਦ ਸਭੈ; ਬਹੁ ਭੇਦ ਕਹੈਂ, ਹਮ ਏਕ ਨ ਜਾਨ︀ਯੋ ॥
290.e: The Simritis, Shastras and Vedas describe several mysteries of yours, but I do not agree with any of them.

290.g: ਸ੍ਰੀ ਅਸਿਪਾਨ, ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਤੁਮਰੀ ਕਰਿ; ਮੈ ਨ ਕਹ︀ਯੋ, ਸਭ ਤੋਹਿ ਬਖਾਨ︀ਯੋ ॥੮੬੩॥
290.e: O sword-wielder God! This all has been described by Thy Grace, what power can I have to write all this?.863.

290.g: ਸੋ ਕਿਉ ਬਿਸਰੈ; ਜਿਨਿ. ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਦੀਆ ॥
290.e: Why forget Him, who has given us everything?

290.g: ਸੋ ਕਿਉ ਬਿਸਰੈ; ਜਿ. ਜੀਵਨ ਜੀਆ ॥
290.e: Why forget Him, who is the Life of the living beings?

290.g: ਸੋ ਕਿਉ ਬਿਸਰੈ; ਜਿ. ਅਗਨਿ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਖੈ ॥
290.e: Why forget Him, who preserves us in the fire of the womb?
By Guru's Grace, rare is the one who realizes this.

290.g: ਸੋ ਕਿਉ ਬਿਸਰੈ; ਜਿ. ਬਿਖੁ ਤੇ ਕਾਢੈ ॥
290.e: Why forget Him, who lifts us up out of corruption?
Those separated from Him for countless lifetimes, are re-united with Him once again.
Through the Perfect Guru, this essential reality is understood.
O Nanak, God's humble servants meditate on Him. ||4||
DOHRA

290.g: ਸਗਲ ਦੁਆਰ ਕਉ ਛਾਡਿ ਕੈ; ਗਹਿਓ ਤੁਹਾਰੋ ਦੁਆਰ ॥
290.e: O Lord! I have forsaken all other doors and have caught hold of only Thy door. O Lord! Thou has caught hold of my arm

290.g: ਬਾਂਹਿ ਗਹੇ ਕੀ ਲਾਜ ਅਸ; ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਦਾਸ ਤੁਹਾਰ ॥੮੬੪॥
290.e: I, Govind, am Thy serf, kindly take (care of me and) protect my honour.864.

290.g: ਇਤਿ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਰਾਮਾਇਣ ਸਮਾਪਤਮ ਸਤੁ ਸੁਭਮ ਸਤੁ ॥
290.e: BENIGN END OF THE RAMAYANA.
God, the Forgiving Lord, is kind to the poor.
He loves His devotees, and He is always merciful to them.
The Patron of the patronless, the Lord of the Universe, the Sustainer of the world,
the Nourisher of all beings.
The Primal Being, the Creator of the Creation.
The Support of the breath of life of His devotees.

290.g: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਜਪੈ; ਸੁ ਹੋਇ ਪੁਨੀਤ ॥
290.e: Whoever meditates on Him is sanctified,
focusing the mind in loving devotional worship.
I am unworthy, lowly and ignorant.
Nanak has entered Your Sanctuary, O Supreme Lord God. ||7||
Ashtapadee:

290.g: ਜਬ ਅਕਾਰੁ ਇਹੁ; ਕਛੁ ਨ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟੇਤਾ ॥
290.e: When this world had not yet appeared in any form,

290.g: ਪਾਪ ਪੁੰਨ; ਤਬ. ਕਹ ਤੇ ਹੋਤਾ ॥
290.e: who then committed sins and performed good deeds?
When the Lord Himself was in Profound Samaadhi,

290.g: ਤਬ ਬੈਰ ਬਿਰੋਧ; ਕਿਸੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਕਮਾਤਿ ॥
290.e: then against whom were hate and jealousy directed?

290.g: ਜਬ ਇਸ ਕਾ; ਬਰਨੁ ਚਿਹਨੁ. ਨ ਜਾਪਤ ॥
290.e: When there was no color or shape to be seen,

290.g: ਤਬ ਹਰਖ ਸੋਗ; ਕਹੁ. ਕਿਸਹਿ ਬਿਆਪਤ ॥
290.e: then who experienced joy and sorrow?
When the Supreme Lord Himself was Himself All-in-all,

290.g: ਤਬ ਮੋਹ ਕਹਾ; ਕਿਸੁ ਹੋਵਤ ਭਰਮ ॥
290.e: then where was emotional attachment, and who had doubts?
Everything is obtained: the heavens, liberation and deliverance,

290.g: ਏਕ ਨਿਮਖ; ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਏ ॥
290.e: if one sings the Lord's Glories, even for an instant.
So many realms of power, pleasures and great glories,

290.g: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਕਥਾ; ਮਨਿ ਭਾਈ ॥
290.e: come to one whose mind is pleased with the Sermon of the Lord's Name.
Abundant foods, clothes and music
come to one whose tongue continually chants the Lord's Name, Har, Har.
His actions are good, he is glorious and wealthy;
the Mantra of the Perfect Guru dwells within his heart.
O God, grant me a home in the Company of the Holy.
All pleasures, O Nanak, are so revealed. ||8||20||
Salok:

290.g: ਸਰਗੁਨ ਨਿਰਗੁਨ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ; ਸੁੰਨ ਸਮਾਧੀ ਆਪਿ ॥
290.e: He possesses all qualities; He transcends all qualities; He is the Formless Lord. He Himself is in Primal Samaadhi.

290.g: ਆਪਨ ਕੀਆ ਨਾਨਕਾ; ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਜਾਪਿ ॥੧॥
290.e: Through His Creation, O Nanak, He meditates on Himself. ||1||

290.g: ਅਥ ਦੇਵੀ ਜੂ ਕੀ ਉਸਤਤ ਕਥਨੰ ॥
290.e: Now begins the description in praise of the goddess
SWAYYA

290.g: ਹੋਇ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਤੁਮਰੀ ਹਮ ਪੈ ਤੁ ਸਭੈ ਸਗਨੰ ਗੁਨ ਹੀ ਧਰਿ ਹੋਂ ॥
290.e: On receiving Thy Grace, I shall assume all the virtues

290.g: ਜੀਅ ਧਾਰਿ ਬਿਚਾਰ ਤਬੈ ਬਰ ਬੁਧਿ ਮਹਾ ਅਗਨੰ ਗੁਨ ਕੋ ਹਰਿ ਹੋਂ ॥
290.e: I shall destroy all the vices, ruminating on Thy attributes in my mind

290.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਚੰਡਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਤੁਮਰੀ ਕਬਹੂੰ ਮੁਖ ਤੇ ਨਹੀ ਅਛਰ ਹਉ ਕਰਿ ਹੋਂ ॥
290.e: O Chandi! I cannot utter a syllable from my mouth without Thy Grace

290.g: ਤੁਮਰੋ ਕਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਿਧੋ ਤੁਲਹਾ ਜਿਮ ਬਾਕ ਸਮੁੰਦ੍ਰ ਬਿਖੈ ਤਰਿ ਹੋਂ ॥੫॥
290.e: I can ferry across the ocean of Poesy, on only the boat of Thy Name.5.
DOHRA

290.g: ਕਾਲ ਪੁਰਖ ਕੇ ਬਚਨ ਤੇ; ਸੰਤਨ ਹੇਤ ਸਹਾਇ ॥
ਮਥੁਰਾ ਮੰਡਲ ਕੇ ਬਿਖੈ; ਜਨਮੁ ਧਰੋ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇ ॥੩॥
290.e: Vishnu took birth in Mathura area for the welfare of saints, on receiving the orders of the Loard.3.
KABIT

290.g: ਸੰਕਟ ਹਰਨ, ਸਭ ਸਿਧਿ ਕੀ ਕਰਨ ਚੰਡ; ਤਾਰਨ ਤਰਨ ਅਰੁ ਲੋਚਨ ਬਿਸਾਲ ਹੈ ॥
290.e: The large-eyed Chandika is the remover of all sufferings, the donor of powers and support of the helpless in ferrying across the fearful ocean of the world

290.g: ਆਦਿ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਆਹਮ ਹੈ, ਅੰਤ ਕੋ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰ; ਸਰਨਿ ਉਬਾਰਨ ਕਰਨ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲ ਹੈ ॥
290.e: It is difficult to know her beginning and end, she emancipates and sustains him, who takes refuge in her,

290.g: ਅਸੁਰ ਸੰਘਾਰਨ, ਅਨਿਕ ਦੁਖ ਜਾਰਨ ਸੋ, ਪਤਿਤ ਉਧਾਰਨ ਛਡਾਏ ਜਮ ਜਾਲ ਹੈ ॥
290.e: She destroys the demons, finishes various types of desires and saves from the noose of death

290.g: ਦੇਵੀ ਬਰੁ ਲਾਇਕ, ਸੁਬੁਧਿ ਹੂ ਕੀ ਦਾਇਕ ਸੁ; ਦੇਹ ਬਰੁ ਪਾਇਕ ਬਨਾਵੈ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਹਾਲ ਹੈ ॥੭॥
290.e: The same goddess is capable of bestowing the boon and good intellect  by her Grace this Granth can be composed.7.
Love and affection, and the taste of yearning, have welled up within;
within my mind and body, this is my purpose:
beholding with my eyes His Blessed Vision, I am at peace.
My mind blossoms forth in ecstasy, washing the feet of the Holy.

290.g: ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੈ; ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਰੰਗੁ ॥
290.e: The minds and bodies of His devotees are infused with His Love.
Rare is the one who obtains their company.
Show Your mercy - please, grant me this one request:
by Guru's Grace, may I chant the Naam.

290.g: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਉਪਮਾ; ਕਹੀ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
290.e: His Praises cannot be spoken;
O Nanak, He is contained among all. ||6||
CHAUBIS AVTAR(Contd.)
The Lord is One and the Victory is of the True Guru.
The Lord is one and the Victory is of the Lord.
Now begins the description of KRISHNA INCARNATION, the twenty-first incarnation
CHAUPAI
No I describe the Krishna incarnation as to how he assumed the physical form
The earth, with unsteady gait, reached near the Lord.1.
Amidst the milk-ocean, where the Immanent Lord was seated, Brahma reached there
The Lord called Vishnu near Him and said, “You go to the earth and assume the form of Krishna incarnation.2.
DOHRA

290.g: ਰੇ ਮਨ, ਭਜ ਤੂੰ ਸਾਰਦਾ; ਅਨਗਨ ਗੁਨ ਹੈ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
290.e: O mind! Remember the goddess Sharda of innumerable qualities

290.g: ਰਚੌ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਇਹ ਭਾਗਵਤ; ਜਉ ਵੈ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਾਹਿ ॥੬॥
290.e: And if she be kind, I may compose this Granth (based on) Bhagavata.6.
O friends, O Saints, make this your work.
Renounce everything else, and chant the Name of the Lord.
Meditate, meditate, meditate in remembrance of Him, and find peace.
Chant the Naam yourself, and inspire others to chant it.
By loving devotional worship, you shall cross over the world-ocean.
Without devotional meditation, the body will be just ashes.
All joys and comforts are in the treasure of the Naam.
Even the drowning can reach the place of rest and safety.
All sorrows shall vanish.
O Nanak, chant the Naam, the treasure of excellence. ||5||

290.g: ਸਾਧ ਅਸਾਧ ਜਾਨੋ ਨਹੀ; ਬਾਦ ਸੁਬਾਦ ਬਿਬਾਦਿ ॥
290.e: The saint be not considered as unsaintly ever and the debate as controversial ever

290.g: ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਕਲ ਪੂਰਣ ਕੀਯੋ; ਭਗਵਤ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥੮੬੨॥
290.e: This whole Granth (book) has been completed by the Grace of God.862.

291.g: ਇੰਦ੍ਰ ਕੋ ਰਾਜਹਿ ਕੀ ਦਵੈਯਾ; ਕਰਤਾ ਬਧ ਸੁੰਭ ਨਿਸੁੰਭਹਿ ਦੋਊ ॥
291.e: She, who is the bestower of the kingdom on India by killing Sumbh and Nisumbh

291.g: ਜੋ ਜਪ ਕੈ ਇਹ ਸੇਵ ਕਰੈ; ਬਰੁ ਕੋ ਸੁ ਲਹੈ ਮਨ ਇਛਤ ਸੋਊ ॥
291.e: He, who remembers and serves her, he receives the reward to his heart’s desire,

291.g: ਲੋਕ ਬਿਖੈ ਉਹ ਕੀ ਸਮਤੁਲ; ਗਰੀਬ ਨਿਵਾਜ ਨ ਦੂਸਰ ਕੋਊ ॥੮॥
291.e: And in the whole world, none other is the supporter of the poor like her.8.

291.g: ਇਤਿ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਦੇਵੀ ਜੂ ਕੀ ਉਸਤਤਿ ਸਮਾਪਤੰ ॥
291.e: End of the praise of the goddess,

291.g: ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਬਾਚ ॥
291.e: Speech of the lord:

291.g: ਦੋਹਰਾ ॥
291.e: DOHRA

291.g: ਜਹ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਪੁਰਖੁ; ਪੁਰਖ ਪਤਿ ਹੋਤਾ ॥
291.e: When there was only the Immaculate Being, the Lord of beings,

291.g: ਤਹ ਬਿਨੁ ਮੈਲੁ; ਕਹਹੁ. ਕਿਆ ਧੋਤਾ ॥
291.e: there was no filth, so what was there to be washed clean?

291.g: ਜਹ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ; ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ਨਿਰਬਾਨ ॥
291.e: When there was only the Pure, Formless Lord in Nirvaanaa,

291.g: ਤਹ ਕਉਨ ਕਉ ਮਾਨ; ਕਉਨ ਅਭਿਮਾਨ ॥
291.e: then who was honored, and who was dishonored?

291.g: ਜਹ ਸਰੂਪ; ਕੇਵਲ ਜਗਦੀਸ ॥
291.e: When there was only the Form of the Lord of the Universe,

291.g: ਤਹ ਛਲ ਛਿਦ੍ਰ; ਲਗਤ ਕਹੁ ਕੀਸ ॥
291.e: then who was tainted by fraud and sin?

291.g: ਜਹ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਰੂਪੀ; ਜੋਤਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥
291.e: When the Embodiment of Light was immersed in His Own Light,

291.g: ਤਹ ਕਿਸਹਿ ਭੂਖ; ਕਵਨੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਵੈ ॥
291.e: then who was hungry, and who was satisfied?

291.g: ਕਰਨ ਕਰਾਵਨ; ਕਰਨੈਹਾਰੁ ॥
291.e: He is the Cause of causes, the Creator Lord.

291.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਕਰਤੇ ਕਾ; ਨਾਹਿ ਸੁਮਾਰੁ ॥੪॥
291.e: O Nanak, the Creator is beyond calculation. ||4||

291.g: ਜਬ ਅਪਨੀ ਸੋਭਾ; ਆਪਨ ਸੰਗਿ ਬਨਾਈ ॥
291.e: When His Glory was contained within Himself,

291.g: ਤਬ ਕਵਨ ਮਾਇ ਬਾਪ; ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਸੁਤ ਭਾਈ ॥
291.e: then who was mother, father, friend, child or sibling?

291.g: ਜਹ ਸਰਬ ਕਲਾ; ਆਪਹਿ ਪਰਬੀਨ ॥
291.e: When all power and wisdom was latent within Him,

291.g: ਤਹ ਬੇਦ ਕਤੇਬ; ਕਹਾ ਕੋਊ ਚੀਨ ॥
291.e: then where were the Vedas and the scriptures, and who was there to read them?

291.g: ਜਬ ਆਪਨ ਆਪੁ; ਆਪਿ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰੈ ॥
291.e: When He kept Himself, All-in-all, unto His Own Heart,

291.g: ਤਉ ਸਗਨ ਅਪਸਗਨ; ਕਹਾ ਬੀਚਾਰੈ ॥
291.e: then who considered omens to be good or bad?

291.g: ਜਹ ਆਪਨ ਊਚ; ਆਪਨ ਆਪਿ ਨੇਰਾ ॥
291.e: When He Himself was lofty, and He Himself was near at hand,

291.g: ਤਹ ਕਉਨ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ; ਕਉਨੁ ਕਹੀਐ ਚੇਰਾ ॥
291.e: then who was called master, and who was called disciple?

291.g: ਬਿਸਮਨ ਬਿਸਮ; ਰਹੇ ਬਿਸਮਾਦ ॥
291.e: We are wonder-struck at the wondrous wonder of the Lord.

291.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਅਪਨੀ ਗਤਿ; ਜਾਨਹੁ ਆਪਿ ॥੫॥
291.e: O Nanak, He alone knows His own state. ||5||

291.g: ਜਬ ਹੋਵਤ; ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇਵਲ ਧਨੀ ॥
291.e: When there was only God the Master,

291.g: ਤਬ ਬੰਧ ਮੁਕਤਿ; ਕਹੁ. ਕਿਸ ਕਉ ਗਨੀ ॥
291.e: then who was called bound or liberated?

291.g: ਜਬ ਏਕਹਿ; ਹਰਿ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
291.e: When there was only the Lord, Unfathomable and Infinite,

291.g: ਤਬ ਨਰਕ ਸੁਰਗ; ਕਹੁ ਕਉਨ ਅਉਤਾਰ ॥
291.e: then who entered hell, and who entered heaven?

291.g: ਜਬ ਨਿਰਗੁਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ; ਸਹਜ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
291.e: When God was without attributes, in absolute poise,

291.g: ਤਬ ਸਿਵ ਸਕਤਿ; ਕਹਹੁ ਕਿਤੁ ਠਾਇ ॥
291.e: then where was mind and where was matter - where was Shiva and Shakti?

291.g: ਜਬ ਆਪਹਿ ਆਪਿ; ਅਪਨੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਧਰੈ ॥
291.e: When He held His Own Light unto Himself,

291.g: ਤਬ ਕਵਨ ਨਿਡਰੁ; ਕਵਨ ਕਤ ਡਰੈ ॥
291.e: then who was fearless, and who was afraid?

291.g: ਆਪਨ ਚਲਿਤ; ਆਪਿ ਕਰਨੈਹਾਰ ॥
291.e: He Himself is the Performer in His own plays;

291.g: ਨਾਨਕ; ਠਾਕੁਰ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰ ॥੨॥
291.e: O Nanak, the Lord Master is Unfathomable and Infinite. ||2||

291.g: ਜਹ ਅਛਲ ਅਛੇਦ; ਅਭੇਦ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥
291.e: When the Undeceiveable, Impenetrable, Inscrutable One was self-absorbed,

291.g: ਊਹਾ; ਕਿਸਹਿ ਬਿਆਪਤ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
291.e: then who was swayed by Maya?

291.g: ਆਪਸ ਕਉ; ਆਪਹਿ ਆਦੇਸੁ ॥
291.e: When He paid homage to Himself,

291.g: ਤਿਹੁ ਗੁਣ ਕਾ; ਨਾਹੀ ਪਰਵੇਸੁ ॥
291.e: then the three qualities were not prevailing.

291.g: ਜਹ ਏਕਹਿ ਏਕ; ਏਕ ਭਗਵੰਤਾ ॥
291.e: When there was only the One, the One and Only Lord God,

291.g: ਤਹ ਕਉਨੁ ਅਚਿੰਤੁ; ਕਿਸੁ ਲਾਗੈ ਚਿੰਤਾ ॥
291.e: then who was not anxious, and who felt anxiety?

291.g: ਜਹ ਆਪਨ ਆਪੁ; ਆਪਿ ਪਤੀਆਰਾ ॥
291.e: When He Himself was satisfied with Himself,

291.g: ਤਹ ਕਉਨੁ ਕਥੈ; ਕਉਨੁ ਸੁਨਨੈਹਾਰਾ ॥
291.e: then who spoke and who listened?

291.g: ਬਹੁ ਬੇਅੰਤ; ਊਚ ਤੇ ਊਚਾ ॥
291.e: He is vast and infinite, the highest of the high.

291.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪਸ ਕਉ; ਆਪਹਿ ਪਹੂਚਾ ॥੬॥
291.e: O Nanak, He alone can reach Himself. ||6||

291.g: ਅਥ ਪ੍ਰਿਥਮੀ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਪਹਿ ਪੁਕਾਰਤ ਭਈ ॥
291.e: Earth’s prayer to Brahma:

291.g: ਸਵੈਯਾ ॥
291.e: SWAYYA

291.g: ਦਈਤਨ ਕੇ ਭਰ ਤੇ ਡਰ ਤੇ; ਜੁ ਭਈ ਪ੍ਰਿਥਮੀ ਬਹੁ ਭਾਰਹਿੰ ਭਾਰੀ ॥
ਗਾਇ ਕੋ ਰੂਪੁ ਤਬੈ ਧਰ ਕੈ; ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਰਿਖਿ ਪੈ ਚਲਿ ਜਾਇ ਪੁਕਾਰੀ ॥
291.e: When the earth was overburdened by the weight and fear of the demons, she assumed the form of a cow and went to the sage Brahma

291.g: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕਹਿਯੋ ਤੁਮ ਹੂੰ ਹਮ ਹੂੰ ਮਿਲਿ; ਜਾਹਿ ਤਹਾ ਜਹ ਹੈ ਬ੍ਰਤਿਧਾਰੀ ॥
ਜਾਇ ਕਰੈ ਬਿਨਤੀ ਤਿਹ ਕੀ; ਰਘੁਨਾਥ, ਸੁਨੋ ਇਹ ਬਾਤ ਹਮਾਰੀ ॥੯॥
291.e: Brahma said, “We two will go to the supreme Vishnu in order to request him to listen to our supplication.”9.

291.g: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕੋ ਅਗ੍ਰ ਸਭੈ ਧਰ ਕੈ; ਸੁ ਤਹਾ ਕੋ ਚਲੇ ਤਨ ਕੇ ਤਨੀਆ ॥
291.e: All the powerful people went there under the leadership of Brahma

291.g: ਤਬ ਜਾਇ ਪੁਕਾਰ ਕਰੀ ਤਿਹ ਸਾਮੁਹਿ ਰੋਵਤ ਤਾ ਮੁਨਿ ਜ︀ਯੋ ਹਨੀਆ ॥
291.e: The sages and others began to weep before the supreme Vishnu as if someone had beaten them

291.g: ਤਾ ਛਬਿ ਕੀ ਅਤਿ ਹੀ ਉਪਮਾ; ਕਬਿ ਨੇ ਮਨ ਭੀਤਰ ਯੌ ਗਨੀਆ ॥
291.e: The poet mentioning the beauty of that spectacle says that those people appeared

291.g: ਜਿਮ ਲੂਟੇ ਤੈ ਅਗ੍ਰਜ ਚਉਧਰੀ ਕੈ; ਕੁਟਵਾਰ ਪੈ ਕੂਕਤ ਹੈ ਬਨੀਆ ॥੧੦॥
291.e: Like a trader crying before a police officer having been plundered at the instance of the headman.10.

291.g: ਲੈ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਸੁਰ ਸੈਨ ਸਭੈ; ਤਹ ਦਉਰਿ ਗਏ, ਜਹ ਸਾਗਰ ਭਾਰੀ ॥
ਗਾਇ ਪ੍ਰਨਾਮ ਕਰੋ ਤਿਨ ਕੋ; ਅਪੁਨੇ ਲਖਿ ਬਾਰ ਨਿਵਾਰ ਪਖਾਰੀ ॥
291.e: Brahma reached the milk-ocean alongwith the gods and the forces and washed the feet of the supreme Vishnu with water

291.g: ਪਾਇ ਪਰੇ ਚਤੁਰਾਨਨ ਤਾਹਿ ਕੇ; ਦੇਖਿ ਬਿਮਾਨ ਤਹਾ ਬ੍ਰਤਿਧਾਰੀ ॥
ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕਹਿਯੋ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਕਹੁ ਜਾਹੁ; ਅਵਤਾਰ ਲੈ ਮੈ ਜਰ ਦੈਤਨ ਮਾਰੀ ॥੧੧॥
291.e: Seeing that supreme Immanent Lord, the four-headed Brahma fell at his feet whereupon the Lord said, “You may leave, I shall incarnate and destroy the demons.”11.

291.g: ਸ੍ਰਉਨਨ ਮੈ ਸੁਨਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕੀ ਬਾਤ; ਸਬੈ ਮਨ ਦੇਵਨ ਕੇ ਹਰਖਾਨੇ ॥
ਕੈ ਕੈ ਪ੍ਰਨਾਮ ਚਲੇ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਆਪਨ; ਲੋਕ ਸਭੈ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਕਰ ਮਾਨੇ ॥
291.e: Listening to the words of the Lord, all the gods were pleased and went back to their places after paying their obeisance to him

291.g: ਤਾ ਛਬਿ ਕੋ ਜਸੁ ਉਚ ਮਹਾ; ਕਬਿ ਨੇ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਮਨ ਮੈ ਪਹਿਚਾਨੇ ॥
ਗੋਧਨ ਭਾਤਿ ਗਯੋ ਸਭ ਲੋਕ; ਮਨੋ ਸੁਰ ਜਾਇ ਬਹੋਰ ਕੈ ਆਨੇ ॥੧੨॥
291.e: Visualising that spectacle the poet said that they were going back like a herd of cows.12.

291.g: ਆਪਨ ਖੇਲੁ; ਆਪਿ ਵਰਤੀਜਾ ॥
291.e: He Himself has staged His own drama;

291.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਕਰਨੈਹਾਰੁ; ਨ ਦੂਜਾ ॥੧॥
291.e: O Nanak, there is no other Creator. ||1||

291.g: ਜਹ ਆਪਿ ਰਚਿਓ; ਪਰਪੰਚੁ ਅਕਾਰੁ ॥
291.e: When He Himself fashioned the visible world of the creation,

291.g: ਤਿਹੁ ਗੁਣ ਮਹਿ; ਕੀਨੋ ਬਿਸਥਾਰੁ ॥
291.e: he made the world subject to the three dispositions.

291.g: ਪਾਪੁ ਪੁੰਨੁ; ਤਹ ਭਈ ਕਹਾਵਤ ॥
291.e: Sin and virtue then began to be spoken of.

291.g: ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਸੁਖ; ਆਪਨ ਆਸਨ ॥
291.e: When the Immortal Lord was seated at ease,

291.g: ਤਹ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ; ਕਹੁ ਕਹਾ ਬਿਨਾਸਨ ॥
291.e: then where was birth, death and dissolution?

291.g: ਜਬ ਪੂਰਨ ਕਰਤਾ; ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
291.e: When there was only God, the Perfect Creator,

291.g: ਤਬ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਤ੍ਰਾਸ; ਕਹਹੁ ਕਿਸੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
291.e: then who was afraid of death?

291.g: ਜਬ ਅਬਿਗਤ; ਅਗੋਚਰ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਏਕਾ ॥
291.e: When there was only the One Lord, unmanifest and incomprehensible,

291.g: ਤਬ ਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਗੁਪਤ; ਕਿਸੁ ਪੂਛਤ ਲੇਖਾ ॥
291.e: then who was called to account by the recording scribes of the conscious and the subconscious?

291.g: ਜਬ ਨਾਥ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ; ਅਗੋਚਰ ਅਗਾਧੇ ॥
291.e: When there was only the Immaculate, Incomprehensible, Unfathomable Master,

291.g: ਤਬ ਕਉਨ ਛੁਟੇ; ਕਉਨ ਬੰਧਨ ਬਾਧੇ ॥
291.e: then who was emancipated, and who was held in bondage?

291.g: ਆਪਨ ਆਪ; ਆਪ ਹੀ ਅਚਰਜਾ ॥
291.e: He Himself, in and of Himself, is the most wonderful.

291.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਆਪਨ ਰੂਪ; ਆਪ ਹੀ ਉਪਰਜਾ ॥੩॥
291.e: O Nanak, He Himself created His Own Form. ||3||

292.g: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ੍ਰ ਸਭ; ਤਾ ਕੈ ਹਾਥ ॥
292.e: All beings and creatures are in His Hands.
He is Merciful to the meek, the Patron of the patronless.

292.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਰਾਖੈ; ਤਿਸੁ. ਕੋਇ ਨ ਮਾਰੈ ॥
292.e: No one can kill those who are protected by Him.
One who is forgotten by God, is already dead.

292.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਤਜਿ; ਅਵਰ ਕਹਾ ਕੋ ਜਾਇ ॥
292.e: Leaving Him, where else could anyone go?
Over the heads of all is the One, the Immaculate King.

292.g: ਜੀਅ ਕੀ ਜੁਗਤਿ; ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸਭ ਹਾਥਿ ॥
292.e: The ways and means of all beings are in His Hands.
Inwardly and outwardly, know that He is with you.
He is the Ocean of excellence, infinite and endless.
Slave Nanak is forever a sacrifice to Him. ||2||
DOHRA

292.g: ਕੰਸ ਬਾਸਦੇਵੈ ਤਬੈ ਜੋਰਿਓ ਬ︀ਯਾਹ ਸਮਾਜ ॥
292.e: On this side Kansa and on that side Vasudev made arrangements for the marriage

292.g: ਪ੍ਰਸੰਨ ਭਏ ਸਭ ਧਰਨਿ ਮੈ; ਬਾਜਨ ਲਾਗੇ ਬਾਜ ॥੨੦॥
292.e: All the people of the world were filled with joy and the musical instruments were played.20.
SWAYYA

292.g: ਆਪਸ ਮੈ ਮਿਲਬੇ ਹਿਤ ਕਉ; ਦਲ ਸਾਜ ਚਲੇ ਧੁਜਨੀ ਪਤਿ ਐਸੇ ॥
ਲਾਲ ਕਰੇ ਪਟ ਪੈ ਡਰ ਕੇਸਰ; ਰੰਗ ਭਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਨਾ ਪਤਿ ਕੈਸੇ ॥
292.e: The forces of both sides moved for mutual union  all of them had tied red turbans and they looked very impressive filled with joy and gaiety

292.g: ਰੰਚਕ ਤਾ ਛਬਿ ਢੂੰਢਿ ਲਈ ਕਬਿ; ਨੈ ਮਨ ਕੇ ਫੁਨਿ ਭੀਤਰ ਮੈ ਸੇ ॥
ਦੇਖਨ ਕਉਤਕਿ ਬਿਆਹਹਿ ਕੋ; ਨਿਕਸੇ ਇਹੁ ਕੁੰਕੁਮ ਆਨੰਦ ਜੈਸੇ ॥੨੪॥
292.e: The poet briefly mentioning that beauty says that they seemed like the beds of saffron coming out of their abode in order to see this delightful spectacle of the wedding.24.

292.g: ਫਿਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਇਹ ਆਗਿਆ ਦਈ; ਦੇਵਨ ਸਕਲ ਬੁਲਾਇ ॥
ਜਾਇ ਰੂਪ ਤੁਮ ਹੂੰ ਧਰੋ; ਹਉ ਹੂੰ ਧਰਿ ਹੌ ਆਇ ॥੧੩॥
292.e: Then the Lord called all the gods and ordered them to incarnate before him.13.

292.g: ਬਾਤ ਸੁਨੀ ਜਬ ਦੇਵਤਨ; ਕੋਟਿ ਪ੍ਰਨਾਮ ਜੁ ਕੀਨ ॥
ਆਪ ਸਮੇਤ ਸੁ ਧਾਮੀਐ; ਲੀਨੇ ਰੂਪ ਨਵੀਨ ॥੧੪॥
292.e: When the gods heard this, they bowed and assumed the new forms of cowherds alongwith their wives.14.

292.g: ਰੂਪ ਧਰੇ ਸਭ ਸੁਰਨ ਯੌ; ਭੂਮਿ ਮਾਹਿ ਇਹ ਭਾਇ ॥
ਅਬ ਲੀਲਾ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਦੇਵਕੀ; ਮੁਖ ਤੇ ਕਹੋ ਸੁਨਾਇ ॥੧੫॥
292.e: In this way, all the gods assumed new forms on the earth and now I narrate the story of Devaki.15.

292.g: ਇਤਿ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਬਿਸਨੁ ਅਵਤਾਰ ਹ੍ਵੈਬੋ ਬਰਨਨੰ ਸਮਾਪਤੰ ॥
292.e: End of the description about the decision of Vishnu to incarnate.
KABIT

292.g: ਦੀਨੋ ਹੈ ਤਿਲਕੁ, ਜਾਇ ਭਾਲਿ ਬਸੁਦੇਵ ਜੂ ਕੇ; ਡਾਰਿਯੋ ਨਾਰੀਏਰ ਗੋਦ ਮਾਹਿ ਦੈ ਅਸੀਸ ਕੌ ॥
292.e: Putting a cocoanut in the lap of Vasudev and blessing him, a frontal mark was put on his forehead

292.g: ਦੀਨੀ ਹੈ ਬਡਾਈ, ਪੈ ਮਿਠਾਈ ਹੂੰ ਤੇ ਮੀਠੀ ਸਭ; ਜਨ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਈ ਅਉਰ ਈਸਨ ਕੇ ਈਸ ਕੌ ॥
292.e: He eulogized him, sweeter than the sweetmeats, which was even liked by the Lord

292.g: ਮਨ ਜੁ ਪੈ ਆਈ, ਸੋ ਤੋ ਕਹਿ ਕੈ ਸੁਨਾਈ; ਤਾ ਕੀ ਸੋਭਾ ਸਭ ਭਾਈ, ਮਨ ਮਧ ਘਰਨੀਸ ਕੋ ॥
292.e: Coming home, he fully appreciated him before the women of the house

292.g: ਸਾਰੇ ਜਗ ਗਾਈ, ਜਿਨਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਗਾਈ; ਸੋ ਤੋ ਏਕ ਲੋਕ ਕਹਾ, ਲੋਕ ਭੇਦੇ ਬੀਸ ਤੀਸ ਕੋ ॥੧੯॥
292.e: His praises were sung in the whole world, which echoed not only in this world but also penetrated into twenty thirty other regions.19.
DOHRA

292.g: ਰੀਤਿ ਬਰਾਤਿਨ ਦੁਲਹ ਕੀ; ਬਾਸੁਦੇਵ ਸਭ ਕੀਨ ॥
ਤਬੈ ਕਾਜ ਚਲਬੇ ਨਿਮਿਤ; ਮਥੁਰਾ ਮੈ ਮਨੁ ਦੀਨ ॥੨੨॥
292.e: Vasudev made all the preparations for wedding and made arrangements for going to Mathura.22.

292.g: ਬਾਸਦੇਵ ਕੋ ਆਗਮਨ; ਉਗ੍ਰਸੈਨ ਸੁਨਿ ਲੀਨ ॥
ਚਮੂ ਸਬੈ ਚਤੁਰੰਗਨੀ; ਭੇਜਿ ਅਗਾਊ ਦੀਨ ॥੨੩॥
292.e: When Ugarsain came to know of the arrival of Vasudev, he sent his four types of forces to welcome him, in advance.23.
Description of the Marriage of Devaki
SWAYYA

292.g: ਆਸਨਿ ਦਿਜਨ ਕੋ ਧਰ ਕੈ; ਤਰਿ ਤਾ ਕੋ ਨਵਾਇ ਲੈ ਜਾਇ ਬੈਠਾਯੋ ॥
ਕੁੰਕਮ ਕੋ ਘਸ ਕੈ ਕਰਿ ਪੁਰੋਹਿਤ; ਬੇਦਨ ਕੀ ਧੁਨਿ ਸਿਉ ਤਿਹ ਲਾਯੋ ॥
292.e: The seats were presented to Brahmins respectfully, who, reciting Vedic mantras and rubbing saffron etc. applied it on the forehead of Vasudev

292.g: ਡਾਰਤ ਫੂਲ ਪੰਚਾਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਅਛਤ; ਮੰਗਲਚਾਰ ਭਇਓ ਮਨ ਭਾਯੋ ॥
ਭਾਟ ਕਲਾਵੰਤ ਅਉਰ ਗੁਨੀ ਸਭ; ਲੈ ਬਖਸੀਸ ਮਹਾ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਯੋ ॥੨੧॥
292.e: They mixed also the flowers and panchamrit and sang songs of praise. On this occasion the ministrels, artists and talented persons eulogized them and received awards.21.

292.g: ਅਥ ਦੇਵਕੀ ਕੋ ਬਰੁ ਢੂੰਢਬੋ ਕਥਨੰ ॥
292.e: Now Begins the description about the search of the match for Devaki
DOHRA

292.g: ਜਬੈ ਭਈ ਵਹਿ ਕੰਨਿਕਾ; ਸੁੰਦਰ ਬਰ ਕੈ ਜੋਗੁ ॥
ਰਾਜ ਕਹੀ ਬਰ ਕੇ ਨਿਮਿਤ; ਢੂੰਢਹੁ ਅਪਨਾ ਲੋਗ ॥੧੭॥
292.e: When that beautiful girl reached the marriageable age, then the king asked his men to search for a suitable match for her.17.

292.g: ਦੂਤ ਪਠੇ ਤਿਨ ਜਾਇ ਕੈ; ਨਿਰਖ੍ਰਯੋ ਹੈ ਬਸੁਦੇਵ ॥
ਮਦਨ ਬਦਨ ਸੁਖ ਕੋ ਸਦਨੁ; ਲਖੈ ਤਤ ਕੋ ਭੇਵ ॥੧੮॥
292.e: The consul was sent, who approved the selection of Vasudev, whose face was like cupid and who was the abode of all comforts and master of discriminating intellect.18.
Ashtapadee:
He Himself is the speaker, and He Himself is the listener.
He Himself is the One, and He Himself is the many.

292.g: ਜਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ; ਤਾ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਉਪਾਏ ॥
292.e: When it pleases Him, He creates the world.
As He pleases, He absorbs it back into Himself.

292.g: ਤੁਮ ਤੇ ਭਿੰਨ; ਨਹੀ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
292.e: Without You, nothing can be done.
Upon Your thread, You have strung the whole world.

292.g: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀਉ; ਆਪਿ ਬੁਝਾਏ ॥
292.e: One whom God Himself inspires to understand
- that person obtains the True Name.
He looks impartially upon all, and he knows the essential reality.
O Nanak, he conquers the whole world. ||1||
DOHRA

292.g: ਕੰਸ ਅਉਰ ਬਸੁਦੇਵ ਜੂ; ਆਪਸਿ ਮੈ ਮਿਲਿ ਅੰਗ ॥
ਤਬੈ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਦੇਵਨ ਲਗੇ; ਗਾਰੀ ਰੰਗਾ ਰੰਗ ॥੨੫॥
292.e: Kansa and Vasudev hugged each other to his bosom and then began to shower gifts of various types of colourful satires.25.
The Perfect, Merciful Lord is pervading everywhere.
His kindness extends to all.
He Himself knows His own ways.
The Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts, is present everywhere.
He cherishes His living beings in so many ways.

292.g: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਰਚਿਓ; ਸੁ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਧਿਆਤਿ ॥
292.e: That which He has created meditates on Him.
Whoever pleases Him, He blends into Himself.

292.g: ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਹਿ; ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ॥
292.e: They perform His devotional service and sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.
With heart-felt faith, they believe in Him.
O Nanak, they realize the One, the Creator Lord. ||3||
The Lord's humble servant is committed to His Name.

292.g: ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਆਸ; ਨ ਬਿਰਥੀ ਜਾਇ ॥
292.e: His hopes do not go in vain.
The servant's purpose is to serve;
obeying the Lord's Command, the supreme status is obtained.
Beyond this, he has no other thought.
Within his mind, the Formless Lord abides.
His bonds are cut away, and he becomes free of hatred.
Night and day, he worships the Feet of the Guru.
He is at peace in this world, and happy in the next.
SORTHA

292.g: ਦੁੰਦਭਿ ਤਬੈ ਬਜਾਇ; ਆਏ ਜੋ ਮਥੁਰਾ ਨਿਕਟਿ ॥
ਤਾ ਛਬਿ ਕੋ ਨਿਰਖਾਇ; ਹਰਖ ਭਇਓ ਹਰਿਖਾਇ ਕੈ ॥੨੬॥
292.e: Beating their drums, they came near Mathura and all the people were pleased to see their elegance.26.
Salok:

292.g: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਕੇ ਠਾਕੁਰਾ; ਆਪੇ ਵਰਤਣਹਾਰ ॥
292.e: O Lord and Master of all beings and creatures, You Yourself are prevailing everywhere.

292.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਏਕੋ ਪਸਰਿਆ; ਦੂਜਾ ਕਹ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਾਰ ॥੧॥
292.e: O Nanak, The One is All-pervading; where is any other to be seen? ||1||
Some have gone to hell, and some yearn for paradise.
Worldly snares and entanglements of Maya,
egotism, attachment, doubt and loads of fear;
pain and pleasure, honor and dishonor
these came to be described in various ways.
He Himself creates and beholds His own drama.
He winds up the drama, and then, O Nanak, He alone remains. ||7||
Wherever the Eternal Lord's devotee is, He Himself is there.
He unfolds the expanse of His creation for the glory of His Saint.
He Himself is the Master of both worlds.
His Praise is to Himself alone.
He Himself performs and plays His amusements and games.
He Himself enjoys pleasures, and yet He is unaffected and untouched.

292.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ; ਤਿਸੁ. ਆਪਨ ਨਾਇ ਲਾਵੈ ॥
292.e: He attaches whomever He pleases to His Name.
He causes whomever He pleases to play in His play.
He is beyond calculation, beyond measure, uncountable and unfathomable.

292.g: ਜਿਉ ਬੁਲਾਵਹੁ; ਤਿਉ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਬੋਲੈ ॥੮॥੨੧॥
292.e: As You inspire him to speak, O Lord, so does servant Nanak speak. ||8||21||
Now begins the description about the Birth of Devaki
DOHRA

292.g: ਉਗ੍ਰਸੈਨ ਕੀ ਕੰਨਿਕਾ; ਨਾਮ ਦੇਵਕੀ ਤਾਸ ॥
ਸੋਮਵਾਰ ਦਿਨ ਜਠਰ ਤੇ; ਕੀਨੋ ਤਾਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਸ ॥੧੬॥
292.e: The birth of the daughter of Ugrasain named Devaki took place on Monday.16.

292.g: ਇਤਿ ਦੇਵਕੀ ਕੋ ਜਨਮ ਬਰਨਨੰ ਪ੍ਰਿਥਮ ਧਿਆਇ ਸਮਾਪਤਮ ॥
292.e: End of the first Chapter regarding the description about the Birth of Devaki.

293.e: SWAYYA

293.g: ਆਵਤ ਕੋ ਸੁਨਿ ਕੈ ਬਸੁਦੇਵਹਿ; ਰੂਪ ਸਜੇ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਤਨਿ ਨਾਰੀ ॥
ਗਾਵਤ ਗੀਤ ਬਜਾਵਤ ਤਾਲਿ; ਦਿਵਾਵਤਿ ਆਵਤ ਨਾਗਰਿ ਗਾਰੀ ॥
293.e: Hearing the arrival of Vasudev, all the bedecked women began to sing in tune and showered satires on the coming marriage party

293.g: ਕੋਠਨ ਪੈ ਨਿਰਖੈ ਚੜਿ ਤਾਸਨਿ; ਤਾ ਛਬਿ ਕੀ ਉਪਮਾ ਜੀਅ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
ਬੈਠਿ ਬਿਵਾਨ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਸਮੇਤ ਸੁ; ਦੇਖਤ ਦੇਵਨ ਕੀ ਮਹਤਾਰੀ ॥੨੭॥
293.e: The poet, mentioning the beauty of the women seeing from their roofs said that they appeared like the mothers of the gods seeing the marriage party from their airvehicles.27.
DOHRA

293.g: ਉਗ੍ਰਸੈਨ ਤਬ ਕੰਸ ਕੋ; ਲਯੋ ਹਜੂਰਿ ਬੁਲਾਇ ॥
ਕਹਿਓ ਸਾਥ ਤੁਮ ਜਾਇ ਕੈ; ਦੇਹੁ ਭੰਡਾਰੁ ਖੁਲਾਇ ॥੨੯॥
293.e: Then Ugarsain called Kansa near him and said, “Go and open the doors of the stores for charity.”29.

293.g: ਅਉਰ ਸਮਗਰੀ ਅੰਨ ਕੀ; ਲੈ ਜਾ ਤਾ ਕੇ ਪਾਸਿ ॥
ਕਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਨਾਮੁ ਤਾ ਕੋ ਤਬੈ; ਇਉ ਕਰਿਯੋ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥੩੦॥
293.e: Bringing the materials like corn etc. and bowing down, he requested Vasudev thus.30.

293.g: ਕਾਲ ਰਾਤ੍ਰ ਕੋ ਬ︀ਯਾਹ ਹੈ ਕੰਸਹਿ ਕਹੀ ਸੁਨਾਇ ॥
ਬਾਸੁਦੇਵ ਪੁਰੋਹਿਤ ਕਹੀ; ਭਲੀ ਜੁ ਤੁਮੈ ਸੁਹਾਇ ॥੩੧॥
293.e: Kansa said, “The marriage has been fixed for the night of Amavas (the dark night) ” on this the priest of Vasudev gave his acceptance saying “as you please”.31.

293.g: ਕੰਸ ਕਹਿਓ ਕਰਿ ਜੋਰਿ ਤਬ; ਸਬੈ ਬਾਤ ਕੋ ਭੇਵ ॥
ਸਾਧਿ ਸਾਧਿ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਕਹਿਯੋ; ਅਸ ਮਾਨੀ ਬਸੁਦੇਵ ॥੩੨॥
293.e: Then coming on this side, Kansa with folded hands related all the happenings and when the Pundits came to know that the people of vasudev had accepted the date and time of wedding, then all gave their blessings to him within their minds.32.

293.g: ਤਿਸ ਤੇ ਦੂਰਿ; ਕਹਾ ਕੋ ਜਾਇ ॥
293.e: Where can anyone go, to get away from Him?
Meditating on the Protector Lord, you shall be saved.
Meditating on the Fearless Lord, all fear departs.
By God's Grace, mortals are released.

293.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਰਾਖੈ; ਤਿਸੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਦੂਖ ॥
293.e: One who is protected by God never suffers in pain.
Chanting the Naam, the mind becomes peaceful.
Anxiety departs, and ego is eliminated.

293.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਕਉ; ਕੋਇ ਨ ਪਹੁਚਨਹਾਰੁ ॥
293.e: No one can equal that humble servant.
The Brave and Powerful Guru stands over his head.
O Nanak, his efforts are fulfilled. ||7||
Salok:

293.g: ਗਿਆਨ ਅੰਜਨੁ. ਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਆ; ਅਗਿਆਨ ਅੰਧੇਰ ਬਿਨਾਸੁ ॥
293.e: The Guru has given the healing ointment of spiritual wisdom, and dispelled the darkness of ignorance.

293.g: ਹਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ. ਸੰਤ ਭੇਟਿਆ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਮਨਿ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ॥੧॥
293.e: By the Lord's Grace, I have met the Saint; O Nanak, my mind is enlightened. ||1||
KABIT

293.g: ਗਾਵਤ ਬਜਾਵਤ ਸੁ ਗਾਰਨ ਦਿਵਾਖਤ; ਆਵਤ ਸੁਹਾਵਤ ਹੈ ਮੰਦ ਮੰਦ ਗਾਵਤੀ ॥
293.e: The women singing and playing their musical instruments and chanting their satirical songs look very impressive

293.g: ਕੇਹਰਿ ਸੀ ਕਟਿ, ਅਉ ਕੁਰੰਗਨ ਸੇ ਦ੍ਰਿਗ ਜਾ ਕੇ; ਗਜ ਕੈਸੀ ਚਾਲ ਮਨ ਭਾਵਤ ਸੁ ਆਵਤੀ ॥
293.e: They have slim waist like lions, eyes like does and gait like elephants.

293.g: ਮੋਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਚਉਕਿ ਕਰੇ, ਲਾਲਨ ਕੇ ਖਾਰੇ ਧਰੇ; ਬੈਠੇ ਤਬੈ ਦੋਊ ਦੂਲਹਿ ਦੁਲਹੀ ਸੁਹਾਵਤੀ ॥
293.e: Within the square of gems and on the seats of diamonds and jewels, the bride and bridegroom both look splendid

293.g: ਬੇਦਨ ਕੀ ਧੁਨਿ ਕੀਨੀ, ਬਹੁ ਦਛਨਾ ਦਿਜਨ ਦੀਨੀ; ਲੀਨੀ ਸਾਤ ਭਾਵਰੈ ਜੋ ਭਾਵਤੇ ਸੋਭਾਵਤੀ ॥੩੫॥
293.e: Within the chanting of Vedic mantras and giving and taking of religious gifts, the marriage ceremony was completed with seven matrimonial rounds by God’s will. 35.
DOHRA

293.g: ਰਾਤਿ ਭਏ ਬਸੁਦੇਵ ਜੂ; ਕੀਨੋ ਤਹਾ ਬਿਲਾਸ ॥
ਪ੍ਰਾਤ ਭਏ ਉਠ ਕੈ ਤਬੈ; ਗਇਓ ਸਸੁਰ ਕੇ ਪਾਸਿ ॥੩੬॥
293.e: During the night Vasudev stayed at some place and getting up in the morning, he went to meet his father-in-law Ugarsain.36.

293.g: ਮਤਿ ਪੂਰੀ; ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ॥
293.e: His wisdom is perfect, and His Glance is Ambrosial.
Beholding His Vision, the universe is saved.
His Lotus Feet are incomparably beautiful.
The Blessed Vision of His Darshan is fruitful and rewarding; His Lordly Form is beautiful.
Blessed is His service; His servant is famous.
The Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts, is the most exalted Supreme Being.

293.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਬਸੈ; ਸੁ ਹੋਤ ਨਿਹਾਲੁ ॥
293.e: That one, within whose mind He abides, is blissfully happy.

293.g: ਤਾ ਕੈ ਨਿਕਟਿ; ਨ ਆਵਤ ਕਾਲੁ ॥
293.e: Death does not draw near him.
One becomes immortal, and obtains the immortal status,
meditating on the Lord, O Nanak, in the Company of the Holy. ||8||22||
SWAYYA

293.g: ਰਾਤਿ ਬਿਤੀਤ ਭਈ ਅਰ ਪ੍ਰਾਤਿ; ਭਈ ਫਿਰਿ ਰਾਤਿ ਤਬੈ ਚੜਿ ਆਏ ॥
ਛਾਡਿ ਦਏ ਹਥਿ ਫੂਲ ਹਜਾਰ ਦੋ; ਊਭੁਚ ਪ੍ਰਯੋਧਰ ਐਸਿ ਫਿਰਾਏ ॥
293.e: The night passed, the day dawned and again the night fell and then during that night, the fireworks were displayed, scattering the colour of thousands of flowers

293.g: ਅਉਰ ਹਵਾਈ ਚਲੀ ਨਭ ਕੋ ਉਪਮਾ ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਕਬਿ ਸ︀ਯਾਮ ਸੁਨਾਏ ॥
ਦੇਖਹਿ ਕਉਤਕ ਦੇਵ ਸਬੈ; ਤਿਹ ਤੇ ਮਨੋ ਕਾਗਦ ਕੋਟਿ ਪਠਾਏ ॥੩੩॥
293.e: Seeing the flying fireworks in the sky, the poet Shyam says this figuratively that it appear to him that the gods were flying the citadels of paper in the sky, seeing this miracle.33.

293.g: ਲੈ ਬਸੁਦੇਵ ਕੋ ਅਗ੍ਰ ਪੁਰੋਹਿਤ; ਕੰਸਹਿ ਕੇ ਚਲਿ ਧਾਮ ਗਏ ਹੈ ॥
ਆਗੇ ਤੇ ਨਾਰਿ ਭਈ ਇਕ ਲੇਹਿਸ; ਗਾਗਰ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਡਾਰਿ ਦਏ ਹੈ ॥
293.e: The priests taking Vasudev with them, are going towards the home of Kansa and seeing a beautiful woman in front of them, the Pundits caused her metallic pitcher to fall

293.g: ਡਾਰਿ ਦਏ ਲਡੂਆ ਗਹਿ ਝਾਟਨਿ; ਤਾ ਕੋ ਸੋਊ ਵੇ ਤੋ ਭਛ ਗਏ ਹੈ ॥
ਜਾਦਵ ਬੰਸ ਦੁਹੂੰ ਦਿਸ ਤੇ ਸੁਨਿ; ਕੈ ਸੁ ਅਨੇਕਿਕ ਹਾਸ ਭਏ ਹੈ ॥੩੪॥
293.e: From which the sweetmeats have fallen out with a jerk  they have taken up and eaten these sweetmeats   knowing all about it, both the sides of Yadava clan have been ridiculed in various ways.34.
Ashtapadee:
In the Society of the Saints, I see God deep within my being.
God's Name is sweet to me.
All things are contained in the Heart of the One,
although they appear in so many various colors.

293.g: ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ; ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
293.e: The nine treasures are in the Ambrosial Name of God.
Within the human body is its place of rest.
The Deepest Samaadhi, and the unstruck sound current of the Naad are there.
The wonder and marvel of it cannot be described.
He alone sees it, unto whom God Himself reveals it.
O Nanak, that humble being understands. ||1||
O Nanak, the Lord God unites him with Himself. ||4||
DOHRA

293.g: ਕੰਸ ਲਵਾਏ ਜਾਤ ਤਿਨਿ; ਸਕਲ ਪ੍ਰਬਲ ਦਲ ਸਾਜਿ ॥
ਆਗੇ ਤੇ ਸ੍ਰਵਨਨ ਸੁਨੀ; ਬਿਧ ਕੀ ਅਸੁਭ ਅਵਾਜ ॥੩੮॥
293.e: When Kansa was going with all the forces, he heard, on going forward, an invisible and inauspicious voice.38.
KABIT

293.g: ਬਾਸੁਦੇਵ ਆਇਓ ਰਾਜੈ ਮੰਡਲ ਬਨਾਇਓ; ਮਨਿ ਮਹਾ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਇਓ ਤਾ ਕੋ ਆਨਨ ਨਿਰਖ ਕੈ ॥
293.e: On the arrival of Vasudev, the king got the pavilion constructed, and he was very much pleased on seeing his beautiful face

293.g: ਸੁਗੰਧਿ ਲਗਾਯੋ ਰਾਗ ਗਾਇਨਨ ਗਾਯੋ; ਤਿਸੈ ਬਹੁਤ ਦਿਵਾਯੋ ਬਰ ਲਿਆਯੋ ਜੋ ਪਰਖ ਕੈ ॥
293.e: The fragrances were sprinkled on all  the songs were sung and consul who had approved the selection, was greatly awarded

293.g: ਛਾਤੀ ਹਾਥ ਲਾਯੋ ਸੀਸ ਨਿਆਯੋ ਉਗ੍ਰਸੈਨ ਤਬੈ; ਆਦਰ ਪਠਾਯੋ ਪੂਜ ਮਨ ਮੈ ਹਰਖ ਕੈ ॥
293.e: Ugarsain worshipped the match by putting his hand on his breast, joyfully bowing his head and getting pleased in his mind

293.g: ਭਯੋ ਜਨੁ ਮੰਗਨ ਨ ਭੂਮਿ ਪਰ ਬਾਦਰ ਸੋ; ਰਾਜਾ ਉਗ੍ਰਸੈਨ ਗਯੋ ਕੰਚਨ ਬਰਖ ਕੈ ॥੨੮॥
293.e: At this time the king Ugarsain appeared like the heavenly cloud showering gold, he gave in charity innumerable gold coins to the beggars.28.
Embellish both this world and the next;
enshrine the Lord's Name deep within your heart.
Perfect are the Teachings of the Perfect Guru.

293.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਬਸੈ; ਤਿਸੁ ਸਾਚੁ ਪਰੀਖਿਆ ॥
293.e: That person, within whose mind it abides, realizes the Truth.

293.g: ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ; ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
293.e: With your mind and body, chant the Naam; lovingly attune yourself to it.

293.g: ਦੂਖੁ ਦਰਦੁ; ਮਨ ਤੇ ਭਉ ਜਾਇ ॥
293.e: Sorrow, pain and fear shall depart from your mind.
Deal in the true trade, O trader,
and your merchandise shall be safe in the Court of the Lord.
Keep the Support of the One in your mind.
O Nanak, you shall not have to come and go in reincarnation again. ||6||
SWAYYA

293.g: ਸਾਜ ਸਮੇਤ ਦਏ ਗਜ ਆਯੁਤ ਸੁ; ਅਉਰ ਦਏ ਤ੍ਰਿਗੁਣੀ ਰਥਨਾਰੇ ॥
ਲਛ ਭਟੰ ਦਸ ਲਛ ਤੁਰੰਗਮ; ਊਟ ਅਨੇਕ ਭਰੇ ਜਰ ਭਾਰੇ ॥
293.e: Bedecked elephants and horses and threefold chariots were given (in marriage), one lakh warriors, ten lakhs of horses and many camels laden with gold were given

293.g: ਛਤੀਸ ਕੋਟ ਦਏ ਦਲ ਪੈਦਲ; ਸੰਗਿ ਕਿਧੋ ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਰਖਵਾਰੇ ॥
ਕੰਸ ਤਬੈ ਤਿਹ ਰਾਖਨ ਕਉ; ਮਨੋ ਆਪ ਭਏ ਰਥ ਕੇ ਹਕਵਾਰੇ ॥੩੭॥
293.e: Thirty-six crores of soldiers on foot were given, who seemed to be given for the protection of all and Kansa himself became the charioteer of Devaki and Vasudev and for the protection of all.37.
The Infinite Lord is inside, and outside as well.
Deep within each and every heart, the Lord God is pervading.
In the earth, in the Akaashic ethers, and in the nether regions of the underworld
in all worlds, He is the Perfect Cherisher.
The heavenly speech addressed to Kansa:
KABIT

293.g: ਦੁਖ ਕੋ ਹਰਿਨ ਬਿਧ, ਸਿਧਿ ਕੇ ਕਰਨ ਰੂਪ; ਮੰਗਲ ਧਰਨ ਐਸੋ ਕਹਿਯੋ ਹੈ ਉਚਾਰ ਕੈ ॥
293.e: The Lord, remover of suffering, performer of austerities for great powers and bestower of prosperity, said through the heavenly speech,

293.g: ਲੀਏ ਕਹਾ ਜਾਤ, ਤੇਰੋ ਕਾਲ ਹੈ ਰੇ ਮੂੜ ਮਤਿ, ਆਠਵੋ ਗਰਭ ਯਾ ਕੋ ਤੋ ਕੋ ਡਾਰੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਹੈ ॥
293.e: “O fool! where are you taking your death? The eighth son of this (Devaki) will be the cause of your death
Join the Company of the Holy, and be happy.
Sing the Glories of God, the embodiment of supreme bliss.
Contemplate the essence of the Lord's Name.
Redeem this human body, so difficult to obtain.

293.g: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਚਨ; ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਉ ॥
293.e: Sing the Ambrosial Words of the Lord's Glorious Praises;
this is the way to save your mortal soul.
Behold God near at hand, twenty-four hours a day.
Ignorance shall depart, and darkness shall be dispelled.
Listen to the Teachings, and enshrine them in your heart.
O Nanak, you shall obtain the fruits of your mind's desires. ||5||

294.e: DOHRA

294.g: ਕੰਸ ਦੋਹੂੰ ਕੇ ਬਧ ਨਮਿਤ; ਲੀਨੋ ਖੜਗ ਨਿਕਾਰਿ ॥
ਬਾਸੁਦੇਵ ਅਰੁ ਦੇਵਕੀ; ਡਰੇ ਦੋਊ ਨਰ ਨਾਰਿ ॥੪੦॥
294.e: Kansa took out his sword in order to kill both of them and seeing this both husband and wife were frightened.40.
Speech of Kansa in his mind:
DOHRA

294.g: ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਹੇਤ ਕੇ ਭਾਵ ਸੌ; ਮਤਿ ਇਹ ਜਾਇ ਛਪਾਇ ॥
ਬੰਦੀਖਾਨੈ ਦੇਉ ਇਨ; ਇਹੈ ਬਿਚਾਰੀ ਰਾਇ ॥੪੨॥
294.e: May it not happen that under the impact of her affection for her son, she may hide offspring from me, therefore I feel that they may be imprisoned.42.

294.g: ਇਸ ਤੇ ਹੋਇ; ਸੁ. ਨਾਹੀ ਬੁਰਾ ॥
294.e: If it comes from Him, it cannot be bad.
Other than Him, who can do anything?
He Himself is good; His actions are the very best.
He Himself knows His Own Being.
He Himself is True, and all that He has established is True.
Through and through, He is blended with His creation.

294.g: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ; ਕਹੀ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
294.e: His state and extent cannot be described.
If there were another like Him, then only he could understand Him.
His actions are all approved and accepted.
By Guru's Grace, O Nanak, this is known. ||7||

294.g: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕਾ; ਪੇਖਨੁ ਸਭੁ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ॥
294.e: In the eye of the Saint, everything is God.

294.g: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੈ; ਹਿਰਦੈ ਸਭਿ ਧਰਮ ॥
294.e: In the heart of the Saint, everything is Dharma.
The Saint hears words of goodness.
He is absorbed in the All-pervading Lord.

294.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਜਾਤਾ; ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਇਹ ਰਹਤ ॥
294.e: This is the way of life of one who knows God.
True are all the words spoken by the Holy.

294.g: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਹੋਇ; ਸੋਈ ਸੁਖੁ ਮਾਨੈ ॥
294.e: Whatever happens, he peacefully accepts.
He knows God as the Doer, the Cause of causes.
He dwells inside, and outside as well.
O Nanak, beholding the Blessed Vision of His Darshan, all are fascinated. ||4||
See Him in the Vedas, the Puraanas and the Simritees.
In the moon, the sun and the stars, He is the One.

294.g: ਬਾਣੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ; ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਬੋਲੈ ॥
294.e: The Bani of God's Word is spoken by everyone.
He Himself is unwavering - He never wavers.
With absolute power, He plays His play.
His value cannot be estimated; His virtues are invaluable.

294.g: ਸਰਬ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਹਿ; ਜਾ ਕੀ ਜੋਤਿ ॥
294.e: In all light, is His Light.
The Lord and Master supports the weave of the fabric of the universe.
By Guru's Grace, doubt is dispelled.
O Nanak, this faith is firmly implanted within. ||3||
Description about the Imprisonment of Devaki and Vasudev
SWAYYA

294.g: ਡਾਰਿ ਜੰਜੀਰ ਲਏ ਤਿਨ ਪਾਇਨ; ਪੈ ਫਿਰਿ ਕੈ ਮਥੁਰਾ ਮਹਿ ਆਯੋ ॥
ਸੋ ਸੁਨਿ ਕੈ ਸਭ ਲੋਗ ਕਥਾ; ਅਤਿ ਨਾਮ ਬੁਰੋ ਜਗ ਮੈ ਨਿਕਰਾਯੋ ॥
294.e: Putting chains in their feet Kansa brought them back to Mathura and when the people came to know about it, they greatly talked ill of Kansa

294.g: ਆਨਿ ਰਖੈ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਆਪਨ ਮੈ; ਰਖਵਾਰੀ ਕੋ ਸੇਵਕ ਲੋਗ ਬੈਠਾਯੋ ॥
ਆਨਿ ਬਡੇਨ ਕੀ ਛਾਡਿ ਦਈ; ਕੁਲ ਭੀਤਰ ਆਪਨੋ ਰਾਹ ਚਲਾਯੋ ॥੪੩॥
294.e: Kansa dept them imprisoned in his own house and forsaking the traditions of his elders, he engaged servants to keep a watch over them and bound them to submit to his orders, remaining fully under his control.43.

294.g: ਪ੍ਰਥਮ ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਦੇਵਕੀ ਕੇ ਜਨਮ ਕਥਨੰ ॥
294.e: Description of the birth of the first son of Devaki
DOHRA
In all forms, He Himself is pervading.
Through all eyes, He Himself is watching.
All the creation is His Body.
He Himself listens to His Own Praise.
The One has created the drama of coming and going.
He made Maya subservient to His Will.
In the midst of all, He remains unattached.

294.g: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਹਣਾ; ਸੁ ਆਪੇ ਕਹੈ ॥
294.e: Whatever is said, He Himself says.
By His Will we come, and by His Will we go.

294.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਜਾ ਭਾਵੈ; ਤਾ ਲਏ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੬॥
294.e: O Nanak, when it pleases Him, then He absorbs us into Himself. ||6||

294.g: ਜੋ ਜਾਨੈ; ਤਿਸੁ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
294.e: One who knows Him, obtains everlasting peace.
God blends that one into Himself.
He is wealth and prosperous, and of noble birth.
He is Jivan Mukta - liberated while yet alive; the Lord God abides in his heart.
Blessed, blessed, blessed is the coming of that humble being;
Speech of the poet: DOHRA

294.g: ਕਿਤਕ ਦਿਵਸ ਬੀਤੇ ਜਬੈ; ਕੰਸ ਰਾਜ ਉਤਪਾਤ ॥
ਤਬੈ ਕਥਾ ਅਉਰੈ ਚਲੀ; ਕਰਮ ਰੇਖ ਕੀ ਬਾਤ ॥੪੪॥
294.e: Many days passed during the tyrannical rule of Kansa and in this way, according to the line of fate, the story took a new turn.44.
Speech of Vasudev addressed to Kansa:
DOHRA

294.g: ਬਾਸਦੇਵ ਡਰੁ ਮਾਨ ਕੈ; ਤਾ ਸੋ ਕਹੀ ਸੁਨਾਇ ॥
ਜੋ ਯਾ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਜਨਮ ਹੈ; ਮਾਰਹੁ ਤਾਕਹੁ ਰਾਇ ॥੪੧॥
294.e: Absorbed in fear, Vasudev said to Kansa, “Do not kill Devaki, but O king! whosoever will be born to her, you may kill him.”41.
In the forests, fields and mountains, He is the Supreme Lord God.
As He orders, so do His creatures act.
He permeates the winds and the waters.
He is pervading in the four corners and in the ten directions.

294.g: ਤਿਸ ਤੇ ਭਿੰਨ; ਨਹੀ ਕੋ ਠਾਉ ॥
294.e: Without Him, there is no place at all.
By Guru's Grace, O Nanak, peace is obtained. ||2||

294.g: ਅਚਰਜ ਮਾਨ ਲੀਨੋ, ਮਨ ਮੈ ਬਿਚਾਰ ਇਹ; ਕਾਢ ਕੈ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਨ ਡਾਰੋ ਇਨ ਹੀ ਸੰਘਾਰਿ ਕੈ ॥
294.e: Being greatly astonished Kansa ruminated in his mind whether they be killed by taking out the sword

294.g: ਜਾਹਿੰਗੇ ਛਪਾਇ ਕੈ, ਸੁ ਜਾਨੀ ਕੰਸ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ; ਇਹੈ ਬਾਤ ਭਲੀ ਡਾਰੋ ਜਰ ਹੀ ਉਖਾਰਿ ਕੈ ॥੩੯॥
294.e: Till what time, this fact will be kept concealed? And he will be able to save himself? Therefore, he will be within his right to destroy instantly this very root of fear.39.
He Himself is True, and all that He has made is True.
The entire creation came from God.
As it pleases Him, He creates the expanse.
As it pleases Him, He becomes the One and Only again.
His powers are so numerous, they cannot be known.
As it pleases Him, He merges us into Himself again.
Who is near, and who is far away?
He Himself is Himself pervading everywhere.
One whom God causes to know that He is within the heart
- O Nanak, He causes that person to understand Him. ||5||

295.e: SWAYYA

295.g: ਲੈ ਕਰਿ ਤਾਤ ਕੋ ਤਾਤ ਚਲਿਯੋ; ਜਬ ਹੀ ਨ੍ਰਿਪ ਕੈ ਦਰ ਊਪਰ ਆਇਓ ॥
ਜਾਇ ਕਹਿਯੋ ਦਰਵਾਨਨ ਸੋ; ਤਿਨ ਬੋਲਿ ਕੈ ਭੀਤਰ ਜਾਇ ਜਨਾਇਓ ॥
295.e: When the father reached the gate of the palace, he asked the gatekeeper to inform Kansa about it

295.g: ਕੰਸ ਕਰੀ ਕਰੁਨਾ ਸਿਸੁ ਦੇਖਿ; ਕਹਿਓ ਹਮ ਹੂੰ ਤੁਮ ਕੋ ਬਖਸਾਇਓ ॥
ਫੇਰ ਚਲਿਓ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਕੋ ਬਸੁਦੇਵ; ਤਊ ਮਨ ਮੈ ਕਛੁ ਨ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਓ ॥੪੬॥
295.e: Seeing the baby and taking pity Kansa said, “I have forgiven you.” Vasudev started back to his house, but there was no cheerfulness in his mind.46.
SWAYYA

295.g: ਪਾਚਵੋ ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਭਯੋ ਸੁਨਿ ਕੰਸ ਸੁ; ਪਾਥਰ ਸੋ ਹਨਿ ਮਾਰਿ ਦਯੋ ਹੈ ॥
ਸ੍ਵਾਸ ਗਯੋ ਨਭਿ ਕੇ ਮਗ ਮੈ; ਤਨ ਤਾ ਕੋ ਕਿਧੌ ਜਮੁਨਾ ਮੈ ਗਯੋ ਹੈ ॥
295.e: Hearing about the birth of fifth son, Kansa also killed him by dashing him against the store  the soul of the infant went to heaven and his body was merged in the flowing current

295.g: ਸੋ ਸੁਨਿ ਕੈ ਪੁਨਿ ਸ੍ਰੋਨਨ ਦੇਵਕੀ; ਸੋਕ ਸੋ ਸਾਸ ਉਸਾਸ ਲਯੋ ਹੈ ॥
ਮੋਹ ਭਯੋ ਅਤਿ ਤਾ ਦਿਨ ਮੈ; ਮਨੋ ਯਾਹੀ ਤੇ ਮੋਹ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਸ ਭਯੋ ਹੈ ॥੫੩॥
295.e: Hearing this, Devaki began to sigh and because of the attachment she experienced such a great anguish that she appeared to have given birth to the attachment itself.53.
The most sublime hymns are the Words of the Holy.
These are priceless rubies and gems.
One who listens and acts on them is saved.
He himself swims across, and saves others as well.

295.g: ਸਫਲ ਜੀਵਨੁ; ਸਫਲੁ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਸੰਗੁ ॥
295.e: His life is prosperous, and his company is fruitful;

295.g: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਲਾਗਾ; ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ॥
295.e: his mind is imbued with the love of the Lord.
Hail, hail to him, for whom the sound current of the Shabad vibrates.

295.g: ਸੁਨਿ ਸੁਨਿ ਅਨਦ ਕਰੇ; ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਗਾਜੈ ॥
295.e: Hearing it again and again, he is in bliss, proclaiming God's Praises.
The Lord radiates from the foreheads of the Holy.
Nanak is saved in their company. ||3||

295.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਉਸਤਤਿ; ਕਰਹੁ ਸੰਤ ਮੀਤ ॥
295.e: Sing the Praises of God, O Saints, O friends,
with total concentration and one-pointedness of mind.
Sukhmani is the peaceful ease, the Glory of God, the Naam.

295.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਬਸੈ; ਸੁ ਹੋਤ ਨਿਧਾਨ ॥
295.e: When it abides in the mind, one becomes wealthy.

295.g: ਸਰਬ ਇਛਾ; ਤਾ ਕੀ ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
295.e: All desires are fulfilled.
One becomes the most respected person, famous all over the world.
He obtains the highest place of all.
He does not come and go in reincarnation any longer.

295.g: ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਖਾਟਿ ਚਲੈ; ਜਨੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
295.e: One who departs, after earning the wealth of the Lord's Name,
O Nanak, realizes it. ||5||
Comfort, peace and tranquility, wealth and the nine treasures;
wisdom, knowledge, and all spiritual powers;
learning, penance, Yoga and meditation on God;
End of the description regarding the killing of the sixth son.
Speech of Kansa address to his servants:
SWAYYA

295.g: ਬਾਤ ਸੁਨੀ ਜਬ ਨਾਰਦ ਕੀ ਇਹ; ਤੋ ਨ੍ਰਿਪ ਕੇ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ਭਈ ਹੈ ॥
ਮਾਰਹੁ ਜਾਇ ਇਸੈ ਅਬ ਹੀ ਕਰਿ; ਭ੍ਰਿਤਨ ਨੈਨ ਕੀ ਸੈਨ ਦਈ ਹੈ ॥
295.e: When the king listened to the speech of Narada, it went deeper into his mind  he told his servants with signs to kill the infant immediately

295.g: ਦਉਰਿ ਗਏ ਤਿਹ ਆਇਸੁ ਮਾਨ ਕੈ; ਬਾਤ ਇਹੈ ਚਲਿ ਲੋਗ ਗਈ ਹੈ ॥
ਪਾਥਰ ਪੈ ਹਨਿ ਕੈ ਘਨ ਜਿਉ; ਬਪੁ ਜੀਵਹਿ ਤੇ ਕਰਿ ਭਿੰਨ ਲਈ ਹੈ ॥੪੯॥
295.e: Receiving his order all (the servants) ran away and they dashed the baby against a store like a hammer, separated the soul from the body.49.
Killing of the first son
SWAYYA

295.g: ਅਉਰ ਭਯੋ ਸੁਤ ਜੋ ਤਿਹ ਕੇ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ; ਤਉ ਨ੍ਰਿਪ ਕੰਸ ਮਹਾ ਮਤਿ ਹੀਨੋ ॥
ਸੇਵਕ ਭੇਜ ਦਏ ਤਿਨ ਲਿਆਇ ਕੈ; ਪਾਥਰ ਪੈ ਹਨਿ ਕੈ ਫੁਨਿ ਦੀਨੋ ॥
295.e: Another son who was born to Devaki and Vasudev, who was also killed on the orders of Kans of vicious intellenct, by his servants by dashing him on the store  the dead body was given back to the parents

295.g: ਸੋਰ ਪਰਿਯੋ ਸਬ ਹੀ ਪੁਰ ਮੈ; ਕਬਿ ਨੈ ਤਿਹ ਕੋ ਜਸੁ ਇਉ ਲਖਿ ਲੀਨੋ ॥
ਇੰਦ੍ਰ ਮੂਓ ਸੁਨਿ ਕੈ ਰਨ ਮੈ; ਮਿਲ ਕੈ ਸੁਰ ਮੰਡਲ ਰੋਦਨ ਕੀਨੋ ॥੫੦॥
295.e: Hearing about this heinous crime, there was great uproar in the whole city and this tumult appeared to the poet like the cries of gods on the death of Indra.50.

295.g: ਅਉਰ ਭਯੋ ਸੁਤ ਜੋ ਤਿਹ ਕੇ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ; ਨਾਮ ਧਰਿਓ ਤਿਹ ਕੋ ਤਿਨ ਹੂੰ ਜੈ ॥
ਮਾਰ ਦਯੋ ਸੁਨਿ ਕੈ ਨ੍ਰਿਪ ਕੰਸ ਸੁ; ਪਾਥਰ ਪੈ ਹਨਿ ਡਾਰਿਓ ਖੂੰਜੈ ॥
295.e: Another son was born in their house who was named Jaya, but he was also dashed against the stone by the king Kansa

295.g: ਸੀਸ ਕੇ ਬਾਰ ਉਖਾਰਤ ਦੇਵਕੀ; ਰੋਦਨ ਚੋਰਨ ਤੈ ਘਰਿ ਗੂੰਜੈ ॥
ਜਿਉ ਰੁਤਿ ਅੰਤੁ ਬਸੰਤ ਸਮੈ; ਨਭਿ ਕੋ ਜਿਮ ਜਾਤ ਪੁਕਾਰਤ ਕੂੰਜੈ ॥੫੧॥
295.e: Devaki began to pull out the hair of her head and began to cry like the bird called Karauncha in the sky in the spring season.51.
Hearing that He can give Sanctuary, I have come seeking His Sanctuary.
Bestowing His Mercy, God has blended me with Himself.

295.g: ਮਿਟਿ ਗਏ ਬੈਰ; ਭਏ ਸਭ ਰੇਨ ॥
295.e: Hatred is gone, and I have become the dust of all.
I have received the Ambrosial Naam in the Company of the Holy.
The Divine Guru is perfectly pleased;
the service of His servant has been rewarded.
I have been released from worldly entanglements and corruption,
hearing the Lord's Name and chanting it with my tongue.
By His Grace, God has bestowed His Mercy.
O Nanak, my merchandise has arrived save and sound. ||4||

295.g: ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਭਇਓ ਦੇਵਕੀ ਕੈ; ਕੀਰਤਿ ਮਤ ਤਿਹ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
ਬਾਸੁਦੇਵ ਲੈ ਤਾਹਿ ਕੌ; ਗਯੋ ਕੰਸ ਕੈ ਧਾਮ ॥੪੫॥
295.e: The first son named Kiratmat was born to Devaki and Vasudev took him to the house of Kansa.45.
Speech regarding the supplication of Devaki:
KABIT

295.g: ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਭਇਓ ਛਠੋ ਬੰਸ, ਸੋ ਭੀ ਮਾਰਿ ਡਾਰਿਓ ਕੰਸ; ਦੇਵਕੀ ਪੁਕਾਰੀ ਨਾਥ, ਬਾਤ ਸੁਨਿ ਲੀਜੀਐ ॥
ਕੀਜੀਐ ਅਨਾਥ ਨ ਸਨਾਥ, ਮੇਰੇ ਦੀਨਾਨਾਥ, ਹਮੈ ਮਾਰ ਦੀਜੀਐ, ਕਿ ਯਾ ਕੋ ਮਾਰ ਦੀਜੀਐ ॥
295.e: When the sixth son was also killed by Kansa, Devaki prayed thus to God, “O Master of the lowly! either kill us or kill Kansa

295.g: ਕੰਸ ਬਡੋ ਪਾਪੀ, ਜਾ ਕੋ ਲੋਭ ਭਯੋ ਜਾਪੀ; ਸੋਈ ਕੀਜੀਐ ਹਮਾਰੀ ਦਸਾ ਜਾ ਤੇ ਸੁਖੀ ਜੀਜੀਐ ॥
ਸ੍ਰੋਨਨ ਮੈ ਸੁਨਿ, ਅਸਵਾਰੀ ਗਜ ਵਾਰੀ ਕਰੋ; ਲਾਈਐ ਨ ਢੀਲ ਅਬ ਦੋ ਮੈ ਏਕ ਕੀਜੀਐ ॥੫੪॥
295.e: “Kansa is a great sinner, whom the people consider as their king and whom they remember  O Lord! Put him in the same condition as Thou hast put us   I have heard that Thou didst save the life of the elephant    do not delay now, be kind to do any one of t
Happiness, intuitive peace, poise and bliss
in the Company of the Holy, meditate on the Lord of supreme bliss.
You shall be spared from hell - save your soul!
Drink in the ambrosial essence of the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe.
Focus your consciousness on the One, the All-pervading Lord

295.g: ਏਕ ਰੂਪ; ਜਾ ਕੇ ਰੰਗ ਅਨੇਕ ॥
295.e: He has One Form, but He has many manifestations.
Sustainer of the Universe, Lord of the world, Kind to the poor,
Destroyer of sorrow, perfectly Merciful.
Meditate, meditate in remembrance on the Naam, again and again.
O Nanak, it is the Support of the soul. ||2||
by his grace, the whole world is saved.
This is his purpose in life;

295.g: ਜਨ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ; ਚਿਤਿ ਆਵੈ ਨਾਉ ॥
295.e: in the Company of this humble servant, the Lord's Name comes to mind.
He Himself is liberated, and He liberates the universe.

295.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਕਉ; ਸਦਾ ਨਮਸਕਾਰੁ ॥੮॥੨੩॥
295.e: O Nanak, to that humble servant, I bow in reverence forever. ||8||23||
Ashtapadee:
Listen to the Teachings of the Perfect Guru;
see the Supreme Lord God near you.
With each and every breath, meditate in remembrance on the Lord of the Universe,
and the anxiety within your mind shall depart.
Abandon the waves of fleeting desire,

295.g: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਧੂਰਿ; ਮਨ ਮੰਗ ॥
295.e: and pray for the dust of the feet of the Saints.
Renounce your selfishness and conceit and offer your prayers.
In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, cross over the ocean of fire.

295.g: ਹਰਿ ਧਨ ਕੇ; ਭਰਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਭੰਡਾਰ ॥
295.e: Fill your stores with the wealth of the Lord.
Nanak bows in humility and reverence to the Perfect Guru. ||1||
Speech of the sage Narada address to Kansa:
DOHRA

295.g: ਤਬ ਮੁਨਿ ਆਯੋ ਕੰਸ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ; ਕਹੀ ਬਾਤ ਸੁਨਿ ਰਾਇ ॥
ਅਸਟ ਲੀਕ ਕਰ ਕੈ ਗਨੀ; ਦੀਨੋ ਭੇਦ ਬਤਾਇ ॥੪੮॥
295.e: Then the sage Narada came to Kansa and drawing eight lines before him, he told him some mysterious things.48.
KABIT

295.g: ਚਉਥੋ ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਭਇਓ, ਸੋ ਭੀ ਕੰਸ ਮਾਰ ਦਇਓ; ਤਿਹ ਸੋਕ ਬੜਵਾ ਕੀ ਲਾਟੈ ਮਨ ਮੈ ਜਗਤ ਹੈ ॥
295.e: The fourth son was born and he was also killed by Kansa  the flames of sorrow blazed in the hearts of Devaki and Vasudev

295.g: ਪਰੀ ਹੈਗੀ ਦਾਸੀ, ਮਹਾ ਮੋਹ ਹੂੰ ਕੀ ਫਾਸੀ ਬੀਚ; ਗਈ ਮਿਟ ਸੋਭਾ ਪੈ ਉਦਾਸੀ ਹੀ ਪਗਤ ਹੈ ॥
295.e: All the beauty of Devaki was finished by the noose of great attachment around her neck and she was drowned in great anguish

295.g: ਕੈਧੋ ਤੁਮ ਨਾਥ ਹ੍ਵੈ, ਸਨਾਥ ਹਮ ਹੂੰ ਪੈ ਹੂੰਜੈ; ਪਤਿ ਕੀ ਨ ਗਤਿ ਔਰ ਤਨ ਕੀ ਨ ਗਤਿ ਹੈ ॥
295.e: She says, “O my God! what type of Lord Thou art and what type of protected people we are? We have neither received any honour nor have got any physical protection

295.g: ਭਈ ਉਪਹਾਸੀ, ਦੇਹ ਪੂਤਨ ਬਿਨਾਸੀ; ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਤੇਰੀ ਹਾਸੀ ਨ ਹਮੈ ਗਾਸੀ ਸੀ ਲਗਤ ਹੈ ॥੫੨॥
295.e: Because of the death of our son, we are also being ridiculed, O Immortal Lord! such a cruel joke by you is sharply stinging us like an arrow.”52.
Speech of Vasudev in his mind:
DOHRA

295.g: ਬਾਸੁਦੇਵ ਮਨ ਆਪਨੇ; ਕੀਨੋ ਇਹੈ ਬਿਚਾਰ ॥
ਕੰਸ ਮੂੜ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਬਡੋ; ਯਾ ਕੌ ਡਰਿ ਹੈ ਮਾਰਿ ॥੪੭॥
295.e: Vasudev thought in his mind that Kansa was a man of vicious intellect, with fear, he will definitely kill the infant.47.
Salok:

295.g: ਪੂਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਰਾਧਿਆ; ਪੂਰਾ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਨਾਉ ॥
295.e: I worship and adore the Perfect Lord God. Perfect is His Name.

295.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਇਆ; ਪੂਰੇ ਕੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਉ ॥੧॥
295.e: O Nanak, I have obtained the Perfect One; I sing the Glorious Praises of the Perfect Lord. ||1||

296.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਬਸੈ; ਸੁਨੈ ਲਾਇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ॥
296.e: One, within whose mind it abides, and who listens to it with love

296.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਆਵੈ; ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਚੀਤਿ ॥
296.e: that humble person consciously remembers the Lord God.

296.g: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ; ਤਾ ਕਾ ਦੂਖੁ ਨਿਵਾਰੈ ॥
296.e: The pains of birth and death are removed.

296.g: ਦੁਲਭ ਦੇਹ; ਤਤਕਾਲ ਉਧਾਰੈ ॥
296.e: The human body, so difficult to obtain, is instantly redeemed.

296.g: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਸੋਭਾ; ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਬਾਨੀ ॥
296.e: Spotlessly pure is his reputation, and ambrosial is his speech.

296.g: ਏਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ; ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਨੀ ॥
296.e: The One Name permeates his mind.

296.g: ਦੂਖ ਰੋਗ; ਬਿਨਸੇ ਭੈ ਭਰਮ ॥
296.e: Sorrow, sickness, fear and doubt depart.

296.g: ਸਾਧ ਨਾਮ; ਨਿਰਮਲ ਤਾ ਕੇ ਕਰਮ ॥
296.e: He is called a Holy person; his actions are immaculate and pure.

296.g: ਸਭ ਤੇ ਊਚ; ਤਾ ਕੀ ਸੋਭਾ ਬਨੀ ॥
296.e: His glory becomes the highest of all.

296.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਇਹ ਗੁਣਿ; ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਖਮਨੀ ॥੮॥੨੪॥
296.e: O Nanak, by these Glorious Virtues, this is named Sukhmani, Peace of mind. ||8||24||

296.g: ਦੋਹਰਾ ॥
296.e: DOHRA

296.g: ਕ੍ਰਿਸਨ ਕ੍ਰਿਸਨ ਕਰਿ ਸਾਧ ਦੋ; ਬਿਸਨੁ ਕਿਸਨ ਪਤਿ ਜਾਸੁ ॥
ਕ੍ਰਿਸਨ ਬਿਸ੍ਵ ਤਰਬੇ ਨਿਮਿਤ; ਤਨ ਮੈ ਕਰਿਯੋ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਸ ॥੫੬॥
296.e: Both Devaki and Vasudev, began to remember Vishnu, the lord of Lakshmi with extreme saintliness and here Vishnu entered and enlightened the body of Devaki in order to redeem the world darkened by vices.56.

296.g: ਦੋਹਰਾ ॥
296.e: DOHRA

296.g: ਕ੍ਰਿਸਨ ਜਬੈ ਤਿਨ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਭਯੋ; ਬਾਸੁਦੇਵ ਇਹ ਕੀਨ ॥
ਦਸ ਹਜਾਰ ਗਾਈ ਭਲੀ; ਮਨੈ ਮਨਸਿ ਕਰਿ ਦੀਨ ॥੬੪॥
296.e: On the birth of Krishna, Vasudev, in his mind, gave in charity ten thousand cows for the protection of Krishna.64.

296.g: ਅਥ ਕ੍ਰਿਸਨ ਜਨਮ ॥
296.e: Now begins the description about the Birth of Krishna

296.g: ਸਵੈਯਾ ॥
296.e: SWAYYA

296.g: ਸੰਖ ਗਦਾ ਕਰਿ ਅਉਰ ਤ੍ਰਿਸੂਲ; ਧਰੇ ਤਨਿ ਕਉਚ ਬਡੇ ਬਡਭਾਗੀ ॥
ਨੰਦ ਗਹੈ ਕਰਿ ਸਾਰੰਗ ਸਾਰੰਗ; ਪੀਤ ਧਰੈ ਪਟ ਪੈ ਅਨੁਰਾਗੀ ॥
296.e: Vishnu appeared in the womb of sleeping Devaki (in the form of Krishna) in yellow dress, wearing armour on body and holding conch, mace, trident, sword and bow in his hands

296.g: ਸੋਈ ਹੁਤੀ ਜਨਮਿਉ ਇਹ ਕੇ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ; ਕੈ ਡਰਪੈ ਮਨ ਮੈ ਉਠਿ ਜਾਗੀ ॥
ਦੇਵਕੀ ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਨ ਜਾਨਿਯੋ ਲਖਿਓ; ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਕੈ ਪ੍ਰਨਾਮ ਸੁ ਪਾਇਨ ਲਾਗੀ ॥੫੭॥
296.e: Devaki was terrified, she awoke and sat down  she did not know that a son had been born to her   seeing Vishnu apparently, she bowed at his feet.57.

296.g: ਗਿਆਨੁ ਸ੍ਰੇਸਟ; ਊਤਮ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ॥
296.e: The most sublime wisdom and purifying baths;

296.g: ਚਾਰਿ ਪਦਾਰਥ; ਕਮਲ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ॥
296.e: the four cardinal blessings, the opening of the heart-lotus;

296.g: ਸਭ ਕੈ ਮਧਿ; ਸਗਲ ਤੇ ਉਦਾਸ ॥
296.e: in the midst of all, and yet detached from all;

296.g: ਸੁੰਦਰੁ ਚਤੁਰੁ; ਤਤ ਕਾ ਬੇਤਾ ॥
296.e: beauty, intelligence, and the realization of reality;

296.g: ਸਮਦਰਸੀ; ਏਕ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟੇਤਾ ॥
296.e: to look impartially upon all, and to see only the One

296.g: ਇਹ ਫਲ; ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਕੈ ਮੁਖਿ ਭਨੇ ॥
296.e: - these blessings come to one who,

296.g: ਗੁਰ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮ ਬਚਨ; ਮਨਿ ਸੁਨੇ ॥੬॥
296.e: through Guru Nanak, chants the Naam with his mouth, and hears the Word with his ears. ||6||

296.g: ਇਹੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ; ਜਪੈ ਮਨਿ ਕੋਇ ॥
296.e: One who chants this treasure in his mind

296.g: ਸਭ ਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ; ਤਾ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
296.e: in every age, he attains salvation.

296.g: ਗੁਣ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ; ਨਾਮ ਧੁਨਿ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
296.e: In it is the Glory of God, the Naam, the chanting of Gurbani.

296.g: ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ; ਬੇਦ ਬਖਾਣੀ ॥
296.e: The Simritees, the Shaastras and the Vedas speak of it.

296.g: ਸਗਲ ਮਤਾਂਤ; ਕੇਵਲ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ॥
296.e: The essence of all religion is the Lord's Name alone.

296.g: ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਭਗਤ ਕੈ; ਮਨਿ ਬਿਸ੍ਰਾਮ ॥
296.e: It abides in the minds of the devotees of God.

296.g: ਕੋਟਿ ਅਪ੍ਰਾਧ; ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਟੈ ॥
296.e: Millions of sins are erased, in the Company of the Holy.

296.g: ਸੰਤ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਤੇ; ਜਮ ਤੇ ਛੁਟੈ ॥
296.e: By the Grace of the Saint, one escapes the Messenger of Death.

296.g: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਮਸਤਕਿ; ਕਰਮ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਪਾਏ ॥
296.e: Those, who have such pre-ordained destiny on their foreheads,

296.g: ਸਾਧ ਸਰਣਿ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਤੇ ਆਏ ॥੭॥
296.e: O Nanak, enter the Sanctuary of the Saints. ||7||

296.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
296.e: Pauree:

296.g: ਏਕਮ. ਏਕੰਕਾਰੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ; ਕਰਉ ਬੰਦਨਾ ਧਿਆਇ ॥
296.e: The first day of the lunar cycle: Bow in humility and meditate on the One, the Universal Creator Lord God.

296.g: ਗੁਣ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਗੁਪਾਲ ਪ੍ਰਭ; ਸਰਨਿ ਪਰਉ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇ ॥
296.e: Praise God, the Lord of the Universe, the Sustainer of the World; seek the Sanctuary of the Lord, our King.

296.g: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਆਸ. ਕਲਿਆਣ ਸੁਖ; ਜਾ ਤੇ ਸਭੁ ਕਛੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
296.e: Place your hopes in Him, for salvation and peace; all things come from Him.

296.g: ਚਾਰਿ ਕੁੰਟ ਦਹ ਦਿਸਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਿਓ; ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ. ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
296.e: I wandered around the four corners of the world and in the ten directions, but I saw nothing except Him.

296.g: ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਨ ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਸੁਨੇ; ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਕਰਉ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
296.e: I listened to the Vedas, the Puraanas and the Simritees, and I pondered over them in so many ways.

296.g: ਪਤਿਤ ਉਧਾਰਨ. ਭੈ ਹਰਨ; ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ॥
296.e: The Saving Grace of sinners, the Destroyer of fear, the Ocean of peace, the Formless Lord.

296.g: ਦਾਤਾ ਭੁਗਤਾ ਦੇਨਹਾਰੁ; ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ. ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
296.e: The Great Giver, the Enjoyer, the Bestower - there is no place at all without Him.

296.g: ਜੋ ਚਾਹਹਿ ਸੋਈ ਮਿਲੈ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਇ ॥੧॥
296.e: You shall obtain all that you desire, O Nanak, singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||1||

296.g: ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਈਐ; ਹਰਿ ਨੀਤ ॥
296.e: Sing the Praises of the Lord, the Lord of the Universe, each and every day.

296.g: ਮਿਲਿ ਭਜੀਐ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ; ਮੇਰੇ ਮੀਤ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
296.e: Join the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, and vibrate, meditate on Him, O my friend. ||1||Pause||

296.g: ਅਥ ਬਲਭਦ੍ਰ ਜਨਮ ॥
296.e: Now begins the description about the Birth of Balbhadra

296.g: ਸਵੈਯਾ ॥
296.e: SWAYYA

296.g: ਜੋ ਬਲਭਦ੍ਰ ਭਯੋ ਗਰਭਾਤਰ; ਤੌ ਦੁਹੰ ਬੈਠਿ ਕੈ ਮੰਤ੍ਰ ਕਰਿਓ ਹੈ ॥
ਤਾ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਮੰਤ੍ਰ ਕੇ ਜੋਰ ਸੋ ਕਾਢਿ ਕੈ; ਰੋਹਿਨੀ ਕੇ ਉਰ ਬੀਚ ਧਰਿਓ ਹੈ ॥
296.e: When balbhadra was conceived, Devaki and Vasudev sat to hold consultations and with the power of mantras, he was transferred from the womb of Devaki to the womb of Rohini

296.g: ਕੰਸ ਕਦਾਚ ਹਨੇ ਸਿਸੁ ਕੋ; ਤਿਹ ਤੇ ਮਨ ਮੈ ਬਸੁਦੇਵ ਡਰਿਓ ਹੈ ॥
ਸੇਖ ਮਨੋ ਜਗ ਦੇਖਨ ਕੋ; ਜਗ ਭੀਤਰ ਰੂਪ ਨਵੀਨ ਕਰਿਓ ਹੈ ॥੫੫॥
296.e: Thinking that Kansa may also kill him, Vasudev was frightened. It seemed that Sheshanaga had assumed a new form in order to see the world.55.

296.g: ਸਵੈਯਾ ॥
296.e: SWAYYA

296.g: ਕੰਸਹਿ ਕੇ ਡਰ ਤੇ ਬਸੁਦੇਵ; ਸੁ ਪਾਇ ਜਬੈ ਜਮੁਨਾ ਮਧਿ ਠਾਨੋ ॥
ਮਾਨ ਕੈ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਪੁਰਾਤਨ ਕੋ; ਜਲ ਪਾਇਨ ਭੇਟਨ ਕਾਜ ਉਠਾਨੋ ॥
296.e: Because of the fear of Kansa, when Vasudev put his feet in Yamuna it surged up to touch the feet of Krishna

296.g: ਤਾ ਛਬਿ ਕੋ ਜਸੁ ਉਚ ਮਹਾ; ਕਬਿ ਨੇ ਅਪਨੇ ਮਨ ਮੈ ਪਹਿਚਾਨੋ ॥
ਕਾਨ੍ਰਹ ਕੋ ਜਾਨ ਕਿਧੋ ਪਤਿ ਹੈ; ਇਹ ਕੈ ਜਮੁਨਾ ਤਿਹ ਭੇਟਤ ਮਾਨੋ ॥੬੭॥
296.e: Recognising in its mind some old affection  the poet felt thus about the high praise of that elegance that considering Krishna her Lord, Yamuna rose up to touch his feet.67.

296.g: ਸਵੈਯਾ ॥
296.e: SWAYYA

296.g: ਛੂਟਿ ਕਿਵਾਰ ਗਏ ਘਰਿ ਕੇ; ਦਰਿ ਕੇ ਨ੍ਰਿਪ ਕੇ ਬਰ ਕੇ ਚਲਤੇ ॥
ਹਰਖੇ ਸਰਖੇ ਬਸੁਦੇਵਹਿ ਕੇ; ਪਗ ਜਾਇ ਛੁਹਿਓ ਜਮਨਾ ਜਲ ਤੇ ॥
296.e: When Vasudev started, the doors of the house opened, his feet began to move further and went to enter Yamuna  the water of Yamuna came forward to see Krishna

296.g: ਹਰਿ ਦੇਖਨ ਕੌ ਹਰਿ ਅਉ ਬਢ ਕੇ; ਹਰਿ ਦਉਰ ਗਏ ਤਨ ਕੇ ਬਲ ਤੇ ॥
ਕਾਜ ਇਹੀ ਕਹਿ ਦੋਊ ਗਏ; ਜੁ ਖਿਝੈ ਬਹੁ ਪਾਪਨ ਕੀ ਮਲ ਤੇ ॥੬੫॥
296.e: Sheshanaga powerfully ran forward, he spread his hoods and waved them like fly-whisk and alongwith it the waters of Yamuna and Sheshanaga both conveyed to Krishna about the increasing dirt of sin in the world.65.

296.e: T'hitee ~ The Lunar Days: Gauree, Fifth Mehl,

296.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

296.e: The Creator Lord and Master is pervading the water, the land, and the sky.

296.e: In so many ways, the One, the Universal Creator has diffused Himself, O Nanak. ||1||

296.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
296.e: Pauree:
